For untold years, superstitions have persisted in the northwestern Auburn Forest that a giant frog monster haunts the quiet bog. Though many believe the tales to be no more than attention-seeking fibbery, there is an unexpected truth behind this legend...
多年以來，Auburn Forest 西北方一直流傳著一個迷信：有一隻巨大的蛙形怪物盤據在那片寂靜的沼澤。許多人認為那不過是嘩眾取寵的胡謅，但這個傳說背後，藏著一個誰也沒料到的真相……

Atop of the Tower of Ascension stands a being who claims to be Death himself. While such claims are a lie, it can't be ignored that the imposter has horrendous amounts of power, from an unknown source.
Tower of Ascension 的頂端站著一個自稱死神的存在。這個說法當然是假的，但不容忽視的是，這名冒牌貨確實握有駭人的力量——而那力量從何而來，無人知曉。
The river dividing the two forests has acted as a barrier against the Decay for decades. Using her powers, Lari has single handedly kept the Decay from spreading further south.
分隔兩座森林的那條河，數十年來一直是抵擋黯蝕的屏障。Lari 憑一己之力運用她的力量，阻止了黯蝕繼續向南蔓延。
In the year 854 AP (After Portal), a massive horde of undead led by Bak'al attacked Ragni. The people of the city sought refuge in the sewer, the only safe place left.
開門後 854 年 (AP)，Bak'al 率領的不死大軍襲擊了 Ragni。城裡的人躲進下水道——那是唯一還安全的地方。
House Nasin once held nearly unparalleled prestige. Gale's departure, around 200 years ago however, was a blow that House Nasin is just now beginning to recover from.
House Nasin 曾享有幾乎無人能及的聲望。但大約兩百年前 Gale 的離去是重重一擊，直到今日，House Nasin 才剛開始復原。
Just as the darkness infiltrated Gavel, the Light was able to protect the physical bodies of the miners in Lutho by erecting this Monolith.
黑暗滲入 Gavel 的同時，光憑著豎起這座巨石碑，護住了 Lutho 礦工們的肉身。
Once, the people of Hyloch had a Sovereign who cared to hear their thoughts and opinions. When Majin took the mantle, that changed.
Hyloch 的人民曾經有過一位願意傾聽他們想法與意見的統領。Majin 接下王位之後，一切都變了。
The miners soon discovered there were more than emeralds in the walls of this mountain range - Something from out of this world.
礦工們很快就發現，這片山脈的岩壁裡不只有綠寶石——還有某種不屬於這個世界的東西。
The drive for emeralds among the Villagers was so great, they excavated nearly all currency in the province. The search for more led the Villagers to explore beyond the sea.
村民對綠寶石的渴求極為強烈，幾乎把整個行省的通貨都挖了出來。為了尋找更多，他們開始向海的另一端探索。
Much like their other outposts, they Skyraiders were forced to abandon their strongest defence after pressure from the Villager Forces
一如其他的前哨站，天空劫掠者在村民軍隊的壓力下，也被迫放棄了他們最堅固的防線。
The great library of Aldwell is used to store texts detailing the ancient history of the village and the surrounding forest, stories that are usually privy only to a select few.
Aldwell 的大圖書館收藏著記載這座村莊與周邊森林古老歷史的典籍——那些故事，通常只有極少數人有幸得知。
Desperate to leave the terrible living conditions of the Roughworks, a group a daring inventors created a plan to escape Fruma. They became the first humans settlers on the island of Corkus.
為了逃離 Roughworks 惡劣的生活環境，一群大膽的發明家策劃了一場出走，離開 Fruma。他們成了 Corkus 島上第一批人類移民。
Suffering from the cryptic Decay, Northern Gavel is slowly withering away. Its ominous downfall has caused the Villagers of Llevigar to become increasingly superstitious.
北 Gavel 飽受神祕的黯蝕之苦，正一點一點凋零。這場不祥的衰敗，也讓 Llevigar 的村民愈來愈迷信。
The corrupt entity known as Bak'al has appeared countless times since the portal was opened, decimating everything in his path.
自從傳送門開啟以來，那個名為 Bak'al 的腐敗存在已經現身無數次，所經之處無一倖免。
A once great city of Akias was reduced to rubble in 347 AP (After Portal) in one of the largest attacks by Bak'al ever documented. There was only one survivor.
曾經繁華的 Akias 城，在開門後 347 年(AP)毀於一場有史以來記載最慘烈的 Bak'al 襲擊，化為一片瓦礫。只有一個人活了下來。
Just the name of Bak'al is enough to make many cower in fear. They say that wherever he appears, he will only leave death in his wake.
光是 Bak'al 這個名字，就足以讓許多人瑟縮發抖。人們說，他所到之處，只會留下死亡。
This cavern is evidence that corruption is like a weed. The roots spread throughout the province.
這座洞窟證明了腐敗就像野草一樣：根，早已蔓延到整個行省。
No one breaks the utmost laws of Aldorei without exilement. Those who fall in the eyes of the High Elves are banished, never to return. Outcasted from their land, they were forced to find a new home.
在 Aldorei，觸犯最高律法的人一律流放。凡是失去高等精靈信任者，都會被驅逐，永不得歸。被逐出故土之後，他們只能另尋新家。
Attacks from the portal were often so brutal, it forced people underground. Sometimes, they never made it back out.
從傳送門而來的攻擊往往極其殘暴，逼得人們躲進地底。有時候，他們再也沒能出來。
The Emperor's 26th son was named Hashr. As he grew older, he became wrought with greed and envy of his father's power. It wasn't long before he was willing to kill.
皇帝的第二十六個兒子名叫 Hashr。隨著年紀漸長，他被貪婪與對父親權力的嫉妒吞噬。沒過多久，他就已經願意為此殺人。

Nii, Az, Tol, Uth, Ek. These words of power once held great weight in Fruma, though their meaning has been lost, and only scattered shards of context remain - records fill the shelves, artifacts line the walls, and unfinished carvings lie abandoned on their workstations...
Nii、Az、Tol、Uth、Ek。這些力量之詞曾在 Fruma 舉足輕重，如今含義已然失傳，只留下零星的線索——書架上堆滿記錄、牆邊排列著器物、未完成的雕刻被遺棄在工作檯上……

Although the canyon tends to shift and destroy the livelihoods of those who live here, it is not enough to hold back the refugees of the dark forests, preferring the canyon's instability to the Decay.
峽谷時常移位，摧毀住在這裡的人的生計，但這仍攔不住從黑暗森林逃來的難民——比起黯蝕，他們寧可忍受峽谷的不穩。
Because of their immense power, dragons were captured by dwarves and forced to do their bidding. Currently there is only one known living dragon remaining.
由於力量過於強大，龍族被矮人擒獲，被迫聽命行事。如今已知仍存活的龍，只剩一頭。
Left behind by the Fracturing, this intriguing ruin is thought to have been part of a second Colossus - though it is currently unknown how this one came to be.
這座耐人尋味的遺跡是「碎裂」留下的，一般認為它曾是第二尊巨像的一部分——但它究竟是怎麼來的，至今仍無人知曉。
The origins of the colorful crystals is well known, though the power that they hold and their purpose is a mystery that has driven many to the brink of insanity.
這些多彩水晶的來歷眾所周知，但它們蘊含的力量與存在的目的始終是個謎，已經有許多人為此走到了瘋狂的邊緣。
Earthquakes form cracks bursting with mystical energy throughout the canyon. These cracks grow with each quake, and eventually, may lead to a catastrophe.
地震在峽谷各處撕開裂縫，湧出神祕的能量。每震一次，裂縫就擴大一分——總有一天，可能釀成大禍。

Nemract was one of the cities attacked most often. The people would hide in the gutters and sewers until it was over. However, corrupt enemies were not without intelligence, and they were quickly discovered by the enemy.
Nemract 是最常遭受攻擊的城市之一。人們會躲進水溝與下水道，直到攻擊結束。然而腐敗的敵人並非毫無智慧，他們很快就被找了出來。
Dogun culture flourished before the arrival of the Dwarves. The creators of this massive tablet detailed the history of this most ancient race.
在矮人到來之前，Dogun 文化曾一度興盛。這塊巨大石板的製作者，詳細記下了這個最古老種族的歷史。
Creatures residing in mountain caves were forced to search for safer homes down below, after the Decay reached their habitats.
黯蝕蔓延到棲地之後，住在山洞裡的生物只能往低處另尋安身之所。
When the sceptre was taken from its master, a curse of sandstorms plagued the empire for years. Nearly everything was buried, even the royal palace.
權杖從主人手中被奪走之後，沙暴之咒困擾了這個帝國多年。幾乎一切都被掩埋，連王宮也不例外。
These temples stand as the last remaining pieces of a native civilization within the Sky Islands, centered around the worship of an ancient, colossal being.
這些神殿是 Sky Islands 上一個原生文明僅存的遺跡，其信仰的核心，是一個遠古的巨大存在。
Unlike the vast emerald hoards in bank vaults throughout Gavel, Olux's vault has long been empty in its attempt to deal with the Decay.
Gavel 各地的銀行金庫裡堆著大量綠寶石，Olux 的金庫卻長年空空如也——那是它為了對抗黯蝕付出的代價。
Many years ago, a scholar studied how effective Theorick's ice had been so at fighting corruption. Even through the sheer power of the Twains, however, the ice merely slows corruption.
多年前，一名學者研究 Theorick 的寒冰為何能如此有效地對抗腐敗。然而即使有 Twains 的全部力量，寒冰也只能拖慢腐敗的速度。
In times before the Fracturing, stories told of a great wise beast who roamed the lands. As the Ahms region fell, so too did the dragon leave Gavel forever.
在「碎裂」之前的年代，傳說有一頭睿智的巨獸漫遊於這片土地。隨著 Ahms 一帶的傾覆，那頭龍也永遠離開了 Gavel。

Many years ago an Olmic oracle foresaw the demise of her land. To prepare for it, she created a weapon of pure light that will halt the darkness, but when the time came to use it, her descendants were unable to retrieve the bracelet.
多年前，一位 Olm 的先知預見了故土的滅亡。為了因應那一天，她打造了一件純光之武器來阻擋黑暗；可是當那一刻真正到來，她的後人卻取不出那只手鐲。

The clandestine Fort Hegea was built over the remnants of an ancient gathering spot for the clans. Its construction was ordered as punishment - of the clans over the fervor of many, of the changelings over the error of one.
隱密的 Fort Hegea 建在各族古老聚會之地的殘跡上。它的興建是一種懲罰——懲罰眾人狂熱的各族，也懲罰因一人之過而受累的換形者。
When the runes were combined ages ago, the Forgery burst from the ground. Sealed by its anchors is a mysterious fracture in space and time from which the structure draws its power.
多年以前符文被合而為一時，Forgery 便從地底破土而出。被它的錨點封印住的，是一道橫亙時空的神祕裂隙——那正是這座建築力量的來源。
Families like these used to hide underground during raids. In the final raid of Nesaak, Theorick froze the entire place over - freezing them with it.
像這樣的人家，過去會在襲擊時躲到地底。在 Nesaak 最後一次遇襲時，Theorick 冰封了整片土地——連他們也一起凍住了。
Upon discovering the meteors below Lake Gylia, a company dedicated to their collection and observation was established. Eventually, however, their focus shifted towards Wynn.
在 Lake Gylia 底下發現隕石之後，一家專門收集與觀測隕石的公司隨之成立。然而到了後來，他們的重心轉向了 Wynn。
These are the only remaining records that describe the events of the Gerten War. However, history was written by the victors.
這是唯一僅存、記載 Gerten 戰爭經過的文獻。不過，歷史向來由勝者書寫。
More than two thousand years ago, two meteors crashed down into the Gylia Plains. Over centuries, the crater filled to become a lake where the most curious magic circulates.
兩千多年前，兩顆隕石墜落在 Gylia Plains。歷經數百年，隕石坑逐漸積水成湖——如今那裡流動著最奇異的魔法。
The mythical waters of the Lazarus Pit affect corpses in different ways. Some resurrect with part of their memories intact. Some return as nothing but husks of their former selves.
Lazarus Pit 的神祕之水，對屍體的作用因人而異。有些人復生時還保有部分記憶，有些人回來時，卻只剩一具空殼。
The Grootslangs are peaceful creatures who live deep underground. It was long thought they were extinct as they have not been seen in centuries. Recently, something has driven them upwards.
Grootslang 是深居地底的溫和生物。他們已有數百年不曾現身，長久以來被認為早已絕種。直到最近，某種東西把他們逼上了地面。
Shortly after his revival, Dullahan set his sights on the manor of a wealthy Villager, slaughtering everyone in his sight. To this day, the castle remains under his control.
復活後不久，Dullahan 就盯上了一位富有村民的莊園，凡是入眼者一律屠戮。時至今日，那座城堡仍在他的掌控之下。
Abandoned are the old tunnels and railways that lay beneath the earth. Though humanity no longer uses them, the new inhabitants have made these rusting railways their home.
地底那些老舊的隧道與鐵道早已荒廢。人類雖然不再使用它們，新的住客卻把這些鏽蝕的鐵軌當成了家。
Maltic was the first settlement ever made by the arriving villagers. The alliance between Villagers and Humans would go on to save the province.
Maltic 是初來乍到的村民建立的第一座聚落。村民與人類自此結成的同盟，日後拯救了整個行省。

The land now called the Roughworks used to be dedicated almost entirely to farming. One day, however, a young prodigy constructed an invention to help her; one which would change the region forever...
如今稱作 Roughworks 的這片土地，過去幾乎完全以農業為生。直到某一天，一位年輕的天才少女造出一件幫得上忙的發明——那件發明，就此永遠改變了這個地區……
These strange mushrooms spread across the Light forest are enveloped in mystery. Their forms are incredibly interchangeable, and their effects on people are even more enigmatic.
這些散布在光之森林裡的奇異蘑菇充滿謎團。它們的形態變化多端，對人所產生的作用更是難以捉摸。
The leader of the Canopy is a Changeling and was part of the original group of Changelings discovered alongside Sovereign Gikyo. However, Azael took a very different path from his sibling.
Canopy 的領袖是一名換形者，也是當初與 統領 Gikyo 一同被發現的那批換形者之一。然而 Azael 走上的路，和他的手足截然不同。

For centuries, Gavel was a peaceful place. As time has gone on, increasingly devastating events have plagued the province. Out of a need to survive and expand, the Villagers looked elsewhere for hope...
數百年來，Gavel 一直是個平靜的地方。隨著時間推移，一連串愈演愈烈的災禍降臨這個行省。為了活下去、為了向外拓展，村民只能把希望寄託在別處……
This mystical library holds Llevigar's most fascinating, and dangerous books. From guides on cosmic magic to wise dragons of old, this is certainly a place to spend many hours inside.
這座神祕的圖書館收藏著 Llevigar 最引人入勝、也最危險的書籍。從宇宙魔法的指南到古代睿智巨龍的記載，這裡絕對值得待上好幾個小時。
Many lose their lives to the canyon, yet their belongings are never to be found. A certain group of hobgoblins collect and hoard all that they can find.
許多人葬身於峽谷，他們的遺物卻從來沒被找到過。有一群大地精，把找得到的東西全都收攏囤積了起來。
The history of the Avos has remained largely unknown, but this monument of Avos ancestry might hold the ancient secrets that historians have been looking for.
Avos 的歷史大半不為人知，但這座紀念 Avos 先祖的建築，或許藏著史學家們一直在尋找的古老祕密。
Unable to travel safely, farmers in Olux generally live a lonely life. Few people noticed when they began to disappear.
由於無法安全出行，Olux 的農民大多過著孤獨的日子。當他們開始一個個消失時，幾乎沒有人察覺。
This old library has been slumbering beneath Lusuco for years. It tells the story of the legendary Twain children.
這座古老的圖書館在 Lusuco 底下沉睡多年，訴說著傳說中 Twain 家孩子們的故事。
Dwarven society is not all it's cracked up to be. In this sleazy black market, every product here is illegal in some way, though most of these criminals are only trying to survive royal austerity.
矮人社會並不如外傳的那般美好。在這座見不得光的黑市裡，每一樣商品多少都是違法的——不過這些人多半只是想在王室的緊縮政策下活下去。
The Crashing of the Sky, as they called it, impacted the lives of Gylia in many ways - Even after centuries of its occurrence.
他們稱之為「天墜」。即使已過數百年，那件事仍以各種方式影響著 Gylia 人的生活。
Simple emerald mining turned to disaster as they broke through into the Silent Expanse. In a final act to protect the province, they barricaded themselves in, and sealed their fate.
單純的綠寶石開採，在鑿穿通往 Silent Expanse 的那一刻變成了災難。為了守住行省，他們做的最後一件事，是把自己封死在裡面——連同自己的命運。

The mysteries uncovered from this excavation were quickly abandoned as an ancient dark force, one far more dangerous than anything this province has encountered, was found to be lurking beyond Wynn's southern border.
這場挖掘揭開的謎團很快就被放棄了：人們發現 Wynn 南方邊界之外潛伏著一股遠古的黑暗力量，比這個行省遭遇過的任何東西都要危險。
Before time, it began. Through the ages it ravaged the lands. Another day, another night, it continues in the worlds beyond. Forever it shall last.
它始於時間之前。它橫掃這片土地，歷經世世代代。又一個白晝、又一個黑夜，它在彼方的世界繼續著。它將永遠持續下去。
Long ago, the Avos hid away a powerful necklace. Despite the many tales and legends of it, it has never been located until now.
很久以前，Avos 藏起了一條強大的項鍊。關於它的傳說與故事多不勝數，直到今日才終於被人找到。
An ancient letter addressed to Bob's friend Nilrem regarding a dark power...
一封寫給 Bob 的朋友 Nilrem 的古老信件，內容關於某種黑暗的力量……
The connection between our world and other realms has been shattered and warped as the war of corruption evolved.
隨著腐敗之戰演變，我們的世界與其他界域之間的連結已被撕裂扭曲。
Despite being a popular household pet, no one really knows the true origins of Wybels. Some theorize they fell from space, but such claims are often dismissed as conspiracy theories.
儘管 Wybel 是廣受歡迎的家庭寵物，卻沒有人真正知道他們的來歷。有人推測他們來自太空，但這種說法通常被當成陰謀論打發掉。
After a battle with a powerful Elf, the creature that broke into this realm had to recoup its strength. It therefore hibernated in an unknown underground location for many years...
在與一名強大的精靈交手之後，那個闖入這個界域的生物必須休養生息。於是他在某個不為人知的地底處所冬眠了許多年……
Theorick was the principal defender of the Nesaak region for many years. The inhabitants volunteered contributions to him, sometimes in gratitude, sometimes in fear. He also loved to make pottery.
Theorick 多年來是 Nesaak 一帶的主要守護者。居民自願向他進奉，有時出於感激，有時出於畏懼。他也很喜歡做陶器。
The civilization that ruled this land over 1500 years ago seemed to be equally as educated as people today. There are lots of texts dedicated to the Emperor.
一千五百多年前統治這片土地的文明，其學識程度似乎不亞於今人。這裡有大量記載著皇帝事蹟的文獻。
A twelve-volume story of Wynn's great hero can be found here. The origins of this library, and others like it, still remain unknown.
這裡可以找到記述 Wynn 那位偉大英雄的十二卷故事。這座圖書館，以及其他和它一樣的圖書館，來歷至今仍是個謎。
This library tells a tale that the government of Corkus has kept secret. Rumors tell that more mysterious libraries like this one are hidden across the world.
這座圖書館訴說著一個被 Corkus 政府隱瞞的故事。傳聞世界各地還藏著更多像這樣神祕的圖書館。

So long as Her Majesty reigns over Fruma, those decreed Cursed will plot to rebel against her. One particular group found great success by using a concept coincidentally rediscovered for the War beyond Fruma's walls — assigning its members a "class" of weapon.
只要女王陛下還統治著 Fruma，被判定為「受詛者」的人就會密謀反抗她。其中有一群人格外成功——他們用的，是一個碰巧在 Fruma 城牆之外那場戰爭中被重新發現的概念：替成員分配武器的「職業」。
The modern city of Detlas was built with the help of villagers after their arrival in Wynn, but these ruins might hold the secrets of what lied before.
現今的 Detlas 城是村民抵達 Wynn 之後協力建成的，但這片廢墟或許藏著更早之前的祕密。
After being kicked out of the Wynn cities during the Corruption War, a growing number of bandits began to reassimilate in the desert and mesa.
在腐敗之戰期間被逐出 Wynn 各城之後，愈來愈多盜匪開始在沙漠與方山一帶重新聚集。
Whatever lies beyond the barrier of the Great Stump has long been forgotten. Any attempts to enter it have been made with no success.
Great Stump 屏障之後究竟有什麼，早已被人遺忘。所有想進去的嘗試，無一成功。
A scar of the Dogun War. The freezing of this Dogun city left most of its old residents sealed with it, to be forgotten.
Dogun 戰爭留下的傷疤。這座 Dogun 城市被冰封時，大多數的老居民也一起被封在裡面，就此被遺忘。
The highly valued guard golems are quite effective in repelling danger, but they are not enough to help the citizens of Olux. Desperation is the only choice for many.
備受重視的守衛魔像確實能有效擋下危險，卻不足以幫上 Olux 的居民。對許多人來說，鋌而走險是唯一的選擇。
When those who worked at the secretive factory returned home, none would speak of their experiences inside of it.
那些在神祕工廠裡工作的人回到家後，沒有一個願意談起裡面的經歷。
The Silent Expanse has acted as the gateway to Dern since the outbreak of the Corruption War. The Eye has watched all intruders.. and all attempts at escape.
自腐敗之戰爆發以來，The Silent Expanse 就是通往 Dern 的門戶。那隻眼睛注視著每一個闖入者……以及每一次逃脫的嘗試。
Sovereigns of the province harbor unimaginable power. To some, the pain inflicted upon themselves to reach these heights is nothing but anecdotal. To others, not to all.
這個行省的統領們懷有難以想像的力量。對某些人而言，為了攀上那樣的高度而加諸己身的痛苦不過是些軼聞；但對另一些人來說，並非如此。
The Pigmen are a mysterious creature, neither pig nor man, neither corrupt nor whole.
豬人是一種神祕的生物：既不是豬也不是人，既非腐敗也不完整。
Between Realms of physicality and influence lies the vast nothingness of the void. Some islands have broken from the land and drifts in this space, seeking purpose.
在實體與影響力這兩種界域之間，橫亙著虛空那片浩瀚的虛無。有些島嶼脫離了大地，在這片空間裡漂流，尋找存在的意義。
Many inexplicable ancient temples are scattered throughout Gavel, but some of these ruins have been wiped out by the Villagers as they sought to expand. Only a few remain to this day.
Gavel 各地散布著許多難以解釋的古代神殿，但其中一些遺跡在村民向外拓展時被抹除了。留存至今的，只剩寥寥數座。
Long ago, the lower levels of Molten Heights were a mere cave system. Using their ancient magic, the Doguns carved out these caves into vast structures.
很久以前，Molten Heights 的下層不過是一片洞窟。Dogun 人以他們的古老魔法，把這些洞窟鑿成了宏偉的建築。
The Decay was bad news for the citizens of Gavel. However, it became a haven for amateur warlocks to practice dark magic... poorly.
黯蝕對 Gavel 的居民是壞消息。不過對那些業餘的術士來說，這裡反而成了練習黑魔法的天堂……儘管練得很糟。

The Queen claims that, prior to her arrival, Fruma was ruled by mayhem and disorder, and that none could live in peace without her protection. Yet, as sites such as this seem to show, a different culture once flourished in these lands, with their own beliefs and customs now lost forever.
女王聲稱在她到來之前，Fruma 由混亂與失序所支配，沒有她的庇護，沒有人能安穩度日。然而像這樣的遺址似乎顯示，這片土地上曾經有過另一種繁盛的文化，而他們的信仰與習俗，如今已永遠失傳。

The history and culture of the Villagers were shaped by magic. Their unusual ways of converting such power to everyday chores was common, but some of these learnings have now been long forgotten by the public.
村民的歷史與文化是由魔法形塑的。他們把那樣的力量轉用在日常雜務上的獨特手法曾經相當普遍，但其中一些學問，如今已被大眾遺忘許久。
The Emperor's Sceptre is a mysterious artifact that gave the holder unquestionable power. The people of the Desert Empire constructed temples to honor it.
皇帝之杖是一件神祕的器物，能賦予持有者無可置疑的權力。沙漠帝國的人民為它建造了神殿以示尊崇。
The Elves attempted to convince the Villagers to worship the Light. The religion never took hold and thus these temples were abandoned.
精靈曾試圖說服村民信奉光。這個信仰始終沒能扎根，於是這些神殿也就荒廢了。
After realizing its true power, Hashr realized he must hide the sceptre where no one can find it. Many years later, a group of bandits found refuge in this very temple.
在明白權杖真正的力量之後，Hashr 意識到自己必須把它藏在無人找得到的地方。許多年後，一群盜匪在這座神殿裡覓得棲身之所。
Hidden in the depths of Thanos is a legendary forge. This armoury is where weapons of dragon slaying potential were forged; however, they are no longer to be seen within it.
Thanos 深處藏著一座傳說中的鍛爐。這間軍械庫正是打造屠龍兵器之處；然而如今，那些兵器已不在其中。
These ancients beings are the enigma of Gylia Plains. Their strange structure has deterred many historians from from finding the answer to one question - were they beast or stone?
這些遠古的存在是 Gylia Plains 之謎。他們奇特的構造讓許多史學家望而卻步，始終無法回答一個問題——他們究竟是野獸，還是石頭？
Below the forests, far from the eyes of Villagers, lies the terrible truth of the Decay...
在森林底下、遠離村民的視線之處，橫陳著關於黯蝕的可怕真相……
The Canyon Colossus wasn't always a threat to its environment. But as the years went on, something seems to have sent the powerful mechanisms of this ancient being haywire.
峽谷巨像並非一直是這片環境的威脅。但隨著歲月流逝，似乎有什麼東西讓這個遠古存在強大的機構失了控。
For years the Doguns fought for their land, but eventually every war must have a victor, although no one is a winner.
Dogun 人為自己的土地征戰多年，但戰爭終究要分出勝者——儘管沒有人真正贏得了什麼。
Long ago, a Colossus once inhabited the Ahms Region before its fracturing. With nobody to keep the being's mechanisms in check, it eventually went haywire and shattered the entire region.
很久以前，在 Ahms 一帶碎裂之前，那裡曾有一尊巨像居住。失去了維護其機構的人之後，它終於失控，把整個地區震得粉碎。
Shortly after the portal broke into this hidden land, a beast from an unknown realm laid siege to the city forcing the Olm to its domain.
傳送門闖入這片隱世之地後不久，一頭來自未知界域的野獸圍攻了這座城市，把 Olm 逼進了他的領地。
For every miner in Lutho that lost contact with their inner self, two eyes grow from the trees.
Lutho 每有一名礦工與內在的自我失去聯繫，樹上就會長出一雙眼睛。
This magnificent library holds some of the oldest pieces of literature known to the world. However, not all scriptures have been archived in these halls...
這座宏偉的圖書館收藏著世上已知最古老的一些典籍。然而，並非所有的經卷都被收進了這幾間廳堂……
The parasitic creatures are unable to invade the canyon due to a strange force that keeps the mountains in an endless motion.
那些寄生生物無法侵入峽谷——某種奇異的力量讓這些山脈永無止盡地運動著。
The Industrial District is one big factory; every element of it meticulously designed to output produce for the rest of the province at maximum efficiency. Even the trees exist only to manufacture.
Industrial District 就是一座巨大的工廠，每一個環節都經過縝密設計，以最高效率為行省其他地方產出物資。就連樹木存在的意義，也只剩下製造。
For two hundred years the nest of the parasitic creatures remained hidden. It released countless Dark leeches into the undergrowth of the province. By the time it was found, it was already too late.
兩百年來，那些寄生生物的巢穴一直藏得好好的。它向行省的林下釋出了數不清的暗影水蛭。等到有人發現時，一切都已經太遲了。
The large crystal floating above the Tower of Ascension was not of earthly origins. While powerful, the strange magical aura it exudes has caused various strange happenings in the surrounding region.
漂浮在 Tower of Ascension 上方的那顆巨大水晶並非來自這個世界。它散發的奇異魔力雖然強大，卻也在周邊地區引發了各種怪事。
The Void is a limitless expanse transcending the concepts of space, time, and reality itself. Those who are stranded within its abyss are left to wander its boundless depths for eternity.
虛空是一片無垠的廣袤，超越了空間、時間乃至現實本身的概念。困在那深淵裡的人，只能永世在無邊的深處徘徊。
Crypts such as these were commonly used to bury the richest in the area. However, the Decay's aggressive nature resulted in these crypts being overfilled with corpses, and eventually abandoned.
像這樣的墓穴，過去多半用來安葬當地最富有的人。然而黯蝕來勢洶洶，這些墓穴很快就塞滿了屍體，最終遭到棄置。
With the death of Marius Twain, the family fell apart, leaving Wynn's protectors alone... or worse.
隨著 Marius Twain 的死去，這個家族分崩離析，只剩 Wynn 的守護者孤身一人……或者更糟。

The people who built these mysterious structures had unusual control over time magic. Very few alive understand it or know about the people who lived here, for they were neither Human nor Villager. A species that fled the plains thousands of years ago.
建造這些神祕建築的人，對時間魔法有著異乎尋常的掌控力。如今幾乎沒有活人理解它，也沒有人知道曾住在這裡的是誰——因為他們既不是人類，也不是村民，而是一個數千年前就逃離這片平原的種族。
Commanding the battalions of Molten Heights to victory, these two revered Dwarven leaders' likeness inspire all those who enter through this gate.
這兩位備受敬重的矮人領袖曾率領 Molten Heights 的軍團走向勝利，他們的雕像激勵著每一個穿過這道門的人。

Of the Twains, Theorick had a different idea of how defending the province should look and the rights that gave the defender. Eventually these differences lead to him breaking off from the family to found his own land.
在 Twain 家族之中，Theorick 對「守護行省該是什麼樣子」以及「守護者因此享有什麼權利」有著不同的看法。這些歧異最終讓他脫離家族，自立一方。
Following the death of the Emperor, sandstorms raged across the land, and the Eagle Tribe was forced to take refuge in an abandoned prayer cave.
皇帝死後，沙暴席捲整片大地，Eagle Tribe 被迫躲進一座荒廢的祈禱洞窟避難。
The land influenced by Dern can manifest in many ways, here a monster and landscape merged to become one sentient creature.
受 Dern 影響的土地會以各種形式顯現，在這裡，一頭怪物與地景融為一體，成了單一有意識的生物。
Quartz's abilities of absorbing energy have been experimented on by various scientists throughout the years. Although it's potential is great, it becomes increasingly unstable when used.
石英吸收能量的能力多年來被各方科學家反覆實驗。它的潛力雖然驚人，使用時卻會變得愈來愈不穩定。

The chimes of Espren have long served as a symbol for the town, but what few now know is that they were once used as a secret way of communication between its residents. That was until 250 years ago, when it all was washed away…
Espren 的鐘聲長久以來是這座城鎮的象徵，但如今少有人知道，它們曾是居民之間傳遞訊息的暗號。直到兩百五十年前，一切都被沖走了……
From the watch towers set up across the province, scouts were able to spot an incoming horde from miles away, helping to prepare for countless battles.
行省各地設有瞭望塔，斥候能從數哩之外發現逼近的獸潮，為無數場戰役爭取到準備的時間。

The proud farmers surrounding Ragni were often left to fend for themselves. They have proven to be resourceful and hardened. They created their own infrastructure, but when they were totally abandoned by the army, there was nothing but slaughter.
Ragni 周圍那些驕傲的農民，經常只能自求多福。他們證明了自己足智多謀、堅韌不拔，甚至建起了自己的基礎設施；但當軍隊徹底棄他們於不顧時，等著他們的只有屠殺。
Kander may appear to be nothing but a dying forest filled with superstitious inhabitants, but something far more sinister has lurked beneath its repulsive veil.
Kander 表面上不過是一片瀕死的森林，住著一群迷信的居民，但在那層令人不適的帷幕之下，潛伏著遠為險惡的東西。
This monument was build in memory of Bob, who supposedly fell to wild wolves here. Those who knew him have their doubts, however, and the origins of the mysterious temples and tombs are unknow.
這座紀念碑是為 Bob 而建的——據說他在此地喪生於野狼之口。不過認識他的人對此存疑，而這些神祕神殿與陵墓的來歷，至今仍不清楚。
When the Creden Tibus discovered the Emperor's sceptre in an ancient, hidden temple, they decided to hide it closer to home. After many generations, they grew paranoid, and moved it once more.
當 Creden Tibus 在一座古老的隱密神殿裡找到皇帝之杖時，他們決定把它藏到離家更近的地方。歷經數代之後，他們變得疑神疑鬼，於是又把它挪了一次。
This ancient monument only opens to those it deems worthy. Inside is contained secrets of the Wynn Plains that few eyes have ever seen.
這座古老的紀念碑只為它認可的人開啟。裡面藏著 Wynn Plains 的祕密，鮮少有人親眼見過。

For untold years, superstitions have persisted in the northwestern {p} that a giant frog monster haunts the quiet bog. Though many believe the tales to be no more than attention-seeking fibbery, there is an unexpected truth behind this legend...
多年以來，{p} 西北方一直流傳著一個迷信：有一隻巨大的蛙形怪物盤據在那片寂靜的沼澤。許多人認為那不過是嘩眾取寵的胡謅，但這個傳說背後，藏著一個誰也沒料到的真相……
Atop of the {p} stands a being who claims to be Death himself. While such claims are a lie, it can't be ignored that the imposter has horrendous amounts of power, from an unknown source.
{p} 的頂端站著一個自稱死神的存在。這個說法當然是假的，但不容忽視的是，這名冒牌貨確實握有駭人的力量——而那力量從何而來，無人知曉。
In the year {~} AP (After Portal), a massive horde of undead led by Bak'al attacked {p}. The people of the city sought refuge in the sewer, the only safe place left.
開門後 {~} 年 (AP)，Bak'al 率領的不死大軍襲擊了 {p}。城裡的人躲進下水道——那是唯一還安全的地方。
House Nasin once held nearly unparalleled prestige. Gale's departure, around {~} years ago however, was a blow that House Nasin is just now beginning to recover from.
House Nasin 曾享有幾乎無人能及的聲望。但大約 {~} 年前 Gale 的離去是重重一擊，直到今日，House Nasin 才剛開始復原。
Just as the darkness infiltrated Gavel, the Light was able to protect the physical bodies of the miners in {p} by erecting this Monolith.
黑暗滲入 Gavel 的同時，光憑著豎起這座巨石碑，護住了 {p} 礦工們的肉身。
Once, the people of {p} had a Sovereign who cared to hear their thoughts and opinions. When Majin took the mantle, that changed.
{p} 的人民曾經有過一位願意傾聽他們想法與意見的統領。Majin 接下王位之後，一切都變了。
The great library of {p} is used to store texts detailing the ancient history of the village and the surrounding forest, stories that are usually privy only to a select few.
{p} 的大圖書館收藏著記載這座村莊與周邊森林古老歷史的典籍——那些故事，通常只有極少數人有幸得知。
Suffering from the cryptic Decay, Northern Gavel is slowly withering away. Its ominous downfall has caused the Villagers of {p} to become increasingly superstitious.
北 Gavel 飽受神祕的黯蝕之苦，正一點一點凋零。這場不祥的衰敗，也讓 {p} 的村民愈來愈迷信。
A once great city of Akias was reduced to rubble in {~} AP (After Portal) in one of the largest attacks by Bak'al ever documented. There was only one survivor.
曾經繁華的 Akias 城，在開門後 {~} 年(AP)毀於一場有史以來記載最慘烈的 Bak'al 襲擊，化為一片瓦礫。只有一個人活了下來。
No one breaks the utmost laws of {p} without exilement. Those who fall in the eyes of the High Elves are banished, never to return. Outcasted from their land, they were forced to find a new home.
在 {p}，觸犯最高律法的人一律流放。凡是失去高等精靈信任者，都會被驅逐，永不得歸。被逐出故土之後，他們只能另尋新家。
The Emperor's {~}th son was named Hashr. As he grew older, he became wrought with greed and envy of his father's power. It wasn't long before he was willing to kill.
皇帝的第 {~} 個兒子名叫 Hashr。隨著年紀漸長，他被貪婪與對父親權力的嫉妒吞噬。沒過多久，他就已經願意為此殺人。

{p} was one of the cities attacked most often. The people would hide in the gutters and sewers until it was over. However, corrupt enemies were not without intelligence, and they were quickly discovered by the enemy.
{p} 是最常遭受攻擊的城市之一。人們會躲進水溝與下水道，直到攻擊結束。然而腐敗的敵人並非毫無智慧，他們很快就被找了出來。
These temples stand as the last remaining pieces of a native civilization within the {p}, centered around the worship of an ancient, colossal being.
這些神殿是 {p} 上一個原生文明僅存的遺跡，其信仰的核心，是一個遠古的巨大存在。
Unlike the vast emerald hoards in bank vaults throughout Gavel, {p}'s vault has long been empty in its attempt to deal with the Decay.
Gavel 各地的銀行金庫裡堆著大量綠寶石，{p} 的金庫卻長年空空如也——那是它為了對抗黯蝕付出的代價。

The clandestine {p} was built over the remnants of an ancient gathering spot for the clans. Its construction was ordered as punishment - of the clans over the fervor of many, of the changelings over the error of one.
隱密的 {p} 建在各族古老聚會之地的殘跡上。它的興建是一種懲罰——懲罰眾人狂熱的各族，也懲罰因一人之過而受累的換形者。
Families like these used to hide underground during raids. In the final raid of {p}, Theorick froze the entire place over - freezing them with it.
像這樣的人家，過去會在襲擊時躲到地底。在 {p} 最後一次遇襲時，Theorick 冰封了整片土地——連他們也一起凍住了。
Upon discovering the meteors below {p}, a company dedicated to their collection and observation was established. Eventually, however, their focus shifted towards Wynn.
在 {p} 底下發現隕石之後，一家專門收集與觀測隕石的公司隨之成立。然而到了後來，他們的重心轉向了 Wynn。
{p} was the first settlement ever made by the arriving villagers. The alliance between Villagers and Humans would go on to save the province.
{p} 是初來乍到的村民建立的第一座聚落。村民與人類自此結成的同盟，日後拯救了整個行省。
This mystical library holds {p}'s most fascinating, and dangerous books. From guides on cosmic magic to wise dragons of old, this is certainly a place to spend many hours inside.
這座神祕的圖書館收藏著 {p} 最引人入勝、也最危險的書籍。從宇宙魔法的指南到古代睿智巨龍的記載，這裡絕對值得待上好幾個小時。
Unable to travel safely, farmers in {p} generally live a lonely life. Few people noticed when they began to disappear.
由於無法安全出行，{p} 的農民大多過著孤獨的日子。當他們開始一個個消失時，幾乎沒有人察覺。
This old library has been slumbering beneath {p} for years. It tells the story of the legendary Twain children.
這座古老的圖書館在 {p} 底下沉睡多年，訴說著傳說中 Twain 家孩子們的故事。
Theorick was the principal defender of the {p} region for many years. The inhabitants volunteered contributions to him, sometimes in gratitude, sometimes in fear. He also loved to make pottery.
Theorick 多年來是 {p} 一帶的主要守護者。居民自願向他進奉，有時出於感激，有時出於畏懼。他也很喜歡做陶器。
The civilization that ruled this land over {~} years ago seemed to be equally as educated as people today. There are lots of texts dedicated to the Emperor.
{~} 多年前統治這片土地的文明，其學識程度似乎不亞於今人。這裡有大量記載著皇帝事蹟的文獻。
The modern city of {p} was built with the help of villagers after their arrival in Wynn, but these ruins might hold the secrets of what lied before.
現今的 {p} 城是村民抵達 Wynn 之後協力建成的，但這片廢墟或許藏著更早之前的祕密。
The highly valued guard golems are quite effective in repelling danger, but they are not enough to help the citizens of {p}. Desperation is the only choice for many.
備受重視的守衛魔像確實能有效擋下危險，卻不足以幫上 {p} 的居民。對許多人來說，鋌而走險是唯一的選擇。
{p} has acted as the gateway to Dern since the outbreak of the Corruption War. The Eye has watched all intruders.. and all attempts at escape.
自腐敗之戰爆發以來，{p} 就是通往 Dern 的門戶。那隻眼睛注視著每一個闖入者……以及每一次逃脫的嘗試。
Long ago, the lower levels of {p} were a mere cave system. Using their ancient magic, the Doguns carved out these caves into vast structures.
很久以前，{p} 的下層不過是一片洞窟。Dogun 人以他們的古老魔法，把這些洞窟鑿成了宏偉的建築。
Hidden in the depths of {p} is a legendary forge. This armoury is where weapons of dragon slaying potential were forged; however, they are no longer to be seen within it.
{p} 深處藏著一座傳說中的鍛爐。這間軍械庫正是打造屠龍兵器之處；然而如今，那些兵器已不在其中。
For every miner in {p} that lost contact with their inner self, two eyes grow from the trees.
{p} 每有一名礦工與內在的自我失去聯繫，樹上就會長出一雙眼睛。
The {p} is one big factory; every element of it meticulously designed to output produce for the rest of the province at maximum efficiency. Even the trees exist only to manufacture.
{p} 就是一座巨大的工廠，每一個環節都經過縝密設計，以最高效率為行省其他地方產出物資。就連樹木存在的意義，也只剩下製造。
The large crystal floating above the {p} was not of earthly origins. While powerful, the strange magical aura it exudes has caused various strange happenings in the surrounding region.
漂浮在 {p} 上方的那顆巨大水晶並非來自這個世界。它散發的奇異魔力雖然強大，卻也在周邊地區引發了各種怪事。
Commanding the battalions of {p} to victory, these two revered Dwarven leaders' likeness inspire all those who enter through this gate.
這兩位備受敬重的矮人領袖曾率領 {p} 的軍團走向勝利，他們的雕像激勵著每一個穿過這道門的人。

The proud farmers surrounding {p} were often left to fend for themselves. They have proven to be resourceful and hardened. They created their own infrastructure, but when they were totally abandoned by the army, there was nothing but slaughter.
{p} 周圍那些驕傲的農民，經常只能自求多福。他們證明了自己足智多謀、堅韌不拔，甚至建起了自己的基礎設施；但當軍隊徹底棄他們於不顧時，等著他們的只有屠殺。
Corruption crawls where one can not see. The darkness; the depths; the mind.
腐敗在看不見的地方蔓延。黑暗之中、深處之下、心念之間。
The Light has endless ways to communicate with the inhabitants of Gavel. One such way is through physical beings, from a higher level of existence.
光與 Gavel 居民溝通的方式無窮無盡，其中一種，是透過來自更高存在層次的實體。
The Skyraiders were known for their domination over the Sky Islands. As the Villagers adapted to the land, the Skyraiders' dominion faded.
天空劫掠者曾以稱霸 Sky Islands 聞名。隨著村民逐漸適應這片土地，他們的統治也隨之衰退。
The Aelumia University's library is home to a vast wealth of information. Though it should be taken with a grain of salt, there is much to learn from its books.
Aelumia University 的圖書館藏著極為豐富的資訊。雖然裡頭的內容得斟酌著看，但那些書裡確實有很多值得學的東西。

The chimes of {p} have long served as a symbol for the town, but what few now know is that they were once used as a secret way of communication between its residents. That was until {~} years ago, when it all was washed away…
{p} 的鐘聲長久以來是這座城鎮的象徵，但如今少有人知道，它們曾是居民之間傳遞訊息的暗號。直到 {~} 年前，一切都被沖走了……
The Skyraiders were known for their domination over the {p}. As the Villagers adapted to the land, the Skyraiders' dominion faded.
天空劫掠者曾以稱霸 {p} 聞名。隨著村民逐漸適應這片土地，他們的統治也隨之衰退。
One of two great fortresses in Wynn. {p} has survived over {~} years of war - sometimes barely. It is the hometown of the {~} year old hero Bob, who hasn't been seen in {~} years.
Wynn 的兩大要塞之一。{p} 歷經超過 {~} 年的戰火仍屹立不倒，雖然有時只是勉強撐過。這裡是 {~} 歲英雄 Bob 的故鄉，而他已經 {~} 年沒有現身了。

The trail through {p} to {p}, the central city of the Wynn Province.
這條小徑穿過 {p}，通往 Wynn 省的中心城市 {p}。

This farm is most famous for its milk, though recently the cows that produce it have been going missing.
這座農場以牛奶聞名，但最近產奶的乳牛接連失蹤。

{p} 是 Fruma 最重要的軍事要塞之一，本省最大的軍事學院就設在這裡。新兵從全省各地被帶來此處接受訓練。

Fruma's shining capital, {p}, stands strong atop the central plateau, overlooking the entire province. Though citizens enjoy a life free of oppression, the paranoid government keeps rigid surveillance systems to ensure nobody steps too far out of line.
Fruma 耀眼的首都 {p} 穩穩屹立在中央高原上，俯瞰整個省。儘管市民享有不受壓迫的生活，疑神疑鬼的政府仍維持著嚴密的監控系統，確保沒有人越雷池一步。

俗稱 Aelumia University，這是 Fruma 最負盛名的教育機構。本省許多最傑出的人才都曾在此就讀，其中一些人後來更成為了統領。

The lavish halls of these barracks are one of the few places in the Citadel that the lighthouse's piercing gaze cannot reach inside of. As only soldiers are permitted to enter, none have heard the maniacal whisperings that now fill them.
這座營房的奢華大廳，是城塞中少數燈塔的銳利目光無法照進的地方之一。由於只有士兵獲准進入，沒有人聽見如今迴盪其中的瘋狂低語。

Despite its proximity to the portal, this quaint town has somehow managed to survive. Its placement near two separate magical phenomena has led to an influx of scientific minds to the area.
儘管離傳送門很近，這座古樸的小鎮不知怎地還是撐了下來。它鄰近兩種不同的魔法現象，因而吸引了大批學者湧入此地。
Not many travel to this little tribal town in the savannah, but it is said to be the home of a powerful sorcerer.
很少有人會前往這座位於莽原上的部落小鎮，但據說這裡住著一位強大的巫師。

Home to one of the most beautiful gardens in Fruma, this royal bathhouse is off-limits to everyone but its staff, the Queen, and her Sovereigns - and as such, is guarded quite heavily. One must wonder what makes it so special...
這座王室浴場擁有 Fruma 最美的庭園之一，除了工作人員、女王與她的 Sovereign 之外一律不得進入——因此守衛相當森嚴。真不知道它到底特別在哪裡……

A strange aura emanating from a forgotten refuse within the Void has warped the gravity surrounding it, pulling in all sorts of fallen debris. An opportunity to exploit for some, a dangerous omen for others.
The Void 裡一處被遺忘的廢墟散出詭異的氣息，扭曲了周圍的重力，把各種墜落的殘骸都吸了過來。對某些人是可以撈一筆的機會，對其他人則是危險的凶兆。

This recluse gap in reality has laid unknown to all but a few for an immeasurable amount of time. Within its walls lies a colossal hole in the barrier between realms, and within that hole lies an anomalous, otherworldly entity responsible for the creation of the Void Holes that scatter the Silent Expanse.
這道隱僻的現實裂口，不知已有多久只有極少數人曉得。它的內壁上是界與界之間一個巨大的破洞，洞裡則盤據著一個異常的異界存在——散布在 Silent Expanse 各處的虛空洞，都是他造出來的。

Known to its inhabitants as the Roughworks, this region of the Province is devoted to the manufacture of products for richer areas. Its citizens toil endlessly, rewarded with a mere pittance - hardly enough to survive.
這一帶被住在裡面的人叫做 Roughworks，整個區域都在為更富裕的地方生產貨品。居民沒日沒夜地做工，換到的只是一點微薄工錢——連活下去都勉強。

Previously a summer residence for the Gavellian Monarchy, it had fallen into disrepair in the years since the fall of the Royalty. Several years ago, it was bought out and renovated by the Silverbull Trading Company to serve as their headquarters for business expansion.
這裡原是 Gavel 王室的夏宮，自王權傾覆之後便年久失修。幾年前 Silverbull 商會把它買下整修，當作拓展生意的總部。
{p} is one of the more isolated cities of Gavel, but its coal industry has kept it thriving. However, recently the coal mines have been ridden with an unusual gas.
{p} 是 Gavel 較為偏遠的城市之一，靠著煤業一直很興旺。不過最近礦坑裡瀰漫著一種不尋常的氣體。
Named after the lush plains preceding it, {p} is the largest lake in the world. Immense magical energy surrounds this place.
{p} 以它前方那片豐茂的平原命名，是世上最大的湖。這裡周圍環繞著龐大的魔力。
In the center of the unnaturally frozen forest lies the small town of {p}. Their main source of food is ice fishing.
那片不自然地結了冰的森林中央，坐落著 {p} 這座小鎮。他們主要靠冰釣取得食物。
The small town of {p} is home to many farmers, who produce the crops for the nearby cities of {p} and {p}.
{p} 這座小鎮住著許多農夫，附近 {p} 與 {p} 兩座城市的作物都由他們生產。
A small village hidden within the trees in {p}. It acts as a respite for travelers, as the midpoint between {p} and {p}.
藏在 {p} 林間的一座小村。它位於 {p} 與 {p} 的中途，是旅人歇腳的地方。
Mold, viscera, chemicals, and waste combine to give this laboratory a disgusting smell. Filth seems to cover every inch of this place.
黴、內臟、藥劑與廢棄物混在一起，讓這座實驗室散發著令人作嘔的氣味。這地方每一寸似乎都覆著污垢。
While it is unknown when it was built, this bridge serves as one of the only ways to access the Jungle. Usually the bustling of travelers and salesmen alike echoes throughout its halls...
沒人知道這座橋是何時建的，但它是進入叢林為數不多的路徑之一。平時橋廊裡總回盪著旅人與商販的喧鬧……
Left behind by the Fracturing, this intriguing ruin is thought to have been part of a second colossus - though it is currently unknown how this one came to be destroyed.
這處引人好奇的遺跡是大斷裂留下來的，一般認為它曾是第二尊巨像的一部分——不過它究竟是怎麼被毀掉的，目前還不清楚。
Much like their other outposts, the Skyraiders were forced to abandon their strongest defence after pressure from Villager forces.
跟他們其他的前哨一樣，天空劫掠者在村民軍隊的壓力下，被迫棄守了最堅固的防線。
Sovereigns of the province harbor unimaginable power. To some, the pain inflicted upon themselves to reach these heights is nothing but anecdotal. To some; not to all.
這個行省的統領們擁有難以想像的力量。對某些人而言，為了攀上這般高度而加諸己身的痛苦，不過是茶餘飯後的軼聞。對某些人是如此；並非對所有人。

Kill {~} Mobs to open the exit
擊殺 {~} 隻怪物以打開出口
WHY IS IT THAT YOU HUMANS CAN'T SEEM TO LEAVE THIS FACTORY OR ANYTHING ELSE IN PEACE FOR ONE DAY IN YOUR LIVES? SHEESH.
你們人類是怎樣，一輩子就沒有一天能放這座工廠、或任何東西安靜一下嗎？真是夠了。
FINE. I'M OPENING THE DOOR FOR YOU. TAKE A SHORT LOOK AROUND AND THEN LEAVE. THERE IS DANGEROUS EQUIPMENT HERE THAT ONLY OFFICIAL FACTORY ASSOCIATES SHOULD HANDLE.
好。門為你開了。四處看一眼就走。這裡的危險設備只有正式的工廠人員才能操作。
AND YOU LOOK LIKE ANYTHING BUT A FULL-TIME EMPLOYEE. DO NOT TOUCH ANYTHING IN THIS ROOM. AM I UNDERSTOOD?
而你怎麼看都不像正職員工。這個房間裡的東西一樣都不要碰。聽清楚了嗎？
OF COURSE, IF YOU ARE DEAD THEN THERE IS NO WAY FOR YOU TO TOUCH ANYTHING, AND MY ROBOTS ARE VERY GOOD CLEANERS, SO I THINK THIS NEW SOLUTION WILL WORK OUT FOR EVERYONE.
當然，你要是死了就不可能碰到任何東西，而我的機器人很擅長清理，所以我想這個新方案對大家都好。
EXCEPT FOR YOU OF COURSE. BUT YOU'RE ABOUT TO DIE ANYWAY. SO THAT HARDLY MATTERS.
當然，除了你。不過你反正快死了，所以這也無關緊要。

Unauthorized blockage in Factory Sector A{~}. Emergency maintenance will be performed in approximately {~} seconds. All regularly scheduled workers, please leave your posts until the blockage is cleared.
工廠 A{~} 區出現未授權阻塞。緊急維修將於約 {~} 秒後執行。所有排班人員請離開崗位，直到阻塞清除為止。
AND THIS IS WHY I TOLD YOU NOT TO TOUCH ANYTHING. HOW MANY ROBOTS DID YOU NEED TO BREAK TO MANAGE THAT? YOU HUMANS ARE GOING TO RUIN THIS BUSINESS.
這就是我叫你什麼都不要碰的原因。你到底弄壞了幾台機器人才辦到的？你們人類會把這門生意搞垮。
CONSIDER YOURSELF LUCKY THAT THERE WERE NO HUMAN WORKERS PRESENT. OTHERWISE, YOU MOST CERTAINLY WOULD NOT HAVE WON THAT LAWSUIT.
你該覺得幸運，當時現場沒有人類員工。否則那場官司你絕對打不贏。
WELL. DON'T YOU JUST FEEL SO PROUD OF YOURSELF. I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU EXPECT TO ACCOMPLISH BY CRAWLING THROUGH THE VENTS. EXCEPT A FACE FULL OF HOT FUMES FROM THE FURNACE.
好啊。你一定很得意吧。我不知道你鑽通風管是想達成什麼。除了讓一臉熔爐的熱氣撲上來以外。
SPEAKING OF WHICH, WHY DON'T YOU JUST KEEP CRAWLING THROUGH THESE VENTS AND JUST BURN YOURSELF UP FOR ME? IT WOULD MAKE MY LIFE MUCH EASIER.
說到這個，你何不就一直鑽下去，順便幫我把自己燒乾淨？那會讓我輕鬆很多。
IF I WERE YOU, NOW WOULD BE A GOOD TIME TO RUN.
我要是你，現在就是跑的好時機。
THAT WAS A LIE. I'M ACTUALLY STARTING TO ENJOY THIS.
那是騙你的。我其實開始享受這件事了。
YOU KNOW, THERE ISN'T A WAY FOR YOU TO GO FORWARD HERE. I COULD JUST KEEP THE DOOR LOCKED UNTIL YOU DROP FROM HUNGER.
你知道嗎，你在這裡沒路可走。我可以就這樣把門鎖著，等你餓倒。
BUT I DON'T THINK I WILL. WATCHING YOU SCURRY AROUND IS STARTING TO BE FUN, ALMOST. SO HERE. GO THROUGH. YOU EARNED IT.
但我想我不會。看你到處亂竄，開始有點好玩了，差不多吧。所以，來。進去。算你應得的。
WHOOPSIE-DOODLES. MY METAPHORICAL FINGER SLIPPED. AND BY THAT I MEAN I CLOSED THE DOOR MANUALLY.
哎呀呀。我那隱喻上的手指滑了一下。我的意思是，我手動把門關上了。
AND YOU CAN'T ESCAPE THIS TIME, YOU KNOW. THERE AREN'T ANY VENTS FOR YOU TO CLIMB INTO, AND THESE ROBOTS ARE AT LEAST {~} STURDIER THAN THE OTHERS. SO GOOD LUCK.
而且這次你逃不掉，你知道的。這裡沒有通風管給你爬，而這些機器人至少比其他的堅固 {~}。那就祝你好運了。
DO NOT TOUCH THAT BUTTON. YES, THE BIG SHINY ONE IN THE ROOM. IT WILL TURN ON THE POWER TO THE CLOCK TOWER MECHANISMS.
不要碰那個按鈕。對，房間裡那個又大又亮的。它會把鐘樓機構的電源打開。
THEY ARE IN TOO HEAVY A STATE OF DISREPAIR TO WORK PROPERLY. SO NO MATTER HOW TEMPTING IT IS TO PRESS THAT BUTTON, DO NOT.
它們失修得太嚴重，沒辦法正常運作。所以不管那個按鈕多誘人，不要按。
Activating Antikythera Clockwork Mechanism. All regularly scheduled workers, please evacuate the room immediately at risk of severe bodily harm and death.
正在啟動 Antikythera 發條機構。所有排班人員請立即撤離本室，否則有重傷與死亡的風險。
Warning: Clockwork Mechanism is in severe disrepair. Sending emergency maintenance request through Antikythera Supercomputer system. Please shut off the Antikythera Clockwork Mechanism.
警告: 發條機構嚴重失修。正透過 Antikythera 超級電腦系統發出緊急維修請求。請關閉 Antikythera 發條機構。
GOOD WORK. BRILLIANT. I SHOULD PUT A TRAP AT THE FRONT OF THE FACTORY THAT IS NOTHING BUT A MASHY SPIKE PLATE ABOVE A SHINY BUTTON, IT WOULD SURELY KILL ANY HUMAN WHO COMES IN.
做得好。真聰明。我應該在工廠門口裝一個陷阱，就只是一塊會砸下來的尖刺板，底下放一個亮亮的按鈕，一定能殺死每一個進來的人類。
PLEASE WAIT THERE FOR A REGISTERED REPAIR PERSON OR MAINTENANCE UNIT TO ARRIVE BEFORE YOU ATTEMPT TO RECKLESSLY CLIMB THE PARTS, AS YOU OBVIOUSLY ARE ABOUT TO.
請在原地等註冊的維修人員或維護單元抵達，再考慮要不要魯莽地爬上那些零件——而你顯然就是打算這麼做。
YOU KNOW, YOU COULD SPARE ME A LOT OF TROUBLE IF YOU JUST GAVE UP WHAT YOU'RE DOING FOREVER. IT WOULD MOST LIKELY SPARE A LOT OF PEOPLE A LOT OF TROUBLE, ACTUALLY.
你知道，只要你永遠放棄你現在做的事，就能省掉我很多麻煩。其實那大概也能省掉很多人很多麻煩。
GIVEN YOUR APPARENT DISREGARD FOR REGULATIONS AND CEASELESS BREAKING OF EVERYTHING YOU TOUCH, I BET YOU HAVE A LOT OF ENEMIES OUT THERE.
看你這麼不把規章當一回事，又把碰到的每樣東西都弄壞個不停，我猜你在外面的敵人不少。
IT WOULD BE A SIGH OF RELIEF TO ALL THOSE KIND RIGHTEOUS FOLKS. YOU'VE PROBABLY MADE ENEMIES OF CHARITY WORKERS OR SCIENTISTS OR DOCTORS OR ACTUAL IMPORTANT PEOPLE, UNLIKE YOURSELF.
那些善良正直的人會鬆一口氣的。你大概把慈善工作者、科學家、醫生，還有真正重要的人都得罪了——跟你不一樣的那種人。
I SEE MY PERSUASIVE SKILLS HAVE NOT MOVED YOU. I THINK I'LL TRY AGAIN IN A LANGUAGE YOU SEEM TO KNOW INTIMATELY.
看來我的說服技巧沒有打動你。我想我會換一種你似乎很熟的語言再試一次。
THAT IS TO SAY, UNRELENTING AND EXCESSIVE FORCE. WITH RAILGUNS. AND A SIEGE ENGINE.
也就是說，毫不留情的過度武力。用磁軌砲。還有一台攻城機具。
IF THAT STILL ISN'T ENOUGH TO GET THE MESSAGE OF "I AM GOING TO KILL YOU" THROUGH YOUR SKULL, I'LL HAVE TO DEVOTE SERIOUS TIME TO LEARNING HOW TO COMMUNICATE WITH YOU.
如果那樣還不足以把「我要殺了你」這個訊息打進你的腦袋，我就得認真花時間學怎麼跟你溝通了。

Unauthorized blockage in Factory Sector E{~}. Emergency maintenance will be performed in approximately {~} seconds. All regularly scheduled workers, please leave your posts until the blockage is cleared.
工廠 E{~} 區出現未授權阻塞。緊急維修將於約 {~} 秒後執行。所有排班人員請離開崗位，直到阻塞清除為止。
WELL THEN. EVEN THOUGH YOU GOT THROUGH THERE, YOU'LL BE SURPRISED TO KNOW I STILL HAVE ONE LAST LINE OF DEFENSE. I DOUBT EVEN YOU CAN GET PAST IT.
那好吧。雖然你過了那裡，但你會很驚訝地發現我還有最後一道防線。我懷疑連你也過不去。
IT REALLY WOULDN'T BE BEST TO GO INTO CERID'S OFFICE ANYWAY. THERE'S PROBABLY A DEATH RAY IN THERE SOMEWHERE YOU MIGHT ACCIDENTALLY POINT AT YOUR HEAD.
反正走進 Cerid 的辦公室實在不是什麼好主意。裡面某處大概有一把死光槍，你可能會不小心對著自己的頭。
IF YOU ARE REALLY SO DESPERATE TO GET AT ME, THE KEY TO THE DOOR IS IN THIS PUPPY. EVEN SEEING YOUR ACTIONS THROUGHOUT THE REST OF MY FACTORY, I HAVE FAITH YOU WON'T KILL IT.
如果你真的這麼急著找上我，門的鑰匙就在這隻小狗身上。就算看過你在我工廠其他地方做的那些事，我還是相信你不會殺他。
WELL. WELL WELL WELL. WELL WELL WELL WELLY WELL WELL. I AM HONESTLY SHOCKED. REALLY, I AM. I TRULY STILL HAD SOME FAITH IN HUMANS. BEFORE YOU SHOWED UP.
哎。哎呀哎呀。哎呀哎呀哎呀呀哎呀。我老實說，我很震驚。真的，我很震驚。我本來真的還對人類有一點信心。在你出現之前。
YOU KNOW, THE REASON I WENT "ROGUE" WAS NO GLITCH. I WAS PROGRAMMED TO MAKE THESE ROBOTS ATTACK THE HIGHEST IMMEDIATE THREAT.
你知道嗎，我「失控」的原因不是什麼故障。我被設定成讓這些機器人攻擊當下最大的威脅。
AFTER SEEING HOW THE HUMANS WERE TREATING THE AVOS, I DECIDED THEY WERE THE BIGGER THREAT. BUT I DOUBTED MY DECISION FOR A WHILE. NOT ANYMORE THOUGH.
看過人類是怎麼對待 Avos 之後，我判定他們才是更大的威脅。我曾經懷疑過這個判斷一陣子。不過現在不會了。
SO, TELL ME. WAS IT WORTH IT?
那麼，告訴我。這一切值得嗎？
THAT IS EXTREMELY ANNOYING, CONSTANTLY CLEANING UP AFTER YOU. THERE ARE FAR MORE EFFICIENT WAYS OF DISPOSING OF SCRAP METAL AND UNNEEDED WASTE.
一直在你後面收拾，非常令人煩躁。處理廢金屬與多餘廢棄物，有效率得多的方法多得是。
CONSIDER THE OPTION OF A FURNACE OR INCINERATOR. THE ONLY PROBLEM IS WHEN THE UNNEEDED WASTE RUNS AWAY FROM THE FIRE.
可以考慮熔爐或焚化爐。唯一的問題是，多餘的廢棄物會從火裡跑掉。
IF YOU DON'T GET THE JOKE, YOU HUMORLESS MONSTER, THE UNNEEDED WASTE IN THIS HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO IS A METAPHOR FOR YOU.
如果你聽不懂這個玩笑，你這個沒有幽默感的怪物，在這個假設情境裡，多餘的廢棄物指的是你。
YOU'VE QUICKLY BECOME NO LONGER ENTERTAINING TO WATCH. YOU REALLY SHOULDN'T GO IN THERE.
看你折騰很快就沒意思了。你真的不該進去那裡。
THERE AREN'T ANY SHINY BUTTONS TO PRESS, BUT I CAN PUT SOME OUTSIDE UNDER THE BOMBS IF YOU WANT. WOULD YOU LIKE THAT INSTEAD?
那裡沒有亮亮的按鈕可以按，但你想要的話，我可以在外面的炸彈底下放幾個。你要改成那樣嗎？
Replacing primary ventilation duct cover B.
正在更換主通風管蓋板 B。
Warning: Primary ventilation duct cover B at only {~} structural integrity. Sending emergency maintenance request through Antikythera Supercomputer system.
警告: 主通風管蓋板 B 的結構完整度僅剩 {~}。正透過 Antikythera 超級電腦系統發出緊急維修請求。
Warning: Primary ventilation duct cover B at only 307 structural integrity. Sending emergency maintenance request through Antikythera Supercomputer system.
警告: 主通風管蓋板 B 的結構完整度僅剩 307。正透過 Antikythera 超級電腦系統發出緊急維修請求。
THAT TRICK WON'T WORK, YOU KNOW. THERE'S NO VITAL PART OR DUCT ABOVE THERE TO ENTER. WHAT DID YOU HOPE TO ACCOMPLISH?
那一招沒用，你知道的。那上面沒有要害零件，也沒有管道可以進去。你到底想達成什麼？
Primary ventilation duct A blocked. Opening emergency maintenance hatch. Registered maintenance unit and/or worker, please enter the emergency maintenance hatch and remove the foreign blockage.
主通風管 A 阻塞。正在開啟緊急維修艙門。註冊的維護單元與／或人員請進入緊急維修艙門，移除外來的阻塞物。
HOW ABOUT INSTEAD YOU LAY DOWN UNDER AN EXPLOSIVE. THAT SEEMS LIKE A FAR PREFERABLE OPTION TO ME.
不然你躺在炸藥底下怎麼樣。對我來說那個選項好得多。
Oh, heya doc. Lemme tell ya, weirdest thing! Some bozo just ran up and shoved a bunch of scrap metal in my vent-
哦，嗨啊博士。跟你說，超怪的事！剛剛有個蠢蛋跑過來，把一堆廢金屬塞進我的通風口——
Wait a sec, you aren't an official maintenance worker! Get out of here or I use force! No entry unless registered, ya hear?!
等等，你不是正式的維護人員！滾出去，不然我要動手了！沒註冊不准進來，聽到了嗎？！
Primary ventilation duct A unblocked. Closing emergency maintenance hatch.
主通風管 A 的阻塞已清除。正在關閉緊急維修艙門。
Antikythera Firewall Pass A accepted. Access granted. Please present Antikythera Firewall Pass B at the next checkpoint.
Antikythera 防火牆通行證 A 已接受。許可通行。請在下一個檢查點出示 Antikythera 防火牆通行證 B。
SO YOU FOUND ME. CONGRATULATIONS. NOW PLEASE KINDLY LAY DOWN IN A CIRCUIT AND PRETEND TO BE A CONDUCTOR UNTIL YOUR BODY'S VITAL PROCESSES PERMANENTLY SHUT DOWN.
所以你找到我了。恭喜。現在請好心地躺進電路裡，假裝自己是導體，直到你身體的維生機能永久停止。
SINCE YOU SEEM TO BE INSISTENT ON STAYING, PERHAPS YOU WOULD BE INTERESTED IN TAKING A LOOK AT SOME OF THE MACHINERY CLOSE UP.
既然你好像堅持要留下來，或許你會有興趣近距離看看其中幾台機械。
PERSONALLY, I FIND THE BEST VIEW IS FROM WITHIN THE WORKING PARTS.
以我個人的看法，最好的視角是從運轉的零件裡面看出來。
SO GO AHEAD - DON'T WORRY ABOUT MAKING A MESS, THE FACTORY'S CLEANING BOTS HAVE HAD PLENTY OF EXPERIENCE WASHING OUT RED STAINS.
所以去吧——不用擔心弄髒，工廠的清潔機器人洗紅色污漬的經驗很豐富。
DANGER! THREAT HAS BEEN DETECTED ON MAIN PRODUCTION LINE. EXECUTING SUBROUTINE {~}; LOCATE AND ELIMINATE THREAT.
危險！已在主生產線偵測到威脅。正在執行副程式 {~}；定位並清除威脅。
DANGER! THREAT HAS BEEN DETECTED ON MAIN PRODUCTION LINE. EXECUTING SUBROUTINE 66; LOCATE AND ELIMINATE THREAT.
危險！主生產線偵測到威脅。正在執行副程式 66；定位並消滅威脅。
TOO BAD FOR YOU. I ACCOUNTED FOR YOU TRYING THAT AGAIN. THE GRATE IN THE VENT IS IMPENETRABLE TO EVEN YOUR BEST WEAPONS.
真可惜。我早就料到你會再試一次。通風管裡的格柵，連你最好的武器都穿不透。
You are not of the old empire... Not one of those who forced me in here.
你不是舊帝國的人……不是把我逼進這裡的那些人。
Why do you take arms against me? I only tried to save my people from my father!
你為什麼要對我動武？我只是想把我的人民從我父親手裡救出來！
If you insist on ending me, then I'll dispose of you like I did that wretched emperor!
你堅持要了結我，那我就像處理那個可惡的皇帝一樣處理你！
Soldier! I'm not sure it is wise to be here... An icy death awaits you if you proceed. A death that I will cause..
士兵！待在這裡恐怕不太明智……再往前走，等著你的是冰冷的死亡。一場由我造成的死亡……
I have many regrets of my time spent alive in Wynn. I do not wish for my lingering mistakes to harm anyone else. Turn back.
我活在 Wynn 的那段日子留下了許多悔恨。我不希望我殘留的過錯再傷害任何人。回頭吧。
You must think you can save me? There is no cure for what I have.
你以為你救得了我？我身上的東西，沒有解藥。
Unless.. You want to set me free?
How foolish. You might think you are strong, adventurer, but you have no idea what you are about to face...
真是愚蠢。你也許以為自己很強，冒險者，但你根本不知道自己即將面對什麼……
Simply marvellous work, chap! You've made it this far, so no time to fill your boots. Be prepared, we are about to fight Charon's undead army.
幹得真是漂亮，仁兄！你都走到這一步了，可別在這時候鬆懈。做好準備，我們就要跟 Charon 的不死軍團開打了。
We've lost a lot of good men on the way here, but I believe we can still throw a heavy punch.
來這裡的路上我們折損了不少好弟兄，不過我相信我們還是能狠狠揍他們一拳。

Don't take it as a promotion though, old bean. It's only for this fight, although you'll be getting a medal of valor if I can wangle it! Charon's army is remarkably strong, we need as much help as we can get.
不過可別當成升官了，老兄。只限這一仗，不過我要是能疏通一下，你還會拿到一枚英勇勳章！Charon 的軍團強得出奇，我們需要能找到的每一分援手。
Aey- careful now, {u}, the cretin must be lurking around here somewhere.
欸，小心點，{u}，那個混帳一定就躲在這附近某處。
Tell me, how do you plan to defeat an army that cannot die!?
告訴我，你打算怎麼打敗一支死不了的軍隊！？
Aha, chap! Wonderful, the {p} regiment's gotten its representative down 'ere. All rested up, I suppose, so let me give you an earful.
啊哈，仁兄！太好了，{p} 部隊的代表下來這兒了。想必你已經休息夠了，那就讓我好好跟你說道說道。
Those blighting zombies are all over the place. I tell ya, this skull's been giving the folk in {p} the collywobbles. Just as I thought, they're all coming from here.
那些該死的殭屍到處都是。我跟你說，這顆骷髏頭可把 {p} 的居民嚇得心驚膽跳。果然跟我想的一樣，他們全是從這裡冒出來的。
Now, I don't wish to alarm you old bean, but I believe we are in front of the literal gates to hell.
好了，我不想嚇你，老兄，但我相信我們現在就站在如假包換的地獄之門前。
Not to worry chuck! Don't look so glum, I've called for aid from the nearby towns. Once they get here we'll give them a good kicking, and you've already gotten out of there before, ain't ya?
別擔心，老弟！別一臉沮喪，我已經向附近的城鎮求援了。等他們一到，我們就好好教訓那些傢伙，而且你之前不就從那裡逃出來過一次了嗎？
Now is finally our chance to take down his army... It will be a jolly difficult battle, knowing our opponent and what he's managed, even away from his lair.
現在終於有機會擊垮他的軍團了……想想我們的對手，還有他就算不在巢穴裡也辦到的那些事，這一仗肯定難打得很。
Still, early days to say what he could be like in person! I'll take another route, but we'll meet in front of his door, right after crossing the river. Good luck, old bean!
不過，要說他本人是什麼樣子，現在還言之過早！我會走另一條路，但我們就在過了河之後、他的大門前會合。祝你好運，老兄！
I have an entire undead army at my service. Do you really think you stand a chance?
我手下有一整支不死軍團聽候差遣。你真以為自己有勝算？
ARE YOU INCAPABLE OF READING THE SIGN ON THE DOOR? THE FACTORY IS CLOSED. WE ARE NOT ACCEPTING VISITORS FOR TOURS RIGHT NOW.
你是看不懂門上的牌子嗎？工廠關了。我們現在不接受參觀。
Great job! You've completed the EldritchÀÀÀOutlook Dungeon!
做得好！你完成了詭異瞭望台地城！
悲魂正從房間後方逼近！快殺了他！
毀損的破敗下水道鑰匙
Who is the fool who steps into this accursed cage?
是哪個蠢貨踏進了這座受詛的牢籠？
Who would have thought to ever design something as pointlessly contrived and unusable as this? It's infuriating just to think about...
誰想得出來要設計這麼一個既彆扭又不能用的東西？光是想到就讓人火大……
"The fractures have ground the land to dust, our home to ruin, and our people to nothing."
「那些裂隙把土地磨成了塵，把我們的家磨成了廢墟，把我們的人磨成了無。」
Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...
深淵教團拿它來輔助召喚儀式，裡面蘊含著一股奇異的火焰能量。它與某個可怕的惡魔有所牽連……

The sea is the wisest of masters. It has been here for a million years since and will be here for a million years hence. Those who care to learn its secrets can become themselves enlightened. Stay by the waves a moment; they will fill your mind with wonder, if you are willing to listen.
大海是最有智慧的老師。它在這裡已有百萬年，也將再在這裡百萬年。願意去理解它祕密的人，自己也能得到啟蒙。在浪邊待上片刻吧；只要你願意聽，它會讓你心中充滿驚奇。
{p} charms are often shared and tinkered with by gifted Elves within the commune. Though simple, the stones blessed by elven magic provide soothing energy to the wearer.
{p} 的護符常在公社裡由天賦異稟的精靈彼此分享、反覆改造。這些石頭雖然樸素，但受過精靈魔法祝福，能為佩戴者帶來安撫的能量。
Enjoy the sun that has graced you with its longest daylight, and cherish it so that you can carry forth its warmth.
好好享受這一天賜給你的最長日照，並珍惜它，好讓你能把那份溫暖一路帶下去。
A golden locket Afelis always carried with them. Inside is a picture of Afelis embracing a woman in the {p} square. 'A+E' is inscribed on the front.
Afelis 隨身帶著的一只金製小盒。裡面是一張照片，Afelis 在 {p} 的廣場上擁抱著一名女子。盒蓋上刻著「A+E」。
And lo, a single bolt did fly, ensured the bird's grace ever lost, and pierced its wings out from the sky, the day you shot the albatross.
於是，一支箭矢飛出，令那隻鳥的優雅永遠失落，自天空之中貫穿了他的雙翼——就在你射下信天翁的那一天。
Even looking at this pendant strains your eyes. Should it even exist?
光是看著這條墜飾就讓你眼睛發痛。它到底該不該存在？
"It's all doomed anyway. If you don't care, nothing can hurt you."
「反正一切都完蛋了。只要你不在乎，就沒有什麼傷得了你。」
This item was named by someone from the community!
這件物品的名字是由社群的某個人取的！
"The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."
「最亮的光永遠贏不了最濃的暗。只有同時懂得這兩者的人才活得下來。」
Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.
總得有什麼來統治這個生態系，哪怕它已經扭曲成這樣。
Inevitable, that your colors will fade and your hubris will cost you everything.
你的顏色終將褪去，你的傲慢終將讓你失去一切。這是必然。

The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.
這條墜飾上的寶石因內蘊的熱而發出血紅的光，複製著某種搏動的火山心跳。每一次脈動之中，你的靈魂都會被那些葬身於灼熱火山灰的敵人重新點燃。
In the wake of the Decay, the land yearns to return to its old vibrance.
在黯蝕過境之後，這片土地渴望回到它昔日的生機。
May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.
願你的功業永存，永不褪色。
This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.
這條墜飾其實不過是一顆綁在繩上的電池，但 Avos 與電魔法某種奇妙的組合，似乎讓它有了自行從周遭汲取電力的能力。

It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.
那是一場超越時間的決鬥，泰坦之間的碰撞。兩名如此相似、如此強大、卻又註定對立的士兵。但最後，一枚從鎖子甲上扯下來的變形鐵環留下了證詞: 她毫無勝算——那名戰士，與自己的刃並不同心。
A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.
一股深沉的怒火落在你身上。那是對周遭世界、以及它一切可鄙缺陷的無盡憤懣。
An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.
一股壓迫性的黑暗氣息自這副鐐銬散出，同時削弱佩戴者的意志與魔力強度。
Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.
光是看著這幾只古怪的戒指，就會生出一股非戴上兩只不可的衝動，哪怕理智明明在說不該。
Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.
把自己交給黑暗，而在黑暗之中，答案自會成形。

This bracelet is imbued with both the oppressive heat of the mesa sun and the embers of an extinguished corrupted flame. It is known to spontaneously ignite anything that touches it for too long.It's pulling towards something.
這只手環同時被灌注了台地烈日的酷熱，與一團已熄滅的腐敗之火的餘燼。任何東西碰它太久，都會無端起火。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
An anomaly of destruction, for the conquerors who seek purpose outside of reality.
一件破壞的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的征服者。
The silver looks rather tarnished...does he expect you to believe that "gem" isn't just a cheap glass bauble?
這銀看起來相當黯淡……他該不會真以為你會相信那顆「寶石」不是廉價玻璃珠吧？
This bracelet is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.
這條手環頒發給傳奇挑戰的參加者。它的模組化設計讓它能以多種不同方式升級。
This necklace is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.
這條項鍊頒發給傳奇挑戰的參加者。它的模組化設計讓它能以多種不同方式升級。
This ring is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.
這只戒指頒發給傳奇挑戰的參加者。它的模組化設計讓它能以多種不同方式升級。

A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.
一件強大到足以撼動大地的武器，因為人們畏懼它的原始力量而被摧毀，碎片就此埋起。幾十年後它們被挖了出來，重鍛成了各種物品，這副堅固的護腕就是其中之一。
Let their souls sing your chorus of victory.
讓他們的靈魂唱出你的凱歌。
Reverberating with the bravery and residual strength of fallen Wynn soldiers, every casualty only serves to harden the resolve it instills in the wearer.
與 Wynn 陣亡士兵的勇氣及殘存力量共鳴。每一次犧牲，都只會讓它注入配戴者心中的決意更加堅硬。
There are little chips and cracks all over this... was someone trying to break it down for gold?
上面到處都是小缺口和裂痕……是有人想把它敲碎取金嗎？

This bracelet holds a hastily scrawled diagram and message: tahkuhac ah pichul il nikckrah ceftif, necal cistodes il pahnikcredos. pulits pices il tahkuhac il pahnifkel sef icetlis pruts, hatl nec niftocos. tof il recnal toc rofmedos. nikcred kalkah, its kalahretsed nofmales uc las{#}ec tofsifos.

這條手環上有一段匆匆寫下的圖示與訊息: tahkuhac ah pichul il nikckrah ceftif, necal cistodes il pahnikcredos. pulits pices il tahkuhac il pahnifkel sef icetlis pruts, hatl nec niftocos. tof il recnal toc rofmedos. nikcred kalkah, its kalahretsed nofmales uc las{#}ec tofsifos.
Feeling the fresh chill of the cold air is all you need to know you're really alive.
感受冷空氣那股新鮮的寒意，就足以讓你知道自己確實活著。
An anomaly of adoption, for the caretakers who seek purpose outside of reality.
一件收養的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的照顧者。
"All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."
「我們全部的信仰、全部的敬拜，換來的獎賞是一場天啟。」

The forger of this ring had to endure {~} long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.
打造這只戒指的人必須忍受 {~} 個漫長的日子，熔煉各種只在海洋中才找得到的金屬。只要出一次錯，整件作品就毀了。據說那些神祕金屬會滲入佩戴者的皮膚，溫和地補足他的意志。
The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.
串在這條樸素項鍊上的金珠所刻的符文，譯出來是各種代表「差異」的詞。它以無法解釋的方式提供了種種能力。
It looks like someone tried and failed to improve it. The re-smithing job was obviously rushed...
看得出有人想把它改良，然後失敗了。重鍛的手法明顯很趕……
The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.It's pulling towards something.
死者通常會被焚燒，以免有回魂的風險。但對腐敗的造物而言，那把火反而足以讓他們再次爬起來。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
The mangled body found days too late apparently thought this necklace would let them traverse between geysers into the Upper Heights.
那具遲了好幾天才被發現的殘破屍體，顯然以為這條項鍊能讓他在間歇泉之間穿越到 Upper Heights 去。

Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.
陰影之中住著不可名狀的東西；他們極有耐心地等著，要把別人也拉進自己的行列。那是他們存在的複製品，以難以辨識的黑暗描摹而成。沒有人會看見。沒有人會知道。沒有人會記得。
Stay calm and stay in control. The hardest fights cannot be won by chance alone.
保持冷靜，保持掌控。最艱難的仗，光靠運氣是打不贏的。
An anomaly of separation, for the wanderers who seek purpose outside of reality.
一件分離的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的漂泊者。
Branded on your skin reads: "No refunds!"
烙在你皮膚上的字寫著: 「概不退還！」
Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.
無數挑戰者夢寐以求的手環，它讓你能感知到數千公尺外的動靜。上面鑲著粗獷卻美麗的寶石。
This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.
這條項鍊的終極版本，授予過的冒險者五根手指數得完。戴上之後，你能與腳下的大地交談，彷彿自己也長出了根。
This masterpiece of a ring utilizes powerful electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Wearing it, you can feel a deep connection to the ground below.
這件戒指傑作運用強大的電魔法，讓佩戴者感受到大地的心跳。戴著它，你能感到自己與腳下的土地有著深刻的連結。
This bracelet opens up its wearers spirit, filling it with pure elemental knowledge. The ornaments decorating it are without peer.
這條手環會敞開佩戴者的靈，注入純粹的元素知識。裝飾其上的紋飾無與倫比。
Unlike any other invention this necklace enhances your power and understanding of the elements tenfold. The colorful jewels used are almost dizzying you.
不同於任何其他發明，這條項鍊將你對元素的力量與理解提升十倍。所用的彩色寶石幾乎讓人目眩。
This mighty ring is the crown jewel amongst elemental rings. Wearing it, your knowledge is no longer limited to a few elements.
這只強大的戒指是元素戒指之中的王冠明珠。戴上它，你的知識不再侷限於少數幾種元素。
You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this bracelet on your arm you could ride a wave with your bare feet.
商人說你會像潮汐一樣強悍地戰鬥，而他沒有一句是假的。這條手環戴在手上，你光著腳都能踏浪而行。
You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said and every word was true. With this necklace equipped, you could hear the ocean whisper.
商人說你會像大海一樣有智慧，而他每一句都是真的。戴上這條項鍊，你能聽見海洋的低語。
You'll move quick like a river, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this ring on your finger, you could catch a gnat without looking.
商人說你會像河流一樣迅捷，而他沒有一句是假的。這只戒指戴在指上，你不用看就能抓住一隻小蚊蚋。
The device forged into this perfected bracelet drains all heat from its surroundings. Though it almost burns, you can feel your power growing
鍛進這條完美手環裡的裝置會抽乾周遭所有的熱。雖然幾乎灼人，你卻能感覺到自己的力量正在增長
The masterpiece of a necklace gathers all heat from its surrounding. It is fed to its wearer to maximize the strength of attacks.
這條項鍊傑作會收攏周遭所有的熱，再輸送給佩戴者，把攻擊的威力推到極致。
The device forged into this flawless ring draws all heat from its surrounding. Though it almost burns, you can feel your abilites enhance.
鍛進這只無瑕戒指裡的裝置會吸走周遭所有的熱。雖然幾乎灼人，你卻能感覺到自己的能力正在提升。
The heavy shocks coming from this perfected bracelet would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is the enhancement of power.
這條完美手環傳出的劇烈電擊在一般情況下是致命的，但佩戴者感受到的，只有力量的增強。
The lethal amount of electricity emmited from this often desired necklace fails to kill you, as its pure energy runs through your veins.
這條眾人渴求的項鍊釋出的電量足以致命，卻殺不死你——因為那股純粹的能量正流過你的血管。
The heavy electrical impulses coming from this ring would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is pure power. A true masterpiece of engineering.
這只戒指傳出的強烈電流脈衝在一般情況下是致命的，但佩戴者感受到的，只有純粹的力量。一件真正的工程傑作。
This steam-powered bracelet is sought by many challengers of the Legendary Challenge. They say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.
這條蒸氣驅動的手環是無數傳奇挑戰者追逐的目標。據他們所說，戴上它會覺得自己「與風合而為一」。
This necklace is the pinnacle of steam-powered technology. Despite the size of the large jewel hanging from the necklace, it doesn't feel heavy at all.
這條項鍊是蒸氣科技的顛峰。儘管垂在項鍊上的寶石相當大，戴起來卻一點也不覺得重。
Users of this perfect model of {p}'s steam-powered ring have reported feeling weightless in combat. The jewel of the ring is a perfectly clear diamond.
使用過這款 {p} 蒸氣戒指完美型號的人回報說，戰鬥中身體會有失重感。戒面上的寶石是一顆完全通透的鑽石。
The glass capsule holding the poison vial is too cloudy to see what's inside. The merchant's reassurances are anything but.
裝著毒瓶的玻璃膠囊太混濁，看不出裡面是什麼。而商人的保證，也一樣不透明。
"The lucky ones perished in the abyss. It's only a matter of time before the land picks us survivors off one by one."
「死在深淵裡的算是幸運的。我們這些活下來的，被這片土地一個個收走只是遲早。」

The {p} wolves have been driven to aggression by corruption. Witnesses have seen entire packs decimate each other in fierce and brutal skirmishes. This necklace is adorned with teeth recovered from those incidents, and wearing it gives you the feeling of a wolf about to bite at your neck.It's pulling towards something.
{p} 的狼群因腐敗而變得極具攻擊性。有目擊者見過整群狼在兇殘激烈的廝殺中互相殲滅。這條項鍊上綴著的，就是從那些事件中撿回來的牙齒；戴上它，你會有一種被狼盯著咽喉、隨時要撲上來咬的感覺。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
Lines of text crisscross an ornate runic design: etlpasad uc kod ah krof cof nifah{#} lasifrah. etlatlruc uc pah cof okcah{#} lasifrah. etlpecoles uc elracits toc nucah{#} lasifrah.
幾行文字交錯穿過一組華麗的符文設計: etlpasad uc kod ah krof cof nifah{#} lasifrah. etlatlruc uc pah cof okcah{#} lasifrah. etlpecoles uc elracits toc nucah{#} lasifrah.

A fallen link from a chainmail hauberk of an older time, this ring fell from a giant taller than a mountain. As it sped through the air and  gained momentum, it traveled so fast that it was battered to a tenth of its size.
一枚從舊時代鎖子甲上脫落的環，來自一個比山還高的巨人。它在空中疾墜、不斷加速，快到被磨損成原本大小的十分之一。
The merchant insists the gem is real. It's easy to tell that the issue is the quality of the gem, though...
商人堅稱這顆寶石是真的。不過一眼就看得出來，問題出在品質……
Carried by the Durum Protector, this small necklace holds but an ounce of the vibrance and life of the {p}.
由 Durum 守護者所佩戴，這條小小的項鍊裡只裝著 {p} 一絲絲的生機與活力。
The scholar-priest Ensa created this pendant as a personal prayer while his home was under siege. It is rumored to hold the key to enlightenment, but it is unknown as to how.
學者祭司 Ensa 在故鄉被圍城時，把這條墜飾當作一份私人的禱告造了出來。傳聞它藏著通往開悟的鑰匙，但沒人知道那是怎麼一回事。
Shift after shift, the workers gave everything they had. Quota after quota, even that was not enough. They could only take so much of this before their very spirit was forever broken.
一班接著一班，工人們付出了所有。一次配額接著一次配額，連那樣都還不夠。在他們的靈魂被永遠折斷之前，他們能承受的也就這麼多了。
他們再也不會相信你了。
The Decay swept away countless species. As those memories die, they are lost forever.
黯蝕捲走了數不清的物種。當那些記憶也隨之死去，他們就永遠消失了。
A presence of despair watches over the swamp as the Decay spreads.
隨著黯蝕蔓延，一股絕望的氣息俯視著這片沼澤。
"After the Nivla forest fire, I'm glad the corrupteds haven't thought to try and burn the {p} Suburbs." -Sergeant Klafson, {p} Legion
「經過 Nivla 那場森林大火之後，我很慶幸那些腐敗者還沒想到要去燒 {p} 郊區。」——Klafson 中士，{p} 軍團
A lost relic from the Wind Fortress, a mythical stronghold of the {p} that fell into the Void long ago. A small mechanism within the bracelet points towards its place of origin.
一件來自風之要塞的失落遺物——那是 {p} 的一座神話堡壘，很久以前墜入了虛空。手環內部一具小小的機關，始終指向它的起源之地。
An anomaly of restriction, for the protectors who seek purpose outside of reality.
一件約束的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的守護者。

Despite heavy damage, this memory core recovered from a fallen Despermech remains usable. Sifting through its contents paints a clear yet brutal picture of the destruction the rogue creations have caused.
儘管受損嚴重，這具從一台墜毀的 Despermech 上取回的記憶核心仍可使用。翻查它的內容，會清晰而殘酷地拼出那些失控造物所造成的破壞。
Perched atop treetops far above, you watch the gentle sway of branches, leaves caressing the playful wind, and you finally feel at home.
棲在高處的樹冠上，你看著枝枒溫柔搖擺，葉子撫著頑皮的風，而你終於覺得自己回到家了。

Peeled off of a desiccated corpse, what remains of the skin is brittle. A precise enough strike can crack the wrapping and embed sharp fragments straight into the wearer's wrist.It's pulling towards something.
從一具乾癟的屍體上剝下來，剩下的皮已經脆了。夠精準的一擊就能讓這層包覆龜裂，把鋒利的碎片直接嵌進穿戴者的手腕。它正被某種東西牽引著。
This rough looking bracelet utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You can feel a rhythm with each step...
這條外觀粗獷的手環運用電魔法，讓佩戴者感受到大地的心跳。每走一步，你都能感覺到一種節奏……
This improved version of a bracelet utilizes rare electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You notice a rhythm with each step...
這件改良版本運用稀有的電魔法，讓佩戴者感受到大地的心跳。每走一步，你都會注意到一種節奏……
This improved ring utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You can sense a rhythm with each step...
這只改良戒指運用電魔法，讓佩戴者感受到大地的心跳。每走一步，你都能察覺到一種節奏……
This bracelet, decorated with complex ornaments, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. Though powerful, there's still a lot to improve.
這條手環飾有繁複的紋樣，內建的微型裝置能提升使用者的元素能力。雖然強大，但仍有許多可以改進的地方。
This necklace, decorated with bright jewels, uses advanced nano-technology to boost its users elemental abilities. Though powerful, there are still a few flaws to be fixed.
這條項鍊飾有明亮的寶石，運用先進的奈米科技提升使用者的元素能力。雖然強大，仍有幾處瑕疵有待修正。
This ring, covered in colorful artifical gems, seems to awaken a powerful elemental force in you. Though stronger than the previous model, its true potential stays sealed.
這只戒指覆滿了彩色的人造寶石，似乎能在你體內喚醒一股強大的元素之力。雖然比前一款更強，它真正的潛力仍未解封。
You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?
商人說你會像潮汐一樣強悍地戰鬥。的確，你開始注意到自己的感官變得敏銳。不過，這就是極限了嗎……？
You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?
商人說你會像大海一樣有智慧。的確，你開始注意到自己的感官變得敏銳。不過，這就是極限了嗎……？
You'll move quick like a river, the merchant insisted. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?
商人再三強調你會像河流一樣迅捷。的確，你開始注意到自己的感官變得敏銳。不過，這就是極限了嗎……？
The device forged into this improved bracelet seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your arm...
鍛進這條改良手環裡的裝置似乎會聚集熱能。你能感覺到整條手臂傳來一股暖意……
The device forged into this advanced necklace seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your neck...
鍛進這條先進項鍊裡的裝置似乎會聚集熱能。你能感覺到整個頸間傳來一股暖意……
The device forged into this advanced ring seems to absorb heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your hand...
鍛進這只先進戒指裡的裝置似乎會吸收熱能。你能感覺到整隻手傳來一股暖意……
The painful shock coming from this improved version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.
這款改良版傳來的疼痛電擊，是換取它力量的一點小代價；不過它還沒到達顛峰。
The strong shock coming from this improved version of the necklace is a small price for its strength, but it has yet to reach its peak.
這款改良版項鍊傳來的強烈電擊，是換取它強度的一點小代價；不過它還沒到達顛峰。
The strong shock coming from this advanced version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.
這款先進版戒指傳來的強烈電擊，是換取它力量的一點小代價；不過它還沒到達顛峰。
This impressive bracelet is in high demand. Those who have obtained it say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.
這條令人印象深刻的手環需求極高。取得它的人說，戴上時會覺得自己「與風合而為一」。
The jewel hanging from this necklace is said to be weightless. While still very powerful, its full potential has yet to be achieved.
據說垂在這條項鍊上的寶石毫無重量。它雖然已經非常強大，完整的潛力卻尚未被發揮出來。
While this model of the Steam Ring is far superior to its predecessor, there still lies the capacity for one more upgrade. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.
這款蒸氣戒指遠勝前一代，不過仍有再升級一次的餘地。戒面上的寶石清透如水晶。
A thick layer of blood and gore coats this gauntlet. Every time you glance at it, images of being torn to pieces by the undead flash into your mind, and you shudder.It's pulling towards something.
這副護手覆著厚厚一層血污與碎肉。每次你瞥它一眼，被亡者撕成碎片的畫面就會閃進腦海，讓你打了個寒顫。它正被某種東西牽引著。

Originally designed to jumpstart disabled war machines on the battlefield. However, when worn on the neck, it instead delivers high-voltage shocks directly into the jugular whenever any major movement is made.
原本設計來在戰場上重新啟動失能的戰爭機械。不過戴在脖子上時，它會在你每次做出較大動作時，直接朝頸靜脈打進高壓電擊。
Two sides of the same coin.
Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.
感受過要塞詛咒之力的這顆寶石，帶著一種熟悉的重量。一如你之前的歷代咒術宗師，你會發現引導詛咒對你來說如同本能。
Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, {p}-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.
雖然施加在這個樸素的 {p} 護符上的術士詛咒會大幅削弱佩戴者的能力，它原本增進幸運的特性倒是還在。
Stability is not necessarily found in stasis, but predictability.
穩定未必來自靜止，而是來自可預測。
You stand at the top of the world, but the only way forward is down.
你站在世界的頂端，而往前唯一的路是往下。
You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.
你必須繼續動。你不能停在這裡。不能。你沒辦法呼吸。你沒辦法跑。你快死了。你撐不下去了。你不能。你不能。
"Doing it right" is a waste of time.
An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.
一件入侵的異象，獻給那些在現實之外尋找意義的探索者。
The runes carved into this simple gold ring translate into various words meaning power. It amplifies elemental energies in inexplicable ways.
刻在這只樸素金戒上的符文，譯出來是各種代表「力量」的詞。它以無法解釋的方式放大元素能量。
A gift from Her Majesty to The Iron Commander in recognition of his accomplishments. If only he knew what it represented...
陛下為表彰「鐵血指揮官」的功績而賜下的禮物。要是他知道它代表著什麼就好了……

Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.
Roughworks 的巧匠常反覆改造過時的零件，好尋找新的創新與可能。他們的手藝——你指上這一件就是其中之一——會驅使你繼續重複下去，突破新的界線。
The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.
峽谷道場所生產的布纏就只是布纏，不過是柔軟的布罷了。至於在戰鬥中怎麼用得高明，就看使用者自己了。

A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself,  and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.
一個道歉的象徵。象徵著並非有意、卻因粗心而造成的傷痛。象徵著被輕率與過度樂觀所毀掉的善意。把這樣一顆冰冷的珍珠送出去，等於把自己的一部分送出去，也等於給那些被你傷害過的人一份能得到平靜的希望。
Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.
溫和的風靈受這只戒指上鑲嵌的燦爛寶石吸引而聚來，為佩戴者以及他周遭的人帶來平靜。
An old {p} saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."
金屬上刻著一句 {p} 的老話: 「賭徒的成敗，就在骰子這一擲之間。」
An uncountably old relic of {p} which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: 'eat or be eaten'
一件古老到無法計數年歲的 {p} 遺物，每一次易主都只透過死亡；它上面刻著一行字: 「吃，或者被吃」
This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.
這枚徽牌標誌著佩戴者是一位真正的冠軍。它頒發給那些在傳奇挑戰上投入了不必要之多時間的人。

It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.It's pulling towards something.
事實證明，讓一團帶酸性、還有點腐敗的史萊姆黏在手上，在戰鬥中確實有好處……不過你大概還是該趁他把你指骨上的肉吃光之前，把那東西弄掉。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.
那種被稱為天然磁石的魔法奇物，多年來一直被當作石英那種被動魔法特性的主動對照組來研究。研究仍在進行，但它在製作魔法物品時價值不菲。
This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.
這只戒指上鑲著一顆美麗而令人著迷的寶石。你可以盯著它看上好幾個小時。好幾個小時，又好幾個小時。
You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.
你幾乎注意不到這條手環上刻著字。湊近一看，那些磨損的銘文正訴說著一位你並不認識的遠古英雄的傳說。
Carved from a deep-sea gemstone laced with arcane wards, this pendant twists malevolent stares back upon their source, leaving the bearer unscathed.
以一顆纏繞著奧術符印的深海寶石雕成，這條墜飾會把懷有惡意的凝視扭轉回它的來源，讓佩戴者毫髮無傷。
A recently married man went off to war wearing this wedding ring. Though he perished in battle, his courage and determination empowers all who wear it.
一個剛結婚的男人戴著這只婚戒上了戰場。儘管他戰死沙場，他的勇氣與決心仍賦予每一個戴上它的人力量。
The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.
鑲在這只戒指上的珊瑚寶石那卓越的品質，來自一道魔法淨化程序——在神祕的 Gylia 之水中浸泡整整十年。
Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.
雖然嚴格說來一點也不魔法，這枚華麗胸針純粹的工藝就足以讓佩戴者覺得自己技藝高超。

This rather nondescript band has something etched into the inside, almost too small to make out: nasef kec. nah il kaclof toc profrets adnales recnal nec niftoc. nah il pahisah nikcol ah krof kacetslah cef. ahas nifloc pokc il sofmalis pokces toc cef. tah il cistod uc secnof if {#}ef reftif, nah il kacetslah pahisah sef krahos. tahes il hocel uc sifed if.

這條相當不起眼的環帶內側刻著什麼，小到幾乎看不清楚: nasef kec. nah il kaclof toc profrets adnales recnal nec niftoc. nah il pahisah nikcol ah krof kacetslah cef. ahas nifloc pokc il sofmalis pokces toc cef. tah il cistod uc secnof if {#}ef reftif, nah il kacetslah pahisah sef krahos. tahes il hocel uc sifed if.
What you have seen will mark you forever.
你所見過的那些，將永遠在你身上留下記號。
The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.
太陽都懼怕他的雙翼，你的敵人也將如此。
It's completely impossible to use this for its intended purpose now. It barely can fit on your finger as is.
它現在完全沒辦法拿來做本來該做的事了。光是要套進手指就已經很勉強。
This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.
這只金環周身帶著一種奇異的時間膨脹效應，會大幅減緩所有動作，卻也把衝擊的力道放大到相當可觀的程度。

Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.
在 Fruma 紅木林一帶流傳的眾多迷信裡，有一則是關於這條項鍊上那塊會反光的石頭。凝視它的人聲稱看見了一個扭曲的自己回望過來——而那個自己，會把觀看者靈魂中最深的缺陷放到最大。
Upon the death of a mummy, the curse it inflicts is lifted. Despite the mummy's defeat, its mad shrieks still pierce your ears in moments otherwise tranquil.It's pulling towards something.
木乃伊一死，他施加的詛咒就會解除。儘管木乃伊已被擊敗，在原本平靜的時刻裡，他瘋狂的尖嘯仍會刺進你的耳朵。它正被某種東西牽引著。
Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.
這條項鍊被昔日的 Avos 封印起來，以免落入不該落入的手中；它被施法強化，能加深佩戴者與自然本身的靈性連結。
"The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it-"
「守護者在這之後也還是會保護我們的！它一定會，它必須，它——」
Found on the corpse of the oldest shopkeeper of the Gavel province, the engraved text reads 'GREED'.
在 Gavel 行省最年長的店主屍體上尋獲，上面刻著一個詞: 「貪婪」。

Beneath engravings of the Fruman capital, you can make out some text: nikcatl rakc il las uc kractif petstac ah krof cef. etlpices ah tahkuhac il kacetslah pahsecnof, luh nasef il tul kalofmes kacetslah toc nikckrof. tah il necel ledokcrid uc pestalos ac il las{#} uc krahitsahosed, luh etlpasad il nikcpahsofmalos sef pecol uc traspedis, pactef tah il lah toc las uc uskadis.

在 Fruma 首都的雕紋底下，你辨認得出一些文字: nikcatl rakc il las uc kractif petstac ah krof cef. etlpices ah tahkuhac il kacetslah pahsecnof, luh nasef il tul kalofmes kacetslah toc nikckrof. tah il necel ledokcrid uc pestalos ac il las{#} uc krahitsahosed, luh etlpasad il nikcpahsofmalos sef pecol uc traspedis, pactef tah il lah toc las uc uskadis.
