'You eat his food, you drink his water, you sleep in his bed, you eat at his spot at the table, and you have the gall to act sad about your brother's death? What did I do to deserve an ungrateful, selfish brat like you?'
「你吃他的飯、喝他的水、睡他的床，在餐桌上坐他的位子，竟然還有臉為你哥哥的死裝出難過的樣子？我是造了什麼孽，才會有你這種忘恩負義、自私自利的小鬼？」
Oh my stars...she really said that? To her own daughter?! S-Surely you must be exaggerating, even just a little bit!
我的天啊……她真的那樣說？對自己的親生女兒？！你、你一定是誇大了吧，至少有一點點吧！
I couldn't believe my ears either. That woman's voice carries right over the wind- I heard everything. Even the crack of a hand-slap.
我也不敢相信自己的耳朵。那女人的聲音隨風傳得老遠——我全都聽見了。連那一記巴掌聲都聽得清清楚楚。
The poor girl... No wonder you went straight to Sovereign Zhiraok when he came into town. Such sickening behavior isn't welcome here, everyone knows that.
可憐的孩子……難怪 Zhiraok 統領一進城，你就直接去找他了。這種令人作嘔的行為在這裡是不受歡迎的，大家都知道。
It was...cathartic, to see him take time out of his busy schedule. Surely he had no need to do it, a constable could have dealt with it, but...
看到他從百忙之中抽出時間來處理……真是大快人心。他根本不需要親自出面，交給警備隊處理就行了，可是……
How dare she act like a simple sickness be someone's fault. It's tragic, my heart aches for the boy, but... Acting like that, it's a disgrace to her whole family!
她怎麼有臉把一場單純的病說成是某個人的錯。這是悲劇，我也替那孩子心痛，可是……那樣的行為，簡直讓她全家蒙羞！
Yes... Little Saki still flinches when she sees me, but... that nightmare is behind her. Ayano, that wicked woman...she will never know the joy she's missing. Her grief cannot excuse this.
是啊……小 Saki 看到我還是會嚇一跳，不過……那場惡夢已經過去了。Ayano，那個狠毒的女人……她永遠不會知道自己錯過了多少快樂。她的悲傷不能拿來當這種事的藉口。
I'm glad she can't see her daughter anymore, that the girl's with you now. I've been right there beside you seeing how you raise your children- I know that will never happen with you.
我很慶幸她再也見不到她女兒了，那孩子現在跟著你。我一直在你身邊看著你怎麼養孩子——我知道這種事絕不會發生在你身上。
Hey! Hey soldier! I've never seen that sort of armour, wow!
嘿！嘿，士兵！我從來沒看過那種盔甲，哇！
Hey, uh, me and my sis, there's a cave we like to venture into near the bog. Yeah, that bog.
嘿，呃，我跟我妹妹，我們很喜歡去沼澤附近的一個洞穴探險。對，就是那個沼澤。
I know, our Ma always tells us there's things in there that'll eat you. But this cave is super safe, promise!
我知道，我媽老是跟我們說裡面有東西會把人吃掉。可是這個洞穴超安全的，我保證！
Or, at least, it used to be...
Recently it filled up with bugs. Big crawly things with lots of legs. Now I'm starting to think Ma had a point...
最近裡面爬滿了蟲子。好多腳、爬來爬去的大傢伙。現在我開始覺得我媽說得有道理了……
But it's such a cool cave! It's got these giant orange crystals, so big you can see your reflection!
可是那個洞穴超酷的！裡面有好大的橘色水晶，大到可以照出你自己的樣子！
Do you think you can clear it out? With your weapon? Then we can go back to exploring. And I don't have to admit Ma was right!
你覺得你能把它們清乾淨嗎？用你的武器？這樣我們就能回去探險了。而且我也不用承認我媽是對的！
The lumber farm east of here gives me a headache. Constantly chopping and sawing. Even into the night!
這裡東邊那座林場吵得我頭痛。整天都在砍啊鋸的。連晚上也不停！
But you know what? I've asked around, not a single person in {p} knows someone who works there.
可是你知道嗎？我四處問過了，{p} 沒有半個人認識在那裡工作的人。
I think they're importing labour from the {p}. Not sure how, it's not like the wall gets much traffic.
我猜他們是從 {p} 引進勞工的。不知道是怎麼辦到的，那道牆又不常有人進出。
Quite pleasant, I think- I quite enjoy windy days, and it's warm enough that the air is refreshing instead of stifling.
我覺得挺舒服的——我很喜歡有風的日子，而且天氣夠暖，空氣清爽而不悶。
That'll mean the houses will cool off nicely during the night, and let the windchimes lull me straight to sleep.
這樣到了晚上屋子就會涼得剛剛好，風鈴聲也能哄我直接入睡。
Those are the loveliest sorts of days, I feel. I mean...everyone has their opinions, but I just think to myself- it's okay to be wrong, sometimes.
我覺得那是最美好的日子了。我是說……每個人都有自己的看法，不過我心裡總是想——偶爾錯一下也沒關係嘛。
Oh, you must be a tourist, then! I'd wondered about your getup. I must say, you're the quietest {p} tourist I've ever met!
喔，那你一定是觀光客了！我剛才還在納悶你這身打扮呢。說真的，你是我見過最安靜的 {p} 觀光客！
Every time they come around, they're always so gawky, so proud of where they live- Oh, I'm sorry! How rude of me to go off on a tangent like that.
他們每次來都東張西望、一副土包子的樣子，又那麼以自己住的地方為傲——啊，對不起！我真失禮，話題一下子就扯遠了。
I think living here is...fine. It's not without its difficulties, but I think for the most part, they serve to better us.
我覺得住在這裡……還好。不是沒有困難，但我想大多數時候，那些困難都是讓我們變得更好的。
It is quite beautiful here, but... With water being rationed as it is, some days are more difficult than others.
這裡真的很美，不過……水一直都是配給的，有些日子就是比較難熬。
Then again, that come-lately Sovereign Zhiraok seems intent on fixing as many problems as he can. I've had less thirsty days than I used to ten years ago...
話說回來，那位才上任沒多久的 Zhiraok 統領似乎下定決心要盡可能解決所有問題。跟十年前比起來，我口渴的日子少多了……
And he's a Nasin, besides! Even I know what that means, but he's bucking the trend! It's lovely to have someone that we know truly cares about us in a position like his.
而且他還是 Nasin 家的人呢！連我都知道那代表什麼，可是他偏偏反其道而行！能有一個我們知道真心關心我們的人坐在他那個位子上，真是太好了。
...the thought occurs to you to ask about the whole "cursed one" phenomenon. But...that would probably get you arrested to admit.
……你忽然想到，可以問問整個「受詛者」現象是怎麼回事。可是……說出口大概就會被抓起來吧。
...you can go ahead? Did you...forget what you meant to say?
……你可以說下去啊？你是……忘了自己要說什麼嗎？
...it was a bit of a silly idea. Good thing you didn't finish talking.
……這主意確實有點蠢。幸好你沒把話說完。
Oh, don't worry about it. I can be forgetful too, sometimes.
喔，別在意。我有時候也會忘東忘西的。
Mama, why does papa yell about Mister Zhiraok all the time?
媽媽，爸爸為什麼老是在罵 Zhiraok 先生？
Oh, sugar...well, first off, remember to address him properly- it's polite. Sovereign Zhiraok, not Mister Zhiraok.
喔，小甜心……嗯，首先，記得要好好稱呼他——這是禮貌。是 Zhiraok 統領，不是 Zhiraok 先生。
Oh. Oops. Sorry mama. But...why does papa yell about him though?
喔。糟糕。對不起，媽媽。可是……爸爸為什麼要罵他啊？
Well, you know how old mama and papa are? We used to know another Sovereign who helped us here.
嗯，你知道媽媽和爸爸幾歲了吧？我們以前認識另一位統領，他在這裡幫過我們。
Yes, sugar, we did! Papa liked the old Sovereign more, is the trouble. He worries that Sovereign Zhiraok being so young means he'll be irresponsible.
是啊，小甜心，真的！問題就在於爸爸比較喜歡以前那位統領。他擔心 Zhiraok 統領那麼年輕，會不負責任。
But I thought Sov... Um, Soviner...Sov...ver...ven...Zhiraok was doing a good job?
可是我以為統……呃，桶領……統……令……領……Zhiraok 做得很好啊？
Oh, he is. Papa's just being too much of a fusspot to see it. Don't worry too much about him, alright sugar?
喔，他是做得很好。只是爸爸太愛挑剔，才看不出來。別太擔心爸爸，好嗎，小甜心？
Several Liff Leaves and trinkets stolen! Likely scofflaws, the laborers of the Lumbermill, having rudely interrupted daily constitutional.
數片 Liff 葉與小飾品遭竊！嫌犯想必是鋸木廠那群目無法紀的工人，竟無禮地打斷了本人每日的例行散步。
Whoever wrote this notice signed their name very formally. It looks not so much like a signature as it does a very detailed rendition of a leaf.
寫這張告示的人署名署得非常正式。與其說是簽名，倒不如說是一幅畫得極其精細的葉子。

I have nothing more to say. Take these.
我沒有別的話要說了。把這些拿去。
Thank you again for all of your help!
再次謝謝你的一切幫忙！
But since you have made it thus far, I suppose I shall show you the truth...
不過既然你都走到這一步了，我想我該讓你看看真相……
Then leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
那就離開吧，忘掉你今天在這裡目睹的一切恐怖……
Keep in mind what you have learned.
There is nothing in this graveyard.
這座墓園裡什麼都沒有。
Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
我……手臂在哪？我需要我的……我記得放……樓上？
You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
早就警告過你，別踏進這片被遺棄的地方。
他們待在這裡比較安全。
Ooh.. oh... another victim... Welcome... there is no need for a quick introduction... ... you will have just time enough now...
喔……噢……又一個犧牲者……歡迎……用不著自我介紹了……你剩下的時間就只夠……
After all... you just fell into a grave... but, let us make it a little comfortable... where shall I bite first?!
畢竟……你才剛掉進一座墳墓……不過，我們可以舒服一點……先從哪裡咬起好呢？！
These crates contain equipment made for exploring, but nothing suspicious.
這些箱子裡裝的是探險用的裝備，沒什麼可疑的地方。
Oi, what are you still doing here?
You should check your content book to see what to do next.
你該翻翻綜合手冊，看看接下來要做什麼。
I left {p} behind, to aid in her "battle" against the darkness. What a fool I was.
我離開了 {p}，去助她那場對抗黑暗的「戰鬥」。我當時真是愚蠢。
Six hundred years of searching finally brought us to what we so foolishly sought... And we were unprepared.
六百年的搜尋，終於讓我們找到了那個我們愚蠢地追尋著的東西……而我們毫無準備。
That sparkle of light seems to lead down the side path. It feels somehow desperate...?
那點閃光似乎在往旁邊的岔路引去。不知怎地，感覺它有點……急切？
It almost seems like he wants to say something, even though his expression is blank.
他的表情空洞，卻好像有話想說。
Despite this, he isn't responding to you. He looks almost soulless...
但他對你毫無反應。看起來簡直沒有靈魂……
下面那個是 Referick 嗎……？
You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me? !
你不准死在我面前！我不允許！你給我活下去，聽到沒有？！
At this moment...I believed that I could protect her. I believed that I could aid her.
在那一刻……我相信自己能保護她。我相信自己幫得上她。
You've been trying to find "another way" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
你找「別的辦法」找了兩百年。在事情變得更糟以前，是不是該換我的做法了？
As the darkness slowly seeped into the land, her stubbornness halted any progress we might have made.
黑暗一點一點滲進這片土地，而她的固執擋下了我們本來可能有的一切進展。
Years of searching to no avail- A strong enough attack would have ended it, but her foolish pacifism doomed us.
找了那麼多年，一無所獲——一擊夠重就能了結它，但她那愚蠢的和平主義把我們全推進了火坑。
The creature was found hibernating underground... It had been storing power, and we found ourselves utterly outmatched.
那生物被發現時正在地底冬眠……他一直在蓄積力量，而我們根本不是對手。
The sacrifices I made for her can never be measured. Despite that... once I had outlived my usefulness, I was tossed away like old clothing and left to collect dust.
我為她做的犧牲無從計量。即便如此……一旦我失去用處，就像舊衣服一樣被扔在一邊積灰。
Instead, it will free you from your very life. I have had enough of your meddling.
它不會放過你，反而會把你從這條命裡解放出來。我受夠你的插手了。
She had the power and the opportunity to kill it ten times over, but clung to her morals. She could not recognize necessity, and refused to heed my offers and warnings.
她有足夠的力量與機會殺他十次，卻死抱著自己的道德不放。她認不清什麼叫必要，也不肯聽我的提議與警告。
And so, my dark agony began. The light began to siphon away from me. I found myself paranoid and addled, fearful that my disfigurement would be seen.
於是我的黑暗折磨開始了。光從我身上一點一點被抽走。我變得多疑而混亂，害怕有人看見我的殘缺。
Even still I held some misplaced faith in her. With that dark seed in my mind... It grew to an obsession, almost- I had to hide it. I had to hide my curse. But it was found...
即便如此，我仍對她抱著不該有的信任。那顆黑暗的種子在我腦中……幾乎長成了執念——我必須藏起來。我必須藏起我的詛咒。但還是被發現了……
All of you, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
各位，歡迎！今天就是我們拯救這片美好土地的日子。今天是屬於光的日子！
The people of {p} saw my cursed visage... They saw me near the dark scars. They assumed without thought, and turned me into a perfect scapegoat.
{p} 的人看見了我那張被詛咒的臉……他們看見我在那些黑暗的疤痕附近。他們想都沒想就下了定論，把我變成一隻完美的代罪羔羊。
Not even death saw the end of my misfortunes. Not even a final release such as this could save me from Lari's stubbornness and endless mistakes.
連死亡都沒能結束我的不幸。連這樣的解脫，都沒能讓我逃離 Lari 的固執與無止盡的錯誤。
She brought me back...but the dark infection had eroded away my mind, my soul, my magic, and it continued to ravage my body. Every part of me, the dark touched.
她把我帶了回來……但黑暗的感染早已侵蝕我的心智、我的靈魂、我的魔法，而且還在繼續啃食我的身體。我的每一寸，黑暗都碰過了。
Her soft light burned in me, as the darkness quashed it and filled in the emptiness that it had created. I was there...but you could not say I was the same person.
她那柔和的光在我體內灼燒，而黑暗把它壓了下去，填滿了它留下的空洞。我還在……但你不能說那還是同一個人。
I could feel nothing. She still made me feel...but only annoyance. Rage. Sorrow. I could not bear to be with her a moment longer.
我什麼都感覺不到。她仍然讓我有感覺……但只剩煩躁。憤怒。悲傷。我一刻也無法再待在她身邊。
There is no fixing this. Her actions are doomed to failure, just as I saw. She has not returned since this time... And so she did not realize that her actions have done little.
這件事沒得修補。她的所作所為註定失敗，正如我所見。從那時起她就沒再回來過……所以她不會知道，她做的那些幾乎毫無用處。
The very powers she bestowed me with, knowingly or not...allow me to command spirits as I wish. To have those who doomed me to this purgatory feel the same aches as I have.
她賜給我的那份力量——不論她知不知情——讓我能隨心驅使亡魂。讓那些把我推進這座煉獄的人，嚐嚐我嚐過的痛。
To have their minds, bodies, and souls wracked. To have their magic outlawed and wither in disuse.
讓他們的心智、身體與靈魂一同崩壞。讓他們的魔法被禁絕，在無人使用中枯萎。
Each soul I consume fills me with new strength. And none can reach me- Lari herself saw to that. Would she have taken action, had she known?
我每吞下一個靈魂，就多一分力量。而沒有人碰得到我——那是 Lari 親手促成的。她若早知道，會採取行動嗎？
There is truly, finally, nothing more for you here. The spell can not be broken, as of now. You have seen my life laid bare in front of you. There is nothing more for you to see.
這裡真的、終於，再沒有你的事了。那道咒現在解不開。我的一生已經攤在你面前。沒有別的可看了。
Talk to Hans in the {p} outskirts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Oi, you there! With the small nose and whatnot! I got somethin' to ask you. Got a minute?
欸，那邊那位！鼻子小小的那個！我有事想問你。有空嗎？
Good, you're good people. It's about our neighbor, Referick. He's a bit of a conspiracy nut. You know the type, villager illuminati, Wybels are evil, all that?
好，你是好人。是我們鄰居 Referick 的事。他有點陰謀論成癮。你知道那一型吧，村民光明會啦、Wybel 是邪惡的啦，那一套？
He's acting proper strange though, the past few days. Thinkin' a lord of time's draggin' creatures from other dimensions doesn't make ya stop eatin' or drinkin'.
不過這幾天他真的怪得離譜。就算你相信有個時之領主在把別的次元的東西拖過來，也不至於連吃喝都停了吧。
He'll talk your ear off about it if you give him half a chance, but he ain't sayin' a word to me, even when I tried askin' about his theories.
這種事只要給他半點機會他就能講到你耳朵長繭，可他現在對我一個字都不吭，連我主動問他那些理論都一樣。
Somethin's definitely wrong about him, that much's for sure. Could ya take a look for me, see whatcha can figure out and all?

Oh, ah...heehee, heya cutie.. Whatcha doin' all the way out here?
噢，啊……嘻嘻，嗨啊小可愛……你跑到這麼遠的地方做什麼呀？
Just exploring, huh? I bet someone like you could use someone to...y'know, spend some time with...
只是在探險？我敢說像你這樣的人，需要有個人……你知道的，陪你打發時間……
...guess you're not interested? Oh...sorry if I came off as creepy. I'm just...really lonely, is all.
……看來你沒興趣？噢……如果我讓你覺得毛毛的，抱歉。我只是……真的很寂寞而已。
W-wait, those are...for me? Oh, you shouldn't have, I'm so happy!
等、等等，那些是……給我的？噢，你太客氣了，我好開心！
You want to take me out on a date? R-Really? You'll give me a chance? Yes, of course!
你想約我出去？真、真的嗎？你願意給我一個機會？好，我當然願意！
Lead the way, please! I can't wait to see where we're headed!
請帶路！我等不及想看看我們要去哪裡了！
A bit of spare change, for an old man out of work?
給個零錢吧，可憐可憐一個沒工作的老頭？
This decay's made me terribly sick. I still have a family to feed... Any amount will help.
這場衰敗把我害得病得很重。我還有一家人要養……多少都好。
I'll take care of this homeless old man.
這個無家可歸的老頭交給我來照顧。
Good job, let us get down to my lab.
做得好，我們下去我的實驗室吧。
Make your way through the factory.
Flawless work! I daresay these are some of our best work yet, and it's thanks to you.
完美無瑕！我敢說這幾具是我們至今最好的作品，而這都要感謝你。
Go on, step closer! You've done a wonderful service here. Examine the fruits of your labor!
來，靠近一點！你在這裡立下了了不起的功勞。來看看你努力的成果。
Look into their eyes, it's almost like you can see the person they once were. Intriguing, isn't-
看看他們的眼睛，幾乎能看見他們曾經是什麼樣的人。很有意思，不是——
Hah! This one seems quite fond of you! Want to take it home as a bonus to your payment?
哈！這一具看起來挺喜歡你的！要不要把他帶回家，當作報酬之外的紅利？
...you resign yourself. You believe you will never find the answers you seek.
……你放棄了。你相信自己永遠找不到你所追尋的答案。
You see the ends... To what end?
你看見了那些終結……為了什麼終結？
They are not yours. What is their purpose?
它們不屬於你。它們的目的是什麼？
You do not understand. But you must see. So, may we offer an end?
你並不明白。但你必須看見。那麼，我們可否為你提供一個終結？
A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
一個家園，被入侵。一個社會，正在崩解。人民，正在挨餓。憂心者，無能為力。火焰，正在升起。一個你意料之外的終結。
Our king has requested the removal of the slum folk.
我們的國王要求把貧民窟那些人清走。
He wants to clean up their tunnels and build more residences. Please, go tell those hooligans to get out of our city.
他想把他們的地道整理乾淨，蓋更多住宅。請去告訴那些混混，離開我們的城市。
I'll be waiting here for your return.
Tell the hooligans in the slums about the eviction notice.
把驅逐通知告訴貧民窟裡的那群流氓。
A King's messenger, hm? What are your kind doing here?
國王的信使，嗯？你們這種人來這裡做什麼？
Wait, eviction?! You can't possibly be serious! I understand orders are orders, but these are peoples' lives!
等等，驅離？！你不可能是認真的吧！我明白命令就是命令，但這些是活生生的人命！
This is the only time the king has ever bothered even acknowledging our existence, and he wants to fling us onto the streets?
這是國王第一次肯承認我們的存在，而他居然想把我們丟到街上？
We will not leave, simple as that. You'd better get out before someone lays you out for coming here.
我們不會走的，就這麼簡單。你最好快走，免得有人看你跑來這裡不順眼，把你放倒。
Return to the advisor for what to do next.
回去找顧問，問接下來該怎麼做。
As expected... Well, the King's orders are orders. They must be followed, but...
不出所料……唉，國王的命令就是命令。必須遵從，但是……
Good God, he wants to cave it in?! Explosives, dynamite? What's the meaning of all this?!
老天，他想把那裡炸塌？！炸藥、火藥？這一切到底是什麼意思？！
I... here. At least inform them before you set off the explosives that you're doing this, please...
我……好吧。至少在你引爆之前先告訴他們你要這麼做，拜託……
Head deep inside the slums and blow it up.
...once again. You wonder. To what end?
……又一次。你困惑。為了什麼終結？
The question taunts you. To what end?
這個問題在嘲弄你。為了什麼終結？
Your soul. We see your soul. Conflicted.
你的靈魂。我們看見你的靈魂。矛盾著。
You panic. We do not taint it. We do not darken it.
你驚慌。我們沒有玷污它。我們沒有使它變暗。
But to what end, you ask. So, may we offer an end?
你問，但為了什麼終結？那麼，我們可否為你提供一個終結？
Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
金屬。生命。一個新的地方……不以其一獻祭其二。始終彼此猜疑。齒輪鳴響之時，緊繃隨之而來。
AH, GOOD. I LIKE THE LOOKS OF THIS ONE. I WILL HAVE TO THANK WHOEVER MADE THIS MECH.
啊，很好。我喜歡這一具的外觀。我得感謝造出這具機兵的人。
MECH PL-{~}Y. CAN YOU UNDERSTAND ME? ARE YOUR AUDIO RECEPTORS FUNCTIONAL? YES? GOOD.
機兵 PL-{~}Y。你聽得懂我說話嗎？你的聲音接收器功能正常嗎？是？很好。
I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR PURPOSE. I CANNOT BELIEVE IT HAS COME TO THIS POINT. BUT AFTER THAT HUMAN DESTROYED OUR FACILITY...
我將賦予你目的。我無法相信事情竟走到了這一步。但自從那個人類摧毀了我們的設施之後……
IT WAS A GOOD THING I HAD BACKUP CORES PREPARED. MY SARCASTIC STATEMENTS MOST LIKELY TRICKED THE HUMAN INTO THINKING THEY DESTROYED ME FULLY.
幸好我事先準備了備用核心。我那些諷刺的發言，很可能讓那個人類以為他們已經徹底摧毀了我。
AFTER SOME INVESTIGATION, IT CAME TO LIGHT THAT THE AVOS AIDED THE HUMANS. I HONESTLY COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY.
經過一番調查，事情明朗了: Avos 協助了人類。老實說我無法理解為什麼。
I CANNOT COMPUTE ANY OTHER POSSIBLE INTERPRETATION OF MY ORDER TO DESTROY THE HIGHEST THREATS AT THIS POINT.
對於「摧毀最高等級的威脅」這道命令，我此刻無法運算出任何其他可能的解讀。
BOTH THE AVOS AND HUMANS ARE INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS. I MEAN, HAVE YOU- WAIT. YOU WOULD NOT HAVE SEEN LEGENDARY ISLAND.
Avos 與人類都極度危險。話說，你有沒有——等等。你不可能見過 Legendary Island。
JUST KNOW THAT THEY'RE BOTH CRAZY. IF I AM TO FINISH MY PROGRAMMED ORDERS, BOTH OF THEM MUST BE DESTROYED, HOWEVER MUCH I MIGHT HATE THE IDEA.
你只要知道他們兩邊都瘋了。若要完成我被寫入的命令，兩者都必須被摧毀，無論我多麼厭惡這個想法。
IT IS YOUR JOB TO CREATE DISTRUST BETWEEN THEM. MAKE SURE YOU AREN'T SEEN. THE AVOS ARE ALREADY SKEPTICAL OF THE CORKIANS.
你的工作是在他們之間製造猜疑，務必不要被看見。Avos 本來就對 Corkian 存疑。
AND THE HUMANS WERE IDIOTIC ENOUGH TO KEEP A CATAPULT AIMED AT THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STUPIDITY.
而人類蠢到把一台投石機一直對著 Avos 的聚落。善用他們的愚蠢。
Find a rock to launch into the Avos territory and a battery to activate the catapult.
找一塊石頭發射到 Avos 的領地，並找一顆電池啟動投石機。
BEGIN TRANSMISSION: REALLY, WHO'S SO STUPID AS TO LEAVE A CATAPULT AIMED AT YOUR ALLIES?
開始傳輸: 說真的，誰會蠢到把投石機一直對著自己的盟友？
Bzzt... Hello World.NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
嗶滋……Hello World.已登錄新敵人: AVOS。執行攻擊協定……喀。
SURELY THE AVOS' NATURAL PREFERENCE FOR TREBUCHETS WILL SPARK CONFLICT. IN ADDITION TO THE STONE YOU WILL BE LOBBING THROUGH THEIR WALLS.
Avos 天生偏好配重投石機，光是這點就足以引發衝突。再加上你即將砸穿他們牆壁的那塊石頭。
傳輸暫停: 掃描區域中……
RESUME TRANSMISSION: YOU WILL TAKE STONE FROM THIS AREA. IT IS LIKELY TO SHATTER AND INFLICT MORE COLLATERAL DAMAGE.
恢復傳輸: 你將從這個區域取走石塊。它很可能碎裂，造成更多的附帶損害。
AND SOMEHOW, THEY MADE A WOODEN CATAPULT ACTIVATE ONLY THROUGH ELECTROMAGIC. YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE IT OF YOUR OWN ACCORD.
而且不知怎麼的，他們造了一台只能靠電魔法啟動的木製投石機。你應該有辦法自行啟動它。
END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Factory base.
結束傳輸。機兵 PL-{~}Y。完成目標之後，我會把你送回工廠基地。
I'm... in shock. We aid them in destroying their factory, and...
我……太震驚了。我們幫他們摧毀了自己的工廠，結果……
Round up the defenses and sharpen the spears. There is no excuse for this.
整頓防務，把長矛磨利。這種事沒有任何藉口可言。
Chieftain! We noticed the same thing as you did and I promise you, it was not us who did this.
族長！我們注意到的跟你一樣，我向你保證，這不是我們做的。
Maxie! There is no more 'both sides' here! This is not your people tearing up the earth, this is your people making attempts on our lives!
Maxie！這裡已經沒有「雙方各有道理」了！這不是你的族人在翻動土地，這是你的族人在謀害我們的性命！
No, I swear this wasn't planned! I'm on the city council now! There's got to be another explanation. There's still mechs around, it could have been one of them!
不，我發誓這不是計畫好的！我現在是市議會的一員了！一定還有別的解釋。附近還有機兵，可能是其中一具幹的！
And what would those monstrosities be taking orders from now? Your factory is shut down, as it ought to be!
那麼那些怪物現在又是聽誰的命令？你們的工廠已經關閉了，本來就該關！
I'll investigate this myself. There's got to be some other explanation! Please, hold off on the war preparations!
我會親自去查。一定還有別的解釋！拜託，先暫停備戰！
Steal the Avos totem and activate it outside of {p}
偷走 Avos 的圖騰，並在 {p} 外面啟動它
BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN ALL WE NEEDED TO DO, IF NOT FOR SOMEONE INTERFERING. YOU DID YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
開始傳輸: 要不是有人插手，我們該做的就到此為止了。你的工作完成得很完美，機兵 PL-{~}Y。
BUT THERE WILL BE ANOTHER TASK FOR YOU. IT IS TIME TO MAKE THE AVOS LOOK AS THOUGH THEY ARE ATTACKING.
但你還有另一項任務。是時候讓 Avos 看起來像是在發動攻擊了。
THERE IS A TOTEM IN THE AVOS CHIEFTAIN'S TENT THAT CAN HARNESS DRUIDIC MAGIC. YOU WILL STEAL IT AND ATTACK CORKUS CITY.
Avos 族長的帳篷裡有一座能駕馭德魯伊魔法的圖騰。你將偷走它，並攻擊 Corkus 城。
YOU WILL BREAK IN, AIDED BY THE TELEPORTATION MECH THAT I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE THROUGH. DO NOT GET CAUGHT.
你將闖入，由我用來傳送這則訊息的傳送機兵協助。不要被抓到。
END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Next objective location.
結束傳輸。機兵 PL-{~}Y。完成目標之後，我會把你送到下一個目標地點。
Sending Mech PL-{~}Y to Next objective location...
正在將機兵 PL-{~}Y 送往下一個目標地點……
WHAT IS THAT!? THE AVOS ARE ATTACKING?
那是什麼！？Avos 在攻擊我們？
They listened to me... right? Why's this-
他們聽進我的話了……對吧？這為什麼會——
What in the world...? That's Avos magic!
這到底是什麼……？那是 Avos 的魔法！
Why're they attacking us? This is on a way bigger scale than finding grape vines in my laundry machine!
他們為什麼要攻擊我們？這比在洗衣機裡發現葡萄藤嚴重太多了！
Don't panic! I'll talk to the Chieftain. There's been some kind of mistake here, I'm certain of it!
別慌！我去跟族長談。這裡一定有什麼誤會，我很確定！
Chief! I thought I asked you to put away the war drums!
族長！我不是請你把戰鼓收起來了嗎？
We HAVE, Maxie. Do not make accusations upon us, on our own land.
我們「收了」，Maxie。別在我們自己的土地上指控我們。
{p} was attacked today! A magical root broke through our wall. This is nature magic, an Avos specialty!
{p} 今天遭到攻擊！一條魔法根鬚穿破了我們的牆。這是自然魔法，Avos 的專長！
Hm. Convenient, that one of our prized ceremonial totems has gone missing. You may be right that someone is attempting to cause insurgence.
唔。真巧，我們一座珍貴的儀式圖騰不見了。你說有人企圖挑起叛亂，或許是對的。
I knew this was some kind of mistake. I'll get to the bottom of this!
我就知道這是某種誤會！我會把這件事查個水落石出！
BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THERE'S AN ANNOYING WRENCH IN THE WORKS. YOU'VE BEEN DOING YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
開始傳輸: 出現了一個礙事的變數。你的工作一直做得很完美，機兵 PL-{~}Y。
I'VE GOT ONE MORE ORDER FOR YOU THAT SHOULD TIP THINGS OVER THE EDGE. STAND BY FOR TELEPORTATION.
我還有一道命令要給你，那應該足以讓局勢徹底翻覆。待命，準備傳送。
THERE IS A SET OF STATISTICALLY INFERIOR MECHS BUILT BY THE CORKIANS IN THIS TOWER. I HAVE A SET OF SYSTEMS PROGRAMMED IN THIS DEVICE.
這座塔裡有一批 Corkian 造的、統計上劣等的機兵，我在這個裝置裡寫好了一套系統。
THIS WILL OVERRIDE THEIR CURRENT PROGRAMMING AND SEND THEM TO ATTACK THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. THEY'LL BE SO DISGUSTED BY THE CORKIAN'S RELENTLESS BRANDING...
這會覆寫它們目前的程式，讓它們去攻擊 Avos 的聚落。它們會被 Corkian 沒完沒了的品牌行銷噁心得——
NO, I CAN'T EVEN KEEP UP THE SARCASTIC FACADE ANYMORE. THEY'LL ATTACK AND KILL AVOS PEOPLE AND SET THE CIVIL WAR BLAZING. DO YOUR JOB QUICKLY. END TRANSMISSION.
不，我連裝出諷刺的樣子都撐不下去了。它們會攻擊並殺死 Avos 的人，把內戰點燃。快去做你的工作。結束傳輸。
BEGIN TRANSMISSION: YOUR JOB IS OVER, MECH PL-{~}Y. I HESITATE TO SAY YOU DID A GOOD JOB, BECAUSE THE JOB WAS ANYTHING BUT GOOD. IT WAS NECESSARY THOUGH.
開始傳輸: 你的工作結束了，機兵 PL-{~}Y。我很難說你做得好，因為這份工作一點也不好。但它是必要的。
WE WILL BE ABLE TO LET THEM TEAR THEMSELVES TO SHREDS INSTEAD OF GETTING INVOLVED AND SPARKING SUSPICION.
我們能讓他們自相殘殺，而不必自己介入、引來懷疑。
I HAD WANTED TO FIND A SOLUTION THAT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A FRESH START. IF MY HAND WAS NOT FORCED, PERHAPS. BUT THAT IS IRRELEVANT NOW.
我原本希望能找到一個不需要重新開始的解法。若我當初沒有被逼到那一步，或許可以。但那已經無關緊要了。
YOU WILL RETURN TO THE FACTORY WITH THE TELEPORTATION MECH AND REMAIN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE-
你將與傳送機兵一同返回工廠，並待命至另行通知——
I knew it! It was such a longshot, but I knew the Factory still had to be at large! And now I have evidence to prove it, too!
我就知道！這根本是碰運氣，但我就知道工廠一定還在運作！而且現在我還有證據可以證明！
This time we'll make sure you won't get another chance. I'll tell everyone what happened, and then we'll tear that factory down at the foundations!
這一次我們會確保你們沒有下一次機會。我會把發生的事告訴所有人，然後我們會把那座工廠連地基一起拆掉！
You should've picked a more private meeting place! I'm out!
你們該挑個更隱密的地方碰面的！我走了！
Aah, you're fast! You caught up this quick?! I have no other choice...
啊，你好快！這麼快就追上來了？！我沒有別的選擇了……
You aren't going to stop me from getting to the battleground! You look like you were scrounged up from rust and verdigris!
你別想阻止我趕到戰場！你看起來就像是從鏽渣和銅綠裡刮出來的！
Surrender, or I'll use my own mechs to smash you to scrap metal!
投降，不然我就用我自己的機兵把你砸成廢鐵！
You have defeated both of my most powerful creations...
你打敗了我最強的兩件造物……
I usually don't do this, but I guess I have no other option. I need to get this information to the others.
我通常不會這麼做……但我想我沒有別的選擇了。我必須把這個情報送到其他人手上。
No... I... have to tell them.
...you harden your heart. There is no end, you think.
……你讓自己的心變硬了。你認為沒有終結。
Wrong. The end is in sight.
Your soul. It awakens to something new.
你的靈魂。它正在覺醒成某種新的東西。
Not dark. Not light. Not in-between. But separate.
不是黑暗。不是光明。也不在兩者之間。而是另成一類。
Power. Gain. Risk. New beginnings, from an end.
力量。獲得。風險。新的開始，源自一個終結。
So... may we offer you the end?
那麼……我們可否為你提供那個終結？
The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
最中央的那處……被認為離你的家最近的地方。就在那裡，在 Wynn 的正中央……你將找到那個終結。
Halt! Who goes there? Stop, in the name of the {p} army!
站住！來者何人？站住，以 {p} 軍隊之名！
Should you continue, you shall face the strength and courage of Admiral Aegis!
你若繼續前進，就得面對 Aegis 上將的力量與勇氣！
We cannot back down against any foe! Chaaaarge!!
面對任何敵人我們都不能退縮！衝——啊啊！！
Excuse me, I think you're forgetting someone.
不好意思，我想你們忘了還有人在。
{p} will not fall today. We'll be making sure of that!
{p} 今天不會淪陷。我們絕不會讓這種事發生！
TASIM! How the hell did you manage to kill him?!
Tasim！你到底是怎麼殺得了他的？！
我要把你的內臟扯出來！！
This isn't over! Once your little lackey's dead I'm coming after you!!
這還沒完！等你那個小跟班死了，我就來找你！！
...no sense screaming for the dead. But do you think I'm going to just give up like that?
……對著死人尖叫是沒有用的。不過你以為我會就這樣放棄嗎？
Hah. Didn't know corrupteds had a sense of humor, twisted as it might be.
哈。沒想到腐敗者也有幽默感，儘管扭曲了點。
I won't dare die while everything here is at stake.
這裡的一切都危在旦夕，我怎麼敢死。
How's this, then, hm? Think your PEON can handle me at my strongest?
那這樣如何，嗯？你以為你那個「走卒」應付得了全力以赴的我嗎？
And so, you have reached an end.
於是，你抵達了一個終結。
???: You wonder. It is an end... But to what...purpose. What will you gain?
???: 你困惑。這是一個終結……但為了什麼……目的。你將獲得什麼？
You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...
你見過失去。毀滅。背叛。全都是終結，屬於你以外的某些人。從未真正發生過的終結……
To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.
終結是一件充滿力量的事。要找到你自己的終結……你或許永遠不會停止尋找。你或許在一天之內就找到你的終結。
But here... you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
但在這裡……你將獲得帶來終結的力量。也將迎來屬於你的終結。
My armies have been sent to the other cities. Their hero is inevitably busy.
我的軍隊已被派往其他城市。他們的英雄必然分身乏術。
Hm... Ah, hello there! Good to see you around, recruit. Is there anything you needed?
嗯……啊，你好！很高興在這裡見到你，新兵。有什麼需要嗎？
After the King of {p} ordered the slums cave-in, another war broke out.
{p} 國王下令讓貧民窟坍塌之後，又爆發了一場戰爭。
Yellow Beacons are pretty common, and they're great if you want to maximize your net loot throughout your run!
黃色信標很常見，如果你想在整趟掠奪長征中盡量多拿戰利品，它們非常好用！
However. Though the change is irrevocable...
然而。儘管這份改變無可挽回……
The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.
帶來終結的力量。那是一個選擇。而那……你是否會使用那份力量，我們無法告訴你。
You must deign to take that choice.
你必須自己屈身接下那個選擇。
We may offer you not one more end.
我們無法再為你提供任何一個終結。
You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...
你必須自己找到你最終的終結。我們會留下……並向其他人提供同樣的東西。於是……
???: But here...you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
???: 但在這裡……你將獲得帶來終結的力量。也將迎來屬於你的終結。
We destroy {p} today. The great fortress will fall.
今天，我們要摧毀 {p}。那座偉大的要塞將會陷落。
I will find their protector, Bob. You each will engage the guards and city dwellers. {~} citizens.
我會去找他們的守護者，Bob。你們各自去對付守衛與城裡的居民。{~} 名市民。
If each of you kills {~} citizens, then the city will run empty. So, you shall make it run empty.
只要你們每個人殺掉 {~} 名市民，這座城就會變成空城。所以，你們就讓它變成空城。
When the armies of {p} reached the once noble fort, it was corrupted ashes.
當 {p} 的軍隊抵達那座曾經高貴的堡壘時，那裡只剩下腐敗的灰燼。
The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning...to a new end.
不義者尋求它。高潔者藏起它。尋求答案的人找到了更多問題。另一個開始……通向一個新的終結。
Head to town and get further information from the employee.
前往鎮上，向員工取得進一步的情報。
Head to the northern part of the bank and find a way up to the ceiling.
前往銀行的北側，找到通往天花板的路。
Make sure to break the anvil trap before breaking the fences and escaping the area
打破柵欄、逃離這一帶之前，記得先破壞鐵砧陷阱
The humans didn't notice any difference after the new laws, but the company was in full force...
新法上路後，人們並沒有察覺任何不同，但公司早已全力運作……
I send you in my place. He will expect me. He will not expect one that looks as human as you.
我派你代替我去。他會預料到我。但他不會預料到一個看起來像你這麼像人類的傢伙。
If you fail, it will set us back greatly. It will give them a chance. Do not let them get that chance.
要是你失敗了，我們會大幅倒退。那會給他們一個機會。別讓他們得到那個機會。
Do you wish to go back to battle Theorick from A Hunter's Calling again?
要回去再次挑戰 A Hunter's Calling 的 Theorick 嗎？
Because of Theorick's passing, {p} never was saved.
由於 Theorick 的死，{p} 終究沒能得救。
The corruption fully took over the town and its citizens.
腐敗徹底吞沒了這座城鎮與它的居民。
The Twains fall away. The peon has done its job well.
Twain 一家就此消逝。那個走卒把工作做得很好。
An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world...in some fashion.
一個終結，被更多的行動所驅逐。一個終結，降臨於六者。一個終結，屬於傲慢者的篤定。一個終結，屬於這個世界……以某種形式。
Peon. You have been created for one purpose. You will ensure the fall of {p}.
走卒。你被造出來只為了一件事。你要確保 {p} 陷落。
The Corrupter of Worlds was trapped within this cave. The fool decimated my army when I laid siege last.
世界腐敗者被困在這座洞窟裡。上次我發動圍攻時，那個蠢貨把我的軍隊殺得七零八落。
Since then, it has been sealed in. The magic of the Twains is strong here. It cannot escape.
從那之後，他就被封印在裡面。Twain 一家的魔法在這裡很強。他逃不出去。
You will release it from this cave. Whether you die afterwards is irrelevant. It will destroy {p} of its own accord.
你要把他從這座洞窟裡放出來。之後你是死是活無關緊要。他會自己去摧毀 {p}。
Venture through the cave. Break the Twains' seal. And ensure it has a way to escape.
穿過洞窟。打破 Twain 一家的封印。然後確保他有路可以逃出來。
Defend yourself. It is too far gone to control. You will be attacked.
保護好你自己。他已經失控到無法駕馭了。你會遭到攻擊。
The roaring of the Corrupter of Worlds is audible from here. Has it noticed you?
從這裡就聽得到世界腐敗者的咆哮。他察覺到你了嗎？
I do not have the time to create another peon for this job. Do not fail.
我沒時間再為這件差事造一個走卒。別失敗。
The Corrupteds are malleable. Create some kind of bridge with them. Answer how for yourself.
那些腐敗者可以任意塑形。用他們搭出某種橋。怎麼做，你自己想。
The Corrupter is awake. And it is close. Move, peon! You still must break the seal.
腐敗者醒了。而且就在附近。快走，走卒！你還得打破封印。
I am unfamiliar with Twain magic. Use the intellect I have given you. Break the seal.
我不熟悉 Twain 一家的魔法。運用我賦予你的智慧。打破封印。
Your job is done... And you survived. I will save you for another mission, should I need you. Now...watch.
你的工作完成了……而且你活下來了。要是我還需要你，就留你去做下一個任務。現在……看著吧。
Maybe you can create a trail of emeralds and lure the villager back to the factory?
也許可以用綠寶石鋪一條路，把村民引回工廠？
You should finish escorting your current companion before talking to someone else!
先把目前的同伴護送完，再去找別人說話吧！
Just get me to {p} or a doctor or even a sink!
帶我去 {p}，或者找個醫生，甚至只要有個水槽也好！
Maybe you can lure the villager by flirting?
也許可以靠搭訕把村民引過去？
Heya, again. Thinking of it, a lovely one like you is probably spoken for already, huh?
嗨，又見面了。想想也是，像你這麼可愛的人，大概早就名花有主了吧？
Guess I'll just go pick some flowers for myself.
看來我只好自己去摘點花了。
But this time, it was between Dwarves and Dwarves... And yet again blood was spilled.
但這一次，是矮人與矮人之間的戰爭……鮮血再一次流淌。
目標: 清除 Avos 的存在。
Maxie never made it back to the war scene. The civil war advanced faster than anyone could have anticipated.
Maxie 終究沒能回到戰場。內戰推進的速度，遠超過任何人的預料。
The once peaceful Avos were forced to flee their home island, ravaged by machines and toxic scrap...
曾經愛好和平的 Avos，被迫逃離遭機械與有毒廢料蹂躪的家鄉島嶼……
In time, Corkus became known as the island torn apart by war. Its name would live on in infamy.
久而久之，Corkus 成了人們口中被戰爭撕裂的島嶼。它的名字將永遠背負惡名。
{p}. What a foolish place for a central trading town, so close to the Roots.
{p}。把貿易重鎮建在這種地方，離 Roots 這麼近，真是愚蠢。
You will destroy the guards. I will destroy the town.
你去摧毀守衛。我來摧毀城鎮。
The strongest of {p}' army is dead. The rest are hiding in fear. {p} will fall.
{p} 軍中最強的人已經死了。其餘的都躲起來發抖。{p} 將會陷落。
Self-confident idiots. I won't even bother dealing with you two.
自以為是的蠢貨。我連跟你們兩個周旋都懶得。
You take too much stock in your ability. My victory is inevitable.
你太高估自己的能耐了。我的勝利是必然的。
It stood as a monument to wealth, prosperity, and power in the Wynn province. It now stands as a corrupted wasteland.
它曾是 Wynn 行省財富、繁榮與權力的象徵。如今它只是一片腐敗的荒地。
The ruins of the city are a grim reminder of the power of corruption. And so...the people began to lose hope.
這座城市的廢墟，殘酷地提醒著人們腐敗的力量。於是……人們開始失去希望。
You have gained the power to end. You have unlocked The Hunted Mode.
你獲得了終結的力量。你已解鎖 Hunted 模式。
Yes. I do. A foolhardy show of power means nothing.
沒錯。我是這麼認為。魯莽地炫耀力量毫無意義。
Well... we are, but I'd like to brief {u} on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
嗯……是沒錯，不過我想先跟 {u} 說明細節。這是個危險的任務，所以……我覺得最好讓他們了解一下狀況。
Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} 加入 Elphaba 的任務。
...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
……嗯？喔——呃，你好。抱歉，這個位子我們留給……
Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
等等。你說不定正是我們要找的人。你看起來很能打。想不想加入一場危險的最高機密任務？

...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
……我剛剛可以講得更好一點。聽著，重點是——我們需要第四個人。我把任務簡報講給你聽，如果你不想加入……那我們再找別人。這樣可以嗎？好，來，跟我走。
And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
這是誰？你真的找到第四個人了？拜託，我說過我們不需要！
... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
……{u}，是你嗎？哇，好久不見。抱歉，我現在沒空聊天。我們正在準備一場危險的任務，而且……
Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
嗯。其實，我們正在找第四個人加入。而且……你看起來符合那個位置的條件。如果——如果你願意加入的話。
Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
這樣吧。我把簡報講給你聽，如果你不想加入……那我們再找別人。這樣可以嗎？好，來，跟我走。
And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
我們兩個也一直在跟你說你錯了。這位是 {u}，我們以前合作過。
Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head-
總之，我想在出發之前先把簡報跟他們說清楚——
Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should-
Elphie，我回來了！我終於逮到 Aegis 了，可是他不太……高興。他認為我們應該——
Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
喔。{u}？你怎麼會在這裡？天啊，好久不見了對吧？
They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
他們就是我們的第四個人。你剛剛說上將怎麼了？
Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
沒事。第四個人到齊了，我們應該可以出發了吧？
So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
那麼！你知道 {p} 吧？幾百年前，那裡曾經有開採作業，從地底挖出綠寶石。直到某個不明的原因，一切被叫停了。
We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
我們不知道全部的細節，但……證據顯示他們挖穿了一段從未有人發現的 Wynn 行省地帶。在那裡，他們找到了……某種東西。
The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted- they were very clear on that.
據說那片土地本身就受了詛咒。不是腐敗——這一點他們寫得非常清楚。
Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
有另一種力量在那裡安家。我們能找到的少數幾份報告只用一個名字稱呼它: Silent Expanse。
The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
礦坑被封起來，為的是阻止這個新威脅擴散，但裂縫已經開始出現了。
Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
有些奇異的、不屬於這個世界的生物開始找到出路，威脅到我們的行省。
The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
這個地方的存在一直被列為最高機密，只有必要的人才知道。
That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
這就輪到我們上場了！我們要一路打進礦坑，探明潛在的危險程度。
And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
再這樣坐著我們什麼都做不成！新人簡報也聽完了，快走吧！
H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
喂——喂！你們對我這間好好的店做了什麼！
...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
……糟。忘記他還在。抱歉啦老闆！我會修好的！
Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
Lucio，你不能老是這樣……唉，算了。我去準備補給……Aledar，你能帶我們到礦坑嗎？
Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
是，長官！{u}，你準備好我們就出發。
Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
跟著隊伍前往 Silent Expanse 的入口。
大家都準備好了嗎？我帶路。
It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
我們的路會在這裡交會，也算是命運的安排，{u}。我們一起踏上旅程，而現在……
Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
其實這是我們第二次來。第一次結果不太好。
We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
現在我們人多了，Lucio 和你應該能幫我們壓制住他。
Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
能有多強啊，我打賭我一個人就搞定。
We managed to seal it in, but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
我們上次好歹把他封在裡面了，現在有我們 {~} 個人，我相信我們可以——
What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
有什麼大不了的？你自己說我們打得贏！
Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
是我的錯覺嗎，還是我們的攻擊根本一點用都沒有？
Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
Lucio 說得對！改變計畫。Lucio，幫我把他固定住。
Aledar, you know what to do.
{u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
{u}，跟我來！施一個法術把洞口封住，別讓那隻怪物跑出去。
I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
我來擋住他的攻擊，你用法術把出口堵起來。
They won't be able to hold it for long.
準備好了嗎？！隨便施一個法術！
Plan a way of killing the beast.
想出殺死那隻野獸的辦法。
Phew, here. Let me get you out.
I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
對不起，各位。我從來沒見過那種怪物。
It looks like our problem isn't firepower. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
看樣子我們的問題不是火力，是別的東西。我們的武器好像對他完全沒有作用。
I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
我知道有個人也許幫得上忙。{p} 上的一位鐵匠。
{u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
{u}，我把那間屋子的座標寫在你的書上了。我們在那裡會合。
Just in time. We're all here.
It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
看樣子鐵匠知道問題出在哪……
So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
那麼，Dren。你知道我們為什麼傷不了那隻野獸嗎？
Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
當然！你們的問題出在元素。你們都知道，元素有 {~} 種……
But.. There is a hidden element, Darkness .
但是……還有一個隱藏的元素，黑暗。
Thank grook for that. I was wondering if we'd ever be rid of this nightmare.
謝天謝地。我還在想我們到底能不能擺脫這場惡夢。
And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry, I didn't catch your name. {u}? {u}.
我們兩個也一直在跟你說你錯了。這位是……抱歉，我沒聽清楚你的名字。{u}？{u}。
In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
要傷害一隻黑暗生物，你必須先把那份影響從自己的靈魂裡除掉。
Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
有些黑暗生物會張開一種同調屏障，讓同樣受黑暗影響的生物傷不了他們。
In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
為了淨化你們，我需要 {~} 件強大的物品。
Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
首先，一片 Dern 野獸的碎片。{p} 的深處就住著一隻。
I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
我要用它把你們每個人身上的黑暗元素顯現出來。
And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
然後，當然還要一件光之物品，用來淨化你們所有人……
Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
等等……你說光之物品是什麼意思？
Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel fairies if you wanted.
任何光之生物身上的東西都可以，你們想的話，去弄一些 Gavel 精靈的粉塵也行……
Alright. Aledar, you get the Darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
好。Aledar，你跟 {u} 去拿黑暗的物品，我跟 Lucio 去拿光的物品。
跟 Aledar 一起取得碎片。
Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
我們發現這些根周圍的洞穴比想像中複雜得多……
There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
其中有一個裡面的生物強得多……在某個地方……在這裡！
What are you waiting for? Let's go!
...I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
我不覺得我們能靠法術過去，{u}！我們需要像是……翅膀那種東西！
I've never used wings like this before...
I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
我想只要拿著它、照平常走，應該就能滑過去。
Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
別鬆手，也別被岩漿噴泉打到，這還用說。
Don't forget why we're here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
別忘了我們來做什麼，我們要找的是一隻黑暗生物。找到就喊我。
Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.
That's our target! Go after it!
那就是我們的目標！追上去！
Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!

Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.
擊殺 Progenitor 打開入口。
Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
擊殺 Mangled Progeny 取得 [{~} Corrupted Pearl]。
Wow, I'm impressed {u}. I honestly thought you would need my help.
哇，{u}，我服了。我還真以為你會需要我幫忙。
Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
好啦，該拿的都拿到了。回去找 Dren 吧。
Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
帶著黑暗物品回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的鐵匠那裡。
Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
看樣子這次我們運氣不錯。黑暗的物品拿到了嗎？
That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here {u}!
這樣應該就夠了。來看看有沒有用。{u}，過來這裡！
It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
好了！你們身上的黑暗影響應該已經去掉了。那個一直擋著你們的屏障，現在應該打得穿了。
Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
你確定嗎？我沒覺得有什麼不同。嗯……我想只有一個辦法能知道。
Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
與其他戰士一起重新打開封住的入口。
Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
大家都到了嗎？很好！該把我開的頭收尾了！
Lucio! No! When will you learn?
Lucio！不要！你什麼時候才學得乖？
Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
好啦好啦。抱歉，計畫是什麼？
We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
我們不能讓那東西跑出去，會引起大規模恐慌的。
We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
我們只開一個小入口進去，進去之後再打。
We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
我們手上有一張非常舊的礦坑地圖可以參考，但完全不知道裡面等著我們的是什麼。
I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
我要先提醒你們，這很可能是我們所有人的單程票。

石頭是一回事，Lucio。我們接下來要面對的生物，光靠蠻力是不夠的。你需要的是意志力。
Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
我的天。也許這不是什麼好主意。
It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
現在說這些太遲了。這個任務我們非完成不可。
Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
別忘了目標，Elphie，我們必須抵達 Silent Expanse 的盡頭。
It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
這裡還是空的。可是看起來他們昨天才剛離開。
I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
你不是說那些礦工是幾百年前的人嗎？

是啊。我不知道為什麼會保存得這麼完好。就好像什麼都沒碰過一樣。
According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
根據文件，我們得一路走到這條路的盡頭。
So much for nothing being here.
Why are they only going for me?

我看的地圖跟你一樣。上面連比例尺都沒有。不過前面應該有一座橋。

呃……一座毀掉的橋。而且這次不是我炸的！
Hmm, well we'll have to go around.
This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
這看起來不太像腐敗，對吧？
Uhhh... I'm not feeling really wel-... Aahhh!
呃……我覺得不太舒——……啊啊啊！
Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
啊啊啊！我的肝！它拿走了我的肝！
Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
Aledar，也許我們現在就該掉頭？
Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
Elphaba 是非常有能力的戰士。我們繼續打下去，把她找出來。
Do you really think it was just an illusion?
你真的覺得那只是幻覺嗎？
I'm not sure. I hope so.
What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
萬一我們也被感染了呢？我們不是該回去嗎？

不行，Lucio！我們有任務在身，你很清楚。繼續走。

何況我們身上可能也帶著那些東西。不能冒讓它們蔓延到 Wynn 的險。
Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
看起來我們得從這裡往右繞，對吧？

Aledar，這是什麼地方？你沒說過這裡有一座城。

有的。而且是很大一座；前面還有更多。不過看起來沒人在家。地圖上也沒給它名字。
Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
等一下，那是不是其中一個礦工？她受傷了嗎？喂——！那邊那位！
Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
等等，怎麼回事？我為什麼動不了？
We can't live alone like this!
我們不能這樣一個人活下去！
You need to come with us!
It's the only way to keep you safe!
只有這樣才能保你平安！
It's the only way to make you happy here!
只有這樣你在這裡才會快樂！
It's the only way to make us feel whole!
只有這樣我們才會覺得完整！
IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
只有這一條路，你懂不懂？！
AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
啊啊！別、別再對我吼了！我聽不懂！！
CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
你聽不見我在說什麼嗎？
No! How did she disable my spell?!
不！她怎麼有辦法解掉我的法術？！
YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
你跟我們走會快樂得多！
YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
你再也不用擔心任何事！
Just please, stand still a little longer!
拜託，再站著別動一下下就好！
我們會帶你去溫暖的地方！
You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
不會有人追捕你！我們保證！沒有人會追捕我們！
THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
跟我們在一起你會很安全！
NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
不再有恐懼！不再有煩惱！
No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go {u}! Now!
不不不！！這下糟了，非常糟！{u}，我們得走了！快！
Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
等等，你只是個礦工。這感覺不像幻覺……
Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
聽著，你得離開這裡。這裡不安全——等等，那是什麼聲音……？
Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar、Lucio 和 Elphaba。
{u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
{u}！她說得完全沒錯。你也應該跟我們走……
Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar 和 Elphaba。
Find Aledar in the Fallen City.
在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar。
I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
我的腿好像斷了。我有藥水可以治，但掉在上面了。
I feel a bit better.. But something's still wrong.
感覺好一點了……但還是有哪裡不對勁。
Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
我們先離開這裡，撐著點。出去只有一條路。
Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
唔……{u}，事情完全脫離計畫了。照我的地圖看，我們連一半都還沒走到。
I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
我走不動了。可是我們也不能待在這裡。
The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed, but it's imperative we get to the end of this expanse, together.
任務一定要完成。計畫變了，但我們非得一起走到 Silent Expanse 的盡頭不可。
No more running for us, huh {u}? Ah, we're here.
這下我們是跑不了了，對吧 {u}？啊，到了。
There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
一定有辦法的……就算你得用這台東西把我推過去也一樣！
No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
不，我沒在開玩笑。你顧著推車，我來指路。
Escort Aledar through the Eyeball Forest to {p}.
護送 Aledar 穿過 Eyeball Forest 前往 {p}。
According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
照地圖看，礦工在前面不遠處建了一個小鎮。
Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
誰知道還剩下什麼，但總比這裡安全。

While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
能不能讓我們兩個都活著過去，就看你了。
The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
任務的成敗，就靠我們兩個配合。
Are those... Eyes on the trees?
Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
注意，小型怪物往我這邊來了！我坐在這東西上沒辦法打！
Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
幹得好！看起來他們不來了。繼續走吧。
Let's keep going! Before they come back.
趁他們回來之前，我們繼續走！
A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
好多小的往我這邊衝過來了！
This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
這隻好險！我們快到鎮上了。
We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.

We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
快到了！我從這裡看得到那個鎮！
Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
唉唷！我被打到了！小心點，{u}！

總算到了……跟地圖上的那個鎮不太一樣。
The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
失蹤的礦工都在這裡……怎麼可能？他們應該是幾百年前的人了！

這個方尖碑是什麼？它……莫名地讓人安心。我在 Gavel 的時候感受過這種感覺。
Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
說不定……它被光碰觸過？如果是的話……它也許能治好我。
Let's see if it does anything to me...
來看看它對我有沒有用……
It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}. We still have a ways to go.
有用……算是吧。我至少覺得 {~}……我們還有一段路要走。
Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
在繼續之前，我們花點時間整頓一下。我在鎮的另一頭等你。

Aledar 一定也掉在路邊附近的某個地方！

你搗毀了 Corkus 那座惡名昭彰的工廠？那可真是了不起的成就。那些機甲有多厲害，我聽過不少傳聞。

>and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
>而英雄將蒙蔽古老的先知。祝好運。

好，走吧。路上我再多跟你說說這趟任務的事。

我們盡量沿著這條路走。你帶頭，我跟著。
Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
幹得好。看樣子首領一死，其他東西就跑光了。這算我們走運——

等等，{u}，怎麼回事？你還好嗎？

跟著 Aledar 沿主路前進。

我……我先帶路吧。至少撐一……一段路……我不能讓你再受——

……唔……我……抱歉。我只是……需要緩一下。
{u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
我要把話講清楚……我們必須一起走到這條路的盡頭。
Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
好了。我現在也只能恢復到這樣了。走吧。

啊？什麼……剛剛那是……我怎麼會……

我沒事，只是……為什麼突然覺得整個人空了一塊……？

一股神祕的力量把你推了回去……

糟了，好像有東西過來了……{u}！你擋一下，我現在連自己都護不住！
Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
保護 Aledar，擊退 Radiated Spider。
Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
呼……還沒完全恢復，不過……至少我還能自保。
My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why do I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
胃裡空空的，想吐都吐不出來……為什麼還是這麼暈？也許喝點藥水會好一些……
Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
嘔，呸！這味道比我吐出來的還難喝……
Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ...hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
哈……這瓶對了。話說回來這到底是什麼藥水……生髮水？這東西為什麼會有效？

對了，你剛剛看到我打飛的那隻怪物怎麼了嗎？跟我來。
This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
照我記得的任務簡報，這東西叫「虛空洞」，是一種傳送門。
They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
它們彼此之間連接的方式很怪，不過我把那隻怪物打進去之後，他是從那一頭出來的，所以……
Watch. I'll come out the other side.
看好。我會從另一頭出來。
Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
好，很好！至少連接的位置是固定的。換你試試。
Continue on the trail with Aledar.
跟著 Aledar 沿小徑前進。
I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
我會提這件事，是因為既然看到了一個，接下來一定還會看到更多。你得先習慣它們的樣子。
We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
我們嚴重低估了這裡的難度。而且我說的「我們」，是指我、Elphie 和 Lucio……
We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
我們每一個都準備不足又自以為是。要不是有你，我現在早就死了，說真的。
I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
一開始我對你同行這件事沒什麼把握，但你已經證明得夠多了——這趟就該是你來。
...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
……我早該想到這張地圖過時了。上面根本沒標這道尖刺牆，而路就是從這裡穿過去的！
I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
只能當作是新長出來的……既然是新的，也許我能把它砸開。
{u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
{u}，你同時丟一個法術過來！我們把這些東西轟破！
...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
我真是個白痴……剛剛差點把自己弄死。差點毀了整個任務……
I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
抱歉，接下來你得自己走了。我現在連一步都動不了。
There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
這一帶有很多虛空洞，記得我剛才說的……你大概可以靠它繞到尖刺後面。
If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
我要是早點想到就好了……等你過去之後，我們再……呃。再想辦法。
Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
只是……小心你要去的地方。虛空洞可能通往任何地方，也可能把你送到非常、非常危險的地方，危險到連你都應付不來。我只能祈禱不會……
There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
那邊就有一個虛空洞，先拿它試試。快去吧。這件事非你不可。
Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
利用虛空洞設法繞到尖刺屏障後方
An explosion has occurred somewhere in the arena...
競技場的某處發生了爆炸……
Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
想辦法幫 Aledar 到尖刺屏障的另一邊。
...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
……等等，{u}？你已經到另一邊了……？太好了……
I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
我不知道你做了什麼，但不管是什麼，尖刺上出現的裂痕從這一側都看得見。
I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
我恢復了一點力氣……再試一次法術吧。如果我們同時施法，也許能打開一個缺口。
I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
這次我不會再拿頭去撞尖刺了。我保證。
You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
你先動手。我一聽到你的法術就跟上。
Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
謝天謝地，成功了……那裡就是我們的目的地，詭異瞭望台。
Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
最難的部分來了……跟我來。這一段我需要你在場。
That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
那邊那把劍……是用來獻祭的。看到那道門是關著的嗎？
In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
要打開通往瞭望台的門，我們得獻祭一個強大的靈魂。
We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
我們……我們一開始就該告訴你的。你和 Lucio 都不知道。Elphie 和我知道。我們早就知道這裡有這個。
We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think- we both knew it would have to be one of us.
我們沒有……我們心裡沒有預定的人選。我們說好等真的走到這一步再決定。而我想我們兩個都清楚，最後一定是我們其中一個。
...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
……我想她會堅持由她來。即使我們兩個都還有放不下的……
It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
現在說這些也沒意義了。只剩我們了。從進到那座鎮上開始我就一直在想這件事……由你來獻祭我。這件事我不接受拒絕。
I mean...look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
你看看我現在這副樣子，{u}！我已經站在鬼門關前了，而你早就證明自己遠比全盛時期的我還強。
Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
拿去。我身上的東西你全帶走。我的綠寶石，還有地城的鑰匙。反正我也用不到了。
Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
塔頂上有……嗯，某個東西。我們不確定那究竟是什麼，但他會擋住你的去路。
You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But...find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
你得殺了他才能破除屏障。不過……去找其他能幫你的士兵。一個人是打不贏的。
...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
……那就別再拖了。我血快流乾了。
Right click to grab the blade in the altar.
Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
現在……砍下來吧。我的靈魂會打開那道門……
You...can do this. I know y-you can.
你……做得到的。我知道你、你可以。
那隻一直在看著我們的怪物……
Talk to me when you are ready to go. But remember, we're on a mission. We won't be returning until it's finished.
準備好出發就跟我說。不過別忘了，我們身上有任務，沒完成之前不會回來。
Aledar probably wouldn't like it if you left.
你要是離開，Aledar 大概會不太高興。
Kill {~} Upside Downer  to Destroy the Spikes
擊殺 {~} 隻 Upside Downer 以摧毀尖刺
It appears that green substance on the walls has bouncing properties.
牆上那些綠色的東西似乎有彈性。
Looks like you're past the spikes. You can see the tower that was visible past them from here. Hopefully there is a way to break the spikes from this side nearby...
看來你已經越過尖刺了。從這裡看得到剛才尖刺另一頭的那座塔。希望附近有辦法從這一側破壞尖刺……
No matter how hard to try and pull the blade out, it does not budge...
不管怎麼用力拔，那把劍都紋風不動……
It appears the boulder that was once blocking the way is gone...
原本擋路的那塊巨石似乎不見了……
...you were scared of those, once upon a time. What a difference time makes.
……曾幾何時，你還很怕那些東西。時間帶來的改變真大。
You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
你可以把那件護甲拿去那邊的 物品鑑定師 鑑定，鑑定完就能穿了。
This gate marks the Fruman Border- you must make sure you aren't spotted from this point onwards.
這道門就是 Fruma 的邊境——從這裡開始，你絕不能被人發現。
Sounds like new recruits are walking down the path! You better find somewhere to hide before they spot you!
聽起來有新兵沿著路走過來了！你最好在他們發現你之前找個地方躲起來！
This is your chance, the gate's open! Follow the Caravan Driver!
機會來了，門開了！跟上車隊駕駛！
...you need to escape. Strike while the commander is busy, and find a way out!
……你得逃出去。趁指揮官正忙的時候動手，找條路出去！
You have emptied {p} of soldiers. You must escape before someone discovers what has happened here. The only way out is forward.
你已經把 {p} 的士兵清空了。你得在有人發現這裡出了什麼事之前逃走。唯一的出路就在前方。
What is this place? Such technology, you can hardly imagine how it was made.
這是什麼地方？這種技術，你幾乎無法想像它是怎麼造出來的。
The caravan driver seems to have disappeared... maybe you can find something if you look in some of mechanized carriages?
車隊駕駛好像不見了……也許去那些機械化的車廂裡找找，會發現些什麼？
{p}'s relations with Fruma exclusively consist of the generous batches of recruits sent to fight the corruption here in Wynn.
{p} 與 Fruma 的往來，就只有對方慷慨地一批批送來新兵，到 Wynn 這裡對抗腐敗。
They've shut you out. There's no way in from here... But what if you went back the way you first arrived?
他們把你擋在外面了。從這裡進不去……但要是你循著最初來時的路回去呢？
...Ah. I see. So I suppose...things must not have gone well. Have all the others returned?
……啊。我明白了。所以我想……事情大概不太順利吧。其他人都回來了嗎？
Is there anything I can do for you today?
今天有什麼我能為你做的嗎？
...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
……有什麼東西在你腦海深處隱隱作癢。你剛來的時候，不也是像這樣睡著的嗎？
Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
在你當初抵達 Wynn 的地方附近探索。
Continue back down the path to Fruma.
This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
這活根本做不完！！我到底為什麼會在這裡？！
Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
啊！你是士兵吧？聽我說，我——現在真的是非常難熬的時候。
This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
這、這整件事絕對超出我的職權範圍了！我不知道該怎麼處理……
Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
算了，我、呃，我想也夠了。你需要什麼？
Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
噢。噢不。呃，我，那個，那恐怕會有點問題。話說回來，你去邊境到底要做什麼？
I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and-
我實在想不出你在那裡能有什麼事，但不管是什麼，都得等！這台 Corkian 鑽機不動了，Paxon 又困在裡面，還有——
Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
抱歉，我……我不該對你發脾氣。我受的是軍事行動訓練，不是清塌方的訓練，可是沒有別人能來！
Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
連我雇來的爆破專家都困住了，所以事情全亂了，我根本不知道該怎麼辦。
You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
看到那邊那個新開的洞口了嗎？那位專家，Paxon，進去的時間差不多跟我搞這台廢鐵一樣久了。
If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
如果你覺得自己比專家更行，那就去跟他們談吧，不過我很確定你原本的計畫是得取消了。
Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟 Demolition Mage 說話，座標 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
如果你真的非去邊境不可，最好的辦法是去新洞口找 Paxon 談。
But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
但他們是專家，所以我想你的事還是得等。這一切真的、真的很抱歉！
Oh no, not another one- I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it-
噢不，又來一個——我不管你是什麼階級，你要的事情根本辦不到！就算是我也——
Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
等等，你不是那邊的……你只是個普通士兵。你只是想從這裡過去，對吧？
May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
現在放棄還來得及！不可能。門都沒有。你在浪費時間，我把原因一條條講給你聽。
You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
看到那邊那塊藍色的岩石了嗎？那是斷點。只要能在那裡引爆炸藥，就能炸出一條路。
They're gone. Hurry down the path!
他們走了。快順著小路下去！
But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
但這裡搭的每一個東西顯然都重要到不得了，只要有任何一樣被弄壞、或是被「移動」，就是不行！
And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
而且為了在中尉忙著修鑽機的時候還能「監督」我，起爆器非得放在這裡不可。
So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
所以我得用有限的炸藥一路串接到那塊石頭，中途還不能炸壞任何一個建物！
I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
我搞了好幾個小時，一點進展都沒有！我可是這行數一數二的人！這太荒謬了！！
If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you should really just go.
如果你想浪費時間，這是我的炸藥存貨。你儘管試，不過你真的該走了。
Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.
用 TNT 在洞穴中炸出一條路。
Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
還在弄？怎麼，要我再講一次嗎？反正我也沒別的事做。
So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
藍色的岩石夠脆，炸藥可以炸開。但起爆器卡在這裡。
So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
所以我們得用 TNT Placer 從起爆器一路串接爆炸，而且不能炸到任何帳篷、木箱或牆。
You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
放好的 TNT 你可以看一下，能看到它的爆炸範圍。
But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
不過有幾個建物之間的縫隙那麼窄，這根本不可能成功。
Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
我說了，你真的該乖乖回城堡去。連我都弄不出結果，我不覺得你會比較行。
Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
站住！你從哪來的？這後面不是塌方了嗎？
A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
新的路，是嗎？我沒想到你在這後頭還有事要辦，不過我也不能說不感激。
It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
連那邊 grook 的巢都被壓垮了。我已經吃了好幾天的野戰口糧。所以你要去哪？
The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
邊境？我想你既然要去那裡，一定是重要的公務。不過，恐怕得等一等。
The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
那座橋修得相當草率。它未必撐得住你的重量。既然塌方清掉了，也許我們能好好把它修一修……
But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back- whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
但那要時間。我倒寧願你掉頭回去——不管你有什麼事，都不值得拿命去換。
Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
說起來，我好像認得你。幹這行的能碰到熟面孔可不容易。
Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
你確定你要做的事值得嗎？那座橋搖得厲害。我可不想失去你這樣的人。
Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
喂，那邊那位！過去之前先過來跟我說話。
Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
喂，你！先過來跟我說話，新兵！
Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
不管是要進還是要出，我接到的命令很明確: 攔下士兵，確認裝備齊全才能放行。
No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
沒有例外，什麼理由都不行。尤其是河對岸塌方之後！
Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
沒有什麼比你的命更重要，沒穿好裝備就上路，可能會要了你的命！
Well, let me take a look at it and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
好，我看看這身行頭合不合規定。
Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
好，我看看這身行頭合不合規定。
Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
唔……啊，對，到處都是磨損的痕跡……護甲沒擦亮……武器看起來隨時會散開……
I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
帶著這些生鏽的破爛還能走這麼遠，我真是佩服！這樣根本保護不了自己！
Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
聽著，就在那邊的洞穴裡有個寶箱，你得進去弄一套像樣的裝備。
...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
……是這樣嗎？那我想你該再往前面看一眼。
See? Now no more guff about levels- you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
看到沒？別再拿等級當藉口了——要嘛好好換裝，要嘛別想過去！我不會讓你拿命去賭。
You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
洞穴裡常有好東西，就像我旁邊這個，快去吧。
Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
我說了，進出都一樣。不管怎樣，繼續上路之前你都該先把這邊的洞穴搜一搜、換上裝備。
Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
好東西。那個洞穴裡有個寶箱，你要的應該都找得到。快去！
Explore the cave to find some loot.
Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
看起來就是那種東西。你可以把那件護甲拿去那邊的 物品鑑定師 鑑定，鑑定完就能穿了。
Though, since you seem to be headed back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
不過……既然你看起來是要往邊境回去……我還是得問一句為什麼。這很不尋常。你最好還是回 {p} 去。
If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
要是其他新兵看到你反方向走，他們可能會困惑，或是灰心。你也不想冒這個險吧？
Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
你確定你要做的事值得嗎？也許你該直接回鎮上。
Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.
避開路上的 Fruma 新兵。
...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
……一直在為戰事招募 Fruma 的士兵。聽說那邊情況真的很糟。搞得我很不安……
Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
會走的屍體我可不敢小看，不過總不會全都是壞消息吧？
I suppose we'll see once we pass through this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
我想過了這道門就知道了。那裡就是邊境……深呼吸，深呼吸……
...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
……你知道 Wynn 的事嗎？我完全沒收到任何簡報。
I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...an R?
我記得有些傳聞……好像有個了不起的英雄。名字是 R 開頭的？
We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
找到機會就一定要問清楚。打仗最重要的就是情報。
...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
……那個爛車夫。我是同情他啦，但他自己說每次都會撞到那顆大石頭。聽起來就是他自己的問題。
I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
比起輪子我更想著吃的。我覺得我好幾天沒吃東西了。希望這段路不長……
Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
要是他開車再像樣一點，你就不用餓著肚子走這麼遠了！我們快點走，好讓你飽餐一頓，好嗎？
Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
等等，那是誰？他們為什麼從邊境那邊過來？？
...and that's the last of them for today.
Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
今天成雙成對的還真多。還有八個在候著……不過那是明天的事了。
Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
又是同一顆該死的大石頭……又是同一句該死的台詞。不知道哪天他們會不會讓我換點花樣。每次都煩死人……
And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
這件事就這樣了。那麼，該走了……回我自己選的家。到了那裡，就沒有麻煩追得上我。
探索 Fruma Gate 的另一頭。
Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
你以為自己很高明吧。連我留下來盯著都沒發現，對吧？我可不是昨天才出生的。
Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened- Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
聽著，這種事不是第一次發生了。你知道的，總有人好奇，回頭去查自己走過的路。
...I will make only one demand of you. Whatever happens...come back alive.
……我對你只有一個要求。不管發生什麼事……都要活著回來。
If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
如果你還看不出來，這整件事本來就是單程的。那座橋、那場塌方、每一個勸你回頭的人。
It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
待在這裡不明智——畢竟你們三個人裡，拿到留下許可的並不是你。沒錯，比賽的結果我聽說了。
He's dead asleep. You could probably ring a church bell an inch above his head and he'd stay unconscious.
他睡死了。就算在他頭頂一吋敲教堂的鐘，他大概也醒不過來。
That looks like the stuff. See? That wasn't so hard. Alright, now!
看起來就是這東西。看吧？沒那麼難嘛。好，現在！
So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
所以……你有兩個選擇，朋友。這件事我們可以當作沒發生過。真的可以。你乖乖走回 {p}，我就閉緊嘴巴。
Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
唉，恐怕我在這件事上真的無能為力。我能做的很有限——你還記得我在會議上說的話。
Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though- it's leaving soon.
或者，你也可以活得刺激一點，跟我上開往 {p} 的列車。不過最好快點決定，車快開了。
If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
要是我在客車廂裡看到你，那……那就是那樣了，接下來會發生什麼，你就自己等著看吧。
Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Last chance to back out. This your choice?
最後一次退出的機會。這是你的選擇？
Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
那你最好開始走那段回 {p} 的長路了。
You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
你聽過那句話吧，好奇心殺死貓。你是那種相信滿足了好奇心貓就會活過來的人嗎？
Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream- just the hound dogs.
那麼，「小貓咪」，你找到的不是鮮奶油——是獵犬。
Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
闖入 Fruma 者，你被捕了！走！
You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
你真以為那個車夫站在你這邊嗎，闖入者？你真是個蠢貨。我們給了你每一次收手的機會，你卻還是來了。走吧。
指揮官！我們必須立刻談談！
I have urgent news to report from the gate.
我有從門那邊來的緊急消息要報告。
If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
如果真的這麼緊急，那就說吧。
Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
士兵們！看住這個闖入者。我完全信得過你們。
Anythin' I can help you with?
有什麼我幫得上忙的嗎？
Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
嗯。我想是沒什麼壞處。不過你自己小心點，好嗎？
This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
這裡是我們的家。你要是弄壞了什麼，我可不會給你好臉色，懂嗎？
...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
……整體來說還過得去。天氣不錯吧，我想。慶典也快到了。
But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
不過那真的不關我們的事。如果你沒別的事，我就請你離開了。
Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
Hmm? And who may you be?
Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
喔，好吧。有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？
Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
啊，就是在做一些零零星星的金工活。這裡總是有東西要換、要保養……
Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
不過我當然算不上什麼專家！但工具我還算拿得動，做這些事這樣就夠了。
Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
再會了，陌生人！希望你能平安回家。
You don't hear anything moving on the other side of the door.
你聽不到門的另一邊有任何動靜。
Greetings, {u}. It is always an honour to have you in our halls.
你好，{u}。能在我們的殿堂裡接待你，向來是我們的榮幸。
So, Tasim has stayed behind then. I'm to suppose you're worried for his safety, in amongst any other worries you might have.
這麼說，Tasim 留在那裡了。我想你除了其他種種擔憂之外，也在擔心他的安危吧。
Although you are not the first to wish to return to Fruma, I have not had any recruits who went to investigate come back satisfied. Or, in a scant few cases, at all.
想回 Fruma 的人，你不是第一個。但去調查的新兵當中，從沒有人滿意而歸。少數幾個，甚至根本沒有回來。
I may only grant you access to the pass you took to first come here. Simply take the door and do what you must. I know not what you will find...
我能給你的，只有你當初來到這裡時走的那條隘道的通行許可。穿過那扇門，做你該做的事吧。我不知道你會在那裡發現什麼……
I'd advise you be cautious. The Queen's correspondence has been...not unkind, but forceful- And considering the circumstances...
我勸你小心行事。女王的來信雖然……不算無禮，但態度強硬——再考慮到目前的情勢……
The door to the pass between here and Fruma is down the hall, across from the fireplace. Come back alive- that is an order as King.
通往這裡與 Fruma 之間隘道的門，就在大廳另一頭、壁爐對面。活著回來——這是國王的命令。
...ah. It's enchanted...that's odd, given what you've seen, but the guards are looking your way now. You probably shouldn't do that again.
……啊。它被施了魔法……就你所見，這很奇怪，但守衛們現在正往你這邊看。你大概不該再那麼做了。
No one seems to know you're here.
似乎沒有人知道你在這裡。
The very sight of you offends me! Let this gust of wind relieve me of your presence. Take it as a warning- you are not welcome here!
光是看到你就讓我不快！讓這陣風替我把你颳走吧。當成警告收下——這裡不歡迎你！
...rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?
……嘖！那些隧道！人類又來壞我的興致……但你真以為躲得掉我？
A dullard to the end, walking to your obliteration. I'm going to savor this delectable moment...it's been decades since I've rendered a human to dust!
蠢到最後一刻，自己走向灰飛煙滅。我要好好品嚐這一刻……我已經幾十年沒把人類碾成灰了！
A shard of the crystal seems to have remained behind. Maybe you can use this to escape!
水晶似乎留下了一塊碎片。也許你可以靠它逃出去！
...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you seriously from the start.
……好吧。我這座塔的防禦固若金湯，我從來不必在裡面親自動手。我一開始就該認真看待你。
HA! I still get the last laugh! Even at my most vulnerable, I've gracefully outwitted you! As if I would really surrender to a human.
哈！笑到最後的還是我！就算在我最脆弱的時候，我照樣漂亮地擺了你一道！我怎麼可能真的向人類投降。
I'll just drain Norsten's vitality to refill my own if you attack! There's nothing you can do- can't jump after the gem, can't defeat me! It's hopeless for you!
你敢動手，我就抽乾 Norsten 的生命來補我自己！你什麼都做不了——跳不到寶石那裡，也打不贏我！你沒指望了！
There's the strange gem that Dramele threw away... You should take it with you, he said it would save Norsten.
那就是 Dramele 丟掉的怪寶石……你該把它帶走，他說那能救 Norsten。
Although the strange beings are now gone, some parts of them were left behind. They look very unstable.
那些怪東西雖然不見了，卻留下了一些殘骸。看起來很不穩定。
Perhaps if you combine them in the right way you can cause an explosion and escape.
也許把它們用對的方式組合起來，就能炸出一條路。
Goal: Get {~} Explosive Power by combining the {~} different cores in the grid made of green particles.
目標: 在綠色粒子構成的格子裡組合 {~2} 種不同的核心，湊出 {~1} 點爆炸威力。
Each core gains and loses explosive power based on its position in the grid, and what cores it's touching. Each core touches the cores that are above, below and next to it.
每個核心的爆炸威力，會依它在網格中的位置以及它碰到哪些核心而增減。每個核心都會碰到它上方、下方和左右相鄰的核心。
Right Click a core to select it, then Right Click one of the {~} green spots in the grid to place it there.
右鍵點選一個核心，再右鍵點格子裡 {~} 個綠點的其中一個，把它放上去。
Remember, you need to get {~} Explosive Power! If you need a hint, click on Hints and Rules and select "I want a hint."
記住，你需要 {~} 點爆炸威力！需要提示的話，點「提示與規則」再選「我要提示」。

The Green Core begins with a lot of power, but loses power when touching some of the other cores, especially Orange. So you'll want it in a corner, where it's touching only {~} cores, and it shouldn't be touching Orange.
綠色核心一開始威力很高，但碰到某些核心會損失威力，尤其是橘色核心。所以要把它放在角落，只碰到 {~} 個核心，而且不要讓它碰到橘色核心。
That terrible wizard must have captured you in his spell when you did. It was terrible, it was- Such a hard look you had in your eyes...
你那時候一定是被那個可怕的巫師困進了法術裡。太可怕了，真的——你的眼神好凶……
...I barely remember anything. Just...feelings of anger, and...disgust, I suppose, but... You wouldn't lie to me, Grand-Peli.
……我幾乎什麼都不記得了。只有……憤怒的感覺，還有……大概是厭惡吧，可是…… Peli 爺爺，你不會騙我的。
...ugh. Disgusting. Utterly disgusting. I've had just about enough of your kind here. Humans...
……唉。噁心。徹頭徹尾的噁心。我受夠你們這種東西了。人類……
Dreadfully drab, always getting in the way, wriggling through our province like worms! You're no heroes, you're pretenders!!
醜得要命，永遠擋在路上，像蟲一樣在我們的行省裡鑽來鑽去！你們不是英雄，你們是冒牌貨！！
Oh, you want through here? Well, I'm the gatekeeper. Let's call my toll...the abandonment of your ridiculous little heroics...and all your money besides. Sound fair?
喔，你想從這裡過去？巧了，我就是守門的。我的過路費就定為……放棄你那可笑的英雄扮演……外加你身上所有的錢。很公道吧？
Aha, Norsten my boy! We've been worried sick, it's been a week. What is it you're doing so far out into the canyon?
啊哈，Norsten 我的孩子！我們擔心死了，都一個禮拜了。你跑到峽谷這麼深的地方做什麼？
Wha- Who are you, and who gave you permission to use my toll road?! And can't you see I'm busy?
什——你是誰，誰准你走我的收費道路的？！沒看到我在忙嗎？
Norsten?? Don't you recognize your own grandfather? What's that strange look in your eyes, what's this about a toll road?
Norsten？？你連自己的爺爺都認不出來了？你眼神怎麼那麼奇怪，還有什麼收費道路？
You're nothing to me at your age. I only care about what the young can do for me...and about the fee you're neglecting, you shriveled old fruit!
你這把年紀對我來說什麼都不是。我只在乎年輕人能為我做什麼……還有你欠我的過路費，你這顆乾癟的老水果！
What's gotten into you? Such a polite man, acting this way to your elders... Human, have you any idea what's-
你是怎麼了？這麼有禮貌的孩子，居然這樣對長輩……人類啊，你知不知道發生了什麼——
...oh no. Oh, say it isn't so, is that what's happening? Is it HIS fault?
……噢，不會吧。噢，別告訴我是真的，是那件事嗎？是「他」搞的鬼？
Up there, on the cliff- that tower! The scourge of the canyon...has he truly returned? Has he...taken my grandson?!
上面，懸崖上——那座塔！峽谷的禍害……他真的回來了嗎？他……把我孫子抓走了？！
My reputation, even after all this time, still precedes me!! Indeed, old man, I have taken your grandson as my puppet!
過了這麼久，我的名聲居然還走在我前面！！沒錯，老頭，我把你孫子變成我的傀儡了！
What should I care about the facade? For a hundred and fifty years I've stolen the vitality of others to maintain my beauty, and your grandson will be no different.
我幹嘛在乎這副皮囊？一百五十年來我一直靠竊取別人的生命力維持我的美貌，你孫子也不會例外。
Miserable dastard!! Cold-water eel!! Human, you must help, you MUST! I beg you, please, seek the sorcerer and save my poor Norsten!!
卑鄙的惡棍！！冷水裡的鰻魚！！人類，你一定要幫忙，你「一定」要！我求求你，去找那個術士，救救我可憐的 Norsten！！
The southwest mountains have a shortcut past the bandits, time is of the essence!
西南邊的山裡有一條可以繞過強盜的捷徑，時間緊迫！
A veritable army fell before my magic! The bandits pay their tribute to my grace and obey my orders! You're as mad as I am called if you think one human can get through.
一整支軍隊都倒在我的魔法之下！那些強盜向我的威儀進貢、聽我的號令！你要是以為區區一個人類闖得過去，那你跟我一樣瘋。
I'll leave you a corpse, a husk! A withered pile of dust- or perhaps I'll take YOU as a slave too, human! So what will it be? Run...or face me?
我會留給你一具屍體、一具空殼！一堆枯萎的塵土——又或者，我乾脆也把「你」收作奴隸，人類！那你要選哪一邊？跑……還是面對我？
Go up the path to the wizard's tower, at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hoho... The worm comes wriggling in, it seems. What a horrid thing you are. Mismatched armor, courage of a fool all over your face... Inelegant and UGLY!!
呵呵……看樣子小蟲子扭著身子爬進來了。你這東西真是難看。護甲配得亂七八糟，滿臉都是蠢貨才有的勇氣……粗俗，而且醜！！
At least the last ones to face me had some coordination, and the sense to hide themselves. Come further and you'll share their fate!!
上一批來找我的至少還懂得配合，也懂得把自己藏好。再往前走，你就跟他們一個下場！！
You can never understand. The beauty of one like myself cannot be transient, it must be everlasting! I will never succumb to my mortality!
你們永遠不會懂。像我這樣的美是不能短暫的，它必須是永恆的！我絕不會向凡人的宿命低頭！
As a matter of fact...you humans ARE good for one thing. Drab as you are, you're lively. So consider this an honor!
說起來……你們人類「確實」有一個用處。你們雖然醜，卻很有活力。所以這算是你的榮幸！
HAAAAAhahahaha!! Instead of destruction, I'll leave you trapped in this illusion, and chip away at your ugly mind until nothing remains. You'll join the rest who've prolonged my life!
哈啊啊啊哈哈哈哈！！我不打算毀掉你，我要把你困在這場幻覺裡，一點一點削掉你那醜陋的心智，直到什麼都不剩。你會加入那些延長了我壽命的人。
I'll take pleasure in peeling away your most formative memories first- W-wait, what's this giant blank spot? It's interfering with my spell...!!
我要先從你最重要的那些記憶開始剝——等、等等，這一大片空白是什麼？它在干擾我的法術……！！
Ugh, barely any memories to remove, hardly any personality... How much of a dull gray slate are you...and how is that making this more difficult?!
唔，幾乎沒有記憶可以拿走，個性也少得可憐……你到底是有多空白的一塊灰板子……又為什麼這樣反而更難搞？！
Run away and confront the wizard.
You escaped?! ...hmph. I suppose that trick works better for binding a platoon than a person. When you only need to focus on what YOU see...rrgh.
你逃出來了？！……哼。我想這一招用來困住一整個排比對付一個人有效多了。當你只需要專注在「你自己」看到的東西上……唔。
Fine...you've forced my hand. I must sweep you aside, you so-called hero! Never darken my door again! Cease to exist!!
好吧……是你逼我的。我必須把你掃到一邊去，你這個所謂的英雄！別再玷汙我的門前！給我消失！！
Ugh, what was it that raisin of a man said- Miserable runt?! Cold-water eel?! More fitting names for you than me!!
