The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
{~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].
打開地下室的金庫 [密碼: {~}]。
Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
啊，你回來了！報告那邊查到什麼有意思的嗎？
Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
店裡金庫的 TNT 不見了？看來那個店主說的是實話。

他們手上有那麼多 TNT，我們得盡快抓到人——那足以直接在銀行金庫上炸出一個洞！

你該去查另一份目擊報告，時間在店主遇襲之後。

那份是在卷軸商人住處的屋頂花園記錄的，你去看看。
Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
動作要快！想攔下這些強盜，我們沒多少時間了。
Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
喂，你們兩個混帳，帶著那種危險的炸藥在城裡是想幹嘛？
Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
衛兵！衛兵！有強盜！快來！十萬火急！
Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
關於這些罪犯的動向，你有查到什麼新消息嗎？
Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
啊……這下麻煩了。那些罪犯搶走了兩件威力極強的武器。
It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
他們要是帶著那些武器來搶銀行，可就不好對付了。
I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
接下來該怎麼辦我也沒個準，再沒有別的目擊報告進來了，而且——
Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
長官，剛收到急報，{p} 左側住宅區正在發生搶案！
Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
天啊……你！士兵！快！搶案就在橋的另一頭，你今天去的第一間屋子旁邊！很可能就是我們要找的那批強盜。
There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
你到住宅區之後，會有人在屋子外面等你！
If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
要是還找不到，我把座標寫進你的綜合手冊了。快，趕去那間屋子！
Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
哈囉？你是衛兵那邊的人嗎？太好了！快！有幾個強盜剛把我家洗劫一空，帶走了一大堆綠寶石！
Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
跟我到我家去，希望你能找到那些強盜！他們偷走了我好多珍貴的寶石！
Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.
Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
都準備好了嗎，弟兄們？TNT、武器，還有那些綠寶石買得到最快的馬，全都到手了。現在我們只要——
Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
哈。我就覺得後面跟了個衛兵。
No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
拿這些全新的武器對付你太浪費了……反正這個藏身處我們也要炸掉！
Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找出強盜炸開、通往銀行的那個洞。
Follow the criminals into the other room.
跟著罪犯進入另一個房間。
Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
你看看，這位士兵決定跟上來了。蠢招。
I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
那就一石二鳥吧: 逃出銀行，順便宰了這隻蒼蠅。
Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
士兵！你跑到哪裡去了？你聽見銀行底下那些爆炸聲了嗎？
You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
你已經把他們攔下來了？連被搶走的武器跟炸藥也都拿回來了……？
Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
哇。幹得漂亮，士兵。{p} 欠你一份人情。這些是從我們金庫裡拿出來的，請收下，聊表謝意。
I then realized that they had no innocent itinerary, they were heading straight for my wealthy neighbor's house!
這時我才發現，他們的行程一點也不單純——他們直直朝我那位有錢鄰居的家去了！
The bandits came sprinting out of my wealthy neighbor's house with some of his most prized possessions: two weapons from his collection.
強盜們從我那位有錢鄰居家裡衝了出來，帶走了他幾件最珍貴的收藏: 兩件武器。
Oh, an egg! I'll pay you {~} emeralds for it, of course!
噢，一顆蛋！我當然會付你 {~} 綠寶石買下它！
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 取得 Gavel 護照
I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
很抱歉先生，我不能就這樣發一本新護照給你……你需要取得——
But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
可是先生，我的護照被偷了！我還有不到 {~} 分鐘就要搭飛船去 {p}。我真的急需一本……
I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
我已經跟你說過要去哪裡辦新的了。下一位，麻煩。
Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
嗯……你是 {u}，對吧？很遺憾，人類必須在 Wynn 辦護照。
I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
恐怕我幫不上忙。下一位，麻煩。
Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
喂，你！對，就是你！可以出來一下嗎？我想我們可以互相幫忙。
So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
我剛才不小心聽到你跟官員的對話……你也在找護照，對吧？
Well...so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
是這樣的……我聽過一些傳聞，說飛船基地裡藏著一個祕密黑市。
Let's explore the airbase, then! We need to look for clues, lead the way.
那我們就去探索飛船基地吧！我們得找線索，你帶路。
Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
據說他們在那裡買賣違禁品……那裡一定有辦法買到護照，我很確定！
If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
如果我們合作，說不定就能找到進去的門路。你覺得呢？
Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
探索飛船基地，尋找黑市的線索。
Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
喔，你把我們帶到旅店來了！嗯，酒保在這裡做很久了……
Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know...all, uh...sneaky-like.
說不定他知道黑市的事！我來問問看，你知道的……用那種，呃……鬼鬼祟祟的方式。
I can't believe this place! They only have some rancid wheat stored here, what am I supposed to do with that? I'll take a carrot any day over... wheat.
這地方真叫人不敢相信！他們這裡只存了一些發臭的小麥，我拿那種東西能幹嘛？比起……小麥，我寧可要紅蘿蔔。
All those other airship men carry around those vile face fruits, but I have to say, I've always had a soft spot for potatoes.
其他那些飛船上的人全都帶著那種長著臉的噁心果子，不過老實說，我一直對馬鈴薯情有獨鍾。
I wish my airship was black, I can't say I'm a fan of that white palette...
真希望我的飛船是黑色的，我實在不怎麼喜歡那種白色調……
You know, maybe white isn't so bad after all.
你知道嗎，白色說不定也沒那麼糟。
It turns out, white's actually quite a nice colour.
原來白色其實還挺好看的。
... Oh, fine, wheat's not bad. I'll take some, I guess.
……唉，好吧，小麥也不差。那我就拿一些吧。
Though, really, the face doesn't mean it has to be evil, does it? It could be a nice face, after all.
不過說真的，長了張臉也不代表它就一定邪惡，對吧？說不定是張和善的臉呢。
Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
不好意思，先生……你，呃……該不會剛好知道這附近有什麼真的很便宜的店吧？
The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
盛宴的桌子已經擺好，要黑啤還是啤酒，你選哪一個？
Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
有用嗎？他會放我們進去嗎？
I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
我想要找到門路本來就不會那麼容易……{u}，你覺得從這條線索還能往哪查？
Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
繼續探索飛船基地，尋找黑市的線索。
Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
欸，呃……你也覺得這些人看起來很可疑嗎？
The airship commanders love what they hate.
飛船指揮官愛的正是他們恨的。
I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
我想我們摸到門路了！繼續走吧。
Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
追查線索: 飛船指揮官愛的正是他們恨的。
Hmmm... These crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
嗯……這些箱子裡裝滿了東西。也許我們可以拿一些給指揮官？
Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
一旦撕裂，便永遠無法修補。
Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
喔，我們繼續吧！這條線索能帶我們去哪？
Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
追查線索: 一旦撕裂，便永遠無法修補。
Who's that on top of that platform?!
The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
你們兩個為了這件事跑了不少路啊？

好吧，黑啤跟啤酒那題的答案我可以告訴你們！但光靠那個進不了黑市。

你要知道，要進黑市，你得有東西可以賣！而且那東西，怎麼說呢，不會是你在這附近買得到的，你懂我意思吧。
我們需要……違法的東西，對吧？

正是！算你們走運，我今天心情不錯。附近停著一艘飛船。我們可以把它開走，我來幫你們弄到一樣東西。
Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well...you could get something out of this too, right?
呃……{u}，你覺得呢？我真的很需要那本護照，而且，嗯……你也能從中拿到點什麼，對吧？
Protect me while I harvest the egg, soldier!
士兵，我採蛋的時候保護我！
Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
等等！有守衛在看著那艘飛船。別讓他們看見你！
They're near the edge... Push them off.
他們就站在邊緣……把他們推下去。
Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
呃……我相信他們沒事，我相信那個高度摔不死人……

好，那就是你唯一進得去的路了！前面還有更多守衛。別被發現，把他們解決掉，我們就沒問題了！
Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Did you just... Push them all...?
你剛剛是不是……把他們全都推下去了……？
Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
坐穩了！我們要前往 {p}，在那裡可以弄到一些 Dragonling 蛋，讓你拿去黑市賣！
Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
與技師和 Doan 一同前往 {p} 取得 Dragonling 蛋。

我們要去的那座島是 Dragonling 的巢穴！他們在那裡產卵，因為那地方很難抵達。
And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
那些東西在黑市上應該很值錢吧……？
They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
當然值錢！Dragonling 蛋很稀有，而那座島只能靠飛船抵達……在 Letvus 那邊，它們可值一大筆錢。
Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
喔，就在那裡！我從這裡就看得到那座島了，坐穩。我們有幾顆蛋要偷！
What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
那是什麼？！喔……看來有人跟我們搶了……
Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
糟了，天空劫掠者也來了！我們不能讓他們把那些蛋帶走……
Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
好，既然如此，那就只有一條路可走了！來，跟我來！
We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
路上這麼多海盜，我們到不了巢穴，把他們殺光！
Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
好，跟我來！我們去採那顆蛋！
Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
人類，我採蛋的時候保護我！
We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
我們完成一半了，繼續掩護我！
There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Soldier, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
士兵，別讓他們打中我們！在砲彈擊中飛船之前用你的武器打掉它，把它彈開！
We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
我們再挨幾砲就撐不住了……別在這浪費時間，我們走！還有更大的獵物等著呢！
That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
好險……那麼，我們回飛船基地吧！
Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
和 Doan 一起回到 Blackbird Inn 的酒吧。
The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
你們兩個今天確實證明了自己！
So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
那麼，我把進黑市的暗號告訴你們。
Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him 'I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.'
回旅店找酒保，跟他說「我不渴，我隨身都帶著一瓶。」
That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
這樣應該就能給你們一個進去的機會了。祝好運！
Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
謝謝你的幫忙，先生……那我們回酒吧吧。
Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
我們又回來了。去跟酒保說話吧。
Um, sir? I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
那個，先生？我不渴，我隨身都帶著一瓶。
...Well, hey there... Would you like to buy some... potions?
Well, hello there! You like you could use some of my fine wares, yes!
哎呀，你好啊！看你的樣子，正需要我這些上等好貨，沒錯吧！
A dragonling egg? I'd pay {~} emeralds for it.
Dragonling 蛋？我願意出 {~} 綠寶石買下它。
So that's our initial bid. Now we need to ask for a higher bid, remember? We can't always talk to the same merchant or they'll lose interest...
這就是我們的起價了。接下來得找人把價錢往上抬，記得嗎？我們不能老是找同一個商人，不然他們會失去興趣……
And we can't talk to more than {~} people for a raise or they might get angry.
而且我們最多只能找 {~} 個人加價，不然他們可能會生氣。
Well! We really don't see many dragonling eggs around here, not at all!! I'll give you {~} emeralds for it, how does that sound?!
哎呀！這一帶真的很少見到 Dragonling 蛋，少得很！！我出 {~} 綠寶石跟你買，怎麼樣？！
Fine! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds. But if this egg isn't mine now? Don't bother coming back.
好啦！我把價錢加到 {~} 綠寶石。但這顆蛋要是現在還不歸我？那你就別再回來了。
Remember what the passport seller said? We shouldn't always talk to the same merchant... I think this one won't like another price raise. We should talk to the others.
還記得賣護照的那個人怎麼說嗎？我們不該老是找同一個商人……我看這一位不會樂意再加價了。我們去找其他人談吧。
An egg, eh... I'd pay you... {~} emeralds, for it.
一顆蛋啊……我願意付你……{~} 綠寶石。
Another price hike?! I'm not interested anymore. Scram.
又要加價？！我沒興趣了。滾。
Is that a dragonling egg I spot? For a rare item such as that, I would of course be willing to pay {~} emeralds for it!
我看到的那是 Dragonling 蛋嗎？這麼稀有的東西，我當然願意出 {~} 綠寶石買下它！
He appears to be rummaging through his documents.
他好像正在翻找他的文件。
We have to get to {~} emeralds in {~} bid increases. Let's try again!
我們得湊到 {~} 綠寶石，而且只能加價 {~} 次。再試一次吧！
You should try to increase the price with another merchant before going back to your previous one.
回頭找上一個商人之前，你應該先找另一個商人把價錢抬高。
Oh, you're bold, I'll give you that! Asking for another price increase?! Fine!! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds!
喔，你膽子不小，這點我承認！還想再加價？！好！！我把價錢加到 {~} 綠寶石！
I'll raise that price to... {~} emeralds.
我把價錢加到……{~} 綠寶石。
...might not be my business to ask, but what's a human got business at a villager airship customs office for?
……也許輪不到我過問，不過一個人類跑來村民的飛船海關辦事處做什麼？
Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
只跟走廊底端的黑市成員說話，別跟任何其他人交談。
Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
進入黑市，與走廊底端的成員交談。
I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
我聽說你們從天空劫掠者那裡偷了幾顆蛋。這一手夠大膽！
Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
兩本護照？我看差不多要 {~} 綠寶石。把這顆蛋拿去市場上賣就湊得到。

我來說明一下這個市場怎麼運作。你的蛋會有一個很低的起價，然後你得四處找商人，設法把價錢往上抬。
Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
不過要小心，你最多只能要求 {~} 次加價。
You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
你可以試著跟不同的商人談，看看每個人願意把蛋的價錢抬高多少。
Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
祝好運，還有，盡量別把自己搞死了。

看到煙火了。人類做得好，完成了一次晨練！
Orc do much training to stay strong. Orc runners must be fast and not tire to become Marathon!
獸人做很多訓練才能保持強壯。獸人跑者必須跑得快又不會累，才能成為 Marathon！
Here. Human take. Train harder. Maybe visit Holehold- also place for relax, not just run. Stamina good for all.
拿去。人類收下。練得更勤一點。也許可以去 Holehold 看看——那裡也是放鬆的地方，不只是跑步。體力對什麼都好。
Oh. Human who help Ressinter. You are strange. Not like other human at all.
喔。幫過 Ressinter 的人類。你很奇怪。跟其他人類完全不一樣。
This? This food storage. Mostly for meats and roots. Though, large ritual happening soon.
這個？這是食物儲藏。主要放肉和根莖。不過，很快會有大型儀式。
Festival with Earthpit. Will be coming soon- so stocking up food for that.
跟 Earthpit 一起辦的祭典。快到了——所以在囤食物。
...human look like want help. You...really are strange. I suppose...if you want help with food, could do some fishing.
……人類看起來想幫忙。你……真的很奇怪。我想……如果你想幫食物的忙，可以去釣魚。
Won't ask human to do everything- just [{~} Carp Meat] enough to help. Though, could bring more if wanted.
不會要人類做全部——[{~} Carp Meat] 就夠幫忙了。不過想多帶也可以。
If want bring more than {~}, will accept more than {~}.
想帶超過 {~}，超過 {~} 也收。
Mhm, mhm. You are strange human, but not bad human. This enough meat.
嗯，嗯。你是奇怪的人類，但不是壞人類。這些肉夠了。
Festival will still be long time away, but here. Since human help, you get reward. Only fair.
祭典還很久以後，不過拿去。既然人類幫忙，你就該拿獎賞。這才公平。
Oh, you brought more fish than asked. Twice as much as asked!
喔，你帶的魚比要的多。是要求的兩倍！
You are good human. Strange, but not bad. Willing to put in extra effort.
你是好人類。奇怪，但不壞。願意多花力氣。
Here- will also share some meat that won't be for festival. Other rewards too.
拿去——也分你一些不是祭典用的肉。還有別的獎賞。
...that is...much fish. You heard me when I said five, right?
……那是……很多魚。我說五份，你有聽到吧？
Four times as much as fair share. Why human like this?
是應分的四倍。人類為什麼會這樣？
Humans are supposed to be selfish. Listen to villager and kill orc. But you are not like that at all.
人類照理應該自私。聽村民的話去殺獸人。但你完全不是那樣。
Then here- Will share extra meat. Not for festival, but still good. Other thing too. Thank you very much, human.
那拿去——會分你多的肉。不是祭典用的，但一樣好。還有別的東西。非常謝謝你，人類。
Said five. You have thirty. I...how and why.
說了五份。你有三十份。我……怎麼會，還有為什麼。
You just did work of six orc. You are...overachieving human. But that is not bad thing!
你一個人做了六隻獸人的份。你是……做過頭的人類。但那不是壞事！
Here, then. This meat not for festival, but you deserve hearty meal for all effort!
那拿去。這些肉不是祭典用的，但你出了這麼多力，值得吃一頓好的！
That much fish actually meet quota! Thank you so much, strange, kind human!
那麼多魚其實已經達標了！非常謝謝你，奇怪又善良的人類！
Human OFFERING help- Hmh! Very good human! Task simple. Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
人類主動說要幫忙——哼！非常好的人類！事情很簡單。堡壘東南邊，過了山脊，Teiren 的舊營地。
Used to live, but left because Freelancer jump down from mountain. Forgot important thing there!
以前住那裡，但因為 Freelancer 從山上跳下來就搬走了。有重要的東西忘在那裡！
Need stay here, make sure stupid Peloros no run into firepit. Has done before. So, you go get!
得留在這裡，確保笨 Peloros 不會跑進火坑。以前發生過。所以你去拿！
Oi, oi! Y'oughta gimme 'at back right now, li'l lady!
喂、喂！你現在就該把那個還我，小姑娘！
Absolutely NOT, you craven wind spirit! This belongs to me now!
絕不！你這個怯懦的風之精靈！這東西現在屬於我！
Nonsense! This camp was built by those who respected the earth and its bounties. Now that its inhabitants have left, nature is free to reclaim it, as is right!
胡說！這座營地是由敬重大地與其恩賜的人所建。如今住民已經離去，自然理當收回它，這才是正道！
Aw yeah? Issat it? You're a peach, gal, but I'll clip those petals, you don't give it up right now!
喔是嗎？就這樣？你長得挺甜的，姑娘，但你現在不交出來，我就把那些花瓣一片片剪下來！
What a brutish lout you are, threatening an embodiment of nature! I won't give this up without a fight!
你這個粗野的莽夫，居然威脅自然的化身！要我交出來，先打贏我！
...hm? And who might you be? What brings a human to this disused place?
……唔？你又是何人？什麼風把一個人類吹到這個荒廢的地方來？
Oh no, you want this too?! I have claimed it for my own! Leave me be, go! Get out of here!
喔不，你也想要這個？！我已經把它據為己有了！別來煩我，走！離開這裡！
Shouldn'ta crossed me, doll! Remember who spreads your pollen next time, huh?! Now to just take this back up the mountain...
早該知道別惹我的，洋娃娃！下次記清楚是誰替你散花粉，啊？！現在只要把這個帶回山上就好……
OI! Who's THIS joker now? You lookin' ta empty your wallet for me or something?
喂！這個小丑又是誰？你是來把錢包掏空給我的嗎？
What, you want this thing too?! It's mine, y'hear? MINE! You can't have it!
什麼，你也想要這東西？！這是我的，聽到沒？我的！你別想拿到！
Human! Was right to send out. Peloros fall over chair and almost burn! Did find thing? Very distinctive, only thing left at camp.
人類！派你出去果然是對的。Peloros 絆到椅子差點燒起來！東西找到了嗎？很好認，營地裡只剩那一樣。
Hmhm!! Yes! This what looking for! Very good human! Human deserve reward for be good human!
唔唔！！對！就是這個！非常好的人類！人類是好人類，該拿獎賞！
Oh? Human not know what thing is? Want know?
喔？人類不知道這是什麼東西？想知道？
Silly! If human not know what thing is, no tell! Can learn for self.
傻瓜！人類不知道是什麼東西，那就不說！可以自己去學。
不管怎樣。拿去，給好人類！
呃啊……笨 Jixy。笨人類語言！
Hrrh! Human! You language dumb! Name smart, flow like water in Orc language, look like dungpile on paper in human language!
呃嗯！人類！你的語言笨！名字很聰明，在獸人語裡流得像水，寫成人類文字卻像一坨糞！
Say name! Look at spell, say name! Try!! TRY!!!
把名字唸出來！看著拼法，唸出來！試試看！！試啊！！！
GRRRH! Confusing name! Not confusing in orcish! Human say all wrong!
呃啊啊！亂七八糟的名字！在獸人語裡根本不亂！人類全唸錯！
Hmh. That right, human. Willing to try at least. See how bad name look?
哼。那才對，人類。至少願意試。看到名字寫出來有多難看了吧？
Said "shoon-bur." Not even LOOK like that in human letter!
唸的是「shoon-bur」。寫成人類的字母根本不「長」那樣！
Here. Needed show anger at stupid language, not show anger at human.
拿去。需要對笨語言發脾氣，不是對人類發脾氣。
Stupid stupid STUPID! Not at all say like spell! See stupid language now?!
笨笨笨！跟拼法完全不一樣！現在看到語言有多笨了吧？！
GAAAH!! No, no, no, no!!! Why need learn human language?!
啊啊啊！！不，不，不，不！！！為什麼要學人類語言？！
NAME NOT JOE! WHAT KIND NAME JOE?! JOE STUPID NAME!!! AAAAHH!!
名字不叫 Joe！哪有人叫 Joe？！Joe 是笨名字！！！啊啊啊！！
Yunelsu 不會……呃嗯……輸給石頭！！
呼……哈……人、人類！奇怪……奇怪的那種人類！
Rock stuck. Trying to lift- for train strength! No one able to lift rock.
石頭卡住。想抬起來——練力氣用！沒有人抬得動這顆石頭。
Yunelsu try throw rock into river! Have thrown other rock, not this one.
Yunelsu 想把石頭丟進河裡！別的石頭丟過，這顆沒有。
Hmm...human magic strong, but rock still not moving.
唔……人類魔法強，但石頭還是不動。
Work together! Cast magic at rock, I try lift again! Ready!
一起來！對石頭施魔法，我再抬一次！準備！
Hrrgh... Hrrf. Must be...old earth rock.
呃嗯……呼。一定是……古老大地的石頭。
Been here very long time. Stuck here, rock where earth wants rock to be.
在這裡很久很久了。卡在這裡，石頭在大地要它在的地方。
Yunelsu find other rock then. Sometimes rock break, though.
那 Yunelsu 去找別的石頭。不過石頭有時候會裂。
See? Many broken rock. Hear can be good for armor though. You take.
看到沒？很多碎石頭。不過聽說對做盔甲很好。你拿去。
Oh! You! Saw Zuett dragging you to camp. And saw other thing.
喔！是你！看到 Zuett 把你拖進營地。也看到別的事。
And you helped Ressinter! Will apologize later. Was my fault. Human seen Freelancers?
而且你幫了 Ressinter！之後再道歉。是我的錯。人類看過 Freelancer 嗎？
Freelancers think everything belong to them. Loiter around fortress a lot, try to jump in sometimes.
Freelancer 以為什麼都是他們的。常在堡壘附近晃，有時候想跳進來。
Was trying to shoot flying one down, but cannon broke, and cannonball explode.
本來想把飛的那隻打下來，可是大砲壞了，砲彈爆炸。
Now Ressinter okay, but still need repair cannon. Human feel like helping, will need [{~} Iron Ingots] to repair.
現在 Ressinter 沒事，但還是得修大砲。人類想幫忙的話，修理需要 [{~} Iron Ingots]。
Long walk, but there iron in valley east of villager quarry. There also other villager there, with weapons. Not sure why.
路很遠，不過村民採石場東邊的谷地裡有鐵。那裡也有別的村民，帶著武器。不知道為什麼。
Human being weirdly helpful. That good though! Make Lomoster job of shooting enemy easier.
人類幫忙得有點奇怪。不過那是好事！讓 Lomoster 射敵人的工作輕鬆一點。
Here. Freelancer like steal metal and other thing too, have found a lot from shooting. Human can have.
拿去。Freelancer 也愛偷金屬和別的東西，打下來找到很多。人類可以拿走。
Not good for repair cannon, but probably good for make other thing.
修大砲不好用，但拿來做別的東西大概不錯。
Her name, my name, sound same. Don't sound same in Orcish! But in YOUR language, sound same!
她的名字，我的名字，聽起來一樣。在獸人語裡不一樣！但在你們的語言裡，聽起來一樣！
Grrmbl... Dumb Kreimu... Human have stalks?
呃嗯……笨 Kreimu……人類拿到莖了嗎？
Good. Can take these, then- Alraune girl have sometimes. Tasty, but not good medicine.
好。那這些可以拿去——Alraune 女孩有時候會有。好吃，但不是好藥。
Durbeo might like, actually. Durbeo orc in food storage tower behind me. Maybe he want help too?
其實 Durbeo 可能會喜歡。Durbeo 是我後面那座食物儲藏塔的獸人。也許他也需要幫忙？
Oh, that human who healed Ressinter. Yes, I've heard of you already. News travels fast here.
喔，治好 Ressinter 的那個人類。是的，我已經聽說你了。這裡消息傳得很快。
You have a weird face. Uh, a weird look on your face, I mean. What, not used to a more eloquent orc?
你的臉很奇怪。呃，我是說，你臉上的表情很奇怪。怎麼，沒見過講話比較文雅的獸人？
I'm studying languages, is why. I haven't got everything known yet, so if you feel like helping, I could use it.
因為我在研究語言。我還沒把全部都學會，所以你要是想幫忙，我用得上。
I used to have a very smart hobbit friend who lived nearby. They've left, but I want you to check their hobbit hole to see if they left behind any language books.
我以前有個很聰明的哈比人朋友住在附近。他搬走了，但我想請你去他的哈比洞看看有沒有留下什麼語言書。
It should be close to the blue tower on the hill. That should be easy, right?
應該就在山丘上那座藍塔附近。這不難吧？
Oh, good, they did leave a book behind. This even completes the collection I have. I have the first, second, fourth, fifth, and sixth volumes of this.
喔，太好了，他真的留了一本書。這下我的收藏還湊齊了。這套我有第一、第二、第四、第五和第六冊。
Hopefully I can learn something new here. I still don't understand what all these weird "figures of speech" are supposed to mean...
希望能在這裡學到點新東西。我到現在還是搞不懂那些奇怪的「慣用語」到底是什麼意思……
What does busting your hump mean? Or two shakes of a lamb tail? Well, anyway. You probably know, so me trying to guess is boring.
「累斷了駝峰」是什麼意思？還有「兩下羊尾巴的工夫」？唉，反正。你大概知道，所以我在這裡亂猜也很無聊。
Here, then. That friend of mine wrote everything he came across down in some diaries, and he gave me them to keep, but I can't read them.
那拿去。我那個朋友把他遇到的每件事都寫進日記裡，臨走前把它們留給我保管，可是我看不懂。
The pages are too flimsy- I'll rip them if I turn them. It's a good thing the book you gave me is bound with strong leather, but I still need to be careful not to ruin it...
書頁太脆了——我一翻就會撕破。還好你給我的那本是用結實的皮革裝訂的，不過我還是得小心別把它弄壞……
Well, maybe if you read what these have written in them you can learn some things yourself.
嗯，也許你讀了這些書裡寫的東西，自己也能學到一些。
Huh. You again. That weird human who helped Ressinter. Something wrong?
咦。又是你。那個幫過 Ressinter 的奇怪人類。有什麼事嗎？
Hm. Looking to help out still? What is it with you looking to be helpful? Have to say I'm not used to this. But, I can think of something.
唔。還想幫忙？你這麼想幫忙是怎麼回事？我得說我不太習慣。不過，我可以想到一件事。
HEY! Any of you feel like playing a game?
喂！你們有誰想玩遊戲嗎？
Ugh, yeah! We're so BORED in here!
唔，想！我們在這裡無聊死了！
Well, sure, but...even if you say this one isn't so scary, I know I don't wanna tell them my real name!
呃，好啊，可是……就算你說這個沒那麼可怕，我還是不想告訴他們我的真名！
Didn't we just eat a bunch of fruit though? We can use those as fake names!
我們剛剛不是吃了一堆水果嗎？可以拿那些當假名！
Okay then. Well, call me Mango then, weird human!
那好吧。那就叫我 Mango 吧，奇怪的人類！
I just ate a bunch of blueberries, so I guess I'm Blueberry for now?
我剛吃了一堆藍莓，所以我現在大概叫 Blueberry？
Hey, I wouldn't mind being called Grapes by anyone, really!
欸，我真的不介意被任何人叫 Grapes！
Then I'm Peaches! So we're just doing a little hide and seek game?
那我就是 Peaches！所以我們只是要玩個捉迷藏？
Yes. Just hide around the fort someplace. If the human doesn't find you, you win.
對。就在堡壘裡找個地方躲起來。人類要是找不到你們，你們就贏了。
Well, that's kinda boring, so I'm gonna go find a really tough to reach spot!
唔，那有點無聊，所以我要去找一個超級難到的地方！
Well, there you go. I'll tell you how many you have left to find if you talk with me.
好啦，就這樣。你來問我，我會告訴你還剩幾個沒找到。
...wow. You're good. I thought you might be able to see me up here, but I didn't think you'd be able to reach me!
……哇。你很行欸。我想過你可能會看到我在上面，但我沒想到你居然爬得上來！
I don't really care about the fact you're human. As long as I get my entertainment I'm happy. Which kinda isn't so great, cause there isn't a lot here to tinker with.
你是人類這件事我其實不太在意。只要我有樂子我就開心。不過那也不太妙，因為這裡沒什麼東西可以拆著玩。
Tinkernook is so much better about having machines and metals and things to experiment and build than here is.
Tinkernook 那邊機器、金屬、可以拿來實驗和組裝的東西比這裡多太多了。
Anyways, you win, I lose, so I better get back to stick-in-the-mud Nunexetor. See ya!
總之，你贏了，我輸了，那我最好回去找那個死板的 Nunexetor。回頭見！
NYACK! For such a big human you really know how to sneak up on someone!!
喵啊！你這麼大一個人類，居然這麼會偷偷靠近人！！
Gah, I thought I was a goner for a second there... If Nunny says you're okay then I'll trust him, but that doesn't make you less intimidating!
咕啊，我剛剛有一秒以為我完蛋了……Nunny 說你沒問題，那我就信他，但那不代表你就不嚇人！
And, I guess out in the open like this, the other orcs wouldn't let you bully us, so...
而且，我想在這種空曠的地方，其他獸人也不會讓你欺負我們，所以……
Suppose you're alright, maybe. But even still, you found me, so I lose. Unless you can't find everyone else!
我想你大概還可以吧。但即使如此，你找到我了，所以我輸了。除非你找不到其他人！
I bet you'll NEVER find Mango, hahaah! She always takes these games SUPER seriously!
我打賭你「絕對」找不到 Mango，哈哈哈！她每次玩這種遊戲都「超級」認真！
Aw darn it. I guess it's pretty easy to see me up here.
唉，可惡。我猜在上面很容易被看到吧。
I mean, I knew that, but I thought you wouldn't think to climb the tower!
我知道是知道啦，但我以為你不會想到要爬塔！
Well, anyway...you really went and tried to heal Ressinter? That's pretty admirable!
唉，總之……你真的跑去試著治 Ressinter？那還挺值得敬佩的！
Aaaand then a human went and killed her, because I guess they got told to do so! At least you seem halfway decent.
然後有個人類就跑去把她殺了，大概是因為有人叫他這麼做吧！至少你看起來還算像樣。
Anyway, back to the quiet ol' grouch with me!
總之，我回去找那個安靜的老古板了！
Ack! Thought you wouldn't notice me behind the stairs!
啊！我以為你不會注意到我躲在樓梯後面！
Ugh, you...you human types are scary up close. Is Nunexetor really sure you're not a bad guy?
唔，你……你們人類靠近看好可怕。Nunexetor 真的確定你不是壞人嗎？
I mean, look at your armor! You, you look like you could splat me against the wall in a snap!
你看看你的盔甲！你、你看起來一巴掌就能把我拍在牆上！
...I feel like I just gave you an idea and I'm not sticking around to find out! You win!
……我覺得我剛剛好像給了你一個主意，我可不留下來看結果！你贏了！
Looks like the human wins. Guess I know how you managed to find that spineback boar.
看來人類贏了。這下我知道你是怎麼找到那頭棘背野豬的了。
There's no way you REALLY hunted one of those things. Those even give the orc hunters trouble!
你「絕對」不可能真的獵到那種東西。那玩意兒連獸人獵手都嫌麻煩！
Are you kidding me? Humans are terrifying, Blueberry! They've hunted way stronger stuff than some stupid pig!
你在開玩笑嗎？人類很可怕的，Blueberry！他們獵過比那種笨豬強得多的東西！
But, the game was fun, right?
That's all I wanted from you. Can go back to whatever it was you were doing now.
我想要的就這些。你們可以回去做原本在做的事了。
Yes, finally! I don't have to spend time wondering if the human's gonna try and poke my eyes out!
太好了，終於！我不用再一直想人類會不會來戳我的眼睛了！
Oh, quit being such a scaredy-baby. This one's nice!
喔，別那麼膽小啦。這個人不錯！
Good game, I guess! Back to being bored again.
好遊戲，我想啦！又要回去無聊了。
What? You aren't even wearing those kinds of shoes.
什麼？你根本就沒穿那種鞋。
Anyways, to the winner goes the spoils. Here, for entertaining them for a bit.
總之，戰利品歸勝者。拿去，謝謝你陪他們玩了一陣子。
They have me watch the goblins but I'm no good at having fun with them, so thanks I suppose.
他們讓我看著這些哥布林，可是我不太會陪他們玩，所以我想我該謝謝你。
Ah, the weird human. Why you looking to be helpful?
啊，奇怪的人類。你為什麼一直想幫忙？
The cave outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it. Go in, and there will be blue flowers.
村民橋外面那個洞穴，旁邊有池塘跟拱門的。進去，裡面會有藍色的花。
Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Don't know why you helping, but won't turn down help either.
拿 [{~} Terramarine Buds] 回來就能做更多染料。不知道你為什麼幫忙，但也不會拒絕幫忙。

又是那個奇怪的人類？你全身都是藍色粉末。那你找到花了！

拿去。會替你收下。花苞夠用了，粉塵你可以留著。
Little more, too. But, again- why you looking to be helpful? Don't understand. Humans kill orcs a lot.
還有多一點。不過，還是那句——你為什麼一直想幫忙？不懂。人類殺很多獸人。
You that weird human helping instead killing, right? Nunexetor and little goblins talking about you.
你就是那個幫忙而不是殺人的奇怪人類吧？Nunexetor 跟小哥布林都在講你。
Trying to make weapons and tools better. Training, but running out of grindstones. Etemitoro- that is me, my name... That how say it?
在想辦法把武器跟工具做得更好。在訓練，但磨石快用完了。Etemitoro——那是我，我的名字……是這樣唸嗎？
Weird human language. Anyway, know where good grindstone is- top of mountain east of fortress.
奇怪的人類語言。總之，知道哪裡有好磨石——堡壘東邊那座山的山頂。
There shortcut running through top by Ledant cave. Maybe dangerous, but not too much. Follow dead bushes on road and can get to top quickly.
有一條捷徑從 Ledant 洞穴旁邊的山頂穿過去。也許有點危險，但不會太危險。沿著路上的枯灌木走，很快就能到山頂。
May have something useful if bring me [Leaden Stone] for grind metal.
帶 [Leaden Stone] 回來磨金屬的話，也許有有用的東西給你。
Look- human want help? Then get Etemitoro- that is me, my name... Get-
聽著——人類想幫忙？那就去替 Etemitoro——那是我，我的名字……去拿——
Oh! You have [Leaden Stone]! Was focusing on work, didn't notice.
喔！你有 [Leaden Stone]！剛才專心工作，沒注意到。
Here. Human like green gem for money, right? Not good for smithing though.
拿去。人類喜歡綠色寶石當錢，對吧？不過不適合鍛造。
Hm, healer human. Could swear, saw you walking around plains some time ago. What here for? Ressinter hurt again?
唔，治療師人類。可以發誓，前一陣子看過你在平原上走。來這裡做什麼？Ressinter 又受傷了？
No? Well, am curious now. You try heal Ressinter...luck, maybe? Or did human really know what herbs do?
沒有？那，現在好奇了。你想治 Ressinter……也許是運氣？還是人類真的知道那些藥草的作用？
Want review. Want see human medicine knowledge. Will ask questions, human give answer. Simple. Ready?
想考一下。想看看人類的醫藥知識。會問問題，人類回答。很簡單。準備好了嗎？
Good! So, first question. Ginkgo Leaf. What Gingko Leaf good for?
好！那，第一題。銀杏葉。銀杏葉有什麼用？
Yes! Good. Gingko leaf help brain. Make feel better when stress, but make blood runny. Can be good for sometimes, but can be dangerous.
對！很好。銀杏葉對腦子好。壓力大的時候讓人舒服一點，但會讓血變稀。有時候是好事，但也可能危險。
So, second question. Sweetgale. What Sweetgale good for?
那，第二題。香楊梅。香楊梅有什麼用？
Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
不對。香楊梅不是幫那個的。唔，也許人類治好 Ressinter 是靠運氣……想的話可以再試一次。
Here third question. Elderberry. Elderberry good for two thing. What Elderberry good for?
第三題來了。接骨木莓。接骨木莓有兩種用途。接骨木莓有什麼用？
No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
不對，接骨木莓對那些沒用。唔，也許人類治好 Ressinter 是靠運氣……想的話可以再試一次。
It soothes pain and treats c
它能舒緩疼痛，還能治類似感冒的病。
Yes! Though, Elderberry also good for third thing. Can make good drink! Get drunk if ferment Elderberry, but that not medicine.
對！不過，接骨木莓還有第三種用途。可以做很好的飲料！接骨木莓發酵會讓人喝醉，但那不是藥。
Last question for human. Feverfew. What Feverfew NOT help with?
人類的最後一題。小白菊。小白菊「不能」治什麼？
Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
小白菊很擅長治那個。唔，也許人類治好 Ressinter 是靠運氣……想的話可以再試一次。
噗……哈哈哈哈哈！！！人、人類，好耶！我——哈哈！
That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
那個……答對了！不正確，但答對了！你……哈哈，你治好 Ressinter 真的只是靠運氣吧？人類其實不是治療師。
Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
不過人類有幽默感！而且人類很努力想幫忙。這比大部分人類都好。那就拿去吧——多試著治療，別只當個士兵。
World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
這世界需要更多願意幫助別人的人。人類願意去試，就代表了很多好事。
It aids in sleep and soothes
它能助眠，還能舒緩發炎。
No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
不對。銀杏葉對那個不好。唔，也許人類治好 Ressinter 是靠運氣……想的話可以再試一次。
Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
好。慢慢來。會在這裡待一陣子，確認另一個治療師沒事。
Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
治療師人類！你好！這是 Onluk 塔。Onluk 二號塔！人類幫過忙，所以人類歡迎。
Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
一號塔叫一號塔，因為一號塔是 Onluk 蓋的！這裡不是 Onluk 平常待的地方。
Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
平常在小山丘上的塔，過了橋那邊。但因為是自己一個人蓋的，塔很搖。
Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
人類很會幫忙。人類去弄結實的木頭來修塔？{p} 有結實的木頭。森林也有木頭，但比較有魔力，不夠結實。
Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
啊哈！人類有柳木！Onluk 現在就修塔！
Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
會修好 Onluk 一號塔！修好之後來看！
TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
一號塔修好了！呃啊啊！好耶！人類非常會幫忙！
Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
應該去看看！爬上塔，用弩射 Freelancer！
See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
看到沒？Onluk 一號塔比 Onluk 二號塔好太多了！上面很舒服，還看得到 Fruludir 的塔！
Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
人類非常會幫忙。是治療師，也是伐木工！是修塔的人——呃，人類沒有修塔。是修塔的人的幫手！
Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
拿去，謝謝你幫忙修 Onluk 一號塔！
Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Ureietun 談話，以取得進入女酋長小屋的許可
Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
人類想跟 Arrai-Veretel 談。在小屋裡。跟上。
Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
Arrai-Veretel！人類在堡壘裡到處幫獸人。想談談。
Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
接下來看人類自己。不會再幫了——決定權在 Arrai-Veretel。
Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
哼。Zuett 提過你。所以你就是那個想結束戰爭的人類？
YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
你！你就是殺了 Rai-Poxper 的人類！你就是攻擊另一座堡壘的人類！

得再跟 Zuett 談一次。你跟上。而且你給我安靜。懂嗎？
Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
跟著 Arrai-Veretel 進入 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的會議室

Zuett！你說人類想要和平。你知道這個人類是誰嗎？！
Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
呼——這是好人類！治好 Ressinter——
Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
這人類「也」攻擊過另一座堡壘！很多獸人因為這個人類死掉！
Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.

Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
村民跟人類先攻擊，卻反過來把獸人收取應得代價說成獸人先動手！然後人類殺了 Rai-Poxper！

……Arrai-Veretel 說得對。人類做的好事，補不回那些。但是，人類還在試。如果一個人類願意試著停下來，更多人類也可以試著停下來。
Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
也許。也許死的獸人反而更多。Zuett，你沒辦法說之後會怎樣。那是一廂情願，而我也希望會那樣！

Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
在獸人會議室下方的競技場擊敗 Arrai-Veretel。

願大地親自聽見我們……縱使我們已不再以昔日的言語言說……

我們，作為她所賜予之地上卑微的住民，謹以此戰獻上對她的敬意。

願她饜足、康健，並以此供奉回報我們。

我沒事！笨蛋，白痴！儀式戰鬥時不准插手！

人類贏了。不想承認，但人類贏了。甚至沒有想殺我。
Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
給點時間。這一戰打得很苦——需要緩一緩。在會議室等。會……談條件。
Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
要停一場不是我們挑起的戰爭，感覺像羞辱。但，給了承諾。人類強。還是補不回那麼多死亡……

Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
會停止攻擊城市。獸人還是會自衛！不會躺下來把肚子送給長矛。還是不信村民——只給停火。

會先說——平原上很多獸人心裡有仇。很多獸人大概還是會攻擊。真的那樣，人類也可以自衛。但，人類最好避開那裡的戰鬥。

……村民要是繼續攻擊，會像以前一樣自衛。人類，確保村民知道這件事。

嗯。村民比人類更笨。村民做了很多可怕的事。但沒完沒了的戰爭幫不了什麼。

所以 Zuett 不天真。有些事……不能……被……原諒。村民踩在線上了。
Human seen earth rotting in north. Have to have, since took fort in rotting place. Forest used to be living thing. Now dying. Dead in north-east.
人類見過北邊腐爛的大地。一定見過，既然拿下了腐爛之地上的堡壘。那片森林以前是活的。現在正在死。東北邊已經死了。
Start happening only few decades before Villager leave across ocean! Villager always run away from problem.
只比村民渡海離開早幾十年開始的！村民總是從問題面前逃走。

而且村民自己製造問題。只可能是村民傷了大地，讓她慢慢地、確確實實地死去。以前很多獸人住在那裡。
Even after villager move in, try kick orc out, many orc live there...then earth start to die. Has not come south- and we are south!
就算村民搬進來、想把獸人趕走，還是有很多獸人住在那裡……然後大地開始死。還沒往南邊來——而我們在南邊！

但……那扯遠了。不再有戰爭。把這個交給需要看到它的村民。

把停火協議拿給 Goruca 隊長看。

人類！你回來了！這確實花了你不少時間。不過考慮到各種因素，我想我也不該意外。那些獸人很難纏。

這是什麼？你居然真的讓那些畜生簽了停火協議？！我還以為你會帶著血淋淋的戰利品回來，而不是一個簽名！

不過，這是好事！條款比我想要的更滴水不漏了一點，不過我想只要他們不再來煩我們，怎麼樣都行。

獸人投石機！我跟你說真的，隊長！他們用巨大的石頭把我們的守衛魔像壓碎了！我們要拿什麼去擋？！
He's right, captain. After the golems were crushed, the orcs spilled out from the fortress. If we didn't retreat we would've been killed, with just the four of us.
他說得對，隊長。魔像被壓碎之後，獸人從堡壘裡湧了出來。我們要是不撤退，就我們四個人，早就死了。
Human! Let me give you the lowdown. Since you helped us reclaim the outpost up north, the orcs have gotten much more aggressive.
人類！我把情況跟你講一遍。自從你幫我們奪回北邊的前哨站之後，獸人變得侵略性強得多。
And that's where you come in, soldier. We need you to go to the orc fortress and break through their line of defenses. Maybe if we show them we can equal their force, they'll listen, right?
而這就要靠你了，士兵。我們需要你去獸人堡壘，突破他們的防線。也許只要讓他們看到我們的武力跟他們相當，他們就會聽了，對吧？
One against four... Human not beat even one. Ismikku! Hulve!
一打四……人類連一個都打不贏。Ismikku！Hulve！
Mmh. Get up. Human! Get up! See human breathing, you awake!
唔。起來。人類！起來！看到人類在呼吸，你醒著！
Anyway. Why you here? Why now? Give me good reason. Because kill orcs for "peace"?
總之。為什麼來這裡？為什麼是現在？給我一個好理由。因為為了「和平」殺獸人？
[!] An Elite Boar has been spotted. The hunt begins!
[!] 發現了一頭 Elite Boar。狩獵開始！
[!] The Elite Boar can be identified by the particles above it's head.
[!] Elite Boar 可以從頭上的粒子效果認出來。
[!] The boars will try to hide in the bushes around the hunting grounds.
[!] 野豬會試著躲進獵場四周的灌木叢裡。
[!] Pay attention to what bush the Elite Boar is hiding in and give that bush a rustle with right-click to get the boars out of their hiding spots.
[!] 注意 Elite Boar 躲在哪叢灌木裡，用右鍵搖那叢灌木，把野豬趕出藏身處。
...hm. ... ... ...can respect human strength. Can hunt spineback, mean strong.
……唔。…………可以尊敬人類的強。獵得到棘背，就是強。
!! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!
！！Ressinter 是唯一的治療師！Zuett 想當治療師，Creinu 想當治療師，但都不是！
Hm... HM!! Human, uh, human good healer! Heal own injury with medicine! Human will help!
唔……唔！！人類，呃，人類是好治療師！自己受傷自己用藥治好！人類會幫忙！
The book depicts a tall, vine-like plant with red buds.
書上畫著一株高大的藤狀植物，長著紅色的花苞。
The illustration shows a body with splotchy red patches, and seems to depict pulped buds being applied to them.
插圖畫著一具布滿紅色斑塊的身體，似乎在描繪把搗碎的花苞敷在上面。
There's a picture of fire on the skin...? Is it trying to say that sweetgale helps heal inflammation?
有一張圖畫著皮膚上的火……？這是想說香楊梅能治發炎嗎？
Another diagram shows grubs on the body, and seems to show that applying the pulped buds kills the bugs? That's what the big red X over the grub implies...
另一張圖畫著身上長蟲，看起來是說把搗碎的花苞塗上去可以殺蟲？蟲身上那個大紅叉大概是這個意思……
The book depicts large groups of flowers in various colors, but primarily yellow.
書上畫著成群的花，顏色各異，但以黃色為主。
Seems like yarrow can do a lot- there's a lot of disparate illustrations. One depicts a sneezing orc with two yarrow plants pointing at it, and the sneezing stopping.
蓍草好像能做不少事——圖畫得很雜。其中一張畫著一隻打噴嚏的獸人，兩株蓍草指著他，然後噴嚏就停了。
A similar illustration shows an orc that appears to be having stomach cramps, if its hands being crossed over its stomach is any indication, with two yarrow plants pointed at it.
另一張類似的圖畫著一隻獸人，兩隻手交疊在肚子上，看起來是肚子絞痛，旁邊有兩株蓍草指著他。
The third one shows an orc seemingly cut up, with red droplets coming off it. Again, two yarrow plants are pointed at it, and the next picture shows the cuts and droplets gone.
第三張畫著一隻好像被割傷的獸人，身上滴著紅色的水滴。同樣有兩株蓍草指著他，下一張圖裡傷口和水滴都不見了。
The book depicts small, dainty flowers with white petals.
書上畫著小巧精緻、花瓣雪白的花。
There's a detailed picture of the plant, with arrows pointing to multiple different illustrated orcs each showing different things.
有一張植物的細部圖，箭頭指向好幾隻畫出來的獸人，每一隻表現的狀況都不一樣。

One orc is shown to be agitated, and then subsequently sleeping. Another is...shown with red patches on the skin, and fire next to it, which is replaced with water droplets in the next drawing. The red patches are gone.
一隻獸人畫得焦躁不安，接著就睡著了。另一隻……皮膚上有紅斑，旁邊畫著火，下一張圖裡火換成了水滴。紅斑不見了。
The last one shows various cuts and gashes on a third orc that's emitting red droplets, and then smaller cuts without any red drops on the next depiction...
最後一張畫著第三隻獸人身上大小不一的傷口，滲出紅色的水滴，接著下一張圖裡傷口變小，也沒有紅點了……
...but the next page is showing an orc with X's over its eyes, and arrows from multiple chamomile plants pointing to it. Does that mean too much chamomile is bad?
……但下一頁畫的是一隻眼睛被打上叉的獸人，好幾株洋甘菊用箭頭指著他。這是說洋甘菊用太多不好嗎？
The book depicts a shrub-like plant with white petals and buds.
書上畫著一株灌木狀的植物，有白色的花瓣和花苞。

It looks like this is good for healing a lot of things. The pictures show a sweating, feverish orc, one clutching its stomach, a female one clutching her stomach, and what can be assumed to be an orc with...a toothache?
看起來這個能治不少毛病。圖上畫著一隻冒汗發燒的獸人、一隻按著肚子的、一隻按著肚子的雌獸人，還有一隻大概是……牙痛的獸人？
Seems to imply that feverfew is good for dealing with all of those kinds of maladies.
看起來是在說小白菊對那些毛病都有用。
The bleeding seems to have slowed down a little bit, but the medicine orc is still badly injured. The balm must not have been effective. You'll have to make another one.
流血好像稍微慢了一點，但那隻醫藥獸人還是傷得很重。藥膏一定沒有奏效。你得再做一份。
Not know much about medicine yet. Medicine give to you, last one- Was made before. Know this though.
對藥還不太懂。給你的藥，是最後一份——以前做的。不過這個知道。
Ressinter bleeding bad. Find herb good for bleeding. Won't need more than two herb of type, too.
Ressinter 流血流得很嚴重。找對止血好的草藥。同一種草藥也不會需要超過兩株。
The book depicts broad, yellow-green leaves.
書上畫著寬大的黃綠色葉子。
There's an image of an orc with red droplets coming off it, and an arrow with a picture of a gingko leaf pointing at it- the arrow is crossed out. That could mean multiple things.
有一張圖畫著一隻身上滴著紅點的獸人，一個帶著銀杏葉圖案的箭頭指著他——那個箭頭被劃掉了。那可能有好幾種意思。
The next page shows a gingko leaf pointed at an illustration of a brain, and a similar arrow points from a frowning orc to a smiling one.
下一頁畫著一片銀杏葉指向一顆腦的圖，另一個類似的箭頭從一隻皺眉的獸人指向一隻在笑的獸人。
So that means it's good for mood and mental health...and that it does something with bleeding, but you can't tell whether it would be good or bad for it.
所以這是說它對情緒和心神有好處……而且跟流血有關，但你看不出來是好還是壞。
The book depicts red-orange flowering stalks, almost like cattails.
書上畫著橙紅色的花穗，幾乎像香蒲一樣。
There's a large illustration of an orc with big purple blotches all over it, and next to it there's a similar illustration with orange splotches instead.
有一張大圖畫著一隻全身布滿大片紫色斑塊的獸人，旁邊還有一張類似的圖，斑塊換成了橘色。
That implies that ground-up pyrola goes on there...probably depicting bruises.
這是說把磨碎的鹿蹄草塗在那裡……畫的大概是瘀青。
Similar orange splotches are shown applied to what is clearly a cut, and the next illustration over shows the same cut having become smaller.
類似的橘色斑點被塗在一道明顯的傷口上，隔一張圖裡同一道傷口就變小了。
Then there's illustrations of what look like...veins? There's a lot of orcish script next to it, so you can't make heads or tails of what that much could mean.
接著有幾張圖畫的好像是……血管？旁邊寫了一大堆獸人文字，所以那些到底是什麼意思你完全看不出來。
The book depicts a short shrub covered in vibrant red berries on small stalks.
書上畫著一株矮灌木，細莖上長滿鮮紅的漿果。
There are multiple illustrations of what look like sick orcs- sneezing and coughing shown in pictures.
有好幾張圖畫的好像是生病的獸人——圖上畫著打噴嚏和咳嗽。
One illustration shows what looks to be an orc in great pain, and arrows pointing from the elderberries to those figures.
有一張圖畫著一隻看起來痛得厲害的獸人，箭頭從接骨木莓指向那些圖形。
Your best guess is that elderberries are good for healing mild illnesses, and maybe for dulling pain.
看來接骨木莓大概能治輕微的病，也許還能減輕疼痛。
The balm doesn't seem to have worked this time either. He's still bleeding badly. Maybe you can just...cover up all the cuts and hope for the best? Or maybe that's not a good idea.
這次藥膏好像也沒用。他還在大量流血。也許你可以直接……把傷口全蓋起來，然後祈禱？又或者那不是個好主意。
Still no significant effect. The orc's breathing is getting shallower...
還是沒有明顯效果。那隻獸人的呼吸越來越淺……
... Agreed. We should get back to our tasks though.
……同意。不過我們該回去做自己的事了。
If she's worried about you just following orders, then if you go and help out some orcs on your own, Ureietun might change her mind.
如果她擔心你只是在聽命令，那你自己主動去幫幫獸人，Ureietun 或許會改變想法。
There are lots of orcs around. Asking them if they need help should be simple enough.
附近有很多獸人。去問他們需不需要幫忙應該不難。
Human stupid? I say no see Arrai-Veretel!
人類笨嗎？我說了不能見 Arrai-Veretel！
Suppose that's that, then- Fruludir has his package. Time to go back to Peloros.
那就這樣了——Fruludir 拿到他的包裹了。該回去找 Peloros 了。
Peloros train hard. Peloros work hard. Peloros work everyone hard, do everything hard.
Peloros 練得很拚。Peloros 做事很拚。Peloros 操每個人都很拚，什麼都做得很拚。
Heard that Peloros thinking of making more race spot.
聽說 Peloros 在想多弄幾個賽跑的地點。
Maybe if war stop, then all orc can try run. Maybe human try run too.
也許戰爭停了，所有獸人就能試著跑。也許人類也可以來跑。
NO! Wrong! Say wrong, all wrong! Sound even stupider than normal!
不對！錯！說錯了，全錯！聽起來比平常還笨！
Want human try again! Feel pain of good name in stupid language! SAY NAME!
要人類再說一次！感受好名字被笨語言念出來的痛！說名字！
Supposed to learn human language for peace. Show orc good because big-nose grub say bad.
為了和平該學人類的語言。要讓人看到獸人好，因為大鼻子蟲說獸人壞。
Idiot villager get human before orc, so human greet orc with weapon and death!
笨村民比獸人先找上人類，所以人類拿武器和死亡來見獸人！
Now learn language but only in half, and name all stupid!
現在學語言只學一半，名字還全都取得很笨！
His breathing is steady...better let him sleep.
他的呼吸很平穩……還是讓他睡吧。
Just need [{~} Carp Meat] from human. Could bring more if wanted, but will not force you.
只需要人類的 [{~} Carp Meat]。想多帶也可以，但不會逼你。
All must work together to survive on earth. All have places, all have paths.
要在大地上活下來，所有人都得一起出力。所有人都有位置，所有人都有路。
Many just take and not give. Villager, bugs, other human... You are different.
很多人只拿不給。村民、蟲子、其他人類……你不一樣。
Still not understand why helping so much. It good, but was not expecting from human.
還是不懂為什麼幫這麼多。這是好事，但沒想到人類會這樣。
Can say, happy to be wrong about this.
可以說，這次錯了，很開心。
Well, it seems like just trying to lift it won't work. Maybe casting some spells at it will dislodge it? Try casting multiple spells in a row.
看來光用力抬是沒用的。也許對它施幾個法術能把它鬆開？試著連續施幾個法術。
Human! Try move rock, use magic!
人類！試著搬石頭，用魔法！
Human can't find iron? There some in valley east of villager quarry, around villager with weapons.
人類找不到鐵？村民採石場東邊的山谷裡有一些，在拿武器的村民附近。
Maybe someplace closer. If so, not know where. Need [{~} Iron Ingots] total though.
也許有更近的地方。有的話，不知道在哪。不過總共需要 [{~} Iron Ingots]。
Grrmb. Dumb Kreimu. Stupid Wynn language...Gavel language...pfeh. Whatever language. Not orc language.
呃嗯。笨 Kreimu。笨 Wynn 語……Gavel 語，呸。哪一種語言都好，就不是獸人語。
Not just that- Learning to be medicine orc. She medicine orc too! Healer, brewer, herbalist, whatever. Too much same!
還不只那樣——我在學當醫藥獸人。她也是醫藥獸人！治療師、調藥師、草藥師，隨便。太多一樣的！
Angry about it. Been distracting from training too. Human want help like help with Ressinter? Get Creinu- Crei...nu...not Kreimu...ingredient for medicine.
為那件事生氣。也一直讓訓練分心。人類想像幫 Ressinter 那樣幫忙？去拿 Creinu——Crei……nu……不是 Kreimu……做藥的材料。
[{~} Leafy Stalk]. Need to learn how to make much medicine out of little herb. Easy?
[{~} Leafy Stalk]。要學會用少少的草藥做出很多藥。簡單吧？
[{~}/{~}] Onluk [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
[{~1}/{~2}] Onluk [{~3} Willow Planks] 也許就夠把塔弄好。柳木是硬木！拿得到嗎？
Human welcome in Onluk tower two, but Onluk tower one better. Not safe to be on without fix tower though.
人類可以來 Onluk 的二號塔，但一號塔比較好。不過塔沒修好，站上去不安全。
If want go on Onluk tower one, bring [{~} Willow Planks] so Onluk can fix!
想上 Onluk 的一號塔，就帶 [{~} Willow Planks] 來讓 Onluk 修！
If bring up lots of arrow, maybe can shoot Freelancer. Like to run through sky. Cause problem for everyone, and Freelancer never actually die, just dissipate.
帶很多箭上去，也許就能射 Freelancer。他們喜歡在天上跑。給每個人製造麻煩，而且 Freelancer 從來不會真的死，只會散掉。
Fun time sometimes! Though sometimes Freelancer shoot back. That how Onluk tower one broke.
有時候很好玩！不過有時候 Freelancer 會反擊。Onluk 的一號塔就是那樣壞掉的。
Must be some reason. Not sure if tired of fighting or some other reason, but if human feel like helping, can use some help.
一定有原因。不確定是打累了還是別的原因，但人類想幫忙的話，這裡用得上。
Running low on blue dyes. Have plenty of the other colors, but need blue. Know where to get them, too.
藍色染料快沒了。其他顏色很多，但需要藍的。也知道去哪裡拿。
Can't find the cave? Is outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it.
找不到洞穴？在村民橋外面，旁邊有池子跟拱門。
Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Bright blue flowers, very dusty.
拿 [{~} Terramarine Buds] 回來就能做更多染料。亮藍色的花，粉塵很多。
You unlearn villager stupidity, maybe? In the middle of unlearning? Perhaps a sign from the earth things will heal. Perhaps not. We will see.
也許你正在把村民的愚蠢學掉？學到一半？也許是大地給的徵兆，一切會癒合。也許不是。再看吧。
Mhm. Good! Sweetgale pulp make bugs avoid. Also make irritated skin soothe. Very good for bug bite.
嗯。好！香楊梅搗成泥能讓蟲避開。也能讓發炎的皮膚舒緩。對蟲咬很有用。
Broken weapon parts not good alone, but still sharp. Can be used to make other weapons! Reuse good for earth- waste not!
壞掉的武器零件單獨沒用，但還是利。可以拿去做別的武器！再利用對大地好——別浪費！
What in the... HEY! Why's one of those big, scary humans in here?! Nunny, I thought you said we were gonna play a game!
這是什麼……喂！為什麼有一個又大又可怕的人類在這裡？！Nunny，你不是說我們要玩遊戲嗎！
We are. This human isn't actually so bad. Care to introduce yourselves?
是啊。這個人類其實沒那麼糟。要不要自我介紹一下？
Silly little goblins. Who goes and names themself after fruits?
傻傻的小哥布林。誰會拿水果給自己取名字啊？
Guess goblins are just sort of fickle like that. But again, you just have to find all four of them.
我想哥布林大概就是這麼善變。不過話說回來，你就是得把四個都找出來。
None of them will have left the fortress, so it shouldn't take too long.
他們都不會離開堡壘，所以應該不會花太久。
I hear most humans are bullies. It's why Veltu over at the Trunkstump camp was training us to be tougher.
我聽說大部分的人類都是惡霸。所以 Trunkstump 營地的 Veltu 才會訓練我們變強。
I lost, so I don't care about the game anymore. I saw Blueberry over by that one orc who keeps trying to lift that rock.
我輸了，所以我不在乎這場遊戲了。我看到 Blueberry 在那個一直想搬石頭的獸人旁邊。
Ack! I saw Grapes on the hanging flag! Don't hurt me!
啊！我看到 Grapes 在那面掛著的旗子上！不要打我！
Y'know, I probably shouldn't tell you this, but I could actually see Mango over in the other tower! She probably figured it was tough to get to.
你知道嗎，這個我大概不該講，但我其實看得到 Mango 在另一座塔上面！她大概覺得那裡很難上去。
Uh... I wonder where Peaches went? I know he loves playing in the creeks at Waterway, so... Oh. I shouldn't spoil their spot.
呃……不知道 Peaches 跑去哪了？我知道他很愛在 Waterway 的小溪裡玩，所以……喔。我不該把他的藏身處說出來。
Yeah, I guess it wasn't as boring as I thought.
是啊，我想這沒有我以為的那麼無聊。
Not much else to say. Was fun, I suppose.
沒什麼別的要說。我想，挺好玩的。
Hey! Human! Human who hunt spineback boar and help heal healer!
喂！人類！那個獵棘背野豬又幫忙治好治療師的人類！
Not stupid human who go around kill other orc! Good human! Can trust. So trust, will ask for small thing.
不是那種到處殺別的獸人的笨人類！好人類！可以信。既然信，就要拜託一件小事。
Oh, human forget. Teiren tell again! Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
喔，人類忘了。Teiren 再說一次！堡壘的東南邊，過了山脊，Teiren 的舊營地。
Forgot important thing there. Need make sure Peloros no run into firepit. So, you go get!
有重要的東西忘在那裡。要確定 Peloros 不會衝進火坑。所以，你去拿！
Lady, everything the wind touches is OURS! Not ta mention we're so close to the mountains we live on! This camp's our property, and that thing you got's part of the camp!
小姐，風吹得到的地方全都是我們的！更別說我們離自己住的山那麼近了！這個營地是我們的財產，你手上那東西也是營地的一部分！
One so brazen as yourself could never share in the bounties of nature! Now begone, and leave me be!
像你這麼厚顏的傢伙，永遠不配分享自然的恩賜！走開！別來煩我！
Will say, got thing from Earthpit. Was brought by Holehold gofer during party.
會說，東西是從 Earthpit 來的。宴會上由 Holehold 的跑腿帶來的。
Special thing! Kept for long time. Important, so was bad to forget.
特別的東西！留了很久。很重要，所以忘掉是不好的。
Will maybe invite human to next party!
下次辦宴會也許會邀人類！
Earth say what earth should be. Only need to listen to her.
大地說大地該是什麼樣子。只要聽她說就好。
Earth say rock should stay here, then rock stays here. Simple.
大地說石頭該留在這，石頭就留在這。很簡單。
Hurts, seeing earth rot in north. Big-nose grubs should feel her pain too- they make earth sick!
看大地在北邊腐爛，很痛。大鼻子蟲也該感受她的痛——是他們讓大地生病的！
How can Zuett say human trying end war, when human START WAR AGAIN?!
Zuett 怎麼能說人類想結束戰爭，人類又把戰爭打起來了？！
THAT. IS. THE. POINT!! Villager get human to fight for them! Cease-fire say Villager not attack orc. Then, human come over ocean. Try make peace- get attack!
那。就。是。重。點！！村民讓人類替他們打！停火協議說村民不攻擊獸人。然後人類渡海過來。想講和——就被攻擊！
See human attack. Villager get human to attack, say lies to trick humans. Orcs defend self. Then, three Rai-orc die at Earthpit, Cliffhearth, Trunkstump goblin camp.
看到人類攻擊。村民讓人類攻擊，說謊騙人類。獸人自衛。然後三個 Rai 獸人死在 Earthpit、Cliffhearth 和 Trunkstump 的哥布林營地。
Orc take human fort built in dying earth forest. Cannot know if human planning another attack! But not kill human. Hold human instead.
獸人拿下了人類建在死去大地的森林裡的堡壘。不知道人類是不是又要攻擊！但沒有殺人類。是把人類關起來。
War only killing us! If tried talk to human instead of go to sharpen spear and fight back, maybe human would learned faster than now.
戰爭只是在殺我們！要是當初去跟人類談，而不是去磨矛反擊，也許人類早就學得比現在快。
Listen. Zuett. I want war stop too. But you must understand the risk here. Cannot make decision lightly. Villager go back on word- see writing, find way around writing.
聽好，Zuett。我也想要戰爭停下來。但你必須明白這裡的風險。不能輕率做決定。村民會反悔——看字面，找繞過字面的方法。
...that right. Prepare, human. Arrai-Veretel strongest orc. Strong in everything. Mind, body, power, spirit.
……說得對。準備好，人類。Arrai-Veretel 是最強的獸人。什麼都強。腦、身體、力量、精神。
Zuett still think human trying to be good. Still think can help stupid war end. Knock sense into Arrai-Veretel. Arena is down stairs.
Zuett 還是覺得人類想做好事。還是覺得能幫忙結束這場笨戰爭。去把 Arrai-Veretel 打醒。競技場在樓下。
Before fight... Must perform ritual. This challenge need respect. I do not respect you, human, but will show respect anyway.
打之前……必須行儀式。這場挑戰需要敬意。我不敬你，人類，但還是會表示敬意。
Hmh. Human probably trying end war to start with. Just on wrong side. Can agree, Zuett.
哼。人類本來大概就是想結束戰爭。只是站錯邊。可以同意，Zuett。
Give opportunity for human to learn and villager to show respect. They not attack, then will be open to more negotiation.
給人類學的機會，也給村民表示敬意的機會。他們不攻擊，就願意再談。
Peace first step to heal. ...unless villager keep doing stupid thing. Then may need fight anyway.
和平是療癒的第一步。……除非村民一直做笨事。那也許還是得打。
That's the cease-fire agreement! You need to hand this to Captain Goruca- He should be waiting in {p} still.
那就是停火協議！你得把這個交給 Goruca 隊長——他應該還在 {p} 等。
Maybe see human again soon. Hopefully in good spirit and on good faith.
也許很快會再見到人類。希望是帶著好心情和誠意。
Go on. Give to whatever villager need to see it. Let them learn.
去吧。給需要看的村民看。讓他們學。
...Think new thoughts. Difficult ones, from now on.
……想新的想法。難的那種，從現在開始。
Keep thinking too. Not just copy what see. Figure for self what good and bad.
也要繼續想。不要只照看到的做。自己想清楚什麼好什麼壞。
After the way they so savagely attacked our outpost and the way they've rebuffed our diplomacy squads, I wasn't expecting this.
他們那樣野蠻地襲擊我們的前哨站，又那樣回絕我們的外交小隊，我沒想到會是這樣。
You know, that one guy was going off about that orc catapult or whatever the entire time you were gone. He's shut up now, but criminy!
跟你說，你不在的那段時間，那個人一直在講什麼獸人投石機的。他現在閉嘴了，但天啊！
The cuts are closing underneath the balm, and his breathing is becoming more steady. Did you do it...?
傷口在藥膏底下慢慢癒合，他的呼吸也越來越平穩。你成功了嗎……？
...I am... What^s my...name...? I had one...
……我是……我的……名字……是什麼？我以前有名字的……
Re...remember!! WHAT IS MY NAME? My life?
想……想起來！！我的名字是什麼？我的人生呢？
REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!! No...no oives!
想起來！！不……不要命令！不要指想起來！！不……不要命令示想起來！！不……不要命令！
My name!! My life! I won't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PLEASE!
我的名字！！我的人生！我不會傷害他們！痛能讓我想起……誰在那裡？！走開！拜託！
NO MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE VOICES THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [ERROR]!! [ERROR]!! NOOO!!
別再有寒冷了！別再有不屬於我的聲音了！我的名字是 [ERROR]！！[ERROR]！！不要啊啊！！
Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [ERROR] ... Ma[ERROine... Madeleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-
正在……崩解……這不是我我我原本的樣子……我的……我的……我我我我我的名字是。曾是。是。曾是。是。是……！[ERROR]……Ma[ERROine……Madeleine！！我是 Madeleine……我……我-我-我我我我我我我我我——
Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
喔，那邊那位！我沒想到這裡會有人類士兵，不過你來得正是時候。我這兒正需要幫手。
I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
你應該知道守衛魔像吧？那是在 Gavel 這裡製造的，我最近買了一台。
The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
那些哥布林老是想跑到我的農田裡翻找東西——我需要點什麼把他們擋在外面，而魔像本來是最合適的。
But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
可是我才剛啟動它沒多久，那東西就攻擊我！我差點沒命——它一直拿自己去撞岩石和牆壁……
I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
我八成是買到瑕疵品了……那台魔像對周遭的一切都是威脅。你覺得你制伏得了它嗎？
It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
你看得出來，它一路上掉了不少碎片。拜託，順著那些碎片追過去，別讓它再傷到別人了！
Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的山中找到那台瑕疵的守衛魔像
找到那台瑕疵的守衛魔像
No directives!! Who did this?! I can't...s-stop giving me ORDERS!!
沒有指令！！這是誰幹的？！我沒辦法……住、住手，別再對我下命令了！！
Subdue the defective Guard Golem and return to Duvale at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
制伏那台瑕疵的守衛魔像，並回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 向 Duvale 回報
Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
你制伏那台魔像了嗎？看樣子你倒是全身而退。
Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
唉……真傷。你非得把它毀掉，我也不該覺得意外，但那筆投資就這樣白花了。
Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
不過話說回來……我第一次啟動它的時候，它好像就在講話了——等等，你也聽見了？
Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
嗯。仔細想想，那家工廠是有一些不太好聽的傳聞……說不定不是空穴來風。
It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
它說了一個名字？Madeleine？我完全沒印象，可是這……實在令人不安。我從來沒對它提過什麼 Madeleine。
This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to {p}- the factory is near there.
這件事真的該報給警方。我看我得寫封信到 {p} 去——那家工廠就在附近。
Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
在那之前，這個拿去。就當是你幫我的謝禮，勇敢的人類。外面路上小心。
...I am... What's my...name...? I had one...
……我是……我的……名字……是什麼？我以前有名字的……
Have you found any leads since I sent you to my contact, Daxe?
自從我讓你去找我的聯絡人 Daxe 之後，有查到什麼線索嗎？

Duvale mentioned rumors about an illegal factory in the swamp... If Daxe's criminal past had to do with this, maybe the [Mechanical Reactor] will cause him to react. Duvale mentioned he had spares, should they be needed.
Duvale 提過沼澤裡有座非法工廠的傳聞……如果 Daxe 的犯罪過往跟這件事有關，也許 [機械反應爐] 能讓他有所反應。Duvale 說他還留著備品，需要的話可以拿。
The guard golem left...but the reactor has stopped working.
守衛魔像離開了……但反應爐停止運轉了。
Go on, search my house. Or are you just here to waste my time?
去吧，搜我的屋子。還是說你來只是為了浪費我的時間？
So what is it? Have you made your decision?
Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. All missing...
Etan is the latest. You don't happen to know anything about these people, soldier?
Etan 是最新的一個。士兵，你該不會剛好知道這些人的下落吧？
Citizens are going missing at an alarming rate. We have lost {~} people in just {~} weeks. There hasn't been a trace of them anywhere.
市民失蹤的速度快得嚇人。短短 {~2} 週我們就少了 {~1} 個人。哪裡都找不到一絲線索。
You wouldn't have expected it, with all the guard golems we've been donated recently! {p} should be safer than ever.
照理說不該這樣的，我們最近才收到那麼多守衛魔像的捐贈！{p} 應該比以往都安全才對。
Of course I have my suspicions, there are rumors floating around about...shady business going on.
我當然有我的懷疑，外面一直有些傳聞……說有什麼見不得光的勾當。
I don't know who to trust in these circumstances, so if you would be willing to aid in this investigation, I'd be rather thankful.
這種情況下我不知道還能信誰，所以如果你願意幫忙查這件事，我會非常感激。
The “Great” Daxe is a man with a criminal past. He knows things the police don't, but he won't talk with me, given my status.
那位「偉大的」Daxe 有前科。他知道一些警方不知道的事，但礙於我的身分，他不會跟我開口。
Can you try to get some information from him? You can find his hut west from here. Next to that Elven girl's camp.
你能不能想辦法從他那裡問出點東西？他的小屋在這裡往西。就在那個精靈女孩的營地旁邊。
Follow the west road and speak with Daxe in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
沿著西邊的路走，到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的家裡跟 Daxe 說話
Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
喔，居然有人類想闖進偉大的 Daxe 家裡？
Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind.
很遺憾，我不喜歡訪客。我早就把犯罪的過去拋在腦後了。
So go on. I don't have anything to tell you.
所以你走吧。我沒什麼好跟你說的。
Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind...mh?
很遺憾，我不喜歡訪客。我早就把犯罪的過去拋在腦後了……嗯？
What's that device you have there? So you already know about this, then...?
你手上那個裝置是什麼？所以你已經知道這件事了……？
Hm! If you already know, what do you need the information for?
哼！你既然都知道了，還要那些情報做什麼？
MADELEINE! Where's...wait! What's happening, where am I? WHO'S VOICE IS THIS?!
MADELEINE！她在哪……等等！怎麼回事，我在哪裡？這是誰的聲音？！
Wait, what in the world is going on?! What did you do to my golem?!
等等，這到底是怎麼回事？！你對我的魔像做了什麼？！
They... my daughter... SHUT UP! QUIET! Who's giving me orders- NO ORDERS! Cold! COLD!
他們……我女兒……閉嘴！安靜！誰在對我下令——不准下令！好冷！好冷！
等等，你女兒？！M-Madeleine……？我……怎、怎麼會……什麼……？
You...you aren't...dead steel? You remember your name...?!
你……你不是……死鐵？你還記得自己的名字……？！
STOP GIVING ME ORDERS!! I'M...I'M THEODORE! I'M NOT A SERVANT! I...where has my life gone...? Where is...
別再對我下令了！！我是……我是 THEODORE！我不是僕人！我……我的人生跑到哪去了……？她在哪……
Madeleine... Where are you- RE-AFFIRMING DIRECTIVES. BZZT. ... ... ...
Madeleine……你在哪——重新確認指令。嗶滋。……………
I... I can't believe it. They didn't...they're still...
我……我不敢相信。他們沒有……他們還……
Dear god, that...that must...I'll talk. I will tell you what I know.
老天，那……那一定是……我說。我把我知道的都告訴你。
I broke into the golem factory for petty thievery...and found them. They gave me this Golem... Theodore...later to keep me quiet.
我為了偷點小東西闖進魔像工廠……然後發現了他們。他們後來給了我這具魔像……Theodore……是為了讓我閉嘴。
They assured me that they were gone, that every last bit of them was erased. They...those monsters lied to me...
他們向我保證那些人已經走了，說他們的每一分每一寸都被抹除乾淨了。他們……那些怪物騙了我……
Follow this road west and turn right. Look for Urelix. The factory is hidden in a cabin, it won't look like a factory.
沿著這條路往西走，然後右轉。找 Urelix。工廠藏在一間小木屋裡，外表看不出是工廠。
Head to the Golem Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Find a way to deactivate the Guard Golem
想辦法讓守衛魔像停機
And what do you think you are doing, barging into my humble home like this? Do they not teach humans manners in Wynn?
你以為你在做什麼，就這樣闖進我這間陋室？人類在 Wynn 都沒學過禮貌嗎？
Ah, yes. You are correct- I oversee the creation of Guard Golems. What of it?
啊，沒錯——守衛魔像的製造是我在督導的。那又如何？
Oh, you believe that our company is illicit somehow? You insult me so!
喔，你認為我們公司不乾淨？你這樣說可真傷人！
My golems have protected countless people for years. So if you think my company is corrupt, why don't you take a look around?
我的魔像保護過無數人，年復一年。你既然覺得我的公司腐敗，那不如自己四處看看？
Go on, search through my house. See if you can find anything.
去吧，把我家搜一遍。看你能找到什麼。
Find a way into the factory in Urelix's house
找出進入 Urelix 家中工廠的方法
Escape the Golem Factory and find Urelix.
逃出魔像工廠並找到 Urelix。
Initiating Chip Insertion Machine - All personell in machine be advised, avoid the spikes.
啟動晶片植入機——機內所有人員請注意，避開尖刺。
Intruder Detected - Emergency meltdown initiated. Please evacuate immediately via the emergency exit.
偵測到入侵者——已啟動緊急熔毀程序。請立即由緊急出口撤離。
Talk to Dr. Urelix in his office
到辦公室跟 Urelix 博士說話
Well well, look at you, here at the end of my factory. I wasn't expecting you to survive the production line. I thought you'd be one of ours by now.
哎呀哎呀，看看你，居然一路走到我工廠的盡頭。我沒想到你能從生產線活下來。我還以為你這時候已經是我們的一員了。
That's that, I suppose. Yes, this is indeed where all the iron golems you've ever encountered were made, and if you've gotten here, you know how we make them.
那就這樣吧。是的，你見過的每一具鐵魔像都是在這裡造出來的，而你既然走到了這裡，也就知道我們是怎麼造的了。
Yes, metal forged with flesh...an unbeatable combination. Emotions and memories must be repressed in order to maintain obedience, of course...
沒錯，金屬與血肉鍛在一起……無可匹敵的組合。當然，情緒與記憶必須壓制下去，才能維持順從……
Have you ever looked at a golem's eyes? Sometimes they look back, yes. The person they once were is still in there. I almost feel a connection when I make eye contact with them...
你有沒有看過魔像的眼睛？有時候它們會回望你。他們曾經是誰，那個部分還在裡面。跟他們對上眼的時候，我幾乎感覺得到一種連結……
It's odd, honestly. I'm sure they don't feel much except cold, supposing our safeguards stay in place, of course. I have to assume malfunctions happened to have had you find us out...
老實說很奇怪。只要我們的安全措施還在，我相信他們除了冷之外感覺不到什麼。我只能假設是出了什麼故障，你才會查到我們頭上……
Oh, look at me now, rambling! I must say I have been alone for a while...well, lacking any company that converses! So, I shall make you a deal, human.
噢，看看我，喋喋不休！我得說我一個人待了好一陣子了……嗯，是指沒有能對話的伴。所以，人類，我跟你做個交易。
I will give you a substantial amount of emeralds and a piece of quality iron armor in return for your silence on my little operation here.
我給你一大筆綠寶石，外加一件上等的鐵製護甲，換你對我這門小生意閉口不談。
I'll advise you to take my deal. Imagine what will happen if you should report my operation to the police. Yes, you'll save a few folk here, but how will the golems be made?
我勸你接受。想想看，你要是把我的事報給警方會怎麼樣。是的，你救得了這裡幾個人，但魔像要怎麼造？
Without them, both Gavel and Wynn would struggle under the weight of our wars. Is this operation so immoral, then? Sacrifices must be made in order to survive.
沒有魔像，Gavel 和 Wynn 都會被戰爭的重擔壓垮。那麼，這門生意真有那麼不道德嗎？要活下去，總得有所犧牲。
I'll give you some time to consider my proposition. Take from my chest if you wish to take up my offer, otherwise get out of here and do not return.
我給你一點時間考慮我的提議。想接受的話就從我的箱子裡拿，不然就滾出去，別再回來。
Either take the bribe or return to Detective Hart
接受賄賂，或回去找 Hart 偵探
Ahh, a wise choice. Production will continue then...and you've earned yourself a pocket full of emeralds at the same time.
啊，明智的選擇。那麼生產就會繼續下去……而你也順便替自己賺了滿口袋的綠寶石。
Whether you truly see things my way or simply understand that my work is necessary, I couldn't care less. What matters is not your morality, but your choice.
你是真的認同我的看法，還是只是明白我的工作有其必要，我一點都不在乎。重要的不是你的道德，而是你的選擇。
Enjoy your armor and money, and please escort yourself to the exit.
好好享受你的護甲和錢，請自行走向出口。
You've returned, I see. Any news on the situation?
你回來了。情況有什麼進展嗎？
Yes, we're aware of the Golem factory. Were the criminals using it as a base?

Me? Well, I've been making a little progress... but, nothing too big yet. I'm keeping at it, though!
我？嗯，我有一點小進展……不過還沒什麼大的。我還在努力就是了！
Oh, hello {u}. I'm probably not going to be here for long- I've been assigned to help defend {p} to the south.
哦，你好，{u}。我大概不會在這裡待太久——我被派去南邊協防 {p} 了。
You should come visit, if you have the chance!
你有機會的話該來看看！
I left me old sea farin' map in me old hideout, it'll tell ye where we can find me old gold.
俺把那張老航海圖留在老巢裡了，它會告訴你俺那些老金子藏在哪。
Me old hideout's hidden inside that there skull at the entrance to our mighty fine establishment. Bring me that map, lad!
俺的老巢就藏在咱們這間了不起的店門口那顆骷髏裡頭。把地圖給俺帶回來，小子！
I'm sorry, that's not enough money. Magic doesn't come cheap! Come back when you have [{~} Emerald Blocks] and we will aid you. Make sure to bring the [{~} Faded Map] too.
抱歉，這些錢不夠。魔法可不便宜！等你湊到 [{~} 塊綠寶石磚] 再來，我們就會幫你。記得也要把 [{~} 張褪色的地圖] 帶上。
We only hope that the boots will never fall into the hands of that pirate again, we'd much rather they fall into yours.
我們只希望那雙靴子別再落到那個海盜手裡，落在你手上要好得多。
Talk to Javier in the Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
前往 Pirate Cove [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Javier 對話
Garh, you look like a mighty fine adventurer, lad. But perhaps your pockets are a little lighter than you want, eh?
嘎，小子，你看起來是個相當了不得的冒險家。不過口袋大概比你想要的輕了點，嗯？
Perhaps we be making a deal, lad, and it'll make us both rich!
也許咱們可以做筆買賣，小子，讓咱們兩個都發財！
Ye see, lad, me treasure has been lost for quite some time, I kept it in a ocean village named Sarnfic, in a secret room.
你聽好，小子，俺的寶藏丟了好一陣子了，俺本來把它放在一個叫 Sarnfic 的海上村落，一間密室裡。
Argh, but lad. The village vanished out of nowhere! Like some kind of dark magic! I swears to ye, I tell no lies!
啊，可是小子。那村子憑空消失了！像是某種黑魔法！俺對你發誓，俺沒說半句謊！
So ye see, in me old age I could use a spot of me lawful gold to see me through me final years.
所以嘛，俺這把年紀，能拿回一點俺合法的金子撐過餘生也好。
Don't fret though, chuck, old Javier always kept a back up plan.
不過別急，老弟，老 Javier 向來留一手。
So, lad. Are ya willin' to make ye'self mighty wealthy? Good.
所以呢，小子。你願不願意讓自己發個大財？很好。
Find Javier's map, hidden in the skull tomb at the entrance of the island
在島嶼入口的骷髏墓中找到 Javier 的地圖
Halt it there, laddy! The wind has told us that yer looking for treasure map. Ah, ye'll not get it so easily.
站住，小子！風告訴俺們你在找藏寶圖。啊，沒那麼容易到手。
Ye see, us spirits are as greedy as our physical selves were. 'ere's no foolin' 'round there. We want yer money, and only then will we open the paths to the map.
告訴你，俺們這些亡魂跟生前一樣貪。這事沒得商量。俺們要你的錢，給了才會開通往地圖的路。
One full stack of emeralds will satisfy our needs. Go to the front of this tomb if ye have what we want.
一整組綠寶石就能滿足俺們。有俺們要的東西，就到這座墓的前頭來。
Good luck on that petty journey of yers. Just find the whole path, and yerself'll be just fine...
祝你那趟小小的旅程順利。把整條路走完，你就沒事了……
Argh, yer talented aren't you lad! Many thanks indeed, now we can see where me treasure be buried.
啊，小子你真有兩下子！太感謝了，這下咱們能看出俺的寶藏埋在哪了。
Hrmm, well, garr, blast it all
I canne read me own darn map, lad! What'dya do with it? Scratch off the ink with yer pennies?
俺看不懂俺自己的破地圖，小子！你對它做了什麼？拿銅板把墨刮掉了嗎？
Gar, sorry lad. It be the test of time that failed old Javier, not you.
嘎，抱歉啦小子。是歲月打敗了老 Javier，不是你。
Fear not, lad. There be an old friend of Javier's that can help decipher this old rag.
別怕，小子。Javier 有個老朋友能幫忙解讀這塊破布。
Go to the old {p}, there be a man by the name of Dalben who can restore me map to its former glory. Get it done lad, and bring me treasure back!
去那個老 {p}，有個叫 Dalben 的人能把俺的地圖修回原樣。把這事辦好，小子，把俺的寶藏帶回來！
Talk to Dalben on {p} about restoring the map
前往 {p} 與 Dalben 談修復地圖的事
What's this? A traveller? How might we assist you?
這是什麼？一位旅人？我們能為你效勞嗎？
Ah, I see, you wish to explore the ocean depths? But for what possible reason?
啊，我明白了，你想探索海洋深處？可是為了什麼呢？
This map... How did you acquire it? This is enchanted by our people.
這張地圖……你從哪弄來的？這是我們族人下的附魔。
You... You seek Sarnfic, don't you?
Alas, that place has history. We, the Mage Council, banished that city long ago to hide the horrific power hidden within a treasure a pirate hid there.
唉，那個地方有段過去。我們法師議會很久以前放逐了那座城，為的是藏起一名海盜留在那裡的寶物中那股可怕的力量。
A pair of boots, made from a black material fashioned from the stone of an evil place, incredibly dark magic. But we do not believe the filthy idiotic pirate knew what he'd found.
一雙靴子，用某個邪惡之地的石頭做成的黑色材質，帶著極深的黑魔法。不過我們相信那個骯髒的蠢海盜並不知道自己撿到了什麼。
I must say, we, the council regret having to lay waste an entire village over a pair of boots. There was no other way.
我必須說，我們議會很後悔為了一雙靴子毀掉整座村子。但當時別無他法。
Who knows why he even kept the boots. If he had known about their power, I'm sure he would have used it for evil. But we sense no evil in you, so as such we will aid you in your quest.
誰知道他為什麼還留著那雙靴子。他要是知道它的力量，我相信他會拿去作惡。但我們在你身上感覺不到惡意，所以我們願意協助你。
We hope that you will use the boots for good, despite the dark intentions. We will lift the enchantment once lain upon the charts, but it will cost you.
我們希望你會把那雙靴子用在正途，儘管它出身黑暗。我們會解除當年下在圖上的附魔，不過這要收費。
Give me [{~} Emerald Blocks], that should cover the cost.
給我 [{~} 塊綠寶石磚]，這樣就夠了。
Bring back [{~} Blocks of Emerald] to Dalben
把 [{~} 塊綠寶石磚] 帶回給 Dalben
Brilliant. That seems in order. Here you go.
很好。這樣沒問題了。給你。
Well? What does it say? Go to that location! Find the treasure!
如何？上面寫了什麼？到那個地方去！找到寶藏！
Explore the cave in the ocean, located at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Find [{~} Ocean Treasure] and bring it back to Javier in Pirate Cove
找到 [{~} 海洋寶藏] 並帶回 Pirate Cove 交給 Javier
Gnar, you did it lad! Ye brought back old Javiers gold! And as I promised, heres yer share of the loot.
嘎哈，小子你辦到了！你把老 Javier 的金子帶回來了！照俺答應的，這是你的那一份。
I threw in something extra for ye. It's an old key I salvaged a few years back, from the shipwreck of a legendary pirate.
俺還多塞了個東西給你。那是幾年前俺從一位傳奇海盜的沉船上撈到的舊鑰匙。
Who knows what it leads to? Maybe a treasure hoard, or maybe the ol' swashbuckler wanted to lead someone into a trap.
誰知道它通往哪呢？也許是一座寶庫，也許那老海賊只是想引人掉進陷阱。
Me bones are too old for a grand adventure like that, guess ye'll have to figure it out for yerself.
俺這把老骨頭經不起那種大冒險了，看來你只能自己去弄清楚囉。
Speak to Irlok in the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Welcome to Bantisu Temple, traveler. We guide lost souls onwards, be they wandering men to town or spirits unable to exit the canyon.
歡迎來到 Bantisu 神殿，旅人。我們引導迷失的靈魂前行——無論是迷路進城的人，或是走不出峽谷的亡靈。
However, recently our job has become much more difficult. The canyon shakes, and changes. Often, long-buried creatures are released as the walls shift.
然而近來，我們的工作變得困難許多。峽谷震動、變形。岩壁移位時，常有埋藏已久的生物被釋放出來。
And unfortunately, the worst has come to pass, that one of these creatures is hostile. The Bantisu monks of old collapsed the entrance to its cave to seal it away...
而不幸的是，最壞的情況發生了: 其中一頭生物懷有敵意。昔日的 Bantisu 僧侶曾崩毀他洞穴的入口，將他封住……
...but the rubble has shifted, and the cave is open once more. We were not strong enough to defeat it then, and we are not strong enough to defeat it now.
……但碎石移了位，洞口再度敞開。當年我們沒有足以擊敗他的力量，如今也一樣沒有。
Even trying to collapse the cave again has ended in failure, for the beast, Krolton, slays our mages and demolitionists in but an instant.
就連再次崩塌洞穴的嘗試也以失敗告終——那頭野獸 Krolton，能在轉瞬之間屠盡我們的法師與爆破手。
However, the word on the wind tells tales of humans doing the impossible as a matter of rote. Krolton must be dealt with before it leaves the cave- I beg your assistance!
不過，風中傳來的話語說，人類總是把不可能的事當成家常便飯。Krolton 必須在他離開洞穴之前解決掉——我懇求你的協助！
We've no time to spare. I will prepare a short spell to bring you to the cave- Please, wait outside, and prepare yourself.
我們沒有時間可以浪費。我會準備一道短咒把你送到洞穴——請在外頭稍候，做好準備。
Seek out the creature in the mines at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
I apologize for the suddenness of this, but you must understand the urgency. We have no way of knowing when Krolton may emerge.
事出突然，我深感抱歉，但你必須理解這有多急迫。我們無從得知 Krolton 何時可能現身。
We will pray for your safety, and that your spirit will not become among those we must guide out of the canyon.
我們會為你的平安祈禱，也祈禱你的魂魄不會成為我們必須引出峽谷的其中之一。
那麼，站穩了，祝你一路順利！！
Explore the strange realm and bargain with Death.
探索這片奇異的領域，並與死神交涉。
SO THAT IS YOUR FIRST INSTINCT? TO CLIMB THE VALLEY WALLS IN FRUITLESS SEARCH OF AN ESCAPE?
所以這就是你的第一個念頭？攀上谷壁，徒勞地尋找出路？
AMUSING. BUT THIS IS WHERE YOU MUST BE. TAKE ALL THE TIME YOU LIKE, THOUGH. I WILL WAIT FOR YOU TO COME TO MY MANOR.
有趣。但這裡正是你該在的地方。不過，你想花多少時間都可以。我會等你自己走到我的宅邸來。
SO MY MANSION IS DULL ENOUGH YOU'D RATHER GO ROCK CLIMBING?
這麼說來，我的宅邸無聊到讓你寧可去攀岩？
OR DID I SIMPLY SCARE YOU OFF SAYING SUCH SERIOUS THINGS?
還是說，我把話講得太嚴肅，把你嚇跑了？
NEVERTHELESS, YOU WILL BE BACK EVENTUALLY. THERE IS NOTHING FOR ANYONE OUT THERE.
無論如何，你終究會回來的。外頭什麼也沒有，對誰都一樣。
IT SEEMS I HAVE A NEW GUEST. WELCOME.
看來我有位新客人了。歡迎。
MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE. YOU'LL BE STAYING HERE FOR A WHILE.
請隨意。你會在這裡待上一陣子。
NOTHING IS STOPPING YOU FROM TAKING A LOOK AROUND. DON'T TOUCH ANYTHING THOUGH. AND TAKE OFF YOUR SHOES AS YOU ENTER.
沒有人攔著你四處看看。不過什麼都別碰。還有，進門請脫鞋。
WHEN YOU FEEL LIKE IT, COME TO MY OFFICE UPSTAIRS. WE HAVE A LENGTHY TALK TO HAVE.
等你想好了，就到樓上我的辦公室來。我們有很多話要談。
THIS IS WHERE I SERVE MEALS TO MY GUESTS. THEY GIVE SUCH GLOWING REVIEWS.
這裡是我招待客人用餐的地方。他們給的評價向來極好。
AFTER ALL, IT IS SAID ONE'S LAST MEAL IS THE SWEETEST, SO HAVING ANOTHER AFTER THAT IS SURELY TO DIE FOR. AH HA HA.
畢竟人們都說，最後一餐總是最甜的——那麼在那之後再吃一餐，想必是死也值得。啊哈哈。
IF I HAD BOUGHT ANY FLOUR THIS MORNING, I WOULD HAVE OFFERED A BISCUIT FOR DYING. I'M TOLD I MAKE THE BEST CHOCOLATE CHIP ONES.
今天早上我要是帶了麵粉來，就能請你吃塊餅乾，當作往生的賀禮。聽說我做的巧克力豆餅乾是最好吃的。
BUT ALAS. WE WILL HAVE TO CONTENT OURSELVES WITH A LAST DRINK FOR THE DEPARTED INSTEAD. I'LL PUT THE KETTLE ON.
可惜沒有。那我們只好以敬亡者的最後一杯將就了。我去燒水。
THIS SECTION OF THE MANSION IS UNDERGOING RENOVATIONS. FOR THE TIME BEING, IT GOES EMPTY.
宅邸的這一區正在整修。目前先空著。
SOULS DO LINGER HERE. LINGERING EVER LONGER THAN BEFORE. AND WITH SO MANY ARRIVING...
魂魄確實會在此地滯留。而且滯留得比從前更久。加上來的人又這麼多……
IT IS, PERHAPS, A POINTLESS COMFORT TO GIVE. BUT I FEEL A GUEST ROOM WOULD BE APPRECIATED, UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES.
這或許是個毫無意義的體貼。但在這種情況下，我想有間客房總是好的。
PERHAPS GROWING THINGS IN A PLACE LIKE THIS IS A FOOL'S ERRAND.
在這樣的地方種東西，或許是件蠢事。
IF IT IS, THEN I WILL MERRILY JINGLE MY BELLS AS I WATER THEM. IT IS FLEETING JOY TO CARE FOR THEM, BUT A JOY NONETHELESS.
若真是如此，那我會一邊愉快地搖著我的鈴鐺，一邊替它們澆水。照顧它們的喜悅雖然短暫，但終究是喜悅。
THESE ARE BUSHES. NOTHING YOU DON'T ALREADY KNOW.
這些是灌木。沒有什麼你不知道的。
WELCOME TO MY LIBRARY. I FIND MY GUESTS ARE DRAWN TO HERE. PERHAPS IT IS BECAUSE KNOWLEDGE IS POWER, AS I HAVE BEEN TOLD.
歡迎來到我的圖書室。我發現客人們總是被這裡吸引。也許是因為——如同我聽說的——知識就是力量。
ALTHOUGH, GIVEN SO MANY OF MY BOOKS ARE WRITTEN IN DEAD LANGUAGES, THERE IS LITTLE POWER TO BE FOUND HERE.
不過，既然我的藏書有那麼多是用死去的語言寫成的，這裡能找到的力量恐怕不多。
BUT I WILL NEVER BEGRUDGE A GUEST A REPRIEVE, HOWEVER MOMENTARY. MORTALITY CAN BE A HARSH LESSON.
但我絕不會吝於給客人一段喘息，無論那有多短暫。凡人之身，本就是一堂嚴厲的課。
IT SEEMS YOU REALLY WANTED TO KNOW WHAT WAS BEHIND THIS DOOR.
看來你真的很想知道這扇門後面有什麼。
I GUESS YOU WILL GET WHAT YOU WANTED...
那你大概是如願以償了……
DO YOU REALLY THINK IT WAS WORTH YOUR TIME?
你真覺得這值得你花這些時間嗎？
AH, I SEE YOU HAVE DISCOVERED THE HOURGLASSES. I SUPPOSE IT IS ONLY NATURAL THEY WOULD DRAW YOUR ATTENTION.
啊，我看你發現那些沙漏了。它們會吸引你的注意，也是自然的事。
EACH ONE MEASURES THE LIFE OF A BEING. WHEN ALL THE SAND REACHES THE BOTTOM, I RECEIVE A NEW GUEST.
每一只都在丈量一個存在的生命。當沙全部落到底部，我就會迎來一位新客人。
BUT A MEASURED LIFESPAN IS NOT A GUARANTEE. IT IS ONLY AN ESTIMATE. THE RATE OF THE HOURGLASS WILL SHIFT IN RESPONSE TO ANY NUMBER OF FACTORS.
但被丈量出來的壽命並非保證。那只是個估計。沙漏的流速會因為無數種因素而改變。
I AM SURE WE COULD FIND YOURS, IF WE SEARCHED HARD ENOUGH. BUT I FIND MOST VISITORS STRUGGLE TO GRAPPLE WITH SUCH A TANGIBLE DISPLAY.
只要找得夠仔細，我相信我們能找到你的那一只。不過我發現，大多數訪客很難承受這麼具體的呈現。
THIS ONE... IT IS SPECIAL. IT DISPLAYS SOMETHING FAR MORE IMPORTANT THAN INDIVIDUAL LIFESPANS.
這一只……很特別。它顯示的東西，遠比個別的壽命重要得多。
IT IS HERE TO MEASURE HOW MUCH TIME THE WORLD HAS LEFT.
它是用來丈量這個世界還剩下多少時間的。
AS WITH THE OTHERS, IT IS MERELY AN ESTIMATE. IT HAS BEEN SLOWED AND HALTED IN THE PAST.
和其他的一樣，那也只是個估計。它曾經被減緩過，也曾經被停下過。
BUT I FEAR THE COMING END IS INEVITABLE. IT WAS SET IN MOTION LONG, LONG AGO, BY ACTORS BEYOND THE BOTH OF US.
但我擔心，將至的終局是無可避免的。它在很久、很久以前就被推動了，推動者遠非你我所能及。
I KEEP IT AS A REMINDER. TO CHERISH WHAT STILL IS LEFT. BEFORE IT, TOO, IS LOST.
我留著它，是為了提醒自己珍惜還留下來的一切。在那些也消逝之前。
PLEASE REFRAIN FROM TOUCHING ANY OF MY JARS. I KEEP THINGS VERY DEAR TO ME IN THEM.
請不要碰我的任何一個罐子。我把非常珍視的東西都收在裡面。
PARTICULARLY MY JAR OF SOIL. THAT IS A SOUVENIR FROM VERY, VERY LONG AGO.
尤其是我那罐泥土。那是很久、很久以前的紀念品。
I HAVE NO NEED FOR SLEEP. SO, MY BEDROOM NOW SERVES MERELY A SYMBOLIC PURPOSE.
我不需要睡眠。所以我的臥室如今只剩象徵意義。
SYMBOLIC OF WHAT, YOU ASK? MY LOVING MARRIAGE. JUST BECAUSE I DO NOT HAVE A HEART, IT DOES NOT MEAN I CANNOT LOVE.
你問象徵什麼？象徵我美滿的婚姻。我沒有心，並不代表我不能愛。
"TIL DEATH DO US PART" IS FOR QUITTERS, I SAY. I WILL LOVE HER BEYOND THE END OF TIME ITSELF.
「至死方休」那套是給半途而廢的人用的，我是這麼認為。我會愛她，直到時間本身終結之後。
THESE DAYS, THE CATS LAY CLAIM TO THE BED FOR THE MOST PART. AT LEAST SOMEONE IS GETTING USE OUT OF IT, IN THE END.
這些日子，那張床大半被貓佔去了。至少到頭來還有誰在用它。
THIS IS THE DARK LORD, SNUGGLEBUNS. GREET HIM WITH RESPECT, WITH A PAT ON THE HEAD AND A SCRATCH UNDER THE CHIN.
這位是黑暗領主，Snugglebuns。請以敬意問候他: 摸摸他的頭，再搔搔他的下巴。
HE IS A GUEST, MUCH LIKE YOURSELF. UNLIKE YOU, HOWEVER, HE HAS BEEN HERE A VERY LONG TIME.
他和你一樣是客人。不過與你不同的是，他已經待了非常久。
HE IS ONE OF THE MORE STUBBORN BEASTS I HAVE ENCOUNTERED ACROSS THESE EONS. YOU SEE, HE IS WAITING FOR SOMEONE TO CROSS OVER. MUCH LIKE MYSELF, HE CAN BE VERY PATIENT.
他是我在這些永劫之中遇過最固執的野獸之一。你要知道，他在等某個人渡過來。跟我一樣，他可以非常有耐心。
TOO PATIENT FOR HIS OWN GOOD, PERHAPS.
或許耐心得對他自己沒有好處。
...I DO NOT HAVE THE HEART TO TELL HIM THE TRUTH. AND SO, AS THE YEARS PASS, HIS CLAIM ON MY HOME CONTINUES TO GROW.
……我沒有那個心告訴他真相。於是隨著年歲流逝，他在我家的地盤愈來愈大。
AND I ALLOW IT. I FIND HIS COMPANIONSHIP WORTH THE HASSLE.
而我允許了。我覺得有他作伴，這點麻煩是值得的。
IT MAY NOT SEEM AS SUCH FROM YOUR PERSPECTIVE. BUT LIFE IS LIMITED. STILL, SOULS PASS THROUGH THE CYCLE, AND THE WORLD KEEPS ON SPINNING.
從你的角度看或許不是那樣。但生命是有限的。即便如此，魂魄會通過輪迴，而世界繼續轉動。
...THEY WERE NOT MEANT TO BE LOST. TO PASS BEYOND MY REACH, TO REACH AN END SOMEWHERE I CANNOT FIND THEM.
……他們本不該迷失。不該越過我所能觸及之處，在某個我找不到的地方走到盡頭。
