While we’re on the subject of milk, do you know some folks can’t drink it? Oh, yes, they can try, but sooner or later their belly will protest.
既然講到牛奶，你知道有些人是喝不了牛奶的嗎？噢，是啦，他們可以試，可是遲早他們的肚子會抗議。
It’s the same deal with bread! Stick with whole-grain, nothin’ added. That way, you don’t have to worry about surprise milk appearances and whatnot.
麵包也是同一回事！就守著全穀，什麼都別加。這樣你就不用擔心牛奶突然冒出來之類的事。
You got that? Let me know when you’re ready for more. Say, you know what? I oughta talk a bit slower to help you digest what I’m sayin’. Oh! “Digest”! I did it again! Heheh...
懂了嗎？準備好聽更多就跟我說。話說回來，不如這樣？我大概該講慢一點，好幫助你消化我說的話。噢！「消化」！我又來了！嘿嘿……
Right, then, somethin’ that really peeves me is people who use bakin’ powder. What’s wrong with some good ol’ yeast?
好，那麼，真正讓我火大的是那些用泡打粉的人。好端端的酵母是哪裡不好了？
Too little of it, and it’ll go plum flat in the oven. Just a little too much of it, and your bread’s going to be as bitter as wormwood!
放太少，它在烤箱裡就會扁得像塊板子。只要放得稍微多一點點，你的麵包就會苦得像苦艾！
The only way to get a size that’s just right is the long way! Wait until the yeast works its magic, and bake it right as it reaches its good size.
要得到剛剛好的大小，唯一的方法就是慢慢來！等酵母施展它的魔法，在它剛好長到好尺寸的時候下去烤。
There’s also nothin’ quite like the smell of yeast as it causes the dough to rise! Works up quite the appetite, it does.
而且沒有什麼比得上酵母讓麵團發起來時的那股香氣！那可真是能勾出食慾。
Some people put the cart before the horse and think that yeast works like bakin' powder. Try that, and you'll end up with some scorchin'-hot bricks in your oven.
有些人本末倒置，以為酵母的作用跟泡打粉一樣。試試看，你烤箱裡就會多出幾塊滾燙的磚頭。
No, you have to do it right, and doin’ it right means leavin’ some of the work to the yeast.
不行，你得照規矩來，而照規矩來就代表把一部分的工作留給酵母。
Unless you like flat breads. I can’t see why anyone would, though. Bread’s supposed to be puffy and chewy, not some dough jerky!
除非你喜歡扁麵包。不過我實在想不通有誰會喜歡。麵包本來就該是蓬鬆有嚼勁的，不是什麼麵團肉乾！
Though that may not be the case for some other pastries. For one, I've never once heard of a pie with a chewy crust.
不過對其他點心來說或許不是這樣。舉例來說，我從來沒聽過有哪種派的外皮是有嚼勁的。
Really, the beauty in bread lies with its simplicity! No complicated steps, no chances for the dough to rebel. Certainly not as fickle as somethin' like a cream puff.
說真的，麵包的美就在它的簡單！沒有複雜的步驟，麵團也沒有機會造反。絕不像泡芙那種東西那麼難伺候。

If you treat the dough with respect, the bread will respect you in turn. It’s simple stuff, really! No finnickin’ around with stiff peaks, or needin’ half a dozen bowls to mix in, or getting a flaky dough just right, or...
你尊重麵團，麵團就會回過頭來尊重你。真的很單純！不用去搞什麼硬性發泡、不用準備半打攪拌盆、不用把酥皮弄得剛剛好，或是……
...and not to mention that just about everythin’ needs butter in some shape or form! Really, what’s with it? It’s not like the stuff grows on trees!
……更別提幾乎每樣東西都得用上某種形式的奶油！說真的，這是怎麼回事？那玩意兒又不是樹上長出來的！
Makin’ the pastry shiny. Makin’ it taste rich. Makin’ the dough thick. There’s no end to it! Bread’s so much simpler to handle.
讓點心亮晶晶。讓它吃起來濃郁。讓麵團變厚。沒完沒了！麵包好處理太多了。
Though some people insist upon putin' butter in the bread. Not just on it, but in it! There's more butter than bread at that point!
不過有些人偏偏堅持要把奶油放進麵包裡。不是抹在上面，是放進去！到那個地步，奶油都比麵包多了！
I don’t have anythin’ against butter itself, mind you. It’s great on toast! Just I think it oughta stay on the toast rather than in it.
我倒不是跟奶油本身有仇，你別誤會。它抹在吐司上很棒！只是我覺得它該待在吐司上，而不是待在吐司裡。

Not to mention that there’s a time, place, and occasion for it. If you put butter on everythin’, you’re goin’ to get sick of it real quickly. Eat it in moderation! Your tongue and your emerald pouch will thank you.
更別提凡事都有個時間、地點和場合。你要是什麼都抹奶油，很快就會膩到不行。適量就好！你的舌頭和你的綠寶石袋都會謝謝你。
Of course, there’s always margarine, but why settle for somethin’ inferior? You shouldn’t settle for anythin’ less than the quality you’d expect from your bread!
當然，還有人造奶油這個選項，但何必將就次等貨？你不該將就任何低於你對麵包所期待的品質。
Though, now that I look at it, bread does get a reputation for bein’ a breakfast food. That’s ridiculous! It’s got a place in every meal of the day!
不過話說回來，現在想想，麵包確實被貼上了早餐食物的標籤。荒謬！它在一天的每一餐裡都有位置！
Sandwiches? They’ve got bread in ‘em. Casseroles? Any respectable one has it as a shell. Breadsticks? It’s in the name for cryin’ out loud!
三明治？裡面有麵包。焗烤？任何像樣的焗烤都拿它當底。麵包棒？名字裡就有了，拜託！

Done right, and it’s also great as a side. I already mentioned having a fresh-ground fresh-baked loaf of whole-grain with a slab of flat-iron steak, but really, a well-sliced loaf and some dippin’ butter can transform a family dinner into a banquet!
做得好的話，它當配菜也很棒。我剛剛已經提過現磨現烤的全穀麵包配一塊平底鍋煎牛排，但說真的，一條切得漂亮的麵包加一點沾的奶油，就能把一頓家常晚餐變成一場盛宴！
They’re almost as versatile as potatoes! Actually, even more so, I’d say!
它們幾乎跟馬鈴薯一樣百變！其實，我會說還更勝一籌！
As my pappy liked to say, a real man’s got to earn his daily bread through his own toilin’. As you can see, I’ve taken his advice to heart!
我老爹愛說，真男人得靠自己勞動掙來每日的麵包。你也看得出來，我把他的話牢牢記在心上了！
...I feel that I’m missin’ somethin’ important that I wanted to discuss. Hang on for a bit, would you?
……我覺得我漏掉了什麼重要的、想講的東西。你等我一下，好嗎？
Ah, of course! I can’t believe that I forgot! I wanted to cover some thoughts about bread consistency.
啊，當然！我真不敢相信我居然忘了！我想談談關於麵包一致性的幾點想法。
Namely, the two extremes: too chewy and not chewy enough. I already spoke on hardly chewy bread plenty, but there's such a thing as too much of a good thing.
也就是那兩個極端: 太有嚼勁，和不夠有嚼勁。幾乎沒嚼勁的麵包我已經講很多了，但好東西也有過頭的時候。
And in this case, bread chewiness is a good thing. You don’t want your bread to be too chewy, got it?
而在這件事上，麵包的嚼勁是好東西。你不會想要你的麵包太有嚼勁，懂了嗎？
Too chewy’s a step right towards bread that’s outright rubbery. Your teeth’ll bounce right off it!
太有嚼勁就離「乾脆變成橡膠」只差一步。你的牙會直接彈回來！
Sure, too much give in the dough’s awkward and sets you up for bitin’ your own tongue, but too firm of a loaf can lead to much of the same.
是啦，麵團太軟很難處理，還會讓你咬到自己的舌頭，可是太硬的一條也會落得差不多的下場。
They always say never bite off more than you could chew, but you oughta be careful not to bite off any less than that, either!
大家老是說別咬下超過你能嚼的量，但你也該小心別咬得比那還少！
No, just right and chewy’s what you want. Don’t settle for anything more or less!
不，剛剛好、有嚼勁，那才是你要的。不要多也不要少，別將就！
Hmm, come to think. You seem really interested in discussin’ bread with me!
唔，說起來。你好像真的很有興趣跟我討論麵包！
Lean in for a second, would you? I’ve got somethin’ important to say.
靠過來一下，好嗎？我有件重要的事要說。
Listening? Right! Ah, sorry, I didn’t mean to shout in your ear.
在聽嗎？好！啊，抱歉，我不是故意對著你耳朵吼的。
You’re just about the only person that I’ve been able to have an honest conversation about bread with.
你大概是唯一一個能跟我好好聊麵包的人。

Usually, bread gets brushed off as some kind of dull fodder. Dismissed as too borin’ and too plain, I tell you! That’s what leads to unnecessary excess as people try to make it into something that it’s not.
平常麵包總是被當成某種無聊的飼料打發掉。被說成太無趣、太平淡，我跟你說！就是那樣才會讓人們硬要把它變成它不是的東西，搞出一堆不必要的花樣。
But us? We’re different, we’re visionaries, and we know the truth about what really makes a good loaf!
但我們呢？我們不一樣，我們是有遠見的人，我們知道一條好麵包真正的祕密！
Tell ‘em off, I say! They can’t follow the thoughts of bread enthusiasts like you and I otherwise!
我說，把他們罵回去！不然他們永遠跟不上像你我這樣的麵包愛好者的思路！
Ah! Right, never did I get to answerin’ your question. About my favorite type of bread, that is...
啊！對了，我一直都沒回答你的問題。就是我最喜歡哪一種麵包，那個問題……
就是最單純的粗磨小麥。
Sure, it may be simple, but if you were payin’ any attention at all, you’d know for sure why that’s everythin’ that I’m lookin’ for.
是啦，它或許很簡單，但你要是剛剛有在專心聽，你一定知道為什麼那正是我想要的一切。
And that just about sums up the basics! Let me know if you want to hear anythin’ more.
以上大概就是基礎了！想聽更多的話再跟我說。
Let’s continue! Have you ever seen a baker wearin’ a fancy hat? Have you ever wondered how that corresponds to how well they bake bread compared to somethin’ else?
我們繼續！你有沒有看過戴著花俏帽子的麵包師傅？你有沒有想過，那跟他們烤麵包、烤別的東西的本事有什麼關係？
Hah! That crazy coot, you're chattin' with that feller?
哈！那個老瘋子，你在跟那傢伙聊天？
He's wack-o, y'know... Singing his songs all day, somethin's not right upstairs.
他腦子有問題，你知道吧……整天唱他那些歌，上面那顆腦袋不太對勁。
You do you, buddy, but I'd steer clear.
隨你啦，老兄，不過要我說，離遠一點比較好。
A parrot? You know where you are, right?
一隻鸚鵡？你知道自己在哪裡吧？
I see plenty parrots everyday, I don't keep track.
我每天看到的鸚鵡多得是，我哪記得住。
I'll keep an eye or two out for one, though, sound peachy?
不過我會幫你留意一兩眼啦，這樣行吧？
IT'S IN T-THE TREE, HERE! IT'S HERE!!!
他在樹、樹上，這裡！他就在這裡！！！
登上 Relend 的船出航。
You have the map! Thank you for the assistance!
你把地圖拿到手了！感謝你出手相助！
Now let us set sail, and cover some distance!
那就揚帆啟航，往遠方趕路！
I'm sorry, new friend, to be of haste!
抱歉啊新朋友，我催得急了些！
However I sense power in you, and we have no time to waste!
可我在你身上感到力量，一刻也不能歇！
So off we go, to find an old friend, that would be ideal.
那就出發吧，去尋一位老友，那該有多好！
I'll captain the ship up at the steering wheel.
這艘船由我掌舵，你就在旁邊瞧一瞧！
Speak to Captain Relend aboard the Little Wing.
在 Little Wing 上與 Relend 船長談話。
Welcome aboard, I suppose I can consider you my first mate. Although, it appears we now have a problem on our plate.
歡迎上船，你就當我的大副吧，正好。只是我們眼前，似乎攤上了麻煩不小。
You see those spikes all around my boat? Well, we're about to ram into them like a goat!
看見我船邊那一圈尖刺了嗎，滿滿一排？我們就要像頭山羊一樣一頭撞過去，躲不開！
I'd steer around them, but it appears the wheel is all smashed. I need you to craft a new one before we both get splashed!
我本想繞開，可惜舵輪已經碎成了渣。你得趕快做一個新的，免得我倆一起餵魚蝦！
There's a Crafting Table at the front near all the crates. Now hurry up, else the ocean floor awaits!
船頭那堆木箱旁有張工作台，就在那邊。快些動手，否則海底就在眼前！
Bring a [Wooden Board], a [Center Piece], and a [String] to the Crafting Table
把一塊 [木板]、一個 [中心零件] 和一條 [繩子] 帶到工作台
Bring the [Steering Wheel] to Captain Relend.
把 [舵輪] 交給 Relend 船長。
Ah, thank you for helping me in my time of need. Let's maneuver through these spikes at a steady speed!
啊，多謝你在我最需要的時候伸出手來。我們就穩穩地從這些尖刺之間穿過，別求快！
Although, at the last minute, there is something I have to confess. I have never captained a ship with any success.
不過臨到最後，有件事我不得不講。我這輩子掌船，從來沒有一次像樣。
I think before we get into any real danger, we should turn around. Could you man the wheel and get us back to solid ground?
我想在真正出事之前，我們該掉頭返航。你能不能來掌舵，帶我們回到陸地上？
Man the wheel of the Little Wing.
掌起 Little Wing 的舵。
Now you're the captain, hope the sea's not making you nauseous. Steer this ship, but you'll have to be cautious!
現在你是船長了，但願這海沒把你晃得想吐。掌好這艘船，可千萬要看清楚路！
Nice steering, although your maneuvers are a bit brash. Hey, watch out! I think we're about to-
掌得不錯，雖然你的動作有點莽撞。欸，小心！我看我們就要撞上——
Find Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
在 Little Wing 的殘骸裡找到 Relend。
As you can see, my ship has become a shipwreck! Now please help me, I am trapped in the lower deck!
如你所見，我的船已經成了一堆殘骸！快來幫幫我，我被困在下層甲板出不來！
Amazing work, seems you got below deck rather quickly! You're going to have to get through this wreckage to free me!
了不起，看來你下到甲板底下的速度相當快！你得先穿過這堆殘骸，才能把我放出來！
Wow, so you managed to work your way through after all! Maybe to free me, you can use that cannonball?
哇，你居然真的一路闖了過來，真不簡單！要放我出去，也許可以試試那顆砲彈？
Save Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
在 Little Wing 的殘骸裡救出 Relend。
Thank you for freeing me, now let's leave this mess! Although, I don't know how to do that, I have not even a guess.
謝謝你救我出來，這團亂咱們趕緊離開！只是該怎麼離開，我連猜都猜不出來。
When the ship crashed, it was buried beneath the sand! But the good news is that we're finally back on land!
船撞上去的時候，整艘都被埋進了沙裡！好消息是，我們總算又踩到了土地！
We should probably get out of this place, it feels rather small. Perhaps you can try to break through that weak spot in the wall?
這裡實在太窄，我們八成得另尋出口。也許牆上那處薄弱的地方，你可以動動手？
It looks like we're going to be stuck here for a while. Come and speak to me so we can find a way off of this isle!
看樣子我們得在這兒困上好一陣子，走不了。過來跟我談談，一起想個辦法離開這座島！
Speak to Relend on the beach.
在海灘上與 Relend 談話。
Gateway Island... we've finally arrived. I'm just thankful that we survived.
Gateway Island……我們總算平安抵達。我只慶幸我們還活著，沒被浪打垮。
Well, all this adventuring has me hungry for stew. We'll need ingredients, whatever's on the island will have to do.
這一路冒險下來，我餓得想喝一鍋燉湯。食材得自己找，島上有什麼就將就著上。
Meat is definitely something we need to reap, try and get [{~} Raw Mutton] from those sheep.
肉是絕對少不了的，這點你我都明白。去那些綿羊那兒弄 [{~} Raw Mutton] 回來。
And perhaps you could get [{~} Edible Mushrooms] from the western cave, just make sure not to get the kind that will send me to my grave.
西邊那個洞窟裡，也許能採到 [{~} Edible Mushrooms] 幾朵。千萬別採到會把我送進墳墓的那種，別搞錯。
I feel like something is missing from this medley. Oh, how about you get [{~} Coconut] from atop that tree?
我總覺得這鍋雜燴還少了點什麼，奇怪。噢，不如你去那棵樹頂上摘 [{~} Coconut] 下來？
And if you could fetch [{~} Berries], that would just make me merry!
要是你能再摘些 [{~} Berries] 回來，那我可就樂開懷！
Check your content book if you ever need a recap. And to make sure you don't get lost, take the map.
忘了要拿什麼，就翻翻你的綜合手冊，別慌。還有，為了不讓你迷路，這張地圖你帶上。
Give the Odd Stew to Relend.
把那鍋古怪的燉湯交給 Relend。
Well, this stew has a rather odd flavour. But any food we can get here I shall savour.
唔，這鍋湯的味道實在有些古怪。不過在這島上有得吃，我都當作美味來愛。
What remains of my ship won't protect us very well. We'll need to find shelter, as you can clearly tell.
我那艘船剩下的殘骸，護不了我們周全。我們得找個能遮風避雨的地方，你也看得見。
To the east, I can just barely make out a tent. Go and look for my friend there, I'm simply hellbent!
往東邊看，我依稀辨得出一頂帳篷的影。去那兒找找我的朋友，我心意已定，絕不停！
Check out the tent to the east.
So the tent was all empty and run-down? All of this bad news is making me frown.
所以那帳篷是空的，而且早就破敗不堪？這一連串壞消息，讓我眉頭深鎖、心裡難安。
Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
你的地圖借我看一下，就一會兒工夫。我想我們得換個地方找他，另尋門路。
I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can craft an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
我相信憑我們的腦袋，總能想出個辦法來。也許可以做個炸藥，把那塊大石轟開！
Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
來想想這島上有哪些材料可以用上。只怕這座島上，東西少得不像樣……
First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
首先我們需要 [{~} Gritty Sand]，這樣東西不能少。去哪弄？到島後面那片海灘上找找。
Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
接下來是 [Sawdust]，你得弄到三份。我想最好的去處，是島上那棵最大的樹身。
Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
最後是 [{~} Black Powder]，藏在一個相當特別的地方。你得鼓起勇氣，一路爬上火山的頂上。
You'll need those items to craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your content book.
做炸彈要用的就是這幾樣，該去哪找我都講了一遍。萬一忘了要找什麼，綜合手冊翻開就看得見。
Bring [{~} Gritty Sand], [{~} Saw Dust], and [{~} Black Powder] to the Crafting Table
把 [{~} 份 Gritty Sand]、[{~} 份 Saw Dust] 和 [{~} 份 Black Powder] 帶到工作台
Use the explosive on the boulder.
把炸藥用在那塊巨石上。
Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
太厲害了，那炸藥直接把石頭炸出一個洞！
Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
我們就往這片神祕的地界，一路往裡衝！
For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
對我們這樣的冒險者來說，這洞窟精采得無可挑剔。
Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
我那位老友肯定來過這裡——我早就這麼說過了，你瞧仔細！
Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
很久以前，有位跟你一樣強悍的冒險者來找我，說要來一趟精采的遠航。那真是一段扣人心弦的故事，說來話長！
We became the best of friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
那趟旅程讓我們成了最要好的摯友，情誼深厚。可後來他就這樣消失了——他真是最好的那一個，我至今難受。
And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
而我們總算來到了他當年到過的地方，就在眼前。我等不及要再見到他，激動得不知從何開言！
A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
一道神祕的傳送門！我那位老友一定就是在這裡失了蹤！
We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
我們非穿過去把他找出來不可，付出什麼代價都成！
I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
我簡直不敢相信！我一句話也說不出來！
I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
我一直跟大家說，我才不是什麼怪胎！老朋友，就算找到最後一刻，我也一定把你找回來！
Find Relend in the strange place
在那個奇異的地方找到 Relend
A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
一片異鄉之地，危機四伏，處處陰森……
It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
不管多麼可怕，他一定是在這裡失了蹤影、斷了音訊。
My friend... Where do you think we are?
我的朋友……你覺得我們現在身在何方？
Wherever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
不管這是哪裡，我總覺得有什麼東西在遠處監視著我們。
With all this danger, I do hope my good friend is still okay.
這裡危機四伏，我真盼著我那位好友仍平安無恙。
My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
我的天！打起精神來，我看我們就要有一場硬仗！
Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
別……別放棄……我發誓，一定要把他找回來……
I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
我保證我會找到他，我做得到，連一道疤都不會留下，絕不會差！
Get on it then, no time for a nap! That thieving parrot has our map!
那就快動身吧，沒時間打盹偷懶！那隻賊鸚鵡，還把我們的地圖霸占！
Perhaps these citizens may help us out, ask them about the parrot's route!
這裡的居民，說不定幫得上忙！去問問他們，那隻鸚鵡飛往何方！
He seems distracted, best to walk away while you can.
他好像分心了，最好趁現在趕快走開。
He begins to list off a seemingly endless amount of examples.
他開始一個接一個地舉例，似乎沒完沒了。
It looks like he's nearly finished.
It seems like he's lost in reminiscence.
He doesn't seem to be stopping any time soon.
看來他一時半刻不會停下來。
It seems like he's waiting expectantly.
他似乎正滿心期待地等著。
He's thoughtfully rubbing his jaw. Best to leave him be
他若有所思地摸著下巴。最好別打擾他。
It seems like he's deep in thought.
He proceeds to rattle off several grievances about pastry making.
他接著一口氣抱怨起做點心的種種問題。
You don't have the time for this.
He seems pretty comfortable, best not to disturb him.
他看起來挺舒服的，最好別打擾他。
Heh, have fun, mate. Lot'sa treasure out there, eh?
嘿，好好玩吧，老兄。外頭寶藏多得是，欸？
Looks like the parrot dropped the map! You should get this back to Relend.
看來鸚鵡把地圖弄掉了！你該把它拿回去給 Relend。
You have no use for this yet, you should speak with Relend up near the steering wheel.
你現在還用不上這個，先到上面舵輪附近找 Relend 談談。
You'll need a [Wooden Board], a [Center Piece], and a [String] to craft a Steering Wheel.
製作舵輪需要一塊 [木板]、一個 [中心零件] 和一條 [繩子]。
This will probably work... You should show Relend.
這個應該行得通……你該拿給 Relend 看看。
You have nothing to load... You should continue through the wreckage.
你沒有東西可以裝填……你該繼續穿過這堆殘骸。
Bring [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to the Cooking Pot
把 [{~} Raw Mutton]、[{~} Edible Mushrooms]、[{~} Coconut] 和 [{~} Berries] 帶到烹飪鍋
You'll need [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to make a stew.
煮一鍋燉湯需要 [{~} Raw Mutton]、[{~} Edible Mushrooms]、[{~} Coconut] 和 [{~} Berries]。
Take a look at your content book if you forgot your project, this island has supplies we ought to collect!
忘了該做什麼，就翻翻你的綜合手冊。這島上的物資我們該去收集，一樣也少不得！
This looks dangerous! You should go blow open that boulder now.
看起來很危險！你該馬上去把那塊巨石炸開。
I've been looking for my old friend all this time. Sailing with every young adventurer in their prime!
這些年來，我一直在尋找我那位老友。和每一位正值巔峰的年輕冒險者一同出海遠遊！
...Oh, you're goin' out with Relend, hey? You sure?
……喔，你要跟 Relend 出海啊，嘿？你確定？
This looks... edible. You should see what Relend thinks.
這看起來……能吃。你該看看 Relend 怎麼說。
Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to learn more of this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
啊，{p} 軍隊的人。我們正想多了解這座冰封的墳塚。你的幫忙來得正好。
If you don't remember what I said, I remember you writing something in your book. Try looking there.
如果你不記得我說了什麼，我記得你在本子上寫了些東西。翻翻看吧。
You should head back to the mage with the wand.
你該回去找那位拿著法杖的法師了。
This is the Temple of Time...
Here you can visit the memories of this land...
在這裡，你能造訪這片土地的記憶……
The altar requires an item from the time you desire to access...
祭壇需要一件來自你想前往之時代的物品……
You will access a memory as if you were present, but when you return it will be as if you were never there.
你會像親臨現場一樣進入一段記憶，但回來之後，一切都會像你從未去過一樣。
You should stick around to find out how to reverse the spell.
你該留下來，查出如何解開這道法術。
Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too far gone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
啊啊啊……告訴……所有人。我要把這裡凍結。我……我已經、太遲了。這片土地需要時間癒合……而我的力量，必、必須被壓下……被凍住……
If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
如果說我從那個討人厭的傢——……從 Mael 那裡學到了什麼，那就是死得不明不白會讓亡魂徘徊不去。我……不想再給他添麻煩。
Wha... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true that this place has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
什……這麼多真相……冰魔法能擋住腐敗……？的確，這個地方遇到的腐敗威脅，比行省裡其他地方都要少……
Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... It was to protect everyone... but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
天上諸神啊……我們一直以來全都弄錯了……這是為了保護所有人……可他要是神智還那麼清楚，總該跟誰交代一聲吧！
I froze this land to allow it to heal.. People did not understand.. They came for me here, seeking revenge.
我凍結這片土地，是為了讓它癒合……人們不明白……他們追到這裡來找我，想要復仇。
Of course, just like you.. They can not leave. Their souls are stuck here. For the spell must not be broken.
當然，就跟你一樣……他們離不開。他們的靈魂被困在這裡。因為這道法術絕不能被打破。
Even if you think you can cure me.. I can not allow you to try for if it were to fail my corrupted body would wreak havoc on the world!
就算你以為能治好我……我也不能讓你嘗試，因為一旦失敗，我這腐敗的軀體會為世界帶來浩劫！
It will be dangerous...perhaps your toughest fight yet...but it must be done. If you need time to prepare, do so. But you must end Theorick's pain.
這會很危險……也許是你至今最艱難的一戰……但非做不可。需要時間準備的話就去準備吧。但你一定要終結 Theorick 的痛苦。
Don't you just love fishing? The little waves in the river, the wind and the rewarding feeling when you catch something, those are my favorite things about it.
你不覺得釣魚很棒嗎？河裡的小波浪、微風，還有釣到東西時那種滿足感，這些就是我最喜歡的地方。
You can not return until your goal is fulfilled...
在目標達成之前，你回不去的……
Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
你熟悉 Theorick 與 {p} 的故事嗎？
Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
大概不熟。是這樣的，{p} 並非一直都是冰封的。
During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
在 Theorick 的年代，這裡就像 Wynn 的平原，溫暖而適於耕作。
For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
不知為何，Theorick Twain 動用了他龐大的力量把這片土地凍結，然後把自己流放在此。
We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
我們得查出原因，才能解開這道法術。照理說，法術的魔力源頭應該就在墳塚裡……但我們不想空著手進去。
As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
因此……你聽過一個叫 {p} 的地方嗎？我們可以藉它回到過去，多了解一些 Theorick 的作為。
Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
呃……至少某種程度上是。這類魔法有它的規矩。其一，你需要一件來自我們想看的那個年代的物品。其二，你只能目睹過去，不能改變它。
One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Theorick 的其中一根法杖就陳列在 {p} 的銀行裡。照理說應該合用。你有辦法把它弄來嗎？
在 {p} 的銀行找到 Theorick 的法杖。
Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
啊哈，動作真快。看來你把法杖拿到手了。要讓那些銀行的人鬆手，想必得有一副好口才。
Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
走去 {p} 可是一段長路。不過不必用走的，我可以把你傳送過去。但願如此。
Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
到了之後，進入 Temple of Time。到了那裡你就會知道該怎麼做。時光旅行要小心，朋友……誰也不知道你會碰上什麼。
直接走進傳送門就是了。
Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
萬一出了什麼差錯，我會留在這裡把你傳送回神殿。
Enter the portal the mage made.
進入法師開啟的傳送門。
Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
進入 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Gate of Time，回到過去。
Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
哇，你的武器跟護甲好先進！
Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
你也是 Twain 嗎？只有 Twain 家族懂那種魔法。
喔，你是來找 Theorick 的。
He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
他忙著在前線打仗，你不也該去嗎？
He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
他往西邊去了。好像出了什麼緊急狀況。
We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
我們跟腐敗打了好幾年，看樣子它終究要把 {p} 吞掉了。
Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
在 {p} 西邊的森林裡找到 Theorick [{~1}, {~2}, {~3}]。
I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
我敢發誓她是往這邊走的……喔，又怎麼了，又來一個蠢貨？這片森林不能亂走！
If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
要幫忙就去跟衛兵申訴。我很忙，總不能丟下拯救這個天殺的行省，跑去幫你冰牛奶吧！！
Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
你耳朵塞了耳屎嗎？！我說了——
Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
唔，那些東西跟著你來了！看吧，出事了吧？！退到一邊去。
As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
好像我還嫌只救一個人不夠似的！快滾，我還得去找那個失蹤的女人！
HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
救命啊——！我跑不過他們！！！衛兵！誰來啊！！
Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
咦！那是她的聲音！她人在哪？！我剛才才清過這一帶！
Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
唔，她是從西邊一路把他們引過來的嗎？！你，不想被凍成冰塊的話，立刻躲到我身後！！
Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
呼……你安全了。不過你要是沒離開城裡，根本就不會有什麼危險！
Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
不必跟我道歉，回城裡去就是了。立刻。
Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
下次想到森林裡採花還是幹嘛的時候，記得你的命只有一條，聽見沒？！
Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
每一天，腐敗者更多，死的人也更多……只剩一條路了。我得親自去處理。斬斷根源……除掉這株地獄來的雜草。
Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
還在啊？那就聽好。我和另外幾個人在籌畫一件冒險的事。就算心智因此喪失也罷，我必須穿過那道傳送門。
You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
你裝備看起來很齊，我徵召你了。立刻到我們的據點會合。沿著河往南走，右手邊會看到一棟房子。
Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
好吧，這點我承認。你至少聽令很快。我們要前往 {p}。
The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
上一個進了那道門又回來的人，變成了 Bak’al……但只要還有一絲成功的可能，事到如今我們就得賭。
Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
出發吧。這一路不休息，希望你早有準備。
Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
好。我所駕馭的極寒能夠擋住腐敗本身。我可不覺得你們哪個也做得到。我一個人進去。
When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
我進去之後……照我推測，腐敗者會跟著湧向那道門。你們的任務？把他們殺光。我不能在裡面分心。
You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
在我從那道門出來之前，你不准離開崗位。聽懂了嗎？
...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
你知道發生什麼事了嗎？！我輸了！！我要是徹底轉化，會毀了整個行省！走開，快！聽見沒有？！快跑！！
I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
我……冷、冷靜下來，Theorick……別……別讓它吞掉你……還有……還有辦法……有一條路……
Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
喔……又是你……其他人呢……死了？跑了？一群懦夫……唔……
You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
你還活著……那……抬起頭來。聽我說。如果我轉化……不，是當、當我轉化的時候……不、不行……啊啊啊，我會毀——唔……
I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
我撐不了多久，你看得出來……此刻……要殺我是不可能的，你這蠢弱的——啊，滾出我的腦袋！！
All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
全都不值一提……唔，不……他們仍配得上活著……而這道法術……必定會奪走一些人的命。拜託，讓他們知道原因……
K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
繼、繼續前進吧。你這身裝備，要是人人都像你這麼強……我們也許還有機會。等我更虛弱了，這終有一天能了結我。
Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
讓世人知道……Theorick Twain 並沒有死。他是殺不死的……一切都將焚毀……直到將來的某一天。就在這裡，在這片受詛咒的土地上。找到我……然後為這一切畫下句點。
Tell Telvu the mage what happened.
You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
你想必是成功了，否則你此刻還困在過去的記憶裡。我感覺得到你身上帶著強大的魔力。
So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
這麼說，你見到 Theorick 了？一直以來的說法都是，大冰封之後他就從英雄的位置上墮落了。
Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
至少，你查出他為什麼要把這裡凍結了嗎？
All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
這麼多年，就這樣被活埋著，與腐敗搏鬥。看你的臉色，這念頭也讓你毛骨悚然吧。殺了他，反而是慈悲。
Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
來。用這個。在冰封墳塚裡面它或許能保護你……拜託了，士兵。當 Theorick 的守護天使吧。把他從這場折磨裡解脫出來。
Most of the pages are filled with religious verses. At the very end of the book, there's a card separate from the rest of the pages.

……我至少得做對一件事。我不能再這樣原地打轉下去了。凡是必要的事，我都會去做！
You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
那麼，你必須去尋找罐裝 Abis 這種植物。它長在一處被巨大蕨葉遮蔽的洞窟裡。
Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
謝謝您。我終於能做我本該做的事了！這一次我不會讓任何東西攔住我！！
...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
……人類，我看得見你。她沒看見，算你走運。過來說話。
So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
所以你就是 Orphion 新的受選者。這既令人意外，也不令人意外——人類的名聲很有意思。
Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
人們常說，人類什麼事都做得成，毫無限制——不論是完成不可能的任務，還是打破道德的戒律。
In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
不過在這件事上，這兩樣你都得做。Orphion 已經下了令，不是嗎？所以你非做不可，而為此我向你致歉。
I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
我看過 Lari 的作為——她為這片土地立下了無價的功勞。是她一個人擋住了黯蝕南下，守護者才得以留在我們身邊。
However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
然而，正是她自己的道德讓局面無法推進。她下不了殺手——而唯有根除源頭，光才能再度充滿這片土地。
Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Orphion 的處境已經危急——所以有件事你必須明白。祂在道德的層次上高於我們。那些概念並不適用於祂。
As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
身為光本身的化身，祂沒有道德觀——只有存續與維持。祂要求我們做的事，許多人會退避三舍。
It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
這是一件必須把道德擱在一旁的事……而那正是 Lari 無法接受的，因為她固執地守了那些東西一千年。
To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
要打破它們……我承認，我相信這些問題還有別的解法，但事實是，已經沒有時間了。
She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
她必須用盡她全部的力量，而只要她還抱著那份不殺的堅持，那就不會發生。我必須請你跟著她，一如 Orphion 所願。
There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
很遺憾，這件事沒有所謂的對錯。只有必要——而在那裡，你必須把她逼到極限。去找罐裝 Abis 的洞窟。
It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
從這裡往東北方。入口被巨大的蕨葉遮著。我只能祈禱這樣就夠了。
Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Find the plant inside the cave.
在洞窟裡找到那株植物。
...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
……我不敢相信。我到底做錯了什麼？是哪裡？一定有什麼原因，到底是什麼？！
There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by "dire actions?!" I've done everything I can think of!
根本沒有新的銘文……還是同樣那幾句話！「決絕之舉」到底是什麼意思？！我想得到的我全做了！
...{u}. I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
……{u}。我、我必須知道。Orphion 到底跟你說了什麼？我再也受不了這樣一無所知了。祂真的取代我了嗎？
Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
這——這樣還不夠決絕嗎？整天盯著你研究、把我的位置和我的驕傲都讓給別人，這樣還不夠極端嗎？！
I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
我想不出還有什麼別的理由，能解釋為什麼我這邊的一切就這樣……全都不管用了。是嗎？拜託，告訴我——
...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
……等等……你……你身上有罐裝 Abis！！你從哪裡拿到的？！
You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
你……你不可能會知道那個，除非你——是你！你偷聽了我說話！！
You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
我明明叫你別跟來，你還是跟進洞窟裡了！你……在我說了那些話之後！！在你聽完那些私密的心事之後！
You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
你居然還覺得追上來是個好主意！你這樣到底想達成什麼？！
You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
那你都聽見了！！全都攤在陽光下了！我成不了事！你在那裡！我做不到的，你全都做到了！
I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
我不是失敗者！我不是！我不會是！我拒絕當那種東西！你沒資格站在那裡看我掙扎、看我出醜！！
Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
什——我……剛才怎麼……我做了什麼……？
I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
我差一點就殺了他們！我親手粉碎、玷污了我這輩子所堅持的一切！！
TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
告訴我！！這怎麼可能會是答案？！這怎麼可能是非發生不可的事？！
WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
因為他們做到了我做不到的事，我就想殺了他們——這不算墮入黑暗嗎？你怎麼可能這樣想？！
What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
你算什麼守護者，居然容許這種暴行？我剛才做的事，哪一點是可以的？
...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
……你。你不可能是在說我剛才做的是對的。我拒絕接受這種說法。
...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
……那麼……我不是應該覺得……我不知道。我不是應該覺得比較不受束縛？比較不害怕？比較……比較自由嗎？
If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
如果我做的正是非做不可的事，為什麼我覺得自己像地上的爛泥？為什麼我這麼難受？！
...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
……我……我需要時間消化這件事。我……你明白這有多難聽進去嗎？有多難承受嗎？
My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
我的脈搏，你的光何其燦亮……它已照在 Lari 身上，不久之後，她的光也將照向我……
Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
進入根中，見證通往我領域的道路。然後，做好準備。凝聚起你最耀眼的光……
secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in cinfras
祕密藏於 cinfras 最古老的圖書館之中
awakening the guardian of the forest requires more than just magic
喚醒森林的守護者，所需的不只是魔法
the home of the elves will house the answers and revelations
精靈的家園將藏有答案與啟示
dire actions in the presence of the guardian will waken many things
在守護者面前的決絕之舉，將喚醒許多事物
Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
帶著你的 Gavel 護照到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找飛船櫃檯員。
Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
日安，大兵！今天要搭我們的船嗎？
May I see your passport please?
可以讓我看一下你的護照嗎？
It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
有點灰塵呢！看起來很舊了，不過照片確實是你。
Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
好，一切都沒問題，請上船，祝你旅途愉快。
Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
各位乘客請就座。我們馬上就要起飛了！
Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
與 Ackbar 船長談談失蹤孩童的事。
Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
各位乘客請注意。船上有人通報失蹤人口。若有志願者願意協助搜尋，請前往艦橋向船長報到。
This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee at your cabin.
起飛期間本區域禁止乘客進入。請上到客艙層，會有服務員在你的房間等候。
The bear really liked the cod!
那隻熊很喜歡那條鱈魚！
I hope I don't get nauseous...
Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
你好啊，年輕的冒險者。你有沒有看到我的眼鏡？
The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
日安，大兵！這趟航程這裡就是你的房間。祝你旅途愉快！
You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
如果你沒別的事要做，也可以在這裡一路睡到目的地！
The food they're serving here is dreadful! As if it was meant for the beasts they transport below deck.
這裡供應的食物糟透了！簡直像是給他們關在下層的野獸吃的。
*Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
*啜泣*……你有看到我的孩子嗎？我們本來在房間裡，然後他就這樣不見了！
I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
我聽說有一艘大船從北邊靠過來。我在入口甲板看到的。不曉得他們想幹嘛。
Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
你是來志願協助尋找那個失蹤孩子的嗎？
We only just set off and there is already an incident.
我們才剛啟航就出事了。
Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It's been following us since we lifted off.
喂！你看遠處那艘船。從我們起飛到現在，它一直跟著我們。
His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
他母親說她兒子一上船沒多久就不見了。
Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
要我說，這是父母沒管好。唉，總之我們得把那孩子找出來。
Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
既然完全沒有線索，或許先去問問其他乘客會比較好。
Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
他們大部分應該都在餐廳或交誼廳。
Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
非常感謝你的幫忙，希望你早點找到那孩子。
Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
向乘客們打聽，試著找出失蹤孩童的下落。
Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
喂！你看遠處那艘船。從我們出發到現在，它幾乎一直跟著我們。
I know I shouldn't be down here but...
我知道我不該跑到下面來，可是……
I love airships, and I've never seen one like that.
我超喜歡飛船的，而且我從來沒看過那種樣子的。
Okay then, I'll head back right now!
Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
太感謝你找到我的孩子了！剩下的行程他都不准離開我半步。
I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
對不起，剛剛害大家擔心了……
Hello again, did you find him?
又見面了，你找到他了嗎？
How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
他怎麼會跑到下面去的？！那裡明明該有人在值班！
Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
太感謝你把他找回來了。你是唯一一個志願幫忙的人。
Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
希望這趟航程就這麼一個小插曲。
What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
老天爺啊，那是什麼聲音？船員，回報！
Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
長官！我們有一具引擎爆了！那一側完全失去推力。
Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
該死！沒有兩具引擎，我們就只能在這裡動彈不得。
Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
大兵，去輪機艙向工程師報到，看看你能不能幫上什麼忙，讓這艘船重新動起來。
Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
去看看工程師有沒有什麼事需要你幫忙。
Ye must be the 'uman the captain done told me about.
你就是船長跟俺說的那個人類吧。
We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
俺們下面這邊的狀況可真不小。
I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
俺得守在這裡顧著引擎，不然這老姑娘可能會把自己搞壞。
If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
人類，你要是想幫忙，就爬上索具去看看那幾具螺旋槳。
Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
從艦橋的檢修口可以上去。
If'n they are stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
要是它們停了，把跳脫的斷路器扳回去就行。
Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
弄完回來這裡找俺。俺得待著替她降溫。
Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
找出並修好飛船引擎的問題。引擎在氣囊頂端，從艦橋可以上去。
In event of shut-down, maintenance must be performed.
That fixed the engine, better get back to the Engineer now.
引擎這樣就修好了，現在最好回去找工程師。
Worker must restart all wooden switches before the engine overheats.
作業人員須在引擎過熱前重啟所有木製開關。
DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
回報 Engineer Eric，告訴他引擎修好了。
Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
I couldn't have dun it without ye.
沒有你俺可弄不完這個。
You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
你回房間去休息吧。像你這樣的乘客本來就不該幫船員做事。
I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the good cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
希望你剩下的旅程順利。俺會跟咱們的好船長說一聲，讓他把馬力開到最大，咱們再上路。
All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff, report to stations!
全體船員各就各位！這不是演習！全體船員各就各位！
That should be enough of them gone. The way to the lower deck is open
解決掉這些應該夠了。通往下層甲板的路開了。
Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
探索下層甲板，查明爆炸的原因。
Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
撐住啊老姑娘，你辦得到的！
Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
弟兄們，穩住她。我們還活得下來！只要能甩掉後面那些人就好。
Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
姑娘們看啊，肉自己送上門來了！
Send more in! They can't get all of us!
再派人進去！他們沒辦法把我們全解決掉！
The rest of you all, get in here!
你們其他人，全給我進來！
I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
我聽到打鬥聲？有人在嗎？我被關在牢房裡！
I heard the fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
我聽見上面在打了，幹得好！能看到那群劫掠者遭報應，我這把老骨頭都暖起來了。
It looks like the way out is open.
I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
我以前可是全 Gavel 最厲害的鎖匠！我當年名聞遐邇——很不幸地。
These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
這幫惡徒好幾年前抓走了我，逼我替他們的劫掠打造上百把鑰匙。
I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
我現在太老了，但在離開這個世界之前，我真想親眼看到他們垮台。
My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
我的製鑰工具收在走廊底端、樓梯後面。你可以用它們做出進入女王艙房的鑰匙。
Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
往鎖孔裡看，就知道該怎麼做了。祝你好運！
Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
製作能通往天空劫掠者女王的鑰匙。
So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
所以你覺得你可以就這樣闖上我的船，是吧？
Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
殺我的手下？打斷我的搶劫？
I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
你這種「麻煩」，我知道該怎麼處理！
Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
擊敗天空劫掠者女王，並帶走她的一件私人寶物。
Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
逃離該船，並與 Ackbar 船長交談。
Wow... You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
哇，你憑一己之力擋下了一整場天空劫掠者的入侵。
And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
而你還只是個乘客！你做得太好了……
We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
這艘船上完全沒有防衛能力。我們只是民用客船。
What is this? A ring from the Queen?! It looks valuable. You should keep it.
這是什麼？女王的戒指？！看起來很值錢。你應該留著。
I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
我實在不知道該怎麼謝你……我們欠你太多了。
Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
等等！我知道了！你可以免費搭乘 {p} 到 {p} 的航班！
Wait! I know! You can have free travel between {p} and {p}!
等等！我知道了！你可以免費往返 {p} 與 {p}！
A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
有個叫 Calo 的私人飛船船主欠我一個大人情。
I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
我會跟他說好這件事。你只要上他的船，他就會載你來回！
Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
喔，另外也會有一筆優厚的酬勞給你。戒指我會親自送過去給他，免得路上弄壞了，你到那邊再拿。
Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
你直接下到入口甲板就好，我們馬上就要抵達 {p} 飛船基地了。
Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
下到入口甲板，然後下船。

瞧，我這裡有些東西……四處看看吧，全都非常稀有……

我看得出你眼裡那個神情……你對這裡的什麼有興趣？全部都賣……

……欸，人類仔……我不是要嚇你，不過你知道那個從你背後偷偷靠過去的傢伙是誰嗎？

喂！醒醒，你這個該死的人渣！

還有，別以為你可以整天在牢房裡閒晃。你在這裡得工作，不然就等著被丟進禁閉室。

不過現在，你先待在你的牢房裡，懂了嗎？好了，待在這裡，看看你的牢房。該工作的時候你就會知道了……
GWAH! Who the hell are you?

喔，感謝 Grook，你只是另一個囚犯……而且還這麼年輕……

你才剛進來的吧？嗯……我看得出你是無辜的……就跟這座鬼監獄裡幾乎所有人一樣……

聽著，人類……這座監獄……全世界你不可能進到比這裡更恐怖的監獄了！這地方就是地獄！！
The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
這裡的獄警，全是虐待狂！他們會隨便從牢房裡挑走囚犯，然後那些人就再也沒有人見過！他們是想把我們全都弄死在這裡！
I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
人類，我是說真的！你要是留在這裡，他們也會殺了你！你「一定」要逃出這個地方，不管付出什麼代——
Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
喂，垃圾！你跟我們走。給我出牢房，立刻！

呃，長官，你確定嗎？我今天應該哪裡都不用去才對……
Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
喔，你以為你很聰明，想反抗是吧？？喂，Jon，把入口擋住！
H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
喂——喂！你們要做什麼——放開——啊啊啊啊！！誰來啊！！救我！！！拜託！！！！
OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
喂！別再發呆了，蛆蟲！過來你牢房的欄杆這邊。

工作時間到了，垃圾。我押你到走廊去。到了那裡會有人告訴你要做什麼。照他們說的做，今晚你或許還回得來。

聽懂了嗎，賤骨頭？好，現在給我出牢房！
Get your instructions from the guard

看來打掃的活是你的了，是吧？好。聽好了，人渣！

拿著這塊海綿，到走廊各處看看。看到髒污就用海綿擦乾淨。弄完了會有人押你回牢房。
Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
懂了嗎？好。現在給我去做事！
Search the hallways for messes to clean up
在走廊上尋找需要清理的髒污
Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

哎呀呀……看來社會的渣滓準時到齊了！

好。站好隊，不准動，蛆蟲們！點名時間到了……

好。暫時就到這裡，你們這群沒用的禍害。用餐時間到了。到餐廳去，然後祈禱我們給的不是你們的最後一餐。
Find a place to sit in the cafeteria
Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
嗨……那個，你可以……幫我一件事嗎……？

我……我快餓死了……那些該死的獄警不肯……讓我拿到任何食物……

拜託……我右手邊……那裡放著一些食物，你要是能幫我拿過來，我會……感激你一輩子……
I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
我……我真的不知道該怎麼謝你，人類……有這個我應該撐得下去了……

欸……沒事的，你可以坐這裡，別緊張。

新來的，他說的是真話。我們這裡大多數人都只是普通老百姓。我在 {p} 一家運輸公司上班，正要把幾箱貨送去 {p}，結果一出城就被他們抓了。

我也是！我到現在都不知道自己為什麼會被關進來！我連上法庭受審都沒有！他們就直接把我從街上抓走扔進來了！

因為他們想殺你，就是這樣。你聽說 Revan 的事了嗎？他幾天前點名的時候不小心絆了一下，然後就被帶走了。從那之後沒人再聽過或看過他。

我……你大概說得對……我只是再也搞不懂這一切了……我只想永遠離開這個鬼地方……

……那祝你好運了……唯一的出路就是那扇出口門，而且就算走到那裡，你還得先進得了控制室。這……根本不可能，你懂吧？
Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
好了，用餐時間結束！回你們的牢房，垃圾！

……嗯……人類，這地方大概就是這樣了。盡量別擋到誰的路、別脫隊，在他們找上你之前應該都還好。

欸，欸，算了吧，Don。他們又沒惹到誰。

哈！說不定你也會得到同樣的待遇，novello。我第一眼看到你就知道了。你也是個殺人的，對吧？欸，要自己是那種人，才認得出對面也是那種人。

Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
好了，用餐時間結束！回你們的牢房，垃圾！

在走廊上尋找可能的逃脫路線，並找到一套獄警制服

你做完了？好，跟我來。點名要開始了。

你們全都在，是吧？那好，去吃晚——

You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
你們兩個膽子還真大，敢在點名的時候打架！
W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
哇——喂！這隻蛆有自製刀！退後！！！
LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
封鎖！封鎖！你們全部人，回牢房，立刻！

你，把這兩個蠢貨帶去禁閉室；還有你，去我辦公室拿一把控制室的備用鑰匙。現在，熄燈！

好，全部人排好隊，站直！不准動，動了就等著玩完！
H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-

哎呀呀……又一個賤民自以為聰明，敢脫隊……

等、等一下，典獄長女士！是有人把我推出隊伍的！我發誓！
BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
閉嘴！我沒說你可以開口，垃圾！

給我回隊伍！等這件事結束，你就完了，爛泥！

從典獄長辦公室偷到鑰匙，然後前往控制室

Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
避開獄警，想辦法前往檔案室

喔，感謝聖牛！這裡總算有張友善的臉了……

聽著，人類，你得把我弄出去！他們今天一整天都在裡面殺人！你要是不幫我，下一個就是我了！

你看，我牢房旁邊，那張桌子上！有一把鑰匙！拿起來交給我！

對，太好了，太好了！就是那把鑰匙，交給我！

Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
咦……？喔——喂！桌子燒起來了，誰過來幫我把火滅掉！
Find and destroy your criminal records
找到並銷毀你的犯罪紀錄

你是誰？人類，有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？
WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
什麼？？Taron，他、他還活著？？而且你……讓他在那座監獄裡沒有餓死……？
I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
我……人類，我真的不知道該怎麼謝你。就算他出不來，光是知道他還活著就……拜託，我知道這不算什麼，但請你收下。
Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
晚安。有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？
M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
我、我兒子？他還活著？！？喔，我的小聖牛啊，那真是……！他在哪裡？？
...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
……在那座監獄，是嗎？嗯……知道他還能再撐一陣子就好了……真的很謝謝你，人類。來，這個拿去！

唯一的出路是走出口那道門。要打開它，你得先進到控制室……

這座監獄似乎對政府謊報了幾乎所有作為，而政府看來也照單全收，儘管關於這裡的傳聞多不勝數。
It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..
看來離開這裡唯一的辦法，就是走那扇出口門……
Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin to ya here..
喂，喂，人類仔！對，我就是在跟你講話……

所以，歡迎來到 {p}。你這輩子都要待在這裡了，短鼻子，抱怨也沒用。

裡面有一把積著灰的鑰匙，標著「補給間」

Looks like there's an inmate being interrogated...
看起來有個囚犯正在被審問……

There's some stuff on the table. It looks like... flesh??
桌上有些東西。看起來像……肉塊？？

你強壓下想吐的衝動……這以前是個人嗎？？？

這本書的書名是《抽魂指南》。
It'd probably be best not to touch it..
There's some broken bits and pieces of a torture device here..
這裡有一些刑具的碎片……

刀鋒已經生鏽，整片沾滿了乾掉的血……
There's some cheese inside of the crate.
This must be the warden's office...
這一定就是典獄長的辦公室……
The warden seems very engrossed in her writing..
典獄長看起來很專注在寫東西……
You place the cheese on the floor, where the rat had run by...
你把乳酪放在地上，就放在老鼠跑過的地方……

那隻老鼠逃走的時候好像掉了東西……
You managed to fill your bucket with some water.
你成功在桶子裡裝了一些水。
You throw the water bucket onto the generator...
你把整桶水潑到發電機上……
Looks like something popped out of the generator...
好像有東西從發電機裡彈出來了……
Looks like you've cleaned up all the messes! You should return to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're done.
看來你把所有髒亂都清乾淨了！你該回到走廊入口的獄警那裡，告訴他你做完了。
You're escorted back to the cell block by the guard...
The two of you arrive just as rollcall is about to begin. Some guards shove you into place with the other prisoners...
你們兩個剛到，點名就要開始了。幾個獄警把你推去和其他囚犯站在一起……
You're escorted to the cafeteria by the guards...
You're escorted out of the cafeteria and back to your cell...
你被押出餐廳，帶回牢房……
Looks like that's the end of today... Your top priority tomorrow should be to devise a plan to escape the prison. Finding a guard outfit could be helpful, as well..
今天看來就到這裡了……明天最要緊的是想出逃獄的計畫。找到一套獄警制服應該也有幫助……
[{~}/{~}] ??? Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
[{~1}/{~2}] ??? 好了！所有人，起來！離開牢房，現在！點名時間到了！
There's a lockpicking kit inside of this crate!
這個箱子裡有一套開鎖工具！
There's a few stacks of coins inside of this crate.
這個箱子裡有幾疊硬幣。
There are some vegetables inside of this crate.
這個箱子裡有一些蔬菜。
This must be the exit door.
This should be the most direct way out of the prison... You'll need to get into the control room to open it, though.
這應該是離開監獄最直接的路……不過你得先進到控制室才能打開它。
It's the map of the prison's hallways.
Looks like the Warden isn't here during your regular work time... That could be useful later on...
看來典獄長在你平常工作的時段不在這裡……這一點之後可能有用……
This must be the control room those inmates were talking about yesterday...
這一定就是那些囚犯昨天講的控制室……
This room has to be your ticket out of this place. You just need to find a way inside of it...
這個房間一定是你離開這裡的門票。你只要想辦法進去……
You vaguely remember the rat that had ran by here yesterday...
你隱約記得昨天有隻老鼠從這裡跑過……
You put the guard uniform underneath your regular outfit. This should help you avoid some suspicion when you make your escape...
你把獄警制服穿在平常的衣服底下。逃走的時候這應該能少招一點懷疑……
Looks like this is all you'll be able to find for now. You should head back to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're finished working.
目前看來能找到的就這些了。你該回到走廊入口的獄警那裡，告訴他你工作做完了。
Time to take stock of the situation. You need to get out of here, and you might just have found enough out to do it.
該把情況整理一下了。你得離開這裡，而你打聽到的說不定已經夠了。
The Warden mentioned during rollcall that there's spare control room keys in her office. You'll have to find a way into her office during work time in order to access the control room.
典獄長點名時提到她辦公室裡有控制室的備用鑰匙。你得在工作時段想辦法進她的辦公室，才能進控制室。
Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over fo-
好，剩下的人，去工作！點名結束——
-The hell? Ow, hey! Get off me, you worthless pests!
——搞什麼？噢，喂！放開我，你們這些沒用的害蟲！
...All of you... Get out... Of my sight... NOW.
……你們全部……從我眼前……消失……現在。
Now that the guard isn't standing here, you can more closely inspect this vent...
獄警不站在這裡了，你可以更仔細地檢查這個通風口……
It looks quite old, and the vent grates appear to be splitting at their seams... it shouldn't take too much effort to just...?
看起來相當老舊，通風口的柵板接縫處好像裂開了……應該不用太費力就能……？
Perfect! With the grate off, it's relatively easy to squeeze through the vent opening.
太好了！柵板拆掉之後，要從通風口鑽過去就不算難了。
These papers on the desk appear to be directed to the Warden.
桌上這些文件看起來是寫給典獄長的。
The papers appear to be asking the Warden for...? A quota of souls...
這些文件看起來是在向典獄長要……？一份靈魂的配額……
The signature at the end simply reads the letter D.
末尾的署名只有一個字母 D。
There are some books stacked up in piles right here.
The subject of the books range from the history of the Decay, to spirit magic and... Soul extraction.
這些書的題材從黯蝕的歷史，到靈魂魔法，還有……抽魂。
It'd probably be best to stop looking through these.
最好還是別再翻這些了。
The key fits perfectly into the door's keyhole...
鑰匙完全吻合門上的鎖孔……
There are some papers here about the prison's history..
這裡有一些關於監獄歷史的文件……
The papers say that the prison was constructed in {~} AP, and was reserved for Gavel's worst criminals...
文件上說這座監獄建於 {~} AP，專門關 Gavel 最惡劣的罪犯……
It's also the largest prison in all of Gavel, and receives an enormous amount of funding in order to maintain captivity of their inmates...
它也是整個 Gavel 最大的監獄，為了關住囚犯而領著龐大的經費……
It's just instructions on how to operate electromagic appliances.
只是一些電魔法器具的操作說明。
There are a few rusted axe heads in here. The sharp edges are stained with dried blood...
這裡有幾個生鏽的斧頭。鋒口上沾著乾掉的血……
The screen appears to show a map of the entire prison! It looks like after you head through the exit door, you'll have to sneak through a large portion of the prison to escape.
螢幕上好像顯示著整座監獄的地圖！看起來你穿過出口門之後，還得偷偷穿過監獄的一大片區域才能逃出去。
Near the back of the prison, there's a room that holds almost all of the records in the prison... You might be able to destroy your criminal record if you reach it!
監獄後方有一個房間，裡面放著監獄裡幾乎所有的記錄……要是能進去，也許就能把你的犯罪記錄毀掉！
There's a lever on this control panel that is labeled with the words "UNLOCK EXIT DOOR".
這個控制面板上有一根拉桿，標著「解鎖出口門」。
You can hear the sound of a door opening in the distance... the exit door must have just opened!
你聽到遠處有門打開的聲音……出口門一定剛剛開了！
This screen appears to show some information about guard patrols and placements in the second half of the prison...
這個螢幕上好像顯示著監獄後半部獄警巡邏與配置的資訊……
...The entire area is going to be crawling with guards. You're going to have to sneak through them all in order to escape the prison for good.
……整個區域都會有獄警在巡。你得從他們之間全部偷偷穿過去，才能真正逃出這座監獄。
There's some extremely dark looking metal inside of this closet. You can't tell what it's used for...
這個櫃子裡有一些看起來極黑的金屬。你看不出它是做什麼用的……
This cabinet has a number of letters between Gavel's government and the Prison.
這個櫃子裡有不少 Gavel 政府與這座監獄之間的往來信件。
The government must not care about the lives of anyone who lives in Gavel's northern forests enough to condemn the prison for all of this slaughter.
政府想必根本不在乎住在 Gavel 北方森林裡的人的死活，才沒有為了這些屠殺查封這座監獄。
These cabinets have some criminal records on a lot of the prisoners here...
這些櫃子裡有這裡很多囚犯的犯罪記錄……
Most of these files are virtually empty, save for a select few that had committed petty thefts some time ago.
這些檔案大部分幾乎都是空的，只有少數幾份記著前些時候的小偷小摸。
This box has a few criminal records in here. The first one has your name on it... At least you didn't need to search very long to find it.
這個箱子裡有幾份犯罪記錄。第一份上面就是你的名字……至少你沒有找很久。
There should be something nearby you can use to destroy it.
附近應該有什麼東西可以用來把它毀掉。
You toss your criminal records into the fire. Good riddance.
你把自己的犯罪記錄丟進火裡。總算擺脫了。
Your record has been destroyed, for now. You can finally leave the prison for good.
你的記錄暫時被毀掉了。你終於可以永遠離開這座監獄。
This cabinet has a few records on the Warden...but they all seem incomplete.
這個櫃子裡有幾份關於典獄長的記錄……但看起來全都不完整。
Hardly any of the information is actually filled out, No age, career history, family, or any other information. She appears to be a complete un-person.
幾乎沒有一欄是填好的。沒有年齡、沒有經歷、沒有家人，什麼資料都沒有。她看起來完全不像一個存在過的人。
It's as if she just popped into existence for the sole purpose of being this prison's warden.
就好像她是憑空冒出來的，唯一的目的就是當這座監獄的典獄長。
There you are! Good to see you managed to escape that horrid place!
你在這裡！很高興看到你逃出了那個可怕的地方！
But seriously, thank you, {u}. I thought I was going to get killed in there! This isn't much, but hopefully it can help you get back on your feet after all of that.
不過說真的，謝謝你，{u}。我以為我要死在裡面了！這不算什麼，但希望能幫你在經歷這一切之後重新振作。
Anyways, I have to go now. But if I can ever help you with anything at all, just let me know! I'm forever in your debt, human.
總之，我得走了。但只要有任何我幫得上的地方，儘管跟我說！我永遠欠你一份情，人類。
An'! The best part! The idiot came back with a crumpled wrist and this HORRIFIED look- Musta gotten on the Hive witch's bad side!
還有！最精彩的來了！那個白痴回來的時候手腕都扭爛了，一臉嚇壞的樣子——八成是惹毛了蜂巢的女巫！
Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
啊，你好啊，人類！我想你一定注意到下面這個市集了。這可是矮人的驕傲——所有矮人城市裡最大的市場！
Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
這裡有別處買不到的特殊商品——各式各樣稀奇、美妙、獨一無二的東西。我自己也正在找幾樣零碎的玩意兒。
It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
跟上面那些做閃亮貨幣生意的商人不同，這裡幾乎全是以物易物。這對我來說……某方面來說有點不妙。
You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after right now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
是這樣的，我本行是歷史學家，但我現在真正想要的是 Troll Hair。你知道，我真的很喜歡那個味——呃。它拿來裝訂書本又牢又耐用——等一下！
YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
「你」身上就有？太棒了！我自己永遠弄不到——我從來就不是打架的料。呃，來！讓我用這個……跟你換！
A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
一套裝飾用瓶蓋收藏！這東西可不好找，不過我反正有兩套。你看看！你會學到很多的。對了，非常謝謝你！
...this is more useless to you than that troll hair. But, Nakoba did say the merchants barter. Maybe you can get something more useful for these.
……這東西對你來說比那撮 Troll Hair 還沒用。不過，Nakoba 確實說過那些商人是以物易物的。也許你能拿這些換到更有用的東西。
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
在 {p} 找到想收購 [Decorative Bottlecap Collection] 的人。Dobile 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}
Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
礦石出售！礦石出售！來買稀有金屬！我們有 Kanderstone、Wynnic Copper、正宗的 {p} Sandstone，還有來自 {p} 的真品 Voidstone！
Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
人類，說你呢！如果你對鍛造有興趣，那你來對地方了！……前提是你喜歡喝矮人的酒。我想用這些換瓶蓋收藏。
What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
你那是什麼表情？你新來的還是怎樣？沒見過收集瓶蓋的人嗎？還是說你長得就這樣？
Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
什——那個！那是！我！你怎麼會！它……它保存得完美無瑕！一個瓶蓋都沒少！連開瓶器壓出來的凹痕都沒有！！！
There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
你不可能是自己收集到那些的！你根本不可能明白你手上那東西的意義！！我！需！要！它們！
Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
拿去！我最稀有的金屬！拿去！拿去然後把那些瓶蓋給我！我一定要把我的收藏補齊！！給我！給我！給我給我給我給我，快！
...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
……呃。咳。我剛剛有點失控了。不過……那些瓶蓋是第一屆 Dogun 慶典的東西啊。它們做出來的時候，那個慶典甚至還不是在 Courag 辦的！
I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jaspilite I gave you!
我很想再多聊聊它們，但我不能在一筆買賣上耗太久，不然其他客人會跑掉。不過我給你的那塊 Jaspilite，你這筆可是賺到了！
Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what he's selling instead.
這麼一說，之前有個傢伙也想要那玩意兒，可他身上連一個普通汽水瓶蓋都沒有！我想他就在附近。說不定你會對他賣的東西有興趣。
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
在 {p} 找到想收購 [Molten Jasplite Ingots] 的人。Dorroc 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}
Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
嗯……人類商人？我是聽說過你們啦，但希望你拿出來的不是那些老套貨色。
Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables and all. You all seem to have metals in bulk...
沒錯，我在這個市集見過不少你們這種人——用著公共熔爐和鍛造台什麼的。你們手上的金屬似乎都是成堆的……
...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
……但我看過人類用的金屬錠，一百塊裡大概九十八塊都是垃圾等級！只配拿來練手！我要的可只有最頂級的金屬。
...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPILITE?! Oh, you must've gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
……所以，你當然非得拿出 MOLTEN JASPILITE 來打我的臉是吧？！喔，這你一定是從 Dobile 那裡弄來的。真看不出來你是收集瓶蓋的人！
I've been pestering him for awhile about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is incredibly valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
我纏著他要那批貨已經好一陣子了。你要知道，Unseen Blade 用的金屬非常珍貴。它是很脆沒錯……
...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
……但握住它，就等於引導 Ockar the Unseen Blade 本人的力量！那位戰時的督軍，光憑一把匕首就震住了一百隻惡魔！
Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
潛入敵人後方，頂著灼人的高溫！化身影子，眉頭都不皺一下就切開堅硬的岩層與岩漿！！
...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
……呃，是的。總之！衝著這個，我非拿出最稀有的存貨不可。一枚 Golemlus Power Core。要是被 Qira 發現我有這東西，我的下場會比死還慘。
She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
那些生物的祕密她鎖得死死的——而這東西一定就是解開那個謎團的鑰匙。人類，好好珍惜它！這可不是什麼普通的 Corkian 電池。
Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
在 {p} 找到想收購 [Golemlus Power Cell] 的人。Lodog 在 {~}, {~}, -{~}
Aight chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
好啦老大，我能為你效什麼勞？我這兒各式各樣的機器都有。總有一台入得了你的眼，聽見沒？
I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
這台榨汁機是我自己拼出來的！放顆檸檬進去，給它一點，嘿嘿，動力，一眨眼就有檸檬汁了！
Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business! Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
或者這台硬幣發射器怎麼樣？轉一下把手，它就能把任何硬幣大小的東西射得又快又準。不過呢，呃，別對著窗戶瞄，除非你真的很討厭那扇窗。
...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round, I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
……什麼？喔，我懂了。你覺得是「你」有東西能讓「我」感興趣，不是反過來。我明白了。那，讓我看一下。
...okay, I can't make heads or tails 'a this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-Legendary island!
……好吧，這玩意兒我完全看不出個所以然。你剛說這是什麼來著？別告訴我這是那座沒那麼「傳奇」的 Legendary Island 弄出來的 Corkus 小裝置！
...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
……好吧。這玩意兒我完全看不出個所以然。你剛說這是什麼來著？別告訴我這是那個不怎麼 {p} 的地方弄出來的 Corkus 小裝置！
...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This...hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about those wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell but this is an opportunity!
……一顆……一顆 Golemlus Power Core……？這……我的天啊！呀哈——，這種瘋狂的魔像玩意兒我老早以前就聽說過，我一直想把它們拆開來看！哎唷，這可是天大的機會！
Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
我得說，以一個從那座蜂巢出來的東西來說，它的紫色、黑色跟蜘蛛感都比我想的少太多了。這個複雜度……這絕對是真貨，可是……
Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is somethin' like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
感覺像是別人做的。那位 Qira 女士看起來不像會親自動手的類型，而這東西大概是 {~} 機械、{~} 魔法。實在不像她的作風。
Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!

……可是一旦離開溫暖的地方，他們就會把什麼都燒了。想想看——居然有人把他們當武器用。好端端的偏要瞎折騰……

我們得把這些 Flerisi 抓起來。來，拿著這張網。你去抓，我來修這台車，等一下好把他們裝進去。
Capture all of the rogue Flerisi and bring them to Axelus.
捕捉所有失控的 Flerisi 並帶回給 Axelus。
I'll keep the Flerisi in a smaller fire to keep them calm, see if I can't get them back to the Heights when this is done.
我會用比較小的火把 Flerisi 安撫住，看這件事結束之後能不能把他們送回 Heights。
For now, I want to see if I can find anything on who these traffickers were. Let's see if they left anything in the front of the cart.
現在我想查查這些走私販是什麼來頭。看看他們有沒有在車頭留下什麼。
Methinks this one's getting a bit out of control. This is right next to that big forest, too. Could be a problem if we leave this one be.
我看這一隻是有點失控了。而且這裡就緊鄰那片大森林。放著不管會出事。
We're going to have to track it down and subdue it. Here, follow me. I'll dig us down to the valley. Watch a dwarf at work!
我們得追上去把他制伏。來，跟我走。我挖條路帶我們下到山谷。看好矮人怎麼做事！
Not bad, eh? Anyways, dunno what that huge gate's for, but it looks like our Fleris friend has commandeered it for a bonfire.
不賴吧？總之，不知道那座大門是幹嘛的，但看起來我們那位 Fleris 朋友把它徵收來當營火了。
At least it's a little more contained than I thought, being in that cave, but we still have to catch it. Lead the way. I'm right with you.
至少在那個洞穴裡比我想像的收斂一點，不過我們還是得抓到他。你帶路。我就在你旁邊。
What the...?! It inflamed the creatures in this cave! Fend 'em off!
搞什麼……？！他把這洞裡的生物都點著了！擋住他們！
There are more of them coming! Get to the end of the cave!
還有更多過來了！往洞穴深處跑！
Both of us stopping is going to make it take too much time, the traffickers might come back!
我們兩個都停下來太浪費時間了，走私販可能會回來！
Listen up. I'll handle these things, while you go after the Fleris. If it's a big one like we think, it'll be a downhill battle- It should shrink if you attack it!
聽好。這些東西我來處理，你去追那隻 Fleris。如果真像我們想的那麼大，這一仗會愈打愈輕鬆——他被打會縮小！
Alright, time for a little royal rumble!
好，來場小小的皇家大亂鬥吧！
Phew, you're alright! Charred and covered in soot, but that's to be expected. Subdued the Fleris, too! I have the net with me, so allow me.
呼，你沒事！焦了一身又沾滿煤灰，不過這是意料中的事。Fleris 也制伏了！網子在我這，交給我。
Well, this is probably a bit of thankless work we just did, but so is a lot of work. Let's get out of here. We can talk outside.
嗯，我們剛做的大概是件吃力不討好的事，不過很多工作都是這樣。我們離開這裡吧。外面再聊。
Exit the cave and talk with Axelus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
離開洞穴，到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 跟 Axelus 說話。
Well, I say the work is thankless, but that won't stop me, anyways. Thank you for the help, human- This would've been overwhelming alone.
我說這是吃力不討好的活，不過那也攔不住我。謝謝你幫忙，人類——我一個人絕對應付不來。
Oh, where are my manners? Never even introduced myself this whole time. The name is Axelus. And yours?
噢，我真是失禮。這麼久了都沒自我介紹。我叫 Axelus。你呢？
{u}, huh? I'll try and remember that. For now, take this armor for the trouble. Safe travels, {u}!
{u}，是吧？我會記住的。這件護甲你先拿去，就當是這趟的補償。一路平安，{u}！
I ignored the warning at first, since the bridge is the only path into the jungle...
我一開始沒把警告當回事，畢竟那座橋是進叢林的唯一路徑……
If you want to ignore the military's warning, I suppose you might benefit from buying some our stock first. Our potions are stronger than any sold in {p}, after all!
如果你打算無視軍方的警告，我想你先買點我們的存貨應該不吃虧。畢竟我們的藥水比 {p} 賣的任何一種都還要強！
From the look of your equipment... I'd say you might have a better chance of making it across than us.
從你的裝備看來……我想你能過去的機會比我們大多了。
Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up and take a look at the drill, would you?
喂，衛兵！你懂電魔法嗎？上來看看這台鑽機，好嗎？
Now you've obtained the key, you can enter Theoricks mansion
你拿到鑰匙了，現在可以進 Theorick 的宅邸了
Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, I have a carriage for it.
我們一起去那座宅邸吧。來，我備了一輛馬車。
This is unbeliveable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.
這太扯了……他根本就是個貪得無厭的——啊啊啊啊。
There must be some way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.
一定有辦法打開它的。四處找找看有什麼發現。
Wow, even by todays standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
哇，就算用今天的標準來看，這也是一大筆錢。想想看，這在幾百年前又值多少。
Find Eppo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The entrance to his cave can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Darn. The drill just won't start.
可惡。這鑽頭就是發不動。
Oh! Never mind, it lit up, back up!
For the love of Bob... Why won't you just break?
看在 Bob 的份上……你怎麼就是不碎？
This ice was created by Theorick, a Twain who defended this area many many years ago.
這些冰是 Theorick 造的，他是很久很久以前守護這一帶的一位 Twain。
When the corruption got too much... He froze everything, including the people. Do you see them in there?
當腐敗蔓延到無法收拾……他把一切都凍住了，連人也不例外。你看見裡面那些人了嗎？
We've tried desperately to get them out, but we've tried all the equipment we had, including this Corkian drill.
我們拚命想把他們弄出來，手上所有的設備都試過了，包括這台 Corkian 鑽頭。
Maybe we should get more destructive... The demolition expert, Rhudya, is further down the cave.
也許該用更暴力的方式……爆破專家 Rhudya 就在洞穴更裡面。
It's a long shot, but worth a try. Would you be able to get it while I clear this space?
機會不大，但值得一試。我來清這塊地方，你能去把東西拿來嗎？
Go deeper into the cave and speak to Rhudya.
深入洞穴，與 Rhudya 對話。
Whup! You're on private property, y'know! Oh, Eppo sent ya? That's fair enough.
哇！你可是踩在私人地界上啊！喔，Eppo 叫你來的？那就沒問題了。
You'll be needing this TNT then, make sure not to drop it though, whup!
那你會需要這些 TNT，可別給我摔了啊，哇！
Just travel through this cave and you'll be returned to Eppo easy-peasy!
穿過這個洞穴，輕輕鬆鬆就回到 Eppo 那邊了！
Return to Eppo with the tnt.
帶著 TNT 回到 Eppo 那裡。
Very nice, this might do the trick.
Back up, I'll ignite the explosive.
NOTHING? Not even a scratch. I don't understand Theoricks ice.. It's not real.
什麼都沒有？連一道刮痕都沒有。我搞不懂 Theorick 這冰……這根本不像真的。
I'm not sure what else we can do then...
那我也不知道還能怎麼辦了……
HEY. Eppo, over here! Near the cave!
Did the explosive not work? I found this old mineshaft on the way back from the cave, it leads to an old lava cavern.
炸藥沒效嗎？我從洞穴回來的路上發現了一條舊礦坑道，通往一個古老的熔岩洞。
Might be a long shot, but this lava looks different. Why not give it a try?
機會或許不大，但那裡的熔岩看起來不太一樣。何不試試？
Travel to the lava springs through the mineshaft.
穿過礦坑道，前往熔岩泉。
Complete the puzzle and bring the lava back to Eppo.
解開謎題，把熔岩帶回給 Eppo。
I don't understand how you can hold lava in a bucket.. But here we are.
我不懂熔岩怎麼能裝在桶子裡……但事實就擺在眼前。
Truth is.. We're not retrieving these bodies for no reason.
老實說……我們挖這些屍體不是沒有理由的。
We believe one of these people worked for Theorick, and has a key to his mansion
我們認為這些人裡有一個曾替 Theorick 做事，身上有他宅邸的鑰匙
We in {p} think Theorick has a lot to answer for. We want to redistribute his wealth among those he hurt.
我們 {p} 的人認為 Theorick 欠了太多交代。我們要把他的財富重新分給被他傷害過的人。
Right, I've dipped this stick in the magical lava. Just hold the rod and walk into the ice to melt it.
好，我把這根棒子浸過那魔法熔岩了。你只要握著它走進冰裡，冰就會融。
Look for the corpse with a key, it might be above you. Good luck!
去找身上帶鑰匙的那具屍體，可能在你上方。祝你好運！
Melt the ice and find the Servant's corpse.
融開冰層，找到那名僕人的屍體。
Is that the right one? You got it? Brilliant! Now come back down.
是那一具嗎？拿到了？太好了！快下來吧。
Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, lets take my horse.
我們一起去那座宅邸。來，騎我的馬。
While we ride, let me explain a little more about what we're doing. Let's go.
路上我再多說一點我們在做的事。走吧。
As I mentioned before, there is a reason this land is frozen, and it's not natural.
我剛才說過，這片土地被凍住是有原因的，而且不是自然造成的。
Many years before Bob was around, Wynn was in ruins due to the corruption war.
早在 Bob 出現的許多年前，Wynn 就因為腐敗之戰而滿目瘡痍。
In those times there used to be a group of naturally gifted individuals called the Twains. They defended us all with elemental magic.
那個年代有一群天賦異稟的人，稱作 Twains。他們以元素魔法守護著我們所有人。
Theorick was one of those Twains. He harnessed unnaturally powerful ice based magic. He used it to protect the land surrounding the mansion.
Theorick 就是其中一位 Twain。他駕馭著強得不自然的冰系魔法，用它守護宅邸周圍這片土地。
Theorick.. Wasn't like the other Twains. He wanted the people he protected to pay and feed him as way of thanks.
Theorick……跟其他 Twains 不一樣。他要他所保護的人以錢財與糧食來答謝他。
After years, Theorick was rich while the people he protected lived in poverty and fear - not only of the monsters, but in fear of Theorick himself.
多年下來，Theorick 富可敵國，而被他保護的人卻活在貧困與恐懼之中——他們怕的不只是怪物，還有 Theorick 本人。
He punished those who disobeyed his curfews and would get angry if anyone tried to move away. The people felt trapped.
誰不遵守他的宵禁就會被懲罰，誰想搬走他就發怒。人們覺得自己被困住了。
Eventually, just like the other Twains - Theorick fell to the corruption. Not before he had the last word.
最後，跟其他 Twains 一樣——Theorick 也墮入了腐敗。但在那之前，他還留了最後一手。
He froze the land entirely, killing almost everything and everyone left outside in it. Hundreds of lives were lost.
他把整片土地徹底冰封，幾乎凍死了留在外頭的一切生靈。數百條性命就此消逝。
It turns out the ice slowed the spread of corruption across the land to almost a standstill. It's been this way ever since.
結果那些冰竟把腐敗在這片土地上的蔓延拖到幾乎停滯。從那時起就一直是這樣了。
Now that we can get in his mansion we hope to uncover the secrets of his ice magic so we may undo it, and share the wealth he hoarded from the people. Ah, we're here.
現在我們進得了他的宅邸，希望能揭開他冰魔法的祕密好把它解開，也把他從人民身上搜刮來的財富分還出去。啊，到了。
This place looks frozen in time.. The grandure.. Well he did just take and take from everyone around him.
這地方彷彿被時間凍住了……這般氣派……唉，他確實是不斷從身邊每個人身上榨取。
So, I'm not sure where to start, but I'm guessing he has some protection in place.
我不確定該從哪裡下手，不過我猜他一定設了什麼防護。
... I don't think we should insult him..
Find the riches in Theorick's mansion.
在 Theorick 的宅邸裡找出財寶。
Oof! Wasn't expecting that. That just proves everything I said about him. Punishing people who insult him.
唔！沒料到會這樣。這正好印證了我說的那些。誰罵他他就懲罰誰。
Anyway, we should look around for some kind of secret entrance.
總之，我們該四處找找有沒有什麼暗門。
Trust Theorick to booby trap his own house the paranoid frozen gro-
也只有 Theorick 會在自己家裡裝陷阱，這個疑神疑鬼的冰凍老怪——
That really isn't fun at all. I can't see a thing. Where are we now, a dead end?
這一點都不好玩。我什麼都看不見。我們現在在哪，死路嗎？
Well we know that insults result in punishment. Maybe a compliment will make him happy?
既然知道罵他會被罰，那讚美他會不會讓他高興？
Oh Theorick, strongest of all the Twains, you really are a hero.
噢，Theorick，Twains 之中最強的一位，你真是個英雄。
Looks like we finally found his private quarters, look at that vault door.
看來我們總算找到他的私人居所了，你看那道金庫門。
Find your way into the vault.
Grab a little for yourself, too, we wouldn't have been able to get here without you.
你自己也拿一點吧，沒有你我們根本走不到這一步。
Wait, look at this. It seems to be a piece of Theoricks armour.
等等，看看這個。這好像是 Theorick 的一件護甲。
You did it! We have access to the vault.
你做到了！我們可以進金庫了。
Surprised it even managed to fit over his fat head.
真想不到這居然套得下他那顆肥腦袋。
Speak to Private Tylas outside of Kitrios Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Kitrios Barracks 外與 Private Tylas 交談
……呼嚕……　……唔嗯。……再五分鐘鐘鐘……　……呼嚕……
...wh...? Oh...OH! Oh oh oh! Ahem! Yes, um! Absolutely sir! Right away sir! I don't think you're crazy at all sir!
……什……？喔……喔！喔喔喔！咳咳！是的，那個！當然沒問題長官！馬上就辦長官！我完全不覺得您瘋了長官！
...oh. Wait, you're just one of those heavily armored human types. Cripes, I thought you were Lecade... Even nuts as he's gotten I'd get the thumbscrews if he caught me napping.
……喔。等等，你只是那種全身重甲的人類啊。我的天，我還以為你是 Lecade……就算他瘋成那樣，被他抓到我打瞌睡，我還是會被整得很慘。
Hum...well, hey. You humans like doing work, right? I hear about it from folks in the army that you lot are pretty zealous about your favors.
嗯……不過，欸。你們人類喜歡做事，對吧？我聽軍隊裡的人說，你們這種人對接委託熱衷得很。
Then I think today might be your lucky day, because General Lecade is running out of free hands to push asinine tasks onto. No one knows what in the world's gotten into him.
那我想今天可能是你的幸運日，因為 Lecade 將軍已經快找不到閒人來塞那些荒唐的任務了。沒人知道他到底是哪根筋不對。
Between you and me, I'm using this time to work on sleep instead. I mean, honestly! He wants me to dance with the other privates to greet visitors! We don't even ALLOW visitors normally.
我私下跟你說，我拿這段時間補眠。真是的！他要我跟其他二等兵一起跳舞來迎接訪客耶！我們平常根本「不准」有訪客。

所以你要是想打發幾個小時，就去找 Lecade 談。上坡進軍營就是了。我要在這裡做我真正的守衛工作，而不是去跳那什麼放克 Grook 舞。
Hey, hey, hey! What is this person? Why is it in my administrator's? New work! New work! Get this person out of the administrator's!
嘿，嘿，嘿！這個人是什麼？為什麼他在我的行政官的裡面？新的工作！新的工作！把這個人弄出行政官的！
Wait. Wait, you. Wait right there. Don't move until someone comes to get you. Order! I order it!
等等。等等，你。就站在那裡等。在有人來帶你走之前不准動。命令！我命令它！
...okay, person. No one wants to bring you from administrator's, so instead I will give you another orders! Listen, listen, listen!
……好吧，人。沒有人想把你從行政官的帶走，所以我改給你另一個命令們！聽好，聽好，聽好！
