你之所以會站在我面前，當然是因為你成了我們拯救這個國家的計畫裡的一顆棋子。
I suppose I should apologize, but truth is you are the reason for this movement. Not you personally... but your people.
我想我應該道個歉，但事實是，這場運動正是因你而起。不是你這個人……而是你的同胞。
You... Look at yourself. You fight in a war you did not cause. You come from a land you don't even remember.
你……看看你自己。你為一場不是你挑起的戰爭而戰。你來自一片連你自己都記不得的土地。
We ask ourselves why would we invite people from two lands of sin. Invite a nation of warring travellers and a nation of greedy merchants to our doors?
我們不禁自問: 我們為什麼要邀請來自兩片罪惡之地的人？把一個好戰的旅人之國、和一個貪婪的商人之國請進我們的家門？
The Corkian people are above such mundane capitalism and brutality. We work as a nation to better all.
Corkian 人民不屑於那種庸俗的資本主義與野蠻。我們以整個國家之力，讓所有人變得更好。
You have been a pawn your entire existence on this world. The worst part is you don't even know it.
你這一生在這個世界上都只是一顆棋子。最糟的是，你自己根本不知道。
Do you, for example - Know the name of your ultimate enemy? The reason for the war on your land?
舉個例子——你知道你們最終敵人的名字嗎？知道你們那片土地上戰爭的起因嗎？
No? Didn't think so. I have no time for this. You served your purpose, even if you did try and redeem your barbaric behaviour... Kill them!
不知道？我就猜到了。我沒時間跟你耗。你的用處已經盡了，就算你確實試著彌補自己那些野蠻的行徑……殺了他們！
Fight and evade the waves of mobs until the timer runs out.
戰鬥並閃避一波波的怪物，直到時間結束。
Tougher than I expected. You don’t mind if I interfere a bit, do you?
比我預期的難纏。你不介意我插手一下吧？
You may have won this fight, but you are still the loser in this situation.
這一仗你或許贏了，但在這整件事裡，你依然是輸家。
Your eyes are still closed to the greater picture of it all. Corkus is the only place safe from it. I will make sure of it!
你的眼睛依舊看不見更大的全貌。Corkus 是唯一能倖免的地方。我會確保這一點！
There are still greater things in motion as we speak. Plans that will secure this island's safety.
就在我們說話的此刻，還有更大的事正在進行。那些計畫將保住這座島的安全。
Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… It’s all a joke. We all sit on the cusp of this reality, fighting only the prelude to the real war.
Fruma……Gavel……Wynn……全都是笑話。我們全都坐在這個現實的邊緣上，打的不過是真正戰爭的前奏。
This is our farewell. I must depart before the short sighted government arrive. Good Luck with your struggle.
我們就此別過。我得在那些目光短淺的政府趕到之前離開。祝你奮戰順利。
Now look who we got over ‘ere! We were all wondering if you'd ever wake up.
瞧瞧誰來啦！我們都還在猜你到底會不會醒過來呢。
Sorry we ever doubted ye. Weren't fair of us. What you drank was a rare brew designed to enrage and berserk someone.
抱歉我們曾經懷疑過你。那樣對你不公平。你喝下去的是一種稀有的釀酒，專門用來讓人暴怒發狂的。
Basically, it weren't yer fault lad. We never knew some Corkians were so closed minded.
說白了，這根本不是你的錯，小夥子。我們從來不知道有些 Corkian 心眼這麼窄。
Anyways! Look at what we got, thanks to you I acquired this little place!
總之！你看看咱們現在有什麼——多虧了你，我把這個小地方弄到手啦！
By means of reparations have this on me. Yer always welcome round here.
就當是賠罪，這杯算我的。你隨時都歡迎來這兒。
Go for a drink at the Corkus Docks Inn, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Corkus 碼頭旅店喝一杯
Talk to Javen to find out more about what happened.
找 Javen 問清楚發生了什麼事。
You should ask Javen about what happened.
你該問問 Javen 發生了什麼事。
Talk to citizens around the docks to find out more about what happened.
找碼頭一帶的居民談談，問清楚發生了什麼事。
You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise!
你從這裡衝出去，砸壞了一堆東西！你最好去找那些被你害到的人，好好道歉！
Hurry, please! Just head into the big trapdoor by the bushes, the controls are in there.
拜託快一點！直接進灌木叢旁那道大活板門，控制裝置就在裡面。
> Thank you for choosingsing CorkTech! Your company for a safe and trustworthy service.
> 感謝您選擇 CorkTech！為您提供安全可靠服務的夥伴。
You can push the button beside the crates to pick them up, and stand on the pressure plate to place them.
按木箱旁邊的按鈕可以把它們舉起來，站到壓力板上就能放下。
It seems like all crates are balanced now.
看來所有木箱都平衡好了。
I learned about some rumours involving separatists. I should continue helping locals to find out more.
我聽到一些牽涉到分離主義者的傳聞。我該繼續幫助當地人，問出更多東西。
Someone told you more about the patriots of Corkus. You should continue to find the missing clue.
有人告訴了你更多關於 Corkus 愛國者的事。你該繼續去找那條遺失的線索。
You manage to reach the chest safely, getting ready to jump through a hole the fire burned.
你順利來到箱子旁，準備跳過火燒出來的那個洞。
Follow the trail of blood close to the castle, [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
沿著城堡附近的血跡追查，[-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
You really don't see a reason to go in there at the moment.
你現在實在找不到進去那裡的理由。
Use the balloon to enter the suspicious hideout.
搭熱氣球進入那個可疑的藏身處。
Survive the fight against the drugged corkian
在與被下藥的 Corkian 一戰中存活下來
After witnessing your crash into the cliff, Corkian citizens informed the government.
目睹你撞上崖壁之後，Corkian 居民通報了政府。
Shortly after your victory security forces found the hideout and arrested the remaining separatists.
你獲勝後不久，保安部隊便找到了藏身處，逮捕了剩下的分離主義者。
Their leader was nowhere to be found.
Always nice to see my favourite customer pay a visit!
最愛的客人上門總是令人開心！
It's some kind of snake symbol, but it's probably not useful to you now.
那是某種蛇的符號，不過現在對你大概沒什麼用。
If you find any more leads remember to come to me - and if you find the murder weapon, make sure to bring it to us immediately!
要是你找到更多線索，記得來找我——還有，找到凶器的話，務必馬上帶來給我們！
Have you made any progress? There was a smashed window in there, it might be a good place to start.
你有進展了嗎？那裡有一扇被打破的窗戶，也許可以從那裡開始。
It looks like the victim's head was somehow detatched from his body...
看起來受害者的頭不知道怎麼從身體上被卸了下來……
The victim's book collection seems to be exclusively made up of dimestore romance novels.
受害者的藏書看起來全部都是廉價的愛情小說。
This painting doesn't seem to have anything to do with the murder, but its a nice landscape of {p}.
這幅畫看起來跟兇殺沒什麼關係，但它是一幅很不錯的 {p} 風景畫。
This half-finished letter seems to be asking for a loan to pay off some kind of debt...
這封寫到一半的信看起來是在請求借錢來還某種債務……
It looks like the attacker managed to break in through the window.
看起來攻擊者是從窗戶闖進來的。
It's a letter addressed to someone called Rohem in House No. {~} in {p}.
這是一封寄給 {p} 第 {~} 號屋一個叫 Rohem 的人的信。
If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation.
你要是找得到它，它會指給你進下水道的路。抱歉，我要是知道得更多就會告訴你。不過祝你調查順利。
Some of those gamblers had a symbol built into their homes, shaped like a snake. If you find it, it'll show you the way into the sewers. Good luck, officer.
那些賭徒有些人在家裡嵌了一個記號，形狀像條蛇。你要是找到它，它就會指給你進下水道的路。祝你好運，警官。
The barkeeper takes the snake symbol and examines it for a moment before nodding and giving it back to you.
酒保接過那個蛇形記號，看了一會兒，點了點頭就還給你。
The barkeeper gestures down to the open trapdoor.
酒保朝打開的地板門比了比。
But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, til neither of em had anythin' left.
不過他把 Eminar 帶來的那天，場面很快就難看了。一直跟 Rohem 借綠寶石又一直輸，輸到兩個人都一毛不剩。
Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back 'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
現在走吧；那邊牆上有個後門。不過你哪天想玩兩把二十一點，隨時回來，我們很樂意招待！
What are ya lingerin' around 'ere for? I've told ya all I know. Now either take a seat or get out.
你在這裡晃來晃去幹什麼？我知道的都跟你說了。現在要嘛坐下，要嘛出去。
Ya can then hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
然後你可以一直要牌，要幾張都行，或者停牌結束你的回合。目標是讓你手上的點數盡量接近 {~}！
It seems like you better go have a chat with Rohem...
看來你最好去跟 Rohem 談一談……
You should look around for clues that tie Rohem to the murder.
你該四處找找能把 Rohem 跟這場兇殺連起來的線索。
Get out of my house, officer, and don't you dare go rooting around in my property!
滾出我家，警官，還有你敢在我的地方到處亂翻試試看！
It's a dirty shovel - it must've been used recently to dig something up.
這是一把沾滿泥的鐵鏟——一定是最近才用來挖過什麼東西。
There's a trail of muddy footprints leading back into the house.
有一串泥腳印通回屋裡。
Whatever, you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
隨你怎麼說，你這根臉色蒼白的會走路的呆毛。你要去 {p} 了，罪名是一級謀殺。守衛，把他帶走。
Thank you for your help in catching the perpetrator!
Looks like the symbol has something carved in on the back...
這個符號背面好像刻了什麼……
到 [-{~1}, -{~2}] 找 Lorias 偵探說話。
Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
退後，人類！這裡是犯罪現場，歸我管。我不能讓你進去。
Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
不過……我們確實需要一些協助……而你經驗還算豐富，對吧？
Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
好，直說了吧——你覺得我有沒有可能雇你當私家偵探？
To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
講白一點，這棟房子的主人 Eminar 幾天前被謀殺了，而我們僅有的幾條線索全都斷了。
This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
這當然是違反規定的……但只要你能抓到兇手，我一定想辦法動用關係，付你一筆酬勞！
I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
我會確保沒有人在犯罪現場裡攔你。進屋去看看能不能找到什麼有用的東西。
My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
我和我的士兵會在屋外看著，保證沒人打擾你。裡面小心點！
Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.
Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
啊，一個人類！這年頭看到還挺新鮮的。我猜你是來找我的？什麼風把你吹來的？
An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
調查？！Eminar？這……這太荒唐了。我什麼壞事都沒做。
Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
不過，那可憐人。說起來，我和 Eminar 是好朋友。如果能幫忙找出兇手，我或許有些消息可以給你……當然，絕對不能留下紀錄……
Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
是這樣的。城裡的下水道藏著一間地下賭場。只有上流人士進得去，而 Eminar 剛好是常客。
Once, he even brought me along with him.
有一次，他甚至帶我一起去。
Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
不過 Eminar 那個人，常常想騙其他賭客。我想他們會受夠也只是遲早的事；被出老千，沒幾個人吞得下去。
Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
言歸正傳，他們之中很多人——包括可憐的 Eminar——都在自家牆上砌了一個蛇形的記號。可以說是會員證明吧。
Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.
Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.
在 {p} 的下水道裡找到那群賭客。
How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
你怎麼摸到我們這下面來的？我不記得你……你是警察的人吧？我猜是為了 Eminar 來的？
Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
對啦，他出的事我們聽說了。上面那邊可不是每天都在死人。而且說巧不巧，我不久前才在這下面看過 Eminar……
Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
這樣吧……只要你保證不查封我這裡，我就幫你。你應該猜得到，這地方很賺。
He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
有一天他被他朋友帶下來。是 Rohem。一個好客人，你懂的。從來不欠帳……
It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
那天對我來說是好日子，原因不用我說吧！可是 Rohem 氣炸了。而且醉得不省人事，不過那也不是新鮮事！
Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
從那之後兩個人都沒再來過，不過 Eminar 那邊的原因我倒是很清楚！希望這些夠你用了，因為我知道的就這些。
Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.
到 {p} 的 {~} 號房子當面質問 Rohem 謀殺的事。
Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
啊……又是你！你回來了。我看到了。老實說，我沒想到你會這麼快……回來……
You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
你真的找到下去的路了？哦，那……太好了……希望調查進行得順利。那麼，請你別再打擾我——
Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Valimare？呸！你憑什麼相信他說的話？他是個罪犯！騙子！我是把你指去找他沒錯，可是……
He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
該——該被你抓的是他。Eminar 對社會是個威脅，他是罪有應得，那個蠢貨——
Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
等等！不！別把我交出去！你就不能讓我把酒喝完嗎？出去，出去，你什麼都證明不了！
Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
再說了，你有沒有聽過一個叫「證據」的小東西？你根本拿不出證據！
Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
警官，如果你沒有正式的搜索令，我要求你立刻離開我的房產！
Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
到 {p} 的 {~} 號房子，在 Rohem 家附近找出兇器。
Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
嗨！我在院子裡挖洞，就跟 Rohem 先生昨天晚上一樣！
For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
我最後再說一次，警官，你要嘛拿搜索令給我看，要嘛滾出我的——你在我院子裡做什麼？！
A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
一……一把手斧？我不知道你在說什麼，我——我這輩子沒見過那東西！
Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
啊！該死的人類！我或許要進牢裡，但我可以先送你下地獄！
That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
夠了，Rohem！住手，不然衛兵就要動手了。
Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
啊！好吧，你抓到我了。但你記住我的話，人類，你還會再聽到我的消息的！
As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
至於你，人類，請接受我由衷的感謝。沒有你，我們大概抓不到那隻老鼠。
On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
我代表 {p} 全城，請收下這些綠寶石作為你的酬勞。你今天是位出色的偵探！
Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
嘿，你好啊！想不想來一把二十一點？
好嘞，我們來玩二十一點！
Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
太好了！把你的錢押下去，我就開始發牌。
Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
現在沒興致玩？沒關係，之後隨時再來！
Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
現在不行？沒關係——改天再來！
Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
啊，第一次玩是吧？沒關係，我從頭跟你說！
The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
規則很簡單！我發兩張牌給你，兩張都蓋著；我自己也拿兩張，一張翻開、一張蓋著。
Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
數字牌就是它的點數，所有人頭牌都算 {~} 點，A 可以算 {~} 點或 {~} 點，看哪個對你的手牌比較有利。
Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
超過 {~} 點就完了——你爆牌了！用現在的手牌停牌，就換我要牌或停牌，看能不能贏過你。
And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
如果你拿到二十一點——也就是一張 A 配一張人頭牌或十——賭金自動加倍還你！
Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
聽起來夠公道吧？好嘞，再右鍵點我一次就開始！
I'm sorry, recruit, but that passage is blocked. We used to use it, but not anymore...
抱歉，新兵，那條通道被封住了。我們以前會走，但現在不走了……
He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who we lost to spiders some time ago.
他……不好相處。他是我姊姊的兒子，我姊姊前陣子被蜘蛛奪走了性命。
With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken its toll on us both.
他父親又早已不在，我只好把他接來養。他現在是個大人了沒錯，可是……我怕喪親之痛在我們兩個心裡都留了傷。
I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
我真心希望他快點收起這些荒唐的把戲……但除了嚴厲說他幾句，我也狠不下心多做什麼。
He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. I only wish he would show that side of himself to others.
他是個好人，真的。我打從心底相信這一點。我只希望他願意把那一面展現給別人看。
{u}, hello! This place really is nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.
{u}，你好！這地方真的很不錯，對吧？我想在動身前往 {p} 之前再多待一會兒，不過我很快就會準備好。

你需要伐木等級 {~} 才能開始這個迷你任務。

蜘蛛我們殺得了！對吧，{u}？走吧，我們不就是來做這種事的嗎？我們當兵不就是為了幫助 Wynn 的人民嗎？先生，我們會幫你把蘑菇拿回來的。

啊，你們兩個一定就是 Aledar 一直跟大家提起的那兩位新兵。總算見到你們了，不過我不禁注意到，你們似乎是匆匆忙忙趕來的。
O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushrooms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-why wouldn't it b-be?
喔、喔！沒、沒事啊，什麼事都沒有。我的蘑、蘑菇……它們很好。你問這個做什麼？一、一切都很好。怎、怎麼可能不好？
Soon... s-soon I will have my m-mushrooms again...
快了……我的蘑、蘑菇快回來了……

咿、咿呀！你、你不知道偷、偷聽很沒禮貌嗎？
I-... this is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
我……這下糟了。真的糟了。我們得馬上告訴鎮長。

對！對。我們從 {p} 來，帶著壞消息，也來求援。森林裡的蜘蛛變得有攻擊性，已經威脅到鎮上了。
And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with him.
而且 Van 中尉正在籌劃突襲一座腐敗的要塞！多一些人手他一定很樂意。
In the meantime, I've been thinking about what we could do to help this place... I've maybe got something.
趁這段時間，我一直在想我們能為這個地方做點什麼……我好像有點頭緒了。
Take a look at that villager over there. He's acting a little off, like he's got something going on. I wonder...
你看那邊那個村民。他的樣子有點不對勁，好像有什麼事。我在想……
Alright, I've decided. I'm feeling a little restless, so let's go over there and see if there's anything we can help with!
好，我決定了。我閒得有點發慌，我們過去看看有沒有什麼幫得上忙的！
Maybe we can leave this place better off than it was when we got here!
說不定我們離開的時候，能讓這裡比我們剛來的時候好一點！
Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
G-... Hi! H-how can I help you on this... this p-perfectly fine and n-n-normal day!
呃——你好！今、今天這麼……這麼美好又正、正常的一天，有什麼我能幫忙的嗎！

抱歉打擾——我們是路過這個鎮的士兵，你看起來像是需要士兵幫忙的那種人。有什麼我們能幫上忙的嗎？

呃——不是，可是我們就是為這個來的啊！有沒有什麼我們能幫上忙的……呃。幫你的蘑菇？

嗯。一個士兵，兩、兩個士兵……你、你看起來很弱。我見、見過更強的。不、不過——嘿嘿，那些比、比較強的士兵……不在這裡。你、你大概夠用了。也許。
I- my favorite mushroom spot. I c-can't use it any-... anymore. Spiders. L-lots of spiders. They've t-t-taken over it... I can't get... mushrooms. Can y-you kill the s-s-spiders? Mushrooms.
我——我最愛的採菇點。我不、不能再用了。蜘蛛。好、好多蜘蛛。他們佔、佔據了那裡……我採不到……蘑菇。你能不能殺、殺掉那些蜘、蜘蛛？蘑菇。
Follow Yahya to his infested mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Follow Yahya to his infested mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
跟著 Yahya 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 被侵佔的蘑菇田

到、到了。我從這裡就……就感覺得到蘑、蘑菇。還有蜘、蜘蛛！不、不妙。

回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 向 Alvin 鎮長回報蜘蛛的事。

兩位是士兵吧？我想請你們繼續往 {p} 走。去找一位 Aegis 上將——告訴他我們這座小村子需要援助。

Travel to {p} to request the help of their military at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Travel to {p} to request the help of their military at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

又是這種東西？我們以前打過一隻，這次也可以！

呼。我覺得這已經是最好的結果了！
We're both in one piece, the corrupted is dead... Good. That's good!
我們兩個都平安無事，腐敗者也死了……很好。這樣很好！

我們繼續往 {p} 走吧。從這裡一路往東，應該不會太遠了。

……算了。我還活著，你也還活著……大概就夠了。我們去找 Aegis 上將吧。
...Oh, {u}, you're awake! I was really worried there for a bit...
……哦，{u}，你醒了！我剛才真的很擔心……

……我們就是這樣把那群不死生物解決掉的，長官！

那真是好消息。辛苦你了，Aledar。我會跟 Van 中尉談談，看他願不願意把你收進他的小隊。
Thank you for the opportunity, sir. I won't let you down-... Wait, is that- Tasim and {u}?
謝謝您給我這個機會，長官。我不會讓您失望的——等等，那是——Tasim 和 {u}？

Aledar！我們總算到 {p} 了。這一路上……可說是一場冒險。

鎮上有一位居民在我們眼前被抓走了。Alvin 鎮長派我們來請求 {p} 軍的援助。

好了，說正事。我們已經開始籌畫突襲蜘蛛的行動，但我們需要更多受過良好訓練的士兵。這位 Ragon 隊長應該能幫你磨練身手。

那如果我們想幫忙呢，長官？我在這裡待得有點發悶了。

嘖……又一個髒兮兮的窮鬼……不行，我不會給你錢。

好吧，那是一套通到全行省的地下運輸系統……當然，這跟你這種乞丐沒什麼關係。你這輩子都買不起一張票的！哈！

欸嘿……看來我完全誤會你了。我們，呃，就把先前的不愉快放下吧。

噢，嗨！你是這附近的人嗎？我叫 Maddison，是從 Aelumia 來的觀光客。
I've been travelling the Queen's Line all around Fruma to see what the rest of the province is like! It's been a fun time so far! ...Well, mostly...
我一直在搭女王線環遊 Fruma，想看看行省其他地方長什麼樣子！到目前為止都很好玩！……嗯，大部分啦……
This region has been... It's not quite what I expected. There's quite a unique culture here, though! Check out the cool wall art! You never see that back home!
這個地區……跟我想的不太一樣。不過這裡的文化很獨特！你看那些牆上的畫多酷！在我家鄉根本看不到！
I'm really looking forward to seeing what makes {p} different- that's where I'm headed next. So far, everywhere has been really unique!
我很期待看看 {p} 有什麼不一樣——那是我下一站。到目前為止每個地方都很有特色！
I'm just sad I'll miss their festival... The one here went... bad.
只可惜我會錯過他們的慶典……這裡的那場……辦砸了。
...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about?
Oh, well... Anything else you'd like to discuss?
噢，這個嘛……還有別的想討論的嗎？
Roughworks? Oh, right, that's what the people there call it. To me, it's the {p}.
Roughworks？噢對，那裡的人是這樣叫的。對我來說，那是 {p}。
I always imagined it being a bit... cleaner. Maybe the people there are just used to it being messy, though?
我一直以為那裡會……乾淨一點。不過也許那裡的人早就習慣它亂七八糟了？
A lot of the people I tried talking to were, well, not very nice. They didn't seem to like tourists all that much...
我試著搭話的人，很多都，嗯，不太友善。他們好像不怎麼喜歡觀光客……
Overall, it was... probably been the low point of my trip. I think it's just not for me, really. But there were some parts I liked!
整體來說，那裡……大概是我這趟旅程的低點。我想那裡真的不適合我。不過還是有些部分我喜歡！
I already mentioned the pretty murals, but there was a bunch of other cool stuff, too. Did you know the people there fight to resolve disputes?
那些漂亮的壁畫我剛提過了，不過還有很多其他很酷的東西。你知道那裡的人是用打架來解決紛爭的嗎？
...Or, wait. You would, since you're from here, right? Or... no, you're dressed pretty different. Where are you from?
……噢，等等。你應該知道吧，你是這裡的人嘛？還是……不對，你的穿著很不一樣。你是哪裡人？
{p}'s beautiful. I've lived there my whole life, it's my home, it's precious to me.
{p} 很美。我一輩子都住在那裡，那是我的家，對我很珍貴。
It's just... When you've lived somewhere for that long, it starts to feel... small. Samey. Especially when you're boxed in by those towering city walls.
只是……在一個地方住那麼久之後，它會開始讓人覺得……很小。都一個樣。尤其當你被那些高聳的城牆圍住的時候。
Don't get me wrong, I'm proud to live in the Queen's royal city, but... I needed something new. A change of pace. That's why I decided to go on this trip!
別誤會，能住在女王的王城我很驕傲，可是……我需要一點新東西。換個步調。所以我才決定出來旅行！
I'm lucky enough to be the daughter of one of the University's best-paid professors, so I was able to afford such a privilege. Those tickets aren't cheap...
我很幸運是大學裡薪水最高的教授之一的女兒，所以才負擔得起這種待遇。那些車票可不便宜……
...Anyway, sorry, that was a bit of a tangent. Overall, Aelumia's great if you enjoy the city life, it just... gets boring, eventually.
……總之，抱歉，扯遠了。整體來說，如果你喜歡城市生活，Aelumia 很棒，只是……久了就會膩。
So far, the trip's been pretty great! It's been really refreshing to see how different each region of Fruma is!
到目前為止這趟旅程都很棒！看見 Fruma 每個地區有多麼不同，真的很讓人耳目一新！
I've only been to the {p} and {p}, though. Both have been enlightening, in their own ways.
不過我只去過 {p} 和 {p}。兩個地方都各自很有啟發。
The {p} may be the most beautiful place I've ever seen... Not that that's saying much. The landscapes were incredible, and oh, the flowers!
{p} 可能是我看過最美的地方……雖然這麼說也沒什麼份量啦。那裡的風景難以置信，還有，噢，那些花！
The {p}? It's... I guess I've come to learn that some people live by different standards to me, which is... interesting.
{p}？那裡……我想我學到了有些人依照跟我不同的標準在生活，這……很有意思。
I'm a little sad the trip's coming to an end after the next stop... Fruma is so big, yet so small, isn't it?
下一站之後這趟旅程就要結束了，我有點難過……Fruma 好大，又好小，對吧？
I hear people used to live in the {p} and the Penitence District, but they were moved out. I wish I could go back in time and experience their culture, too.
我聽說以前有人住在 {p} 和 Penitence District，但他們被遷走了。真希望我能回到過去，也體驗一下他們的文化。
I think this might be the stop I'm most excited for!
我想這一站可能是我最期待的！
My dad teaches biology, and he's been all over the place studying the province's wildlife. His travels honestly inspired me to go on this journey.
我爸爸教生物學，他為了研究行省的野生動物跑遍了各個地方。老實說，是他的旅程啟發我踏上這趟旅行的。
Growing up, he told me stories of his trips... {p} was always the place that stood out the most, of the ones he described.
我從小聽他講他旅途上的故事……他描述過的那些地方裡，{p} 一直是最突出的。
It sounds like nothing you'd ever see anywhere else. Golden leaves, beautiful traditional architecture, and the kindest people...
聽起來那是別的地方絕對看不到的景象。金色的葉子、美麗的傳統建築，還有最善良的人們……
Needless to say, I've dreamed of going there my whole life. Of course, I also dreamed of going everywhere else, too. But Auburn most of all.
不用說，我一輩子都夢想著去那裡。當然，其他地方我也都夢想著去啦。但最想去的還是 Auburn。
Ah, them. I've not really spoken to either.
啊，他們啊。我其實兩個都沒怎麼聊過。
I tried talking to the one with the funny shirt, but they didn't seem much for conversation.
我試著跟那個穿著怪衣服的人講話，但他好像不太想聊。
The other guy? He seems to be from around here, and, well...
另外那個人？他看起來是這一帶的人，然後，嗯……
...I don't have anything against the people of this District, but their attitudes differ from mine, and...
……我對這個區的人沒有意見，可是他們的態度跟我不太一樣，而且……
...I'm just a little tired of being berated by them for coming here, okay?
……我只是有點累了，一直因為來這裡而被他們罵，好嗎？
Oh! The train's here! ...Uh, Guess I should catch you later?
噢！車來了！……呃，那我們待會兒見？
You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.
你想聊天？唉，好吧。好吧，隨便你。
Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the Industrial Distict was like.
唉。是這樣的，我是 {p} 來的。我……不喜歡那裡。所以我想看看 Industrial District 是什麼樣子。
Having been here yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
你自己也來過這裡了，我相信你很清楚結果如何。現在，我要回家了。
Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like this.
老實說，到了這個地步，我不知道這個行省還有哪裡值得看。大概到處都是這樣。
...But enough about me. What do you want to say?
……不過我的事講夠了。你想說什麼？
Sorry about that, I got... Madder, than expected... Anything else you'd like to discuss?
抱歉，我剛剛……比預期的更火大……還有別的想討論的嗎？
I chose the {p} because it was the cheapest ticket... I had to exchange so many materials for those weird emeralds they use here.
我選 {p} 是因為票最便宜……我得換掉一大堆材料才能拿到他們這裡用的那種怪綠寶石。
I had high expectations, thought seeing another part of the province might restore my hopes... It didn't.
我本來期待很高，以為看看行省的另一個角落也許能重拾我的希望……結果沒有。
I didn't even want to witness whatever mess the Festival there was going to end up being. It couldn't possibly compensate for missing the one back home.
那裡的慶典最後會搞成什麼爛攤子，我連看都不想看。那根本不可能彌補我錯過家鄉那一場的遺憾。
I'm just heading home. I guess I'll have to just... learn to like Auburn. Ugh...
我要回家了。看來我只能……學著喜歡 Auburn 吧。唉……
This shirt? Ugh... I forgot about this stupid shirt.
這件衣服？唉……我都忘了這件蠢衣服。
On the way here, some guy came up to me and begged on his knees for me to buy his shirt. It was hard to refuse... I felt bad...
來的路上，有個人跑來跪著求我買下他的衣服。實在很難拒絕……我於心不忍……
I guess "TC" stands for {p} City. For the record, I do NOT love {p} City.
我猜「TC」是 {p} City 的意思吧。我要聲明，我一點也不愛 {p} City。
In fact, this shirt doesn't even hold any value to me as a souvenier. I don't want to remember this trip.
事實上，這件衣服連當紀念品的價值都沒有。我不想記得這趟旅程。
I'm going to have to destroy it, or perhaps trade it for something. I never want to see it again.
我得把它毀了，或者拿去換點別的。我再也不想看到它。
It feels like we're living in squalor for no reason! You always hear these wonderful stories about other regions, like that the {p} have beautiful, huge lakes.
感覺我們毫無理由地住在髒亂裡！你老是聽到別的地區有多美好的故事，像是 {p} 有又大又美的湖。
If that's even true, why can't we get some of that water? Why must we put up with the pathetic trickle we get from the dam?
如果那是真的，為什麼我們分不到一點那些水？為什麼我們得忍受水壩流下來的那可憐的一點點？
And yet, everyone back home is just so... Okay??? With it??? They think the government couldn't wrong them. They build shrines to the Queen in their homes!
然而，家鄉每個人卻都那麼……接受？？？他們覺得政府不可能虧待他們。他們在家裡替女王蓋神龕！
It's just so... Frustrating!!! Why can't they see things the way I do??? The region itself is mostly fine, it's the people I can't stand!
這實在太……令人抓狂了！！！為什麼他們就不能像我這樣看事情？？？地區本身大致上還可以，我受不了的是那裡的人！
I don't even believe those stories anymore though... I think everywhere is just awful in its own way.
不過我現在連那些故事都不信了……我覺得每個地方都以自己的方式爛透了。
We were always sold this idea of the {p} as this beautiful place where proud workers labored for the Queen amidst beautiful crop fields... You've seen it, haven't you?
他們一直跟我們灌輸，說 {p} 是個美麗的地方，驕傲的工人在美麗的農田間為女王勞動……你看過了吧？
I bet everywhere is just as bad. I just don't know what to think of anything anymore. It all feels like a lie. But maybe I'm just asking for too much, I don't know...
我打賭每個地方都一樣糟。我已經不知道該怎麼看任何事了。一切都像是謊言。但也許只是我要求太多，我不知道……
Other people? The girl tried talking to me, but she left me alone when she realized I didn't want to talk.
其他人？那個女生有試著跟我講話，但她發現我不想聊之後就放過我了。
And that other guy? I didn't notice him until just now.
至於另外那個人？我到剛才才注意到他。
...Train's here. Stop talking to me, please...
……車來了。拜託別再跟我說話了……
Hey... Didn't I just ask you to not cause trouble? Could you stop that, please?
喂……我剛剛不是才請你別惹麻煩嗎？可以停下來嗎，拜託？
Listen. I don't feel like calling the guards over, okay? I'm asking you to please stop.
聽著。我也不想把衛兵叫過來，好嗎？我是在請你停手。
You're really annoying everyone here, including me. Thanks.
你真的把這裡每個人都惹毛了，包括我。謝了。
Sigh... Whatever, it's not like they're paying me enough to care...
唉……算了，他們給我的薪水也不夠讓我在乎……
Step aside, citizens. We're here on important business.
請讓路，市民。我們有要事在身。
The general of the Constables Division..? I wonder what's going on...
警備部隊的將軍……？發生什麼事了……
Keep your nose out of our matters, citizen. Our activities will have no impact on your trip.
別多管我們的事，市民。我們的行動不會影響你們的旅程。
Hey! What's the holdup? All aboard! Come on!
喂！在磨蹭什麼？全體上車！快點！
Hello passenger! I hope that the subway experience has been to your liking.
您好，旅客！希望這趟地鐵之旅還合您的意。
I am Telati, the attendant for your journey today. I am sorry I did not say hello when verifying your stamp, I was a little, uh, shocked by how many people were taking the train today.
我是 Telati，今天這趟旅程的車勤員。抱歉我驗章的時候沒跟您打招呼，我有點，呃，被今天搭車的人數嚇到了。
We don't get passengers often, to be honest with you, so to have even this many... That was a surprise. Not to mention General Levi being here, too.
老實說我們平常很少有乘客，所以光是這個人數……就已經很意外了。更別說 Levi 將軍也在車上。
Anyway, we should be arriving in {p} in an hour or two. Until then, feel free to talk with your fellow passengers, or take a nap.
總之，我們大概一兩個小時後會抵達 {p}。在那之前，您可以跟其他旅客聊聊，或是小睡一下。
I hope you have a good trip! And, if there's any issues, do not be afraid to speak with me.
祝您旅途愉快！如果有任何問題，別客氣，儘管找我。
Explore the train. Return to your seat at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] when done.
在列車上四處看看。結束後回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 你的座位。
Oh, hello there, passenger. Is something the matter?
噢，您好，旅客。有什麼事嗎？
...You just want to chat? You know what, sure, it could be a nice break from my busywork.
……您只是想聊聊？也好，這對我來說反而是從雜務裡喘口氣。
As I told you before, my name's Telati. I'm... the only staffer on the train today. Besides the driver, Cusef, but he's busy, well, driving.
我剛才說過了，我叫 Telati。我是……今天車上唯一的工作人員。除了司機 Cusef，不過他忙著，嗯，開車。
That means I'm the only person here to attend our many passengers today. Again, we don't usually get this many.
也就是說今天這麼多旅客，只有我一個人在服務。再說一次，我們平常不會有這麼多人。
It's... It's okay though. Everyone seems fairly content. Besides that Cemor guy, at least.
不過……不過還好啦。大家看起來都算滿意。至少除了那位 Cemor 先生之外。
Enough about that though. What would you like to talk about?
這個先不談了。您想聊些什麼？
Anything wrong? Or do you just want to chat?
有什麼不對嗎？還是您只是想聊聊？
...It's okay. I can handle it... Anything else to say?
……沒關係。我應付得來……還有別的話要說嗎？
...Perhaps I shouldn't have let that slip... Uhm... Anything else to say...?
……也許我剛才不該說溜嘴的……呃……還有別的話要說嗎……？
There aren't many of us, really. Each train usually has only {~} staffers- a driver and {~} attendants.
我們其實人不多。每列車通常只有 {~} 名工作人員——一名司機和 {~} 名車勤員。
The team for this particular train is Cusef the driver, plus Zathie and I.
這一列的團隊是司機 Cusef，加上 Zathie 和我。
This is typically enough, as the trains aren't very busy. Frankly, I don't know why they bother having this many carriages.
這通常就夠了，因為列車並不忙。老實說，我不懂他們幹嘛要掛這麼多節車廂。
It's usually only Aelumians and Highlanders who can afford trips, and, well... Most of those guys don't seem interested in seeing other regions.
平常也只有 Aelumia 人和高地人負擔得起旅行，而，嗯……那些人大多對看看其他地區沒什麼興趣。
This time of year is actually the exception, since the Festivals are on. But, having spoken to a few passengers, none seem to be travelling for that at all.
一年之中這個時候其實是例外，因為各地慶典都在辦。不過我跟幾位旅客聊過，沒有一個是為了慶典來的。
For today's trip to have so many people - and such a diverse set too - is an anomaly. It's... unfortunate timing, too, since Zathie's on break.
今天這趟能有這麼多人——而且組成這麼多元——是個異常。時機也……不巧，因為 Zathie 剛好在休假。
We were dealing with all the expected extra traffic from the Auburn Festival being on, and she burnt herself preparing a meal, so she got a couple days off.
我們本來就在應付 Auburn 慶典帶來的那波意料中的人潮，她準備餐點時燙傷了自己，所以放了幾天假。
I thought it'd be fine since the Auburn Festival's wrapped up, but... I guess there's still a lot of interest in going there?
我原以為 Auburn 慶典結束了應該就沒事了，結果……我想去那裡的人還是很多吧？
Ah, my home. It may surprise you, but I'm from the Roughw- er- {p}.
啊，我的家鄉。您可能會意外，我是 Roughw——呃——{p} 來的。
I'm lucky to have a job such as this, living where I do. The conditions aboard the train are heavenly compared to where my neighbors work.
以我住的地方來說，能有這樣一份工作算是幸運。列車上的環境跟我鄰居工作的地方比起來簡直是天堂。
...I do wonder why they can't share this quality of life. I suppose there must be a reason for it; I trust Her Majesty's judgement.
……我確實會想，為什麼這種生活品質不能分享出去。我想一定有它的理由；我信任陛下的判斷。
Ah, him. Yes, he's the Highlander sat in the dining carriage.
啊，他啊。是的，就是坐在餐車裡那位高地人。
He seems... needy. No- maybe that's just selfish of me to say.
他看起來……很難伺候。不——也許這樣說是我自私。
He keeps asking me to prepare him some specific meal, and... listen. The customer is always right, and all, but...
他一直要我替他做某一道特定的餐點，然後……聽我說。顧客永遠是對的，這我懂，可是……
I'm not the chef on this train. That's Zathie. I'm scared of messing up the recipe, and also just generally dislike cooking.
我不是這列車上的廚師。廚師是 Zathie。我怕把食譜做壞，而且我本來就不喜歡下廚。
So... I'm hanging out here as far away from him as possible, hoping he just... forgets about it.
所以……我躲在這裡，離他愈遠愈好，希望他就這樣……忘了這件事。
Sigh... Maybe that's immoral of me, I don't know.
唉……也許這樣很不道德吧，我不知道。
The train's like a second home to me. Maybe more of a home to me than my real home...
這列車對我來說像第二個家。對我來說，也許比我真正的家更像家……
It's the most comfortable place I've ever been. I love it here.
這是我待過最舒服的地方。我愛這裡。
Getting to travel all over Fruma for free is such a privilege, too, I've seen some beautiful stations...
能免費跑遍整個 Fruma 也是一種特權，我看過一些很美的車站……
Yes, just stations. They never let me go beyond. But there's some gorgeous sights to see from there alone up in {p} or at {p}.
是的，只有車站。他們從不讓我走出去。不過光是從 {p} 或 {p} 的站裡看出去，就有很壯麗的景色。
...I've only been to {p} a couple of times. It's military-only and they typically use their own trains to travel there...
……{p} 我只去過幾次。那裡只對軍方開放，他們通常用自己的列車往返……
...But sometimes, there are urgent matters that require the use of civilian trains. Today seems to be one such instance of this.
……不過有時候會有緊急事務需要動用民用列車。今天似乎就是這樣的情況。
Oh! I'm so sorry! I must've forgotten to give you that.
噢！非常抱歉！我一定是忘了給您那個。
I- I was in such a hurry to accomodate everyone, it must have slipped my mind... I sincerely apologize.
我、我當時忙著招呼所有人，一定是漏掉了……我誠心道歉。
Oh, alright then. Have a good trip!
噢，那好吧。祝您旅途愉快！
I TOLD you, idiot, ya need to wear Aelumia purple! Since we're not assigned to the Roughworks anymore!
我跟你「說」了，白痴，你得穿 Aelumia 紫！我們已經不歸 Roughworks 管了！
Lighten up, Maury. At least I used the right colour for my sword's hilt.
放輕鬆點，Maury。至少我劍柄的顏色用對了。
NO, Harvin, that is NOT GOOD ENOUGH. We're already on thin ice after the sewage incident.
不對，Harvin，那「還不夠」。污水那件事之後我們已經如履薄冰了。
Bein' assigned to the General is a BIG DEAL! We can't screw it up, or we're OUT.
被派給將軍是「天大的事」！我們搞砸就「完蛋」了。

我到現在還是覺得污水那件事被過度渲染了，不過隨便啦。
I agree, but that's not the p- Oh, hey there, citizen.
我同意，可是重點不在那——噢，嘿，市民。
Drop the act, Maury. They were there for like half the argument.
別演了，Maury。他們差不多從我們吵到一半就在那裡了。
WHAT? Why didn't ya tell me???
Ech... Whatever. You. Whaddaya ya want. You wanna chat? Got a problem to report? What's goin' on.
咳……算了。你。你想幹嘛。想聊天？有問題要報案？怎樣。
Got anythin' else you wanna say?
...We're movin' on before he says any more. Ask about somethin' else.
……在他再多說之前我們換個話題。問點別的。
Me too, bud, me too... Ah, right. You. Anythin' else to say?
我也是，老兄，我也是……啊，對了。你。還有別的想說的嗎？
That ain't fer your ears, kid.
We're guarding General Levi on her trip to {p}, where she'll be helping investigate some kind of bre-
我們在護送 Levi 將軍去 {p}，她要去協助調查某種破——
HARVIN, NO. She told us NOT to tell anyone what's goin' on. And this door's thin, what if she hears us?
Harvin，不行。她「交代」我們別跟任何人講。而且這門很薄，萬一她聽到怎麼辦？
I do wonder what happened though. She said it's really bad there, ton of soldiers dead supposedly, plus a Comman-
不過我真的很好奇發生了什麼。她說那邊情況很糟，據說死了一大堆士兵，還有一位指揮——
Every division of the Guard has a General leading it; she's ours.
衛隊的每一支部隊都有一位將軍領導；我們的將軍就是她。
We were just mindin' our business, roughin' up some... miscreants, and then she comes along an' drags us into bein' her guards for this whole shabang.
我們本來只是在做自己的事，教訓幾個……刁民，然後她就跑來把我們拖進這整場鬧劇當她的護衛。
...Between you an' us... I don't think she woulda made us come along had she not been in a hurry...
……我跟你講喔……我覺得她要不是趕時間，根本不會叫我們一起來……
Yeah, more likely, she would have just fired us on the spot.
對，比較可能的是她會當場把我們開除。
SHHH. What if she overhears? Don't give 'er any ideas.
噓。萬一她聽到怎麼辦？別給她出主意。
Stories? What am I, yer mother at bedtime? Why would I tell you sto-
故事？我是你媽在講床邊故事嗎？我幹嘛講故——
We could tell them about the time we were assigned to {p}!
我們可以跟他們講我們被派去 {p} 那次的事！
Ohhh, yeah! I love that story. Great thinkin', Harvin.
噢對耶！我最愛那個故事了。好主意，Harvin。
So basically, there's this guy who comes up to us, an' he's all like "ooh i'm from house blahblah you must respect me..."
總之，有個傢伙跑來找我們，一副「噢我是某某家的你們必須尊敬我」的樣子。
Us, bein' from the Roughworks, don' give a damn about any 'a that. So he gets mad when we laugh in 'is face.
我們是 Roughworks 出身的，根本不鳥那一套。所以我們當面笑他，他就火大了。
...accidentally knocks over a stall and gets himself totally covered in dyes!
……不小心撞倒一個攤子，把自己弄得一身染料！
YEAH, haha, his fancy clothes were ruined! It was awesome.
對啦，哈哈，他那身高級衣服毀了！超讚的。
Sadly, I think he actually had some influence, cause we've not been assigned to {p} since...
可惜的是，我看他還真有點門路，因為那之後我們就再也沒被派去 {p} 過……
Man, the {p} were beautiful, wish I could see them again.
唉，{p} 真的很美，真希望能再看一次。
The sewage incident is not to be spoken of.
We are NOT tellin' you about that, kid.
那件事我們「不會」告訴你的，小子。
Then go away, kid. We have important things to do.
那就走開吧，小子。我們有正事要辦。
...You again? Was it not clear enough that I wanted to be left alone?
……又是你？我不想被打擾，這還不夠清楚嗎？
Having been there yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
你自己也去過了，我相信你很清楚結果如何。現在，我要回家了。
Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like that.
老實說，到了這個地步，我不知道這個行省還有哪裡值得看。大概全都是那個樣子。
...But enough about me. What do you want to say?
……不過我的事講夠了。你想說什麼？
What do you want to say?
...I have a lot of thinking to do, basically. It would be easier to do that if you left me alone...
……基本上，我有很多事要想。你別煩我的話會比較好想……
It's the same experience as before, just... different.
跟之前是一樣的體驗，只是……不一樣了。
The first time, I was amazed... It's so comfortable and nice... I was so excited to see what awaited me in {p}...
第一次的時候我很驚豔……這麼舒服、這麼好……我那時好期待 {p} 有什麼在等著我……
Now? It all just feels like a facade. I can't enjoy it the same way.
現在呢？這一切都只像是表面功夫。我沒辦法再用同樣的心情享受它了。
Oh, yeah, they're here, I guess.
I don't really care, as long as they don't find some way to make my trip even worse...
我不太在乎，只要他們別想辦法把我這趟旅程弄得更糟就好……
They're agents of the Queen, and I don't really know what to think of that anymore. I can't tell if she hoards all the wealth for herself, or if she tells us everything's good just to make us happy.
他們是女王的人，而我已經不知道該怎麼看待這件事了。我分不出來她是把財富全都囤給自己，還是只是告訴我們一切都好，好讓我們開心。
Oh, hey again, friend. Nice to see ya!
噢，嘿，又見面了，朋友。真高興看到你！
The train's pretty nice, isn't it? If a bit... empty.
這列車還不錯吧？雖然有點……空。
I do wonder what was going on with the military presence... It's not every day that you see a General, after all.
我真的很好奇軍方那陣仗是怎麼回事……畢竟不是每天都能看到一位將軍。
Oh, hey, stranger. Looking for a chat? Sure, it'll help kill some time on the ride, I guess.
噢，嘿，陌生人。想聊聊？好啊，反正路上也能打發時間。
The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be going to the same stop as me? To {p}?
我叫 Malic，幸會。我猜你跟我要在同一站下車吧？去 {p}？
I'm pretty excited about it. In the Roughworks, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
我還蠻興奮的。在 Roughworks，人們幾乎沒有機會搭女王線。對我們來說通常太貴了。
Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right?
呵。我話太多了。你大概也有自己想聊的事吧？
...Anyway, what do you want to talk about?
It's, uh, a lot different to the trains back home. Nicer.
這，呃，跟我家鄉的列車差很多。好多了。
See, I commute to work on the Industrial Sector Loop, for which I am fortunate enough to have a free pass.
是這樣的，我通勤上班是搭工業區環線，我很幸運有一張免費通行證。
The trains there are... not like this. The seats are uncomfortable, it's usually packed with people, and it's never as clean.
那邊的列車……跟這個不一樣。座位不舒服，通常擠滿了人，也從來沒這麼乾淨過。
Why... Why are ours different? Why can't this quality be afforded to us..?
為什麼……為什麼我們的就不一樣？為什麼這種品質不能也給我們？
I'm very curious about their "important matters," it's highly unusual for them to travel with this amount of urgency.
我對他們的「要緊事務」非常好奇，他們這麼急著趕路是很不尋常的。

軍方通常是搭自己的列車，為了安全與保密。但像她這麼重要的人——警備部隊的將軍——竟然用民用列車……
...the Constables Division... I'm... not fond of them, to be honest. I'm sure you've seen, but they patrol all over the Roughworks, and they're just... such bullies.
……警備部隊……老實說，我對他們沒什麼好感。你大概看到了，他們在整個 Roughworks 巡邏，而且就是……那麼愛欺負人。
They're always going around, roughing up people for not paying their rent, or stepping even slightly out of line...
他們老是到處走動，只因為有人繳不出房租、或稍微越了一點線，就把人痛打一頓……
I know the General said her activities wouldn't impact the trip, but... I'm not convinced. I hope it'll be okay.
我知道將軍說她的行動不會影響這趟旅程，可是……我不太信。希望不會出事。
I've not spoken to anyone else on the train, but maybe I should. Could hear some interesting things about their regions.
車上其他人我都還沒說過話，不過也許我該去聊聊。說不定能聽到一些關於他們家鄉的有趣事情。
Besides the attendant, Telati, I seem to be the only Roughworker here. To be expected, of course, since none of us can usually afford such a privilege.
除了車勤員 Telati 之外，我好像是這裡唯一的 Roughworks 人。當然是意料之中，因為我們通常沒人負擔得起這種待遇。
Hm. I'll think about socializing in a little bit. But for now, I'm pretty comfortable, honestly.
嗯。等一下我再考慮去交際。不過老實說，現在這樣還蠻舒服的。
Oh, hello. Looking for a conversation to pass some time? Sure thing.
噢，你好。想找人聊天打發時間？沒問題。
My name is Demma, and I'm a student from the Aelumia University.
我叫 Demma，是 Aelumia 大學的學生。
I'm travelling to Auburn for my study project... I can't wait!
我要去 Auburn 做我的研究專題……真等不及了！

是這樣的，我是繁花學院的。我們研究生物學，而這門課最精彩的部分之一就是能出去做田野調查。
I'm conducting a study of Fruma's snails- they've always fascinated me... They come in so many different shapes and sizes...
我在做 Fruma 蝸牛的研究——他們一直讓我著迷……他們有那麼多不同的形狀跟大小……
Auburn forest has some of the greatest... I can't wait to see a Gigastropod in person!
Auburn 森林裡有一些最了不起的……我真等不及要親眼看到 Gigastropod！

天啊，我得打住，不然又要用我的長篇大論把你煩死了。我很常這樣。你其實想聊什麼？

……我們換個話題吧。還有別的想討論的嗎？

唉！我得改掉扯題外話的毛病。抱歉。換個話題吧。

Have you not heard of it? It's the most prestigious educational institution in the province!
你沒聽過嗎？那是全行省最負盛名的教育機構！

對喜歡學習的人來說，那是世界上最好的地方……我們有一座巨大的圖書館，幾乎你想得到的任何主題都有書！
You can only really study one set of topics at a time though, sadly, unless you're super dedicated.
可惜一次通常只能修一組主題，除非你非常拚。

它分成 {~} 個學院——秩序、水晶、繁花、星辰——每個學院各有自己的幾門學科。我在繁花，剛才說過了。
I chose Blossom for the biology, specifically. We also study history and fashion, but I care less about those.
我選繁花學院，正是為了生物學。我們也學歷史和時尚，不過我對那些比較沒興趣。

幾乎沒有人同時修過兩門課程。我想得到的唯一例外是 Majin 統領，他在秩序和星辰都念過。

他那些大話還真的撐得起來呢……

老實說，那裡的文化我沒那麼在意……是很酷啦，學它的歷史也很有趣，可是……

我真正想看的是那裡的動物群！那個地區有好多迷人的生物！

撇開蝸牛不談，我讀過好多關於那個地區野生動物的有趣資料。會模仿樹木的麋鹿、藏在葉子間的甲蟲，還有狐狸那麼大的蝙蝠！

光是讀就已經很享受了，親眼看到一定更驚人！

說真的，我也好想有一天能去 {p} 做田野研究。我的老師 Pestal 教授去過幾次。

聽說那裡危險到你得全程有軍方專業人員護衛……但那一定超酷的！我好想親眼看到 Kivaraptor！
From a young age, I've always loved animals, so joining Blossom House at the university just made sense.
我從小就一直很愛動物，所以進大學選繁花學院是很自然的事。
I grew up in {p}, so I've not seen much wildlife besides the limited amount that live in the city, plus some from travelling zoos.
我在 {p} 長大，所以除了城裡有限的那些、加上一些巡迴動物園的動物之外，我沒見過多少野生動物。

能有機會出去親眼看到更多，實在太美好了。我們已經在 {p} 做過一次田野研究，那次超棒的。
Professor Pestal - my teacher - has been all over the place studying the province's fauna. I'd love to be like him someday.
Pestal 教授——我的老師——為了研究行省的動物群跑遍了各地。我好希望有一天能像他那樣。
Hey... On that note, see that girl sat over there? That's actually his daughter, Maddison. It's crazy running into her here.
嘿……說到這個，看到坐在那邊那個女生了嗎？那其實是他女兒 Maddison。在這裡遇到她真是太巧了。
I've spoken to her before- she's nice. Very curious, always wanted to explore the province, looks like she's finally gotten her wis-
我以前跟她說過話——她人很好。很好奇，一直想去探索這個行省，看來她終於如願——
Oh, do NOT get me started on snails. I've always loved those little guys. They're so cute, and so interesting!
噢，「千萬別」讓我開始講蝸牛。我一直都很愛那些小傢伙。他們好可愛，又好有趣！

你知道嗎，他們其實不像大家以為的那樣是蟲，反而跟水生生物比較近緣？
It's really fascinating! They're also so different to creatures as we tend to understand them.
真的很迷人！而且他們跟我們一般理解的生物差別很大。

他們是雌雄同體，也就是說任何兩隻蝸牛都能繁殖！而且，他們——
Actually, maybe that's not an appropriate topic of conversation. Well, okay, I can think of something else...
呃，也許這不是適合聊天的話題。好吧，那我想想別的……

你知道他們有好幾千顆小牙齒嗎？而且他們聽不見！
Yet, despite these differences, they like, understand us! They show signs of enjoying human contact!
然而，儘管有這些差異，他們居然能理解我們！他們會表現出享受人類接觸的跡象！
There's also so many different species of snail, like the one I'm studying, the Gigastropod!!!
而且蝸牛的種類也超多，像我在研究的這種，Gigastropod！！！
Did you know that Gigastropod shells are tougher than concrete? You can stand on them and the creature will be fine!
你知道 Gigastropod 的殼比混凝土還硬嗎？你站上去他都不會有事！
...Though, I don't advise doing that- it's probably really scary for the poor snail.
……不過我不建議這樣做——那對可憐的蝸牛來說大概很可怕。
Apparently, back in the horrible Great Auburn Flood - you know - the one that kickstarted the New Age...
據說在那場可怕的 Auburn 大洪水的時候——你知道的——就是開啟新紀元的那一場……
...People survived by clinging onto the Gigastropods, because despite their hardy shells, they're also bouyant!
……人們是靠攀住 Gigastropod 活下來的，因為他們的殼雖然堅硬，卻也能浮起來！
Speaking of the dam, isn't it fascinating that Gigastropods are so closely related to the Murex Mollusc despite the sheer cliff between them?
說到水壩，Gigastropod 和 Murex Mollusc 之間隔著一整面陡崖，卻是如此近緣，這不是很迷人嗎？
Don't stand on Murex Molluscs though, they're toxic! Plus, their shells aren't as strong.
不過別站到 Murex Mollusc 上面，他們有毒！而且他們的殼也沒那麼硬。
Did you know that their slime-
OH, GOODNESS! I'm so sorry! I... I got carried away.
噢，天啊！真的很抱歉！我……我又講得太忘我了。
I've got a really bad habit of just... infodumping. I'm so sorry.
我有個很糟的習慣，就是會……一股腦兒地講個不停。真的很抱歉。
Gosh, we're going to arrive in {p} soon... It's quite exciting, isn't it?
天啊，我們快到 {p} 了……蠻興奮的，對吧？
I do wonder what was going on with the military activity back in the station... It was cool to see, but...
我真的很好奇車站那邊軍方在忙什麼……看起來是很酷啦，可是……
I just hope it doesn't ruin our trip, somehow...
我只希望那不會用某種方式毀了我們的旅程……
...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about?
The train's really cool to ride around on. The spectacle of it hasn't worn off on me, and this is my third time experiencing it!
搭這列車真的很酷。那種新鮮感到現在都還沒消退，而這已經是我第三次搭了！
In this area, I'm noticing a bunch of murals in the tunnels... It's fun to watch them, I just wish I could catch the details better.
在這一段，我注意到隧道裡有好多壁畫……看著很有趣，只可惜我看不清楚細節。
Can you imagine how beautiful it would be if the train was on the surface instead of underground? You'd get some amazing views of the province, I bet...
你能想像如果列車跑在地面上而不是地底下，會有多美嗎？我打賭能看到行省一些驚人的景色……
I do wonder why the train only runs underground. Safety, maybe?
我真的很好奇為什麼列車只在地下跑。也許是為了安全？
Having grown up in Aelumia, I'm pretty familiar with the Guard's upper ranks. There's military parades all the time, you know!
在 Aelumia 長大，我對衛隊的高階軍官還蠻熟悉的。那裡三天兩頭就在閱兵呢！
That scary lady we saw back there? That was General Levi, the leader of the Constables Division.
剛剛我們看到那位嚇人的女士？那是 Levi 將軍，警備部隊的領導者。
She took on the role a few years ago, when the previous General, General Daimyo, stepped down. She's pretty cool, it was a nice surprise seeing her here!
她是幾年前接下這個職位的，前一任的 Daimyo 將軍卸任之後。她蠻厲害的，能在這裡看到她是個不錯的驚喜！
I do wonder what calls for such urgency though... Usually, she has her Commanders handle most things. For her to need to handle something personally, and on a civilian train...
不過我真的很好奇是什麼事這麼緊急……平常她大多讓底下的指揮官處理。要她親自出馬，還搭民用列車……

「因此，所幸很少有人選擇將它用於這類目的。」
There's also an illustration of Murex Mollusc slime. It seems to match what you found on the blade perfectly. This must be it!
書上還有一張 Murex Mollusc 黏液的插圖。看起來跟你在刀刃上發現的完全吻合。一定就是它！
It's a key. Engraved on it is the word "MASTER". This must be Telati's missing key!
是一把鑰匙。上面刻著「MASTER」這個字。這一定就是 Telati 弄丟的鑰匙！
You slip it into your pocket. You can now access locked rooms.
你把它塞進口袋。現在你可以進入上鎖的房間了。
You're sure you can break that rule for the sake of the case, though. Open the door?
不過為了辦案，你相信破一次規矩應該沒關係。要開門嗎？
It's a book with a knife on the cover, with no title to be seen. You try to read.
是一本封面畫著刀的書，看不到書名。你試著讀讀看。
...Almost all of the pages are glued together, and a knife-shaped compartment is carved into them.
……幾乎所有書頁都被黏在一起，中間還挖出了一個刀子形狀的凹槽。
This must be how the murderer smuggled the weapon onto the train!
兇手一定就是這樣把兇器偷渡上車的！
I mean, maybe they want to ask us some questions, Maury.
我是說，也許他們想問我們一些問題啊，Maury。
Your takeaway from that... conversation... is that the General was completely unguarded.
從那段……對話……你得出的結論是，將軍當時完全沒有人在保護。
It seems that the cafe isn't open right now.
咖啡廳現在似乎沒有營業。
Are you sure you want to make an accusation? You will not be able to go back on this decision!
確定要提出指控嗎？這個決定將無法反悔！
Are you sure you would like to accuse Flinn? You cannot go back on this decision!
確定要指控 Flinn 嗎？這個決定無法反悔！
Are you sure you would like to accuse Demma? You cannot go back on this decision!
確定要指控 Demma 嗎？這個決定無法反悔！
Are you sure you would like to accuse Telati? You cannot go back on this decision!
確定要指控 Telati 嗎？這個決定無法反悔！
Are you sure you would like to accuse Malic? You cannot go back on this decision!
確定要指控 Malic 嗎？這個決定無法反悔！
Are you sure you would like to accuse Cemor? You cannot go back on this decision!
確定要指控 Cemor 嗎？這個決定無法反悔！
Are you sure you would like to accuse Maddison? You cannot go back on this decision!
確定要指控 Maddison 嗎？這個決定無法反悔！
Thank goodness he didn't stick around. After all, you wouldn't want him to see what you kept from the crime scene, would you?
幸好他沒有留下來。畢竟，你也不想讓他看到你從案發現場帶走了什麼，不是嗎？
Read the Help Wanted sign in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
你好，歡迎來到 Ynnos 的研究設施。
Oh, you're here about the job vacancy? Well, you're a little late.
喔，你是為了那個職缺來的？嗯，你來得有點晚了。
There might still be time, just sneak in to the conference room behind me.
或許還來得及，你就從我後面偷偷溜進會議室吧。
Enter the conference room and listen to the scientist.
進入會議室，聽科學家講話。
I am Ynnos, one of the leading scientists in Gavel. You're here because... Well you read the help wanted sign.
我是 Ynnos，Gavel 頂尖的科學家之一。你們會來這裡是因為……嗯，你們看了徵人告示。
Allow me to explain the situation we're in. It's a series of unfortunate events. I study the amazing properties of crystals and other geodes.
容我說明一下我們的處境。這是一連串不幸事件。我研究的是水晶與其他晶洞的驚人性質。
I am funded by a private organization, however that seems to have stopped. So... We had to make cuts in the budget.
我的經費來自一個私人組織，不過那筆錢似乎斷了。所以……我們只好縮減預算。
One of these, was using cheaper rope. While moving the crystal across {p}, well, it snapped. The crystal fell.
其中一項就是改用比較便宜的繩索。結果在把水晶運過 {p} 的時候，繩子斷了。水晶掉了下去。
I can not stress the value of that crystal. It had many unique properties that are allowing me to understand why the {p} float the way they do.
我再怎麼強調那顆水晶的價值都不為過。它有許多獨特的性質，正讓我逐步理解 {p} 為什麼能那樣浮在空中。
They hold the very key to restoring this land to being whole once more... But it's gone.
那些性質正是讓這片土地重新完整的關鍵……可是它沒了。
Fortunately, I detected an impact. It's hit something down in the void. We're not sure what, however or how deep.
所幸，我偵測到了一次撞擊。它在虛空底下撞到了什麼東西。不過我們不確定是什麼，也不知道有多深。
Your mission will be to retrieve the crystal in a specially designed ship to withstand the void. We barely scraped it out of the budget, so try to bring it back in one piece.
你的任務是搭乘一艘專為承受虛空而設計的船，把水晶取回來。那艘船的預算是好不容易才擠出來的，所以請盡量把它完整地帶回來。
If you think you are not up for the challenge, leave now...
如果你覺得自己應付不了這個挑戰，現在就離開……
When you think you are ready, exit the room behind me and meet me at the dock as soon as possible.
等你覺得準備好了，就從我後面的出口離開，盡快到船塢找我。
Wait for the submarine to arrive at the void islands.
等待潛艇抵達虛空群島。
This is the ship's mechanic. There appears to be a fault on the lower deck. I request urgent assistance.
這裡是船上的機械師。下層甲板似乎出了故障。我需要緊急支援。
I wonder what the mechanic is doing?
不曉得機械師在忙什麼？
He has been screaming and crying for a while now. I hope everything is alright down there.
他已經又叫又哭好一陣子了。希望下面一切都還好。
Ah finally! One of the air pipes has shattered, we need to patch it up ASAP!
啊，終於來了！有一根空氣管破裂了，我們得馬上把它補起來！
Quick, head into the room behind me and line up the white glass with the blue blocks. I'll control things from here!
快，進我後面那個房間，把白色玻璃和藍色方塊對齊。我從這裡操控！
Take a nap in the resting room.
Oh wow, thanks for the help! You should head up to the resting room and take a nap before we arrive at the first island.
喔哇，謝謝你幫忙！趁還沒到第一座島，你先上去休息室睡一下吧。
Talk to the captain outside of the submarine.
到潛艇外面與船長交談。
We have encountered out first island, {~}m down. Crew members, climb up the ladder and search the island for the crystal.
我們抵達第一座島了，深度 {~} 公尺。組員們，爬上梯子，到島上搜尋水晶。
We've arrived at the next void island.
我們抵達下一座虛空島了。
The void islands are really different from Gavel... Or are we still even in Gavel?
這些虛空島跟 Gavel 真的很不一樣……還是說，我們其實已經不在 Gavel 了？
Anyway, let's explore the island, look for the crystal, and return to {p}!
總之，我們去探索這座島，找出那顆水晶，然後回 {p}！
Explore the island and look for the crystal.
Return to the submarine and continue your journey.
回到潛艇，繼續你的旅程。
Oh my, what are these creatures!?
我的天，這些生物是什麼？！
They are attacking the windshield in the front room, it looks like it's about to break any moment!
他們在攻擊前艙的擋風玻璃，看起來隨時都會破！
Quick, you! Come to the cockpit and press on the window to scare them off!
快，你！到駕駛艙來，按住窗戶把他們嚇走！
This is not good, the creatures destroyed part of the windshield.
這下不妙，那些生物把擋風玻璃弄破了一部分。
We can't continue much longer with a broken windshield, we'll have to repair it at another island.
擋風玻璃破了，我們撐不了多久，得在下一座島上修好它。
Ynnos said the void has pockets of toxic gas... Go take a nap, I'll wake you up when we're there.
Ynnos 說虛空裡有一團團的毒氣……你先去睡一下，到了我叫你。
Meet up with the captain outside the submarine.
Attention crew. We have arrived at the second island, {~}m down. We cannot progress without making some emergency repairs.
全體組員請注意。我們抵達第二座島了，深度 {~} 公尺。不做緊急維修就沒辦法繼續前進。
Crew, please disembark and search resources to help repair the ship. We need glass and some kind of glue.
組員們，請下船搜尋可以用來修船的資源。我們需要玻璃和某種黏著劑。
The void creatures did heavy damage to our craft, we need to repair the submarine.
那些虛空生物把我們的船弄得傷得不輕，得把潛艇修好。
I'm not sure what we'll find here, but we'll need some glue and glass...
我不確定這裡找得到什麼，但我們需要某種黏著劑和玻璃……
I doubt we'll find those exact things, so get resourceful!
我很懷疑能找到一模一樣的東西，所以動點腦筋吧！
Bring me [{~} Sand Substitutes] and [{~} Glue Substitutes], that should be enough.
帶 [{~} Sand Substitutes] 和 [{~} Glue Substitutes] 給我，那樣應該就夠了。
Find [{~} Sand] and [{~} Glue] on the void island.
在虛空島上找到 [{~} Sand] 和 [{~} Glue]。
Ech! What is this stuff? Well, this should do the trick.
呃！這是什麼玩意兒？算了，這應該行得通。
The mechanic and I will start repairing. It'll take a while, so enter the submarine and rest up.
我和機械師這就開始修理。要花一段時間，你先進潛艇休息吧。
We'll continue the trip when we've repaired the ship.
等船修好，我們就繼續上路。
This is the mechanic, requesting urgent assistance in the basement!
這裡是機械師，請求地下層緊急支援！
Toxic gas has leaked in through the submarine's vents, someone will have to manually close them.
毒氣從潛艇的通風口滲進來了，得有人手動把它們關上。
I'll control things from here, someone get down to the lowest level and close those vents!
我從這裡操控，誰下到最底層去把那些通風口關掉！
Attention crew. We have arrived at the next island {~}m down.
全體組員請注意。我們抵達下一座島了，深度 {~} 公尺。
Disembark and start the search for the crystal.
Let's hope it's here... I don't know how much more void my body can handle.
希望這次真的在這裡……我不知道我的身體還能撐多少虛空。
Look out! {u}, we'll build a bridge to the other island whilst you defend us from the mobs!
小心！{u}，我們來架橋通到另一座島，你負責擋住那些怪物！
Keep fighting! We're almost halfway to the other side!
繼續打！我們快架到一半了！
Return to the submarine and continue the journey.
We didn't find the crystal here either. Maybe it just fell in the void?
這裡也沒找到水晶。搞不好它就直接掉進虛空裡了？
No, it must have hit an island. The scientist said he detected a collision.
不對，它一定撞到了某座島。那個科學家說他偵測到撞擊。
The ropes are snapping! Quick! Abandon ship!
Someone dropped a boooook about you people! Warriors! Workers!
有人掉了一本關於你們的書——下來！戰士！工人！
Ah. Yoooou want to know about this place?
啊。你——想知道這個地方的事？
Well... We were once Villagers. I think we still are, a bit.
這個嘛……我們曾經是村民。我想我們現在還有一點是。
For some reason, {~} years agoooo. The sky islands ruptured.
不知道為什麼，{~} 年前——天空群島碎裂了。
Some stayed. Others fell. We somehow survived the fall into the vooooid.
有些人留了下來。有些人墜落。我們不知怎麼地在墜入虛空——之後活了下來。
How we have lived for so long, I doooo not know. But one thing we know for sure. The void provides.
我們為什麼能活這麼久，我也不——知道。但有一件事我們很確定。虛空會供養我們。
We are stuck here now. The void has forever changed our physiology.
我們現在被困在這裡了。虛空已經永遠改變了我們的身體構造。
The crystal yoooou are looking for fell on this island. But...
你——要找的那顆水晶掉在這座島上。但是……
We need it. It will aid us for years.
我們需要它。它能供養我們很多年。
We have very limited resources here. That's why a power source like this is soooo valuable.
我們這裡的資源非常有限。所以這樣的能量來源才會這麼——珍貴。
If you go to the east, you will find Rontaid, our chief scientist. He'll know what to doooo.
往東走，你會找到 Rontaid，我們的首席科學家。他會知道該怎麼——辦。
Talk to Rontaid outside the town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到城鎮外 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Rontaid 交談。
Well, looks like the book we found wasn't fiction after all!
哎呀，看來我們撿到的那本書終究不是虛構的！
This crystal is going toooo be our saviour. I was trying to create one of my own, you know.
這顆水晶會是我們的——救星。我自己也一直想做一顆出來呢。
I think I have the formula, but we don't have what we need to make it.
我想我已經有配方了，可是我們沒有製作所需要的東西。
Instead of taking this crystal back, why don't I exchange it for the recipe?
與其把這顆水晶帶回去，不如我拿配方跟你換，如何？
That way, you can make however many crystals youuuu want, and we can keep this one.
這樣一來，你——想做幾顆水晶就做幾顆，而這一顆我們留著。
Here's the recipe, give it to a scientist or someone a bit...smarter than yourself. No offense.
配方在這裡，交給科學家或哪個比你稍微……聰明一點的人。無意冒犯。
A platform was lowered from the surface a while ago at your crash site, as well. If youuuu wish to return, follow this path, I made a shortcut.
另外，前陣子有個平台從地表降到你們的墜毀地點了。你——要是想回去，就順著這條路走，我開了一條捷徑。
Return to the crash site by following the road.
順著道路回到墜毀地點。
Return to the scientist and tell him the news.
回去找科學家，告訴他這個消息。
You survived! Where is everyone else?
I knew some must have died... But all of them?
我就知道一定會有人死……可是全部？
Well... At least I don't have to pay them! Hah!
嗯……至少我不用付他們薪水了！哈！
...That was heartless of me, I'm sorry. The rope we used was too weak to hold you down there.
……我這麼說太沒良心了，抱歉。我們用的那條繩子太弱了，撐不住你們在下面的重量。
My calculations didn't account for the void's physics, it seems.
看來我的計算沒有把虛空的物理法則算進去。
At least we got you back in one piece. You can tell us what happened.
至少你完好無缺地回來了。你可以告訴我們發生了什麼事。
Well I'll be damned. I'll start sending post down there! We can work together.
我的老天。我要開始往下面寄信了！我們可以合作。
Better to keep everything that happened here a secret. I don't want to lose what little funding I have. This recipe is genius! Here, take this, as well as your money.
這裡發生的一切最好都保密。我不想連現有的那點經費都丟掉。這個配方是天才之作！來，這個連同你的酬勞一起拿去。
It looks like everyone already went inside the submarine.
看來大家都已經進潛艇了。
對講機劈啪作響，傳出了聲音……
Looks like you managed to fix the pipe! You should tell the mechanic.
看來你成功修好水管了！你該去告訴技師。
Who would've thought that the crystal fell that far...
誰想得到那顆水晶竟然掉得那麼遠……
But after all, there's still a lot ahead of us!
不過說到底，我們前面的路還長著呢！
Have you looked around for the island for the crystal yet?
你在島上找過那顆水晶了嗎？
If you haven't found anything, jump back in the submarine and I'll take us down to the next one.
如果什麼都沒找到，就跳回潛艇裡，我帶我們下潛到下一座。
I've been hearing a lot of strange sounds...
我一直聽到很多奇怪的聲音……
Pfft. I would've done a better job saving the windshield.
哼。換作是我，擋風玻璃一定保得更好。
Too bad I was in another room.
可惜我剛好在別的房間。
Oh no, this isn't good. The windshield is destroyed...
噢不，這下不妙。擋風玻璃毀了……
I thought this trip was going to be easy.
我還以為這趟會很輕鬆。
This sand must've fallen from the sky islands, but why is it red?
這些沙子一定是從空島掉下來的，可是為什麼是紅色的？
It smells really...sterile? Does this mean I have to work...?
聞起來真是……很無菌？這是不是代表我得幹活了……？
We need this crystal. Go see Rontaid on the eastern part of the island, he can figure something out.
我們需要這顆水晶。去島的東邊找 Rontaid，他會想出辦法的。
I hope you make use of our science.
希望你能善用我們的科學。
We don't want another village to fall down here... I'm not sure we could provide for even more people.
我們可不希望又有一座村子掉到這下面來……再多一些人，我們恐怕養不起。
Looks like the backup team have lowered a crane down to the island, this is your way out!
看來支援小組已經把起重機放到島上了，這就是你的出路！
I'm working on a replacement for the crystal now...
我現在正在研究那顆水晶的替代品……
These void villagers are rather smart, but their handwriting is utterly atrocious.
這些虛空村民相當聰明，但他們的字跡實在醜得要命。
The crystal you're looking for is purple, not blue.
你要找的水晶是紫色的，不是藍色的。
You probably could've seen that from the other side.
你大概從另一邊就看得出來了。
Wait Viola, this is our chance! This stranger sure seems like they could tackle anything, even evil hermit crabs! We could just ask them to see if these rumours are true!
等等，Viola，這是我們的機會！這位陌生人看起來什麼都應付得了，就算是邪惡的寄居蟹也一樣！我們可以直接請他們去看看那些傳聞是不是真的！
I don't know, you guys, all these rumours seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be some mad scientist?
我說啊各位，這些傳言聽起來都有點太離譜了。接下來呢？難不成他還會突然變成什麼瘋狂科學家？
Let's go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
走吧，我帶你去出口，就不再耽誤你的時間了！
So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have just been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
所以你一定在想，怎麼會直到現在才遇見我這樣一位出色的人物？老實說，你八成只是運氣太差，我可是走遍過世界的人呢！
Oh the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
噢，我去過的地方都好精采！從叢林的最深處，到叢林沒那麼深的地方，甚至我家後院，探險這件事我可沒少做，這話我自己說也不怕。
You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {u}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
{u}，你是我最近見到的第一個正常人。我前陣子出門一趟，結果被幾個非常沒禮貌的鎮民說了幾句非常沒禮貌的話！
The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even there to hide from! Strange people.
我上次去鎮上的時候那裡也空蕩蕩的，但我感覺得到人們都躲在自己家裡，即使那天天氣那麼好。根本就沒有人需要他們躲！一群怪人。
Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books for hours too! Here's one right now.
我們到了，圖書館！我可以在這裡待上好幾年，但誰有那個時間呢？我也可以聊書聊上好幾個小時！瞧，這就有一本。
The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back friend, I can't do this alone!
地在搖……我以為那應該要晚一點才發生的！回來啊朋友，我一個人應付不來！
If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shelf hitting you square in the head!
你要是還記得的話，我們當時正在討論怎麼把門關好，突然有個很重的東西從架子上掉下來，正正砸中你的頭！
During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping something heavier on your head for the second time.
剛才震動的時候，我有幾台機器散架了，不過我們可以拿這些零件組出一台能把更重的東西砸到你頭上的裝置，來上第二次。

Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose were you want it to go and face.
照這個邏輯，一切當然非順利不可，你說是吧。現在讓我說明要怎麼做。首先，選好你要用哪個零件來組我們的機器，然後選它要放在哪裡、面向哪邊。
Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all that shaking!
快，穿過那道大門，去阻止震動的源頭！
I don't know about you, Todd, but I feel we should make them our new honorary club member for finding such amazing things!
我不知道你怎麼想，Todd，但我覺得他們找到了這麼了不起的東西，我們該讓他們當我們新的榮譽社員！
Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you've got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.
別理 Viola，她今天鬧脾氣，大概是因為這次鋒頭被你搶了。不過，我同意 Prentiss 的話。
Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to others with style.
歡迎你加入社團，新成員！這是你亮晶晶的新徽章，你可以戴著它在鎮上四處走，很有派頭地向別人炫耀你有多酷。
You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?

Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.
在樹屋跟 {p} 的孩子們說話。
Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
你們兩個有沒有聽說有個傢伙在鎮上到處晃？我聽到一些關於他的怪傳聞……

當然聽過啦，他可是全鎮的話題！我聽說他一天只刷一次牙，而且他喜歡看園藝的書！
Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
噓，安靜點，我們又不是活在故事書裡！何況他要「真的」是瘋狂科學家，不是應該像故事裡那樣想佔領整座城市嗎？
To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
跟我聽到的其他事情比起來，那對我來說一點都不奇怪……好像還有什麼實驗室，還有一個「隱士」。
I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
我覺得那是一種螃蟹之類的吧。大人有時候真的怪得可以。
Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
喂，陌生人！你偷聽我們多久了？你媽沒教過你禮貌嗎？
Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
別理那邊那兩個，他們一直都這樣，不過 Prentiss 說得沒錯。這可能是我們唯一能弄清楚那個神祕男人到底是誰的機會！
It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
也許可以去看看城市東南方那片陰森廢墟旁邊那間怪房子。我們撿到這把鑰匙，你可以試試看，弄丟的話我們基地還有備份。

Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
你好啊陌生人！歡迎來到我這間簡陋的木屋。很舒服吧？我猜你一定想來一杯這個咖——

喔對了，我就是那個和藹可親的 Ariodo，友善的鄰家鄰居。你找我有什麼事嗎？
Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
綁架？盜獵？沒刷牙？！你說的那個下流坯子是誰啊……聽起來可不像我這麼好的人。

這是你剛剛來的那個房間。我叫它「Vivarium」，這名字我自己想的，很有創意吧？裡面養著那些還沒準備好的寵物。
Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
準備好做什麼？那說出來不就破梗了嗎？可不能讓人在大日子之前就發現。
Let us go now, time is precious.
I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
我就是個普通人而已，為什麼就沒有人肯欣賞我一次呢？你一定會的，對吧？

This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
這本叫《Sweeney S. Greenville 冗長而痛苦的死亡》，我得說這是書堆裡的滄海遺珠！有一天它就這麼突然出現在這裡，我實在忍不住讀了下去。故事一開始是 Sweeney S. Greenville……
We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
我們到了！走你正前方那個出口，右邊那條走廊別管它，那只是裝飾！

Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
改天再來喝杯茶或咖啡，好好聊聊書吧，我注意到你對我那段冗長的書評很有興趣！在外面玩得開心，別忘了，我永遠都在這裡等你！
Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
做一台機器敲自己的頭，讓自己恢復正常
Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
幫我把這扇門頂住，不然我的驚喜就毀了！
Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
靠邊站就好，那樣比較安全。
Just stay here for one more momen...
Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
我的天，鬼？等等，這該不會是你這位可靠的朋友在整我吧？不是？那這下真的麻煩了！

我好像也撞到頭了，所以每個零件放哪裡得靠你決定。記得，目標是把椰子送到綠色的格子上。
You're back! To be quite honest, I didn't think that would work, but I'm glad it did!
你回來了！老實說我沒想到那真的會有用，不過成功了我很高興！
Find a way to destroy the plant monster, then return to the group in {p} at [-{~},-{~}] to report your findings
想辦法消滅那隻植物怪物，然後回到 [-{~1},-{~2}] 的 {p} 向大家回報你的發現

不過你做了你該做的事。朋友，我很遺憾要這麼說，但我想我會在裡面再多待一陣子。抱歉了，我唯一的朋友。
We'll surely meet again in the future, so don't be sad. I'll still be the one and only friendly neighbourhood neighbour when that moment comes, I promise. Goodbye now!
我們將來一定會再見的，所以別難過。到那時候，我依然會是那個獨一無二、友善的鄰家鄰居，我保證。再見啦！
You're back! You were gone for ages too, and what happened to your head? Who did the mystery man turn out to be?
你回來了！而且去了好久，你的頭是怎麼了？那個神祕男人到底是誰？
That sounds ridiculous! Who could ever belie-
那聽起來太荒謬了！誰會相——
Wow that sounded just like in the stories, but it came from you, so it must be true!
哇，那聽起來就跟故事裡一樣，可是是從你口中說出來的，那就一定是真的！
Why do I even try... You two would believe anything.
我幹嘛還白費力氣……你們兩個什麼都信。
I'm pretty sure they mentioned something about being hit by coconut crabs, and just look at their head. One... two... two huge bumps!
我很確定他們提到被椰子蟹砸到什麼的，你看看他們的頭。一個……兩個……兩個大包！

好啦好啦……隨便你怎麼說，Prentiss。我相信他們下次一定會帶你去什麼亂七八糟的冒險！
Thanks to you, we solved the case of the mystery man as well as the mystery house! For this I'd like to...
多虧了你，我們把神祕男人的案子還有神祕房子的案子一起破了！為此我想要……

還有，既然大人都這麼做，我們也要給你一些綠寶石，這是你憑本事拿到的獎勵。大家都出了一份！

...{p}. Ha, the... the tourists really weren't lying when they kept saying it was a work of art.

住在這裡想必很好吧……可以無視其他地方正在發生的一切……

那我為什麼不行？！我們等愈久，出、出事的機會就愈多！！我們現在就得走！

有，我有一個。找到那個統領。放出 Rex 和 Zeph。然後離開那裡！
I'll... f-fill in the details as we go. I will! We just need to go already!
細節……我、我們邊走邊補。我會的！我們現在就得走！
我們要把他們帶去哪裡？

我想……樹冠？我們可以把他們帶去樹冠！那……那就行得通……

嗯……不、不知道。可是——可是我們可以找到知道的人，然後——然後把情報逼出來！
We can do that. Captain Fuhue, she... told me about some of her methods! I just... need to find someone who... knows...

如、如果非得那樣不可的話！！我們不是連 Gikyo 都殺得掉嗎？
Even if it was hard... and Majin is... probably stronger...
就算那很難……而且 Majin……大概更強……
Good. Okay! To start with, we...
Okay, fine, maybe you're right! Just... ugh!! We have to do something!
好啦，好吧，也許你說得對！只是……唉！！我們總得做點什麼！
...right. That's... smart. Word's probably spread from, um, {p}, hasn't it...? We'll need to blend in better.
……說得對。那……很聰明。消息大概已經從，嗯，{p} 傳過來了吧……？我們得混得更自然一點。
And... we don't know how long it'll be until we... find the information we need. So... a place to say, too?
而且……我們不知道要多久才能……找到需要的情報。所以……也得有個地方住？
Okay. Find new clothes, and find a place to stay. That's a plan. We can do that.
好。找新衣服，找住的地方。這是個計畫。我們做得到。
Indeed, I am. I was raised here in {p}.
沒錯，我是。我在 {p} 這裡長大。
Though, in truth... I've never really left. I'm planning on enlisting in the military once I've completed my provincial tour.
不過老實說……我從來沒真正離開過。等我完成行省巡遊，就打算從軍。
I've been saving up for years for a round-trip ticket throughout the province... I'd like to see all of the less-fortunate regions firsthand.
我存了好幾年的錢，就為了一張環遊全行省的來回票……我想親眼看看那些比較不幸的地區。
I'm leaving just after the festival. Exciting, isn't it?
我慶典一結束就出發。很令人期待吧？

旅館……唔。我知道好幾家，不過大部分大概都因為即將到來的慶典訂滿了。

銀行北邊有一家高級旅館……叫王冠寶石，我想？不過對你們來說大概太貴了。
A fine question. I'm not too certain, honestly... growing up here has made me overlook things.
好問題。老實說我不太確定……在這裡長大反而讓我對很多事情視而不見。

不過我知道觀光客通常是為了看我們這裡的大宅與城堡而來的。也許你們會有興趣？
How might I help you this fine day?
今天這個好日子，我能幫上什麼忙嗎？

好得不能再好了！謝謝你的關心。

Ah... tourists from the lower districts, I take it? A fine use of your travel allotments.
啊……我猜是從下面幾個轄區來的觀光客？把旅行配額用在這裡是很好的選擇。
You will want to visit the bustling market on the west side, it would be a shame to miss it!
你們會想去西側那個熱鬧的市集，錯過就太可惜了！
And if you wish to leave the bounds of the city, I have heard one may find tour guides which will bring you to see the mountains!
如果你們想離開城的範圍，我聽說可以找到導遊帶你們去看山！
Yes, {p} is known for its high fashion, isn't it? I'm certain you've heard about it... wherever you come from.
是的，{p} 以高級時尚聞名，不是嗎？我相信你們一定聽說過……不管你們是從哪裡來的。

如果有興趣，著名的 Til 家在北邊擺了一個快閃服飾攤。
I wish you the best on your stay! Praise be to her Majesty!
祝你們這趟旅程順心！讚頌女王陛下！

我早該想想住哪裡的……我從來沒搭過火車，所以所有心思都花在確保那件事順利上了！
And now all the hotels except the Crown Jewel are fully booked! Will I... will I have to sleep on the street?
結果現在除了王冠寶石以外的旅館全都訂滿了！我……我難道得睡在街上嗎？
Oh, what am I going to do...?
Oh, thank you, thank you! The Queen herself must have sent you my way!
喔，謝謝你，謝謝你！一定是女王陛下親自把你送到我面前的！
...short on emeralds too, are you? Maybe we can share a comfy bush together! Ha...
……你的綠寶石也不夠嗎？也許我們可以一起分享一叢舒服的灌木！哈……
Oh, I'll remember you forever! You've truly made this festival the best one yet!
喔，我會永遠記得你的！你真的讓這場慶典成了最棒的一次！
I can't wait to tell my old folk all about it! How the Queen had blessed me with this miracle...
我等不及要跟我家鄉的老人家講這件事了！女王如何以這場奇蹟賜福於我……
But, it wasn't the Queen that... oh, nevermind.
可是，那並不是女王……喔，算了。
Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
你好，你好！要不要買一份我們的好報紙？也許今天你比較想看雜誌——我聽到了不少精彩的八卦喔。
Hm... Do I want the Crown of Seraphim collection, or the Peacock Couture...
唔……我要買 Crown of Seraphim 系列，還是 Peacock Couture……
Oh, this is important... a whole year's paycheck is going towards this!
喔，這很重要……我一整年的薪水都要花在這上面！
Well, it seems you're in luck! Considering this is a pop-up clothes stall, and all.
