那是當然！籌碼在我們手上……你想必是來找你那兩位被囚禁的親愛朋友的，不是嗎？
What a simple lure... but effective, evidently! It has drawn you in, right where we want you.
多麼簡單的誘餌……但顯然有效！它把你引了進來，正好落在我們想要的位置。
Oh, really! My my, I would have never guessed - to think, holding them captive might draw you in! What an astonishing revelation.
噢，真的嗎！哎呀哎呀，我真是萬萬沒想到——想想看，把他們扣為人質竟然可能把你引來！何等驚人的洞見。
They are here, certainly. But you will not be seeing them. There are greater plans in motion, it would seem!
他們確實在這裡。但你見不到他們。看來還有更大的計畫在進行！
Fight you?! and ruin my decor? Ha! Ahahahaha! Goodness, no, of course not. If I were, you would already be dead.
跟你打？還把我的裝潢毀了？哈！啊哈哈哈哈！我的天，當然不。我要是想打，你早就死了。
Perhaps at some later date I might be more amenable to wiping the floor with you! But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
也許改天我會比較樂意把你按在地上摩擦！可惜我們恐怕還有正事要辦。
Oh, take that dour look off your face. Perhaps if all goes well, we might be willing to discuss returning those friends of yours! I certainly have no need to keep them.
噢，把你那張苦瓜臉收起來。也許一切順利的話，我們會願意談談把你那兩位朋友還給你！我確實沒有留著他們的必要。
I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waste my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
說真的，我留那兩個能有什麼用？浪費我的力氣去撬出我早就知道的情報？
You tell her how you finally killed it. How it fought, and fought, and fought, but could not take you down. How the Light was freed from the Shadows.
你告訴她，你最後是怎麼殺死他的。他如何奮戰、奮戰、再奮戰，卻始終無法打倒你。光明又是如何從暗影中獲得解放。
I mean, really, what use could I actually have had for those two? Waster my efforts pulling information out of them that I already know?
說真的，我留那兩個能有什麼用？浪費我的力氣去撬出我早就知道的情報？
It was pathetic, honestly. The two of them, sitting in front of me, sniveling like little babies...
老實說，那很可悲。他們兩個坐在我面前，像小嬰兒一樣抽抽噎噎……
"Spare me, great Sovereign! Spare me, great Sovereign!"
「饒了我吧，偉大的統領！饒了我吧，偉大的統領！」
As if that would save them! Ha! Hahahahahaha!
彷彿那樣就能救他們！哈！哈哈哈哈哈哈！
Oh, but what does it matter? They are not important, but you... it would seem Her Majesty has taken interest in you, heavens know why.
噢，不過那又如何？他們不重要，但你……看來女王陛下對你產生了興趣，天曉得為什麼。
But before that, seeing as you are a guest of honour here in House Thalas... allow me to lead you on a tour of the castle!
不過在那之前，既然你是 Thalas 家的貴賓……請容我帶你參觀這座城堡！
You should feel honoured. Receiving such a personalized tour is quite an uncommon occurrence around here! Do feel free to write about it in your memoirs... if you ever get the chance.
你該感到榮幸。在這裡，能得到這種私人導覽可是相當罕見的！儘管把它寫進你的回憶錄……如果你還有機會的話。
Oh no, dear guest, I'm afraid you are not. You do not have a choice in the matter, in fact!
噢不，親愛的客人，恐怕你不是。事實上，這件事你沒有選擇。
Oh, but I rather do insist! You've come this far, haven't you? And you're a guest of the House- it would be quite rude for you to decline.
噢，可我還真的堅持！你都走到這一步了，不是嗎？而且你是這座宅邸的客人——你要是拒絕，那可相當失禮。
So come along, now. There's much to see, much to do! And we wouldn't want to keep her waiting, would we?
那就跟上吧。有很多要看的、很多要做的！而我們可不想讓她等，是吧？
Oh, did I forget to mention? There's someone who would like to meet you! Our Spymaster has finally returned from abroad, and she has much to say to you.
噢，我是不是忘了說？有一位想見你的人。我們的諜報總管終於從境外回來了，她有很多話要對你說。
Follow Majin on the tour of his castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟著 Majin 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 參觀他的城堡。
Now. To begin with, to your left you'll see my personal library!
那麼。首先，你左手邊看到的是我的私人藏書室！
I've amassed quite a large collection, you see. Numerous books written by famous writers from all over the province! Some of my personal work is also featured here.
瞧，我蒐集了相當可觀的一批。全行省名家所寫的無數書籍！其中也有幾部是我自己的作品。
And straight ahead, we'll reach my secret, not-so-secret, tower of magical tomes and scrolls.
而正前方，我們會抵達我那座祕密——又不太祕密——的魔法典籍與卷軸之塔。
Over the years, I've acquired much... hm, shall we say, "forbidden" literature of that variety. The Cursed simply will not stop trying, no matter how foolish the act!
這些年來，我取得了不少……唔，該怎麼說呢，那一類的「禁書」。那些受詛者就是不肯放棄，無論那舉動有多愚蠢！
I'd say I have mastered... ah, about half of the spells and rituals featured here? It depends on your definitions- goodness knows the psionics have it rough.
我會說我已經精通了……啊，這裡收錄的法術與儀式的一半左右？那要看你怎麼定義——天曉得靈能那一塊有多難搞。
Oh, good grief, don't play dumb. I know full well that you understand the term. You all out there in Wynn make great use of it, or so I've been told.
噢，天啊，別裝傻。我很清楚你懂這個詞。你們在 Wynn 那邊可是把它用得很兇，至少我是這麼聽說的。
It truly is a wonder you manage to get anything done out there! Where is the control, the coordination?! No, I much prefer how we handle things here in Fruma, thank you.
你們在那邊居然還能把事情辦成，實在是個奇蹟！掌控在哪裡？協調在哪裡？！不，我遠遠更偏好我們在 Fruma 的做法，謝謝。
Yes, the Psionics... old history, that is. Sometime during the RA years, I believe? They had been mistaken for the cursed, and were exterminated by the crown for it.
是的，靈能者……那是舊事了。我想是在 RA 那幾年間？他們被誤認為受詛者，因此遭王室滅絕。
A mistake, if you ask me! Psionic abilities certainly should not be considered the same as magic, they're quite different in how they manifest... but alas, it is what it is.
要我說，那是個錯誤！靈能能力絕對不該與魔法混為一談，兩者的顯現方式相當不同……但唉，事已至此。
Cursed?! Ha! Oh, no no no, I was not "cursed". I believe you and I both understand the meaninglessness of that terminology, hm?
受詛者？哈！噢，不不不，我可不是什麼「受詛者」。我相信你我都明白那個詞有多麼沒有意義，嗯？
Curses, blessings... a means of controlling the public. A rather useful one, at that - though I never did follow the rules.
詛咒、祝福……不過是控制大眾的手段。而且相當有用——雖然我從來沒照規矩走。
In the end, magic is but another way to obtain power over the weak... is it not natural to seek it out oneself, in order to achieve greatness?
說到底，魔法不過是取得凌駕弱者之力量的另一種方式……為了成就偉大，親自去追求它，難道不是天經地義嗎？
I don't suppose you would understand. You don't seem the type to have ever reached such heights. Regardless, let us press onward!
我想你大概不會懂。你看起來不像是曾攀上那種高度的人。無論如何，我們繼續吧！
Hm... I shall leave you to peruse my collections for the time being. The tour shall continue at the top of these stairs! Don't take too long, would you?
唔……我暫且讓你自行瀏覽我的收藏。導覽將在這道階梯的頂端繼續！別花太久，好嗎？
Ah... this before you is my planetarium. Quite the marvel, don't you think? On my journey in developing my magical prowess, I developed quite the interest in the cosmos.
啊……你眼前這座是我的天象廳。相當了不起，你不覺得嗎？在我磨練魔法造詣的路上，我對宇宙產生了濃厚的興趣。
It was this very room in which I discovered the comet which would be named after me! Majin's Comet... this year will be the third time I see its purple shine fly through the night sky.
正是在這個房間裡，我發現了那顆後來以我為名的彗星！Majin 之彗星……今年將是我第三次見到它紫色的光芒劃過夜空。
In truth, it fascinates me... the power and mystery lying dormant behind each and every star, just waiting to be tapped into!
說實話，它令我著迷……每一顆星星背後都潛藏著力量與奧祕，只等著被汲取！
Well, I suppose it wasn't much of a surprise when that was the shape Her Majesty's blessing took on, once I received it on ascension.
嗯，所以我想，當我在飛升時領受女王陛下的祝福，而它化為那個形態時，並不算太意外。
Why are you telling me this?
你為什麼要告訴我這些？
As I said before, it's quite uncommon for me to personally give a tour of the castle. I take the opportunity to speak on my many accomplishments whenever I can!
我先前說過，由我親自導覽城堡是相當罕見的。我一有機會就會把握，好好談談我的種種成就！
Oh, and you mean to tell me that if you had a voice like mine, you wouldn't do the very same? Ha! Perhaps someday, you'll understand.
噢，你的意思是說，如果你有我這樣的聲望，你不會做同樣的事嗎？哈！也許有一天你會懂。
Ah, the Sovereigns' blessings... they truly are an assorted bunch. Each taking on a distinct shape based on the person receiving it.
啊，統領們的祝福……它們確實五花八門。每一份都依領受者而呈現出不同的形態。
I wonder, what could yours have looked like? Anything would be more interesting than that of your friend's... oh yes, "Intention." How passive, how boring.
我很好奇，你的會是什麼樣子？什麼都會比你那位朋友的有趣……噢對，「意念」。多麼被動，多麼無聊。
But I suppose it's just as well, given his... shall we say, transience. Quite the mission he's signed himself up for! What a relief that I have no need to concern myself with it.
不過我想那也剛好，考慮到他的……該怎麼說呢，短暫。他替自己攬下的可是個大任務！所幸我完全不必為此操心。
...oh, yes, this here is my hobby tower! I had it constructed - what was it, {~} years ago? - in order to store all my various projects. I'm a man of many interests, you see.
……噢，對了，這裡是我的興趣塔！我是——多久前來著，{~} 年前？——蓋起來收放我各式各樣的計畫的。畢竟我是個興趣廣泛的人。
As of late, I've been experimenting with gardening, of all things. Incredibly boring, mind you - a word of advice? Don't bother. It is not worth your time.
最近我居然在嘗試園藝。無聊透頂，我告訴你——一句忠告？別碰。不值得你花時間。
Ah... a better view than this is hard to come by. The {p}, in all their glory! Who needs the {p} when you have this!
啊……比這更好的景色可不好找。{p}，盡展其榮光！有了這個，誰還需要 {p}！
不過我們到了。你好，諜報總管。
Sovereign Majin. And {u}. I've been expecting you.
Majin 統領。還有 {u}。我一直在等你們。
Talk to Sovereign Majin and the Spymaster at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Majin 統領和諜報總管談話。
It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it? And you've been busy.
我們上一次面對面已經有一段時間了，不是嗎？而你一直很忙。
So in the end you made the choice to search for your answers... bold, I'll admit. You've caused quite the disruption thus far.
所以最後你選擇了去尋找你的答案……我承認，很大膽。你到目前為止造成了不小的擾動。
I am the Second, the Spymaster. You may call me Two.
我是第二位，諜報總管。你可以叫我 Two。
You've quite the set of accomplishments, it turns out. Careless work by our inquisitors, perhaps, that we did not know beforehand... with some exceptions, granted.
看來你的成就相當可觀。也許是我們審訊官的疏忽，讓我們事先不知情……當然，有幾件是例外。

想想看，幽影竟是被你親手打瞎的！當然，代價不小……但一個破碎的靈魂在更大的舞台上算不了什麼。

如果我們早知道，你會得到更多考慮嗎？也許。也許不會。每一項缺陷仍舊一如既往地致命。
Oh, get to the point, would you? I have more important things to attend to then this frivolous attempt at information gathering.
噢，講重點好嗎？我還有比這場空洞的情報蒐集更重要的事要辦。
Of all your accomplishments, of all your history, of each point along your storied trail, there is but one we cannot see. A place we cannot go.
在你所有的成就、你全部的過往、你那條傳奇路徑上的每一個節點之中，只有一處我們看不見。一個我們去不了的地方。
You and the Light's Scion entered the Realm of Light. At a time pinpointed to have transpired during your stay within, the spread of Gavel's Decay abruptly ceased.
你與光之後裔進入了光之領域。而根據我們的推定，正是在你停留其中的那段期間，Gavel 黯蝕的擴散驟然停止。
You would later return to your numerous adventures, not a sign of ever having traversed the realms at all. She has not been seen since.
你後來回到了你眾多的冒險之中，身上沒有任何曾穿越界域的跡象。而她從此再未被人見過。
I do not expect you to share this information freely. That is why we are here. To make an... exchange, of sorts.
我不指望你會主動分享這份情報。這正是我們在這裡的原因。要做一場……交換，可以這麼說。
I should rather like to know the same thing myself! The way I see it, it hardly impacts the wider scope of your schemes.
我自己倒也很想知道同一件事！在我看來，那對你那些計謀的大局幾乎毫無影響。
I do like to be meticulous. Each additional defined variable helps with the accuracy of my predictions.
我喜歡把事情做得縝密。每多一個被界定的變數，都能提升我預測的準確度。
Regardless - the request comes directly from Her Majesty. It appears she is just as interested in the answer as I am.
無論如何——這項請求直接來自女王陛下。看來她對答案的興趣不亞於我。
How do you know all this?
My goodness, what a question! How does the Spymaster know these things? What a conundrum - perhaps the title should clue you in?
我的天，多好的問題！諜報總管怎麼會知道這些事呢？何等難解之謎——也許那個頭銜能給你一點提示？
There is little I do not keep track of in this world. Mostly, my inquisitors work to collect information beyond our gates...
這個世界上我沒有在追蹤的事情不多。多數時候，是我的審訊官在我們的門外蒐集情報……
Though, in special circumstances, I have been known to do so myself. Such as the one we find ourselves in now.
不過在特殊情況下，我也曾親自出馬。比如我們此刻所處的這一種。
Entry to their Claims is not such an easy task if uninvited. You've seen the portal that lies at the end of the Expanse, haven't you? Still active, yet... sealed shut.
若未受邀，要進入他們的領地並不是件容易的事。你看過Silent Expanse 盡頭那道傳送門了吧？仍然運作著，卻……被封死了。
It seems the Shade did not take well to losing its Sight. An act of caution, blocking your access to its domain. The Light is much the same.
看來幽影對失去它的「眼」反應不佳。封住你進入它領域的通路，是一種戒備之舉。曙光也差不多。
Awestruck, are we? I do suppose such is the natural consequence of being in the vicinity of the crown's two strongest Sovereigns!
怎麼，敬畏了嗎？我想那是身處王室兩位最強統領附近的自然結果！
But I'm afraid we do need you to speak up, so do get over yourself, would you?
不過恐怕我們需要你開口，所以請你振作一點，好嗎？
And so, we return to the exchange. If you tell us what we wish to know, I will offer some valuable information in return. I trust it will be of interest to you.
那麼，我們回到那場交換。如果你告訴我們我們想知道的，我會提供一些有價值的情報作為回報。我相信你會有興趣。
Well, do we have a deal?
You always have a choice. But sometimes, there is a right and a wrong choice to make. The decision is yours.
你永遠都有選擇。但有時候，選擇有對錯之分。決定權在你。
So tell me. What happened in the Realm of Light? What could we not see?
那就告訴我。光之領域裡發生了什麼？有什麼是我們看不見的？
How very interesting. To think, the Shade has enough trust in War's lost Scion to send him to defend its trump card...
非常有意思。想想看，幽影竟然如此信任戰爭失落的後裔，派他去守護它的王牌……
I had wondered when he might finally show his ugly face again. Heavens know we'd had enough of him already.
我早就在想他什麼時候會再露出那張醜臉。天曉得我們早就受夠他了。
And the Dawn is freed from the Dusk's assault... but its Scion is lost to the Dark's Claim... a step forward, and a step back alike.
而曙光從黃昏的攻勢中掙脫了……但它的後裔失落在黑暗的領地裡……有一步向前，也有一步倒退。
A step back, perhaps, but it could also be a boon in disguise. She could serve as a potential ally for your... whatever, if you could only locate her.
倒退一步，也許吧，但那也可能是因禍得福。她可以成為你那個……隨便什麼的潛在盟友，只要你找得到她。
Certainly, she could. This will shift the trajectory of certain shards of possibility... I'll have to dive deeper into the consequences.
當然可以。這會改變某些可能性碎片的軌跡……我得更深入去看它的後果。
Regardless, this has been enlightening. Her Majesty will certainly be interested in these developments.
無論如何，這相當有啟發。女王陛下一定會對這些發展感興趣。
Why does she care about all
她為什麼這麼在意這一切
You refer to the War of the Realms, I presume?
我猜你指的是界域之戰？
I suppose it must. Beyond the wider scope, why do we care? Wynn's corruption is at a safe distance, and both Light and Dark are far, far away.
我想它勢必如此。撇開更大的格局不談，我們為什麼要在乎？Wynn 的腐敗離得夠遠，而光與暗都遠在天邊。
I can answer your question. But first, a tale.
我可以回答你的問題。但首先，說一個故事。
Once, there were two twins orbiting one another, each laying claim to their own piece of the void they were given.
從前，有一對雙生子彼此環繞而行，各自將被賜予的那一份虛空據為己有。
The first was bright, radiant, overwhelming. The other was dark, shadowed, suffocating. Gazing through the abyss, they saw one another - each a mirror image of the other.
第一位明亮、燦爛、令人無法直視。另一位黑暗、幽晦、令人窒息。隔著深淵望去，他們看見了彼此——每一個都是另一個的鏡像。
The twins grew to hate each other. They built forms all their own, denying the truth of their reflections. They tried, and tried, and tried to break their bonds...
那對雙生子逐漸憎恨彼此。他們各自築起了形體，否認自己倒影中的真相。他們試了又試，又試，想要掙斷彼此的連結……
...but in the end, they could do naught but orbit - holding influence in their own right, but possessing nothing to exert it on.
……但到頭來，他們什麼也做不了，只能繼續環繞——各自握有影響力，卻沒有任何可以施展的對象。
Until... they found it. A miraculous world, of magic and life, and all of a sudden, nothing became something.
直到……他們找到了它。一個充滿魔法與生命的奇蹟世界，而剎那之間，虛無成了實有。
And in so doing, they came to shatter the mirror which once held their reflections. A building pressure of light and dark and hate, until finally enough was enough...
而在那過程中，他們打碎了那面曾經映照著他們倒影的鏡子。光、暗與恨意不斷累積，直到終於再也承受不住……
And from those uncountable shattered pieces of their battleground, War came to be.
而從他們戰場那數不清的碎片之中，「戰爭」誕生了。
War, Chaos, Hate... call it what you will. It was lesser, holding less control over itself than the twins from which it was birthed.
戰爭、混亂、憎恨……你要怎麼稱呼它都行。它比較低等，對自身的掌控遠不如生出它的那對雙生子。

You must...make sure...he has not managed...to become invincible... Do what has to be done....

Enter the hut at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and slay Essren, and take his coat.
進入 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的小屋，擊殺 Essren 並取得他的外套。
You must go back out the east gate and enter the hut, it is my master's house.
你得再出東門一趟，進到那間小屋，那是我主人的家。
Don't forget... Do what you must...
Ah, you must be the one my assistant told me about.
啊，你就是我助手跟我提過的那個人吧。
If you are trying to stop me, it's too late. I already drank the pot-...
如果你是來阻止我的，那已經太遲了。我已經喝下那藥——
What is this taste? Mushrooms? This can't b-
這是什麼味道？蘑菇？不可能——
Bring back Essren's Dusty Coat to The Assistant in {p}
把 Essren 的塵封外套帶回 {p} 給助手
Don't believe...everything people tell you... If master managed to...discover invincibility... No...too...dangerous.
別相信……別人跟你說的每一句話……要是主人真的……讓人變得刀槍不入……不……太……危險了。

好了。我……不希望你對外提起……這些事。拿著這些，然後……永遠別再提起。
這件事，別再跟任何人提起……陌生人。
到 {p} 附近 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Korun 交談。
W-Woah there, short nose! What are you doing, barging into my home?!
哇——喂，短鼻子！你在幹什麼，就這樣闖進我家？！

是 {p} 派你來的？好吧，歡迎來到 {p}！我這裡剛好可以用得上一點幫手。

這地方的魔力濃到不可思議；那些神祕的性質你甚至可以直接看見！

我當了很多年的科學家，但從沒見過像這座湖一樣的東西。

所以我才在這裡搭了間小實驗室，住下來研究這個地方。設備很簡陋，但夠用了。
The deeper into the lake you dive, the stronger the magical power becomes. I think something strange is occurring in the heart of the lake. I believe a lot of answers lie inside.
往湖裡潛得越深，魔力就越強。我認為湖心正在發生某種奇怪的事。我相信很多答案就藏在那裡面。
Alright, that's enough context! You see, there's another... "scientist" across the lake. We're kind of rivals? The guy's awful, I hate him, AND... Well...
好了，背景說夠了！是這樣的，湖的另一邊還有一個……「科學家」。我們算是對手吧？那傢伙很討厭，我恨他，而且……嗯……
And while I somewhat hope he's gotten himself in trouble, he might've figured something out about the lake.
雖然我某方面還挺希望他是自己惹上了麻煩，但他也可能真的查出了這座湖的什麼線索。
There's a note here. You start reading it...
這裡有一張筆記。你開始讀了起來……
IMPORTANT NOTES: The map to the talisman is in the basement!! That fool Korun will never see all this coming.
重要筆記: 通往護符的地圖在地下室！！Korun 那個蠢貨絕對料不到這一切。
If everything goes right, it should grant access to the heart of the mountain... I can't wait!
如果一切順利，它應該能讓我進入這座山的心臟……我等不及了！
It looks like there are extra notes on the back. What should you do?
背面好像還寫了別的筆記。你該怎麼做？

I needn't forget to input the total number of lit candles inside the house in order to get in the basement... That's why I made that tube! I'm so good at handling security!! No need for blasted overpriced Corkian equipment!
要進地下室，可別忘了輸入屋裡點著的蠟燭總數……所以我才做了那根管子！我對保全真是太在行了！！才不需要那些貴得要命的 Corkian 鬼設備！
You read what's behind the note...
你讀起筆記背面的內容……
I actually don't know if I'm making it out of this, but I absolutely have to find out what's inside the lake.
其實我也不知道自己能不能活著回來，但我非得弄清楚湖裡到底有什麼不可。
One part of me wants to bring Korun along. As much as we hate each other, it'd surely increase our chance of survival.
我心裡有一部分想把 Korun 一起帶去。雖然我們彼此討厭得要命，但那肯定能提高我們活下來的機會。

而且誰知道呢，說不定這座山的心臟其實安全得很？
Though, I mustn't forget that three of the greatest minds of our time got lost to cosmic powers...
不過我可不能忘了，我們這個時代最頂尖的三個頭腦，都葬送在宇宙力量之下……
No matter what, if you really want to join me, I left you enough clues.
無論如何，如果你真的想跟上來，我留給你的線索夠多了。
This map seems to lead towards a particular location nearby...
這張地圖似乎指向附近的某個地點……
Some mechanisms can be heard... There's probably another lever to press.
聽得見某些機關運作的聲音……大概還有另一根拉桿要扳。
Upon touching the crystal, you notice a peculiar device...
一碰到水晶，你就注意到一個奇特的裝置……
The crystal finished forming something, you should retrieve it.
水晶凝成了某樣東西，你該把它取走。
Looks like you can leave this place now.
看來你現在可以離開這裡了。
I suspect he's gone in to the heart of the lake... Come with me a moment, please.
我懷疑他進到湖心去了……請你跟我來一下。
Alright, this leads underwater where the heart is. How about you try and enter?
好，這條路通往水下的湖心。你要不要試著進去看看？
...just as I thought, you can't get in just like me. We'll need to gather more information.
……跟我想的一樣，你跟我一樣進不去。我們得再蒐集更多情報。
Human, investigate Nikoler's house for me. It's north down the coast.
人類，替我去調查 Nikoler 的房子。就在北邊沿著海岸走。
Where could he be... There's no way he found access to- Hey!
他會在哪呢……他不可能找到進去的方法才對——喂！
Don't just listen to me mumbling! Have you found Nikoler?!
別光聽我在那邊碎念！你到底找到 Nikoler 沒有？！
Investigate Nikoler's house for clues at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 調查 Nikoler 的房子，尋找線索。
Follow the hints in the cellar to the mysterious cave.
照著地窖裡的線索找到那個神祕洞穴。
Enter and explore the mysterious cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Return to Korun in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的家中找 Korun。
Y-you've actually found a lead?! There were clues in his basement? And you found a... talisman? This must be it, then!
你、你真的找到線索了？！他地下室裡有線索？而且你還找到一個……護符？那這一定就是了！

這說不定就是進入湖心的鑰匙，尤其如果它真像你說的，被那些宇宙生物守得那麼嚴實。

那好！這件事對我來說可能太危險了，所以我要再一次把它託付給你。從我地下室的隧道進去，能探多深就探多深！
If you can bring me samples of any kind, I'll try to reward you handsomely. However, if you find Nikoler alive... Please bring him back.
如果你能帶回任何樣本，我會盡量給你優厚的報酬。不過，如果你找到還活著的 Nikoler……請把他帶回來。

至於那個護符，進隧道的時候記得拿在手上。小心點，從這裡開始就是未知領域了。
As Korun said, it's probably better to hold that talisman to traverse the tunnel...
就像 Korun 說的，穿過隧道時最好把那個護符拿在手上……
Good luck, human. Please bring me back Nikoler, or any sample you might find.
祝你好運，人類。請把 Nikoler 帶回來給我，或是任何你找得到的樣本。
Enter the heart of Gylia from under the lake.
從湖底進入 Gylia 之心。
The drill should be ready by now... In just a little bit, I'll have single-handedly conquered the heart of the mountain...!
鑽頭現在應該已經備妥了……再過一下子，我就要獨力征服這座山的心臟了……！
A human!? W...What? Did you read the notes I left for Korun? I'll have you know that's theft!! I - you...!
人類！？什、什麼？你看了我留給 Korun 的筆記？我告訴你那叫偷竊！！我——你……！
Don't get any closer!! I'll destroy the path if I have to!!
別再靠近了！！必要的話我會把路毀掉！！
This is MY story! Don't you dare interfere!!
這是「我」的故事！你敢插手試試看！！
You're... persistent. Are you trying to steal from these meteors I'VE found?! Do you have any idea how much research I did to get this far??
你還真是……鍥而不捨。你是想從「我」找到的這些隕石上偷東西嗎？！你知不知道我做了多少研究才走到這一步？？
It's too late! I've already drilled a piece. Once I show Korun, I'll be known as the better researcher...
太遲了！我已經鑽下一塊了。只要拿給 Korun 看，我就會被公認是更優秀的研究者……
No no no no no no! This CAN'T be happening!
不不不不不不！這不可能發生！
Tampering with the meteors must be making the cave instable! I... I thought this'd happen and yet-
對隕石動手腳一定讓這個洞穴變得不穩定了！我……我早就想過會這樣，可是——
This is all YOUR fault! Why'd you have to come and make me panic? We're both DOOMED!
這全都是「你」害的！你幹嘛跑來害我慌了手腳？我們兩個都完蛋了！
No... I can't die here, I can't die now, what will he think...
不……我不能死在這裡，我現在不能死，他會怎麼想……
I... We might still have a shot at escaping... And then, human, I'll report you to the authorities!!
我……我們或許還有機會逃出去……然後，人類，我一定要去告發你！！
I'm STUCK! Urgh... No... Not like this, please, not like this...
我卡住了！唔……不……別是這樣，拜託，別是這樣……
You... Why? You came to get me? Not the... meteors?
你……為什麼？你是來救我的？不是為了……隕石？
I... Fine then. Let's make a run for it, human!
我……好吧。人類，我們一起衝出去！
Rats! That dynamite went and backfired on us! Quick, try to run in to the rubble with me, we need to hurry!
可惡！那炸藥反倒炸到我們自己了！快，跟我一起衝進碎石堆，我們得快點！
Welcome back! I see you're completely drenched! How did things go? I assume you've explored the place thoroughly.
歡迎回來！我看你全身都濕透了！情況怎麼樣？我想你應該把那地方徹底探過一遍了。

……你剛剛是在擔心我嗎？真是個傻子。這座山連我一根寒毛都傷不了！

我旁邊這個人類其實救了我一命，雖然也是這位先把我害到那步田地的。你該不會是要說，人是你派來找我的吧？

這很簡單啊。你要是自己跑去哪裡死掉了，我們這場較勁還有什麼樂趣可言？

這先不談，你在裡面找到什麼了？發生了什麼事？

Human, you made the right choice... Without Nikoler, our efforts would have been in vain. I'll try to work with him a bit more, as it seems like the logical course of action now. Thank you.
人類，你做了正確的選擇……少了 Nikoler，我們的努力都會白費。看來現在合乎邏輯的做法就是跟他多合作一點了。謝謝你。
欸、欸！我可從來沒答應要——
I see you're completely drenched! There's this odd aura around you... What happened?
我看你全身都濕透了！你身上還有一股奇怪的氣息……發生什麼事了？
You... You actually found a meteor shard! That's amazing! That's... that's... um...
你……你居然真的找到了一塊隕石碎片！太驚人了！那……那……呃……
Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died...?
呃，你、你剛剛說什麼？洞穴塌了，Nikoler 他、他死了……？
That's, um, haha... That doesn't sound right, he can't die, he can't leave like that, he can't-
那個，呃，哈哈……這聽起來不對啊，他不會死的，他不可能就這樣走掉，他不會——
S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. I do have to thank you for the shard...
抱、抱歉。我只是有點震驚而已。碎片的事我還是得謝謝你……
A-at the very least, you saw this through... I have to commend you for that... I think.
至、至少你把這件事做完了……這一點我得稱讚你……我想。
Just take these, and go. I have much to think about.
這些你拿去，然後走吧。我有很多事要想。
You explored thoroughly, and couldn't find a shard? Well, we still have much to discover I suppose.
你徹底探過了，卻找不到碎片？唉，看來我們要發現的東西還多著呢。
Uh, what did you say j-just now? The cave collapsed and Nikoler d-died..?
呃，你、你剛剛說什麼？洞穴塌了，Nikoler 他、他死了……？
S-Sorry. I'm just a little shocked is all. And you came back empty-handed... This was just a loss with everyone involved.
抱、抱歉。我只是有點震驚而已。而且你還兩手空空回來……這下所有人都是輸家了。
I see you're completely drenched, so I suppose you thoroughly explored the place. How did it go?
我看你全身都濕透了，那我想你應該把那地方徹底探過了。情況怎麼樣？
You found... Nothing? Really? And the meteors were too unstable to temper with?
你什麼……都沒找到？真的？而且那些隕石不穩定到沒辦法動手腳？
Actually, how would you know about tempering with the- wait...
話說回來，你怎麼會知道能不能動手腳——等一下……
Did you find him? Please... please tell me you found him, there's no way he'd die just like that. I...
你找到他了嗎？拜託……拜託告訴我你找到他了，他不可能就這樣死掉的。我……
W-what? The whole cave COLLAPSED on him? And you couldn't even save him?! N-no, it can't be your fault, I... I'm sorry.
什、什麼？整個洞穴塌在他身上？而且你連救都救不了他？！不、不對，這不能怪你，我……我很抱歉。
This is all way too much to take in for me, but I suppose you've explored and served the purpose I gave you.
這些事我一時之間實在消化不了，不過我想你確實探索過了，也完成了我交給你的任務。
Here's your reward, then. Now please, just leave me be. There's a lot I have to think about.
那這是你的報酬。現在拜託，讓我一個人靜一靜。我有很多事要想。
It's you! Glad to have crossed paths again!
Since the incident, I've decided to start fishing as a hobby.
那件事之後，我決定開始把釣魚當興趣。
Take this- for all I care, you can own this!
這個拿去——我一點都不在乎，你留著吧！
Check up on Korun from time to time for me, will you?
幫我三不五時去看看 Korun，好嗎？
I'm still taking a break from all the science stuff... But he definitely hasn't seen the last of me!
科學那一套我還在休息當中……不過他絕對還會再見識到我的！
After all, I'm the one who got to the heart of the mountain! I'm even able to sleep soundly knowing that I've won...
畢竟，抵達那座山心臟的人是我！光是知道自己贏了，我連覺都睡得特別香……
Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Mel 和 Lanu，你們住 E{~}。
Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
W{~} 號房……好了快走吧。我還有一大堆房間要分。
I need to tell you s-
Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tasim 想在 {p} 和你敘敘舊，位置 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
{u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
{u}！嘿！能在這裡逮到你真是走運。

好一陣子沒見了吧？我們該好好聊聊！你這段時間一定經歷了不少冒險，對吧？
But before that... I've got to just find...
不過在那之前……我得先找到……
Huh? What am I- oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
啊？我在找什麼——哦對，我在找 Aledar。
He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
他寄了封信給我，叫我跟他一起去執行什麼……偵察任務。可是我一直找不到人。

我趕過來是花了不少時間……說不定他早就跑去別的地方了。Aegis 也說那個任務後來取消了，所以……
But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
不過既然他不在這裡，我大概也不用再在街上瞎晃了吧？我去兵營給他留個口信就好。

We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
我們可以去酒館好好敘舊！天啊，我好想念 Rusty Recruit 的酒……那個酒保，他老說跟別家沒兩樣，才怪！沒有人倒得出他那個味道。
He... doesn't know about Aledar, does he?
他……還不知道 Aledar 的事，對吧？
He just got back. You can't... tell him now. You'll do it later, once he's settled in.
他才剛回來。你現在不能……告訴他。等他安頓下來，你再說吧。
...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
……他還不知道。你得把消息告訴他。
Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
抱歉借過，借過一下！借過！啊，你們兩位！我要找的正是你們。
Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
抱歉借過，借過一下！借過！啊，你們兩位！我要找的正是你們。
Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
呃，也不算指名啦。我手上有一長串要找的人，你們兩位都在上面！Tasim 和 {u}，沒錯吧？
I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
我這裡有一封從 {p} 來的重要公文。國王親自下的，沒錯沒錯！
Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
真的？我上次見到他好像是……他到底找我們做什麼？
I'm not privy to the details, I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned adventurers to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
詳情我可就不清楚了！他要召集一批像你們這樣的資深冒險者到城堡去，好像是要開什麼會。
Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
總之，我還有其他人要找，把信交給你們我就先走一步了！不管是什麼事，祝你們順利！
Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks till later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...

我們走到這一步了，但接下來的行動需要規劃。不過首先——先從我們目前挖到的情報開始。
Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of the nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
這個嘛，王室顯然是不缺錢的！我們一路看到的排場，比起我在 {p} 有幸打過交道的那些最闊綽的貴族，都不遑多讓。
And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
還有建築風格……很獨特。我從沒見過類似的。不過想想也合理，畢竟這個行省封閉了這麼久……
Eh, enough of the unimportant details - any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
欸，這些不重要的細節先擱著——你們其他人對這場錦標賽，有沒有覺得哪裡怪怪的？把我們這些人叫回來辦這個，實在說不通。
I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
我也在想同一件事。而且不管我們打得如何，他們都願意付錢……我不懂為什麼。
Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it-
嗯，老實說，我對這件事沒有太過在意——
Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
對了，Picard，你在宴會廳那一手是怎麼回事？你退出比賽，不是等於自己招來注目嗎？
Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
哦，把我丟進那種格鬥場面能有什麼用處？！我在那個架構之外能發揮的價值大得多——可以自由地在宮裡四處看看。
And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention-
更何況，他們要我交出一份研究筆記的摘要，所以我也不算完全置身事外，更別提——
Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
好了都安靜！時間有限，記得吧？我們扯遠了。他們有錢、講排場，而且不知為何要我們互相打。還有呢？
...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
……如同我在被無禮打斷之前所說——我認為這場錦標賽目前榨不出什麼東西。那是一塊得等以後才能拼上的拼圖。
Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
我們對女王和她的統領們有掌握到什麼嗎？這種政體結構很有意思，不過我想，對各轄區來說，能直接向女王稟報是有價值的。
Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
這個嘛，他們明顯是在演戲。他們一定有事瞞著我們，而且我不覺得他們有任何一個像嘴上說的那樣樂見我們回來。
Yes, indeed... we were sent into Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
沒錯……我們當初被送去 Wynn 是流放，不是什麼榮譽出征。那他們現在裝成這樣是為什麼？是他們把我們召回來的。
Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
啊！說不定他們不曉得我們已經破解了記憶咒？在他們看來，我們可能還相信著那套謊。
It'd explain some things, for certain...
這樣確實能解釋一些事……
So, am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
所以只有我覺得這裡的衛兵數量很奇怪嗎？
You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be under more watchful eyes.
照理說，九個陌生人進了皇宮，應該被盯得更緊才對吧。
Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
經你這麼一提……我們回房間的路上，只有中庭出口那邊有衛兵。房門外一個也沒有。
...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
……所以我們根本不用搞那套潛行的？
Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
看來他們是要我們覺得安全、覺得受信任。他們一定曉得我們回去會把看到的東西全講出來，那何不留個好印象，是吧？
A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
用強一點的法術，應該就能輕鬆打穿這片木頭。
Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
再說了，他們還有那兩位統領盯著我們。挺強的，不是嗎？我想那份威懾足以讓人不敢生事。
Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards, by extension - anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
說到統領……還有那些衛兵——你們有誰擅長讀魔力的？我幾乎感覺不到這裡有在用魔力！
I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
我正要提這件事。我一個法師都沒看到。最接近的也只是高階士兵持有魔法武器。
I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
我讀魔力沒那麼在行，但……那幾位統領身上有什麼。他們身上纏著一股強得離譜的氣息。感覺很……不自然。
Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
對，你說得沒錯。他們，加上女王，是我在這裡見到唯三具備先天魔法能力的人。而且這三個人的能量，彼此之間似乎關聯很深……
As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
這固然有意思，但留給我們其他人能著手的東西不多。博士，把我們召集到這裡的是你。我們的計畫是什麼？

Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
是，我召的……嗯，看來我們最有希望的線索就是那幾位統領。我們要把重心放在他們身上——不過，一般情報也別忽略。我們還是想盡可能弄清楚 Fruma 的一切。
We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
我們拖得夠久了，今天就到這裡。各位好好休息，明天必須拿出最佳狀態。
Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
明天傍晚我們再在這裡碰面，開下一次會。晚安，各位。
Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
回到 W-{~} 號房睡覺。
Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
那幾位統領……確實讓我不安。如果 Fruma 的高層握有這種程度的力量，那……
Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
嗯。或許我們的國王不去招惹他們，是對的。
Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
啊，太好了，現在全都賴在這裡不走了。滾出我的房間！你們不走我一覺都睡不著……
...damned Doctor- should'a just used his own room!!
……那個該死的博士就不能用他自己的房間嗎！！
...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
……唉。我在這裡做什麼？我當初就該留在 {p}。
I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
我只希望這裡沒有人認識以前的我。那種場面我大概撐不住。
Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
嗯……可惜我不能參加錦標賽。我的研究經費快見底了，一筆獎金本來是很受用的……
But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
不過，唉，我終究不是打手。也許國王會願意資助我未來的研究……
Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
天啊，希望我明天那場能順利。我有點緊張……我從來沒跟人正式決鬥過！
What? It's been a long day.
That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
那股魔力……為什麼感覺這麼熟悉？我說不出是什麼，但是……
Let's just go get some sleep.
Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
晚安，{u}。希望你睡得比我好。
{u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
{u}！你再睡下去我們第一輪就要錯過了！
Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
我懂你的感受。我大概連一兩個小時都沒睡到。我一直……我早該料到在這裡會更難熬的。我只是希望……唉，事情就是這樣。
But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
總之，你起來就好。剛才有個士兵來通知我們到錦標賽競技場集合。
You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
你……不，他們只是……敲了門，把通知從門縫底下塞進來。
Was someone in our room during the night...?
昨天晚上有人進過我們房間嗎……？
I don't... like... that. Not at all.
我不……喜歡……這樣。一點都不喜歡。
Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
總之，我們得去競技場。聽說是在皇宮北側。
Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
到皇宮北側 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 找到錦標賽的地點。
Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
哎唷。看來我們總算能驗一驗誰比較強了，是吧，隊長？
Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
哦，總算？我還不曉得這件事有什麼好問的呢！中尉，你真以為你在我面前有勝算？
Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
啊，少擺你那個架子了，Kymer！你如今是人模人樣沒錯，可我還記得你當菜鳥那會兒，被一隻老殭屍嚇得半死！
Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
哈！好時光啊。好時光。你總有一天也會得到你該有的表揚的，我說真的。說不定哪天還會爬到我頭上呢！
Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
欸，你每次都這麼說。再說了，低階挺適合我的。那些大人物往你肩上壓的「責任」，我可扛不太住。
...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
……話雖如此，輪到我們上場的時候你還是要倒的！上次交手之後我可學了幾招新的，別太得意！
Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
如果你們要找錦標賽競技場，沿這條走廊走到底再左轉。
The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
錦標賽競技場在走廊再往前一點的地方。
This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
很抱歉，這個區域目前不開放。
This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
這裡是女王陛下的私人寢宮。
I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until-
恐怕我還不能放你進去。要等到——
Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
是是是，我的研究筆記，我知道。那件事已經辦妥了。我現在可以去圖書館了嗎？
Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
別打斷我。這一輪比賽結束之前你不能進去。女王陛下的命令。
Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
呸。好吧！好，我等就是了。真是的。
You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't need to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
你以為我好歹該有點行動自由，結果沒有！要是沒別的事可做，不用看比賽又有什麼意義？！
Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
哦，快去把你那場比完吧。別磨蹭了。
Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
順著這道樓梯下去就是錦標賽競技場。
The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
人到齊之後就會公布對戰組合。
Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
呃。統領……Majin？Majin 統領。我們都到了。
My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
哎呀，總算來了！身為王室的貴賓，這種場合準時到場對各位有好處，嗯？遲到可不好看。
Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance - a humble mistake, I'm certain.
我們深感抱歉，統領大人。看來是沒人通知我們要提早到——想必只是個無心之失。
Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
啊，下等人的無能……真是令人嘆為觀止！儘管如此，準時到場的責任依然在各位肩上。下次做好一點，好嗎？
Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
好了，我是個大忙人，所以我長話短說。誠如女王陛下已經說明過的，這場錦標賽將由多場決鬥組成！各位不必每一場都到場觀看。
The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
規則照舊。不得殺害、不得致殘、不得攻擊場外人員——不過歡迎嘗試，我很樂意看各位失敗。
With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is-
那麼，還有任何問題嗎？我當然希望沒有，這件事一了我還有一大堆事要——
Ah, I do - I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
啊，我有——我不參加錦標賽。有人告訴我今天會為我安排別的事。
Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
哦，對……你啊。你剛才說你是什麼來著，一個……研究員？
Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
啊哈哈哈！哦，而他們居然把你選為貴省最傑出的人之一？別逗我笑了！啊哈哈哈哈！
Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
啊，不過這樣也好，我想。九個人辦這種錦標賽，本來就湊不整齊。與其多一個第九名鬥士，不如換個研究員！
Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do- you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
是的，很快就會有人來找你。你就坐在場邊玩你的手指，或隨便你做什麼——反正你已經不是我的問題了。
Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
很好！第一場對戰似乎是……{u} 對 Mel。你們兩位，出列。
Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
好了，快去準備！各挑一條通道，北邊或南邊，然後給我開打！
As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
至於其他人……哦，我懶得管了。自己去看板上找你們的對戰組合。
Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
呃……好喔。那我選這邊好了。
Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
到南側候戰室開始與 Mel 的對戰。
Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
我們是有任務在身沒錯，可別以為我會放水！
Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
準備好了嗎？！讓他們看看我們的本事！
Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
呼！打得真過癮！血都熱起來了！
What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
你覺得我那招怎麼樣？不賴吧？有了它我在場上就不會只能挨打了！
Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
啊，我本來也沒指望能贏什麼啦。不過試一試還挺好玩的。
{u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
{u} 在第一輪擊敗 Mel，晉級下一輪！
You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
錦標賽期間你仍可留在宮中。參賽報酬會在你離開時發放。
I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
我想這也合理。不曉得 Lanu 的比賽是什麼時候……
{u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
{u}，恭喜獲勝。下一場比賽的時間會另行通知。在那之前，請自便休息。
Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
離開競技場候戰室，到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 找 Picard。
It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
那是一場好比賽！不過你現在可得為我的面子贏下去，聽見沒？
We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
下一場對戰稍後公布。在那之前，請自便休息或參觀皇宮。
Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
啊，{u}，我看了你那場！技術非常好，比我在 {p} 那些年見過的許多士兵都強。
I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
我想這也不意外！錦標賽公布的時候，我心裡浮現的可能冠軍就是你。你，還有另外一個人。
Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
嗯……說不定我可以開個賭盤押誰會贏……啊，不行不行，我太忙了。專心點，Picard。
Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
嗯？哎呀，我都忘了你還在這！對，我本來要去做一件事……
Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really- who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
哦！圖書館！你敢相信嗎，那個討人厭的衛兵終於走開了！這也太荒謬了——圖書館到底有什麼好守的？！
But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take this opportunity while I can!
但是。但是但是但是。路開了，雖然這一輪比賽還沒結束，我還是想趁現在把握機會！
Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
要一起來嗎？我相信裡面一定有你會感興趣的東西。Fruma 人在這些牆裡藏了什麼樣的知識呢……
Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
你到底來不來？快點快點，趁衛兵回來之前！
跟著 Picard 進入圖書館。
Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
天啊，該從哪裡開始才好？這裡的東西也太多了……

哈，你記性不好？我也是啊，老兄。這本食譜書給你，右鍵打開就能看食材要去哪裡拿！
Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
全部拿到就回來這裡。掰啦，老兄！
Welcome to Astralaus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
歡迎來到 Astralus 的星辰之屋！你有辦法靠翻轉重力爬到頂端嗎？
Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
天文級的進展！不過這才剛開始而已！
...And why did you come to my tower?
……所以你到底為什麼來我的塔？
My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
我的 Moonsalt？荒謬！我的是我自己採的，你的自己去採！這才公平。
Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
該死的人類，你們從來不聽！我說了……自。己。去。拿。
What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick else, strangeling!
什麼帶你到此，陌生仔？你有什麼稱名？人、類？我們宣稱人累！壞選擇，去挑別的，陌生仔！
Looking for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observes, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
來調查為了幫忙？多少方便！人累需要協助化！你觀察者，人累飛失敗撞進大坑洞岩！
Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
燒奶用光光，取回它的唯一方向是 moonsalt！我們敲中幸運塊，在坑洞岩上發現 moonsalt！
Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
精煉過的 moonsalt 給出燒奶給太空咻！不方便化，太空咻毀壞。人累創造微小太空咻！
Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps, humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom given time!
只有單數人累塞得進現有太空咻。若陌生仔幫忙，人累會讓陌生仔進太空咻。人累能在給定時間內創造新太空咻！
Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result death!
人累目前居住在坑洞岩，意思是等待不會導致死亡結果！
Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Moonsalt 發現於北方鹽洞，陌生仔跟隨路徑！
Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
燒奶只需要 [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt]，剩下的陌生仔可以自行抓取！
When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
陌生仔有 moonsalt 時，在人累旁邊的裝置精煉，然後坐太空咻去咻！
Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
哈囉——歡迎來到世紀大賽道！
One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
一個贏家，一個輸家。而 Usnail Bolt 是把輸家當早餐吃的。
Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
早餐？等等，我今天吃早餐了嗎？來點小早餐好像也不——
Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
算了，不重要。怎麼樣啊，冒險者？來跟 Usnail Bolt 比一場。首獎是 Snail Slime！
Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
可惜，本來會是場精彩的比賽的。有緣再見，冒險者！
Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
唉呀呀呀……看來這一場是 Usnail Bolt 贏了。又一次。
Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
今天不是你的幸運日，人類。好吧，輸的代價你是知道的。衛兵！
Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
哇喔！這場比賽精彩到不行，這位人類竟然在 Usnail Bolt 的鼻子底下把領先給搶走了！
Here, human, take this slime as your prize.
來，人類。這份黏液是你的獎品。
ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
噢，這可真是太精彩了。一個人類？！誰想得到呢。
YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
你是今天第七個經過我的，而且跟其他人沒兩樣。
EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
每一個都掛著那種呆頭呆腦的傻樣，好像會說話的蘑菇有多稀奇似的。
GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
饒了我吧，我受夠那些混蛋把我拔起來、這樣不尊重我了。私人空間，聽過沒有？
WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
我幹嘛還費這個力。你看看你！狀況外的典範。現在怎樣，要帶我去天空島之間來一場瘋狂大冒險嗎？
I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
最好不是，如果你真這麼想的話。我今天已經被扯掉一根莖了，因為某個蠢蛋想咬我一口……活的咬！
DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
別跟我說，你真的要帶我去天空島之間來場瘋狂大冒險？真是太美妙了。
A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
你說廚房？好吧，如果那能讓我早點解脫，那有何不可。
WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
等等，你為什麼要把我塞進包包裡？你要我在這裡面怎麼呼吸？！
Hello there! I can see you knead some sunrise flour, don't you?
你好啊！一見「麵」我就看出來了，你需要一些 Sunrise Flour 對吧？
It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
馬上就要？別擔心，朋友，這事「包」在我身上！
Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
唉唷，這下真是「烤」倒我了——看來我的麵粉用完了，一點都不剩。
I'm sorry if I seem to be just loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
抱歉，我看起來大概像在「發」呆——不過至少我知道怎麼再「發」一批出來。
Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
看到麵包坊旁邊那片麥田了嗎？你可以去收一些小麥，然後丟進磨坊裡。
Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
去隔「麵」——啊不是，隔壁——的工具商那兒拿把鐮刀，然後開工吧！
Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
你想磨多少就磨多少，今天要用的麵包我早就烤完了。
Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
嘿呀，朋友！在找 Skyhigh Raspberries 嗎？拿來做派超棒的！
If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
有興趣的話，只要 {~} 顆綠寶石的小小費用，就能上那座島。
A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
人總得討生活嘛，所以我架了一套大砲系統，能直接把你送上它們生長的那座島！
So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
怎麼樣？一點小錢換一場小冒險，還有吃到飽的覆盆子！
Alrighty! Just head over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
好嘞！走到我旁邊那座島上，跳進大砲裡就行了——絕對安全，我保證！
Find your way up to the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon to come back to shore!
想辦法爬上島，想採多少覆盆子就採多少！採完了跳進那尊大砲，就能回到岸上！
Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
好嘞，沒關係。什麼時候想吃了，隨時歡迎回來！
Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.
把食材交給你選的廚師。
Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
食材都拿到了嗎？太棒了！
Okay you step back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
好，你退後讓我來煮，把食材交給我就好！
Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
啊哈！應該可以了！希望每一步我都做對了……不過哇，你看看這湯的顏色！
You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
你該把它端去給 Hamsey，看看他怎麼說！
You got everything? Took you long enough.
東西都拿到了？你還真是慢。
Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
開始吧。其他人早就完成了。我施展魔法的時候你退後點。
Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
啵！我的曠世名菜完成了。把這個端給廚師，他一定會愛死的！
And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
端過去的時候「小心點」。等我出名了，這道菜可是能值「好幾百」的！
You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
東西都拿到啦？帥喔，老兄。
I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
我就拿這覆盆子一小～小口就好——廚師的抽成嘛，對吧？來，我們開始！
And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
搞定收工。Hamsey 一定會愛死這個。
Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
拿去吧，老兄。跟你合作很愉快——把這個拿去給 Hamsey，看看他怎麼說。路上可別「弄丟」了任何一塊喔——你知道人家怎麼說「自己的貨」的吧！
Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
帶著完成的料理去找 Hamsey 談話。
Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de gouter!
Ah，你的菜完成了？那麼，il est temps de goûter！
Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
我們移駕到我的私人餐室吧……這邊請！
Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的餐室與 Hamsey 會合。
Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've returned with a dish in hand!
歡迎回來，mon ami！我看到你手上端著一道菜回來了！
A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
一道燉菜？看起來簡單，但人生中最簡單的東西也可以是 le meilleur！
Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
冒險者，你確定這道菜是你做的？好吃到我乾脆把餐廳關了算了！
You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
你總是能讓我驚訝，朋友。來，收下這條圍裙，真正的廚師都少不了它。
I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
我一眼就注意到了——你的菜好了！
Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
讓我嚐嚐你的菜，我也讓你嚐嚐我的！Mon dieu，une omelette？
Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Je suis déçu, ami。我寧可去咬一口騾子的 derrière！這種東西……連 Gert 都不會碰！
I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
看來你在烹飪這門藝術上毫無長進。別煩我了，等你學會什麼叫好料理再回來！
I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
我看到你回來了，而且不是空手。來，讓我看看你創造出了什麼！
A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
一個派？哎呀，你一定是找了 Frank 幫忙。他就是特別喜歡做派！
I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
我看得出來，你的 compétences culinaires 已經相當成熟了！
Though I will not truly call you a master chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
雖然我還不能真的稱你為大廚，但你 très bien！收下這份獎勵當作恭賀吧！
Adventurer! You haven't talked to Brie, Kale, or Frank yet, make sure to talk to them before choosing who to work with.
冒險者！你還沒跟 Brie、Kale 或 Frank 說過話，選合作對象之前記得先去找他們聊聊。
Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Pleasure to meet'cha.
喲，老兄。我叫 Frank。很高興認識你。
Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someoneplease.
你還在這裡？就……去跟別人聊天吧，你還在這裡？就……去跟別人聊天拜託。
You've talked to all three chefs, you should check back with Hamsey.
你已經跟三位廚師都談過了，該回去找 Hamsey 了。
Which chef you would like to cook with?
你想跟哪一位廚師一起下廚？
Not feeling a vibe with me? No worries! I'm sure you'll do great whoever you work with.
跟我不太對盤？沒關係！不管你跟誰合作，我相信你都會做得很好。
Thank grook you didn't choose me. Goodness knows I don't need another ameteur weighing me down.
感謝 grook 你沒選我。天知道我可不需要再多一個外行來拖累我。

在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg]，或是查看你的食譜書。

在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Voidroot]，或是查看你的食譜書。

在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Moonsalt]，或是查看你的食譜書。
Collect [{~} Snail Slime] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Snail Slime]，或是查看你的食譜書。
Collect [{~} Talking Mushroom] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} 會說話的蘑菇]，或是查看你的食譜書。
Collect [{~} Sunrise Flour] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Collect [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
在 [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 收集 [{~1} Skyhigh Raspberry]，或是查看你的食譜書。
You shouldn't go entering private rooms uninvited!
你不該未經邀請就進別人的私人房間！
How is the cooking going?! If you have lost your recipe book, just ask your chef for another copy!
下廚還順利嗎？！要是食譜書掉了，直接跟你的廚師再要一本就好！
Follow me into the kitchen, mon ami.
You need [{~} Sunrise Wheat] to refine using the mill!
你需要 [{~} Sunrise Wheat] 才能用磨坊精製！
You've managed to farm up some Sunrise Wheat - you should go refine it at the Bakers mill.
你已經收成了一些 Sunrise Wheat——該拿去麵包師的磨坊精製了。
Looks like you managed to escape with the egg... that was a close one!
看來你帶著蛋逃出來了……真是千鈞一髮！
Would you like to collect some Skyhigh Raspberries?
你想收集一些 Skyhigh Raspberry 嗎？
You're all paid up for a trip to the island already, just jump in the cannon on the island right beside me!
你去島上的費用已經付過了，直接跳進我旁邊島上的那尊大砲就行！
You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Frank.
你已經把材料都收集好了，該回去找 Frank 了。
You shouldn't jump onto the islands without talking to the Raspberry Vendor!
沒跟覆盆子商人說過話，就不該往島上跳！
You watch Hamsey start to taste your dish... will it be up to his standards?
你看著 Hamsey 開始品嘗你的料理……它會合他的標準嗎？
Welcome back to my restaurant, adventurer!
歡迎回到我的餐廳，冒險者！
Good to see you again, dude!
Ah. You're back. Just stay out of my way, I'm trying to do actual cooking.
啊。你回來了。別礙著我，我在認真做菜。
Hey! Nice to see you again.
Welcome back, mon ami! Alas, running a restaurant is busy work, so I can't talk for long. Maybe take a seat in the restaurant?
歡迎回來，mon ami！唉，開餐廳就是忙，我沒辦法聊太久。要不要到餐廳裡找個位子坐？
Hey, again! I'd love to chat, but you should talk to the other chefs before making your decision!
嘿，又見面了！我很想跟你聊聊，不過你做決定之前，應該先去找其他廚師談談！
Please go and talk to the other chefs first before you decide to weigh me down with your "assistance".
在你決定用你的「幫忙」來拖累我之前，請先去跟其他廚師談談。
Can't wait to work with you man, tell the big man we're working together and we can get started.
等不及跟你合作了，老兄。去跟老大說我們要一起做，我們就能開工了。
I still can't believe you chose to "work" with me. Make yourself useful and go and tell the Chef. I certainly won't.
我還是不敢相信你竟然選了跟我「合作」。做點有用的事，去告訴主廚吧。我才不去。
You should go tell Hamsey who you've chosen to work with!
你該去告訴 Hamsey 你選了誰合作！
It is time to cook, mon ami! Head over to your chef and ask them what to do.
該下廚了，mon ami！去找你的廚師，問問他們該做什麼。
No sweat, man, I probably wouldn't choose me either. Good luck!
沒關係啦，老兄，換作是我大概也不會選我。祝你好運！
Hey! How's the ingredient gathering going? Remember to check your recipe book if you're stuck!
嘿！食材收集得怎麼樣了？卡住的話記得翻翻你的食譜書！
Need another recipe book? No problem! I keep plenty of spares, you never know what might happen!
還要一本食譜書？沒問題！我備了很多本，誰知道會發生什麼事呢！
The announcer seems to lose his train of thought.
播報員似乎一時忘了自己要說什麼。
Would you like to race Usnail Bolt?
你想跟 Usnail Bolt 比賽嗎？
You shouldn't leave the race before it's finished!
比賽結束前可不能離開！
You've clearly won the race, but everyone seems to be waiting for Usnail Bolt to finish as well...
你顯然已經贏了這場比賽，不過大家似乎都還在等 Usnail Bolt 跑完……
Looks like this is that "Space Wizard"'s tower... you should start looking around for some Moonsalt.
看來這就是那位「太空巫師」的塔了……你該開始四處找找 Moonsalt。
A large warning on the display flashes a "LOW FUEL " warning at you.
顯示器上閃著一個大大的「燃料不足」警告。
You need [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] to refine into "burnmilk fuel". Perhaps the Humyn nearby knows how to get some?
你需要 [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] 來精煉成「燒奶燃料」。也許附近的人累知道怎麼弄到一些？
Looks like this is the Moonsalt Cave... you should head deeper to find some salt.
看來這裡就是 Moonsalt 鹽洞了……你該往深處走，找些鹽。
You grab a large handful of the unrefined salt.
你抓了一大把未精煉的鹽。
You've secured some Unrefined Moonsalt, time to head back to the village and your way home.
你弄到了一些 Unrefined Moonsalt，該回村子去，準備踏上歸途了。
You've managed to refine the moonsalt into some kind of fuel, you should head over to the spaceship now.
你成功把 moonsalt 精煉成某種燃料了，現在該去太空船那邊了。
You fill the ship up with the burnmilk and press the button on the control panel that is helpefully labelled "TRAVEL SPACEZOOM".
你把燒奶加滿船，按下控制面板上那顆貼心地標著「旅行太空咻」的按鈕。

看來你已經平安回到 {p}，還順道帶回了一些 Moonsalt！

食譜書上說 Voidroot 只長在完全黑暗的地方……最好開始四處找找。

灰撲撲的質地？褪色的綠葉？不斷滋長、籠罩一切的恐懼感？跟食譜書上的描述完全吻合！

你已經把材料都收集好了，該回去找 Brie 了。
Have you shown Hamsey our dish yet? I'm sure he's gonna love it!
你拿我們的料理給 Hamsey 看了沒？我敢說他一定會愛死的！

你烤的東西看起來不怎麼樣嘛。根本比不上 Kale 的無敵歐姆蛋！
Meet me in my dining room and we'll taste your dish!
到我的餐室來，我們來嚐嚐你的料理！

這是一顆奇怪的灰色果實，摸起來又冷又乾……不過不是你要找的 Voidroot。
I need more firepower if I'm going...to get...
如果我要……奪回……我需要更多火力……

總之，很明顯，要想有機會奪回那座前哨站，我需要更多火力。

什——我很意外！正中間那裡——他們把士兵關起來，沒有殺掉？這……算是鬆一口氣。

喔，泡泥巴浴回來的獸人。快進來！

你們 Wynn 人比我們適合站崗多了。不如你來替我，怎麼樣？
Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Temporary Camp 加入 Elphaba 的任務

喔，這種鳥不生蛋的地方居然有 Wynn 的士兵？說真的，你正是我們需要的人——如果你有空的話，能不能幫我一個忙？

我叫 Elphaba。我在 Gavel 的軍隊裡待了好幾年了。

我是前面那座 {p} Outpost 的指揮官。那是一座戰略要塞，位置就是用來監視獸人首都的。

這是三天內第三次進攻了！他們到底有多少援軍？！

哨站附近有一座舊塔——是個老倉庫塔。它蓋得比堡壘還高，也許我們可以從那裡偵察他們。

不過這很冒險，因為離得太近了，可是我們沒有別的選擇。到這裡東南方的那座塔跟我會合，我們去看看情況。
Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

士兵！我就在你後面。你看得到我們的哨站——還有我剛才說的那座塔。

如果裡面還有生還者，救出他們應該是第一優先。

來吧，趁獸人發現我們之前趕快進去！

好，這裡視野很清楚。來看看裡面是什麼情況……

也許我們可以盯著他們的巡邏規律，找一個空檔——
Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
舊塔上有人類！Junhur 要開砲了！這裡現在是我們的地盤，滾出去！！

唉，怎麼偏偏是現在！我就知道這很冒險，來不及出去了……快抓穩！！

舊塔倒了！Junhur 是最厲害的砲手！！

咳啊，士兵！！你還好嗎，你摔到哪裡去了？！

去探查哨站的外圍。想辦法找到進去的路，但要小心，好嗎？

去殺 Orcish Overtaker，其他的我們幫你擋住！

幫我從那間鐵匠鋪把零件弄來，我就跟你去 Picard 的塔。我總不能把我的寶貝就這樣丟著不完工吧？

把箱子推離門口，完成這道謎題！

你從殘骸裡取出一個包裹。

你該趁鐵匠發現之前，帶著包裹回去找 Caid……

沒問題。欸，Caid。你到底是怎麼一直弄到這些東西的？裡面有些零件很貴，感覺不太是你買得起的價位。

把他押到監獄進一步訊問，並決定該怎麼處置他。

嗯。嗯嗯嗯。記憶在那裡斷掉了……我很好奇，要是我們能……

是的，看來正是如此！不過在這之後一定還有更多……也許，只要我……

不過那現在不重要。重要的是我們剛才看到的東西！記憶以栩栩如生的細節重現！這個裝置真的會徹底改變世界！

我不久前看到他走進神殿。說不定他回心轉意了。你帶路去找 Caid，我跟在你後面。
I wouldn't dream of doing anything else!

不過，Reynauld，你也想想。說不定過去被遺忘，是有它的理由的。

我從……呃，附近一家工廠弄了一些零件。我希望這是……這大概就是你要的。

沒、沒有。我沒被看到。我，呃……我有做防範。半夜進去的。你懂的。

我……哼。好、好，好啦，我、我再加一些綠寶石。讓這筆交易好看一點。

你的共犯，那個供貨的，前幾天被抓到了。我聽說他幾乎沒怎麼掙扎，就選擇把你的祕密全招了。
Assistant! Assistant! Snap out of it!
{u}!? What're you doing... here...? No, actually, better question- what is happening up here?
{u}？！你怎麼會……在這裡……？不對，更該問的是: 這上面到底在搞什麼？
Science! Highly experimental and important science! That is what is taking place up here- and who are you, interrupting-
科學！極具實驗性又極其重要的科學！這上面進行的就是這個！還有你是誰，竟敢打斷……
Doctor. Stop. Talking. Tasim, why are you here? Where's Caid?
博士。別。再。說了。Tasim，你怎麼會在這裡？Caid 呢？
Right... the Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defences. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
對了……上將派我來加強 {p} 的防務。我本來以為會在橋邊見到你，結果只找到 Caid。
Urgh... that damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
呃啊……那個該死的賊！我就知道我不該離開……這整件事都是個錯誤……可惡。
There's no time to waste now. Let's go. Tasim, {u}. We need to save {p}.
現在沒時間浪費了。走吧。Tasim、{u}。我們得去救 {p}。
...hmph. Rather rude, the both of them. But fine, the circumstances warrant it, I suppose.
……哼。這兩個人還真沒禮貌。不過算了，情況緊急，我想也情有可原。

那位 Tasim，他一定也是 Fruma 來的吧？既然是你的同伴，你應該把他也拉進我們這個小實驗。我得好好想想我們的下一步……
... Well? What are you waiting for?! Go on, get out there! {p} needs saving!
……怎麼？你還在等什麼？！快去，出發吧！{p} 等著人救呢！
I'm trying to think, but... I've never...
我正在想辦法，可是……我從來沒有……
Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming- we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Reynauld，這樣行不通！他們一直湧上來，我們……得換個做法，不然撐不住了！
You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. The three of us alone can't defeat this!
你說得對。我們只能撤退，向 {p} 求援。光靠我們三個是打不贏這東西的！
Caid! You made it! That was incredible- you're a hero!
Caid！你活下來了！剛才太厲害了，你是英雄！
That's all well and good, but... what about your boat?
那都很好，可是……你的船怎麼辦？
Well, Caid seems to be fine enough... considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case.
好了，考慮到剛才的狀況……Caid 看起來還算沒事。我帶他去檢查一下，以防萬一。
Do you remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
你還記得嗎？我們才剛踏進 Wynn，然後……Aledar 也跟我們在一起，他第一天差點就死了！但願他在外頭有小心一點……
... Oh, {u}, you've returned, and with a brand new subject! I take it {p} is now safe and sound? Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb, and-
……哦，{u}，你回來了，還帶了一位全新的受試者！我想 {p} 現在已經平安無事了吧？太好了、太好了。來，請站到球前面，然後……
Hold on. I didn't get the chance to ask questions, when I walked in on this earlier. How safe is this procedure, exactly? Because from what I saw of Reynauld-
等一下。我剛才走進來的時候沒機會問。這個程序到底有多安全？因為從我在 Reynauld 身上看到的……
Now, now, settle down. Just because I didn't do any proper tests before this doesn't mean it isn't safe! I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
好了好了，冷靜點。我之前沒做過正式測試，不代表它不安全！我算過了！數字全都沒問題！
You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?!

俺快沒耐性了……全船的人都到齊了，就差他一個！

呸！咱們那位夥計到底跑哪去了？天都快黑了！只好把 Marston 丟在岸上。
Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Marston 買的那張圖在你身上嗎？
Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
咱們來瞧瞧這圖，看看該往哪去。
It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
看樣子寶藏是在這幾座島的其中一座……好啦，旱鴨子，你來作主！給咱們指一座島！
Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
嗨呀，一定就是這批寶了。別擔心，Argus 顧著船，隨時能開走。
A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
好啦，咱們把它挖出來，夥計們！
Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
哈，俺看見裡頭有東西在發亮！小子們，俺想咱們挖到金子了。
Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
等等，鑰匙上有線索！將其呈於沉沒的大帆船之前，真正的道路便會顯現。
Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
唔……俺快沒耐性了。Argus 到了，趁這旱鴨子醒來之前把人丟下吧，嗯？這座島有魔法遮著，沒人找得到的。
Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
好極了！這把鑰匙……咱們說不定能讓 Redbeard 本人活過來……他會再度讓大海聞風喪膽，而咱們就是他的船員！
Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
離開這座隱藏的島嶼，阻止海盜偷走 Redbeard 的寶藏。
Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
和 Marston 談談他的船員，座標 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。
Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
這一切俺可沒料到……那幫傢伙動作真快，嗯？
Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
以一個旱鴨子來說，你腳程真快。俺趕到 Pirate Cove 的時候，你已經是海平線上的一個小點了。
Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
說到這個，看在 Davy Jones 的墜盒份上，外頭到底發生了什麼鬼事？！
Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
你看起來有點傷！想必你也跟他們碰上麻煩了，是吧？
Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
好啦，小子！俺看你該追上去才是！咱們這幫人是吵鬧了點，可叛變是絕對不能忍的。
They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
那批寶藏他們不配拿，小子！那也不是俺的——俺沒趕上你嘛。那些金子是你的，儘管拿去吧……去拿！
Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
說到這個……俺身上沒剩幾個子兒，不過你不在的時候俺撈到這條魚。聽說能賣個好價錢，拿去吧。
Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.
前往 Bob 的墓中與 Batelu 對話。
Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
你好，冒險者！看來你也想解開 Bob 之墓的謎團？很高興認識你。
My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
我叫 Batelu。最近我一直在研究牆上這些奇怪的符號。
It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
這跟 Bob 有關。你該不會相信他死掉的那些說法吧？Bob 不可能死得那麼輕易。更不可能敗給一頭狼那種平凡的東西。
He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
他不只是強，他根本是殺不死的，幾乎樣樣技藝都精通。
I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
我相信他知道自己即將死去。怎麼知道的？死於什麼？沒有人曉得，但他離開這個世界時是有準備的。
You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
是這樣的，這裡寫著 Bob 有三隻忠心的動物。臨死前，他把他們分散到大海各處。
I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
我想那三隻動物就是進入他真正墓室的關鍵……
You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
你看到那邊那道小縫了嗎？那就是入口……
Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
可惜的是，從來沒有人解得開封住它的法術。
But I can. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals will come in useful...
但我解得開。我知道怎麼打開通往 Bob 的路。這時就輪到那些動物派上用場了……
Bring me [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather], [{~} Baab's Wool] [{~} Mooington's Skin] if you can find them.
如果你找得到，請把 [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather]、[{~} Baab's Wool]、[{~} Mooington's Skin] 帶來給我。
How is your quest going along?
你的任務進行得怎麼樣了？
I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, I merely read it. You shall go alone. Be careful.
我不夠格進去。動物的試煉不是我完成的，我只是把它讀出來而已。你得自己進去。小心一點。
I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
我相信 Bob 對那些動物做了什麼。我想只要能用某種方式把他們重新聚在一起，就能打開通道。
Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
如果你找得到，請帶 {~1} 個 Cluckles' Favourite Feather、{~2} 個 Baab's Wool，還有 {~3} 個 Mooington's Skin 給我。
I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
我相信我們一起就能打開那道通道。祝你好運。
Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.
把 {~} 份 Cluckles 最愛的羽毛、Baab 的羊毛與 Mooington 的皮帶回給 Batelu。
Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
太好了！我們現在可以打開通往 Bob 真墓的路了……
I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
我不夠格進去。動物的試煉不是我完成的，我只是把它讀出來而已。你得自己進去，小心一點。
擊殺 Bob 的轉世之身。
I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
我是 Bob，Wynn 諸般技藝的宗師。
Let me explain why you are here.
讓我告訴你，你為何會來到這裡。
My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
我的動物，是我行遍世間時最好的夥伴。
I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
我走得太遠、挖得太深，當然也挑戰了不該挑戰的東西。我在 Wynn 的時日將盡。
I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
我心裡明白。但在把我得到的力量交給配得上它的人之前，我不願離開。
Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
我用剩下的能力，把我的力量分成三份，轉移到我的動物身上。希望配得上駕馭它的人會去尋找他們。
The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
我下在這座領域門上的法術，只會為集齊我力量的人而破。但你不會沒注意到——你身上並沒有我的力量。
The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
事實是，你必須通過一場試煉，最終極的那一場。磨利你一路上習得的本事，然後面對我。面對我，贏得你在 Wynn 戰士之列的位置。
Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.
把 {~} 枚 Bob 的認可印記帶回給 Batelu。
Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
啊！你回來了！告訴我，你在裡面看到了什麼？
...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
……你跟 Bob 本人交手了？而且你贏了？這實在了不起！
And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
而且他還給了你他的認可印記……嗯。既然如此，那我或許可以為你做一件事。
Before Bob passed, he left his mythical weapons with a trusted friend. They were, so he said, to be kept for one who would be worthy to wield them...
Bob 過世前，把他的神話武器託付給一位信得過的朋友。他說那些武器要留給配得上使用它們的人……
Yes... Yes, I am certain. You have proven yourself worthy. Take this relic, the Stone of Myths, and bring it to the Temple of the Legends.
沒錯……沒錯，我很確定。你已經證明了自己配得上。拿著這件聖物，神話之石，把它帶到傳說神殿去。
Within, you will find a merchant who will offer you a weapon in exchange for it. I wish you luck with your future travels.
在那裡面，你會找到一位商人，他會用一件武器跟你交換。祝你往後的旅程一路順風。
They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
他們有可能變得危險。有時候，他們也確實如此。但更多時候，他們是英雄。他們用自己的力量保護需要幫助的人。
Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
各位好。謝謝你們今天到場。
It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
愈來愈明顯，待在這裡，我們很難對 Fruma 造成更大的影響。
We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
我們確實為 Auburn 的人民做了好事！但我們的資源有限，能採取行動的機會更是有限。
Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
此外，我們行動的風險與日俱增。我不後悔接納 {u} 成為成員，但大家都清楚，有他們在這裡，我們會招來更多注意。
Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Zeph 和 {u} 昨天得知有一位審訊官要來這一帶。我們不清楚具體是為了什麼，但他的出現讓我們的事業更加危險。
At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine - they're called the Steel Feather.
在慶典上，我收到了 Roughworks 一位聯絡人的消息。那裡有一個跟我們類似的組織，由我的一位老朋友帶領——他們叫鋼羽。
They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
他們有我們沒有的資源，位置也有利得多。只要我們能越過去 Roughworks，他們同意收留我們，並協助規劃下一步。
So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
所以，我們的下一步是什麼？我不知道有什麼事是我們在那裡做得到、在這裡卻做不到的。
I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
我還在琢磨一些想法，不過都跟王室慶典有關。動作夠快的話，我們趕得上 Roughworks 那一場。
Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
當然，前往另一個轄區有它自己的風險與危險……如果你們有人想留下，我尊重那個決定。
Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
哈！然後留你一個人去擬定策略？我早就預見到會有這樣的發展，所以我已經跟工作那邊打好招呼了。我跟你去，小姐。
And I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
而我絕對不會缺席這一趟，你在開玩笑嗎？你去哪我就跟到哪，Syndra。
I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
我、我也去！如果不把魔法用在我們的事、事業上，那擁有它還有什、什麼意義？
Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
欸。老實說 Synny，我不覺得自己在外頭派得上什麼用場。而且我想你們走了總得有人看家。所以我留下。
That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
那就太好了，Kaio。知道風中之葉交在你手上，我離開會安心得多。
You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
你們會……需要我的藥。所以我去……
Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you-
Sui……你想留下的話可以留下。我不想勉強你——
N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
不、不用！我想跟你們一起去！我只是……我得先跟一些人道別。在我們出發之前。
I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
我永遠欠你這份情。再一次謝謝你願意伸出援手。
In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
在 Wynn，我們流傳著一些故事，說有人能像你這樣使用魔法。那對他們來說是與生俱來的，不需要任何媒介。
Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
唉……我真希望我能反駁。但你說得對，我需要你加入我們。
I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
出發前我還得做些準備——具體來說是安排過境。我有一位聯絡人，我……希望能說服他幫忙。
You- you can't pos- possibly mean-
Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
是的，Zeph，我就是那個意思。不會有事的。
As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
至於你們其餘的人，也去做自己的準備吧。我不知道這個機會能維持多久，所以好好把握剩下的時間。
Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
唔……Zeph，你在擔心什麼？我們都知道 Syndra 小姐清楚自己在做什麼！既然她說情況在掌握之中，我看不出有什麼理由懷疑她！
Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
啊，無妨！來吧，其他孩子們……當然還有 {u}！我們都花點時間去道個別。畢竟誰也不知道我們什麼時候回得來！
If we'll be back at all...
Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Sui……我們會回來的。我會確保這一點！而你知道，這種事我向來說到做到。
We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
我們不會有事的，Sui。我們一向如此。
Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
我不知道我準、準備好了沒有。
But I have to be! I... I have to.
但我必須準備好！我……我必須。
So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
是這樣的……我真的不信任那位統領，而、而、而我怕他會對 Syndra 做出什、什麼事。
It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
這、這很傻，可是……如果你、你和我能找到翻過牆的方法，不必直、直接去求他，我們就能避開一、一場可能的衝、衝突。
And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
何況，反正我也沒、沒有什麼更好的事可做……
So! L- let's head into town and s- s- see if we can-
所以！我、我們進城去，看、看、看能不能——
Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt- I overheard you were... going into town?
嗯……不好意思，抱、抱歉打斷你們——我聽到你們說要……進城？
Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
如果……如果不會太麻煩的話……我可以跟你們一起去嗎？我，啊……有些人我想去……道別。
Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
喔……是 R、R——紅狐那邊的人嗎？
It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
那是……我，嗯，常去的一家餐館。老闆人……很好。我想謝謝他們，哈，謝謝他們的一切。
It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
那家店蓋在 {p} 最高的幾棵樹之、之一上面……所以也剛好合我的計、計畫。它就在 {p} 的門外。
Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
我、我們就在紅——紅狐咖啡館會合。它就在 {p} 大門外、外、外面。
So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
所以，你覺、覺得如何？從這上面看出去的景色很不、不錯吧？
I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
我……常帶其他人來這裡。他們，嗯，做的是 {p} 最好吃的東西……
Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
對啊……我會想、想念我們半夜溜出去吃宵夜。呵。
S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can-
S、Sui，你……想要我們留、留下來嗎？我們可以——
N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll... go find Chen on my own. You two, um, had something you were going to do, right?
不、不用！不用，沒關係……我沒事。我自己去找 Chen 就好。你們兩個，嗯，本來就有事情要做吧？
We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
是有……呃，如、如果你確定的話，Sui。我們待、待會兒見？
Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
嗯……好。那個，祝……祝你們順利！
...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
……好。那麼，{u}，我們來這裡的原、原因是……從這上、上、從這上面，我們可以很方便地上到屋、屋頂。
I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
我想——我、我想看看我們能不能翻、翻過那道牆。只要我們沿著屋頂走，應該就能避、避開懷疑……
Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
啊，Sui！一如既往，見到你真開心！
Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
