Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
好，這些送到 P 區，然後……喂，我正忙著把這些貨分配到 {p}。去煩別人好嗎？
...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
……什麼。你……覺得我……噗……噗哈哈哈哈！喔，這話從一個人類嘴裡說出來，還真好意思！
"Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
「喔，我這個為了錢殺人的傭兵種族，要來指控你這個做了七年的資深工人非法勾當！」哇，你這個偽君子！
I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
我根本連氣都氣不起來！不過呢，你這個怪胎。你抓錯人了，驚不驚喜！你腦袋裡的線路還正常嗎？
I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
我猜你腦子裡有幾條線接錯了吧？快滾回鎮上，去殺誰家的 Wybel 賺點零錢什麼的。
Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.
回去找 Nasea，告訴她 Dado 的反應。
I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
我大膽猜一下好了: 好聲好氣問他有沒有偷東西，什麼答案也沒問出來。
What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
什麼，他就這樣把你打發掉？天啊，我知道他很機車，但真的假的？這也太過分了。
We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
我們得讓他開口……如果貨繼續消失，我的客戶就要去找別家了！
We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
我們得證明他有罪……等等，你是來問「我」有什麼點子？我就是因為沒點子才找你幫忙的啊！我又回到原點了嗎？
I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
我……你怎麼會在這裡，呃……Larry？你的石英也不見了嗎？？
Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
啊，是……Lari。不是，那批石英順利送到了……
But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
但幾乎沒有效果。很遺憾，你的想法是條死路。
Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
欸，我早就提醒過你那只是個想法。我管的是礦場，我又不搞淨化魔法。這件事別賴到我頭上。
I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
我並無此意。你的幫助我很感激，只是命運另有安排……
...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
……小姐，這位人類是你手下的人嗎？
Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
算是吧。有人在偷運石英，但我們的嫌犯完全沒被這十噸重的盔甲嚇到，所以我們卡住了。你有什麼想法嗎？
...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
……事實上，我確實有個辦法。精靈植物學裡記載過一種長在附近的花，叫做「Tattytale」花。
It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
聞到它花瓣氣味的人意志會變得薄弱，於是有問必答。這……並不光彩，但若有必要，我想也只好如此。
There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
西邊山裡有個滿是蜘蛛、佈滿蛛網的洞穴。很遺憾，那是 {p} 以外唯一長有這種花的地方。
Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Nasea，既然沒有幫助，石英我已經還回來了。謝謝你的幫忙……我就此向兩位告辭。
Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.
用 Tattytale 花讓 Dado 招供。
Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
喲，這不是大家最討厭的那條攻擊犬嗎！過來，乖狗狗！想要綠寶石嗎？去把我家裡的蒼蠅全殺光！來啊，乖！
Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
哎唷，花啊。你人真好！抱歉，我可不會對神經病或馬屁低頭，嘿嘿嘿！
I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
我……呼……你這是幹什麼？！我不喜歡你的花你就這麼受傷——什麼？我拿那些石英做什麼？
Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
呃，這不是很明顯嗎？我在加班，把它們送上去給 Popo 啊，廢話。不然我還能送去哪？
What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
什麼——Popo 又送去哪？呃……不知道。不過不管是誰，那人有錢得不得了。每一批貨付我的錢都比我房子還值錢！
Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
我不懂你幹嘛要——什麼？Popo 在哪？呃，他說他會在礦車軌道的天橋那邊等我，青綠色旗子附近。
This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
這本來是我們第一次見面，所以我不知道他長什麼樣，他也沒見過我。
Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.
往礦車坡道上去找 Popo。
Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
啊，你一定是——等等，算了。我在等的是別人。
Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
等等，你就是 Dado？看來人類的腦容量到底還是比獸人大一點嘛，嘿哈！
Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
好，講正事。你去基地聽簡報的時候，我會裝忙幫你打掩護。細節那邊會跟你說。
You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
你在這裡實在太顯眼了，不過還好人類本來就愛往奇怪的地方鑽，所以應該不會太突兀。
Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.
Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
上礦車，要開了！記得裝自然點！
Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
有意思，居然有個人類被捲進我們的計畫裡。沒想到勞動力這麼快就多元化了。
Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
該來說明一下了，喔我最愛解釋這個了！我想你會覺得我要說的相當有趣，是的是的！
You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
要知道，石英是一種強大的魔法材料——比很多人以為的還強！它能吸收並駕馭魔力，但除此之外呢？我非查清楚不可！
The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
我研究部門裡那群蠢貨，就因為我提議把研究再往前推，就把我趕了出來。哪有科學家會怕求進步的？！
But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
但沒了董事會在背後緊盯著我，我的研究正好走到了我期望的地方，甚至還更遠，是的是的！
Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
喂。有個客人走了密道進來。
Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Harnort！我才是 Dado！這個變態搶了我的情報！他們會把我們兩個都害死！
Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
衛兵！！衛兵！！抓住他們！攔下他們！把他們綁起來，做點什麼啊！！我們的研究不能白費，在這種關鍵時刻絕對不行！！
HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
哈！誰叫你給我看那朵超讚——超可怕的花！我閃了！
Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.
You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
你……我不會讓他們的犧牲白費！{p} 必須看看石英真正的能耐！我一定要讓他們看見。
My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
我的 Quartron 就是未來！他們必須看見！那些算計、那些偷竊、那些斷掉的關係，全都會是值得的！
But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
可是你——你就是要多管閒事。你插了手，冷血地拋掉一百條人命，去阻止那本來就無可避免的事！
Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.
擊倒 Quartron，帶著消息回去找 Nasea。
The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
一百多條人命的未來！！你們人類這種毫不在乎的破壞，就該下地獄去燒！
The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
爆炸產生的能量正在讓牆裡的石英過度充能……整座實驗室現在就是個死亡陷阱！幫大家一個忙——給我乖乖坐著去死吧！！
Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
然後他又跑回來，問我有沒有再找到那種花，而就在他語無倫次的時候，「整座山」都在震。
So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
所以，說吧。我要你查出我的石英跑去哪了，結果你把我一個工人搞成了癮君子，還弄出一場大山崩！！
A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
軍事化的石英機甲……天啊。那傢伙聽起來真不是個好東西。看來這也不能全怪你。
I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
我會找警方把那些衛兵跟他們全都抓起來。……你那是什麼表情？看起來好像你覺得那裡不會有人。總之……
Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
搭黃旗那邊過去的電梯，進入私人區域，我准你進去。我在上面跟你會合。
Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.
到礦車軌道盡頭與 Nasea 會合。
This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
這是最新的採礦附屬區，不過我們碰上了一點瓶頸。呃……應該說是一堵碎石牆。
So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
所以，只要你能把這一區打通，就能進這座礦坑，在裡面找到的東西也都歸你。
I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
不過我得走了，還有一堆事要辦。嗯。你給我看的那個核心，好像自己摺成了一只戒指。技術含量真高，可是我用不上，你拿去吧。
Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
那我想就這樣了！這是你的報酬。有緣再見。
到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與天空劫掠者守衛交談。
Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like ye doin' here?
退後！海盜女王選出來之前誰都不准進。你這種旱地佬跑來這兒做什麼？
Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
參加？你瘋啦？旱鴨子絕不可能戴上那頂王冠。
Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering round chatting to any skyraiders!
快滾吧！趁我還沒叫姊妹們來把你開膛之前。還有，別在這兒到處亂晃跟天空劫掠者搭話！
Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
你想當海盜女王，是吧？別擔心，俺能幫你。
Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
跟你說，其他那些海盜根本不夠格。又蠢又弱。她們就只剩一張臉了。
Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
你可是兩樣都有！臉蛋跟本事。
Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
跟你說，那個守衛也蠢得很。隨便一套偽裝就能唬過她。問題是，你看起來一點都不像天空劫掠者！
Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
不過你走運了。天空劫掠者只要價錢對，什麼都肯賣——你在鎮上四處看看，說不定能說動誰把身上那套讓給你。
Look around the skyraider town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find a pirate outfit.
在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的天空劫掠者鎮上四處尋找，弄到一套海盜裝。
Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
哎？一個旱地佬在咱們基地裡晃來晃去？你想幹嘛？
... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
……哎，我想我是可以考慮讓給你啦……只要價錢對。
Here, these are what I would trade it to ye for.
喏，這些就是我肯拿它換的東西。
If yer thinkin' emeralds... [{~} Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
要是你想用綠寶石，[{~} Emerald Blocks] 這價錢算公道了，嘿。
Of course, if yer running low on funds, how about ye grab me [{~} Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
當然，要是你手頭緊，不如幫我弄 [{~} Dragonling Eggs] 來？就是那個素材啦。我一直想養幾隻那種小東西！
But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [{~} Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
要是這兩樣你都看不上……我一直很想要 [{~} Shiny Shell]——那玩意兒閃得可漂亮了！你可以在這裡東南邊的洞穴裡找到，就在梯子旁邊。
Ye get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
旱地佬，這三樣你隨便弄一樣給我，我這身衣服就是你的了！
Give an item to Egpla at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 把東西交給 Egpla。
So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
那麼，旱地佬，準備好付錢了嗎？我看得見你口袋裡的綠寶石，交出來吧。
Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
好啊！這正是我要找的東西。拿來，讓我瞧瞧……
Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
哎呀，旱地佬！我在你口袋裡瞄到的那個，是 shiny shell 的光嗎？！讓我看看……
Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
好吧，旱地佬。這身衣服歸你了。來，我進去換一下。
Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
拿去吧，旱鴨子。不管你要拿它做什麼，希望你派得上用場。
Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
又一個參賽的，是吧？那身衣服穿在你身上是有點怪，不過我放你進去。快點！
Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
呿！你哪能當女王，你連飛船都開不太動！
No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
不！女王會是我！我比你們這群天上的臭老鼠夠格多了！
Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.
Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
都圍過來，姑娘們。下一任女王就要選出來了！
As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
你們都知道，咱們上一任女王遭遇了……很難看的下場，在她自己的飛船上被一個 Wynn 士兵殺了。
But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
但從她榮耀的灰燼裡，將會誕生新的女王！三場試煉。這就是你們現在要面對的。
Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
只有一個人能通過眼前所有的試煉，取得天空劫掠者女王的頭銜。
Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
現在，我來介紹第一場試煉，考驗的是當女王最要緊的一項本事——戰鬥！
Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.
通過戰鬥挑戰的軍械庫房間。
Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.
通過戰鬥挑戰的禁閉室房間。
Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.
通過戰鬥挑戰的駕駛艙房間。
Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
啊哈，弱的都被篩掉了。女王要領導眾人，就得夠強。
Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
現在，第二項挑戰——飛行！開不動自己的飛船，就別想當女王！
Make sure ye bring yer sharpest eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
眼睛給我睜大點，姑娘們，一步走錯就是死。
This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
這項應該就能把你們剩下不夠格的都清掉了。
Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
喲，瞧瞧，居然有個外行人飛過去了。
Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
那就來看看你們在最後一項裡撐不撐得住吧，姑娘們。
Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
不會偷，你就根本算不上海盜，但這一次不一樣。
This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
這回是來真的。從一棟守衛森嚴的宅邸裡偷東西。
Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
你們的任務，是從天上最有錢的那家人手裡偷走一件無價之寶。
We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll be left behind.
我們會開一艘接應飛船在撤離點等，其他人就自個兒留下吧。
Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
記住，這回是來真的，失敗的下場會很慘。祝好運，姑娘們。
This is the garden we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
這裡就是咱們要挖地道進去的花園，然後你們得自己想辦法進宅邸，說不定好聲好氣問一下就成了，嘿。
Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
接著你們得溜過這些走廊才拿得到寶物——別讓守衛發現，不然他們會把你們關起來，鑰匙丟得遠遠的。
This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses around, though...
這個嘛，當然就是你們要抓了就跑的那件傳說寶物了。不過我想那邊應該還會有額外的防衛……
And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
最後你們得從這扇窗子逃出來——我會開著飛船在那兒等，把你們全都接走。
Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
哎，覺得自己準備好去搶那件寶物了？從這個洞出去，自己想辦法進宅邸吧。
Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.
Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
喂，你！你在這一帶鬼鬼祟祟是想幹什麼？這裡是禁區！你要進大牢了！
Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.
把寶物交給宅邸窗外的試煉主持人。
Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
喂，弟兄們！那件寶物被偷了！準備防衛！
Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
哎，這個下流的賊被我們逮到了！我們要把這傢伙關到爛！
Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
啊，我就想第一個回來的可能是你。你身上有股女王的架勢……
Head into the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second for the others.
上我後面那艘飛船，小妞。咱們再等一下其他人。
Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.
離開宅邸，登上外面的飛船。
Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
啊哈！我就猜到贏過那群人的會是你……你已經憑本事拿到了統治我們的名分，成為咱們天空劫掠者的女王。
Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
別擔心，這艘飛船裝甲厚得很，而且咱們離他們的砲台有好幾哩遠……沒什麼好怕的，在這船上我們很安全。
But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
不過先辦正事，咱們來看看你弄到的那個華麗盒子裡頭裝了什麼，瞧瞧那群邋遢守衛看守的傳說寶物是什麼玩意兒，好嗎？
I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
我現在不得不懷疑，這東西被看得那麼緊，是不是有什麼見不得人的理由。這是……相當可怕的武器。要是真被用上，會死很多人。
Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
好吧，多虧了你，這東西現在可能歸咱們天空劫掠者了，但拿這種武器去對付文明世界，那可就太過分了。咱們是海盜沒錯，可咱們不是沒心肝的！
I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
我想等回去之後，只能把它牢牢鎖起來了。咱們一定會把這個盒裝天災綁得比那群蠢男人牢靠得多。
Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
啊哈！這才剛回來呢。咱們下去開始典禮吧，好嗎？
I am pleased to introduce our {~}th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
我很榮幸為各位介紹咱們第 {~} 任天空劫掠者女王。為了咱們族人著想，願她這回能撐過兩個禮拜。
I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
我謹代表全體天空劫掠者族人，很榮幸為你戴上天空劫掠者的最高榮譽——The Queen's Headpiece。
Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
請用你的統治，帶領我們去取回我們應得的財富。
Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
陛下。能有這麼美的女王，真是我們的榮幸。
Now that ye've been crown, we must give ye the reward.
既然已經為你加冕，我們也該把報酬交給你了。
Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
我想這就是當女王的好處吧。
What item would you trade to Egpla for her outfit?
要拿哪樣東西跟 Egpla 換她的衣服？
Landwalker! Have ye found any of the items yet?
旱地佬！那幾樣東西你找到了沒？
Remember, I'd trade it to ye for [{~} Emerald Blocks], [{~} Dragonling Eggs] or [{~} Shiny Shell] from the cave to the south-east!
記住，[{~} Emerald Blocks]、[{~} Dragonling Eggs]，或是東南邊洞穴裡的 [{~} Shiny Shell]，拿哪一樣來我都換！
Don' waste your time 'round me! You've got trials to attend.
別在我這兒浪費時間！你還有試煉要參加。
As you walk, you hear arguments between other contestants either side of you...
你一邊走，一邊聽見兩旁其他參賽者的爭吵聲……
Perhaps you could try throwing this at the window?
或許可以試著拿這個去丟窗戶？
What item would you like to throw at the window?
It doesn't look like your leaf did anything... you should find another item to throw.
你的葉子看來沒起什麼作用……再找別的東西來丟吧。
It doesn't look like your grape did anything... you should find another item to throw.
你的葡萄看來沒起什麼作用……再找別的東西來丟吧。
It doesn't look like your flower did anything... you should find another item to throw.
你的花看來沒起什麼作用……再找別的東西來丟吧。
It doesn't look like your apple did anything... you should find another item to throw.
你的蘋果看來沒起什麼作用……再找別的東西來丟吧。
It doesn't look like your egg did anything... you should find another item to throw.
你的蛋看來沒起什麼作用……再找別的東西來丟吧。
The rock broke the window! Now you've just got to find a way up there...
石頭把窗戶砸破了！接下來只要想辦法上去就行了……
Looks like you're inside the Mansion... now you've got to your way to the treasure.
看來你進到宅邸裡了……接下來得設法找到寶物。
Aye, we caught the dirty thief. We'll 'ave that treasure back, and ye can rot in this cell!
沒錯，我們逮到這個骯髒的賊了。寶物我們要拿回來，你就在這牢房裡爛掉吧！
Move along, ya' got clearance to board the airship!
走吧，你已經獲准登上飛船了！
Aye, landwalker. Hope yer getting some use outta that outfit!
哎，旱地佬。希望那身衣服對你還有點用處！
The Bluecap Mushrooms grow in a cave out the gate northwest of here.
藍帽菇長在這裡西北邊那道門外的洞穴裡。
You find and take the mushroom Likeru asked for.
你找到並取走了 Likeru 要的蘑菇。
You begin to feel an odd sensation...
你開始有種奇怪的感覺……
...Now that you... have the mushrooms... you should return to... Likeru...
……既然你……拿到蘑菇了……你就該回去找……Likeru……
Swish and sproont! Or is it the other way around? The moon shoes will help too!
咻一下再噗一下！還是反過來？月亮鞋也會有幫助！
Sorry! The stairs broke! Try again.
抱歉！樓梯斷了！再試一次。
Is a refreshment needed? For I shall provide- the colors, green, blue, red, yellow, floating above the pillars- reveals where you will arrive
需要來點提神的嗎？我來提供——浮在柱子上方的那些顏色，綠、藍、紅、黃——會顯示你將抵達何處
They send the same way! Such direction waters my crops and tops my hat- fly well!
它們都送往同一個方向！這樣的指引灌溉我的作物、加冠我的帽子——飛得好啊！
A fresh-water fellow finds a fresh start for the fish out of water, frying in the fuzzies' fireplace!
一個淡水來的好夥計，替那條離水的魚找到了新開始，就在毛毛們的火爐裡油炸！
Green means go- and going green means you get going! Glance the green in the air by the gates, greengills!
綠色就是走——而變綠就是你該上路了！瞄一眼大門旁空中的那抹綠吧，綠鰓們！
The Bluecaps are fickle things, inasmuch as inanimate objects can be. We cannot control their influence but in passing. We shall need to take care with them...
藍帽菇是善變的東西，就無生命的物體而言算是這樣。我們只能短暫地控制它們的影響。我們得小心處理它們……
Yeah...the more I think on it, the more that the corruption portal messing with the visions makes sense.
是啊……我越想就越覺得，腐敗傳送門干擾了那些幻象這件事很說得通。
Well, if you ever want to try again and see if I'm wrong go ahead, but please don't dive into the pond again?
好吧，如果你哪天想再試一次、看我是不是錯了，那就去吧，但拜託不要再跳進池塘裡了好嗎？
前往 {p} 的 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Likeru 交談。
Aha, perfect! You'll be perfect! Lucky a human decided to come here!
啊哈，太好了！你會非常適合！運氣真好，居然有個人類跑來這裡！
I'll get to the point- I want you to go get something for me, and then bring it back here. Simple, right?
我直說了——我要你去幫我拿個東西，然後帶回來這裡。很簡單吧？
When you do that, I'm going to fix it up and try something out on you. Something magically enlightening!
等你拿回來，我會把它處理一下，然後在你身上試點東西。某種能讓人靈光大開的魔法！
Oh, don't give me that look, it should be perfectly safe! Unless you've been mired in darkness for the past however many years...
噢，別用那種眼神看我，應該完全安全才對！除非你過去這些年一直泡在黑暗裡……
Anyway, what I need is a specific kind of mushroom that grows close by, the Bluecap Mushroom.
總之，我需要的是一種長在附近的特定蘑菇，藍帽菇。
They grow underground- in a cave out the gate northwest of here. I'll even pay you if you bring it back, so what have you got to lose?
它們長在地底下——從這裡西北邊的門出去有個洞穴。你帶回來我還會付你錢，你又不會有什麼損失，對吧？
Bring Likeru the mushrooms from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
從 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞穴帶蘑菇回來給 Likeru。
Figure out how to get out of the cave, and return to Likeru.
想辦法離開洞穴，然後回去找 Likeru。
Looks like someone rolled about the air fuzz too much, so indeed hello! A light hello to yourself, {u}, and a greetings to Professor Eih, which is me!
看來有人在空中的絨毛裡滾得太久啦，所以，你好哇！輕輕地向你問聲好，{u}，也向 Eih 教授，也就是我，致上問候！
I don't rhyme all the instances, I feel the need to say. But what do you say? Very little! But I bet you're wondering where you are.
我得說，我可不是每一句都押韻的。不過你說什麼呢？你什麼都沒說！但我敢打賭你正在想自己身在何處。
I am no gambling man, but the chips are down and it is time to play {~}-Pickup with the puzzle pieces, and I'll eat my bowtie if you aren't ready.
我不是個賭徒，但籌碼都推出去了，該來玩一場 {~} 片拼圖大搜羅了，你要是還沒準備好，我就把我的領結吃下去。
The betting pool says the way to go is the opposite of in front, so that leaves someplace we can't talk about in front of the kids as your path!
賭盤說該走的方向是「前面」的相反，所以剩下的那個——當著孩子的面說不出口的那個——就是你的路！
I will be around! Or asquare, as it were. Technically amultiplesquares, replete with alines! And abevels! And other some such things like-
我會在附近！或者說在附方，就字面而言。嚴格說是在附複數方，外加附直線！還有附斜角！以及諸如此類的東西比如——
The punks scramble like eggs, and your skillet is sizzling! Certainly the heat in the kitchen is too much- so where is the fire extinguisher?
小混混們像蛋一樣散開，而你的平底鍋正滋滋作響！廚房裡顯然太熱了——所以滅火器在哪裡？
It won't rocket you! The hole in the shape of a door looms out of your transparent grasp- frogs can't skip leg day, so be froggy! Bounce and jump!
它不會把你射上天！門形狀的那個洞，從你透明的掌握中隱隱浮現——青蛙可不會蹺掉腿部訓練，所以像青蛙一點！彈起來，跳！
Swoosh and sprint! Speed and non-slip shoes! With a CLICK upon me I give you all but one, as much as you need!
咻一聲，衝刺！速度加防滑鞋！在我身上「喀」一下，我就把除了一樣以外的全部給你，你要多少有多少！
The colors! Shimmering as a prism- oh, no one likes those things. The writing is on the wall, but the window mugs it for pocket change! The inhumanity!
那些顏色！像稜鏡一樣閃爍——噢，沒人喜歡那種東西。字都寫在牆上了，可是窗戶把它搶去換零錢！真是毫無人性！
Use your eyes as ears and hear what I shall write! The cockpit is missing ground control and the cornfields all look the same in endless rows!
用你的眼睛當耳朵，聽我寫下的話！駕駛艙聯絡不上地面管制，而玉米田一排排望過去全都長一個樣！
So Eih, esquire professor PhD, will provide the coordinates in helpfully non-literal fashion, and one's joystick shall lead the holder to bliss!
所以本人 Eih，教授閣下、博士，將以極其不字面的方式提供座標，而持有者的操縱桿將引領其人抵達極樂！
At one's boots, the colors paint themselves towards an orientation. Above one's head, the lights match and fling you the same!
在你的靴子旁，顏色自行塗抹出一個方向。在你的頭頂上，那些燈光彼此相符，把你朝同一邊拋出去！
I'm all out of airplane food, but the goal is more than peanuts- it's progress, just opposite our position. Fly well!
我的飛機餐發完了，但目標可不只是幾顆花生——是進展，就在我們位置的正對面。飛得順利！
WOW. Just, WOW! Your brain being frazzled doesn't excuse this failure! Time is money and we're swimming in a river called DEBT!
哇。就是，哇！你的腦子被烤糊了也不能當作這次失敗的藉口！時間就是金錢，而我們正泡在一條叫「負債」的河裡！
I'm just going to stand here and you're gonna go into the teleporters I'm NOT in, and you're gonna like it!
我就站在這裡不動，你呢，就走進那些沒有我在裡面的傳送門，而且你會喜歡的！
Explore the strange forest to find Likeru.
探索那片奇異的森林，找到 Likeru。
Hey, look to your left for a moment.
I hope you've got a note pad with you, if you want me to teach you the ways of a master you'll need to write a lot down!
希望你身上帶了筆記本，你要我教你大師之道的話，得寫下很多東西！
It doesn't matter that we're on a {~}-match losing streak, we'll never give up!
我們連輸 {~} 場又怎樣，我們永遠不會放棄！
C'mon Beakmeister, we've ventured together for years now! Why won't you listen to me?
拜託啊 Beakmeister，我們一起冒險這麼多年了！你為什麼就是不聽我的？
I don't think she's even listening to me anymore. She's a free spirit!
我覺得她根本已經不聽我說話了。她就是這麼隨性！
Familiar to the nursing home, with no IV in sight! Phenomenal, and now my gambling metaphors will be apropos!
對療養院來說很熟悉，卻連一根點滴都看不到！了不起，這下我的賭博比喻就用得恰到好處了！
A solid, {~} pure, statue-made-out-of-tons-of-things what looks like me! I call it, “Ill Of The Ooze, Young!” And it begets your path amongst the lilypads.
一尊結結實實、{~} 純度、用一噸東西堆出來、長得像我的雕像！我管它叫「黏液之病，年輕人！」而它引出了你在睡蓮之間的路。
Likeru? No, no, she can’t find you here- her eyes deceive her. But I won't! Not any more than the film reel degrades, and the theater is ahead!
Likeru？不不，她在這裡找不到你——她的眼睛在騙她。但我不會！絕不會比膠卷褪色得更多，而戲院就在前方！
Now, don't tell the kids about this one either! The way forward is through my masterpiece- but I can't imagine a gullet glorious!
好了，這一個也別跟孩子們說！前進的路要穿過我的傑作——但我實在想像不出一根光榮的食道！
Enter the giant frog and escape.
進入那隻巨大的青蛙，然後逃出來。
Don't come any closer... I don't want to have to fight...
別再靠近了……我不想動手……
I-I'm warning you. You'll stand no match against me...
我、我警告你。你根本不是我的對手……
There we are! Snapped out of it! Though perhaps writing in the mud was better- Soon it will dry.
這就對了！清醒過來了！不過也許寫在泥巴上還比較好——它很快就會乾。
Without the static of the fungal caps, the radio station will be off-air- and the device unplugged!
沒了那些菌帽的雜訊，電台就會停播——而那台裝置就會被拔掉插頭！
Scratch it in your eyelids- the lightbulb screwed between the arches, and the feather-duster's sunset shades will reveal my deepest compatriot. Quick now, wake!
把它刻進你的眼皮裡——旋在拱門之間的那顆燈泡，還有雞毛撢子的夕陽色，會顯露出我最深處的同伴。快，醒來！
Ugh. Rats chewing the roots. They've their place, it simply isn't here. Neither is your place in the koi pond, stranger.
唉。老鼠在啃樹根。他們有他們的位置，只是不在這裡。就像你的位置也不在這座錦鯉池裡，陌生人。
I believe Likeru tossed you into the deep end without meaning, so to speak. I understand your being overwhelmed, but still...
我相信 Likeru 是無心地把你扔進了深水區，姑且這麼說。我理解你會不知所措，但話說回來……
Speaking of which, it might behoove you to let her know you've recovered. Though, should you need rest, you may take it here.
說到這個，你或許該去讓她知道你已經沒事了。不過，你要是需要休息，可以在這裡休息。
Ehm. Okay, that was...a bad idea. Should NOT have done that with a human. Uh, noted for the futu- oh, you're actually alright?!
呃。好吧，那真是……一個爛主意。絕對不該拿人類來做這個。呃，記下來以備將——噢，你其實沒事？！
You came back and just leapt into the koi pond! I thought you'd drowned down there!
你回來之後直接跳進錦鯉池！我還以為你已經淹死在下面了！
I guess the spores from the Bluecaps got to you before you could bring them back. I wonder what you saw?
我猜是藍帽菇的孢子在你把它們帶回來之前就先找上你了。真好奇你看到了什麼？
You reacted like you were crazy when I tried to talk with you... You were supposed to get visions of the light! A deep connection!
我試著跟你說話的時候，你的反應像個瘋子……你本來應該看見光的異象！一種深刻的連結！
Wait, maybe it's cause of that portal...the signals got mixed? I'll have to look into this more...but hey, I got the Bluecap, anyways, so...
等等，說不定是那道傳送門的關係……訊號混在一起了？我得再研究研究……不過欸，反正藍帽菇我拿到了，所以……
Here, your payment- and a little extra I whipped up too. Um, really sorry about all that!
來，這是你的報酬——還有我順手做的一點額外的東西。嗯，那整件事真的很抱歉！
Would you like to challenge Sovereign Zhiraok again?
要再次挑戰 Zhiraok 統領嗎？

新章節開始: 樹冠之間
There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
The monitor is keeping the machine running.
監測器讓機器維持運轉。
Maybe something sharp can break it...

……好吧。……抱歉，Nisen……我。我確實知道。我不該告訴你的，但我確實知道。拜託別傷害我。
You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
你得搭西北邊那條滑索。不過不是往上走的那一條。
Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 搜索 Nisen 的家，找出關於他的線索。
Um, let's hope he's not home...
That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
那就怪了……最後一篇的日期是幾週前。
It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
感覺他是突然就不寫了……
Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
咿！那一定是 Nisen！我們得想個藉口……
Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
不好意思？你們在我的居所裡做什麼？
If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
如果我沒有弄錯的話，闖進他人的居所並不是一種習俗。
Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
喔……我、我很抱歉！我、我——我們——我們以為這裡是……麵包店。
Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
喔。是的，走錯建築了。麵包店在下面地面那一層。
Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
喔！謝謝你指路。造成誤會……我們真的很抱歉。
Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
好險……我，呃，很意外他居然信了。
I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
我、我當時慌了嘛，好嗎！但它有用，不是嗎？
He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
他……意外地健談。跟其他人比起來是個不錯的改變。
Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
不過，呃，他有點……怪。他對自己的答案好像不太確定……
I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
我不知道。你怎麼想？有什麼推測嗎？
I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
我……剛才也在想同一件事。那可以解釋日記為什麼突然中斷……
Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
也許……我想他有可能。也可能是我太快下結論了。
Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
呃……那個我們再琢磨一下好了。
Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
你看，我從他床頭櫃上摸到一張行程表。
Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
聽聽這個。「正午自南門送出武器匠的狩獵工具。」
It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
很怪吧？他身上絕對有問題……但即使如此，把他綁走交給某個……某個隨便的鳥人！我不喜歡這樣。
But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp out outside the southern gate and wait...
但是……我們沒什麼選擇。我們去南門外面守著等吧……
Guess we'll just have to wait...
I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
我……哈，我在這裡一直覺得很力不從心。我從來沒有在……呃，在沒有他們支援的情況下做過這麼多事。
But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
但是……你在這裡幫我，所以。呃。謝謝你——謝謝你陪著我。我……我想沒有你我走不到這裡。
Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
呃……不過我想有用。可以幫我一下嗎？
That was... easier than I expected it to be.
I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
我就是，呃，直接砸在他身上？然後……然後就這樣了。
We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
我們應該……差不多該走了。我不想被任何人——被任何人看到！
Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
呃！控制……大概不是正確的用詞。我……哈，我本來是想把他凍住的。所以……還在練吧。我想。
......how are we going to move him?
So, how do we carry him?
Um! I... didn't think about that.
Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
好啊好啊，新來的！看來你們需要幫手！
Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
當然是從樹上啊！我看你們已經制伏了這位好心的 Nisen 先生，做得好，做得好。
...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
……我們照你要求的全都做了。現在——現在告訴我們你知道什麼！！
Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
喔天啊，你們以為自己做完了？哈！啊哈哈哈！
Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
開玩笑的！開玩笑，開玩笑——天啊，你們那個表情！朋友之間開個小玩笑而已嘛，是吧？
Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
好啦！好啦好啦，我懂了！天啊，這位女士……
I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
我不開玩笑了……暫時。好消息！你們通過測試了！
Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
會，會，冷靜點，我會告訴你們的。給我一點時間！天啊。你還真是沒耐性啊。
I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive. Just a security measure!
我會帶你們兩位去樹冠！不過，啊，有個小小的預防措施——在抵達之前我得把你們的眼睛蒙起來，只是個保安措施！
Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
唉……算了，我已經不在乎了。就……帶我們去找 Yusanu。
Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
唉！好啦好啦好啦！但是快一點。
Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Rurie，可以解釋一下嗎？你為什麼把這些外人帶來這裡？
Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
哎呀，你也知道是怎麼回事嘛，Fuhue！我今天早上巡邏無聊死了！你們這些人可不太算得上派對的靈魂……
You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
你知道 Azael 對招募有明確的規定。你有沒有把該辦的書面文件辦好？因為我桌上沒看到任何相關的東西。
The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
那個……啊，那個書面文件是真的？我一直以為那是你自己編出來好玩的。
No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
不是。我們訂下規程是有理由的，Rurie 隊長。你要自己找時間把它們讀過一遍，還是要我請 Cileon 隊長帶你走一遍？
Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
是，是，我明白它的重要性——不過我相信 Cileon 對規程的看法跟我一樣。對吧，Cileon？
H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
喂、喂！別搞得好像，好像我們不在這裡一樣！
Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Cileon！那也違反我們的規程。我們可不想留下一具屍體讓王室找到，我們有遠遠更簡便的處理方式。
And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
而且當然，我們得先從他們身上拷問出所有必要的情報——這句我已經聽過十幾遍了。
Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
啊！你有在聽！很好，Rurie 隊長。我們總有一天會把你敲醒的。
I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
我先前確實請幾位小鹿把 Nisen 帶進處理室了。感謝你的付出，隊長。
Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
啊，不客氣！根本連汗都沒流！
Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
好啦，我晚點再來找你們！我想既然要照規程走，我得把這幾個孩子交給 Azael。
Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
嘿嘿，朋友們！我有點渴了，所以就先告辭啦！你們自己找得到 Azael 吧？
Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
嗯。Rurie 叫你們去找 Azael。
The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
行程總是這麼滿……現在又多了更多事要處理。
But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
不過我想我可以擠出一點時間回答問題。
I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
我同時也是整個樹冠的總管，不只是鹿群那邊的事務。
Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Azael 大師在他的小屋裡……就在這裡的西南邊。
From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
就我聽到的，你們的朋友也在那邊。
I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
恐怕是的。一如既往地令人難以忍受……
But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
但他在自己的專業上極有天分。沒有人能像他那樣帶好梟群。
Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
或者不見！你們留不留下來，是 Azael 大師的決定。只希望你們能讓他印象深刻。
I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
我已經聽說了你們至今在 {p} 的作為。非常出色。
Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
不好意思打斷你，但我們跑了一整天，我很累。Yusanu 在哪裡？
Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
是的，終於團聚了。不過既然你們到了，該談正事了。
I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
我請 Yusanu 把你們在 {p} 的經歷告訴了我。
And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
而看來我們的目標是一致的……推翻王室。我們樹冠在這件事上採取了非常積極的做法。
We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
我們設立了三支隊伍，各有各的職責。每支隊伍從不同的戰線攻擊王室。
The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
梟群是我們的耳目。他們同時也是我們最有效率的刺客。你們已經有幸見過的 Rurie 隊長，是我們最致命的成員之一。
The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
狐群是我們的突擊隊。他們是精通 {p} 本地技法的劍士。他們受的訓練是絕不輸掉任何一場對決。
The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
鹿群是我們的指揮隊，是整個行動的頭腦。他們同時也負責……處理 {p} 內部的間諜。
Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
間諜。你們帶進來的那個人，Nisen……我恐怕那已經不是 Nisen 了。幾週前，他就被王室的一名精銳間諜取代了。我們稱他們為換形者。
The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
{p} 多年來一直為這些偽裝大師所苦。每當有人被認出來，我們就會把他們抓起來拘留審問。
The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
我們這個地區的人發展出一種辨識方式，也就是徽牌。你若沒有一枚，許多人會拒絕跟你說話。
Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
呃……Azael 先生，我不是想失禮，但是……Rurie 跟我們說有我們 Roughworks 朋友們的消息。
In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
某種意義上，是有的。然而，梟群從慶典帶回來的情報我們還在整理。我現在還無法提供任何東西。
Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
請放心，等我們全部梳理完，我們不會有所隱瞞。
I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
我向你們保證，我們會繼續尋找你們朋友的任何消息。
It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
終於……終於感覺可以喘一口氣了。
I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
我會跟 Yusanu 待在一起，等他們把情報整理好。
I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
我要專心搞清楚這個裝置是做什麼用的。
It must have be worth stealing it... somehow.
它一定有值得偷的理由……總會有的。
It looks like someone's diary. The latest entries are dated {~} IA.
看起來是某人的日記。最新的記事日期是 {~} IA。
- Entry {~}: Mother came by today. She is taking their separation quite poorly.
- 第 {~} 則: 媽媽今天來了。她對他們分開這件事很難釋懷。
- Entry {~}: Father tried to bring me fresh produce today. I asked him about mother, and he left.
- 第 {~} 則: 爸爸今天想拿新鮮蔬果給我。我問起媽媽，他就走了。
- Entry {~}: I stopped talking to Father. Mother came by my work at the market. We went for food after.
- 第 {~} 則: 我不跟爸爸說話了。媽媽來市場找我。之後我們一起去吃飯。
There's a note with information slipped between the pages: Parents divorced. Working at market.
書頁間夾著一張寫著資訊的字條: 父母離異。在市場工作。
Seems like no one has slept here in a while.
這裡似乎有一陣子沒人睡過了。
- Entry {~}: I had a normal day today. Helped my friend carry some food to their house.
- 第 {~} 則: 今天過得很平常。幫朋友把一些食物搬回他們家。
I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but his enthusiasm gets the best of him sometimes.
希望那幾兄弟沒有太煩人。尤其是 Yuman……他是個好孩子，但有時候熱情會沖昏他的頭。
My water's been out for two days now. Last bloke I tried to get on the job refused.
我家的水已經停了兩天了。上一個我找來做這活的傢伙還拒絕了。
These boards can last generations, you're sure of it. And this one is covered in notes of all kinds! Even graffiti carvings mean something. There's a carving in one corner that catches your eye...
這些木板能撐上好幾代，你很確定。而這一塊上面寫滿了各式各樣的字條！就連塗鴉刻痕也有意義。角落裡有一道刻痕吸引了你的目光……
You made it back to Torann.
That's what we call the {p} sewers and waterworks. Maze of pipes and brickwork, some of it old old. Vagrants and criminals been settling there for years.
我們都這樣叫 {p} 的下水道和水利設施。管線和磚牆組成的迷宮，有些老得不得了。流浪漢和罪犯在那裡落腳好多年了。
You need to pack something that will help Aihan sleep, something to remind her of home, and something to entertain her at the station.
你得替 Aihan 打包: 一樣幫她入睡的東西、一樣讓她想起家的東西，還有一樣讓她在車站打發時間的東西。
Wh-what?! H-how did you fit my whole m-mattress in here? Was... was there not anything smaller?
什、什麼？！你、你怎麼把我整張床、床墊塞進來的？有……有沒有小一點的東西啊？
Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
……人到齊了。很好。很好，你們都平安。在那件事之後，我本來不太確定……
Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
你打算就這樣當作那裡發生的事沒發生過嗎？
Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Zhiraok 的祝福……讓他能夠自行復活。不過需要一點時間。
If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
如果我們想要有任何脫身的機會，我就得——我就得殺了他。
Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
嗯，總之，我們都在這裡了！我們很快就會跟我的聯絡人碰面，之後就一定安全了，不過……
We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
我們還有一點時間。你們已經有幾天適應 Roughworks 了——有什麼感想嗎？
It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
確實是這樣，對吧？這裡熱鬧得多、沒那麼開闊，但它對我來說……帶著某種懷念。
Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
懷念？這個地方，真的嗎？吵死人的工廠和一路蔓延的城區有什麼好懷念的？
Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
嗯，這、這件事我站 Rex 那邊！我不會想在這裡待、待、待太久，這裡好……嗆。
Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
確實，這裡不像 {p} 那麼……乾淨吧，我想。清晨露水的氣味會令人非常懷念的！
Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
好了，孩子們，發洩完就好。等我們見到我的聯絡人之後，請不要再說 Roughworks 的壞話……我想給人留個好的第一印象。
Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
喔，你要是真的得住在這裡就不會這麼想了。
What?! Most of them would agree with me!
什麼？！他們大部分人都會同意我的！
I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
我想這、這件事我站 Rex 那邊！我沒辦法想、想像住在這裡，這裡好……嗆。
Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
好了，孩子們，發洩完就好。等我們見到我的聯絡人之後，請不要再說 Roughworks 的壞話……不管他們同不同意都一樣。
In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
總之，他們要我正午在城裡跟他們碰面——{p} 白天通常是空的。
What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
什麼？白天是空的？那、那不太合理啊。
I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
恐怕 Roughworks 居民的生活是完全繞著工作轉的。工作日從日出開始，日落結束。所以，我們就等吧……
Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
也許他們，呃，這裡的時間讀法不一樣……？還是說我們——
Hello, Quill. It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it?

光是看看這些公告欄，就能了解一個社群的精神。看他們在憂心什麼，看他們如何互相扶持，看他們的文化……
Donated {~} IA by Sovereign Zhiraok after vandalization of previous noticeboard.
前一面公告欄遭破壞後，由 Zhiraok 統領捐贈 {~} IA。
Said it was the Sovereign's problem, but I know the real reason. He just didn't want to go into The Flush.
他說那是統領的問題，但我知道真正的原因。他只是不想進沖刷道而已。
You don't know us, and we don't know you. But we're here to help. I'm Yuman, and these are-
你不認識我們，我們也不認識你。但我們是來幫忙的。我是 Yuman，這幾位是——
Why... why would you... help me...?
為什麼……你們為什麼要……幫我……？
'Cause... that's what people like us should do.
因為……像我們這樣的人就該這麼做。
No! N-n-no... people like us should just do as we're told and not get involved in things that aren't ours!
不！不、不……像我們這樣的人就該照吩咐做事，別去管不關自己的事！

If I just follow orders, at least I'll survive! I might lose my apartment, and maybe everything I've built for myself, and all the things I've managed to keep for myself, but- but- but at least I'll be alive!
只要我照命令做，至少我還能活下去！我可能會失去我的公寓，也許還有我為自己建立的一切、我設法替自己留住的所有東西，但是——但是——但至少我還活著！
...I hear you. Trust me, Aihan, I really do.
Can I tell you a story?
我可以跟你講個故事嗎？
Long, long ago, when I was just a little kid, I lost my ma. Dad's out of the picture, so... my bros had to put in the work to take care of me, even though they were just kids too.
很久很久以前，我還只是個小孩的時候，我失去了我媽。爸早就不在身邊，所以……我哥哥們得扛起照顧我的責任，雖然他們自己也還是孩子。
But, y'know, being kids... they couldn't do enough. Failed to meet their quotas, just like you. Got kicked out, had to live on the streets.
但是，你知道的，孩子就是孩子……他們做不夠。沒達到配額，就跟你一樣。被趕出去，只能睡街頭。
You want to know the reason we made it through that? It was 'cause someone reached out a helping hand. Gave us a place to stay, to work without the threat of not meeting expectations. To live, man.
你想知道我們是怎麼撐過來的嗎？是因為有人伸出了手。給了我們一個地方住、一個可以工作而不必擔心達不到期望的地方。一個可以活下去的地方，老兄。

So... please. Accept the hand that's offered to you, 'kay? You can come with us and talk to the boss, and if what we have isn't enough for you... no one will force you to stay. But give it a try, please?
所以……拜託。接受伸向你的那隻手，好嗎？你可以跟我們走，去跟頭頭談談，如果我們有的東西對你來說不夠……沒有人會逼你留下。但至少試試看，拜託？
Not to ruin the moment, Yuman, but we've got more soldiers coming our way! We've got to get moving soon!
不是要破壞氣氛，Yuman，但有更多士兵往我們這邊來了！我們得趕快走！
Damn... alright. Aihan, will you trust me?
可惡……好吧。Aihan，你願意相信我嗎？
Okay... okay. Thank you. {u}, could you help her pack her stuff? Zeph, Jiro, help me prepare an escape route.
好……好。謝謝你。{u}，你可以幫她收拾東西嗎？Zeph、Jiro，幫我準備逃走的路線。
W-wait! I... I don't know what I'm packing!
等、等一下！我……我不知道要收拾什麼！
Right. Uh... don't bring anything heavy. We have food and cookware where we're going...
對喔。呃……別帶重的東西。我們要去的地方有食物和炊具……
Bring something to sleep with, something that reminds you of home... and maybe some form of entertainment, if you've got any.
帶一樣睡覺用的東西、一樣能讓你想起家的東西……還有，如果有的話，帶點能解悶的東西。
I... I can't think straight... this is all moving so fast... please- please, can you help me?
我……我沒辦法好好思考……這一切發生得太快了……拜託——拜託，你可以幫我嗎？
Grab that backpack and... pick whatever you think works...
拿那個背包然後……你覺得哪個可以就挑哪個……
You've probably seen most of the station by now. Time to head back.
你大概已經把車站大部分都看過了。該回去了。
Grab that and... pick whatever you think works...
拿那個然後……你覺得哪個可以就挑哪個……
We have to hurry but I just can't think!
我們得快一點，可是我腦子一片空白！
Pack something to help Aihan sleep, some form of entertainment,  a piece of clothing, and something to remember.
替 Aihan 打包: 一樣幫她入睡的東西、一樣解悶的東西、一件衣服，還有一樣紀念品。
{u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
{u}，快、快點！我們沒有多、多少時間了！
站住！你們全部都被捕了！
Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
你——你要去哪裡？別、別把我丟在這裡！
Did you get everything? Can we go?
全部都拿到了嗎？我們可以走了嗎？
Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
我們沒時間了，得走了！快、快、快！
Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
爬上梯子，進隧道！走、走、走！
Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
老兄……你剛才做的事真的蠢到極點。簡直蠢到天上去了，對吧？
But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
但我懂。我懂，你知道吧？如果我當時不是得當帶頭的，我大概也會做一樣的事！
Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
差別在於，我哥哥們拉得住我那股衝動。看來我在這裡沒能替你做到這件事……
Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
不想讓他們失望，你懂吧？不過現在說有點晚了。做都做了，收不回來。
It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
會沒事的。更糟的事都發生過。Aihan 平安，那才是重點！剩下的我們見招拆招。
I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
我、我應該……我應該聽、聽你的。可是，看、看到他們——他們那樣對她……我就是好……生氣。他、他們憑什麼那樣看不起人？！
Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
對啊……我懂。聽得一清二楚。那不對，對吧？但那正是我們在下面努力想改變的事，老兄。能做多少就做多少，對吧？
Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
我們走吧。他們會等我們。可不想讓他們久等。
...We should f- f- follow them in.

Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?

對、對！平常我會去找 Quill，但他在忙。我們先看看能不能找到 Yusanu——他會……理解的。大概吧。至少比 Yulie 好。我至少信得過他暫時不說出去……你懂吧？
Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Yuman，我真是服了。Yusanu 應該要知道不能讓你帶頭做這種事！你在想什麼？
Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
哇哇哇！這一堆指控從哪冒出來的，老哥？怎麼了？

怎麼了？！你知道怎麼了——一整隊住房執法人員死在任務上，你以為這事能不聲不響地過去？

啊——那個啊。嗯，你也知道是怎麼回事。事情就是會發生，對吧？
You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
你——至少裝作認真看待一下好嗎？你比誰都清楚這會帶來什麼後果。
It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
那、那不是——不是——那不是他的錯，我——
Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
欸，公主，沒事的。不用你替我掩護，好嗎？
So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
那計畫是什麼，Yulie？跟以前一樣開會討論？
Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
唉……等 Quill 把 Aihan 安頓好就開，是的。應該不會太久，所以大家已經先聚集了。
Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
喂！外面發生什麼事了？大家對這件事的反應都很奇怪。
We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
我們最後跟一些士兵打、打起來了，為了救我們去救的那個女、女人……
Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
咦。就這樣？我還以為會糟糕得多。
Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
對啊……他們是擔心這會引、引來注意……
Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
還在廚房幫忙，準備晚餐！別擔心，會議結束我會跟她說明的。
Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
她還沒完全決定，但她答應住一晚。她的狀態很不好，可憐的女人。休息一下對她有好處。
But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
不過這正好帶到我們召開這場會議的原因。救援的過程……我想是不太順利？
Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
不順利算是輕描淡寫了。軍方現在進入高度戒備！今天傍晚每一個進出 {p} 的人都被盤查——我要不是走了我們的隧道，現在還卡在那邊排隊！
This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
這是一場徹頭徹尾的災難。Yuman，你有什麼話要說？你到現在應該要更懂事了，我們需要——
H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
喂！那、那不是——不是——那不是他的錯！是、是我——
Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
不，責任在我。我是帶頭的，所以發生的任何事都是我的責任。我應該……更強硬一點的。
None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
如果當時我在場，這一切都不會發生……可惡。時機再糟也不過如此。這全都是我的——
Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
好了，夠了。你們全都在耍笨！誰在乎是誰的錯？反正已經發生了，我們來想想接下來要怎麼辦。
And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
而且我還沒說完！你們搞得好像死幾個士兵是世界末日。那又怎樣？當兵的哪天不死人？
They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
但他們不是這樣死的。我們沒有那種餘裕，可以不把王室的關注當一回事！要是他們發現我們在下面做什麼，我們就完了。
But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
但他們還沒發現，不是嗎？你們還有選擇。舉例來說——你在偵探隊裡啊！如果起了疑心，你不能把他們引到別的方向嗎？
Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
何況。如果保持隱蔽的代價是眼睜睜看著無辜的人受傷——那你們算什麼反抗組織？這一切又還有什麼意義？
Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Rex……說話小心一點。別說出你會——
What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
什麼意義？！意義就是我們在下面「已經」收容的所有人，我們得保護他們！Quill，拜託，幫我說句話。
... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
……不，Yulie，Rex 說得有道理。就算措辭嚴厲了些……我們至今在這場鬥爭裡確實相當被動。我們讓人受了傷，哪怕只是為了我們自己的安全。
We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
我們有我們的理由……而且我們也在能力所及之內做了好事。但如果我們害怕行動，事情又怎麼可能變好？

You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
你感到挫折並沒有錯，Yulie。我也希望這件事能處理得更謹慎……但這樣的事遲早會發生。我們會撐過去的，就像我們撐過以前的難關一樣。
...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
……不過我們讓氣氛輕鬆一點吧！晚餐應該快好了。Yuman，你今天早些時候跟我說你在寫一首新歌。你今晚還想表演嗎？
Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
咦？喔，好啊好啊，老兄！我可以，沒問題。

咳。在我們散會之前，容我一言——既然大家都聚在這裡，我想把一些相關的資訊攤開來講可能會有幫助。
Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
我們大多數人對 Roughworks 都還很陌生，了解一下這裡的情勢會有幫助。

對，當然。我本來稍早就想提類似的建議，只是……出了這個狀況。
Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
當然，我們可以談！你們想知道什麼？
Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
啊，是的。她叫 Soosu。關於她很難說什麼……她相當離群索居，總是窩在她的宅邸裡埋頭工作。

在這一點上她跟 Zhiraok 正好相反。理想上，我們會避免引起她的注意。我們要擔心的事已經夠多了，不需要再把她加進名單。

That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
那樣最好，對。她……算是個天才。一個多世紀前，是她一個人帶來了工業紀元！你在 Fruma 看到的大部分機械，追根究柢大概都跟她有關。
Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
哈！對啦對啦，難怪你什麼都知道，老哥。書呆子。
Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
什——那只是寫下來的歷史，Yuman。你要笑我，至少笑對地方。
How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
那她的祝福呢？如果我們真的碰上她，會想知道要提防什麼。
I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
我不知道細節……但我知道的是，它讓她能夠隨意塑形物質。到什麼程度、有什麼限制……很難說。不過，正是那份不確定才危險。小心點。
Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
很好！那我們就散會用餐吧。

啊，不、不是，我——嗯，是的，我很想吃點東西，但我是來——來謝謝 {u} 的。

前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Imal Inn 附近，調查天候異常的傳聞。
Find the meteor's crash site at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hey you! Human. What are you doing here?
喂，你！人類。你在這裡做什麼？
Under Villager law any extra terrestrial or extra voidal entities are prohibited and owned by the state.
依村民律法，一切來自天外或虛空的物體皆屬禁品，歸國家所有。
Seeing as you are new to the land, I can't see you being prosecuted, especially a {p} Guard.
不過你初來乍到，我想應該不至於被起訴，何況你還是 {p} 的守衛。

這顆隕石跟我們以往見過的都不一樣。我們懷疑直接接觸它是危險的。

可是那股魔法輻射對你好像完全沒有影響。你沒有任何感覺嗎？也許你可以幫我找到它。
Explore the cave that the meteor crashed into.
探索隕石墜落造成的洞窟。
Follow the trail leading off to the east from the cave.
沿著洞窟往東延伸的痕跡追蹤。
Explore the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the insane thief.
.... I can't control myself...fjfjfj This rock...
……我控制不了自己……fjfjfj 這塊石頭……
What is... this feeling... No I won't listen..
這是什麼……感覺……不，我不會聽的……
Bring back the piece of meteor to the secret agent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把那塊隕石碎片帶回 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 交給那名密探。
Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? Why on earth are you holding some?!
又見面了。你在底下找到那顆隕石了嗎？你到底為什麼手上會拿著一塊啊？！
I see. This material is incredibly rare and magically powerful. Meteors fall all over Gavel and come in a variety of colours and potency.
我明白了。這種材質極為稀有，魔力也極強。隕石在 Gavel 各地都會墜落，顏色與威力五花八門。
We don't fully understand them, but we know they are dangerous. Every scientist who has studied them has lost their minds.
我們還沒能完全理解它們，但我們知道它們很危險。每一個研究過它們的科學家，最後都瘋了。
The meteors hold many secrets and powers, maybe the ones we need to end your war. Thank you, here's a small reward for helping us.
隕石藏著許多祕密與力量，也許正是我們結束你們那場戰爭所需要的。謝謝你，這是一點小小的謝禮。
Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? No? Maybe go back and try to find it?
又見面了。你在底下找到那顆隕石了嗎？沒有？那要不要回去再找找看？
Remember... Just follow the white trail leading to the cave!
記住……順著那道白色的痕跡走，就會到那個洞窟！
I can't... control... my mind... end me.
我沒辦法……控制……我的意識……殺了我。
What was that? It seems to have landed nearby, maybe you should go investigate.
那是什麼？好像落在附近了，也許你該去調查一下。
It seems like the meteor crashed into a cave.
看來隕石墜落在一座洞窟裡了。
The meteor shard is radiating an odd and unfamiliar magical energy
隕石碎片散發著一股奇異而陌生的魔法能量
Thank you again for your help!
Well? Did you buy the supply crate yet?
All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. It's not that hard!
你只要走到交易市場，幫我把那箱補給買下來就好。沒那麼難吧！
You bought the crate! Good, good. You still need to pick it up from the Trade Market, though!
你買到箱子了！很好，很好。不過你還得去交易市場把它領出來！
Hey! I- uh, I can't help but notice that. You're still here. With the crate. You need to bring it to {p}, remember?
嘿！我——呃，我不得不注意到這件事。你還在這裡。還帶著那個箱子。你得把它送到 {p}，記得吧？
What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
幹嘛？別用那種眼神看我！我們那次交易完全公平，雙方都得利。我拿到了植物，而你……嗯。你得到了經驗？
So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
所以你要嘛把補給跑一趟送到 {p}……要嘛我們兩個一起跑路重新做人，把自己的爛攤子甩在後面！
Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.
你好啊！想搭車去 {p} 嗎？很抱歉，馬車壞了。
I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.
我看用不了多久就能修好，不過眼下你得自己走一趟了。
This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.
這個快速旅行需要完成「補給與運送」才能使用。
I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
希望這些綠寶石夠。另外……我們最近修好了一輛壞掉的馬車，可以往返 {p}。
Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
唉，天啊……我現在該怎麼辦……
O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
哦、哦！你、你好啊士兵！哇，我們今天居然都在……在 {p}……真巧啊……

聽著，好啦，我懂！可是我怎麼樣都還不了你錢。鎮長派我來這裡領一箱給村子的補給。
The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
問題是……我的錢已經花在——呃，別的事情上了。而且就算我有錢，我也買不到那箱補給……
Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
那邊管市集的那兩個人，在我試圖把全世界的魔法粉末都掃光之後，就永久禁止我使用市集了。
Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
聽著，我在市場上做大動作又不是我的錯。我只是，你知道的——比這裡其他人都聰明！
... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
……總之。我現在真的很需要你幫忙！我——我保證，這次我一定還你。
All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
你只要走到交易市場，幫我把那箱補給買下來就好。拜託？
... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
……什麼？他們連你也一起禁了？！這下好了。那我們現在該怎麼辦？
Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
那，你還有沒有別的朋友可以拉進來？就……另一個當兵的那傢伙，對吧？他叫……Tim。之類的。
Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
聽著——好啦，我懂，我是個記不住別人名字的混蛋！你能不能就去請他幫我們把補給買下來？他是我們最後的希望……大概吧。
Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的交易市場買下那箱補給。
Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
嘿，幹得好！接下來你得去把那箱補給領回來。
Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找 Tasim，說服他幫你買下那箱補給。
Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
哦，嘿，{u}！你只是來晃晃的嗎？還是——你臉上那個表情告訴我，你是為了別的事來的。
[{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
[{~}] 你能不能幫我從交易市場買個東西？

我……應該可以？你自己不能買，是有什麼原因嗎？
...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!

You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
你——什麼？！算了，我其實不想知道。走吧，你帶路。不管你要什麼……我幫你買。
...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
……哦。那就說得通了。不過——你自己不能去拿，是有什麼原因嗎？
You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy whatever it is Ope needs.
你——什麼？！算了，我其實不想知道。走吧，你帶路。Ope 要什麼我都幫他買。
Oh, hello . Are you here for training as well? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
哦，你好。你也是來受訓的嗎？還是——你臉上那個表情告訴我，你是為了別的事來的。
Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
帶 Tasim 到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的交易市場。
Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
好。所以我只是要買一箱補給……
Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
拿去。不管你在忙什麼……祝你順利。
Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
太好了！快，趁那兩個人還沒發現你跟我是一夥的，快回這邊來！
You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
東西拿到了？好。很好、很好。
Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
好！那我們進入第二步。是這樣的，這箱東西還是得送到 {p} 去……
And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
而。嗯。拿著箱子的人是你，不是我！所以……你懂的！
Fine, I'll take the crate to
Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
太好了！路你現在肯定認得了！用不著我，呃，在旁邊礙事！
Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
你就把那些補給送到 {p}，然後。嗯。事情就會順利解決的。
Why can't you just take the
Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
這個嘛，是這樣的。我真的很不想做這件事。而我也不打算做！
...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
……不要？不要。好吧。問問也無妨。路你現在認得了！用不著我，呃，在旁邊礙事！嘿……
He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
他幫你把東西買下來了？好。很好、很好。好！這……比我想的還難。
Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把補給箱送到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p}，交給 Alvin 鎮長。
Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
啊，你好！今天有什麼我能為你效勞的嗎？
I have a supply crate from D
我帶了一箱補給，來自 D
Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
啊……原來如此。我記得我是派 Ope 去領的……
More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
我想又是他那些鬼把戲吧。真抱歉讓你跟他打了兩次交道。
When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
等他回村裡，我得跟他好好談一談……啊，不過當然了，我該為你的辛勞付你報酬。

你隨時想用都可以！算是謝謝你為我們做的一切。

他是個好人，真的。我打從心底相信這一點。不過你要是不這麼想，那也沒關係。你不願意跟他往來，我不會勉強你。
Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
哎呀……我接下這個位子，應該是十五年前的事了，那時候老鎮長卸任。

他是個好心人，總是照顧著鎮上的人。不過他退休的時候，看得出來他在我們這座小鎮已經待不住了。

結果呢，他一把位子交給我，立刻就跑去 {p} 從軍了！我聽說他現在在訓練士兵。

啊，不過我一直努力想不辜負他留下來的東西。我想我這些年的鎮長當得還不錯！
A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
今天真是路過的好日子！希望你在這裡待得愉快。

你看起來像個正缺差事的冒險者，朋友。我這裡有事要找你幫忙，不過你至少得有 {~} 級。
Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been here to help!
Tasim 把你解決掉的那支腐敗部隊全講給我聽了。真希望我當時也在這裡幫得上忙！

我們成功了！回去找 Van 中尉，把這個消息告訴他。

哦，等等。我們得先繞一站。跟我去找物品升級師！

聽說塔頂那個大傢伙怕  水屬性傷害！

你可以把各種元素粉末塗到武器上，讓武器能打出原本打不出來的傷害類型。

以這次來說，你可以塗上  水元素粉末，這樣你的武器對付塔裡那些腐敗敵人就更有效了！

……總之，來，拿著這罐元素粉末，把它拿在手上，然後右鍵點擊你的武器。弄好跟我說一聲！
You see this Item Upgrader? It can be used to upgrade powders to high tiers.
看到這個物品升級師了嗎？它可以把粉末升級到更高的階級。

需要的話，它也能把粉末從你的物品上拆下來，別擔心，粉末會還給你！

……總之，Van 中尉他們在 {p} 那一片房子旁邊，你進來的時候大概有看到。

誰去做都不太重要，事情辦成就好。看到機會，就上！
If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here! Understood?
需要撤退、或是腐敗者都清乾淨了，就回到這裡集合！明白了嗎？
Hey, {u}, there you are! Come on, let's climb that tower!
嘿，{u}，你在這裡！來吧，我們去爬那座塔！
They have, lieutenant! {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
肅清了，中尉！{u} 和我攻上塔頂，解決了那隻腐敗者。
Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} 兵營跟 Aledar 談話。
Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
哦，{u}！嘿！能再見到你跟 Tasim 真好。希望你們沒有背著我跑去太多場冒險！

你要找 Tasim 的話，他到訓練室去了。他是真的一頭栽進去了，這……也好啦！我們都得變強，才守得住這個行省。
...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
……哦對！既然你來了——我正要去加入 Van 中尉的小隊，要奪回一座被腐敗者佔據的塔。你也一起來吧！
Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
怎麼樣？想不想累積一點真正的戰鬥經驗？花不了多久的。
Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
太好了。那還等什麼，就是現在！我們走。
I've got something to do her
Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
我還會在這裡待一陣子。你改變主意的話跟我說一聲！
Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
嘿，你回來了！改變主意了嗎？想不想一起去攻打腐敗之塔？
Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟著 Aledar 前往 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的粉末大師。

好，是這樣的。關於我們要攻打的那座塔，我聽到了一件我們可以事先準備的事！

聽說塔頂那個大傢伙怕 傷害！所以呢，我們就來粉末大師這裡了。

我，呃……沒辦法把整套元素的說明背出來。你想多了解的話，得去兵營找 Ragon 隊長。他有一整套課程！
...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
……總之——來，拿著這罐元素粉末，去找粉末大師塗上。弄好跟我說一聲！

你帶路！我就跟在你後面。
Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的狂怒之塔附近與 Van 中尉的小隊會合。

啊，Aledar！在這裡看到你真好。跟你一起的這位是？

這位是 {u}，長官。如果您允許，他們想加入我們的攻堅。

嗯……我看不出有什麼不可以。人多好辦事，我一向這麼說。

人都到齊的話就可以開始了。計畫是這樣！我們得在塔底清掉一部分敵人，好讓有人能爬到塔頂。
Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
很好。好了士兵們，把那座塔奪回來！

Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
哈！你？一個傳說？！真是笑話。順帶一提，你不是第一個這樣試的。我們之中的每一位成員我都認識，而你不是其中之一。
Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
啊，當傳說神殿的守門人真是個有趣的差事。快走吧。等你有真材實料再來給我看。
If you think I'm not impress
既然你覺得我沒什麼了不起，我又何必費心說服你？
Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
哼。荒謬。我不需要你來說服我任何事！很明顯，你不過是個冒牌貨。
Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
快走吧。要是拿不出什麼像樣的東西，就別浪費我的時間！
...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
……不過——啊。既然你還站在這裡。也許——不不，別鬧了，Kelight。
Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
振作點，Kelight，別這樣，你不能就這樣被他們用沉默戰術拿下……
Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
喔，好吧。你引起我的興趣了。你到底有什麼特別的？你看起來就是個普通士兵，可是……
Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
很好。我允許你嘗試這場試煉。或許到那時，你就能證明自己了。
Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
附近一座洞穴的深處藏著一頭無可比擬的野獸。是腐敗過的沒錯，但跟你以前遇過的任何敵人都不一樣。
His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
他叫 Jorkin，關於那個界域，他懂得比我認識的任何人都多。到 {p} 附近找他，那裡位於 {p}。請他幫忙，就說是我叫你去的。
Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
想辦法讓 Kelight 放你進入 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的傳說神殿。
So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
所以你回來了！很有意思。這確實讓你比其他嘗試過的人高了一個層次……但還不夠。
So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
那麼告訴我，我憑什麼要給你這個機會？因為到目前為止，我一點都不覺得驚豔。
So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
你確實是！我也一樣。恐怕你沒那麼容易從我這裡過去。
Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
那你可以走了。沒有東西給我看就別回來！
Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
是啊，我開始有這種感覺了。你這人真是讓人頭痛，你知道嗎？
Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
好啦！好啦。我給你一個機會。我很確定你不會成功，但只要能讓你別再煩我，做什麼都行。
Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
咳。附近一座洞穴的深處藏著一頭無可比擬的野獸。是腐敗過的沒錯，但跟你以前遇過的任何敵人都不一樣。
Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.
到 {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Jorkin 談 Light Dust 的事。
Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
啊，你好啊大兵。今天什麼風把你吹到我這寒舍來的？
Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
我的天。你……你想去攻擊「他」？那、那頭可怕的野獸！你瘋了嗎？！
Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
唉，Kelight 一直用他那些愚蠢的任務把你這樣的冒險者送去送死！
Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
好吧。你要是真的這麼堅持要走向死亡，我可以告訴你該去哪裡。
Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
往下到 the Roots，那裡有座洞穴，裡面滿是你需要的 Light Dust。
Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
那座洞穴裡住著強大的腐敗生物，取的時候務必小心，拿到之後帶回來給我。
Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
找到傳送門附近 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的光塵洞窟。
Retrieve [{~} Light Dust] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
那麼，Light Dust 你拿到了？交過來，我想看點東西。
Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
啊，跟我想的一樣。連這道光都已經被腐敗沾染了。抱歉，看來你沒辦法跟他打，回家吧。
...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
……唉，什麼都瞞不過你，是吧？你是真的鐵了心要去跟他打。
Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
好吧，我說 Light Dust 被腐敗了那不是騙你，不過有辦法把它淨化。
An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
我有位老相識叫 Rayshyroth，他有辦法。他住在 {p}。
He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
關於那個……東西，他知道的比我研究地獄這麼多年還多。說不定他能把你勸退。
Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust
到 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找 Rayshyroth 淨化光塵
Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
喔？你好啊。什麼風把你吹到我們這座安靜的孤島，而且還一路爬到這麼上面來的？
Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
這個我當然做得到，但我需要材料。以你現在的本事，那些應該都難不倒你吧？
You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
是這樣的，我這棟屋子底下有一處泉眼，會湧出一股強大的魔法流。
It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
只要加以擾動，它就會產生一種特殊的魔法蒸氣，我可以用那個替你淨化光塵。
I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [{~} Sky Vapor] for the task.
我看這東西腐敗得這麼嚴重，這件事我至少需要 [{~} Sky Vapor]。
Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
找到 {p} 上 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 那座 Sky Flux 匯聚的洞穴。
Give [{~} Sky Vapor] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把 [{~} Sky Vapor] 交給 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Rayshyroth。
Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
啊哈，你帶著 Sky Vapor 回來了！那段路真是抱歉，連我自己有時候都覺得不方便。
While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
在我進行淨化儀式的同時，我想問你一件事。你到底知不知道你要面對的是什麼？
Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
別這麼驚訝，我很清楚你要 Light Dust 是為了什麼。那頂抵禦腐敗的頭盔……好讓你能與世界腐敗者一戰。

...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
……不過呢，說法不一。有人說第一個進入傳送門的是 Bak'al，而世界腐敗者只是地獄來的一頭野獸。但真相不明，並不會改變他的強大。
Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
你只要記得，除了那個自命不凡的 Kelight 之外，就算你選擇不去跟他打，也沒有人會因此看輕你。
Show the [Purified Light Dust] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把 [Purified Light Dust] 拿去給 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 傳說神殿入口的 Kelight 看。
You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
你還需要一件能把魔力聚集在你身上的東西，最好是能穿戴的。嗯……頭盔如何？那對你那可憐的品味肯定大有幫助。
Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
咳。至於製作的部分……我只認識一個人有能力打出足以確保你安全的護甲。

可惜的是，他很難找。他叫 Garull，是我見過最出色的工匠！不過性格有點古怪。
He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
他老是喋喋不休地講苦力怕……他還真的以為那種東西存在，你能想像嗎？根本是徹頭徹尾的胡說八道。
In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
總之，那至少是個可以開始找的地方！你要是真能找到他，還說服他替你打出那頂頭盔，就回來這裡，我們再繼續。
Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 一帶的 {p} 裡，找到痴迷苦力怕的工匠 Garull。
GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
哇啊！我的天，別這樣嚇我！你……你到底是誰？！

所以，要我替你打這頂頭盔，你不只要帶 [Old Touroto Hide] 來，還得帶上能讓它恢復原有強度的東西。仔細聽好，要說的可不少！
There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
首先是 [Aseado Leaf]，長在 {p} 的某個地方……它有強大的藥性，據說能夠逆轉老化。
There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}...it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
有一種 [Aseado Leaf]，長在 {p} 的某處……藥性極強，據說能讓人返老還童。
Then, a [Maro's Eye Jewel], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
再來是 [Maro's Eye Jewel]，那是一種驚人的魔法聚焦物，來自……不然還能是哪，就是 {p}。用它的粉末，我可以手工把魔法韌性還給那張皮。

最後我需要一塊 [Coral of Nelfors]，可以在 {p} 找到。我要用它替那張皮附上抗魔的效果。

這些我都寫進你的綜合手冊裡了。要是你全都弄到了就回來找我，不過拜託別再那麼鬼鬼祟祟地靠近我了！
Bring the [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel], and [Coral of Nelfors] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把 [Old Touroto Hide]、[Aseado Leaf]、[Maro's Eye Jewel] 和 [Coral of Nelfors] 帶到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞穴給 Garull。
Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
謝謝你聽我的話，過來的時候沒那麼安靜。我猜你東西都齊了？
Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
好，這應該很快。Kelight 那個人再怎麼自大，把你送來找我打這個倒是沒錯。

現在，我想提醒你一件事。關於你需要這頂頭盔去面對的那個敵人，我聽過一些傳聞，沒有一個是好的。

我確實見過有人殺了他口中那頭「野獸」之後回來，但那不常見。你要是決定去打，務必萬分小心。
Bring the [Helmet of the Legends] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
把 [Helmet of the Legends] 帶去 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 傳說神殿入口給 Kelight。

頭盔你拿到了吧？交過來。我很快把光塵加上去。之後你就可以進入那座洞穴了。

……那，祝你好運！我很確定你不是成功，就是敗得驚天動地。反正兩者之一。
