帶回你戰勝那頭野獸的具體證明，我就准你進入傳說神殿！動作快一點，好嗎？
Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
擊殺 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 洞穴裡的世界腐敗者，並把他的死亡證明帶到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 給 Kelight。
Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
連我這樣勇敢又強大的人都不可能在他面前活下來——
Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
呃……我是說，你當然打得贏那頭野獸！我從一開始就相信你！
...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
……咳。我想，你現在可以進入傳說神殿了！你……確實證明了自己。之前看走眼，我向你道歉。為你的成就感到驕傲吧！
Hm? What are these oddities you have with you? Curious, yet useless. Allow me to dispose of them for you.
嗯？你身上帶的這些奇怪玩意兒是什麼？稀奇，但沒什麼用。就讓我來替你處理掉吧。
Comprehensive Guide to Raising an Animal
This guide shall serve as your one-stop shop to caring for mounts.
這本指南會是你照顧坐騎的一站式寶典。
To ensure that a mount has the room and ability to grow and become strong, certain conditions have to be met.
要確保坐騎有空間與能力成長變強，必須滿足某些條件。
To start, a mount has to be placed inside a Feeder to be used. Feeders can be found in Enclosures.
首先，坐騎必須放進餵食器裡才能使用。餵食器可以在圍欄裡找到。
For starters, a mount will get tired as you train it. They are living beings after all! Ensure they have enough food in their Feeder so they can regain their energy.
首先，坐騎在訓練時會疲累。畢竟他們也是活生生的！要確保他們的餵食器裡有足夠的食物，才能恢復能量。

Mounts love to eat or chew on almost any crafting material harvested from crop fields, from fish, even from trees and stones! Just make sure the material's level matches that of the mount for greatest effectiveness.
坐騎幾乎什麼採集材料都愛吃愛咬，從作物田裡採來的、從魚身上取的，甚至樹木和石頭都行！只要確定材料的等級跟坐騎相符，效果最好。

You can purchase tools from Tool Merchants all over the provinces to harvest these materials yourself, too! Bring Grains, String, Paper, Planks, Ingots, Gems, Meat, or Oil to the Feeder to have a happy, well-fed mount.
你也可以在各行省的工具商人那裡買工具，自己採集這些材料！把穀物、線、紙、木板、錠、寶石、肉或油帶到餵食器，坐騎就會吃得好、心情好。
Certain materials will boost different stats. For example, meat will boost Energy and Acceleration. They need a varied diet, just like us.
某些材料會提升不同的屬性。舉例來說，肉會提升「能量」和「動量」。他們跟我們一樣，需要多樣的飲食。
Breeding is useful for creating a strong and fast mount, capable of the most grueling journeys.
繁殖能用來培育出強壯又快速的坐騎，足以應付最艱苦的旅程。

To breed a mount, simply put two of the same mount in the same row of a Feeder. Give it some time and you will see an offspring. A mount is only capable of breeding once they reach an average Limit of {~}.
要讓坐騎繁殖，只要把兩隻同種的坐騎放進餵食器的同一列。給它一點時間，你就會看到後代。坐騎只有在平均上限達到 {~} 之後才有辦法繁殖。
The offspring will inherit some of the parents' visual traits, and will have a chance to gain better stats. If the mounts bred had any previous training done, the offspring will inherit that as well.
後代會繼承父母的一些外觀特徵，也有機會獲得更好的屬性。如果用來繁殖的坐騎先前受過訓練，後代也會繼承那些訓練。
A mount's level can be increased to the Limit by training it. However, it can be further increased to its Max by feeding it.
坐騎的等級可以透過訓練提升到「上限」。不過，再餵食還能把它推得更高，直到「最大值」。
Ensure your mounts have good food to eat if you want them to become strong! Refer to the General Information chapter for more information on feeding.
想讓坐騎變強，就要確保他們有好東西吃！關於餵食的更多說明，請參考「一般資訊」那一章。
Although most traits are self-explanatory, this guide has them sorted in a list for your convenience.
雖然大部分特質看名字就懂，這本指南還是為了方便把它們整理成一份清單。
Speed is all about the max speed your mount can reach.
「速度」講的是坐騎能達到的最高速度。
Acceleration will ensure your mount reaches its max speed faster.
「動量」能確保你的坐騎更快達到最高速度。
Jump Height is all about... you guessed it - how high your mount can jump!
「跳躍高度」講的就是……你猜到了——坐騎能跳多高！
Increasing the Energy stat increases the max energy your mount will have. A worthwhile investment if you're planning to travel across the provinces.
提升「能量」屬性會增加坐騎的能量上限。如果你打算跨行省旅行，這是值得的投資。
Handling is all about your mount's movement efficiency.
「操控」講的是坐騎移動時的效率。
Increasing the stat will allow your mount to more easily climb steep surfaces, turn faster, and be slightly more nimble before they reach their top speeds.
提升這個屬性能讓坐騎更容易爬上陡坡、轉向更快，在達到最高速之前也更靈活一些。
Toughness helps prevent your mount from becoming startled and throwing you off, in case you're ambushed by an enemy.
「韌性」能幫助坐騎在你被敵人突襲時不受驚、不把你甩下來。
Boost will ensure that your mounts make the most out of the boosts they find in the wild.
「衝刺」能確保你的坐騎把野外遇到的加速裝置發揮到極致。
A good Training trait will allow your mount to more easily become stronger and improve as you train it.
好的「訓練」特質能讓你的坐騎更容易變強，也更容易隨著訓練進步。
Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things. Such a premise is hard to believe.
傳聞說這生物本來是最早深入那道傳送門的礦工之一……當然，身為一個傳說，我通常不會理會這種說法。這種前提實在難以相信。
In any case, its power cannot be understated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
不管怎樣，他的力量不容低估。就算配備最好的裝備，光是進入他的洞穴都會大幅削弱你！
Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light whose origin is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
靠近他會很快讓你腐敗，所以你需要防護。只有源自那頭野獸所屬界域的光才管用。
As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Portal and that which lies... beyond.
因此，你踏上成為傳說之路的第一步將會是……去拜訪我的一位朋友，他研究那道傳送門，以及門後……的事物。
Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've retrieved the light you'll need for protection.
怎麼？任務已經交給你了，不是嗎？拿到你防護所需的那道光之前別回來。
...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
……我明白了。是的，那該死的傳送門的腐敗相當強。這需要淨化，我並不意外。
Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was its title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how it came to be...
是啊，是啊。我想 Kelight 沒有費心告訴你那就是它的稱號。我也猜你沒被告知太多它是怎麼來的細節……

The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds is said to have been a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. It is told he was the first to enter that wicked realm.
那頭如今被稱為世界腐敗者的野獸，據說曾經只是一名普通的採礦隊長，就在那場發現地獄傳送門的探勘期間。據說他是第一個踏進那個邪惡界域的人。

The man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Realm of War, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
從此再也沒有人聽過那個人的消息……嗯，直到腐敗的大軍開始從戰爭領域湧出，而他就走在最前面。有點諷刺，不是嗎？生前領著礦工，死後領著腐敗者。
The mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
那裡的採礦隊撐不到幾分鐘。他親手屠殺了自己原本那支隊伍的每一個人，還有數千人。地獄的能量讓他強大得可怕。
Hah. Took you long enough! This is the light dust, I presume?
哈。你可花了不少時間。這就是光塵，我猜？
I'll hold on to this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
這個我先保管著。雖然它是你防護的關鍵材料，但光靠它還不夠。
When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I don't know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
我說這個想法很荒謬的時候，他好像被我的話弄得很不高興，之後就不再來了。說真的，我不知道我哪裡做錯了。真是個荒唐的人。
As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank have ever seen him there.
以現況來說，我完全不知道你能在哪裡找到他。他提過好幾次想研究 Pigman Ravines，不過我們之中從來沒有人在那裡見過他。
Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've found Garull and obtained a helmet.
怎麼？任務已經交給你了，不是嗎？找到 Garull 並拿到一頂頭盔之前別回來。
...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you manage to actually find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
……嗯？喔，又是你。你真的找到那個討厭鬼了嗎？至少知道他沒死也算是好事。
Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight it. Six fighters strong... never came back.
希望你會比上一群想去打他的人做得好。六名戰士……一個都沒回來。
...You're still here? You have your challenge. Slay that beast within the cave, and bring me proof. Then, and only then, will you have proven your worth.
……你還在這裡？你的挑戰已經給你了。去殺掉那個洞穴裡的野獸，帶證據回來給我。到那時，也只有到那時，你才算證明了自己的價值。
I am proud to have you in our temple! Perhaps one day you shall be almost as great as I am!
我很榮幸有你加入我們的神殿！也許有一天你會幾乎跟我一樣偉大！
However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! Let me see if you are even worth my time.
不過呢，身為一個傳說，我可是非常忙的，要簽名之類的，更別提我還得站崗！讓我看看你到底值不值得我花時間。
Yko dare kker these sk:;DJkkkAJEkkkkThkksad:ek ghakkkkkreid:
You still have the chance to give up. You can stop trying to fight that thing at any time...
你還有機會放棄。你隨時都可以不再跟那東西打下去……
Remember, check your content book for guidance.
記住，需要指引就翻翻綜合手冊。
But... There's probably some kind of wacky magic keeping it shut, since I can't get it open at all!
不過……大概有某種古怪的魔法把它封住了，因為我怎麼樣都打不開！
The monster you just killed was known as a Time Trouble. They're odd creatures that were forced into a day-long temporal loop by some fools long ago.
你剛殺掉的那隻怪物叫做「時之亂流」。他們是很奇怪的生物，很久以前被一群蠢貨強行困進了為期一天的時間迴圈裡。
Oh, he actually showed his face after you took care of the thing? What, did you beat him to the punch or something?
哦，你解決那東西之後他才真的現身？怎麼，是你搶先他一步之類的嗎？
Wait... What? He was...trying to seal the thing away, instead of killing it, and...you destroying it broke the seal?
等等……什麼？他本來是……想把那東西封印起來，而不是殺掉，然後……你殺了那東西反而破壞了封印？
...hm. Well, this is a bit awkward- I don't have a reward ready for you. Making this place took a lot of money... Hopefully gratitude is enough- thank you, sincerely!
……嗯。這有點尷尬，我沒有準備好給你的獎勵。建這個地方花了太多錢……希望我的感謝夠有份量。真的，謝謝你！
Hey, excuse me! I'm in need of- ...yeah, just walk right by me. Maybe I shoulda gone to {p} for help, these people here have enough problems...
喂，不好意思！我需要——……好吧，就這樣從我旁邊走過去啊。也許我該去 {p} 求助，這裡的人自己的麻煩就夠多了……
Don't suppose you'd be willing to help, huh? Bet you're busy- Wait, you've got spare time? Criminy, only took a week of asking! Good to meet ya.
你該不會願意幫忙吧？我猜你很忙——等等，你有空？老天，我才問了一個禮拜就問到了！幸會。
Alright, My name is Tyko, and I got asked to find a capable soldier for- well, lemme explain. So, I'm from a place called {p}, by {p}. It's a recent establishment.
好，我叫 Tyko，有人拜託我找一位有本事的士兵來——呃，讓我解釋。我來自一個叫 {p} 的地方，在 {p} 旁邊。那是最近才建起來的。
I'm buddies with the mayor- he set up {p} as kind of a homeless shelter for people whose homes got ruined by corrupted attacks, since {p} doesn't seem corrupted.
我跟鎮長是朋友——他把 {p} 弄成一種收容所，收留那些家園被腐敗生物摧毀的人，因為 {p} 看起來沒有被腐敗。
Some old guy with jaundice or something swings by, some kind of keeper- Says to set up on a ridge overlooking a lake. So, we did! Everything was going well for a bit.
有個得了黃疸還什麼的老頭經過，好像是什麼守護者——他叫我們在俯瞰湖泊的山脊上落腳。所以我們就照做了！有一陣子一切都很順利。
And then some freaky time monster starts showing up in the middle of the night and tries to bust down our doors! We were told that ridge was safe, but that was clearly a lie.
然後就有個詭異的時間怪物開始在半夜出現，想把我們的門撞破！人家跟我們說那條山脊是安全的，結果顯然是騙人的。
So, that's why I'm here. No one at {p} is tough enough to kill that thing, so I ran over here to ask for some backup. Glad I ran into ya!
所以我才來這裡。{p} 沒有人強到能殺掉那東西，我只好跑來這邊找援手。還好遇到你！
Lemme write down the coordinates for ya in your book. I'm gonna stick around and see if anyone else feels like helping.
我把座標寫進你的書裡。我還會待在這邊，看看有沒有別人想幫忙。
The coordinates to where you need to go should be in your book. Help us out, yeah?
你要去的地方，座標應該在你的書裡了。幫我們一把，好嗎？
Hello- Welcome to {p}, friend! Established only two months ago, I'm proud to provide aid to those displaced by corrupted raids.
你好——歡迎來到 {p}，朋友！這裡兩個月前才建立，我很自豪能幫助那些被腐敗生物襲擊而流離失所的人。
Come to think of it, you look like a {p} representative... Can I bother you to deliver some paperwork to the castle about getting officially established here?
這麼一說，你看起來像是 {p} 的代表……能不能麻煩你送一些文件到城堡，辦理我們在這裡正式立案的手續？
...Repeat that? ...OH! Oh, no wonder you- Agh, my mind's all over the place from stress, I'm so relieved he found help finally!
……你再說一次？……哦！哦，難怪你——唉，壓力大到我腦子一團亂，他終於找到人幫忙，我真是鬆了一口氣！
Alright, Tyko told you about the monster, right? We were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there weren't any dangerous creatures here!
好，Tyko 跟你說過那隻怪物了吧？那個叫 Martyn 的老人叫我們在這條山脊上落腳，因為這裡沒有任何危險生物！
Oh, not that kind of soldier? That's too bad... But- oh, this is a shot in the dark, but... maybe you'd be the type of soldier to take out a monster for us?
哦，你不是那種士兵？真可惜……不過——哦，這大概是碰運氣，但……你搞不好是那種能替我們宰掉怪物的士兵？
You- you would!? Oh, thank goodness you arrived when you did! You see- we were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there apparently weren't any dangerous creatures here!
你——你願意？！哦，你來得真是時候！你聽我說——那個叫 Martyn 的老人叫我們在這條山脊上落腳，因為這裡據說沒有任何危險生物！
But every night, the same monster emerges from one of the ruins, and tries to smash the buildings down! Every single night, at the same time!
可是每天晚上，同一隻怪物就從其中一處遺跡裡冒出來，想把建築物砸爛！每一個晚上，都在同一個時間！
The guards are getting run ragged, and I refuse to be responsible for any deaths when I'm trying to save these folks!
守衛都快被操垮了，我是想救這些人，可不想害誰送命！
We found the ruin it came out of, too- Er, one of the folks here, Doug, did! Here, let me write down the location for you- no, no, I insist, let me do it!
我們也找到他出來的那處遺跡了——呃，是這裡一位叫 Doug 的居民找到的！來，我把位置寫給你——不不，我堅持，讓我來寫！
There's the coordinates in case you forget, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
座標在這裡，免得你忘記，不過就在山坡上那座神殿裡！拜託，拜託快去解決那隻可怕的怪物！
The coordinates are in your book, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
座標在你的書裡，不過就在山坡上那座神殿裡！拜託，拜託快去解決那隻可怕的怪物！
Grr... I KNOW I saw that beast go in here, where the heck is it?!
唔……我明明看到那隻野獸進來了，他到底跑到哪去了？！
Hey soldier, does that disk look like some type of door to you?
喂，士兵，你覺得那個圓盤看起來像某種門嗎？
I saw some creature that I've been tracking for a few days disappear around here, and I think it's somewhere behind this disk...
我追蹤了好幾天的某隻生物，就在這附近消失了，我想他就在這個圓盤後面的某個地方……
Hey, you're able to use magic, right? Maybe using one of your fancy spells on the disk will get it open?
喂，你會用魔法對吧？也許對著圓盤放一個你那種花俏的法術，就能打開了？
Stand on the disk and cast any spell. That should probably get it open, then we can finally kill that freak of nature lurking inside of there!
站到圓盤上，隨便放一個法術。應該就能打開了，然後我們終於可以宰掉躲在裡面那個怪胎！
Let's see... What kind of secrets do these odd temples house?
我看看……這些奇怪的神殿裡藏著什麼祕密呢？
Use spells to break open the temple at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
What was going through your noggin, {u}?
Do you have any idea what you were doing? Bashing around that room I just sealed off for good?
你知道自己剛才在做什麼嗎？在我才剛永久封印起來的房間裡亂砸？
You need to be careful, soldier! This Valley's secrets are NOT to be meddled with.
你得小心點，士兵！這座谷地的祕密，是不能亂碰的。
I assume the mayor of that place called {p} sent you here. You are going to have to tell that lad that his problems just got worse.
我猜是那個叫 {p} 的地方的鎮長派你來的。你得去告訴那小子，他的麻煩剛剛變得更大了。

要有效壓制他們，唯一的辦法就是封印，就像我剛才在這裡做的那樣。可是你剛才那一下，讓波紋擴散到整座谷地。現在，每一隻時之亂流都在回應這一隻的死亡！
Now, one Time Trouble I can handle, but this? I can't keep them all at bay... and now, you went and awakened every single one of those critters.
一隻時之亂流我還應付得來，可是這樣？我壓不住全部……而現在，你把那些傢伙全都吵醒了。

我可以把這個封印修好，這樣你要對付的就少一隻，但其餘的時之亂流，只能每天靠蠻力打下來。

那些就得靠你了，士兵。這座谷地裡我要處理的事情太多了。

他們每天都得被清一次。我想這份工作不會白做，{p} 的鎮民說不定會為此給你報酬。

總之，在谷地裡請小心。我已經得照看一個人了，更別提 Olm 當年搞出來的那一團時間亂——

你回來了！我聽到山坡上的神殿傳來某種怪聲——那是好兆頭嗎？
You did?! Oh, thank goodness... Honestly, Martyn told us he would deal with it, but then he just disappeared off into nowhere!
你辦到了？！哦，謝天謝地……老實說，Martyn 跟我們說他會處理，結果他就這樣消失得無影無蹤！

現在還變多了？他為什麼不早說？！這下每天都得把他們壓下去才行！！

唉，這下慘了……這不是你的錯，你又不知道——等等，你手上那個方方的東西是什麼？[Time Fragment]？……哦，是那隻怪物掉的。

有意思……鎮上有個人專門收集這類東西！就是我後面那位神祕商人。

去跟他聊聊那些東西！你拿去跟他換，他說不定會給你值得的東西。

……還有，你不在的時候，山坡上那顆奇怪的魔法石開始發光了。我們也不太確定該拿它怎麼辦！也許值得你去看看。
Heya! Heard from the mayor that you helped out the town! Can't thank you enough for that.
嘿！聽鎮長說你幫了鎮上的忙！真是感激不盡。

哦，是你！希望你有把那些時之亂流壓著。

哦，嘿！希望那隻怪物沒讓你打得太辛苦。

你這麼大隻，肯定不會睡著！拜託幫我採一些回來。

Razorice 的問題解決了，現在只要找到 Psilo 說的那株藍色蘑菇就行了……

前往蘑菇洞窟與 Psilo 對話。

歡迎，巨大的人類！你那是什麼眼神，沒見過地精嗎？！我的家看起來也許很小，但對我來說剛剛好！

其實我需要幫忙。是這樣的，Razorice 把我家鬧得天翻地覆！他們有點像你們行省的老鼠，但對地精來說又兇又致命！

不過有個很簡單的解法。這座洞窟裡有很多魔法蘑菇，其中一種很稀有的叫 Subtraxerim Utilium，正是我們需要的。
It emits a sleeping spore that will knock the Razorice out long enough to kill them! I've seen one in the cave but every time I go to get it, I fall asleep!
它會釋放一種催眠孢子，能把 Razorice 放倒夠久讓我們解決他們！我在洞窟裡看過一株，可是每次我想去採，自己就先睡著了！
I left a trail of spores from the location. Since you're so big, you won't fall asleep! Please retrieve some mushroom for me.
我從那個位置一路灑了孢子做記號。你這麼大隻，肯定不會睡著！拜託幫我採一些回來。

我上次想採的時候好像灑了一路的彩虹孢子，順著顏色穿過洞窟就能找到那株蘑菇了！
Find the Subtraxerim Utilium mushroom in the cave and bring it back to Psilo.

Turn left from the mine's entrance and speak to the chief at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
從礦坑入口左轉，到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與工頭談話。

沒錯，動作別停！照這個速度，整個 {p} 的煤都要用光了！

嗯？你要幹嘛？這裡之後只有登記過的礦工能進。有話快說，不然就滾出去。
...An explosion? In the mines? Just now?
EMERGENCY BREAK TIME, YOU GERBILS! EVERYONE COME AND MEET ME BY THE ENTRANCE! NOW!!!
緊急休息時間，你們這群沙鼠！所有人到入口這邊集合！現在！！！

好了，你們最好給我聽仔細。礦坑裡回報有爆炸。你們都知道那代表什麼吧？

不是，你們這群不知感恩的傢伙！你們其中一個要帶著那隻老金絲雀下礦坑，看看到底是怎麼回事。
Now, which one of you blokes would be willing to-

那就這樣了。看來只剩你了，小夥子。怎麼樣？想要一份工作嗎？
You sure? I'll pay a lot, and it won't be dangerous. Even if it is, you've got all that armor on you!
你確定？我會給很多錢，而且不危險。就算危險，你身上不是有那一整套盔甲嗎！
That's the spirit! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
這才對嘛！那就來吧，我帶你去見我們那位長羽毛的小吉祥物。
You'll get a bloody mountain of emeralds, god damn it! This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Do you want it or not?
你會拿到一座他媽的綠寶石山，該死的！這是千載難逢的機會！你到底要不要？
Good. Now, hurry up and follow me.
You know what? This is ridiculous. The whole of {p} is at danger, and you're playing games with ME?! I know you can do it. Follow me. Now.
夠了。這太荒唐了。整個 {p} 都有危險，你還在跟「我」玩遊戲？！我知道你辦得到。跟我來。現在。

嚇到說不出話啦？別擔心，這工作很輕鬆。來吧，跟我到金絲雀的籠子那邊。
Meet our canary! She's such a beaut.
來見見我們的金絲雀！她真是個美人。
You see, whenever we hear news of an explosion, we always bring our canary with us to check it out. They can detect potential gases much earlier than we can.
跟你說，每次一聽到爆炸的消息，我們都會帶著金絲雀一起去查看。他們能比我們早得多察覺到可能的氣體。
Let me just get the key and-
WAIT, WHAT? WHERE'S THE BLOODY KEY? WHICH ONE OF YOU LOT IS RESPONSIBLE?! I SWEAR I'M GONNA...
等等，什麼？該死的鑰匙跑哪去了？你們哪一個要負責？！我發誓我要……
...Listen up, lad. Take this toothpick I've been chewing on. I need you to pick the cage's lock. It's a little wet, but it should do the trick. Understood? Good, now hurry up!
……聽好了，小子。拿去，這根我一直在咬的牙籤。我要你把籠子的鎖撬開。是有點濕，不過應該夠用。懂了嗎？很好，那就快點！
Doing just fine, lad. Almost there...
Little old birdie is getting quite excited! Keep it up.
小老鳥兒興奮起來了！繼續。
Right then, lad! It's time to begin the-
OW! Bloody hell! Those are some freakishly sharp claws! What are you playing at?!
痛！該死的！那爪子怎麼利成這樣！你在搞什麼——
Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. {u} will take care of it.
冷靜點，Ryan。我們不會丟掉的。我們是一起的。{u} 會處理好的。
Well, I think she likes you, lad. Doesn't like me, apparently.
嗯，我看她挺喜歡你的，小子。顯然不喜歡我。
I was going to feed her, but I suppose you can do the honors. Or not, seeing as she's been particularly troublesome...
我本來要餵她的，不過我看這份榮幸就讓給你吧。或者不用，畢竟她今天特別難搞……
Anyway, do as you please. I'll be waiting by the elevator in the mineshaft. Hurry up, and don't make me wait!
總之，你自己看著辦。我在礦道的電梯那邊等你。快一點，別讓我等！
Head to the mine elevator at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Right then, lad! I suppose you might want to know more about this job.
好了，小子！我想你大概會想多知道一點這份工作的事。
As I said before, when unknown explosions occur in the mines, that's usually a sign that something bad happened.
我剛剛說過，礦坑裡發生不明爆炸的時候，那通常代表有壞事發生了。
Most of the time, an awfully putrid gas appears. This is where our canary comes in. Once she verifies that a gas is present, we decide whether or not to temporarily close the mine.
大多數時候會冒出一種臭得要命的氣體。這時就輪到我們的金絲雀上場了。等她確認有氣體，我們再決定要不要暫時關閉礦坑。
I presume you met Daffyd and his group, correct? Thankfully, they were the only ones down in the mines.
你應該見過 Daffyd 那一夥了吧？幸好當時礦坑下面只有他們。
...Wait, where the hell even are they? Did I not tell them to...
……等等，他們人到底跑哪去了？我不是叫他們……
Eh, doesn't matter. Lad, point is, I want you to check whether that gas is still there, if at all.
呃，不重要。小子，重點是，我要你去查那氣體還在不在，如果真的有的話。
We'll use the elevator behind me to get down into the mines. Just let me pull this here lever to activate it...
我們要用我後面那台電梯下到礦坑。我拉一下這根拉桿啟動它……
...WHY ISN'T THIS BLOODY CONTRAPTION WORKING??! WORK, WORK, GOD DAMN IT!!
……這鬼東西為什麼不動？！動啊，動啊，該死的！！
Must've been Daffyd and his group... No worries, lad. I've got, uh...a last resort, so to speak.
一定是 Daffyd 那一夥搞的……別擔心，小子。我有，呃……可以說是最後手段。
Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The {u}'.
喜歡剛剛那場舞會嗎？那些舞步爛到我大可以把它們命名為「{u}」。

你得搭礦車下到礦坑裡。問題是，我們已經……好幾年沒用它們載過人了。
Why? Erm, well... See for yourself.
為什麼？呃，這個嘛……你自己看就知道。

我們的載運礦車是手排的。這裡的礦工都偏好自排。
For you, it should be no issue controlling it. There's instructions attached to the gear stick.
對你來說，操控它應該不成問題。排檔桿上貼著說明。

那麼，順著我後面的軌道進礦道。你在那裡可以叫出一台礦車。
Use the rails to get to the gas leakage.
利用軌道抵達氣體外洩處。
Follow the rail tracks and find a way to escape the mine
順著軌道前進，找出離開礦坑的方法
Continue further in the mine to find a way out.
繼續深入礦坑，找出出口。
I am but a figment of your imagination. To you, I am not real.
我不過是你想像出來的一個影子。對你而言，我並不真實。
The mysterious force that brought death upon me... It changed me.
那股帶來我的死亡的神祕力量……它改變了我。
So too will it change you. I will make that happen. Just for you.
它也會改變你。我會讓那件事發生。專為你。
No need to thank me. It is the least I can do.
不必謝我。這是我最起碼能做的。
Moments like these are cherished. Savor the moment with me. Would you like to die with me?
這樣的時刻值得珍惜。與我一同細細品味吧。你願意和我一起死去嗎？
No. I won't go that easily.
I see. So you want to make this an unforgettable experience. I appreciate the thoughtfulness.
我明白了。所以你想把這一次變成難忘的經驗。我很感謝你這份體貼。
I was hoping we could stay for a little longer. If that is your choice, then so be it.
我本來希望我們能多待一會兒。既然那是你的選擇，那就這樣吧。
See you on the other side.
I would be more than glad to. Sit back and relax.
我非常樂意。放輕鬆，坐好。
Mine could have been better. Cramped up in a cage all day, then suddenly witnessing my death in front of an incompetent human.
我今天可以更好一點的。整天被關在籠子裡，然後突然在一個無能的人類面前目睹自己的死亡。
You couldn't even save me. How pathetic.
你甚至救不了我。真可悲。
So, anyway, do you come here often?
Oh, wait. This is your first time. As well as your last time. That's very poetic. Do you want to become a poet?
噢，等等。這是你第一次。也是你最後一次。這很有詩意。你想當個詩人嗎？

我知道一首好詩。想聽嗎？
You will lose a lot of things,
The most average Joe I've seen,
How was that? It was beautiful, wasn't it?
Silence is bliss. You must not have very many friends.
沉默是福。你的朋友一定不多。
That's okay. I am your friend. Am I your friend? Please say yes. I'm very lonely.
沒關係。我是你的朋友。我是你的朋友嗎？請說是。我很寂寞。
I had friends too, once. They were all taken by a bunch of selfish coal miners. Then died to their incompetence.
我以前也有朋友。他們全被一群自私的煤礦工帶走了。然後死在他們的無能之下。
But you are different. You are not like the others. I like you. I love you. I love you so much.
但你不一樣。你跟其他人不一樣。我喜歡你。我愛你。我好愛好愛你。
I will give you another chance to redeem yourself.
我會再給你一次自我救贖的機會。
So kindly, I will tell you again.
我這麼親切，就再跟你說一次。
Let's do a little warm-up, shall we?
我們先來個小小的暖身，好嗎？
Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The '.
喜歡剛剛那場舞會嗎？那些舞步爛到我大可以把它們命名為「 」。
Let's do something I like to call 'The Canary'.
我們來玩個我喜歡稱之為「金絲雀」的東西。
Hands off those, if you would be so kind.
麻煩把手從那些東西上拿開，如果你願意的話。
了不起……那一下真的不一樣。
Indeed, you are the one who can destroy the Colossus. (In High Gavellian)
沒錯，你就是那個能夠摧毀 Colossus 的人。(以高階 Gavel 語)
You are about to enter the cruel, real world.
你就要進入那個殘酷的現實世界了。
Kill me now, so we can spend our final moments together in bliss.
現在就殺了我，讓我們在極樂中一起度過最後的時刻。
Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
太好了。你是人類的巔峰。
Kill me now or you'll live to regret it.
現在就殺了我，不然你會活著後悔。
Kill me now or I'll destroy {p}.
現在就殺了我，不然我就毀掉 {p}。
Kill me now or I'll destroy Gavel.
現在就殺了我，不然我就毀掉 Gavel。
Kill me now or I'll ruin every single province.
現在就殺了我，不然我就毀掉每一個行省。
Kill me now or I'll destroy the world.
現在就殺了我，不然我就毀掉這個世界。
Okay, so you don't care about the world. In that case, kill me now or I'll kill your friends.
好吧，所以你不在乎這個世界。那麼，現在就殺了我，不然我就殺光你的朋友。
Kill me now or I'll do LITERALLY ANYTHING!
現在就殺了我，不然我就做出「任何事」！
No no. No no no no no. No. It's too late.
不不。不不不不不。不。太遲了。
I just wanted to play again. Oh well.
我只是想再玩一次。算了。
At least I'll be in your memories. Forever. And ever.
至少我會留在你的記憶裡。永遠。永永遠遠。
Keep performing CPR, they're almost awake!
繼續做 CPR，他們快醒了！

不會吧！我真的做到了！我救了他們一命！
We better get a raise for this!
衝著這個我們該加薪了吧！
What the?! Who the hell let you in my house?
搞什麼？！誰讓你們進我家的？

不，你不行。在我開始扣你薪水之前，滾出去。
Well then, lad! Despite their incompetence, they still managed to save your skin.
那麼，小子！雖然他們很無能，總算還是把你的命撿回來了。

過來跟我談談，做個簡短的報告。

我們一感覺到那場地震，就馬上派礦工下去救你。那震動強到我真的以為世界要毀滅了。
I'm jolly sorry for forcing you to take on this job. This whole situation was completely unexpected.
逼你接下這份工作，我實在很抱歉。整件事完全出乎意料。
Typically, gases are cleared up almost instantly. This time, however, it seemed to have been a lot more potent... But how?
通常那些氣體幾乎一下子就散了。可是這一次，它似乎濃烈得多……但為什麼？
...{p}. It stirs once more. That thing... It has already caused too much hardship for this area to handle.
……{p}。它又動了。那個東西……它給這一帶造成的苦難，早就超過這裡承受得起的了。
It must be destroyed, once and for all. How that will happen, I do not know. But you...
它必須被摧毀，一勞永逸。要怎麼做到，我不知道。但是你……

這樣吧，小子！我給你，而且只給你，進入礦坑部分區域的許可，就是我們開採舉世聞名的 {p} 煤的那一帶。

從現在起你就是 {p} 的兼職煤礦工了。這是你應得的，小子。
Is this the height of your skill?
Are you even playing the game?
Go ahead. Run right into it.
Was that you, or will you blame that on lag?
那是你自己的問題，還是你要怪延遲？
Even a snail could dodge that.
Nice going bozo, you fell off.
幹得好啊蠢蛋，你掉下去了。
Nice try, but that won't work.
Hey up! Aren't you that Wynn soldier we've heard about? You look proper tough, is all.
嘿唷！你不就是我們聽說的那個 Wynn 士兵嗎？你看起來就是很結實，就這樣。

不，這絕對是他們！名字是 {u}，對吧？
Woah, this kid's a soldier? I wish I had that kind of job... I'd imagine it's much better than this crap.
哇，這小子是士兵？真希望我有那種工作……我想那絕對比這鬼差事好多了。

對啊，我真的很討厭這份工作，老兄。這個加上工頭，害我頭髮一直掉……事實上我已經因為這樣禿了！

老兄，工頭嚇死我了。我很意外我居然還保得住這份工作。要是礦坑沒有及早恢復，我看我們可能會丟掉飯碗。
I-I don't want to lose this job, man! I've got a wife and two goldfish!
我、我不想丟掉這份工作啊老兄！我還有老婆跟兩條金魚要養！
Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.
冷靜點，Ryan。我們不會丟掉的。我們是一起的。會處理好的。

我們的命就在你手上了，士兵。祝你好運，也小心點。那些礦坑就算對你這種人來說也相當險惡。
We still can't believe we found you. I'm proper shocked.
我們到現在還不敢相信我們找到了你。我真的嚇壞了。
We had to use that blasted archaic minecart system because the elevator was still busted.
電梯還是壞的，我們只好用那套該死的老古董礦車系統。
Everyone was exhausted from it. But just when all hope was seemingly lost, we found you laying on the ground.
所有人都被搞得筋疲力盡。可是就在希望好像全沒了的時候，我們發現你躺在地上。
You were violently twitching about, as if you were possessed by something. It was scary.
你當時劇烈地抽搐著，就像被什麼東西附身一樣。很嚇人。
Whatever the effects of that gas are, we want absolutely none of it. I'm never stepping foot inside of that bloody mine ever again.
不管那氣體的效果是什麼，我們一點都不想沾。我這輩子再也不踏進那該死的礦坑一步。
For the sake of our jobs and {p}, the Colossus must be stopped.
為了我們的飯碗，也為了 {p}，Colossus 必須被阻止。
So, kindly, I will tell you again.
所以，我好心再跟你說一次。
Very good! Come on then, let me introduce to you our little feathered mascot.
很好！那就來吧，讓我把我們這隻長羽毛的小吉祥物介紹給你。
I ran into a group of miners from {p}, a small mining settlement not far from where I lived. I've heard about this place.
我遇上了一群來自 {p} 的礦工，那是離我住處不遠的一個小礦業聚落。我聽說過那個地方。
It seems you have failed a lot of times. Would you like to skip this section?
看來你失敗很多次了。要跳過這一段嗎？

看來你的法術被那股氣體大幅削弱了。你該沿著軌道找出礦坑的出路。
It's blocked. Perhaps there's something around to break through?
被堵住了。也許附近有什麼東西可以打穿？
The town is incredibly poor, yet they're right on top of an extremely rich coal deposit. Their future, just a stone's throw away. And yet...
那個鎮窮得不像話，偏偏就坐在一座極其豐富的煤層上。他們的未來，近在咫尺。然而……
They still manage to struggle. A struggle that would be incredibly magnified by recent events. Indeed, those miners were also searching for survivors of that earthquake.
他們還是掙扎度日。而最近的事又把那份掙扎放大了無數倍。沒錯，那些礦工也在找那場地震的生還者。
Its influence was far and wide, and its strength unlike anything ever seen before. They told me that their town was absolutely devastated beyond recognition by the earthquake.
它波及的範圍又遠又廣，強度更是前所未見。他們告訴我，他們的鎮被那場地震毀得面目全非。
But words cannot describe the atrocities I saw when I first entered that place.
但我第一次踏進那個地方時看到的慘狀，不是言語形容得出來的。
Families struggling trying to rescue their kin who were trapped by the debris;
一家家人拚命想把被瓦礫困住的親人挖出來；
I heard nothing but complete silence, occasionally interrupted by the wails of the town's residents.
我聽見的只有徹底的寂靜，偶爾被鎮民的哀號打斷。
Despite being a grown man in my {~}'s, I could not help but feel like an innocent child at that moment.
儘管我已經是個 {~} 幾歲的成年男人，那一刻我還是覺得自己像個天真的孩子。
Such a mournful existence. If this life had any meaning to begin with, it was meant for nothing but despair.
多麼哀傷的存在。如果這一生本來就有什麼意義，那意義也不過是為了絕望。
One of the miners who I met earlier brought me to a nearby area underneath a cliff, which was seemingly untouched by the earthquake.
先前遇到的其中一個礦工把我帶到附近一處崖底，那裡看起來沒被地震碰到。
A lot of refugees made their homes here, desperately clinging on to the last thread of life. A lifestyle that I would need to adopt, whether I liked it or not.
很多難民在這裡安了家，死命抓著最後一絲活路。不管我願不願意，那都會是我往後的日子。
But to my surprise, the miner offered me some money and a job to get me back up on my feet. So incredibly kind of him. He reminded me of my mother.
但出乎我意料，那個礦工給了我一點錢和一份工作，讓我重新站起來。他好心得不可思議。他讓我想起我母親。
His name was Clight. Seemed like a nice fellow. Apparently he had gone through a similar situation as I did.
他叫 Clight。看起來是個好人。聽說他也經歷過跟我差不多的事。
Not as grave as mine, though. Lost his home and everything a few years back. Sought refuge in {p}. Now, he is well off and is seeking to become the chief miner one day.
不過沒我的那麼慘。幾年前失去了家和一切。逃難到 {p}。如今他過得不錯，還想著總有一天要當上礦場工頭。
You have already pulled this lever.
你已經拉過這根拉桿了。
To return to your previous point, go back into the mineshaft at [{~},-{~}].
要回到剛才的地方，就從 [{~1},-{~2}] 的礦道回去。
I'm alaready dead, how is this even possible?
我早就死了，這怎麼可能？
Okay, who even put those there in the first place?
好，那些東西到底是誰一開始放在那裡的？
It felt nice the first time, but now it's...different.
第一次的感覺還不錯，但現在……不一樣了。
Hands off of those, if you would be so kind.
Took our canary with us and everything. Just another day in the life.
金絲雀什麼的都帶上了。不過是日子裡又一天。
I was stood on a ledge overlooking a crevasse, where the gas supposedly was, to get a better look of the area.
我站在一處突岩上俯瞰那道裂隙——氣體據說就在那裡——想把地形看得清楚一點。
And then... He pushed me off. As if I was some kind of piece of trash.
然後……他把我推了下去。像丟一塊垃圾那樣。
He did it, that mudder Clight. He said those words with no hesitation, no sarcasm, no nothing.
是他做的，那個泥腿子 Clight。他說那些話的時候沒有遲疑、沒有嘲諷、什麼都沒有。
It was genuine. Or, at least, I think it was. I glanced at his eyes very briefly, and I saw tears. Tears of joy? Or...sadness?
那是真心的。至少我認為是。我很短暫地瞥了他的眼睛一眼，看見了淚。喜悅的淚？還是……悲傷的？
I don't even know what to think anymore. Everything I've experienced, all the moments we've shared, all the trust we've had for each other.
我已經不知道該怎麼想了。我經歷過的一切、我們一起度過的每一刻、我們之間所有的信任。
It was all a blatant lie. An act. And for what? Wealth? Power? Dominion? No... That is not the Clight I know. And yet, somehow, it happened.
全都是赤裸裸的謊。一場戲。而為的是什麼？財富？權力？統治？不……那不是我認識的 Clight。然而，它就是發生了。
It happened. Yes, it did happen. It really did happen. Happen. Happen happen happen. Happy. Yes, I am happy. The happiest person in the world. Happiness.
它發生了。對，它確實發生了。它真的發生了。發生。發生發生發生。幸福。對，我很幸福。世界上最幸福的人。幸福。
Indeed, happiness is the meaning of life, if you are a naive little kid. Life has no meaning.
沒錯，幸福就是人生的意義——如果你是個天真的小鬼的話。人生沒有意義。
How foolish it was of me to think it had any meaning.
我竟然以為它有意義，真是愚蠢。
No... The true meaning of life is to blindly walk a path to find that fabled 'meaning', only to find no end in sight.
不……人生真正的意義，是盲目地走在一條路上尋找那個傳說中的「意義」，然後發現根本看不到盡頭。
Suffering leads to the pursuit of happiness, which only leads back to suffering, and so on.
苦難引人追求幸福，而追求幸福又只會回到苦難，如此循環。
What is the point, really? Even inside my perfect {p}, people were still suffering.
到底有什麼意義？就連在我那個完美的 {p} 裡，人們也還是在受苦。
And Clight... Was it all...pointless? Was there...any point in my existence? Maybe I'll just... No.
還有 Clight……那一切都……沒有意義嗎？我的存在……有任何意義嗎？也許我乾脆……不。
There is only one more thing meant for this world. Destroy what's left of it. People won't need to suffer anymore.
這個世界只剩下一件該做的事。把剩下的都毀掉。人們就不必再受苦了。
I now finally understand why the Colossus claimed so many lives.
我現在終於明白 Colossus 為什麼奪走了那麼多性命。
I have decided, at long last. My true purpose in life. Kill Clight, destroy {p}, and restore order to the world.
我終於決定了。我此生真正的目的。殺掉 Clight、毀掉 {p}，讓這個世界重歸秩序。
We were going down into the mines to investigate a suspicious gas leakage.
我們要下礦坑去查一處可疑的氣體外洩。
I think I'm going insane. Strange apparitions keep appearing in the corner of my eye.
我想我快瘋了。奇怪的幻影一直出現在我的眼角。
Were they ghosts? Or real people? I couldn't tell. It constantly feels as if I'm zoning out from time to time.
那是鬼魂？還是真人？我分不出來。我總覺得自己時不時就恍神。
It's as if I am a figment of his imagination, real but not real. His judgment, clouded by perception. Wait, what did I just write?
就好像我是他想像出來的一個影子，真實而又不真實。他的判斷被感知蒙蔽了。等等，我剛剛寫了什麼？
No, scratch that. No idea...where that came from... Ugh. My head... The pain is indescribable.
不，當我沒寫。不知道……那是從哪來的……唔。我的頭……那種痛難以形容。
But it feels very good, like a nice little massage. What the...? There it is again.
但感覺很舒服，像被輕輕按摩。搞什麼……？又來了。
It's like time stops, and suddenly there's words on the paper. Are they...the thoughts hidden deep within my subconscious...?
就像時間停住，然後紙上忽然多出字來。那些是……藏在我潛意識深處的念頭嗎……？
One of the strange apparitions I saw recently was what seemed to be a blue canary, like that one I brought with me on that day.
我最近看到的其中一個幻影，看起來像一隻藍色的金絲雀，就像我那天帶去的那一隻。
And it was...talking to me? It seemed like it was incredibly angry at me. It cursed at me, made threats against me, and wished I had never existed.
而他在……跟我說話？他好像對我氣得要命。他咒罵我、威脅我，還說寧可我從來沒存在過。
It didn't throw any regular curses, no, it threw the harshest curses and the most horrific threats at me. Was it real? Or just my imagination?
他罵的不是一般的髒話，不，他對我丟出的是最惡毒的咒罵和最可怕的威脅。那是真的嗎？還是只是我的想像？
Likely the latter, but... what was it supposed to mean, then? Was it...a warning? Did I...glimpse the future?
大概是後者，可是……那又該是什麼意思呢？那是……一個警告嗎？我是不是……瞥見了未來？
Or was it just a manifestation of my thoughts? If so, then... perhaps it was him.
又或者那只是我念頭的化身？若是如此，那……也許那就是他。
Indeed. The one who ruined my life and got away with it.
沒錯。那個毀了我一生卻全身而退的人。
No... He will not get away with it. I will not allow that to happen. For the sake of the world, he must be stopped.
不……他別想全身而退。我不會讓那種事發生。為了這個世界，必須阻止他。
He... That's him, right? Am I even thinking about the same thing...? Ugh, every part of my body is aching.
他……那是他吧？我現在想的到底是不是同一件事……？唔，我全身上下沒一處不痛。
I can't even write anymore. This may be the last entry in my journal. I will continue on while my flame still flickers.
我連字都寫不下去了。這也許是這本日記的最後一篇。只要我這點火光還在搖曳，我就會走下去。
Rest assured, I will not die here. I cannot die here. I must do...his...bidding.
放心，我不會死在這裡。我不能死在這裡。我必須照……他的……吩咐去做。
I will change my identity, erase my past self from the face of the world, anything... Anything to achieve my goal.
我會換掉身分，把過去的自己從這世上抹去，什麼都行……只要能達成我的目的。
But I will leave this journal here to remind future miners of the fabled 'meaning' they are hopelessly searching for.
但我會把這本日記留在這裡，提醒後來的礦工: 他們苦苦尋找的那個傳說中的「意義」是什麼樣子。
Stop searching for it, there is no point in finding meaning. If you persist, then... you may end up like me.
別再找了，找出意義沒有任何用處。你要是堅持下去，那……你可能會變成我這樣。
Two paths, side by side. Present, and future. One of them is...hopeless. The other is the road I must walk.
兩條路並排著。現在，與未來。其中一條……毫無希望。另一條是我非走不可的路。
Our paths won't cross. But... Should we, in fact, ever meet up... On that day...
我們的路不會交會。但是……萬一我們真的碰上了……到那一天……
Today, I was nominated for chief of the {p} coal mine. Right hand of the mayor.
今天，我被提名為 {p} 煤礦場的工頭。鎮長的右手。
Four years of hard work finally paid off. This is my chance to find the answers we are all looking for.
四年的苦幹總算有了回報。這是我找出我們所有人都在找的答案的機會。
The answers that I once began to search for on that fabled day when I lost everything.
那些答案，是我在失去一切的那個傳說般的日子裡開始尋找的。
Finally, a chance to find a way for us to live in peace again. No more tragedy, no more disaster.
終於有機會找出讓我們重新安穩過日子的辦法。不再有悲劇，不再有災難。
Just...happiness. Happiness, security, and stability. With the power as chief, I will make that my goal.
只有……幸福。幸福、安全，還有安定。有了工頭的權力，我要把那當成我的目標。
Indeed, the perfect {p} will be realized under my leadership.
沒錯，完美的 {p} 會在我的帶領下實現。
In order to achieve security and stability, my first course of action as chief will be to make everyone into miners to ensure that no one is left without a job.
為了達成安全與安定，我當上工頭的第一件事，就是讓每一個人都成為礦工，確保沒有人失業。
They will work towards a common goal - eliminating the threat of the Colossus. {p} will become a safe haven in the Canyon, a sanctuary in the midst of chaos.
他們會為一個共同的目標努力——消除 Colossus 的威脅。{p} 會成為峽谷裡的避風港，混亂之中的庇護所。
No one will be left homeless or poor, unhappy or misfortuned. Freedom from suffering, in its simplicity. It is...the best existence possible.
沒有人會無家可歸或貧困，沒有人會不幸或倒楣。單純地，從苦難中解脫。那是……可能存在的最好的樣子。
I was running against Clight. As a man of high respect and trust, I was not surprised he was nominated.
我的對手是 Clight。他是個備受敬重與信任的人，被提名我並不意外。
Regardless of whoever wins, I trust that he will do great things. We desire the same thing, after all.
不管誰贏，我相信他都會做出一番大事。畢竟我們要的是同一件事。
Prevent the Colossus from interfering with our futures. The one who ravaged our homes, ruined our lives, and shattered all hope.
不讓 Colossus 再干擾我們的未來。就是它摧毀了我們的家、毀了我們的人生、碾碎了所有希望。
We wouldn't have to live in fear anymore. I know it's wishful thinking, but... a man can dream.
我們就不必再活在恐懼裡了。我知道這是一廂情願，但是……人總可以作夢吧。
I think I'm starting to get used to this place. I've been working for a while now as a coal miner.
我想我開始習慣這個地方了。我當煤礦工也有一陣子了。
It may not be the easiest job in the world, but I'm at least earning money for a roof over my head and for food on the table.
這也許不是世上最輕鬆的工作，但至少我賺到了遮頭的屋瓦和桌上的飯菜。
I wake up every day thinking not of the grueling task at the start of the day, but of the rewards I'll reap at the end of the day.
我每天醒來想的不是這一天開頭那些累死人的活，而是這一天結束時能收到的回報。
It's kind of funny, really. It's funny how much I've changed over such a short period of time.
說起來還真有點好笑。好笑的是我在這麼短的時間裡變了這麼多。
That day, when that man Clight offered to help me walk on this twisted, beaten path, I started to look at life differently. Taking the good with the bad, you know?
那一天，那個叫 Clight 的人願意幫我走上這條扭曲又難走的路，我開始用不一樣的眼光看人生。好的壞的一起收下，你懂吧？
Clight was like the light at the end of the tunnel. Everyone aspired to be like him.
Clight 就像隧道盡頭的那道光。每個人都想成為他那樣的人。
He was a hard worker with relentless determination to make {p} and its residents the best they can be.
他做事賣力，而且有一股不肯罷休的決心，要讓 {p} 和這裡的居民變成最好的樣子。
When we went to the bar after a long day's work, Clight would often bring us boilo, a sweet citrusy alcoholic beverage originating from {p}.
忙完一整天上酒吧的時候，Clight 常常會帶 boilo 給我們，那是一種源自 {p} 的甜味柑橘調酒。
Traditionally, everyone has their own unique take on boilo. My boilo, which I loved making, was something I was always proud of.
照傳統，每個人都有自己一套獨門的 boilo 做法。我很喜歡調我的那一款，也一直為它感到驕傲。
But Clight's boilo? It was by far the best boilo I've ever tasted. He would do that just to put a smile on everyone's faces. Indeed... I've seen that smile, somewhere before.
但 Clight 的 boilo 呢？那是我喝過最好的一款，差距還很大。他那麼做只是為了讓每個人臉上多一點笑。沒錯……那個笑容，我在別的地方見過。
Clight was the only person who I really liked. Looked up to, even. He was always there for me in my times of need.
Clight 是我唯一真心喜歡的人。甚至是我景仰的人。我需要的時候他一直都在。
I would go as far as saying he's perfect. However, when I look into his eyes... I see imperfection.
我甚至會說他是完美的。可是，當我望進他的眼睛……我看見了不完美。
Like a diamond, there is always something flawed about it. Something just... doesn't feel right.
就像鑽石一樣，總有一處是有瑕疵的。就是有什麼……讓人覺得不對。
Like he's trying to hide something by acting in such a way. Or perhaps... I see my own reflection. Indeed, we are...the same.
好像他那樣表現是為了藏住什麼。又或者……我看見的是自己的倒影。沒錯，我們是……一樣的。
The past couple of years have done wonders for myself and {p}.
過去這幾年，對我自己和 {p} 都是脫胎換骨。
Ever since I became chief, I have not lived a single day that I felt was unfulfilling.
自從當上工頭，我沒有一天過得覺得空虛。
I was able to revolutionize the coal industry and bring in much more profit.
我徹底改造了煤礦這一行，帶進了多得多的利潤。
With that profit, I began planning reconstruction for {p}, as part of my goal in mitigating the Colossus' impact on the city.
靠著那些利潤，我開始規劃 {p} 的重建，作為減輕 Colossus 對這座城市衝擊的一環。
I planned to use expensive materials that would, in theory, prevent earthquakes from touching the city.
我打算用昂貴的材料，理論上可以讓地震碰不到這座城。
It took many years, but today, the project has finally been completed.
這花了好多年，但今天，這項工程終於完成了。
The new {p} is completely unrecognizable compared to the old one, and I daresay it's one of the best looking cities in Gavel, as well as the safest in the Canyon.
新的 {p} 跟舊的比起來完全認不出來，我敢說它是 Gavel 最好看的城市之一，也是峽谷裡最安全的。
Clight and I have also been getting along well.
我和 Clight 也處得不錯。
Despite losing in the chief election, he has been there by my side.
雖然工頭選舉輸了，他還是一直在我身邊。
Second in command, if you will. However, even though we are good friends, we still have arguments from time to time, mostly about how to proceed further with {p}.
算是第二把交椅吧。不過即使我們是好朋友，還是三不五時會吵起來，多半是為了 {p} 接下來該怎麼走。
He always mentions that rebuilding the city was a waste of money, instead wishing it funded a direct way of dealing with the Colossus, rather than an indirect one.
他老是說重建這座城是在浪費錢，寧可那筆錢拿去直接對付 Colossus，而不是繞這麼一圈。
Truthfully, I don't know if I can answer that. I just... I don't know if I can. I'm... afraid of the consequences.
老實說，我不知道自己答不答得出來。我就是……不知道自己做不做得到。我……害怕後果。
It is a huge task. Anxiety inducing, in fact. I just can't bring myself to face it.
那是一件巨大的工程。說實話，光想就焦慮。我就是沒辦法讓自己去面對。
And I'm not sure why. I just... want to live a peaceful life. No more problems, no more anxiety, no more fearing the future.
我也不確定為什麼。我只是……想過安穩的日子。不再有問題，不再有焦慮，不再害怕未來。
This new {p} can make that happen. Yes... The endless now. {p}, in stasis, forever frozen in time.
新的 {p} 做得到這件事。是的……無盡的當下。{p} 停滯著，永遠凍結在時間裡。
Miners forever working to maintain the status quo. As it...should be.
礦工們永遠勞動著，維持現狀。本來……就該如此。
Food and water are incredibly scarce. My clothing is beginning to wear and tear.
食物和水少得可憐。我的衣服開始磨損破裂。
My sanity is dwindling by the minute. Darkness envelops the caverns, and not a soul to be seen.
我的神智一分一分地耗盡。黑暗吞沒了洞穴，見不到半個人影。
Yet somehow, I've managed to survive down in the mines for a couple days. Perhaps it's luck? Or fate? I don't even know anymore.
但不知怎的，我在礦坑底下撐過了好幾天。也許是運氣？還是命運？我也不知道了。
It feels as if my memory and thinking skills are extremely clouded. It hurts me to even write this very passage.
我覺得自己的記憶和思考都被蒙上了一層厚厚的霧。連寫下這一段都讓我難受。
This gas... It's not normal. In fact, I don't even think it's a gas.
這股氣體……不正常。其實我根本不覺得那是氣體。
It's like... some kind of magical force. There's this constant pressure against my head, as if it's about to explode, and I can't stop coughing.
那比較像……某種魔法的力量。我的頭一直被某種壓力頂著，像是快要炸開，而且我咳個不停。
I tried casting the handful of Air spells I still remembered from my childhood, and they changed form...?
我試著施了幾個小時候還記得的風屬性法術，結果它們變了形……？
Although they became a lot weaker. Maybe I'm just misremembering, given that I barely used them. Regardless, I have never experienced anything like this, in all my days of mining.
而且弱了很多。也許只是我記錯了，畢竟我幾乎沒用過。不管怎樣，我挖了這麼多年的礦，從來沒遇過這種事。
This force... Could it be the Colossus' doing? If it really is, then that means... No...
這股力量……會是 Colossus 搞的鬼嗎？如果真的是，那就表示……不……
No matter. Time remains but a mere obstacle in my path.
無所謂。時間不過是我路上的一個小障礙罷了。
It will not stop me from achieving my goal, nor will this force. Nothing will stop me, for I am destined to be this world's saviour.
它阻止不了我達成目標，這股力量也一樣。沒有東西攔得住我，因為我注定要成為這個世界的救世主。
People are born into the passage of fate, doomed to float aimlessly in the sea of suffering.
人生下來就落進命運的河道，注定在苦難之海裡漫無目的地漂著。
Many have tried, but none have ever managed to escape its torrential flow. And yet, recent events defy that fate.
很多人試過，但沒有一個逃得出那道奔流。然而，最近發生的事違背了那個命運。
I am...the chosen one. Chosen by the Colossus to rid the world of the cycle of suffering, the very nature of the world, the very fabric of reality.
我是……被選中的那一個。被 Colossus 選中，來為這個世界除去苦難的輪迴——那正是這世界的本質、現實的經緯。
There is only one meant for this world, and I AM IT. That is ME, and NO ONE ELSE.
這個世界只需要一個人，而那就是「我」。是「我」，不會是別人。
a child wandering around looking for their missing family; people frantically rummaging through the rubble to find their belongings.
一個孩子四處遊蕩，找著不見的家人；人們發了瘋似的在碎石堆裡翻找自己的東西。
'When I lost everything, I tried to look towards the future,' he said. 'It was hard, but it's the mentality that keeps me going.' His words inspired me to live on another day.
「當我失去一切的時候，我試著把眼光放到未來。」他說。「那很難，但就是這個心態讓我撐下來。」他的話讓我願意再多活一天。
indeed... you are the one who can destroy the colossus.
沒錯……你就是那個能夠摧毀 colossus 的人。
'This is for your own good. Goodbye.' Those were the last words I heard from him.
「這是為你好。再見了。」那是我從他那裡聽到的最後一句話。
'You're letting this continue to be a problem. Destroy the Colossus and there won't have to be any more worrying,' he says.
「你放著這個問題不管。把 Colossus 毀掉，就不必再擔心了。」他說。
Welcome to Bantisu Temple, wandering human. We aid travelers such as yourself in navigating the capricious canyon walls.
歡迎來到 Bantisu 神殿，流浪的人類。我們協助像你這樣的旅人在這變幻莫測的峽谷壁間找路。
You appear quite strong, and well-kept by your wits. Might we ask you to aid us, then?
你看起來相當強壯，心智也很清明。那麼，我們能否請你幫個忙？
You see, a lost man is staking out in a camp on the nearby cliff faces. It pains us to see him, but be unable to reach him.
是這樣的，有個迷路的人在附近的崖壁上紮營。看得到他卻到不了他那裡，讓我們很難受。
So we ask you to guide Seluc to us. We shall send you to him, and you shall bring him here. If you wish to help, you will be rewarded for your time.
所以我們請你把 Seluc 引導到我們這裡。我們會把你送到他那邊，你再把他帶回來。你若願意幫忙，我們會報答你付出的時間。
Wait, a human! Ugh, I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up. What did you do, take a day of cliff diving?
等等，一個人類！唉，我不該抱期望的。你做了什麼，去玩了一整天跳崖嗎？
If you really want to make yourself useful, get a Bantisu monk over here! You're good at doing that, right? Fetching things and people?
你要是真想派上點用場，就去弄一個 Bantisu 僧侶過來！你很會做這種事吧？跑腿找東西找人？
Kill them! Kill them now! And get me OUT OF HERE! You got me into this mess, now get me out!!
殺了他們！現在就殺了他們！然後把我弄出去！是你把我拖進這團亂的，現在把我弄出去！！
Are you blind?! You knocked my shoes off in that lake! Follow the path, and don't take any off routes! I don't want to risk cutting up my feet!
你瞎了嗎？！你把我的鞋子撞進那座湖裡了！沿著路走，不要亂走岔路！我不想冒著割傷腳的風險！
Trying to ditch on me while I'm talking my coat off? You have an obligation to help me you know!
我正在脫外套的時候你想把我丟下？你可是有義務幫我的！
All this walking...I'm taking a break here. You forced me to jump off a cliff, I get to force you to slow down. It's only fair!. Besides that...
走這麼多路……我要在這裡休息一下。你逼我跳下懸崖，我就有權逼你慢下來。這才公平！除此之外……
I only even came out here to see the view. At least that can't be ruined. Still, some vacation this turned out to be...
我來這裡本來只是為了看風景。至少那個毀不了。不過，這假期還真是……
Ugh, my feet are killing me. Maybe this hike wouldn't be so bad if SOMEONE hadn't knocked me into a lake and made me lose my shoes!
唉，我的腳痛死了。要不是某人把我撞進湖裡、害我丟了鞋子，這趟健行也許就不會這麼糟！
Find me a way up, and fast! I've had enough of this stupid canyon.
幫我找條上去的路，快點！這座蠢峽谷我受夠了。
Huff...puff... Well...huff... Wait, there's...there's no way down the other side! Huff...what a waste!!
呼……喘……嗯……呼……等等，另一邊……另一邊沒有路下去！呼……白費工夫！！
You...had better count yourself lucky I haven't broken any bones from this. Agh...but that doesn't mean I'm not aching all over!!
你……最好慶幸我沒因此摔斷骨頭。唉……但我還是全身都在痛！！
I paid two weeks' wages for that coat you soaked. I'm not leaving here without it, and I'm way too tired to walk back down.
你泡濕的那件外套花了我兩週的工資。沒拿到我不走，而我累得根本沒力氣再走下去。
Now that you have the coat, you should return to Seluc
拿到外套了，你該回去找 Seluc
Seluc doesn't seem to be here any more. Maybe he's moved further.
Seluc 好像已經不在這裡了。也許他又往前走了。
Let this be a lesson to you, Seluc. You cannot lie to those who see with the wind. Now show your gratitude to this kind human.
這就給你一個教訓，Seluc。你騙不了那些以風視物的人。現在向這位善心的人類表示謝意。
As thanks, we will also grant you access to the Bantisu Air Boosters found around the canyon. I hope they are of assistance to you.
為了答謝，我們也會讓你使用峽谷各處的 Bantisu Air Booster。希望它們對你有幫助。
We commune with the wind, and she gives us her sight. Wherever the breeze blows, we may see.
我們與風交流，而她賜予我們她的視野。微風吹到哪裡，我們就能看到哪裡。
The canyon creatures there are ruthless, and we are not suited to physical combat. We would be able to reach him, but we would be stranded ourselves.
那邊的峽谷生物很兇殘，而我們不擅長近身戰。我們到得了，但自己也會被困住。
Find Seluc in his camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Who's that? Am I finally being rescued!?
誰啊？我終於要獲救了嗎！？
If you really did intend to rescue me, you've assuredly wasted both our time.
你要是真打算來救我，那你肯定是在浪費我們兩個的時間。
You're trying to kill me, aren't you?! What, can't take hearing the truth? Now my coat is drenched, and! AND!
你想害死我，對吧？！怎麼，聽不得真話？現在我的外套濕透了，而且！而且！
These Jinko are going to pounce any second now!! I haven't got a weapon, were you expecting me to rush off and get into a rumble?!
這些 Jinko 隨時都會撲上來！！我手上連武器都沒有，你以為我會衝出去跟他們廝殺嗎？！
護送 Seluc 回到 Gana 身邊。
Ugh, all that danger got me flustered. I'm sweating in this coat...and it's all soaked already. Let me just...
唉，剛才那麼危險害我心慌意亂。穿著這件外套我一直冒汗……而且早就濕透了。我乾脆……
...set that aside. Congratulations, human! I'm probably never getting that coat back, and it cost me a pretty sum. Thanks for nothing.
……把它放一邊。恭喜你啊，人類！那件外套我大概是拿不回來了，那可花了我一筆錢。多謝你什麼忙都沒幫。
Wait, what in the world- What's going on?!
等等，這是什麼——怎麼回事？！
NO ONE TELLS ME ANYTHING! The brochure didn't mention earthquakes, YOU didn't tell me either, but what was I expecting from a human anyways?!
都沒人跟我說一聲！簡介手冊上沒提到地震，「你」也沒告訴我，不過對一個人類我還能期待什麼？！
I'm not a carrot! You'd better get me out of h- ...wait, wait, those...
我又不是紅蘿蔔！你最好快把我弄出——……等等，等等，那些是……
H-Hobgoblins. Hobgoblins HOBGOBLINS THERE'S HOBGOBLINS!! KILL THEM! AAAAH! AAH! AAAAAAH!
大、大地精。大地精 大地精 有大地精！！殺了他們！啊啊啊！啊啊！啊啊啊啊！
Sweet baby bovine I just saw my life flash before my eyes. Ugh...now pull me up. I'm stuck. But easy on the goods, I'm NOT a carrot I'll remind you!
我的老天爺，我剛剛整段人生都在眼前閃過了。唉……現在把我拉上去。我卡住了。輕一點啊，我再提醒你一次，我不是紅蘿蔔！
Great. I'm SO grateful to be covered in mud and hobgoblin blood, and to be lacking my coat, AND to be stuck with a human.
太好了。渾身泥巴加大地精的血，外套也沒了，還被迫跟一個人類綁在一起，我真是「感激不盡」。
Just get me out of here already. See, if an actual Bantisu monk had come down I'd probably be at home already, sipping tea by the fire!
快把我弄出去就是了。我跟你說，要是真的來一位 Bantisu 僧侶，我這時候大概已經在家裡爐火邊喝茶了！
I know you humans are reckless, but I'd have expected you to have SOME concern, since you supposedly wanted to rescue me.
我知道你們人類做事魯莽，但你既然說要救我，我還以為你多少會顧慮一點。
...perfect. Just GREAT! The only available path to the temple, and now it's blocked off! Just my luck!!
……好極了。真是「太棒了」！通往神殿唯一的路，現在被堵死了！我的運氣真好！！
...wait. You're reckless and willing to endanger your life, right? There's no way that I could possibly use them, but I see some ledges.
……等等。你這人魯莽又不要命，對吧？我是絕對用不上，不過我看到幾塊岩架。
See, just to the side of the rockslide? There's some ledges to jump around on.
看到沒，就在落石旁邊？有幾塊岩架可以跳。
Find a way to get Seluc past the blockage.
想辦法讓 Seluc 越過阻礙。
...of course it's a ladder. I'm going to be feeling this climb for weeks...
……當然是梯子。這一爬我大概要痠上好幾個禮拜……
Can you do ANYTHING right?! There's no way I'm jumping down there, you maniac!
你到底有沒有一件事做得對的？！我死也不會跳下去的，你這個瘋子！
When I said you were reckless, I was hoping that maybe you'd keep that side of yourself away from other people!!
我說你魯莽的時候，本來還希望你能把那一面收著別用在別人身上！！
At least we're nearly at the temple now. Come on Seluc, silver linings, silver linings. You're nearly away from this freak...
至少我們快到神殿了。撐著點 Seluc，往好處想、往好處想。你快擺脫這個怪人了……
Okay, you know what? No. You've put me through QUITE a lot here, human, so you're going to do me a favor and I'm not going to move another step til it's done.
好，夠了。不行。人類，你害我吃了「這麼多」苦頭，所以你要幫我一個忙，沒辦好我一步都不走。
So you're going back down to the bottom of the ridge, and you're going to get me my coat. It's the least you could do.
所以你給我下去山脊底下，把我的外套拿回來。這是你最起碼該做的。
And be quick about it! I feel like these quakes are going to make the whole mountain collapse. That looks like it opened up a hole straight to the bottom!
而且動作快！我覺得這些地震會把整座山震垮。那邊看起來剛裂出一個直通谷底的洞！
Retrieve the coat Seluc left behind at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
取回 Seluc 留在 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的外套。
跟 Gana 和 Seluc 說話。
Took you long enough, coat-fetcher! I'm practically frostbitten up here!
你也拖太久了吧，拿外套的！我在上面都快凍傷了！
You see, I was just speaking to Gana about your dirt-poor imitation of their job! You ought to be ashamed- I had to get up here all on my own!
我跟你說，我剛剛正在跟 Gana 說你把他們的工作學得有多爛！你該覺得羞愧才對——我可是自己一個人爬上來的！
...hm. I will say, there are many lost around the canyon, Seluc- it may have been a long time before we were able to help you.
……嗯。不過我得說，Seluc，這座峽谷裡迷路的人很多——說不定要等上很久我們才幫得到你。
Anyway! Give me that coat. The monks here are going to provide me some hospitality then guide me out of these wretched canyon walls.
總之！把外套給我。這裡的僧侶會招待我一下，再帶我走出這片討厭的峽谷。
This is goodbye then, human, I won't be missing you. Shoo!
那就再見了，人類，我不會想念你的。走開！
...He did not really guide himself here. Did he.
……他其實不是自己引路上來的。對吧。
It was me who guided him.
Should you tell Gana the truth?
你要跟 Gana 說實話嗎？
...uh. ...dang it, why you gotta did that.
That's right! See, Gana? After all that, at least the human isn't a liar.
說得對！你看，Gana？經過這一切，至少這個人類不是騙子。
...Well, 'coat fetcher', getting this man his coat is still a fine deed. And for that, you shall be rewarded.
……好吧，「拿外套的」，替這個人把外套取回來仍然是一件好事。為此，你應當得到回報。
Maybe you think anything's possible for you since you're a soldier, but I'm just a guy from {p}! I hardly know anything about the canyon outside of what the brochures say!
你也許覺得你是士兵就什麼都做得到，但我只是個 {p} 來的普通人！除了手冊上寫的，我對這座峽谷幾乎一無所知！
Seluc hides in a camp northeast of here, atop the cliffs.
Seluc 躲在這裡東北方崖頂的一處營地。
We ask you to guide Seluc to us. If you wish to help, you will be rewarded for your time.
我們請你把 Seluc 引導到我們這裡。你若願意幫忙，我們會報答你付出的時間。
Did you do what I asked? No? Check your content book.
我交代的事你辦了嗎？還沒？看看你的綜合手冊。
HEY! YOU! What are you looking at? You want to go do ya?!
喂！就是你！看什麼看？想打架是不是？！
I swear if you don't leave right now, I am going to PUMMEL YOUR FACE INTO THE GROUND.
我發誓，你要是不馬上走，我就把你的臉揍進地裡。
We were performing our usual routines when suddenly an unknown explosion caused a massive cave-in at the entrance to our main mining supply area.
我們正照常作業，突然一場不明的爆炸在主要採礦補給區的入口造成大規模坍方。
Something must be done to remove the debris, we cannot easily continue our mining operations without our supplies.
得想辦法清掉這些碎石，沒有補給，我們的採礦作業很難繼續下去。
There also may be people trapped on the other side, and I would hate to lose even more miners to these catastrophes.
另一邊可能還有人受困，我可不想再有更多礦工折在這些災難裡。
Maybe we could use the Wrecking Ball to demolish the debris, but if we don't act soon...
也許我們可以用拆除鐵球把碎石打掉，但如果不趕快行動……
How to Use the Explosive-Cloaker Machine:
爆炸物隱匿機使用方法:
- Insert explosive item into the hole of the INPUT slot of the machine.
- 把爆炸性物品放進機器 INPUT 欄位的孔裡。
- Wait while the machine temporarily disables the item's explosive property.
- 等待機器暫時消除物品的爆炸性。
- Take item out of OUTPUT slot.
- 從 OUTPUT 欄位取出物品。
- Can be very useful for disabling explosive properties of unstable ores found in caves.
- 可用來消除洞窟中不穩定礦石的爆炸性，非常實用。
Orikal takes the materials you retrieved and puts them in a container. He mutters some words in an unknown language, and suddenly the container turns into some sort of Magical TNT.
Orikal 把你帶回來的材料放進一個容器裡。他用一種不明的語言喃喃唸了幾句，容器突然變成了某種魔法 TNT。
But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe. Here, take this for your help.
但它連著的是什麼？那就改天再說了。重點是村子安全了。來，這個給你，謝謝你幫忙。
Speak to Orikal outside the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} 外面找 Orikal 說話。
Go away! I know you're angry but there's nothing to gain her-
走開！我知道你很生氣，但這裡沒什麼好拿的——
Oh, you seem calm. What are you doing here? Bit close to the portal for a soldier isn't it?
哦，你看起來挺冷靜的。你來這裡做什麼？以一個士兵來說，離傳送門有點太近了吧？
I see, you were sent to aid the public. Perfect.
我懂了，你是被派來協助民眾的。太好了。
I am Orikal, I'm trying to stop everyone here from killing each other.
我叫 Orikal，我正想辦法阻止這裡的人互相殘殺。
Do you see all these spikes? I believe they are the thing spreading corruption.
你看到這些尖刺了嗎？我認為腐敗就是靠它們擴散的。
Corruption does not affect humans like other beings. It’s much much slower, more like an infection of the mind to us.
腐敗對人類的作用跟對其他生物不一樣。慢得多，對我們來說更像是心智上的感染。
Could you inspect the peak of the spike in the village for me? It might give me valuable insight. Thanks!
你能替我去看看村子裡那根尖刺的頂端嗎？也許能給我一些有價值的線索。謝了！
Examine the nearby corrupted spike to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到東北方 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 檢查附近的腐敗尖刺。
Climb the spike to see if you can find anything useful about it's existance.
爬上尖刺，看看能不能找到任何跟它的來歷有關的東西。
Report back to Orikal about your observations.
回去向 Orikal 報告你的觀察。
That was quick... did you find anything?
Really, nothing? You didn't even feel anything?
真的什麼都沒有？你連一點感覺都沒有？
How can it be just a spike? It must be spreading corruption somehow.
怎麼可能只是一根尖刺？它一定是用某種方式在擴散腐敗。
Then perhaps my second theory was correct. I will have to send you underground.
那也許我的第二個推論才是對的。我得把你送到地底下去。
There are old cave systems around here from the mining days. I sent two men down to excavate the spike, can you go down and help?
這一帶還留著採礦時期的舊坑道。我派了兩個人下去挖那根尖刺，你能下去幫忙嗎？
The entrance is a little to the northeast. In fact, you should have passed it on your way to the spike.
入口在東北邊一點點。其實你去尖刺的路上應該就經過了。
Find the excavators inside the nearby cave to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到東北方 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的洞窟裡找那兩名挖掘員。
Find the excavators inside the cave.
在洞窟裡找到那兩名挖掘員。
This is insane, why are we here?! We're looking for corruption you know that right?
這太瘋狂了，我們幹嘛在這裡？！我們可是在找腐敗，你知道吧？
Calm down. All we have to do is keep digging. Besides, he did say he'd pay us a lot, so stop being mad.
冷靜點。我們只要繼續挖就好。而且他確實說了會付我們一大筆，別再發脾氣了。
Forget it, I don't care anymore, just prime the explosive and get clear of the blast!
算了，我不管了，把炸藥裝好，然後離爆炸範圍遠一點！
Well, that did the trick. Let's take a look.
好，這下管用了。我們去看看。
It almost looks like a giant spike... Woah. How deep does this thing go?
看起來簡直就像一根巨大的尖刺……哇。這東西到底有多深？
Well, you know what? We did our job, so honestly I don't care. Let's get out of he-
呃，算了。我們的活幹完了，說真的我不在乎。我們離開這——
Orikal? We're done! Pay up! I want out. This place is getting to me.
Orikal？我們挖完了！付錢！我要走了。這地方讓我受不了。
I came when I heard the explosion. I thought you'd hurt yourselves.
我聽到爆炸聲就趕過來了。還以為你們把自己炸傷了。
Well, I'll be darned. The spike goes this far down? And it looks like it goes even deeper than this!
我的老天。這根尖刺埋得這麼深？而且看起來還比這裡更深！
Well, I don't know about you, but I say we blow it to shreds! That oughta get rid of this spike!
我是不知道你們怎麼想，反正我說——把它炸個粉碎！這樣總該能除掉這根尖刺了吧！
For once, I agree. I'll do it, you guys just get clear.
這次我同意。我來動手，你們退開就好。
...Wow, that did nothing. We're going to need something MUCH more powerful than TNT...
……哇，一點用都沒有。我們需要比 TNT 強得多的東西……
Oh yeah? And just what would you have in mind?
是喔？那你倒是說說看你想到什麼了？
Well, it's sorta complicated. That's why I've decided to give our new friend here the job of acquiring this explosive.
呃，這有點複雜。所以我決定把弄到那種炸藥的任務，交給我們這位新朋友。
Oh yeah, we were so busy with this spike, we forgot to address you! Sorry about that.
對耶，我們忙著弄這根尖刺，都忘了跟你打招呼！真不好意思。
Well if you don't need us anymore then we'll just be on our way... WITH our money! So hand it over please.
好啦，如果你們不需要我們了，那我們就走了……連我們的錢一起帶走！所以請把錢交出來。
Alright, fine. Here's your pay. Thank you for your help.
好吧，行。這是你們的酬勞。謝謝你們幫忙。
Gah! That's hardly anything! I'm not even surprised. Let's just go.
啊！這根本沒多少！我一點也不意外。走了走了。
Anyway, come meet me back at my tent, friend. We will discuss what to do then.
總之，朋友，回我的帳篷來找我。我們再討論接下來怎麼做。
