我們還有從富饒的高地進口的、鼎鼎大名的 Heather Beer。
A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
一種用高地各處長出來最美的石楠釀的啤酒。*嗝* 你幾乎能嘗到貴族的那份富庶。
*hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
*嗝* 如果我是你，我一定——會試試這一款。這種東西在 Auburn 可不常見。
If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
如果你想賜福你的味蕾，去找我那邊的兄弟。*嗝*
We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
我們有現煮現烤的在地食品。
Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
想聽聽我們的菜單嗎，親愛的？
Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
太好了！Auburn 以濃郁、樸實而溫暖的風味聞名！
We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
我們也喜歡用野生動物和在地資源入菜，不過我相信這些你早就知道了，哈哈。
Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
讓我介紹幾道今天的特色料理，親愛的。
The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
Auburn 最重要的一道菜，當然是「森林的贈禮」。肉與果實的美妙組合，包在蒸過的葉子裡。
We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
我們今天早上把所有的贈禮都手工包好了，蒸好就能帶走！
If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
如果那不合你的意，我們還有經典的「森林盛宴」。一塊烤野豬肉配上 Mudkin 沙拉。
I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
恐怕我們目前的食材用完了。請晚點再來！
Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
嘿！你看起來像個觀光客！
I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
很高興你決定來看看我這個小小的展區。
Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps want to hear some fun facts about our animals?
這是你第一次來這一帶嗎？也許你想聽聽關於我們這些動物的有趣知識？
First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
首先是我們的 Roly 蟲！這些小傢伙是這裡居民的一大害。
They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
他們最愛啃我們的房子。幸好我們大部分的建築都蓋在高腳柱上，而——且那些蟲不會爬。
Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
接下來！青蛙！西北邊的沼澤是賞蛙最好的地方。只要小心那隻沼澤怪物就好。
Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
青蛙或許是不錯的食物來源，不過我們更喜歡把他們當成……寵物！
Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
最後是狐狸！這些小可愛天性非常害羞。不過要小心，他們還有體型更大的版本，叫做狐獵犬。
Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
那些就沒有他們的小表親那麼害羞……或那麼溫和了。不過一樣可愛就是了！
Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
請隨意看看！你也可以摸摸他們。
Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
哈囉，歡迎來到 Mudkin 農場！
Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
Mudkin 是這一帶菜餚裡很受歡迎的蔬菜。它們長在地底下，你得把它們拔出來！
Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
你有興趣玩一場「拔 Mudkin」嗎？
Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
簡單說，你的目標是在時間結束前拿到愈多分愈好。
There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
Mudkin 有三種大小，每一種給的分數不同。不過！有兩顆薑根會給你負分。
Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
只要點擊田裡出現的泥土粒子就好。有五個地方可以讓你拔。
Return to Syndra at or keep exploring the festival.
回到 Syndra 那裡，或繼續逛慶典。
Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
希望你和王室打交道的經驗，沒有毀掉你對我們行省的印象……這裡還是有很多值得慶祝的東西。
Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
有時候，把煩惱放到一邊、就……照事情本來的樣子接受它，也是不錯的。喘口氣。
總比什麼都沒有好，我想。
It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
背著跟王室打交道的那些經歷，是很難放鬆的，對吧？我懂那種感覺。
Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
唔。我的建議是，能把握的就把握。以我的經驗，這樣的快樂時刻往往轉瞬即逝。
If there's even the smallest spark of joy... take hold of it before it's gone. Cherish it while you still can. Try not to grow old and jaded like I have, would you?
只要有一點點喜悅的火花……就在它消失之前抓住它。趁還能珍惜的時候珍惜它。試著別像我一樣變得又老又麻木，好嗎？
Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
每一年……年年如此，王室都會辦這些慶典。從這裡開始，繞著行省轉一圈。
The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
慶典是假日，是休息的一天、慶祝的一天。有一段時間不必工作，這是多大的恩賜啊！何等慷慨。
I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
我受不了待在這裡……每一年，我都說服自己我撐得住。它帶來的提醒，那些早已逝去的往事。而每一年，我都被證明錯了。
...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
……啊。時間到了。主要活動就要開始了。
Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
當然是女王陛下的年度演說！沒有她露面，那還算什麼王室慶典，對吧？
Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
哈！不，不。當然不是。沒有女王陛下親自演說，那還算什麼王室慶典，對吧？
Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
現在……仔細看。看清楚我們的敵人，注意她如何呈現自己、她說了什麼、以及她沒有說什麼。
Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
啊……{p} 我親愛的人民！能再一次站在你們之中，是何等的喜悅、何等的榮幸。
Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
有些人會說，那壯麗的 {p} 才是我們最美的地區，有著它繁花盛開的樹木與宏偉的歷史城堡……
But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
但我一向對這個地方懷有特別的情感。那些葉子與它們溫暖的色調，在微風中搖曳……世上所有的煩憂，都值得換這一幅景象。
If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
如果可以，也許我願意整年都待在這裡！啊，可惜……城塞裡的事務讓我們都脫不開身！
We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
來年我們有許多計畫。增加從其他地區的進口、讓所有人更容易出行，還有更多的軍職空缺！
More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
更多內容很快就會公布。現在，請聽你們敬愛的統領說幾句。
...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well- Testing, testing, one two three...
……啊。我唯一算錯的一項。麥克風的高度。算了——測試，測試，一二三……
Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
歡迎各位！我是你們的統領，Zhiraok。今天能再一次站在各位面前，是我的榮幸。
Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer- this place, these people, really have become my home.
在 {p} 工作了二十年。二十年。感覺我在這裡待得比那還久得多——這個地方、這些人，真的已經成了我的家。
My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
我的職責不只是效忠王室，也是服務各位。讓各位的生活更好，把我們共同生活的這個地區推向新的高度。
Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
無論是透過增加 Liff 葉的產量，好把我們的資源與知識分享給整個行省——那要歸功於各位的辛勤……
...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
……還是透過強化我們的基礎建設，讓各位的生活品質指數成長，以答謝各位的付出！

I'd be here all day listing all the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize- Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
要把過去一年的改善一一列出，我大概得在這裡站上一整天，所以我長話短說——多條主要道路改善、無數新的工作機會、加倍的守衛巡邏來保障各位的安全……
The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
二十年前我們出發的那個地方，如今已經認不出來了。我的誓言是: 二十年後，我還能對我們共同把這個家改善了多少，說出同樣的話。
'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p}- Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
……直到我們的總和比得上 {p} 的壯麗那一天——謝謝各位！好好享受慶典！
What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
Zhiraok 統領為我們的行省做了何等出色的工作！要填補那個職位，確實再也找不到更好的人選了！
The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
{p} 在他的治理下欣欣向榮，而我對他所取得的進展再滿意不過。
One final message before we conclude. These past years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed - a sign of our strength as a people.
在我們結束之前還有最後一件事。過去這幾年，我們收到關於受詛者的通報愈來愈少——那是我們作為一個民族強盛的徵兆。
And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
而這一切都要歸功於各位！各位勤勉地通報可疑活動，正是保障我們行省安全的關鍵。
We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
我們必須團結、堅定！我們不會讓這份邪惡得勝，我們不會讓我們的行省像牆外那麼多地方一樣淪陷！
With that, let the celebrations begin!
Did anything stand out to you?
有什麼特別引起你注意的嗎？
Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
確實。這很費解，不是嗎？那是一種她在別處從不流露的敬意。
And if there is one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
而如果有一件事我確定她說的是真話，就是這一件。這反而讓它更加奇怪。
Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
是啊，是啊……改善。自從他升上那個位置，生活確實變好了。這一點我認。他確實投入在 Auburn 上。
But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
但他仍然是在王室底下做事。別忘了這一點。他每做出一項改善，就有另一項是他放著不管的。
No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
不，我想他們不會提。讓大眾不知道那些失敗，對他們比較好。
But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
但你可以確定，在內部他們並沒有忘記。他們會繼續找你。
Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
是的……受詛者。王室需要讓人民保持恐懼。如果外面還有另一個敵人，而王室宣稱能保護他們不受其害……
There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
他們要人們相信外面的世界已經毀滅，是有原因的。任何接觸都可能戳破那個幻象。
They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
他們很快就要結束慶典了……所以我們這裡的工作完成了。我們該在人群散到足以讓我們被認出來之前離開。
I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow- I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
我明天安排了一場會議，希望你能出席。內容是關於下一步——既然王室已經往下一站去了。到時候見。
I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
我想我對有人溜進我的辦公室這件事已經受夠了。下次能不能敲個門？
Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital - your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
唔。這樣比較有意思。我從首都帶來消息——你增派部隊的請求批准了。調動應該在本週結束前下來。
Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
嗯，那能解決一些問題。不過那不是全部的訊息，對吧？他這次又要我聽什麼鈍話？
Merely a reminder to... ''get your act together,'' as it were.
只是提醒你……用他的說法，「振作一點」。
Get my act toge- That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
振作一——那個原地打轉的碎形在他那個象限裡一百五十年做的事，還不如我這十年裡兩年做的！
I- Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
我——唉，專注，Z……他人根本不在這裡，別讓他惹到你……
I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
我不扯那條切線了。如果你要說的就這些，那才是浪費你的時間。有什麼是信差送信送不了、非得你親口說的？
The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
那個入侵者。你的行政單位相信自己能控制住局面嗎？
There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
來了。聽著，他們的底細我早就算得一清二楚了，好嗎？這個轄區沒有任何一條進出的路是他們不會被偵測到的。我們會把他們找出來。

Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
不過跟某些人不一樣，我的自尊還沒大到認不出盟友什麼時候能派上用場。你們那一類在這方面是專家，所以如果你能撥一兩雙眼睛過來，我會非常感激。
I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
我看看能做什麼。這一帶剛好已經有一項行動在進行，等它結束之後，我們可以討論把那名探員轉調過來。
One last thing- the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
最後一件事——入侵者的身分已經明確告知你了，對吧？
Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
嗯哼。就像我說的，他們的底細我早就算清楚了。
Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
那你就會明白女王陛下的命令——這件事不得向我們那位最新的成員提起。飛升是個艱難的過程，替它添上額外的干擾會是……不明智的。
Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
可不想打擾一個這麼勤奮的人，是吧。不過如果就這些了，諜報總管？我的待辦清單每分鐘都在增加。
可惜，鞦韆已經有人坐了。
Let's get back to the others
Maybe it's time to find Syndra near the stage. But there is still time to check out the festival more too...
也許該去舞台附近找 Syndra 了。不過還有時間再多逛逛慶典……
她談到 Auburn 的方式。那……不太一樣。
The Fox seems to be fast asleep...
那隻狐狸似乎睡得很熟……
Hello there, chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
你好啊，仁兄！我得說，真沒想到會在這兒見到 {p} 老部隊的人。
I... there... too many... th-thousands, at... at least...
我……那裡……太多了……幾、幾千個，至少……
Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace!
拜託，住手！不管你是誰，放過我和我的家人！
Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! I'm afraid they have already joined me, down below.
啊，可惜你沒早點說！恐怕他們已經先到下面陪我了。
Y-you... I thought they... oh, gods, no...
你、你這個……我以為他們……噢，諸神啊，不……
Hush, now. You and your family will make fine additions to my legion.
別出聲。你和你的家人會成為我軍團裡的好成員。
Wha... you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone!
什……你是說……不、不要，拜託！我不想傷害任何人！
How naive. Fear not. You will rise again, and then you will serve my purpose.
真是天真。別怕。你會再站起來，然後為我的目的效力。
How easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master?
看見這地方倒得多輕易了嗎？我多快就成了它的主人？
You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think to enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
你們在地面上勉強擋著都吃力，卻還想踏進我的領地，到冥界來挑戰我？
So enter the mouth of my skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
所以走進我那顆骷髏的嘴裡吧，士兵，往地底下去。我很期待我們的下一次見面，嘿嘿嘿……
Looks like the only way to go is into the skull...
看來唯一的路就是走進骷髏裡……
You were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
你當時像個老糊塗一樣跌跌撞撞，眼睛白得像奶油，嘴裡一直唸著什麼 Charon。
I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a success!
我猜就是他把你拖去繞了那一圈？嗯，你到底沒送命，所以這次行動我就當它是成功了！
When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
等你準備好了，我很樂意請你一起加入那趟深入地底的遠征，老兄！
You've earned a lot of respect from the boys this fight, better than all of us I'd say. For this fight, I'll let you direct the army.
這一仗打下來，弟兄們都對你刮目相看，我敢說你比我們誰都強。這場戰鬥，我就讓你來指揮部隊。
I see you've brought aid, you aren't as foolish as I thought.
看來你帶了援兵，你沒有我想的那麼愚蠢。
前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Graken 將軍交談
I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
我是 Graken 將軍，{p} 民兵團的頭頭。幸會幸會！
You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
那些到處晃來晃去的該死殭屍你都看到了吧？他們似乎全是從那個巨大的骷髏頭裡冒出來的。
I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
我正在組一支精銳小隊要進去探一探，可我們對底下有什麼東西一點頭緒都沒有！
If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
你要是願意，仁兄，我們非常需要有人在老城區偵察一下，找找線索之類的。
I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
我稍早去瞧了一眼，有一棟老房子引起了我的注意——門上頭掛著一顆大得驚人的骷髏頭！
I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
我沒時間仔細看，不過要查我就從那裡查起，仁兄。
It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
就在這裡的南邊。那房子這麼多年了，木板居然還很結實，所以打起精神，老弟！
Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
噢，糟了，我就知道我忘了什麼！撐住，老弟！我馬上過去！
Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
該死！看來是晚了一步。是的，我忘了說地板狀況很糟。往上看！你摔得可不輕，還好吧？
Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
嗯，我想這也算有點好消息。不過話說回來，我好像把你送進了個相當棘手的局面！你在下面看得到出路嗎？
There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
有條隧道？啊哈，好極了！我建議你立刻走那條路。我現在得趕緊回崗位上了！
Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
祝你好運，老弟！好了，退後，你們這些傢伙！我叫你們退後！
Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...
嘿嘿……再走近一點，小小的人類……走進陰影裡……
Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.
探索房子地下室裡的隧道。
調查那個詭異的黑暗領域。
Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
斥候！立刻回報你的發現！有多少腐敗者要來？
Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
幾千……？這比我預想的糟得多。弟兄們！準備——
Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
等等，怎、怎麼回事？你到底怎麼了？！
Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
拜託，住手！不管你是誰，放過我和我的家人！我們到底做錯了什麼要遭這種罪？！
Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.
啊，可惜你沒早點說！他們早已離開這副凡人的軀殼了……噢，真是遺憾。
Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...
別出聲。我會讓你和你的家人團聚。你們甚至還能一起……嘿嘿……在我的注視底下，出門走走……
Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
什……你是說……不、不要，拜託！我不想傷害任何人！我不想死！！
Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.
啊哈，天真的姑娘。真可愛，你以為這件事你有得選。你想要什麼無關緊要，我需要什麼才算數。
Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?
看見這地方倒得多輕易了嗎？我多快就成了它的主人？而我又能多麼隨意地把你處理掉，連想都不必想？
Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.
幾百人在轉眼間被屠盡……隨即又重新站起，化為我數之不盡的士兵。
You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.
你會失敗，而我將能把你的身體像傀儡一樣吊起來，讓你為我起舞。
離開那個詭異的黑暗領域。
Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
把紅寶石帶回 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 交給 Graken
Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.
現在，回你的世界去。如果你還想挑戰我……我會等著。
Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
嘿！過來，快過來這邊！別跟殭屍們混在一起晃了，仁兄！
Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
喂！哈囉？！老弟？你眼神呆滯地到處亂走做什麼？快回神啊！
Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
振作點，打起精神！讓我看看你眼裡多點血色——這就對了！回來了嗎，仁兄？
Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
好極了！你剛才可把我嚇得不輕。來，好好說說底下究竟發生了什麼事，嗯？
Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
你的發現跟我們既有的情報吻合得很好——我信了。要擋住這些該死的殭屍，我們非下去不可。
Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
先遣隊帶回來一些很噁心的東西，腦漿之類的——不過也帶回了些相當漂亮的珠寶！
Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
拿幾件走吧，提醒你我們面對的是什麼。不過眼睛要盯著正事！
It's an independant island to the west. In fact... If you want to go...
那是西邊一座獨立的島。說真的……你要是想去的話……
The boat is down at the dock.
It's really hard to miss. Just hop on!
很難看不到啦。跳上去就是了！
And don't get me sterted on our architectur'!
還有別讓我講起我們的建築！
Mo'in, Wynn traveller! Come speak to me.
早啊，Wynn 來的旅人！過來跟我聊聊。
North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
往北可以買武器和藥水。再穿過那道門，就會遇到本地的 Avos。
West, you can buy armour, and there is another entrance to the potion shop.
往西可以買防具，那邊還有另一個進藥水店的入口。
Something is going on at the diner, you should hurry.
餐館那邊出事了，你最好快一點。
Psst! You! Over here, behind the logs!
Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you!
早啊，Wynn 人。還好我把你攔了下來！
The diner is being raided by mechs...
You don't know, huh? Of course you don't. Let me explain.
你不知道吧？當然不知道。我來說給你聽。
The name's Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
This town is usually full of life...
這鎮上平常是很熱鬧的……
Look... I know you're a stranger, but... If you want to help, talk to me.
聽著……我知道你是外地人，但……你要是想幫忙，就來找我。
Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic...
好，我用電魔法把門打開……
Look, I-I'm sorry for slowing you down. It's just...
Oh, two paths. Well, I'm not sure which way it is, so let's split up. I'll go to the right.
喔，兩條路。我也不確定是哪一邊，我們分頭走吧。我走右邊。
Mo'in. Sorry, had a problem with the-
早啊。抱歉，剛剛那個出了點問題——
Don't worry about the guards, they're disabled for now. Follow me!
別擔心那些守衛，它們暫時癱了。跟我來！
We saw a mech… A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
我們看到一台機兵……一台新的機兵！它看起來不一樣，像是在——
Our guest... just killed several despermechs by themselves.
我們的客人……一個人就解決了好幾台 Despermech。
Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
等你到 {~} 級就來我家，這把鑰匙給你開門。我們得準備闖進工廠。
我這身打扮讓你覺得新奇嗎？
I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
我不是這一帶的人。老實說，我來自 Corkus。
We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
我們正在找 Wynn 的代表。想見識 Corkus 的話，就到碼頭去找 C.S.S Wavebreaker。真去了的話，好好享受 Corkus！
Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
到 {p} 碼頭與 C.S.S Wavebreaker 的船長對話。
歡迎，歡迎登上 C.S.S Wavebreaker！
Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
上船來，自個兒找地方坐舒服。
Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
歡迎上俺的船，俺直接把你送到 Corkus。
Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
信俺的，那地方比 Gavel 跟 Wynn 精彩太多啦。俺們連機器都有咧！
Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
信俺的，你會待得很開心。
與 Corkus 的代表對話
It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
能有 Wynn 的士兵造訪本島，實在是莫大的榮幸。
We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
我們原本期待的是正式的使者，不過你也行。
If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
跟我來，我帶你在城裡走一圈。
We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
我們是在 {~} 年前首次登上 Corkus 的。
The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
Corkian 跟你一樣，原本都來自 Fruma……
Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
從 Fruma 來的人，自然是完全不懂魔法的。
We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
我們很快發展出自己的一套: 罕見的電魔法之力。
It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
那是一門艱深的現代魔法分支，讓我們得以造出機器。
Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
啊，這麼快就到了。歡迎來到 {p}，本島的首都。
We've come a long way in a short time.
短短時間裡，我們走了很長一段路。
Let me point out where the shops are.
我來告訴你商店都在哪裡。
To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
南邊是銀行、粉末店、捲軸店，還有我們獨有的粉末兌換所！
Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
喔！說到粉末兌換所，先給你一些這個當見面禮。
Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
繼續說……南門通往 {p}。往那邊走的路上，你可能會經過——
Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
呃，當我沒說。對了，我們替你準備了一份禮物。
The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Five Gears Diner 正在招待所有來訪本島的客人。
Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
從西門出去，到那間餐館享用你的免費大餐。祝你用餐愉快！
Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
前往 The Five Gears Diner。
Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
動手之前，我得先跟你說明這裡的狀況……
Our creations have rebelled against us.
我們造出來的東西，反過來背叛了我們。
They now raid towns for parts.
現在它們洗劫城鎮，就為了搜刮零件。
Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
那些機兵越來越不擇手段。
Even in rust, they are still powerful.
就算鏽成那樣，它們依然強悍。
We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
我們試過清除它們，可是工廠總會再造出新的。
It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
那是 Corkus 最大的失敗。非阻止不可。
I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
我可以試著打開通風口，從那裡溜進去。
I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
我知道你只是個外人，不過你願意幫忙的話，就來跟我說一聲。
Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
唉！我連最基本的法術都施不出來！
I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
在你面前這麼沒用，真是抱歉……
Electromagic is different from your magic... And I'm not very good at it.
電魔法跟你們的魔法不一樣……我不太拿手……
Open the door and exit the ducts.
...What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?!
那邊廢料堆上面那台機兵到底是什麼東西？！
That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
那絕對不是普通的 Despermech……它看起來是全新的！
One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
那種東西自從工廠停工之後就再也沒出現過……
We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
我們得做點什麼！我幫你清出一條路。我也就只能做這個了，我……腳……受傷了。
Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
你還好吧？很好。到我們初次見面的那個入口找我。我們得回 {p} 通報！
Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
在 The Five Gears Diner 的入口與 Maxie 對話。
I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
我知道一條捷徑，很快就能到 {p}。
Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.
在 {p} 與 Maxie 和 Corkus 的代表對話。
Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
Beltrude，出大事了！工廠又開始運轉了！
What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
一派胡言！這種事怎麼能在客人面前講！
And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
那我們憑什麼相信一個連基本的電魔法都不會的人？
Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
別聽 Maxie 的。祝你在這裡過得愉快。
They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
有你在場，他們什麼都不會承認的。他們想跟 Wynn 結盟。
Try following the trail outside the castle, it might lead you to the key.
試著沿城堡外的痕跡走，也許能找到鑰匙。
Just follow the road to the north to find my friend. Watch out, she doesn't like humans much.
只要沿著往北的路走就能找到我朋友。小心點，她不太喜歡人類。
You need the key before you leave!
離開之前你得先拿到鑰匙！
The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factory's operations.
當初的構想是兩個種族在工廠的運作裡各占一半。
We need those keys to get in and shut down the factory once more.
我們需要那些鑰匙才進得去，才能再一次把工廠關掉。
The Corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
Corkian 不會輕易交出他們那把，所以我們先從 Avos 下手。
Our best bet is to ask the chief, but... The border's closed due to tensions.
最好的辦法是去問族長，可是……因為緊張關係，邊境封了。
Fortunately, there's a catapult that can help us in a village north-west of here. Let's meet there!
還好西北邊有個村子有一台投石機能幫上忙。我們在那邊會合！
I knew it! There was something here we could use!
我就知道！這裡果然有能用的東西！
I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you'll have to go alone.
我得用電魔法讓它發射，所以你得自己過去。
Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens.
向 Avos 的居民打聽，找出 Avos 族長的位置。
I'm so jealous of the chief, he gets to live in the fanciest house on the hill!
我好羨慕族長，他住在山丘上那間最氣派的房子！
Hmm, no gears or goggles... You are no Corkian Human.
唔，沒有齒輪也沒有護目鏡……你不是 Corkian 人類。
We saw your battle with "Mech X" at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
我們從上面看到你在碼頭跟「Mech X」那一戰。我想我們可以信任你。
Can't you humans see I'm meditating?
你們人類看不出來我在冥想嗎？
I don't see why we're helping humans...
我不懂我們為什麼要幫人類……
You should head back to Maxie with the key.
你該帶著鑰匙回去找 Maxie。
Excellent! I'll hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
太好了！這個先由我保管。接下來專心弄到 Corkian 那把鑰匙。
They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I... I honestly don't know how to get in there.
他們把它鎖在城堡裡的金庫。我……我老實說不知道怎麼進去。
It's in the castle and to the right. There's {~} guards there at all times, you can't miss it.
在城堡裡往右邊走。那裡隨時有 {~} 名守衛，你不會找不到。
Something has happened in the vault.
Don't go in there, it's under control.
別進去，情況已經控制住了。
The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow the trail.
那些機兵不知為何沾滿了農作物，留下一路好認的痕跡。你要是真心想跟工廠拚，就沿著痕跡走。
Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here...
早啊。看到上面那傢伙沒？我來到現在他一動也沒動……
...I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
……我不覺得他真的是農夫。跟我來。
That model was a S-{~}... It's warned the others. Let's go.
那型號是 S-{~}……它已經通報其他的了。我們走。
看吧？我們被鎖在外面了。
You did?! Great! Now we need to meet at the factory. The real hard part begins.
真的假的？！太好了！接下來得在工廠碰頭。真正難的部分才要開始。
You hear a distant rumbling sound...
你聽見遠方傳來隆隆聲……
An engraving on the pillar reads: Reunite three wise creatures to open the way.
柱子上刻著: 讓三隻智慧的生物重聚，路便會開。
You dare intrude on me while I am sculpting?! You shall pay with your life!
你竟敢在我雕刻的時候打擾我？！拿命來賠！
Another miserable whelp has come to steal my knowledge? I won't let you!
又一個可悲的小鬼來偷我的學問？我不會讓你得逞！
So... You've managed to make it past my family. Pathetic aren't they?
所以……你闖過我那些家人了。他們很沒用吧？
Let me show you a real challenge!
讓我給你看看什麼叫真正的難關！
Use Maxie's house key to enter Maxie's house
用 Maxie 的家門鑰匙進入 Maxie 的家
Talk to Maxie on the first floor.
在一樓與 Maxie 對話。
To get in we need two keys. One from the Avos and one from Corkians.
要進去得有兩把鑰匙。一把在 Avos 手上，一把在 Corkian 手上。
Our best bet is to ask the chief. However, because of tensions the border is closed.
最好的辦法是去問族長。可是因為關係緊張，邊界已經封閉了。
Find the Avos chief. Ask for the factory key.
找到 Avos 的族長，向他要工廠的鑰匙。
Press the button when you're ready.
Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens. Avos Chief is at -{~}, -{~}
向 Avos 的居民打聽，找出 Avos 族長的位置。族長在 -{~1}, -{~2}
The chief said your people are welcome here.
族長說過，你的同族在這裡是受歡迎的。
You must be here to see him.
順著這道階梯上去就是了。
Mo'in, soldier. I have been expecting you.
早啊，士兵。我等你很久了。
You can't catapult yourself into a village full of bird people and not get noticed.
你把自己用投石機扔進一座滿是鳥人的村子，怎麼可能沒人注意到。
We know what you are here for, however. The Avos factory key.
不過我們知道你來的目的: Avos 那把工廠鑰匙。
The key you seek is hidden deep within our most protected temple.
你要找的鑰匙，藏在我們守衛最森嚴的神殿深處。
Follow the road north of here to reach the temple. Speak to the grandmaster and she will allow you entry.
沿著北邊那條路走就會到神殿。去跟大宗師說一聲，她會放你進去。
Talk to the chief's friend at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Talk to the chief's friend at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Eh, It's the warrior. I have my orders, but still say this is a bad idea.
哼，是那個戰士啊。我是奉命行事，但我還是要說，這主意很糟。
We hid this key for the purpose that it would never be used again.
我們把這把鑰匙藏起來，就是為了讓它永遠不再被使用。
The creatures we summoned down there are hostile to all. Even Avos.
我們召到下面去的那些東西對誰都懷有敵意。連 Avos 也不例外。
I can't say I have high hopes for you.
我對你可沒抱多大期望。
Meet me round the back of my house and I shall show you the way.
到我屋子後面來找我，我會帶你走那條路。
Meet the grandmaster behind her house and get over the gap and enter the temple.
到大宗師屋後與她會合，越過斷崖進入神殿。
I'll make the bridge for you.
You all act the same to me. Anyway, there you go.
在我看來你們全都一個樣。算了，過去吧。
Find the key inside the temple.
You cannot have the key. Prepare for destruction.
鑰匙不會給你。準備受死吧。
Return to Maxie in his house with the first key.
帶著第一把鑰匙回到 Maxie 家找他。
You're back, and you have the key!
你回來了，而且拿到鑰匙了！
I think first we should just go and scout out the vault itself and work it out.
我想我們先去金庫那邊探探，再想辦法。
Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
呃——不用擔心！我們只是不小心……
Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
在牆上炸了個洞！對，就是這樣！
Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.
別說了。Maxie 是對的。我很抱歉。Mech X 像戳紙一樣穿透金庫，把鑰匙拿走了。
Look for the hidden mech base.
Psst! Over here, in the field!
HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
演得不錯嘛，機兵！可惜騙不了我！
REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
回報……偽裝已暴露……兩名未授權入侵者……位於基地外。
That model was a S-{~}, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
那台是 S-{~} 型，也就是說它已經通報其他同伴了。跟我來。
Stand back, I'll open the door.
I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
我想我們可以放心斷定，就是這裡沒錯。
You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
你衝進去把我們要的東西找出來。我在外面掩護你。
You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.
你得找到那台工廠新造的機兵，把它毀掉。
Retrieve the key from the base.
偵測到入侵者。予以摧毀。
Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
Corkus 必須付出代價……他們關閉了工廠，把我們鎖在裡面。等兩把鑰匙都到手，我們就能打開它——而這一把，你休想拿走。
Find Maxie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and give him the key.
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找到 Maxie，把鑰匙交給他。
Mo'in. Did you get the key?
Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
沿著西北那條路走，從西側進入工廠。我在那裡等你。
Find Maxie outside the Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
早啊。你確定準備好了嗎？
This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
這不會是一般的戰鬥。那座工廠是最尖端的技術，由一個純粹以電魔法構成的存在在運轉。
The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
Corkus 最聰明的人 Cerid，花了好幾年造出一個比他自己更聰明的存在……
Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
如今它以一套扭曲的道德觀經營著那座工廠。工廠為什麼會被關閉，一看便知。
Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
還有……我、我用我的魔法幫你做了這雙靴子。看來我在造東西這方面還挺行的。
I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
我也想跟你說聲謝謝。跟你並肩作戰，我真的覺得自己起了作用。準備好之後，直接走向工廠大門就行了。
Mo'in, {u}! I've been researching everything I can about the factory.
早啊，{u}！我一直在查工廠的所有資料。
I have learned so much on our adventure. One day, if you ever need me, I will be there. You have an ally in this Corkian.
這趟冒險讓我學到太多了。哪天你要是需要我，我一定到。這個 Corkian 是你的盟友。
Visit the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires completion of The Envoy Part II)
前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的工坊(需先完成 The Envoy Part II)
Oh?! Hold on, is anyone there..!
Why hello there! Whatcha doin' here? I'm Ava!
嘿，你好啊！你在這裡做什麼？我是 Ava！
Want a quick job? How 'bout helpin' me out?! That was perfect timing!
想接個小差事嗎？要不要幫我個忙？！你來得正是時候！
Y'see, while the other Avos hate it, I just find electromagic so fascinating!
跟你說，其他 Avos 都討厭電魔法，但我就是覺得它超迷人的！
Look, I think I got a breakthrough invention. If it works... Oh man...
聽著，我好像做出了一個突破性的發明。要是成功的話……天啊……
I just need to harness some nature magic, and there's an amazing source in the chief's hut. Ya comin'?
我只需要汲取一些自然魔法，剛好族長的小屋裡就有個很棒的來源。要來嗎？
Don't you worry about rewards! I got you! See ya' there!
報酬你不用擔心！包在我身上！那裡見！
Hey! You showed up! Listen up, here's the plan...
嘿！你來了！聽好，計畫是這樣的……
There's a small museum inside the hut with all kinds of trophies.
小屋裡有個小型的展示間，裡面放著各式各樣的戰利品。
Our chief is quite the talkative fella, and I can guarantee he'd love to tell you stories.
我們族長是個很愛講話的傢伙，我保證他會很樂意跟你講故事。
That should keep him and his guards busy. And that's where I come in!
這樣應該就能把他和他的守衛都絆住。接下來就換我上場了！
I'll take that chance to sneak behind the throne, where our sacred totem is. I'm not stealing it, don't worry!
我會趁那個機會溜到王座後面，我們的神聖圖騰就在那裡。我不是要偷它，別擔心！
I'm a little clumsy, but I'm sure I can count on ya'! No matter what, keep the chief busy!
我是有點笨手笨腳，但我相信你靠得住！無論如何，都要把族長絆住！
在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 引開 Avos 族長的注意
So, what brings you here, hm?
那麼，是什麼風把你吹來的，嗯？
Oh, you want to learn more about us... Of course, of course!
喔，你想多了解我們一些……當然，當然！
We have a room where I can show you some of our history.
我們有個房間，可以讓你看看我們的一些歷史。
You're in luck, I'm in a good mood. Follow me then.
你運氣不錯，我今天心情好。那就跟我來吧。
It's alright, these books aren't important... Be careful though.
沒關係，這些書不重要……不過還是小心一點。
It's one of a kind! We planted it eons ago. It has never ever grown an inch. Or moved.
它是獨一無二的！我們在遠古就種下了它。它從來沒有長高過一吋。也沒有移動過。
Never died or anything either. For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
也從來沒有死掉或怎麼樣。說不定它比你們的腐敗還要古老呢！
Oh, this is quite the important tome.
喔，這是一本相當重要的典籍。
This book has a signature from all Avos chiefs ever since we discovered ink!
自從我們發現墨水以來，歷任 Avos 族長都在這本書上簽過名！
It's a custom for every Avos chief to keep their feathers somewhere. I guess I left that here.
每一任 Avos 族長都習慣把自己的羽毛存放在某個地方。我想我是把它留在這裡了。
還有這個，是很重要的歷史！
Though, we don't really have the time to sit down and read all of it, do we?
不過，我們也沒那個時間坐下來把它全部讀完，對吧？
那是什麼聲音？！我去看看。
Someone broke in? But why? Anyone can use our totem...
有人闖進來？可是為什麼？任何人都可以使用我們的圖騰啊……
I don't get it. They could've just asked...
我不懂。他們大可以直接開口問的……
Report back to Ava in the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Oh, hey! Thanks for earlier. You were a big help.
喔，嘿！剛才謝啦。你幫了大忙。
Truth is, anyone can use that totem. They just don't like me very much.
老實說，那個圖騰任何人都可以用。他們只是不太喜歡我而已。
Anyway, we got what we needed, and it's promising! Now onto the next part...
總之，我們拿到需要的東西了，而且很有希望！接下來進入下一步……
Y'see, I managed to bottle up some of our magic, but I still need corkian stuff.
跟你說，我成功把我們的一點魔法裝進瓶子裡了，但還需要 Corkian 的東西。
Fortunately for us, there's a shop outside the city. Though, things might get complicated...
算我們走運，城外有一間店。不過呢，事情可能會有點複雜……
A bunch of Corkians aren't too fond of... Us. I just think you should come along with me, y'know?
有一群 Corkian 不太喜歡……我們。我只是覺得你應該跟我一起去，你懂吧？
Here, I wrote the coords into that book of yours. It's a bit far, so come on out and I'll give you a lift!
來，我把座標寫進你那本書裡了。有點遠，出來吧，我載你一程！
Meet Ava near the Corkian shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Corkian 商店附近與 Ava 會合
Alright, if you want a lift, tell me, or you could just walk!
好啦，你想搭便車就跟我說，不然你也可以用走的！
Not sure why you'd do that when I'm right here though!
不過我人都在這裡了，我實在不懂你為什麼要用走的！
Alright, buckle up, we're taking off!
好，坐穩了，我們要起飛囉！
Still holding on? We're almost there!
還抓得住嗎？我們快到了！
Here we are! Enjoyed the lift? I'm a great form of fast travel, right?!
到囉！這趟還喜歡嗎？我可是很棒的快速旅行方式，對吧？！
Well, this was my first time using this magic magnet on people, but...
嗯，這是我第一次把這個魔法磁鐵用在人身上，不過……
This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
就是這間店！我想我們可以在這裡買到強化潛能微晶片。
I need you to accompany me.
If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
有人類陪著，他們總該願意賣一個給我吧？
You go first, I'll follow you.
Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
還是說你打算直接走人？那也沒關係啦……
Ah, finally! I could've taken you there y'know!
啊，終於！我明明可以載你過去的欸！
Honestly, I just wanted to test something on you... Oh well!
老實說，我只是想在你身上測試一點東西……唉，算了！
This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
就是這間店！我想我們可以在這裡買到強化潛能微晶片。
I need you to accompany me.
If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
有人類陪著，他們總該願意賣一個給我吧？
You go first, I'll follow you.
Hmpf. What are you doing in here, Avo?!
So-uh, I was, y'know, wonderin' if you had any-
那個呃，我是想，你懂的，問你有沒有——
There's NO WAY I'm selling anythin' to an Avo! Shoo! Get out!
我「絕對」不會賣任何東西給 Avo！走開！出去！
I am NOT giving up! To hell with all this!
我「不會」放棄的！去他的這一切！
Here, go in yourself and ask. I'll cover the cost later.
來，你自己進去問。費用我之後補給你。
I'll stand back. CLEARLY this guy is too STUCK up to- Ugh, I'm getting angry! Just go in again.
我先退開。這傢伙「顯然」就是太自以為了不起，才會——呃，我要火大了！你再進去一次就對了。
Ask for an Enhanced Microchip at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Huh?! I made myself clear! You were with her!
啊？！我講得夠清楚了吧！你跟她是一夥的！
I'm closing for today, I cannot stand this! OUT!!
我今天要關門了，我受不了了！出去！！
Oh, and don't even think about even approaching MY shop!
喔，還有，想都別想再靠近「我的」店！
Find the control panel near the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
So you did come back! Hang tight!
你果然回來了！等我一下！
Look, we need a plan. Talk to me.
聽著，我們得想個辦法。來跟我說說話。
I'm... surprised he kicked you out, too. Maybe he's a patriot?
我……很意外他連你也趕出來。也許他是個愛國者？
Well, anyway, we need a plan. I don't wanna wait this out.
總之，我們得想個辦法。我可不想就這樣乾等下去。
Look, this guy has to have a control panel somewhere. Maybe we can neutralize the robots.
聽著，這傢伙一定在哪裡藏了個控制台。說不定我們能讓那些機器人停擺。
That stuff hates water, y'know? So I'll go fetch some in the meantime.
那種東西最怕水，你知道吧？所以我趁這段時間去弄一些來。
I'd like to NOT get zapped by a forcefield, so I'll sneak inside once we're done with that.
我可「不」想被力場電到，所以那件事處理完之後我再溜進去。
Got it? Find the control panel. It should be somewhere around the house. Talk to me once you're ready.
懂了嗎？去找控制台。應該就在房子附近某處。準備好了就跟我說。
Good luck, then! I'll be back once you find the control panel and get inside!
那就祝你好運囉！你找到控制台、進到裡面之後我就回來！
Here we are! Good job! Alright, let's see...
Wait... Why are there... Buttons... Everywhere??
等等……為什麼……到處都是……按鈕？？
I feel like soaking everything would be quite the mistake.
我覺得把全部都淋濕大概會是個大錯。
And none of them are labelled! What is that?!
而且一個標示都沒有！這是什麼鬼？！
Look, your choice. What should we neutralize first?
聽著，你決定。我們要先讓哪一個失效？
Left, huh? Well, let's see how that goes.
左邊，是吧？好，來看看會怎樣。
Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
中間……我猜最重要的東西可能在這裡。理論上。我可不敢指望。
Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
咦！這還不算太糟。而且……我看到有東西露出來，等一下……
Haha!... Wait, that's not it. Urgh.
Hey, I'll just give that to you. Though, you probably don't know how to use it, heh!
欸，這個就給你吧。不過你大概不知道怎麼用，嘿嘿！
Looks like we got another shot. I still have some water left.
看來我們還有一次機會。我還剩一些水。
Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
中間……我猜最重要的東西可能在這裡。理論上。我可不敢指望。
Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
咦！這還不算太糟。而且……我看到有東西露出來，等一下……
Haha! I think that's what we're looking for!
哈哈！我想這就是我們要找的！
Look, I still want to make it up to the guy. I really don't want to be the villain of his story.
聽著，我還是想補償那傢伙。我真的不想在他的故事裡當反派。
I'll meet you back at the Workshop. You can go on ahead.
我在工坊等你。你先走吧。
Right, right. Stand back, just in case.
好，好。退後一點，以防萬一。
Oh wow. You got the right one, first try! How'd you know?
喔哇。你第一次就按對了！你怎麼知道的？
Well, good job. I still want to make it up to the poor guy though.
嗯，做得好。不過我還是想補償那個可憐的傢伙。
Just meet me back at the Workshop, I'll be there!
到工坊來找我就好，我會在那裡！
Fight your way out of the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Meet Ava in the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
抱歉給你惹了這麼多麻煩……希望這能補償你。
I hope that human's alright... I managed to find the microchip right away, after all.
希望那個人類沒事……畢竟我一下子就找到微晶片了。
...Alright. Time to go. I'll wait for them, I guess.
……好。該走了。我想我還是等一下他們好了。
Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
抱歉給你惹了這麼多麻煩……希望這能補償你。
Oh, there you are! I felt sad leaving you behind!
喔，你在這裡啊！把你丟下我還挺難過的！
Say, if you need a lift, just tell me.
欸，如果你需要搭便車，跟我說一聲就好。
Alright, I'm dropping you off! Stick the landing!
好，我要把你放下去了！落地站穩啊！
I can't believe it! It's working! Look! Look at it!
我真不敢相信！它成功了！你看！你看它！
A Growth Accelerator... Can you imagine the possibilities?!
生長加速器……你能想像那有多少可能性嗎？！
We'll be able to... I don't know, help the poor, that's nice, right?
我們就可以……我不知道，幫助窮人之類的，那不錯吧？
But we're not done. Well, I'm not done. I'd still like your help.
但我們還沒完。嗯，是我還沒完。我還是想請你幫忙。
Look, let's try it out together, alright? Maybe I'll let you go afterwards?
聽著，我們一起試試看，好嗎？也許之後我就放你走了？
I'll join you outside. Once I'm sure this works, I'll be able to... Show it to them.
我到外面跟你會合。等我確定它能用，我就能……拿去給他們看了。
In theory, it should be easy to operate... I'm trusting you. Again. Sorry 'bout that.
理論上，操作起來應該很簡單……我就交給你了。又一次。抱歉啦。
Meet Ava outside of the Workshop and help her operate her machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的工坊外面與 Ava 會合，幫她操作機器
Alright, it's just on the hill next to us, but I can bring you there if ya want!
好啦，就在我們旁邊那座山丘上，不過你想的話我可以載你過去！

不過可別太依賴我喔？準備好了跟我說。

還是說你打算直接走人？那也沒關係啦……
Alright, this should be good. Talk to me and I'll explain!
好，這樣應該就可以了。來跟我說話，我來解釋！
