好。我現在得去睡了。雖然我興奮到幾乎睡不著！！！！啊啊啊啊！！！！！明天就飛升了，「明天」就飛升了！！！！我等不及了！！！！！
It's all just matter, in the end. Building blocks stuck together in new and different ways! Elements of varying ratios glued to one another at a microscopic scale!
說到底，一切都只是物質。以嶄新而不同的方式黏在一起的積木！不同比例的元素在微觀尺度上彼此膠合！
Shift the quantities, the positioning, the makeup... and one thing becomes another! With a wave of a hand, anything can become anything else!!
改變數量、位置、構成……一樣東西就會變成另一樣東西！只要揮一揮手，任何東西都能變成任何其他東西！！
...Those are people. I know that. I understand that! So why- why do I feel nothing when I look at them?! Why?! Why...
……那些是人。我知道。我明白！那為什麼——為什麼我看著他們卻什麼都感覺不到？！為什麼？！為什麼……
I like working with golems. They're easier. Even if one breaks, I know how to put it back together. Even if they're not people, they're just as real to me.
我喜歡跟魔像一起工作。他們比較簡單。就算壞了一個，我也知道怎麼把它拼回去。就算他們不是人，對我來說也一樣真實。
...What is a soul? What is it that people have that my golems don't? I can't see it when I look for it. It's all the same matter. It all looks the same.
……靈魂是什麼？人有而我的魔像沒有的，到底是什麼？我去找的時候看不見它。全都是一樣的物質。全都看起來一樣。
Do I still have one? Did I ever have one? I must have, I remember being happier, I remember it! But when I look, I can't find it. It's all just matter.
我還有靈魂嗎？我曾經有過嗎？我一定有過，我記得自己以前比較快樂，我記得！可是我去找的時候，找不到它。一切都只是物質。
...The stupid blessing! I can't see it either, but oh do I know it exists. A reminder branded into my skin!! But it's not matter. It's none of the elements, or any of their combinations.
……那個蠢祝福！我也看不見它，可是噢，我太清楚它存在了。烙在我皮膚上的提醒！！可是它不是物質。它不是任何一種元素，也不是元素的任何組合。
How can I get rid of something I can't see?! How can I rid myself of something I don't remember living without?!
我要怎麼擺脫一個我看不見的東西？！我要怎麼擺脫一個我根本不記得沒有它時是怎麼活的東西？！
And even if... even if I succeeded... could I forget what I've seen? It's all just matter. Even if I won't see it anymore... I'll know. I'll know for the rest of my life.
而且就算……就算我成功了……我能忘記我看過的東西嗎？一切都只是物質。就算我再也看不見它……我也會知道。我這輩子剩下的日子都會知道。
Why did I ever agree to this?
我當初為什麼要答應這件事？
Create. Destroy. Create. Destroy. Create destroy create create destroy destroy destroy.
創造。毀滅。創造。毀滅。創造毀滅創造創造毀滅毀滅毀滅。
Build and build and build until the action ceases to hold meaning. Then tear it all down, until its components return to the earth, until nothing remains, not even its memory.
建造、建造、再建造，直到這個動作不再有任何意義。然後把它全部拆毀，直到它的零件回歸大地，直到什麼都不剩，連記憶都不剩。
Repeat. Repeat, repeat, repeat until the ends and beginnings can't even be told apart. And then do it over again. And again. And again and again and again and again...
重複。重複、重複、重複，直到連結束與開始都分不出來。然後再來一次。再一次。再一次又一次又一次又一次……
... failure. No matter how many days I took, the power never ceased to flow. The mark remains.
……失敗。不管我花了多少天，那股力量從未停止流動。印記依然還在。
Tried to use my blessing on myself. Grab at the flesh and blood poisoned by the mark, and twist it into anything, anything other than what it is now.
試著對自己使用我的祝福。抓住被印記毒害的血肉，把它扭轉成任何東西，任何不是它現在這樣的東西。
Agony. Like the pain from receiving the blessing in the first place, but multiplied tenfold. A hundred times. A million screaming signals from nerves that were no longer real...
劇痛。就像當初接受祝福時的痛，但放大了十倍。一百倍。一百萬道來自早已不再真實的神經的尖叫訊號……
When I came to, the mark was still there. As if nothing had ever happened. Flowers had a cubic meter chunk of soil missing from his body. Easy to repair, but...
等我醒過來，印記還在。彷彿什麼都沒發生過。Flowers 身上少了一立方公尺的土。很容易修補，可是……
There are countless more entries... You skip to the last one.
還有數不清的篇章……你直接跳到最後一篇。
The Queen provided me with an out. There's a super-top-secret project she needs done, and I am meant to be the one to do it.
女王給了我一條出路。她有一個需要完成的超級最高機密計畫，而我就是那個該完成它的人。
If I succeed, my blessing will be removed. Finally. Finally finally finally finally FINALLY. Some hope. I just have to do this. I just have to finish this project, and then...
如果我成功了，我的祝福就會被移除。終於。終於終於終於終於「終於」。一線希望。我只要做到這件事就好。我只要完成這個計畫，然後……
Now's your chance to get past - go!

Yusanu
First the Sovereign, and now-?
I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
看來又有一個迷途的靈魂，找上了 {p}！
I see another challenger has found their way to The {p}!
看來又有一個挑戰者，找上了 {p}！
I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
你的樣子並沒有讓我多驚豔。在這裡，誕生的是無數強大而充滿魔力的怪物。
Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
Gavel 的各國政府擋不住 Qira 大人。我看你也一樣。
If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
你想見她，就得把她軍隊的每一支部隊都打敗。
Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
她雖強大，卻不失氣度。每通過一層，你都會拿到一枚代幣，可以到店裡換取獎勵。祝你好運，冒險——
Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
什——喔，大人，是嗎？我失禮了……
Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
開始吧，雷之部隊！速戰速決，別逗留——待得太久，裡面的東西會扭曲你的心智！
Heeheehahaaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
嘻嘻哈哈哈！我看見你啦！你們人類的腦袋真是好擺弄，不過我就先把你打個半死吧！過來，快過來！！！
Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
切，你真沒意思，小騙子！該被打趴的是你，不是我啊！
I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
我恨死你了。快滾出去跟那個蠢僕人講話啦！！
You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
你通過雷之層了？真令人意外。那些可是 Qira 大人最早的成功之作。
I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
遵命，大人。如約定，這是 Thunder Voucher。
Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
拿去店裡兌換你的獎品。店就在蜂巢的底層。那裡的僕人會告訴你關於獎品的重要事項。
I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
不過我可不覺得你還值得大人費神。你也想得到，她這裡有太多事要照料。
She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
很久以前，Gavel 的人愚蠢地想圍攻我們的蜂巢，之後她便與他們立了約。
She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
她可以繼續她那些違背倫理、甚至可說是邪惡的工作……而作為交換，她不會去打擾 Gavel 的人民。
Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
接下來你得面對風之部隊，那裡有她更難纏的一些造物。
Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
開始吧，風之部隊！隨風而戰，自由揮灑——在這裡展不開翅膀，將至的風暴就會把你收歸我有！
Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
哇，能走到這裡真不錯！別跟別人說喔，我等下會手下留情，好嗎？我可是站你這邊的，我們玩得開心點！過來吧！
Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really, really well!
嘻嘻，說不定我根本不必留手呢？你表現得真的非常、非常好！
A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
很多人說我是我們這裡最難纏的，所以你沒問題的！不過接下來要去跟 Yansur 那種人講話，真是辛苦你了。
Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
唔，或許我們是低估你了。風之造物擊敗過成千上萬的人，尤其是——
...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
店裡已經備好你的獎勵。你要是還沒跟店裡的僕人談過，下次去的時候記得談。
You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
你還有很長的路要走。想見 Qira 大人一面可不容易。
Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
你的下一個目標是清空地之部隊。那裡是有史以來最強悍、最原始的孵化物。
Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
開始吧，地之部隊！你得同時扛住蠻力與劇毒！腳步放快些，否則你就要歸於塵土！
Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
地之造物竟也擋不住你……大人最原始強悍的那些……全被摧毀了。
Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
好吧，這是你的 Earth Voucher。
It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
你能走到這一步，確實令人刮目相看。許多人都倒在這裡了。
It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
不過那也無妨，你下一關是水之部隊。我確信你不會成功。
Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
開始吧，水之部隊！你若擋不住拍擊的浪濤，潛伏其中的生物會確保你永遠浮不出深淵！
You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
經判定，你有資格與我一戰。然而我清楚你的實力，我不認為那足以擊敗我。上前來吧。試著證明我看走了眼。
Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
看來我的判斷有誤。不過在此事上，錯得令人愉快。
Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
繼續前行吧，可敬的人類。或許你的才智與敬意，能感染那個令人難以忍受的 Yansur。
Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
不可能。連戰術最精妙的怪物都拿不下你。
... Here's the Water Voucher you're expecting.
We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
你的決心引起了我們的興趣……但我們並不擔心。我們不認為你過得了下一層。
Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
接下來你要面對的，是 Qira 大人想像力所及最難纏的一些生物！
You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
現在你得面對火之部隊，它必定會把你燒個透。
Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
開始吧，火之部隊！鼓起你的勇氣，闖過火山的熾熱——否則就隨風化為飛灰！
Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
能走到這裡，令人佩服。我是你最後的試煉。那麼，我們就堂堂正正地打一場。無論是勝是敗，你的挑戰都該有個體面的收尾。上前來面對我吧。

Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
隔了這麼久，敗北的滋味有些陌生。不過你打得英勇，也充滿熱忱。要說我失望，那是騙人的。若你願意，把這些品格也帶給大人的僕人，然後去領你最後的獎品吧。
All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
剩下的只有去跟大人的僕人談話、領取你最後的獎品。他想必不會像我這樣難以逾越。
This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
這是前所未有的事。你擊敗了最新、也最強大的一批造物。
Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
This is unorthodox, as few have made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
這不合常規，畢竟很少有人走到這一步。但我想，這也代表你已經有資格晉見——
Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
哈！難以置信！大人要親自與你一戰！你真讓我吃驚。
Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
不過先警告你。這將是你至今最艱難的一戰。Qira 大人是 Gavel 最令人畏懼的存在。
You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
你會死的……但死在她手上，就當是至高的榮耀吧。
How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
好個懦夫！在蜂巢裡擊敗了那麼多對手、受了那樣的讚譽，你竟有臉放大人的鴿子？
I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
我本來已經開始高看你，可是在這種令人作嘔的表現之後——
Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
什……那——不，那不可能是真的，你——
...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
……真是高明……我們窩在這座蜂巢裡太久，久到軍隊都過時了嗎？
To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
竟敗在一個 Wynn 的人類手上……我不知道該失望還是該驚嘆。我們最終的試煉被攻破了。
Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
那麼，這是你的兌換券。店裡的後間備有你的獎勵。你要是到現在還沒跟店裡的僕人談過……好吧，這時候你也該知道了。
Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
大人……容我說個故事？她曾經被請去協助阻止森林的黯蝕。
With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
以她無邊的學識與魔法，她一定治得好。但她拒絕了。
She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
她選擇了創造，執著於為某一場戰爭做準備。
Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
大人從未細說，但看來她知道某些我們不知道的事。
Excuse me, but aren't you forgetting some things, Yansur?
恕我打岔，Yansur，你是不是漏了些什麼？
You will be disciplined later...fine. Consider yourself honoured to have even a moment of my time, adventurer. Allow me to explain in further detail, my glorious Hive.
晚點再處置你……罷了。冒險者，能占用我片刻時間，你該引以為榮。就讓我更詳細地說明一下，我這座榮耀的蜂巢。
As Yansur explained, if you wish audience with me, you must prove yourself worthy of my presence by defeating each division of my personal army.
正如 Yansur 所說，你若想晉見我，就得擊敗我私人軍隊的每一支部隊，證明你有資格站在我面前。
It consists of five main divisions, each one based around a particular element. Thunder, Air, Earth, and so on. Clearing one will unlock the next for you to face.
它由五支主要部隊組成，每一支各以一種元素為核心。雷、風、地，依此類推。通過一支，下一支才會開放讓你挑戰。
To pass a floor of the division, defeat my forces and put the catalysts they drop into the collector. You will need five catalysts to pass a floor.
要通過部隊的一層，就得擊敗我的部下，把他們掉落的觸媒放進收集器。通過一層需要五個觸媒。
After nine floors of normal troops, you will face a Division Leader.
打完九層普通士兵之後，你將面對一名部隊首領。
These exceptionally powerful members of my army will be fought alone, and you will only need one catalyst from them to pass.
這些我軍中格外強大的成員會單獨應戰，你只需要從他們身上拿到一個觸媒就能通過。
The Thunder Division will be your first challenge. I do hope you will be entertaining to watch...
雷之部隊將是你的第一道挑戰。但願你夠有看頭……
The mysterious box accepts your tokens. You're free to move on to the next room.
神祕的箱子收下了你的代幣。你可以前往下一個房間了。
How was your first taste of the Hive? Your battle against the Psychomancer was quite the spectacle to behold, ahaha...
初次領教蜂巢的滋味如何？你與 Psychomancer 的那一戰可真是精彩，啊哈哈……
Hush, Yansur. Not a word about her.
安靜，Yansur。關於她的事一個字都別提。
Seems you can move on... All you hear is a bloodcurdling roar. What lies ahead...?
看來你可以繼續前進了……你只聽見一聲令人毛骨悚然的咆哮。前方等著你的會是……？
Well, now that you've destroyed that terrible thing, it seems prudent to tell Yansur and get your Earth Voucher.
好了，既然你已經消滅了那個可怕的東西，去告訴 Yansur、領取你的 Earth Voucher 似乎是明智之舉。
Managed to defeat Genesis, hm? It is normally the end of most... Interesting.
居然打倒了 Genesis，嗯？大多數人都會止步於此……有意思。
I must admit I am impressed; the Judge is ruthless... perhaps he needs further tweaking?
我必須承認，我很佩服；那位審判者可是毫不留情……或許他還需要再調整一下？
Even downed the Vanguard...? My word...
連先鋒都打倒了……？我的天……
Allow me to stop you there, Yansur. I wish to make an exception for this challenger.
到此為止吧，Yansur。我想為這位挑戰者破個例。
You have intrigued me, adventurer...and I want to put you to the truest test.
你引起了我的興趣，冒險者……我想讓你接受最真正的試煉。
I await you in my chambers...
...you. You...ahaha...I like you. You're capable enough... Perhaps we could be allies in the future...
……你。你……啊哈哈……我喜歡你。你夠有本事……說不定將來我們能成為盟友……
You defeated Qira! All that's left to do is tell Yansur!
你打敗了 Qira！剩下的就只差告訴 Yansur 了！
You question your mistress? I have nothing to gain from lying to you about this. And there is no shame in admitting defeat.
你在質疑你的主人嗎？我沒有必要在這件事上對你說謊。而且承認失敗並不可恥。
It is simply a testament to their strength. I will prepare a special reward for them to mark the occasion.
這不過證明了他們的實力。我會準備一份特別的獎賞給他們，紀念這個時刻。
It is as I have always told you. The darkness is coming...but if you Wynn folk are all as strong as you have proven yourself to be, we may just be able to beat it back.
正如我一直告訴你們的。黑暗就要來了……但如果你們 Wynn 的人都像你所證明的這般強大，我們或許真能將它擊退。
Honour to you, warrior of Wynn.
As infuriating as what you did was, you were following orders... I had every right to be angry, but to try and take your life was ten steps too far.
你做的事再怎麼令人抓狂，你也只是在奉命行事……我有一萬個生氣的理由，但要取你性命，那就遠遠越線了。
Even though it is not enough, I will say I am sorry for the pain I caused you. The Guardian was right, in the end.
就算不夠，我還是要說，我為我造成的痛苦向你道歉。到頭來，守護者是對的。
Without you carrying out Orphion's will, we would not be here. You truly are necessary in this, and I believe I have finally made peace with that.
若不是你執行了 Orphion 的意志，我們不會走到這裡。在這件事上，你確實是必要的，而我想我終於能與這件事和解了。
It has been a long time since I had a partner willing to help me in this way. I was unused to it, I suppose... Still.
我已經很久沒有一個願意這樣幫我的同伴了。我大概是不習慣吧……不過還是。
If you'll be willing to aid me, it would be a great relief. It has been a thousand years since I entered the Realm of Light...
你若願意助我一臂之力，那會是莫大的寬慰。距離我上一次進入光之領域，已經一千年了……
I can only hope things have not changed much. I remember how it was, right down to the last petal...
我只能希望那裡沒有變太多。我記得它當時的模樣，連最後一片花瓣都記得……
Walk towards the portal with Lari.
與 Lari 一起走向傳送門。
Wait a moment, {u}. I have one more thing I would like to say before we enter.
等一下，{u}。進去之前，我還有一件事想說。
I... I need to thank you. For helping, as you have. For staying by me as you have. There was one other before you like that...
我……我得謝謝你。謝謝你像這樣幫我。謝謝你像這樣留在我身邊。在你之前，還有過一個人是這樣的……
I promise that you will not meet the same fate as him. I will fight with you to the bitter end, achara.
我保證你不會落得跟他一樣的下場。我會與你並肩戰到最後一刻，achara。
It's time, then. To visit Orphion.
那麼，時候到了。去見 Orphion 吧。
Jump into the portal after Lari.
跟著 Lari 跳進傳送門。
Talk to Lari at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in the Realm of Light.
在光之領域到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 跟 Lari 談話。
Welcome to the Realm of Light then, {u}. Once you've re-oriented yourself, come over here.
那麼，歡迎來到光之領域，{u}。等你站穩了就過來這裡。
It's so much smaller than it used to be! There used to be many more landmasses, all connected to each other...
它比以前小太多了！以前有更多塊陸地，彼此都連在一起……
I feel... I feel everything in here. With Orphion's light, I can tap into the very core of the realm.
我感覺得到……我感覺得到這裡的一切。憑著 Orphion 的光，我能觸及這個領域最核心的地方。
And I can feel disturbances. There are dark creatures here, where there should be none!
而我感覺得到擾動。這裡有黑暗的生物，而這裡本不該有！
I mean, even look at this creature. The light emanating from it is-
你看看這隻生物。從他身上散發出來的光——
Wait. Wh... Why is it attacking you!?
等等。為……為什麼他在攻擊你？！
Its mind was addled by darkness. Poor thing was terrified... Nothing for it though.
他的心智被黑暗攪亂了。可憐的東西，他只是嚇壞了……不過也沒別的辦法。
I suppose your more ruthless nature is a good thing, in this case. We each will need to fight, if this is as widespread as it feels.
這種時候，你那份比較狠得下心的性子，我想反倒是好事。若這事真如我感覺到的那樣蔓延，我們兩個都得動手。
I'll have to prepare myself for that... Being willing to take action will not make it any easier on my conscience.
我得先讓自己有心理準備……願意動手，並不會讓我良心上好過一點。
But I will set that aside, until the day this all becomes a memory. We'll both need to seek the Nexus of Light, Orphion's home. Follow me!
但我會把那些先擱在一旁，直到這一切成為回憶的那一天。我們兩個都得去找光之樞紐，Orphion 的居所。跟我來！
Follow Lari to Orphion's Nexus of Light at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
跟著 Lari 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Orphion 光之樞紐。
I should have expected this. With the connections severed, of course the bridge to the Nexus would be gone.
我早該料到的。連結既然斷了，通往樞紐的橋當然也就沒了。
This must be because of that horrid parasite... The Guardian of the Forest informed me of the situation afterwards.
這一定是那個可憎的寄生體害的……森林守護者事後把情況告訴了我。
The gap may be too far for me to carry you over... Is there a way I can bypass this, I wonder?
這道缺口大概太遠，我沒辦法把你帶過去……不知道有沒有辦法繞過它？
Perhaps I can try to bridge the gap myself. Let's see if this will work.
或許我可以試著自己把缺口接起來。看看行不行得通。
...hm. That ought to have worked! Is the Nexus too far to reach?
……嗯。這本來應該有效的！難道樞紐遠到搆不著？
There has to be some way over... Maybe the direct method is- Hm? Another creature?
一定有辦法過去……也許直接一點的方法是——嗯？又一隻生物？
This one doesn't seem hostile, {u}... I'll try and talk with it.
這一隻看起來沒有敵意，{u}……我試著跟他溝通看看。
Its mind is whole, but it's wary of your presence. You should stay back, just in case.
他的心智是完整的，但他對你的存在很戒備。你先退開一點，以防萬一。
So tell me, achara. What is it you sought me for?
那麼告訴我，achara。你來找我，是為了什麼？
Ahh, I see. You wish to see your master once more as well...
啊，我明白了。你也希望能再見你的主人一面……
The monoliths? Are they what's severed the connections?
那些巨石碑？切斷連結的就是它們嗎？
Ahh, I understand. I assure you, we will fix this!
啊，我懂了。我向你保證，我們會把它修好！
It said that the connections to the rest of the realm were severed intentionally by Orphion, in order to protect them.
他說，通往領域其他部分的連結，是 Orphion 刻意切斷的，為的是保護它們。
Two monoliths on this landmass controlled the connections, and they are being drained of their light- As such, they closed the bridges.
這塊陸地上有兩座巨石碑控制著那些連結，而它們的光正被抽走——所以它們把橋關上了。
The light is still there- But it must be drawn back out. We have our task ahead of us now, achara. We need to go to the first monolith. Follow me!
光還在裡面——只是必須把它引回來。我們眼前的任務有了，achara。我們得去第一座巨石碑。跟我來！
Search for the monolith Lari was talking about at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 尋找 Lari 說的那座巨石碑。
Search for the monolith of light Lari was talking about at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 尋找 Lari 說的那座光之石碑。
I never knew the monoliths kept the realm together as they did. You can see that it is inactive, yes?
我從來不知道巨石碑是這樣把整個領域維繫在一起的。你也看得出來它是停擺的，對吧？
There should be bright bands of color going along it, and light pouring from it. This is where we play our roles, {u}!
它上面本該有一道道明亮的色帶，還有光傾瀉出來。就是這裡，該我們上場了，{u}！
It may be getting drained, but there is certainly still light within it, and if that parasite is battling Orphion we should be able to recharge it.
它的光是正在被抽走沒錯，但裡面肯定還有光。而如果那個寄生體正在跟 Orphion 纏鬥，我們應該有辦法把它重新充滿。
I'll tap into the monolith... You'll need to enter it, and find its core. I'll send a part of Orphion's light with you to activate it once you do.
我來與巨石碑相連……你得進到它裡面去，找到它的核心。你找到之後，我會把一部分 Orphion 的光隨你送進去，用來啟動它。
The damage here is minor- Nothing that can't be fixed, thankfully.
這裡的損傷不算嚴重——謝天謝地，沒有修不好的。
Its aura is lowered- Now your soul must enter. I will keep you safe, {u}.
它的氣息降下來了——現在該你的靈魂進去了。我會護你周全，{u}。
Allow my magic to open your senses... Good luck, achara.
讓我的魔法為你打開感官……祝你順利，achara。
Find a way to fill the monolith with light.
想辦法讓巨石碑重新充滿光。
Follow Lari to the next monolith at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
跟著 Lari 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的下一座巨石碑。
Welcome back, {u}. I had few troubles dealing with the creatures trying to get close. Did you have issues inside?
歡迎回來，{u}。想靠近的那些生物我應付得還算輕鬆。你在裡面有遇到麻煩嗎？
The light is starting to pulse out from the monolith again, so I would say you've succeeded. I suppose we do make a decent team?
光已經開始重新從巨石碑脈動出來了，所以我想你是成功了。看來我們算是不錯的搭檔？
Look! The colours are returning to the monolith! It's definitely reactivated. I'll run ahead and get to the other monolith.
你看！顏色回到巨石碑上了！它確實重新啟動了。我先跑一步，去另一座巨石碑那邊。
Follow the path! The way there is up the big cliff where we first entered the Realm.
順著路走！要上去的地方，就是我們最初進入這個領域的那道大崖壁。
I'm unsure if you can feel the light returning from the monolith, but I can. I almost feel reborn, with all this energy!
我不確定你感不感覺得到光正從巨石碑回流，但我感覺得到。這股能量幾乎讓我覺得自己重生了！
The rift ahead ought to take us to the second monolith, but it doesn't seem to be working, and I'm unsure why.
前面那道裂隙本該把我們送到第二座巨石碑，可它好像沒有作用，我也不曉得為什麼。
See? It's inert, which is... Odd. These aren't connected to the energy of the monolith.
看到沒？它是死的，這……很奇怪。這些東西並沒有連著巨石碑的能量。
It shouldn't be inactive as it is. There's some dark influence around here, but I can't seem to place it.
它不該像這樣停擺。這附近有某種黑暗的影響，可我就是抓不出它在哪。
My only guess is that it's interfering with the rift's energy. I've already scoured the hill though- No dark patches to be seen.
我唯一的猜測是，那東西干擾了裂隙的能量。可是這座山丘我已經搜遍了——一塊黑暗的痕跡都沒有。
Do you think you could take a second look-
你能不能再幫我看一遍——
...maybe you won't need to, after all. That was...
……說不定你不用看了。剛才那是……
We've found the disturbance... Even beyond this, I'll need to charge the rift with energy to activate it.
我們找到擾動的來源了……就算解決了這個，我還得把能量灌進裂隙才能啟動它。
Go in peace, tortured ones! Be at one with the light!
安息吧，受折磨的生靈！與光同歸為一！
Get the rest of them, {u}! I'll charge the rift!
剩下的交給你了，{u}！我來給裂隙充能！
Defeat the darkened creatures and progress to the monolith.
擊敗被黑暗侵蝕的生物，前進到巨石碑。
Thank you, achara. The rift is charged again- Just walk into it!
謝謝你，achara。裂隙重新充能好了——直接走進去就行！
The process here should be roughly the same. I bring down the barrier, you enter and charge it with the light I provide.
這裡的程序應該大同小異。我把屏障降下來，你進去，用我提供的光把它充滿。
I'll need to focus the energies of the monoliths to reconnect the Nexus of Light to the mainland here, so you'll be alone.
我得集中兩座巨石碑的能量，才能把光之樞紐重新接回這邊的主陸，所以這次你得自己來。
I'll leave a barrier around you. Few creatures live on these cliffs, but best to be certain, of course.
我會在你周圍留一道屏障。這些崖壁上沒什麼生物，不過當然還是保險一點好。
Once you're done, meet me at the cliff near the Nexus. If we're to free Orphion from the parasite, having you along would be a great help.
你弄好之後，到樞紐附近的崖邊來找我。如果我們要把 Orphion 從那個寄生體手裡救出來，有你同行會是很大的幫助。
Good luck, achara. I will see you soon.
祝你順利，achara。我們很快就會再見。
There. The connection to the Nexus is established, and so we'll cross.
好了。通往樞紐的連結建立起來了，我們過橋吧。
Wait! Something... Something's not quite right...
等等！有什麼……有什麼不太對勁……
有東西正從那道門裡出來！
Interfere?! You're one of the dark!
干涉？！你根本就是黑暗的一員！
You're the one trespassing in realms not your own!
擅闖不屬於你的領域的人是你！
Continue up the road towards Orphion's Nexus of Light.
沿著路繼續往 Orphion 的光之樞紐前進。
{u}!! Stay back! I'm keeping up but he'll destroy you if you get close!!
{u}！！退後！我還撐得住，但你一靠近他就會把你毀了！！
AGH, ENOUGH OF THIS! You aren't allowed here, foul thing!
啊，夠了！這裡不准你來，骯髒的東西！
No! You won't run- I'll kill you before that!
不行！你別想逃——我會在那之前殺了你！
New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light
新任務開始: 光之領域 V - 光之領域
Or something that another person wants you to see?
還是別人希望你看見的東西？
You. Elf girl. You are to be eliminated.
你。精靈女孩。你該被抹除。
Fool. The Beast quakes with our influence. This land is ours.
蠢貨。那頭巨獸正因我們的影響而顫抖。這片土地是我們的。
I will not waste my time with that specimen. Now. Face death.
我不會把時間浪費在那個樣本上。那麼——受死吧。
You shall not. Surely your god will smile seeing me leave.
你辦不到。看我離開，你的神想必會很欣慰。
YOU DON'T GET TO TALK ABOUT ORPHION LIKE THAT!
你沒有資格那樣講 ORPHION！
We have already won. Your peon is outmatched.
我們已經贏了。你的走卒不是對手。
It's not over... IT CAN'T BE, DON'T YOU- TAKE THIS!
還沒結束……不可能結束，你休想——接招！
There's a faint buzzing in your ears...
你的耳邊傳來微弱的嗡鳴……
I have a slight idea of where I'm headed, but... If I'm able to handle him, then maybe I'm powerful enough for this.
我大概知道自己要去哪裡，不過……如果我連他都應付得了，也許我就夠強，撐得住這一趟。
I've never been one to say goodbyes, but thank you for everything. I know you'll find people just as strong as you are to rescue Orphion in my place.
我向來不擅長道別，但還是謝謝你的一切。我知道你會找到跟你一樣強的人，代替我去救 Orphion。
I- I see the end of this... Tunnel. There's- Wait...
我、我看見這條……隧道的盡頭了。那裡有——等等……
{u}... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
{u}……Achara……我不認為我這輩子能補償我對你做的事。一句道歉根本不夠。
You need to defeat the mob before you can progress!
你必須先擊敗怪物才能繼續前進！
If you were to look into a mirror... what would you see?
如果你往鏡子裡看……你會看見什麼？
Though... I feel something on the other side. It seems incredibly... Foul. I can't tell what it is, let's be careful.
不過……我感覺到另一邊有東西。那感覺極其……污穢。我看不出那是什麼，我們小心點。
{u}. I think. I found someone. Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?
{u}。我想。我找到了一個人。一個該被殺掉的人。幫我一把？
{u}... I apologize for leaving you like that. I felt like this was my only chance at defeating this plague - by attacking its core.
{u}……很抱歉那樣把你丟下。我覺得這是我擊敗這場瘟疫唯一的機會——直搗它的核心。
By the light what is that thing?! S-Stay away f-
以光之名，那是什麼東西？！離、離遠一點——
by the light, i summon thee, aether's judgement! aid me!
以光之名，我召喚汝，以太的審判！助我！
Talk to Maripe at Pishlas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Pishlas 與 Maripe 交談。
Oh! Well, hello there, tourist! I have to assume you're a tourist, anyways. That doesn't look like local dress. I suppose you've heard about the hot springs!
喔！你好啊，觀光客！總之我猜你是觀光客啦。那身打扮怎麼看都不是本地的。我想你是聽說了溫泉的事吧！
Well, ah...unfortunately, Pishlas is closed for renovations. You see, it's been closed for a long time... My family has run it for generations, but trouble started.
嗯，啊……很遺憾，Pishlas 正在整修，沒有營業。是這樣的，它已經關了很久了……我們家經營了好幾代，但後來出了些事。
With my mother having been stricken ill for so long, my father and all our family, we've had to abandon this place to care for her. It's fallen into disrepair.
我母親病了很長一段時間，我父親還有全家人，只好放下這個地方去照顧她。它就這樣荒廢了。
She's well enough now that she doesn't need someone looking after her every hour, so I'm taking it on myself to return this place to its former glory!
她現在好多了，不需要有人時時刻刻在旁邊，所以我打算靠自己把這裡恢復成當年的樣子！
It's been hard work...and it should be opening soon- but I'm not quite done. Again, I'm so sorry you came all this way for nothing.
這工程很辛苦……應該快能開了——但我還沒完全弄好。真的很抱歉，讓你白跑這一趟。
I- excuse me? You want to...
That'd... That'd be absolutely fantastic!! I've been working alone on this for months now!! I'm NEARLY done, but-
那……那真是太好了！！我一個人做這件事已經好幾個月了！！我快、快好了，只是——
Come on, come on! I'll show you around! Let's go, let's go!!
來、來！我帶你到處看看！走吧，走吧！！
Hopefully you'll be able to visit before you have to go home, then!
希望你回家之前還來得及來泡一次！
Okay, okay, what's next on the list... C'mon, think like Sovereign Zhiraok!
好，好，清單上下一件是什麼……來，像 Zhiraok 統領那樣思考！
Let Maripe show you around at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
讓 Maripe 帶你在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 四處看看。
Okay, so! These are the main pools- Frankly, I have no idea how all these frogs got here, given the bog is clear across the whole forest...
好，那麼！這幾池是主池——老實說我完全不知道這些青蛙是怎麼跑來的，沼澤明明在森林的另一頭……
But they've got to go. Sure, they're cute, but no one's going to want to take a soak with them... Or with all these fallen leaves in the pools.
但他們得走。他們是很可愛沒錯，可是沒有人會想跟他們一起泡……池子裡這些落葉也一樣。
The side pool over here is just as important to clean out. Need to have clear pools for the guests! And maybe even for the Sovereign!
這邊的側池同樣要清乾淨。招待客人的池水一定要清澈！說不定連統領都會來呢！
I've already put a lot of time into fixing up these huts. I do carpentry work. These used to be in so much worse shape... I'm a little glad my grandparents didn't end up seeing it like this.
這幾間小屋我已經花了很多時間修。我做木工的。它們以前的狀況比現在糟太多了……我有點慶幸我的祖父母沒有看到那副樣子。
I have such fond memories of playing around here when I was younger... What would they think, seeing it fall apart? That thought has been giving me motivation this whole time.
我小時候在這一帶玩的回憶都很美好……要是看到它這樣崩壞，他們會怎麼想？這個念頭一直是我的動力。
It'd be a disgrace to let Pishlas fall completely apart. Even Sovereign Zhiraok agreed! Did you know he dropped by, when I was first starting- Oh, wait! There's one other place!

無論如何，這是了不起的成果。而且我採收的時候再也不用擔心噁心的蟑螂爬滿全身了！這一點也要謝謝你。

Oh, you look tough. You must be one of those humans I keep hearing about, right? People talk about your kind all the time.
喔，你看起來挺能打的。你一定就是我常聽人說的那種人類吧？大家老是在談你們這種人。
You know, that you're all scrappers. Tough as nails, and willing to kill all sorts of beasts, you know?
就是說，你們全都是打架的好手。個個強悍得很，什麼野獸都敢殺，對吧？
I think you know what I'm getting at. I saw some massive thing lumbering around the swamp one night! Tall as the trees, it was.
我想你知道我要說什麼了。有天晚上我看到一個巨大的東西在沼澤裡笨重地走來走去！有樹那麼高。
I couldn't make out the details, but if its size was any indication, it could just step over the {p} walls and wreck the whole town!
細節我看不清楚，但光看那個體型，他一腳就能跨過 {p} 的城牆，把整座鎮子毀掉！
Of course, there's so many scam artists around here trying to sell anti-monster underwear or whatever that no one believes me.
當然啦，這一帶到處都是想賣什麼防怪內衣褲的騙子，所以根本沒人信我。
So, that means it's up to you! Ehm, supposing that you're willing to help out, at least... The one thing I know for sure is that it was eating something.
所以，這就得靠你了！呃，前提是你願意幫忙啦……我唯一能確定的是，他當時正在吃東西。
Follow the trail of blood left by the beast.
跟著野獸留下的血跡走。
Oh, this is such a mess! And my axe is busted, too...how am I going to get this fixed?!
喔，這下一團亂！而且我的斧頭也壞了……我到底要怎麼修好這些啊？！
I can't pay for- AAAH! H-Human! What do you want?! Not a good time!
我付不起——啊啊啊！人、人類！你想幹嘛？！現在不是時候！
Something destroyed my cow pen and wrecked up my entire farm!
有東西毀了我的牛欄，把我整座農場都砸爛了！
And they were solid, good-quality Willow, too...uff...
而且那些還是紮實的高級 Willow 木……唉……
Wait, what? You're hunting the thing? Well, that's fine and dandy, but do you think you could help here first?
等等，什麼？你在獵那東西？欸，那很好啊，可是你能不能先幫我這邊一下？
I have an idea of where it went, so...you scratch my back, I scratch yours?
我大概知道他往哪走了，所以……你幫我一把，我幫你一把？
Okay, this can work, this can work! I have to figure out how to fix this, and some of my cows ran off in a panic.
好，這行得通，這行得通！我得想辦法修好這些，而且我有幾頭牛驚慌跑掉了。
So, you can take care of them while I re-plan my fencing. Simple enough, right?
所以，我重新規劃圍欄的時候你去處理他們。夠簡單了吧？
Three of my cows ran off. Look around the farm for them. They were eating, so look for fallen wheat on the ground!
我有三頭牛跑掉了。在農場附近找找。他們當時在吃東西，所以注意地上掉落的小麥！
Go on, hop to it! I'm waiting for you right here!
去吧，動作快！我就在這裡等你！
Deal with the three escaped cows near the house and in the cave under the farm.
處理房子附近以及農場底下洞穴裡那三頭逃走的牛。
Oh, back aleady? I haven't even finished my stuff, where are the cows?
喔，這麼快就回來了？我的東西都還沒弄完呢，牛咧？
...eheh. You. You're. This is a joke, right? We're having a chuckle?!
……呃呵。你。你這是。這是開玩笑的吧？我們在說笑對吧？！
WE'RE JOKING, RIGHT?! FOR THE LOVE OF ALL THAT'S HOLY TELL ME THIS IS A JOKE!
我們是在開玩笑對吧？！看在老天爺的份上，告訴我這是玩笑！
WHAT IS THIS?! ARE YOU BRAINDEAD?!
這是什麼東西？！你腦子壞了嗎？！
NO, WAIT, YOU'RE HUMAN, THAT'S THE PROBLEM! IDIOT THUGS, ALL OF YOU!
不對，等等，你是人類，問題就出在這！你們全都是一群白痴暴徒！
DID I NEED TO SPECIFY THAT I WANTED THEM BACK ALIVE? WAS THAT NOT OBVIOUS TO YOU?!
我還得特別交代要「活的」帶回來嗎？這對你來說不是很明顯嗎？！
Hff...haah...hrrgh...I...I can't bellevue...bellevue? Believe! I can't believe this!
呼……哈……嗚……我……我沒辦法接手……接手？接受！我沒辦法接受！
Uff, settle down, Tolem, settle down...you can still salvage this...
唉，冷靜點，Tolem，冷靜點……這還有得救……
Alright, two things. Your new name is Idiot, and I'm changing our deal. You owe me [{~} Willow Planks].
好，兩件事。你的新名字叫笨蛋，還有我要改一下我們的交易。你欠我 [{~} Willow Planks]。
You're going to help me get at least one thing around here working. You get the wood, I'll keep looking over the fencing.
你要幫我把這裡至少一樣東西弄好。你去弄木頭，我繼續看圍欄怎麼辦。
替 Tolem 蒐集 [{~} Willow Planks]。
Oh lovely. Idiot's back! Joy of joys. Willow planks, please.
喔真棒。笨蛋回來了！真是可喜可賀。Willow 木板，麻煩。
Good. Even if you've got murder on the mind constantly, you have decent woodcutting arms.
很好。就算你腦子裡整天只想著殺人，砍樹的臂力倒是挺不錯的。
I'll sell the remainder of these planks to try and recoup the money for my cows you mulched.
剩下的木板我會賣掉，設法把你絞成肉泥的那幾頭牛的錢補回來。
So go on, get out of here now. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
好了，快走吧。做點有用的事，跟著地上那些巨大的腳印走。去獵那些「該被獵」的東西，別再拿牛開刀了！
Go on, get out of here. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
走吧，快離開這裡。做點有用的事，跟著地上那些巨大的腳印走。去獵那些「該被獵」的東西，別再拿牛開刀了！
Follow the footprints from Tolem's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
從 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] Tolem 的房子開始跟著腳印走。
Oh, I'll never be able to fix this with my back in this state...
唉，我這腰成這樣，永遠都修不好這個了……
Oh, look at this...all my years of carpentry and my bad back does my poor house in.
唉，你看看這個……我做了一輩子木工，結果一個腰傷就把自己的房子給毀了。
What on earth could have done this?! It must be the biggest beast in the swamp!
到底是什麼東西能幹出這種事？！那一定是沼澤裡最大的野獸！
I was just sitting inside having some dinner, I hear some rumbling, and suddenly my house is falling apart!
我當時就坐在屋裡吃晚餐，聽到一陣隆隆聲，然後我的房子突然就散了！
You human folk are good with physical labor, I hear? Do you think you could help me out here?
我聽說你們人類很擅長出力氣？你覺得你能幫我一下嗎？
There's a mine just over there. Think you can get [{~} Cobblestone] out of it?
那邊過去有座礦坑。你有辦法從裡面弄到 [{~} Cobblestone] 嗎？
I'll go find someone who's selling any spare wood for the roof...
我去找找看有沒有人賣多餘的木料來做屋頂……
Think you could help fix my house? You'll need [{~} Cobblestone] to do it.
你能幫我修房子嗎？你會需要 [{~} Cobblestone] 才辦得到。
Enter Kroac's mine and gather [{~} Cobblestone].
進入 Kroac 的礦坑，蒐集 [{~} Cobblestone]。
Did you get enough cobblestone? I found a guy down the street selling this top-quality Willow...
圓石弄夠了嗎？我在街尾找到一個人在賣這種頂級的 Willow 木……
Good, perfect. That should be enough. Though, I do have one other thing to ask you, soldier.
很好，太好了。這應該夠了。不過大兵，我還有一件事想拜託你。
My back's already screaming at me just from lugging the wood over here, there's no way I can climb up there and fix the roof like this.
光是把這些木頭搬過來，我的腰就已經在慘叫了，這樣我根本不可能爬上去修屋頂。
I can compensate you for the trouble, but d'you think you could do some patchwork for me with that cobble?
我可以補償你的辛勞，不過你能不能用那些圓石幫我補一補？
Oh, you're a saint. Can't imagine why the guy was grumbling about humans... Just climb right on up the ladder!
喔，你真是個好人。真不懂那傢伙幹嘛老在抱怨人類……順著梯子爬上去就是了！
Repair Kroac's house using the cobblestone from the mine.
用礦坑裡的圓石修好 Kroac 的房子。
I'm sorry, but your patchjob fell apart. You'll need something like {~} cobblestone to help fix this.
抱歉，你補的地方塌了。你會需要大約 {~} 個圓石才修得好。
That'll do just fine, kind soldier! You're a lifesaver, really, you are.
這樣就非常好了，好心的大兵！你真是救了我一命，真的。
Wait, you're going after the thing that did this? Really?! Fantastic! That's a load off my mind.
等等，你要去追那個把這裡弄成這樣的東西？真的？！太好了！這下我心裡的大石頭放下了。
Keep following the tracks of the beast.
繼續跟著野獸的足跡走。
EVERYONE, MOVE! THE BEAST IS ON A RAMPAGE!
所有人，快跑！那頭野獸在暴走！
Aah, no! There were people in that house!
啊，不好！那間房子裡還有人！
Wah! H-Human! Get away, there's nothing you can help with here!
哇！人、人類！走開，這裡沒有你能幫上忙的地方！
All your type does is break and hurt! You have more in common with the giant there than any of us!
你們這種人只會破壞跟傷害！你跟那邊那隻巨獸的共通點還比跟我們多！
We don't even have any medicine...
Oh, right! Fish oil...but I don't have a rod, gah!
喔，對了！魚油……可是我沒有釣竿，啊啊！
There's no way I can get [{~} Salmon Oil], even if that pond out back is teeming with fish...
就算後面那個池塘裡魚多得是，我也不可能弄得到 [{~} Salmon Oil]……
替 Rileen 蒐集 [{~} Salmon Oil]。
No, there's no time to make a fishing spear- AAH! You're still here? What do you WANT?!
不行，沒時間做魚叉了——啊啊！你還在？你到底想要什麼？！
W-wait, what's...is this... This is salmon oil! Ten bottles of it! You...you heard me talking?
等、等等，這是……這該不會……這是鮭魚油！整整十瓶！你……你剛才聽見我說的話？
And you went out of your way to... What kind of a human are you? I've only ever heard horror stories about your kind.
而且你還特地跑去……你到底是什麼樣的人類？我聽過關於你們的，全都是些恐怖的故事。
...maybe you're not so bad. I don't have anything that I can give you in return, but thank you, still.
……也許你沒那麼糟。我沒有什麼能回報你的，但還是謝謝你。
Wait, you were chasing the giant? That's why you were here? That...that's amazing news!
等等，你在追那頭巨獸？你就是為了這個才來的？那……那真是天大的好消息！
Find the cave of the beast by following the footprints behind Rileen's house.
跟著 Rileen 屋後的腳印，找到野獸的洞穴。
Kill the beast and return to Dereg with proof of its death at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
殺死野獸，帶著他的死亡證明回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找 Dereg。
You're back! Any luck hunting the thing down?
你回來了！那東西獵得順利嗎？
What? You actually found the beast?! Heck of a hunting job, human!
什麼？你真的找到那頭野獸了？！人類，這一手獵得漂亮！
You wouldn't be back here if you didn't manage to kill it...which means our problems are solved, right?
要是沒殺掉他，你也不會回來這裡……也就是說我們的問題解決了，對吧？
Heheh! That bone powder looks giant enough to me! Great job, bucko!
嘿嘿！那堆骨粉在我看來夠巨大了！幹得好，老兄！
Y'know, come to think of it, I remember something that might be interesting to your sort.
欸，這麼一說我倒想起一件事，可能會讓你這種人有興趣。
The weapon merchant in {p} researches cryptids as a hobby, and that beast seemed one-of-a-kind to me.
{p} 那個武器商人把研究未知生物當興趣，而那頭野獸在我看來獨一無二。
You should show him that bone powder! He might have some good gear for you.
你應該把那堆骨粉拿給他看！他說不定會有什麼好裝備給你。
I am disappointed in you Perin.
When I meet new recruits, I expect them to look at least somewhat in shape!
我見新兵的時候，至少期待他們看起來有點體格！
Yet here we are... Have you even done any training since we sent you the letter?
結果呢……自從我們把信寄給你之後，你到底有沒有練過？
I have been training! I swear!
Oh really, has a mentor been preparing you? Surely your family could afford one.
噢是嗎，有導師在替你做準備？你家想必請得起一位吧。
Mentor? Y-yeah, of course I have one!
導師？對、對啊，我當然有一位！
They're right there! We were just about to start my training for the day actually.
他就在那裡！我們其實正要開始今天的訓練呢。
So you're Perin's mentor huh? There's no other way to say this, but you must be terrible at your job...
所以你就是 Perin 的導師？恕我直言，你這份工作想必做得很糟……
You certainly look fit to be a soldier though. Perhaps training isn't your strong suit.
不過你看起來倒是很適合當兵。也許教人不是你的強項。
So how about I take you to join the Fruman military instead of Perin?
那不如這樣，我把你帶去加入 Fruma 軍隊，別帶 Perin 了，如何？
That sounds great! Meet us near the south {p} entrance, then we will take you to {p}.
太好了！到 {p} 南邊入口附近跟我們會合，我們再帶你去 {p}。
Oh, and don't keep us waiting. Or it might end up on your record.
噢，還有，別讓我們等。不然可能會記在你的檔案上。
I hope you enjoy MY spot at Tericen!
希望你在 Tericen 享受「我的」位置！
Meet the recruiter near the south entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} 南邊入口附近與招募官會合。
There you are! Didn't I tell you not to keep us waiting?
你來啦！我不是叫你別讓我們等嗎？
Get into the carriage, we'll take you to {p}.
You don't want to miss the opening speech from the famed Sovereign Majin!
你不會想錯過大名鼎鼎的 Majin 統領的開場演說吧！
Watch out for the horses, they can be a bit nippy.
小心那些馬，他們有時候會咬人。
Head into the carriage and then we'll go to {p}.
The carriage is ready to go, we're just waiting on you.
馬車準備好了，就等你而已。
Don't keep us waiting, get into the carriage.
You shouldn't worry about Perin anymore. Trust me, I am doing him a favour by taking you instead.
你不必再替 Perin 操心了。相信我，帶你代替他，是幫了他一個忙。
Although, he will surely be shamed by his community for not becoming a soldier, but frankly, he deserves it.
雖然，他肯定會因為沒當成士兵而被鄉里恥笑，不過老實說，他活該。
You must be very excited to become a recruit, I can see it on your face!
你一定很興奮能成為新兵吧，我從你臉上看得出來！
But let me warn you, the process is not all sunshine and rainbows.
不過我得先提醒你，這個過程可不是一路陽光燦爛。
The training is grueling and competitive, every single facet of your physical ability will be tested!
訓練既艱苦又競爭激烈，你身體能力的每一個面向都會被測試！
Think you're up for it? Well, I think you could manage. You'd certainly do better than Perin!
覺得自己撐得住嗎？嗯，我認為你應付得來。至少一定比 Perin 強！
{p} is run by the esteemed Commander Ferreo. When you meet him, it's very important that you show him his due respect.
{p} 由備受敬重的 Ferreo 指揮官掌管。你見到他的時候，一定要拿出應有的敬意。
The Commander's been serving since as long as I can remember. He's probably the most accomplished man in the {p}, aside from Sovereign Majin of course!
指揮官從我有記憶以來就一直在服役。他大概是全 {p} 成就最高的人了——當然，Majin 統領除外！
Ah, I hope you're ready, we should be arriving soon.
啊，希望你準備好了，我們應該快到了。
We're here, just head on in and I'll meet you up ahead inside!
我們到了，你直接進去吧，我在裡面前面等你！
I don't mind, but did we really need to take the carriage?
我是沒差啦，不過我們真的有必要坐馬車嗎？
Thank the Queen, I won't have to follow this idiot around anymore, now that the recruiting process is done.
感謝女王，招募流程結束了，我終於不用再跟著這個蠢貨到處跑。
Return to the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Talk to the Uniform Tailor, then go see Commander Ferreo.
去找制服裁縫，然後去見 Ferreo 指揮官。
This is where you will be staying until you become a soldier.
在你成為士兵之前，都會待在這裡。
Please see the tailor across from me to get your uniform, then see Commander Ferreo in the next room.
請到我對面找裁縫領你的制服，然後到隔壁房間見 Ferreo 指揮官。
I can't let you enter until you get your uniform, speak with the tailor.
你沒領到制服我不能放你進去，去跟裁縫談。
Are you also here as a recruit?
I'm Arnol, it seems like we've made it just in time!
我叫 Arnol，看來我們趕上了！
I'll let you get your uniform. We should talk after the speech.
我讓你去領制服吧。演說結束後我們再聊。
Welcome to {p}! Congratulations on getting accepted to become a soldier!
歡迎來到 {p}！恭喜你獲選成為士兵！
You must be from the {p}. The rest of the recruits have already gotten their uniforms.
你一定是從 {p} 來的。其他新兵都已經領過制服了。
Your uniform colour will be yellow.
What is your name? I need to write it on your uniform.
你叫什麼名字？我得寫在你的制服上。
Very funny... Now tell me what your real name is.
真好笑……現在告訴我你的真名。
Alright, this will only take a second or two.
All done, here is your uniform recruit!
好了，新兵，你的制服在這裡！
Now go see Commander Ferreo, he is waiting for you in the next room.
現在去見 Ferreo 指揮官，他在隔壁房間等你。
Go see Commander Ferreo, he's in the next room.
去見 Ferreo 指揮官，他在隔壁房間。
I see you've been given your uniform. It looks good on you!
我看你已經領到制服了。很適合你！
Commander Ferreo is waiting for you in the next room.
Ferreo 指揮官在隔壁房間等你。
Once you are done speaking with him, you'll be hearing a speech from Sovereign Majin in the stage room!
跟他談完之後，你會在講台廳聽 Majin 統領的演說！
Recruits are separated by their divisions, their uniform colours reflect this.
新兵依部隊分開，制服顏色就代表這個。
Those with red uniforms are from Auburn, cyan uniforms are from the Industrial district, white uniforms are in the Wings division...
穿紅色制服的是 Auburn 來的，青色是工業區的，白色是羽翼部隊的……
Green uniforms are in the {p} division, they are recruits selected from other regions based on a test that decides if they are suited for the dangerous conditions in the {p}...
綠色制服是 {p} 部隊的，他們是從各地區挑出來的新兵，通過一項測驗，判定他們適合 {p} 那種危險的環境……
Since you are in the {p} division, your group leader is Recruiter Effal.
既然你是 {p} 部隊的，你的小隊長是 Effal 招募官。
{p} is the largest and most prestigious military training camp in Fruma, headed by the equally prestigious Commander Ferreo.
{p} 是 Fruma 最大、最負盛名的軍事訓練營，由同樣負盛名的 Ferreo 指揮官領導。
Many of the most famous soldiers of Fruma have originated from here, you should be proud to be a part of our program!
Fruma 許多最有名的士兵都是從這裡出去的，能加入我們的計畫，你該感到驕傲！
Most recruits already know this before coming to {p}... I suppose there is no shame in asking if you don't know.
大部分新兵來 {p} 之前就已經知道這些了……不過不知道就問，也沒什麼好丟臉的。
The Fruman military is composed of nine divisions, being seven regional divisions, the Constable division, and the Wings division.
Fruma 軍隊由九支部隊組成: 七支地區部隊、警備部隊，以及羽翼部隊。

Yes, you heard that right, seven regional divisions not six. The seventh being the Xima division which recruits soldiers directly from the Auburn division, which is why most people lump them together.
沒錯，你沒聽錯，是七支地區部隊不是六支。第七支是 Xima 部隊，它直接從 Auburn 部隊裡吸收士兵，所以大多數人會把兩者混為一談。

The Constable division has an authority level higher than all the regional divisions, and the Wings division has authority over both of them. Be careful not to step on their toes when you become a soldier!
警備部隊的權限高於所有地區部隊，而羽翼部隊的權限又高於這兩者。等你當上士兵，小心別踩到他們的線！

Within each division is a ranking system used to separate leadership roles. In ascending order of authority; there are soldiers, captains, commanders, and finally a single general that manages the commanders.
每支部隊內部都有一套階級制度來區分領導職位。權限由低到高是: 士兵、隊長、指揮官，最後是統管所有指揮官的一位將軍。
The Wings division has some additional positions within it, like the Gendarmes. They're a group of Wings soldiers that only operate within Aelumia.
羽翼部隊裡還有一些額外的職位，例如憲兵。他們是一群只在 Aelumia 境內行動的羽翼士兵。
Don't worry, this question is more common than you'd think.
別擔心，這個問題問的人比你想的還多。
In about a month, if everything goes to plan, you and the rest of the recruits will attend a ceremony and officially become Fruman soldiers!
大約一個月後，如果一切順利，你和其他新兵會參加典禮，正式成為 Fruma 士兵！
From there, you'll work in a group with other {p} soldiers. If you are able to impress your superiors, you can be promoted to captain or even commander!
從那之後，你會和其他 {p} 士兵編成一組。如果你能讓上級刮目相看，就可能升為隊長，甚至指揮官！
Another thing that can happen if you demonstrate exception abilities is promotion to the Constable division or maybe even the Wings division!
另外，如果你展現出過人的能力，也可能被調升到警備部隊，甚至羽翼部隊！
There truly is fame and glory waiting ahead of you. If you are able to prove yourself.
前方確實有名聲與榮耀在等著你。只要你證明得了自己。
Alright, good luck on your training!
Speak with the secretary if you're lost.
You may not enter yet, talk to the commander and then enter the stage room across from us.
你還不能進去，先去找指揮官談，然後進我們對面的講台廳。
You may not enter yet, talk to Commander Ferreo.
你還不能進去，去找 Ferreo 指揮官談。
I can't let you enter until you talk to Commander Ferreo.
你沒跟 Ferreo 指揮官談過，我不能放你進去。
You have you brought me Effal, this is not Perin.
Effal，你帶來的這位，不是 Perin。
You will have to excuse me Commander, but I did not deem Perin as fit to be a recruit.
請指揮官見諒，我認為 Perin 不適合當新兵。
The boy had done no training, he would not have lasted a day here!
那孩子根本沒受過訓練，他在這裡連一天都撐不過！
I told him this myself, and while I was reprimanding him... Erm...
這話我親口跟他說了，而我在訓斥他的時候……呃……
... Had overheard our conversation and begged that I take them instead.
……聽見了我們的對話，並且懇求我改帶他們。
Seeing that they looked more suitable than Perin, and hearing their reasoning as to why they should be a recruit, I decided to adhere to their request.
我看他們比 Perin 合適，也聽了他們自認該當新兵的理由，於是決定答應他們的請求。
So you deliberately acted against the directions given to you?
所以你是刻意違背給你的指示？
Well... Yes... I-I truly apologize for violating the orders given to me...
這個……是的……我、我為違反命令一事真心道歉……
Do not go against what you are told to do again.
以後不要再違背交代給你的事。
Nevertheless, if what you say about Perin is true, perhaps it is for the best that he does not become a recruit.
不過，如果你所說的 Perin 屬實，那他當不成新兵，或許反而是好事。
Welcome to {p}, recruit. Enter the room to the right so that we may begin the opening speech.
歡迎來到 {p}，新兵。請進右邊那個房間，我們好開始開場演說。
Thank you Commander! Now, let me lead you to the stage!
謝謝指揮官！那麼，我帶你去講台！
Listen to the speech from Sovereign Majin.
聆聽 Majin 統領的演說。
Shouldn't you be listening to a speech right now?
你這時候不是該去聽演說嗎？
You may not enter yet, enter the stage room across from us.
你還不能進去，請進我們對面的講台廳。
You may only enter after Sovereign Majin's speech.
要等 Majin 統領的演說結束你才能進去。
There's no time for chit-chat, the speech is about to start!
沒時間閒聊，演說要開始了！
Welcome recruits, to the start of your training in becoming a Fruman soldier.
歡迎各位新兵，你們成為 Fruma 士兵的訓練，從今天開始。
You have all been carefully chosen by a group of experienced recruiters.
你們全都是由一群經驗豐富的招募官仔細挑選出來的。
They have closely reviewed your performances in physical tests of strength and agility since you were children, and have decided that you belong here.
從你們還是孩子的時候起，他們就密切檢視你們在力量與敏捷測驗中的表現，並認定你們屬於這裡。
Do not prove to me that they were wrong.
Use the opportunities given to you to show us that you deserve to be amongst your superiors.
善用給你們的機會，向我們證明你們配得上與上位者同列。
Your instructors will expect the best from you, so you must show them the best. Those who refuse or are unable to do this have no place here.
你們的教官會對你們期待最好的表現，所以你們必須拿出最好的。做不到、或不願意做的人，這裡沒有你們的位置。
Your role will be the most important in Fruma. Ensuring the safety of the population is no small task, trust me.
你們的職責將是 Fruma 最重要的。確保人民的安全絕非小事，相信我。
So, like I have, each of you must prove yourself worthy of being called a soldier of Fruma.
所以，就像我一樣，你們每一個人都必須證明自己配得上「Fruma 士兵」這個稱呼。
Let my words serve as motivation for you during your training.
願我的話在訓練期間成為你們的動力。
We are thankful to Sovereign Majin for taking time out of his responsibilities to deliver the opening speech.
我們感謝 Majin 統領在百忙之中撥冗前來致開場詞。
Now we will be bringing you to your first training session of the day, I hope you all are ready.
接下來我們會帶各位上今天第一堂訓練，希望你們都準備好了。
Each of you will be separated into groups depending on your division. For each challenge, your group will be paired with another group.
你們會依所屬部隊分組。每一項挑戰，你們這組都會和另一組配對。
The leaders of each region grouping will be the recruiter who originally sent you the invitation letter.
各地區分組的領隊，就是當初寄邀請信給你們的那位招募官。
They will be the ones leading you to where you're supposed to be for the first couple of days here, following an assigned schedule.
接下來幾天，他們會依照排定的日程，帶你們到該去的地方。
You are expected to be at your designated area, on time and ready.
你們必須準時抵達指定區域，並做好準備。
However, if for whatever reason you get lost, go to the secretary at the main lobby desk and she will tell you where to go.
不過，如果因為任何理由迷了路，就去大廳櫃檯找祕書，她會告訴你該往哪走。
Now, go convene with your recruiters in the main room to your left, then they will take you to your first training session.
現在，到左邊的大廳去跟你們的招募官會合，他們會帶你們去第一堂訓練。
That was a pretty good speech, I was a bit nervous, but now I am ready to start the training!
那演說真不錯，我本來有點緊張，現在我準備好開始訓練了！
I'm Arnol, I come from the nobel {p} Tasa family, Fruma has done so much for us, so I am ready to help her.
我叫 Arnol，出身 {p} 的名門 Tasa 家。Fruma 為我們付出了那麼多，所以我準備好回報她了。
I'm glad that you're from the {p}. That means we're in the same group!
我很高興你也是 {p} 來的。那代表我們同一組！
How about you and I stick together during our training?
訓練期間我們兩個要不要待在一起？
My family tells me that recruits often end up very... competitive...
我家裡的人跟我說，新兵之間常常會變得很……好勝……
So I think we can both benefit from sticking together, and watching each others' backs.
所以我想我們待在一起、互相照應，對彼此都有好處。
Anyways, we should head to our group's leader, I think his name is Effal?
總之，我們該去找我們組的領隊了，他好像叫 Effal？
Talk to Recruiter Effal then head to the challenge room at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
跟 Effal 招募官談，然後前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 的挑戰室。
Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
嘿，新兵！需要什麼幫忙嗎？
After corresponding with you recruiter, head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room then go down the stairs on the right.
跟你的招募官會合之後，一進下個房間就走正對面那間，然後從右邊的樓梯下去。
From there, head into the challenge room your team leader told you about.
接著再進你們領隊跟你說的那間挑戰室。
Good luck on your first challenge, I believe in you!
第一場挑戰加油，我相信你！
Good luck with your training, recruit. But I'll warn you, Commander Ferreo is no pushover.
訓練加油，新兵。不過我先警告你，Ferreo 指揮官可不好惹。
Do you need help with something recruit? Your team leader is Recruiter Effal, go see him for instructions.
新兵，需要幫忙嗎？你的領隊是 Effal 招募官，去找他拿指示。
You know it's not too late to turn back. You risk losing more than just your pride here.
你知道現在回頭還來得及。你在這裡可能失去的，不只是自尊。
Definitely not going to happen. After hearing that speech from Sovereign Majin, I feel like I could take on the entire resistance!
絕對不可能。聽完 Majin 統領那場演說，我覺得我一個人就能對付整個反抗軍！
Are you nervous like me? We're about to start the training and I still don't feel ready.
你跟我一樣緊張嗎？訓練要開始了，我還是覺得沒準備好。
I shouldn't worry, if anything goes wrong, I know Recruiter Alena will be there to help.
我不該擔心的，萬一出了什麼事，我知道 Alena 招募官會在。
But at the same time, It's hard not to be scared...
可是同時，又很難不害怕……
Ugh... How did Arnol end up here?...
唉……Arnol 怎麼會跑到這裡來？……
That speech from Sovereign Majin was amazing...
Majin 統領那場演說太精彩了……
I was almost brought to tears... I wish with all my heart that I may serve under him one day!
我差點就哭了……我打從心底希望有一天能在他麾下服役！
Sorry, but I'm not your team leader, since your in the {p} group, your team leader is uhmm... Ah, it's Recruiter Effal.
抱歉，我不是你的領隊。你是 {p} 組的，你的領隊是……嗯……啊，是 Effal 招募官。
I'm so glad to finally be out of the Roughworks. Although, after the training, we will have to go back...
終於離開 Roughworks 了，真好。雖然訓練結束後還是得回去……
I figured you'd be used to it after spending your whole life living there.
我還以為你在那裡住了一輩子，早就習慣了呢。
I think Holger is just impressed by the luxuries of the {p}. I'd imagine even the slums here are fancier than the Roughworks.
我看 Holger 只是被 {p} 的奢華嚇到了吧。我想這裡的貧民窟大概都比 Roughworks 高級。
Excuse me, Ezero sir, is it true the soldiers around here call Commander Ferreo 'The Iron Commander'?
不好意思，Ezero 長官，這附近的士兵真的都叫 Ferreo 指揮官「鐵血指揮官」嗎？
I believe he used to go by that nickname in his younger years, he was quite the fearsome leader.
我記得他年輕的時候確實有這個綽號，那時候他是個很可怕的領導者。
You should be careful not to get on his bad side... The last guy that did got exiled to Wynn...
你最好小心別惹到他……上一個惹到他的人被流放到 Wynn 去了……
Heh, I'm just messing with oyu kid, you don't have to worry about him, he's softened up a lot over the years.
嘿，我只是逗你玩的，小子，你不必怕他，他這些年軟化很多了。
I am not your team leader. Go find Recruiter Effal, the person wearing the same coloured clothes as you.
我不是你的領隊。去找 Effal 招募官，就是那個跟你穿同樣顏色衣服的人。
Shouldn't be too hard to do, I'd think.
我想這應該不會太難吧。
Alright, time to put these skills to use! Are you ready for this, Katze?
好，該把這些本事用上了！你準備好了嗎，Katze？
I'm ready! Let's show everyone we're the best!
我準備好了！讓大家看看我們才是最強的！
Are you from the {p}? I recognize everyone in that group except you, strange...
你是 {p} 來的嗎？那一組的人我全都認得，就是不認得你，奇怪……
Well, just a word of advice, be careful when picking your friends, it means everything here.
嗯，給你一個忠告: 交朋友要小心，在這裡那是最重要的事。
If you know the right people, you can climb the ranks quickly. But you must also have to have the abilities to go along with it of course.
認識對的人，你就能爬得很快。當然，你自己也得有相應的本事才行。
You look lost, don't worry, I can help you! Go find Recruiter Effal, he's wearing a yellow headband and is near the center of the room.
你看起來迷路了，別擔心，我可以幫你！去找 Effal 招募官，他綁著黃色頭帶，就在房間中央附近。
How do you feel about being accepted into the {p} division? I am pretty excited about it, glad Recruiter Olissy noticed my value.
被選進 {p} 部隊，你有什麼感覺？我還蠻興奮的，很高興 Olissy 招募官看見了我的價值。
As someone from Auburn, I'm a bit unsure still, but the recruiters know what they are doing, so I will trust their judgement.
我是從 Auburn 來的，其實還有點沒把握，不過招募官知道自己在做什麼，我信任他們的判斷。
I don't know much about the {p} either, but I guarantee we will be ready for whatever is in store for us there!
我對 {p} 也所知不多，但我保證，不管那裡等著我們的是什麼，我們都會準備好的！
I'm not the person you're looking for, go see Recruiter Effal.
我不是你要找的人，去找 Effal 招募官。
I have spent nearly my entire life training to become a soldier. I wonder how many other recruits here could say the same.
我幾乎花了一輩子在訓練成為士兵。不曉得這裡有多少新兵說得出同樣的話。
The Fruman military is in somewhat of a dire state right now, with resistance attacks becoming more brazen than seemingly ever.
Fruma 軍隊現在處境相當危急，反抗軍的攻擊比以往任何時候都更加肆無忌憚。
The duty will fall to us to return things back to normalcy. I am up to the task, and I hope you are too.
把一切拉回正軌的責任會落到我們身上。我扛得起，也希望你扛得起。
Oh hey, you're from the {p}! I'm from Aelumia but I grew up in {p}.
噢嘿，你是 {p} 來的！我是 Aelumia 人，不過在 {p} 長大。
I was assigned to the Wings group though, I'm a bit worried about meeting those expectations...
但我被分到羽翼組了，我有點擔心自己達不到那些期待……
Heh, Oh well, that's what training is for, right?
呵，算了，訓練不就是為了這個嗎？
There you are. Didn't I tell you? Ah, never mind...
你來啦。我不是跟你說了嗎？啊，算了……
Listen, remember that talk we had with Ferreo, how about that just stays between us ok?
聽著，我們跟 Ferreo 那段對話，就我們兩個知道就好，可以吧？
I better not see you gossiping to other recruits about it, that would make me very upset!
我可不想看到你跟其他新兵嚼舌根，那會讓我非常不高興！
The first test for our group is the shield challenge, everyone follow my lead.
我們這組的第一項測驗是盾牌挑戰，大家跟我走。
This area is only for soldiers and injured recruits, and well... You don't look injured.
這個區域只給士兵和受傷的新兵，而你……看起來沒受傷。
Sorry recruit, only soldiers are allowed to enter this area.
抱歉，新兵，這個區域只有士兵能進。
Welcome recruits to the shield challenge.
歡迎各位新兵來到盾牌挑戰。
Defense is one of the most important aspects of combat. You should not expect yourself to be able to dodge every incoming attack.
防禦是戰鬥中最重要的環節之一。你不該指望自己能閃掉每一次攻擊。
A shield can be an incredibly useful tool for a soldier, but holding them up constantly can often interfere with your mobility.
盾牌對士兵來說是極為有用的工具，但一直舉著它往往會妨礙你的機動性。
Knowing when to hold up your shield to defend yourself against incoming arrows or attackers, is thus, a vital skill to learn.
因此，知道什麼時候該舉盾抵擋來箭或敵人，是一項必須學會的關鍵技能。
Your training today will revolve around holding up a shield against arrows that are being fired from turrets.
今天的訓練會圍繞著一件事: 舉盾抵擋從弩塔射出來的箭。
The turrets will give an indication of when they are about to fire, however, the shields provided to you have many weights embedded into them.
弩塔在要射擊前會給出徵兆，不過，發給你們的盾牌裡嵌了很多配重。
Most of you will only be able to hold your shield up for a second or two at a time, so you must do so wisely.
你們大多數人一次只舉得起一兩秒，所以必須舉得聰明。
I have set up a turret here that you can use to practice getting used to handling the weighted shield.
我在這裡架了一座弩塔，你們可以用它來熟悉這種加重盾牌的操作。
Simply stand where I am now, then click the button behind me. Face the turret and hold up your shield when, or just before, it fires an arrow.
就站在我現在的位置，然後按我身後那個按鈕。面對弩塔，在它射箭的當下、或稍早一點舉起盾牌。
Good luck recruits, I will be judging you from an overlook point. If you haven't already, take a shield from the shield rack next to Recruiter Effal.
祝各位好運，我會在高處評分。還沒拿盾牌的，去 Effal 招募官旁邊的盾架上拿。
When you're ready to start the challenge, enter the large door behind me.
準備好開始挑戰時，就從我身後那道大門進去。
Enter the next room and complete the challenge.
進入下一個房間並完成挑戰。
Stop lingering around. The sooner you get this challenge done, the sooner I get to have lunch.
別在這裡晃來晃去。你們愈早做完這項挑戰，我就愈早能吃午餐。
That's it, holding up a shield against turrets? What a bore.
就這樣？舉盾牌擋弩塔？真無聊。
It seems like the instructors are basing these challenges off of the idea that we haven't done any training beforehand.
看來教官設計這些挑戰時，是假設我們事前完全沒訓練過。
They are wasting our time. Anyone who would struggle in a challenge like this has no hope of amounting to anything.
他們在浪費我們的時間。連這種挑戰都會卡住的人，根本不可能有什麼出息。
These shields are really heavy, it feels like I can only hold them up for around half a second...
這些盾牌真的很重，感覺我只舉得起半秒……
There's no point in overthinking this, I'm sure we'll both do well!
想太多沒有意義，我相信我們兩個都會表現得很好！
Don't worry {u}, this one is the easiest of the three challenges.
別擔心，{u}，這是三項挑戰裡最簡單的一項。
Or was it the endurance challenge that was the easiest? Hmmm, I forget.
還是說最簡單的是耐力挑戰？唔，我忘了。
It's your turn {u}, stand on that plate to start the test.
輪到你了，{u}，站上那塊板子開始測驗。
Well done, now exit through the door across from you.
做得好，現在從你對面那道門出去。
Head to the second challenge room after you speak to Arnol.
跟 Arnol 談完之後，前往第二間挑戰室。
You've really made a habit of testing my patience...
你真的很習慣考驗我的耐性……
Your performance better make up for it. Now, follow me to the next challenge.
你的表現最好能補回來。現在，跟我去下一項挑戰。
Hey {u}, I am ashamed to say it, but things didn't go well for me...
嘿，{u}，說出來很丟臉，但我表現得不好……
I wasn't able to complete the challenge...
I couldn't even manage to raise the shield up to block a single arrow! After a while, the instructor just told me to move on.
我連舉起盾牌擋下一支箭都做不到！過了一陣子，教官就直接叫我離開了。
I should have seen this coming... What about you, how did things go for you?
我早該料到的……那你呢，你的狀況怎麼樣？
Good job ! I am glad that one of us was able to do well. I'd like to learn about how you did it later.
幹得好！我很高興我們之中至少有一個表現得好。我想晚點跟你請教你是怎麼做到的。
I'd like to learn about Beac
Good job ! I am glad that you managed to finish. We should talk more about it later.
幹得好！我很高興你順利完成了。我們晚點該多聊聊這件事。
Well, maybe you just had more strength training than me. The shield was just too heavy to hold up, I don't know what else to say.
嗯，也許你只是力量訓練做得比我多吧。那面盾牌就是太重了，我也沒別的話好說。
We should go to our next challenge now, let's hope Effal doesn't erupt at us for being late.
我們該去下一項挑戰了，希望 Effal 不會因為我們遲到而發火。
Listen to the challenge instructions then enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
聽完挑戰說明後進入下一個房間，完成第二項挑戰。
Now that everyone's here, we may finally begin.
既然大家都到齊了，我們終於可以開始。
As a soldier, you will be defined by your endurance, it is your will to carry on through the fight!
身為士兵，你們的本色就在耐力——那是你們在戰鬥中撐下去的意志！
The terrain you battle on will never be optimal, so you must be able to adapt to it to ensure your success.
你們作戰的地形永遠不會理想，所以你們必須有能力適應它，才能取得成功。
As part of this training exercise, you will be jumping from platforms until you reach the end of an endurance course.
作為這次訓練的一部分，你們要在平台之間跳躍，直到抵達耐力路線的終點。
If you fall, you will have to go back to the start and continue from there.
如果掉下去，就得回到起點重來。
We have installed jump pads on the platforms to help ease you into making riskier leaps.
我們在平台上裝了彈跳板，幫助你們比較容易做出風險較高的跳躍。
To use the jump pads, simply stand on them and jump. The mechanism will detect the sudden weight loss and boost you.
要使用彈跳板，只要站上去然後起跳。機關會偵測到重量突然減輕，把你彈起來。
I've installed a jump pad in this room to the right of me if any of you want to practice before starting the course.
如果有人想在開始前先練習，我右手邊這裡裝了一塊彈跳板。
Soon you'll all hopefully be able to complete a course similar to this one but without the crutch.
希望不久之後，你們都能在沒有這種輔助的情況下完成類似的路線。
You may enter the large door behind me to begin. Oh, and your performance will be judged on how quickly you reach the exit.
你們可以從我身後那道大門進去開始。噢，還有，你們的表現會依抵達出口的速度評分。
I'm going to take my time on the jumps. After what happened in the first challenge, there's no point in rushing through.
跳躍我打算慢慢來。有了第一項挑戰的教訓，急著衝過去沒有意義。
Alright, I think I'm ready, let's sit together in the cafeteria after this.
好，我想我準備好了，這結束後我們一起在餐廳坐吧。
Yeah, it was this one that was the easiest challenge for me!
對，我當年最簡單的就是這一項！
Just get through the platforms as quickly as you can and you'll be fine.
盡快通過那些平台就沒問題了。
What is it, do you want advice?
Well, I can recommend that you go quickly, but you must also be aware of your surroundings.
嗯，我會建議你走快一點，但同時也要注意周圍。
The rest is up to you, think carefully about how you want to approach this.
剩下的就看你了，好好想想你要怎麼應付。
I am surprised by the amount of recruits who rush head first into these challenges.
這麼多新兵一頭衝進這些挑戰，我很驚訝。
Why not think about your approach beforehand? They are all setting themselves up for failure.
為什麼不事先想想自己的做法呢？他們全都在替自己鋪失敗的路。
Find the cafeteria and sit next to Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
找到餐廳，並坐到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 的 Arnol 旁邊。
Not a bad time, of course, not as good as mine, but it's fine since you're still learning.
時間不差。當然沒有我當年好，不過你還在學，這樣可以了。
Wow, you really took your time in there, don't worry, you'll get better... You, will get better? Right?
哇，你在裡面真是慢慢來啊，別擔心，你會進步的……你，會進步的吧？對吧？
It's time to head to the cafeteria for lunch with the other recruits. Follow me, I'll show you where it is.
該去餐廳跟其他新兵吃午餐了。跟我來，我帶你去。
Go through that corridor and then enter into the room on the right. Try not to eat too much, alright?
穿過那條走廊，然後進右邊那個房間。別吃太多，好嗎？
It's lunch time recruit, your food and the other recruits are in the cafeteria. It's the room to the left as soon as you enter the next room.
午餐時間到了，新兵，你的餐點和其他新兵都在餐廳。一進下個房間，左邊那間就是。
Enjoy your meal, you deserve it!
好好享用，這是你應得的！
There you are {u}, come sit next to me so we can talk about the second challenge.
你來啦，{u}，坐到我旁邊來，我們聊聊第二項挑戰。
The chef did a great job with these meals. They must be from Aelumia!
廚師這幾道菜做得真好。一定是 Aelumia 來的！
It's a shame that the lesser recruits also get to have it. I would have had them eating from a trough with the horses!
可惜那些次等新兵也吃得到。要是我，就讓他們跟馬一起在飼料槽吃！
I certainly don't look forward to having to sleep in the same room as the Auburn recruits...
要跟 Auburn 那些新兵睡同一間房，我實在期待不起來……
I can't stop thinking about Sovereign Majin's speech, it was just... Perfect!
我一直在想 Majin 統領那場演說，實在是……完美！
We must remember those words, especially the part about the importance of proving ourselves.
我們一定要記住那些話，尤其是關於證明自己有多重要的那一段。
So, the challenges, how did they go for you?
所以，那些挑戰，你們做得怎麼樣？
Well! Things went well! They were a bit difficult but I managed.
很好！很順利！是有點難，不過我應付過來了。
That's good to hear, we want to make sure everyone in our circle does well on them, so try to keep it that way.
那就好，我們要確保我們圈子裡的每個人都表現得好，所以請保持下去。
I hope our training gets tougher, I'd hardly call them challenges given their current difficulty.
我希望訓練能再難一點，以現在的難度，我很難稱它們為「挑戰」。
We were accepted into the {p} division, it makes sense that these challenges are easier for us.
我們是被選進 {p} 部隊的，這些挑戰對我們來說比較簡單是理所當然的。

Yeah, you're right, Recruiter Olissy told me herself that she sees great potential in us. We should try our best to live up to her expectations, and the expectations set for us as future {p} soldiers as well!
對，你說得對，Olissy 招募官親口跟我說她看見我們有很大的潛力。我們該盡力不辜負她的期待，也不辜負對我們這些未來 {p} 士兵的期待！
I have been watching many of the recruits, seeing how they act and communicate with each other, and frankly, it worries me.
我一直在觀察許多新兵，看他們怎麼行動、怎麼彼此交談，老實說，這讓我很擔心。
Many of them are treating {p} like some sort of children's school, they do not seem to understand what awaits them.
他們之中很多人把 {p} 當成某種兒童學校，似乎不明白等著他們的是什麼。
Of course, it is still only the first day, so hopefully this behaviour does not persist.
當然，這才第一天，希望這種行為不會持續下去。
And if it does. I trust that Commander Ferreo will deal with it.
如果真的持續下去，我相信 Ferreo 指揮官會處理。
Commander Ferreo has been working for the Fruman military for a long time, we're lucky to be training under him.
Ferreo 指揮官在 Fruma 軍隊裡服役很久了，能在他底下受訓是我們的運氣。
I hear he was offered a blessing early on in his service, back when he was still in the {p} division. He was very famous back then, everyone in {p} and Aelumia knew him!
我聽說他服役初期就有人要賜他一份祝福，那時候他還在 {p} 部隊。他當年非常有名，{p} 和 Aelumia 沒有人不認識他！
I hope I can accomplish ending up as half the soldier he was!
我希望自己能成為他當年一半的士兵就好了！
None of my friends ended up being chose to become a recruit like I was, I feel like a complete stranger here.
我的朋友沒有一個像我這樣被選上當新兵，我在這裡覺得自己完全是個外人。
But that's fine, we aren't here to socialize, we are here to prove ourselves worthy of the title of soldier!
不過沒關係，我們不是來社交的，我們是來證明自己配得上士兵這個稱號的！
I didn't do too well on the first two challenges, I hope I can make up for it on my last one.
前兩項挑戰我表現得不太好，希望最後一項能補回來。
Really Holger? You get access to a giant buffet and all you get is a salad and a small fish?
認真的嗎 Holger？你面前有一整桌自助餐，結果你只拿了一份沙拉跟一條小魚？
You idiot, not everyone needs to stuff their face with food like you! This is why mom says I'm the smarter one.
你這白痴，不是每個人都得像你一樣把臉塞滿食物！所以媽才說我是比較聰明的那個。
Well who does she say the stronger one is? That's what really matters!
那她說比較強的是誰？那才是真正重要的！
Can you two go five minutes without arguing with each other?
你們兩個能不能有五分鐘不吵架？
It's nice to finally eat something. I skipped breakfast today, I was too worried that I'd end up hurling it back up.
終於能吃點東西了，真好。我今天沒吃早餐，太緊張了，怕自己會吐出來。
Anyways, about the endurance training. It took some time, but I figured out the perfect strategy to get through the course!
總之，關於耐力訓練。花了一點時間，不過我想出了通過那條路線的完美策略！
I definitely am better at agility tests, I wonder if the instructors will take that into account when grading us.
我確實比較擅長敏捷測驗，不知道教官評分的時候會不會把這個算進去。
How about you, did you struggle with the jumps, or finish the course quickly?
那你呢，跳躍讓你卡關了，還是你很快就跑完了？
It sure was tricky, but at least-
Oh... Well, I guess you don't-
You are Arnol, yes? You must come with me.
你是 Arnol 吧？你必須跟我走一趟。
I am in the middle of eating, can't I go after I finish my meal?
我正在吃飯，不能等我吃完再去嗎？
You're not sitting with anyone? You're a strange one, {u}.
你沒跟任何人坐？你這人真怪，{u}。
The last challenge of the day will be dueling, the other {p} recruits are already heading there, follow me.
今天最後一項挑戰是決鬥，其他 {p} 新兵已經過去了，跟我來。
What was that about, where do you think that guy took Katze?
剛剛那是怎麼回事，你覺得那個人把 Katze 帶去哪了？
No clue, but it seems like that Arnol kid was also asked to go with them.
不知道，不過那個叫 Arnol 的小子好像也被叫去了。
Whatever it is, it doesn't seem good...
不管是什麼事，看起來都不太妙……
Go to the challenge room and receive instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 的挑戰室，接受今天最後一項挑戰的說明。
If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
如果你吃完午餐了，就在餐廳等 Effal 招募官來帶你去下一項挑戰。
And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
如果 Effal 招募官已經來接過你們那組了，那……你應該跟他一起在決鬥室才對。
Your final challenge today will be singular combat against another recruit.
你們今天的最後一項挑戰，是與另一名新兵單獨對戰。
When up against the enemy, you may find yourself in a similar situation. You must be prepared for when this happens.
面對敵人時，你可能會遇到類似的處境。你必須為此做好準備。
This test serves as a way to further gauge your skills, as well as an opportunity to show off the strategies you have developed in melee.
這項測驗一方面進一步衡量你們的能力，一方面也讓你們展現自己在近戰中發展出的戰術。
The most important skill to have in a duel is patience, to know when you have an opening to attack. But of course, agility and strength are also deciding factors.
決鬥中最重要的能力是耐心——知道什麼時候有空隙可以出手。當然，敏捷與力量同樣是決定性的因素。
Use your agility to avoid attacks, but if you find yourself unable to dodge, you must stand on guard and block incoming attacks.
用你的敏捷閃避攻擊，但如果閃不掉，就必須站穩防禦，格擋來襲的攻擊。
Blocking precisely as your opponent strikes may catch them off guard, allowing you an opportunity to retaliate.
在對手出擊的瞬間精準格擋，可能讓他們措手不及，給你反擊的機會。
You weapon is a wooden training estoc. The edges are dulled, so you will not need to hold back your strength.
你們的武器是木製訓練刺劍。刃口是鈍的，所以你們不需要保留力氣。
Your performance will be judged by me, if I see one side clearly winning over the other I will declare a victor.
你們的表現由我評分，如果我看到一方明顯勝過另一方，我會宣布勝者。
Make sure to get yourself an estoc before entering the challenge room, I will oversee the challenges shortly, so do not start until I get there.
進挑戰室之前記得先拿一把刺劍，我稍後會過去監督，我到之前不要開始。
Complete the final challenge of the day.
完成今天最後一項挑戰。
It seems like the commander wants to see you, just look at how he's staring at you...
指揮官好像想見你，你看他那樣盯著你……
Well whatever it's about, try not to make me look bad, ok?
算了，不管是什麼事，別讓我丟臉，好嗎？
I hope your talk with Ferreo went well.
希望你跟 Ferreo 談得順利。
I'll just assume things went well, based on the fact that you're still in this room.
看你還待在這個房間裡，我就假設一切順利了。
Sorry recruit, there's not much advice I can give you here, I wasn't that good at this challenge during my training.
抱歉，新兵，這項我給不了你什麼建議，我自己受訓的時候就不太擅長這個。
I just could never bring myself to go all out on a fellow recruit, what if I accidentally hurt them?
我就是沒辦法對同為新兵的人全力出手，萬一不小心傷到他們怎麼辦？
Ah, here's some advice! Don't do what I did, and you'll do fine!
啊，有了，這個建議: 別學我，你就會表現得很好！
Dueling against other recruits seems strange to me... Won't we be working together when we become soldiers?
跟其他新兵決鬥讓我覺得很奇怪……我們成為士兵之後不是要並肩作戰嗎？
It's fine, I don't want to question Commander Ferreo. He's dedicated his life to protecting others, I trust his opinion more than mine.
算了，我不想質疑 Ferreo 指揮官。他把一生都獻給保護他人，我信任他的判斷勝過我自己的。
So, it looks like your buddy Arnol quit early, what else is new?
看來你那位好朋友 Arnol 提早退場了，一點也不意外。
From the moment I saw him here, I knew he wouldn't be able to last a day.
從我在這裡看到他的第一眼，我就知道他撐不過一天。
But, if it turns out that he didn't leave, I wouldn't stick with him, if I were you.
不過，如果他其實沒有離開，我要是你，就不會繼續跟他混在一起。
You don't want his weakness to rub off on you.
你不會想被他的軟弱傳染。
I would like a word with you first.
I've been looking forward to speaking with you, one on one.
我一直很期待跟你單獨談一談。
I want you to remember that the only reason you're here is because I allowed you to be here, and because I see some potential in you.
我要你記住，你之所以在這裡，唯一的原因是我允許你在這裡，而且我在你身上看到一點潛力。
If you are unable to realize this potential fully, or become more trouble than you're worth, I won't hesitate to have you kicked out.
如果你無法完全發揮這份潛力，或是變得麻煩大於價值，我不會猶豫把你趕出去。
So, for your sake, I hope you do well on these challenges.
所以，為你自己好，我希望你這些挑戰表現得好。
Step up, and the duel may begin.
Now, both of you, exit the room and take a look at your final rankings of the day.
現在，你們兩個離開這個房間，去看今天的最終排名。
Leave the challenge room and check your ranking, then talk to Arnol.
離開挑戰室查看你的排名，然後跟 Arnol 談。
That was the last training exercise for the day.
那是今天最後一項訓練。
Your ranking can be found on the board over there. Be sure to take a look, I hope it can serve as motivation.
你們的排名可以在那邊的告示板上看到。務必去看一眼，希望它能成為你們的動力。
Once you're done here, head up to the recruit barracks and rest for the night.
看完之後，就上樓到新兵兵營休息一晚。
The barracks are up those stairs in the room directly across from the staircase.
兵營在那道樓梯上去，正對著樓梯口的那個房間。
What a day huh? I hope you ended up with a ranking that you're proud of.
今天真是漫長啊。希望你拿到的排名是你滿意的。
If, like me, you didn't do well, don't think too hard about it. A good night's rest will cheer you up.
如果你跟我一樣表現不好，別想太多。好好睡一覺就會振作起來了。
It's not as big of a deal as the other recruits will lead you to believe, trust me.
這件事沒有其他新兵說的那麼嚴重，相信我。
Could be better, but after all, training is supposed to reveal our weaknesses.
可以更好，不過話說回來，訓練本來就是要暴露我們的弱點。
Wow, that Adder guy sure is something...
哇，那個 Adder 真的不簡單……
I shouldn't be surprised though, him and Saldin are on a different level from the rest of us.
不過我也不該驚訝，他和 Saldin 跟我們其他人根本不在同一個層級。
I too will reach that level soon, I will prove my worth to the Commander!
我也很快就會到那個層級的，我要向指揮官證明我的價值！
Look at that disappointment moping in the corner, I think {~}th place suits him well.
看那個廢物在角落自怨自艾，我覺得第 {~} 名很配他。
Arnol? Well... It was only the first day. He could improve...
Arnol？這個嘛……才第一天而已。他可以進步的……
What?! Oh wait... You didn't do too well either, did you?
什麼？！噢等等……你自己也表現得不怎麼樣，對吧？
How could I have ranked so low? I must try harder to show my worth as a soldier!
我怎麼會排這麼後面？我一定要更努力，展現我身為士兵的價值！
I hope Recruiter Olissy will forgive me for this...
希望 Olissy 招募官能原諒我這次……
Looks like brawn beats brains again, huh sis?
看來蠻力又贏過腦子了，是吧老姊？
More like luck beats brains! If our training was more realistic then everyone would see that I am clearly better.
應該說運氣贏過腦子！如果我們的訓練更貼近實戰，大家就會看見我明顯比較強。
It is just as I expected. Despite it being the first day, many recruits struggled catastrophically in their training.
跟我預料的一樣。雖然只是第一天，還是有許多新兵在訓練中慘敗。
Their scores will only go down from here. I doubt any of them have the will to dig themselves out from the dirt.
他們的分數從這裡只會往下掉。我不認為他們之中有誰有那個意志把自己從泥裡拉出來。
I wonder how long it will be until something is done about this.
不知道還要多久才會有人處理這件事。
Hey . It feels like it's been a while since we've last seen each other.
嘿。感覺我們好像好久沒見了。
It's been a long day, I feel so tired already. Heh, it's pathetic...
今天真長，我已經覺得好累了。呵，真可悲……
I've been avoiding it because it's embarrassing, but I think you deserve to know.
我一直迴避這件事，因為很丟臉，不過我想你有資格知道。
Regarding what happened in the cafeteria, another recruit and I were taken to the guard's barracks.
關於餐廳那件事，我和另一名新兵被帶去衛兵兵營。
They wanted the room to be spotless before the end of the day... It was a punishment for not doing well enough on the training.
他們要那個房間在今天結束前一塵不染……那是對訓練表現不夠好的懲罰。
After that, they took me to the dueling room, an instructor hastily explained what to do. And, well... The duel didn't last very long...
之後他們把我帶去決鬥室，一名教官草草解釋了該怎麼做。然後，嗯……那場決鬥沒撐多久……
I just wished they would give me more of a chance to prove myself. I know I can do better!
我只希望他們能多給我一點證明自己的機會。我知道我可以做得更好！
This isn't what I expected Tericen to be like. It feels absurd to subject your recruits to that on the first day!
這不是我想像中的 Tericen。第一天就讓新兵受這種對待，實在荒唐！
There's something I want to tell you in a more private area . Before you go to bed, talk to me in the barracks.
有件事我想在比較私密的地方跟你說。你睡覺前，來兵營找我談。
Speak to Arnol in the barracks, then go to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
到兵營跟 Arnol 談，然後在 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 睡覺。
You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
你今天的行程結束了，沒有挑戰了。
Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
現在去好好休息吧，這是你應得的。一進下個房間就走正對面那間，然後從那裡進左邊的房間。
So how do you feel about all of this after the first day?
所以第一天過完，你有什麼感覺？
It was alright, I don't see the point in the ranking system though, we're all going to become soldiers in the end.
還可以吧，不過我看不出排名制度的意義，反正我們最後都會成為士兵。
It's just something to keep us engaged, to make sure everyone is doing their best in the training I think.
我想那只是拿來讓我們保持投入的東西，確保每個人在訓練裡都全力以赴吧。
You lied to me... Don't ever think about talking to me again until you get at least {~}rd place in the rankings!
你騙了我……在你排名進到至少第 {~} 名之前，別想再跟我說話！
I'm sorry! I was just too embarrassed to tell you the truth!
對不起！我只是太丟臉了，不敢跟你說實話！
I-I can make up for this! Please! I don't want to be alone here!
我、我可以彌補的！拜託！我不想在這裡孤零零一個人！
Are you here to humiliate me further? Go ahead, laugh, I don't care!
你是來進一步羞辱我的嗎？來啊，笑吧，我不在乎！
I'll make you and everyone else who mocked me east their words!
我會讓你和所有嘲笑過我的人把話吞回去！
I'll become stronger, stronger than all of you! I-I just need more time.
我會變強，比你們所有人都強！我、我只是需要更多時間。
I want to apologize to you . Earlier today, when I told you my reason for wanting to become a soldier, I lied.
我想跟你道歉。今天稍早，我告訴你我想當士兵的理由時，我說了謊。
I didn't come to {p} out of any noble duty to serve Fruma. I came here because it was a last resort for me.
我來 {p} 不是出於什麼為 Fruma 效力的高尚使命。我來這裡，是因為這是我最後的退路。
I originally wanted to become a scholar at the royal university. If I were a member of a more powerful house, I would have been accepted in, no question.
我原本想進皇家大學當學者。如果我出身更有權勢的家族，我一定進得去，毫無疑問。
They made me take a test to be let in, and I failed it. On top of that, they refused to let me retake it.
他們讓我考一場入學測驗，我沒通過。而且他們還拒絕讓我重考。
My father was furious with me, he was concerned with how I could bring honour to our house. So he turned to his friends in the military.
我父親對我大發雷霆，他擔心的是我要怎麼替我們家族帶來榮耀。於是他去找了他在軍中的朋友。
He pulled some strings, and here I am, becoming a soldier in order to bring more respect to house Tasa.
他動用了一些關係，於是我就在這裡了——為了替 Tasa 家掙更多尊敬而去當一名士兵。
I am not telling you this because I want you to pity me. I want you to know why this is so important to me.
我告訴你這些，不是要你可憐我。我是要你明白，為什麼這件事對我這麼重要。
If word went around that a member of house Tasa was forced to clean the guard barracks as a punishment...
如果傳出去說 Tasa 家的一員被罰去打掃衛兵兵營……
Well... Everything my father has done for me could be wasted, and I would be an even bigger failure than before...
那……我父親為我做的一切都會白費，而我會比以前更失敗……
That's all I wanted to tell you. I hope you can understand why I lied to you, I just didn't know if I could trust you with this, but now I do.
我想說的就這些。希望你能理解我為什麼騙你，我只是不確定能不能放心把這件事告訴你，但現在我確定了。
Sneak around to find information on the Fruman military.
潛行探查 Fruma 軍隊的情報。
So how did it go, is Verdi alright?
那麼結果如何，Verdi 還好嗎？
I'm afraid not Commander, his injuries are severe. I recommend sending him home to recover.
恐怕不好，指揮官，他的傷勢很嚴重。我建議送他回家休養。
Maybe after he regains his former strength, he will be able to rejoin the program, but it's difficult to say...
也許等他恢復到原本的體力，還能重新加入這個計畫，不過很難說……
To think that this damage was done with a training sword... It's... Incredible.
想到這種傷是用訓練劍造成的……真是……令人吃驚。
What do you think should be done, Commander, should Adder be punished for harming a fellow recruit?
指揮官，您認為該怎麼處理？Adder 傷害同袍新兵，是否該受罰？
No. This is an opportunity, Strumon, one that I do not want to let slip. Verdi will be sent home, and that recruit of your's will not be punished, but praised.
不。這是一個機會，Strumon，一個我不想放過的機會。Verdi 會被送回家，而你那名新兵不會受罰，反而要受表揚。
If Majin wants better results, this is how we do that... Just make sure to keep Adder in line, we don't want him going too far.
