如果 Majin 想要更好的成果，這就是我們達成的方式……只要確保 Adder 別脫韁，我們不希望他做得太過頭。
Who is that? Is someone watching us?...
那是誰？有人在看我們嗎？……
Quickly run back to your bed at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Tell Arnol what you heard last night.
把你昨晚聽到的告訴 Arnol。
Hey, {u}, are you awake? You slept through the alarm bell.
嘿，{u}，你醒了嗎？起床鈴響了你都沒醒。
Everyone has already gone to start the training for today, I told Effal that I'd wake you up.
大家都已經去進行今天的訓練了，我跟 Effal 說我會來叫你。
What! A recruit was injured so badly during the dueling training they had to be sent home?!
什麼！有新兵在決鬥訓練中受傷嚴重到被送回家？！
It must have been an accident, maybe Adder forgot to hold back? I've heard people say that the strength of one Wings soldier is equal to three regional soldiers.
那一定是意外吧，也許 Adder 忘了收力？我聽人說過，一名羽翼士兵的力量抵得上三名地區士兵。
This doesn't seem right, {u}... Why would Commander Ferreo see that as an "opportunity"? What could that mean...
這不太對勁，{u}……為什麼 Ferreo 指揮官會把那件事看成一個「機會」？那是什麼意思……
We have to get down to the bottom of this. How about we confront Adder during lunch, and ask him what happened during his duel on the first day.
我們得查清楚這件事。不如我們午餐時去找 Adder 當面問，問他第一天決鬥時發生了什麼。
But we need to get going now, I imagine Effal and the other recruits aren't happy waiting for us. Follow me, I'll lead you to the training room.
不過我們現在得走了，我想 Effal 和其他新兵等我們等得不太高興。跟我來，我帶你去訓練室。
Go to your first challenge, then listen to the challenge instructions at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
前往你的第一項挑戰，然後在 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 聽挑戰說明。
All of the other recruits are probably in their challenge rooms right now.
其他新兵現在應該都在各自的挑戰室裡了。
You should join them. Head to the endurance training room, it's the same one as yesterday.
你該去跟他們會合。到耐力訓練室，跟昨天是同一間。
Things aren't going to be as easy today, good luck!
今天不會像昨天那麼輕鬆了，加油！
Well, it looks like we can start now that everyone's here.
好，人都到齊了，我們可以開始了。
Most of you did well on the first course, so we're going to be upping the difficulty this time. I trust that you're all ready.
你們大多數人第一輪的路線都表現得不錯，所以這次我們要提高難度。我相信你們都準備好了。
Make sure to watch where you're going, this course will have false platforms to trick you up if you're not paying attention.
務必看清楚你們要往哪裡走，這條路線會有假平台，不注意就會被騙。
Like before, you'll be judged based on how quickly you can complete the course and reach the exit.
跟之前一樣，評分依據是你們完成路線、抵達出口的速度。
I left the jump pad in here in case you want to get used to the feeling again. Enter the large door behind me to start the course when you're ready.
彈跳板我留在這裡了，如果你們想重新熟悉那個感覺。準備好就從我身後那道大門進去開始。
Complete the first challenge of the day.
You realize your bad behaviour makes me look even worse for bringing you in, right?
你知道你的惡劣表現會讓帶你進來的我看起來更糟吧？
If I catch you sleeping in, going where you're not supposed to, or doing anything out of line again... You'll come to regret it...
如果再讓我抓到你睡過頭、跑到不該去的地方、或做出任何逾矩的事……你會後悔的……
I've been disgraced by my friends for getting ranked low yesterday... Now I don't feel like I have the will to do anything...
我因為昨天排名太低被朋友們羞辱了……現在我什麼都不想做了……
D-Do you think I could regain their trust by getting a high ranking? No... I'm still not strong enough...
你、你覺得我拿到高排名就能重新贏回他們的信任嗎？不……我還不夠強……
This is the challenge I did the best on yesterday. It should be mostly the same, hopefully. Slow and steady wins the race.
這是我昨天表現最好的一項。希望大致上還是一樣。穩紮穩打才能贏。
I'm not going to rush into these challenges like yesterday, I need time to think about what I am going to do.
我不會像昨天那樣衝進這些挑戰，我需要時間想清楚自己要怎麼做。
Took you a while to find your way here, did you get lost or something?
你花了不少時間才找到這裡，是迷路了還是怎樣？
You're lucky Effal is a pushover, if you were in my group, you'd be out of here without a second thought.
你走運，Effal 好說話。你要是在我這組，早就毫不猶豫被踢出去了。
Enter the next room and receive instructions for the next challenge.
進入下一個房間，接受下一項挑戰的說明。
Not a bad time you had there. Keep this up and you might end up making me no longer regret letting you in here.
你這次時間不錯。保持下去，說不定我就不會再後悔讓你進來了。
Up next is shield training, you're still not out of the woods yet. We are expecting big things from you.
接下來是盾牌訓練，你還沒脫離險境。我們對你有很高的期待。
Well... That was a disappointment. You've been given many second chances and this is what you do to give thanks>
唉……真令人失望。給了你那麼多次機會，你就是這樣報答的。
If your mediocrity persists, I'll have no choice but to let you go, for both of our sake's. Now follow me to the next training room.
如果你繼續這麼平庸，為了我們兩個好，我只能放你走了。現在跟我去下一間訓練室。
Hey {u}, I think the challenge went well. I managed to complete it at least, although I can't say for certain if I made a good time.
嘿，{u}，我覺得這次挑戰進行得還不錯。至少我完成了，雖然時間好不好我就不敢說了。
I couldn't help but feel off about what the instructor said when I started the course... "Good luck Arnol... Not that it would matter...".
教官在我開始跑路線時說的那句話，我怎麼想都覺得不對勁……「祝你好運，Arnol……雖然那大概也沒什麼用……」。
What is that supposed to mean? I thought instructors were supposed to encourage us, helping us to do better in the training.
那是什麼意思？我以為教官應該鼓勵我們，幫我們在訓練中表現得更好才對。
I'm beginning to think that this training program is more about shaming us rather than preparing us to become soldiers. I wonder if the other recruits are starting to believe this as well...
我開始覺得這套訓練計畫與其說是在準備我們成為士兵，不如說是在羞辱我們。不知道其他新兵是不是也開始這麼想了……
Welcome recruits to day two of your training in the shield challenge.
歡迎各位新兵來到盾牌挑戰第二天。
I'll keep the summary short since I'm sure most of you remember the gist of the test from yesterday.
我把說明講短一點，我相信你們大多數人都還記得昨天測驗的大致內容。
This time, instead of three turrets shooting at you, the number has been upped to five.
這次不是三座弩塔對著你們射，數量提高到五座。
On top of that, the three central turrets have been elevated. You'll have to aim your shield higher to block arrows coming from them.
此外，中間三座弩塔的位置被墊高了。你們得把盾牌舉得更高，才能擋下從那裡射來的箭。
I've also adjusted the turret timings a little. Two turrets are now able to fire at you in quick succession, you must be ready to block the arrows from both of them.
我也稍微調整了弩塔的時序。現在有兩座弩塔能連續快速射擊，你們必須準備好擋下兩邊的箭。
I noticed that some of you struggled with lifting the shield on the first day...
我注意到你們有些人第一天連舉起盾牌都很吃力……
Perhaps those people would like some sort of crutch to help them perform better, but I must say that no such thing will be granted.
也許那些人會希望有某種輔助幫他們表現得好一點，但我必須說，這種東西不會有。
I believe that failure can be an excellent teacher. Some of you may still need to learn that failure should elicit a change from yourself.
我相信失敗可以是最好的老師。你們有些人還需要學會: 失敗應該促成你自身的改變。
For those recruits, until this lesson is fully learned, continued failure will be far more valuable than success.
對那些新兵而言，在這一課完全學會之前，持續的失敗遠比成功更有價值。
With that being said, I wish all of you lulck on the challenge! Pick up a shield on the rack next to Recruiter Ezero if you haven't.
話說到這裡，祝各位挑戰順利！還沒拿盾牌的，去 Ezero 招募官旁邊的架上拿。
Then, once you're ready, enter the large door behind me to start the test. Oh, and the training turret is still here if you need it.
然後，準備好了就從我身後那道大門進去開始測驗。噢，訓練弩塔還在這裡，需要的話可以用。
Enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
進入下一個房間並完成第二項挑戰。
Five turrets already? Seems like they're doing things a bit quicker than usual.
已經五座弩塔了？看來他們的進度比平常快一點。
Just don't look at it as increased difficulty, instead, look at it is an increased chance to show your might!
別把它看成難度提高，換個角度，把它看成展現你實力的機會提高了！
That wretch... Looking directly at me while he talks about failure...
那個混蛋……講到失敗的時候直直盯著我……
I'll make him eat those words... Maybe not today, but eventually... I'm done with letting people walk all over me!
我會讓他把那些話吞回去……也許不是今天，但總有一天……我受夠被人踩在腳下了！
Thank you for being here to listen to me, {u}, I don't know where I'd be right now without you...
謝謝你在這裡聽我說，{u}，我不知道要是沒有你，我現在會是什麼樣子……
After this, we'll meet in the cafeteria, and discuss what you saw last night with Adder.
這結束之後，我們在餐廳碰面，討論你昨晚看到的 Adder 那件事。
Heh... It seems like the instructor had a specific person here in mind when he talked about failures!
呵……看來教官講失敗的時候，心裡是有特定人選的！
When will Arnol realize he can't keep playing pretend soldier?
Arnol 什麼時候才會明白，他不能一直玩扮士兵的遊戲？
Not this again... I think I can already guess how this will go for me...
又來了……我大概已經猜得到我這次會怎麼樣了……
Do you think if I duck when the arrow comes, the instructor will count it as a block?
你覺得如果箭來的時候我蹲下去，教官會不會算我格擋成功？
Ah the shield challenge... Back when I was a recruit this test was the bane of many of my peers!
啊，盾牌挑戰……我當新兵那時候，這項測驗是我許多同儕的剋星！
It was a lot different back then, yet it seeks that it's reputation hasn't changed much. Funny little coincidence I suppose.
當年的做法跟現在很不一樣，不過它的名聲似乎沒怎麼變。我想這算是個有趣的巧合吧。
Alright, {u}, stand on that plate in front of you to start the test.
好了，{u}，站上你面前那塊板子開始測驗。
Good job recruit, exit through the door across from you.
做得好，新兵，從你對面那道門出去。
Leave the challenge room then talk to Arnol and Adder in the cafeteria at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
離開挑戰室，然後到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 的餐廳跟 Arnol 和 Adder 談。
You're all done now. Was the added difficulty too much? It seemed like it was for your friend Arnol, he stormed out after he finished.
你們全都做完了。難度提高是不是太多了？你朋友 Arnol 看起來是這樣，他做完之後就氣沖沖走掉了。
That's definitely not how a soldier should act, even I know that! Maybe you can teach him some manners at lunch.
那絕對不是一個士兵該有的舉止，連我都知道！也許你可以在午餐時教教他規矩。
Anyway, you probably know the drill by now. Head up to the cafeteria and go enjoy your meal.
總之，你現在大概知道流程了。上餐廳去，好好享用你的餐點。
That Wings recruit, Adder, do you know anything about him? Why did he refuse to sit with us?
那個羽翼新兵，Adder，你知道他的事嗎？他為什麼不肯跟我們坐？
He seems like a complete nobody, I don't think he's from the {p} or Aelumia. I wouldn't bother with him, personally.
他看起來就是個徹底的無名小卒，我不覺得他是 {p} 或 Aelumia 來的。要我說，別理他。
Well I didn't ask for your thoughts on the matter... I just want to know how a complete unknown like him was able to score higher than all of us!
我又沒問你的看法……我只是想知道，一個像他那樣完全沒沒無聞的人，怎麼能分數比我們所有人都高！
Two other have been expelled from our friend group... Will I be the next one to go?
已經有兩個人被踢出我們這個小圈子了……下一個會是我嗎？
Oh... Dear Queen... Please give me the strength to do well in the training. I can't end up like the others!
噢……親愛的女王……請賜我力量，讓我在訓練中表現得好。我不能落得跟他們一樣！
How were you accepted into the Wings division? It's my goal here to be able to become a Wings soldier!
你是怎麼進到羽翼部隊的？我來這裡的目標就是要成為羽翼士兵！
Well honestly, I'm not sure. I guess Recruiter Strumon just saw something in me? I was also stronger than my friends, so maybe that was it.
嗯，老實說我也不確定。大概是 Strumon 招募官在我身上看到什麼吧？我也比我的朋友們都強壯，也許是因為這樣。
Hmmm... So if I can impress Recruiter Strumon then I might be able to make it into your group?
唔……所以如果我能讓 Strumon 招募官刮目相看，或許就能進你們那組？
Well not exactly. Recruiter Strumon only accepts recruits. If you want to be promoted into the Wings division as an Aelumia soldier then you'd need to impress a Wings Commander, or Sovereign Majin...
呃，不完全是。Strumon 招募官只收新兵。如果你想以 Aelumia 士兵的身分被調升進羽翼部隊，你得讓一位羽翼指揮官、或是 Majin 統領刮目相看才行……
Darn... That sounds harder than I thought it'd be...
可惡……那聽起來比我想的難多了……
Did you speak to Recruiter Ollisy about your ranking from yesterday's training, what did she say?
你有沒有跟 Olissy 招募官談過昨天訓練的排名？她怎麼說？
She assured me that it was not that big of a deal, and I have lots of time to improve. I suppose I was being a bit overdramatic...
她跟我保證那沒有那麼嚴重，我還有很多時間可以進步。我想我剛才是有點反應過度了……
In the Fruman military's eyes, we already passed the test. We're all going to be soldiers after the training, the ranking just encourages us to constantly improve.
在 Fruma 軍隊眼裡，我們已經通過測驗了。訓練結束後我們全都會成為士兵，排名只是鼓勵我們不斷進步而已。
That's true, I will use my poor ranking as a reminder that I have much to improve on. I will make sure that today, my ranking will be higher!
說得也是，我會把我糟糕的排名當成提醒，提醒我還有很多要改進。我保證今天我的排名一定會更高！
I've seen you and Arnol together a lot. I am confused with what you see in him. Is it because of his family name?
我常看到你跟 Arnol 在一起。我不太懂你看上他哪一點。是因為他的家族姓氏嗎？
If that is the case, I can assure you there are better options. Ones that will not hold you back.
如果是這樣，我可以向你保證還有更好的選擇。不會拖累你的那種。
So... This is how it feels to eat alone at lunch... I hate it...
所以……一個人吃午餐是這種感覺……我討厭這樣……
These challenges have been so difficult... I wonder if my performance will end up on my record, I hope not...
這些挑戰好難……不知道我的表現會不會記進我的檔案，希望不會……
Ha! What am I worried about, this is only the second day of a month of training! I'm sure I will get better before then.
哈！我在擔心什麼，這才是一個月訓練的第二天！在那之前我一定會進步的。
This is my third serving, you really ought to take advantage of this buffet! Oh... I hope I don't get a cramp...
這是我第三份了，你們真該好好利用這桌自助餐！噢……希望我不會抽筋……
Hey, wasn't there someone else in your group, what happened to them?
嘿，你們那組不是還有一個人嗎，他怎麼了？
Eh? I'm not sure, they seemed really jumpy, my guess is they couldn't handle the pressure and wanted to go home.
咦？我不確定，他看起來很緊張，我猜他撐不住壓力想回家了吧。
Maybe you should take their example sis. I can tell already that you're struggling to keep up with everyone else!
老姊，也許你該學學他。我已經看得出來你跟不上大家了！
It seems like things are starting to look better for me in these challenges! Maybe if I keep this up, I can manage a spot in the top five!
我在這些挑戰上好像開始有起色了！照這樣下去，說不定我能擠進前五名！
Ah, you're here, {u}, come on, let's go ask Adder about how his duel went yesterday...
啊，你來了，{u}，來吧，我們去問 Adder 昨天他那場決鬥是怎麼回事……
Hey there, you're Adder right? I saw that you were first on the ranking yesterday, great job!
嘿，你是 Adder 對吧？我看到你昨天排第一，很厲害！
and I were wondering how the duel went for you yesterday. We erm... Both did poorly on it and wanted to know how you won yours, just tell us what happened during the fight.
我和他在想，你昨天那場決鬥是怎麼進行的。我們呃……兩個都表現得很差，想知道你是怎麼贏的，你就跟我們說說打鬥中發生了什麼。
You want to know how my duel went yesterday? Well, when it started I didn't engage immediately, I wanted to gauge the strength of my opponent.
你想知道我昨天那場決鬥怎麼進行的？嗯，開場時我沒有立刻進攻，我想先衡量對手的實力。
Despite leaving myself open for attack many times, my opponent couldn't even land a single hit on me. When I grew tired of that farse, I brutally retaliated...
儘管我多次刻意賣出破綻，我的對手連一下都打不中我。等我厭倦了那場鬧劇，我就狠狠地反擊了……
Even after he was yelling for me to stop, yelling "I yield!" at the top of his lungs, I continued. People like that should not become soldiers.
即使他大喊要我住手，扯開喉嚨喊著「我認輸！」，我還是繼續。那種人不該成為士兵。
I stopped after he finally finished yelling, he had to be carried out by two guards. Commander Ferreo was watching the whole time, and did not intervene.
等他終於喊不出聲，我才停下來，他得由兩名衛兵抬出去。Ferreo 指揮官全程都在看，沒有介入。
You wanted to know how the duel went, that is how. He never should have been here in the first place, and I did the Fruman military a favour by making sure he will never come back.
你想知道那場決鬥怎麼進行的，就是這樣。他一開始就不該來這裡，而我確保他再也不會回來，是幫了 Fruma 軍隊一個忙。
You monster... He wanted to dedicate his life to serving the Queen and the people he loved, and you took that all away from him...
你這怪物……他想把一生獻給女王和他所愛的人，而你把那一切都奪走了……
The will to do something means nothing, no matter how strong it is, if you do not have the ability to do it.
如果沒有做到的能力，想做一件事的意志再強都毫無意義。
He would have just gotten himself killed, or worse, gotten others killed. What I did was serve Fruma to the best of my ability, I am no monster.
他只會害死自己，更糟的是害死別人。我做的是盡我所能為 Fruma 效力，我不是怪物。
No true soldier would ever intentionally injure an ally... Let's go, this conversation is over.
真正的士兵絕不會刻意傷害同袍……走吧，這場對話結束了。
Are you the one who told him to ask me about that? Who are you exactly?
是你叫他來問我那件事的嗎？你到底是什麼人？
Come sit next to me, I want to discuss what just happened.
來坐我旁邊，我想討論剛才那件事。
I expected the worst yet was still surprised by that... That fiend really did it on purpose, and Commander Ferreo let it happen...
我做了最壞的打算，結果還是被嚇到……那個惡棍真的是故意的，而 Ferreo 指揮官任由這種事發生……
I suppose we should talk about how the shield challenge went. That might end up making me angrier, but I should tell you...
我想我們該談談盾牌挑戰的結果。講了可能會讓我更火大，但我還是應該告訴你……
I started the test, confident, ready to make that instructor eat his words, show him that I am not a failure. And I still couldn't block a single arrow.
我開始測驗的時候很有信心，準備好讓那個教官把話吞回去，讓他看見我不是個廢物。結果我還是連一支箭都擋不下來。
He wouldn't even let me retry it, just told me to leave the room. I protested, I said that wasn't fair, but he insisted...
他連讓我重試都不肯，只叫我離開房間。我抗議了，我說那不公平，但他堅持……
And what about you, how did the shield challenge go?
那你呢，盾牌挑戰怎麼樣？
That's great to hear, maybe you can show me how you did it sometime-
太好了，也許你哪天可以教我你是怎麼做到的——
I'm sorry to hear about that, we're in this together-
聽到這個我很難過，我們是一起的——
I-I was just wondering... No need to get-
我、我只是在想……不用這麼——
Ah, you again... I've decided that I won't be going with you, I have done nothing to deserve such punishment, and will not stand to be treated like this.
啊，又是你……我決定了，我不會跟你走，我沒有做任何該受這種懲罰的事，我也不會忍受被這樣對待。
Don't talk to him like he's one of your servants, Arnol. Your family name means nothing here, if he asks you to go with him, you must go!
別把他當成你家的僕人講話，Arnol。你的家族姓氏在這裡什麼都不是，他叫你跟他走，你就得走！
This childish tantrum of yours will be noted. Now come with me before you start a scene. You are here to serve us, not the other way around.
你這場幼稚的鬧脾氣會被記下來。現在，在你鬧出場面之前跟我走。你是來替我們服務的，不是反過來。
Wow, I didn't think Arnol had it in him to talk back to someone like that... Anyway, are you ready for dueling? Follow me.
哇，我沒想到 Arnol 有膽對那種人頂嘴……總之，你準備好決鬥了嗎？跟我來。
Poor Arnol, he's going to become a soldier and yet he still can't control his temper tantrums.
可憐的 Arnol，都要當士兵了還控制不住自己耍脾氣。
What's next? Is he going to ask Commander Ferreo if he can change his diaper for him?
接下來呢？他是不是要去問 Ferreo 指揮官能不能幫他換尿布？
Head to the challenge room and recieve instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 的挑戰室，接受今天最後一項挑戰的說明。
This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
這是你們今天最後一項訓練。與另一名新兵單獨近戰對決。
The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
規則跟前一天相同。還沒拿訓練劍的，從桌上拿一把，準備好就從那道大門進去。
I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is somthing I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
我今天有事要處理，無法監督你們的挑戰。我請了另一位教官代勞，他們在決鬥室等著。
Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
現在去開始決鬥吧，祝各位好運。
Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
進入下一個房間，完成今天最後一項挑戰。
Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
記得別把事情看得太重。當一個好士兵，不見得就是要贏。
Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
Ferreo 指揮官想跟你談談，別讓他等。
Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
別跟他說我這麼講，不過我弟 Robin 在這項挑戰上比我有優勢。
As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
但只要我永遠不跟他對上，他就不會發現這件事，所以我才讓他先走。
Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
說不定我贏了我的對手、而他輸了，他就會相信我比較強！
I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
我還不想讓你開始決鬥，你的對手還沒到。我們一起等他。
There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
你來啦，Arnol。我聽說你午餐時發了一頓脾氣。你會明白那種事在這裡是不能接受的。
This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
Arnol，這位就是你要對決的人。你們兩個是朋友吧？那這場決鬥肯定能給你們兩個上一堂寶貴的課。
Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
寶貴的課？指揮官，這是什麼意思？這是陷阱嗎？讓我跟我的朋友決鬥有什麼意義？
You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
你該知道不能質疑上級的命令，Arnol。現在你們兩個，進決鬥室。
Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
上前，決鬥開始。你們任何一方若有所保留，我就讓你們重來，需要幾次就幾次。
You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
你表現得比我預期的好，Arnol。不過結果仍然如我所想。
Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
那這場決鬥的意義何在，既然您早就知道我會輸！您是想進一步羞辱我嗎？您羞辱得還不夠嗎？！
Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
你的傲慢真是毫無底線。我還得罰你多少次，你才會開始認真看待這裡的事？
You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with in private.
你快變成無可救藥的人了，Arnol。現在走吧，我有些事想私下談。
Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
你對他的善意對他沒有半點好處。Arnol 必須先知道痛是什麼，才可能變強，而你的友情正在阻礙這件事。
For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
為你們兩個好，我要求你切斷跟他的關係。
Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
離開決鬥室，然後到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 的兵營睡覺。
Do not take my advice for granted.
別把我的忠告當耳邊風。
Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
只有我覺得這些挑戰沒什麼了不起嗎？它們跟當士兵好像沒什麼關係。
Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
唉，算了。至少還算有點好玩，這我承認。我只希望其他新兵別看得那麼認真。
Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
做得好，你信守承諾拿到更好的排名了！我相信 Ferreo 指揮官和 Olissy 招募官都會很驕傲。
I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know must be constantly trying to improve!
我把第一次排名的羞恥當成動力，在今天的挑戰上更努力。我很慶幸自己一開始表現不好，因為現在我知道自己必須不斷進步！
I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
我現在許下同樣的承諾: 明天我的排名會比現在更高！
I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
我失敗了……我這輩子都當不成羽翼士兵了……
Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
你不覺得自己有點誇張嗎？我覺得你表現得很好，你又不是排在最後面。
Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
你說得倒輕鬆……你早就在羽翼組了，你什麼都不必爭取，你天生就好！你永遠不會知道當一個失敗者是什麼滋味！
I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
真不敢相信第二天就這樣過完了。趁還是新兵好好享受吧，接下來只會愈來愈難。
You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
你已經岌岌可危了，Priscilla……你比昨天完全沒有進步！要是我讓一個弱者跟在身邊，別人會怎麼想？
Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top {~} tomorrow!
拜託，Lynn！再給我一次機會！我保證明天一定進前 {~} 名！
Make it top {~}! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
改成前 {~} 名！如果你做不到……我就再也不跟你說話！
Top {~}!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top {~} tomorrow, I promise!
前 {~} 名？！那……呃……好吧，我明天一定進前 {~} 名，我保證！
You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
你不值得我浪費時間。幫個忙，滾遠一點。
I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
今天午餐那件事我可以先放一邊。你只需要告訴我，你或 Arnol 是怎麼查到我第一天決鬥發生了什麼。
I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
我沒那麼好騙，我不信你們兩個是來討教的那套說詞。
You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
你最好認真看待這個提議。我不是那種你會想當成敵人的人。
It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
那是僥倖，這是你能贏我一分的唯一解釋！那什麼都不代表！
Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
是喔……你就繼續這樣告訴自己吧，但你心底知道我贏了你。我絕不會讓你忘記這件事！
They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
他們吵好一陣子了。你覺得明天誰會贏誰？
I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
我不確定……你覺得如果他們打平會怎樣？
I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
希望別發生，他們大概會整晚不睡，爭論誰比較厲害。
Could this day have gone any worse?
The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
那位可敬的 Ferreo 指揮官，眼睜睜看著 Adder 把一名同袍新兵打得半死，什麼都沒做……
The instructors of the esteemed {p} recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
備受推崇的 {p} 新兵計畫，那些教官似乎根本無意真的訓練我們……
And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
而我也開始懷疑「替家族爭光」這件事了……
At least I'm not alone though...
Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
潛行探查 Ferreo 指揮官的計畫。
You found all of my diary entries, well done.
你把我的日記全找齊了，做得好。
It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
我藏起來太久了，久到我都快忘記它們存在過。
Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
別指望有什麼獎章之類的，不過關於那些日記，你有問題我可以回答一些。
It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in {p}.
那是 Ferreo 指揮官最後的羞辱。那就是我為什麼會在這裡，在 {p} 當一名衛兵。
After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
我從新兵計畫結業之後，平均排名被認為太低，進不了任何外勤隊長或指揮官的麾下。
So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
於是 Ferreo 親自出面收下我，把我派駐在這裡蹉跎。我想那是某種懲罰吧……
I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
老實說我不太確定。也許我是希望有個像你這樣機靈的新兵找到它們，別重蹈我的覆轍。
It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
不過也可能只是無聊。我想不起來當年成為士兵之後、藏起它們的時候，腦子裡在想什麼了。
Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have though after reading them...
在心底……也許我是希望 Ferreo 指揮官找到那些筆記。不知道他讀完之後會怎麼想……

I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
我就知道你會問這個。而且出乎意料地，是的，我確實查出了 Ferreo 指揮官成功的真相。那沒有什麼祕密。他全靠一股想變得更強的猛烈決心。
When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in {p}. Not living, just, surviving.
Ferreo 指揮官年輕的時候一無所有，他是 {p} 的一個流浪漢。那不叫生活，只叫活著。
Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
有時候 Fruma 軍隊會來造訪，全鎮的人都聚在一起看他們。Ferreo 看見大家如何愛戴、讚頌他們的英勇。
He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
他極度渴望自己也能被那樣讚頌、被那樣愛戴。於是他把爬到那個位置定為目標，克服了路上無數的阻礙。
Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
憑著純粹的實力與專精，他很快就當上羽翼指揮官，過程中還打破了軍中的紀錄。
There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
有傳言說他還想更進一步，試圖成為統領——即使當時所有的位置都滿了……
He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
他終於達到了他當初追求的名聲與景仰。但我想，更高處的可能性折磨著他。
Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
知道的人不多，但就在他被授予現在這個職位之前，Ferreo 指揮官曾與 Majin 統領和女王會面。
We can only speculate at what the discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of {p}. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
他們談了什麼我們只能揣測，但那場會面後不久，Majin 就任命 Ferreo 指揮官為 {p} 的首長。我猜他是因為自己的野心而受了罰……
Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.
訓練加油，新兵。我建議你比我當年更認真看待它。
Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
抱歉，我還是不能放你進去。
I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
我昨天聽見你半夜起身四處潛行，就開始懷疑你。
And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
而你居然還查到了我第一場決鬥的結果……我能得出的唯一結論是，你一直在監視 Ferreo 指揮官。
For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
就憑這一點，你就該被流放、處決，或監禁。
But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
不過……我一直想找點挑戰，目前為止的訓練實在不痛不癢。我想看看一個反抗軍的間諜有幾分本事。
If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land {~} hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
如果你能在決鬥中勝過我，我就不向 Ferreo 指揮官舉報你。先擊中對方 {~} 下的人，即為勝者。
As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
為表誠意，我讓你先打中我第一下。
Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
以一聲低吼與憤怒的粒子效果作為預兆，Adder 會揮出他的刺劍橫掃。完美格擋這一擊會使他暈眩，讓你有機會反擊。
Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.
以一聲沒有憤怒粒子的低吼作為預兆，Adder 會向側邊跳開。

Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
以一聲低吼與憤怒、藍色的粒子效果作為預兆，Adder 會向前突進，持刺劍衝刺。這一招造成兩次傷害，一次在起手、一次在突進的頂點。完美格擋最後一擊會使他暈眩。
Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the {u} for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
以憤怒與綠色的粒子效果作為預兆，Adder 會朝 {u} 一邊奔跑、一邊連續橫掃刺劍數秒。完美格擋最後一擊會使他暈眩。
Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
荒謬……即使經歷了那一切，我還是不夠強……
Make your way through the vents.
We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
我們陷入了極為棘手的處境，Strumon……
We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
我們的新兵裡有間諜，而且我們知道是誰，那個傳令兵卻要我們在 Majin 統領到來之前什麼都別做！？
I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
指揮官，我認為此刻謹慎很重要，如果這名間諜真如傳令兵暗示的那麼強……這可能會是我們所有人的終結……
Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
是，你大概說得對。話雖如此，一旦 Majin 統領抵達，看見我讓一名間諜進了新兵計畫……我怕我一生的心血都會毀於一旦……
I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...
我不會這麼輕易放棄，也不會在等 Majin 統領抵達的期間什麼都不做……

I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
我要 Effal 以叛國罪立即流放到 Wynn。是他讓間諜進來的，必須為此受罰。找個衛兵接替他招募官的位置，隨便誰都會比他稱職。
Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
把這件事傳達給其他衛兵和招募官。Effal 明天之前就該離開 Fruma！
Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
指揮官，還有另一件事我想向您提出，那也是我這麼晚還來您辦公室的原因。
Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
您昨天的計畫進行得非常順利。我跟軍醫確認過了，他說 Katze 必須被送回家。
Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
很好，明天讓 Adder 對上 Arnol。他的家族姓氏再也彌補不了他的軟弱！
Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
指揮官……這真的是最好的選擇嗎？那名間諜似乎對 Arnol 頗有好感。我擔心這麼做會引來他們的報復……
Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
惹惱一個受詛者，真的讓你這麼害怕嗎，Strumon？何況我預期 Majin 統領那時候已經到了，你的顧慮是多餘的。
Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
指揮官、招募官，有件緊急的事需要處理。請跟我來！
Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
把通風口的螺絲拆下來，然後回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 的兵營叫醒 Arnol。
What is this about, {u}? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
怎麼了，{u}？為什麼一大早就把我叫醒？
What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
什麼！？我對上 Adder 根本毫無勝算！我要是跟他對決，他搞不好會殺了我！不過我早該料到 Ferreo 指揮官會做這種事……
If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, {u}?
既然你現在告訴我這件事，你一定對怎麼幫我脫困有點想法。你的計畫是什麼，{u}？
Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
唔……好，我信任你。趁還沒有人醒來，我們走吧。
Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
從 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Tericen 入口逃出去。
We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
我們要從正門走？萬一被衛兵看到怎麼辦？
Alright, I'll try to stay close.
Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
奇怪……好像一個值勤的衛兵都沒有……
Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
你們要去哪裡？我不記得我讓你們兩個離開。
I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
我還以為到現在你們都該明白，這裡不容許違抗命令。也不容許叛國……
Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
Arnol 知道你是間諜嗎？想想看，如果他家人發現他跟反抗軍勾結，會怎麼想。
I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
他就交給他家人處理。至於你……起訴你的責任，落到了我身上。
There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
在 Fruma，你和你的同類都沒有希望！
I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
我從未輸過一場決鬥，別自以為我會讓你打破這個紀錄！
I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
我不會死在這裡！更不會死在你這種人手上！
That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
夠了，指揮官，你顯然不是對手。
Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
謝謝你……在這一切之後還照看著我，即使你根本沒有理由這麼做……
I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
我這輩子都在漂流，漫無目的……但現在我知道我的目標是什麼了，多虧了你……
My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
我的目標，是確保像 Ferreo 指揮官這樣的暴君得到應有的下場。看來這也是你的目標。
I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
我現在必須獨自上路了，希望有一天我們能再見。我向你保證，到那時我會更強！
I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
我從小被教導受詛者是邪惡的，可你除了幫我什麼都沒做過。看來那也只是另一個謊言……
Are you a recruit as well? You certainly look strong. I imagine you must have a lot of experience.
你也是新兵嗎？你看起來確實很強。想必經驗豐富吧。
I am a bit newer to this than you, but I may still be able to offer you some insights if you're curious.
我在這方面比你新一點，不過如果你好奇，我或許還是能提供一些見解。
Well... A carriage rode me halfway to {p}, then it broke down and I had to walk the rest of the way. When I finally arrived the King himself was there to greet me and made me a recruit.
這個嘛……馬車載我往 {p} 走到一半就壞了，剩下的路我只能用走的。等我終於抵達，是國王親自來迎接我，還讓我當上了新兵。
I can't seem to remember anything before that though... It probably wasn't too important, what's important is my new job as a recruit!
不過在那之前的事我好像都想不起來了……大概也不太重要吧，重要的是我這份新兵的新工作！
I wonder if the King will give me a promotion soon...
不知道國王會不會很快就給我升職……
No... I can't say I have ever seen you before... Are you a fan or something?
沒有……我不記得見過你……你是我的粉絲之類的嗎？
I didn't imagine having fans already but that's great! I'm already on the path of becoming the most famous person in Wynn!
我沒想到自己這麼快就有粉絲了，不過這太棒了！我已經走在成為 Wynn 最有名的人的路上了！
Waiting? I'm not waiting for anything! I'm just resting... That's all!
等？我沒在等什麼！我只是在休息……就這樣！
It's tiring doing so much work out there. Plus I need to give the other recruits and guards a chance to prove themselves, I shouldn't hog all of the glory!
在外面做那麼多事很累人的。而且我也得給其他新兵和衛兵一點證明自己的機會，我不該把榮耀都獨吞了！
You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine out there. Just because you look stronger doesn't mean I'm weak!
你不必替我擔心，我在外面不會有事的。你看起來比較強，不代表我就弱！
You're the one who should be worried... Worried about me surpassing you of course!
該擔心的是你——當然是擔心我會超越你！
But hey, we're on the same side, so let's both keep fighting out there! For the King!
不過嘿，我們是同一邊的，所以我們都在外面繼續奮鬥吧！為了國王！
Thank you again...soldier. For helping us make peace...
再次感謝你……士兵。謝謝你幫我們實現和平……
Please take a track controller before entering the rail line.
進入鐵道前，請先拿一個軌道控制器。
This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
這根本是場災難……但願回收隊那邊別再出事。
I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
要是又有人因我而死，我這輩子都過不去。
But I must do what it takes to protect {p} from any more disaster.
但為了不讓 {p} 再遭遇任何災難，該做的我都得做。
Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
Atila，你回來了！直說吧，他們成功了嗎？我們再也承受不起任何損失。
The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
那座升降梯直通那條龍臥著的地方。不知道她什麼時候睡著，去就是在賭。
The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble...
那座升降梯直通那條龍臥著的地方。不知道她什麼時候睡著，去就是在賭。
It's a great feat what you've accomplished. The dwarven defense system was thought to be impeccable. We'll need to rethink our security!
你完成了一項了不起的壯舉。矮人的防禦系統本來被認為無懈可擊。我們得重新檢討我們的保全了！
So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
所以我們真的非得穿過金庫不可。可是防禦系統又全亂了……
Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
別放在心上，我們回頭重新想辦法。
Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
那邊那個，人類！你來這裡做什麼？過來跟我說話。
What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
你來這裡有什麼事？這裡禁止進入，金庫現在非常危險。
Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
這麼一看，你那身裝備品質相當好啊，是吧？你叫什麼名字？
Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high quality, yeah? What's your name?
這麼一看，你那身裝備品質相當好啊，是吧？你叫什麼名字？
... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
……這名字我在哪聽過……噢，我想起來了！你就是打倒那個叫 Qira 的女人的傢伙，對吧？
... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
……這名字我在哪聽過……噢，我想起來了！Dogun 那整件事就是你幫忙解決的，對吧？
I see, I haven't seen you around before.
原來如此，我以前沒在這附近見過你。
{u}..? I see, I haven't seen you around before.
{u}……？原來如此，我以前沒在這附近見過你。
Nevertheless, {p} is in danger. To put it simply, a dragon is living uninvited in our despository.
無論如何，{p} 正身陷危險。簡單說，有一條龍不請自來，住進了我們的儲藏庫。
Perhaps you've seen its lair above our city. Normally she leaves us unharmed, but one day she suddenly made her way in to this vault.
你或許看過她在我們城市上方的巢。她平常不會傷害我們，但有一天她突然闖進了這座金庫。
My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
我的好友 Atila 一直帶著偵察小隊，他判斷那條龍正在孵一顆蛋。
We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
我們不惜代價想把那顆蛋偷出來、送回她的巢，也許她就會離開……但你也聽到了，進展並不順利。
I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it is worth all your trouble.
我平常不會向陌生人開這種口，但我們實在人手耗盡了。你願意幫忙嗎？我一定會讓你的辛苦有所回報。
So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
你願意幫！？太感謝了！我保證你花的每一刻都值得！
You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
你得穿過我身後這座廳室才能抵達儲藏庫。另一條路正好就在那條龍待著的地方……
You have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
你得穿過我身後這座廳室才能抵達儲藏庫。另一條路正好就在那條龍待著的地方……
The people of {p} have everlasting gratitude, soldier.
{p} 的人民將永遠感激你，士兵。
新任務開始: {p} 儲藏庫
Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
Atila 知道一些金庫內部的運作方式。祝你好運，我會為你的成功祈禱。你的勇氣會鼓舞整個 {p}。
Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
噢，看來這事終究是不成了……
Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
好吧，如果我們日後再遇上，我依然會非常感謝你的協助……回頭再想辦法吧……
Find a way through the depository.
Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository
Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.
偷走 Ozoth 的蛋並逃出儲藏庫。
Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
噢——我的天啊！！我還以為你死了，以為那條龍是把一具屍體送上來給我！
You really got it!? Hurry then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...
你真的拿到了！？那快，巢就在這個洞穴上去的地方！也許 {p} 終於能擺脫這場麻煩了……
Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [{~},-{~}].
把 Ozoth 的蛋放回她的巢，座標 [{~},-{~}]。
She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
她很美，不是嗎？不過終究是頭怪物。
{u}! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
{u}！這邊……Atila 把消息告訴我了，我用最快的速度趕過來！
You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, {p} no longer has to live in fear.
你是英雄，小子！那條龍離開我們的城市，{p} 再也不用活在恐懼裡了。
I've prepared your reward. The people of {p} will remember your contribution years to come.
你的報酬我準備好了。{p} 的人民會在往後的許多年裡記得你的貢獻。
Tell me what I should know.
So you've taken the job. Good luck to you in there.
所以你接下這份工作了。祝你在裡面順利。
What would you like to do?
The way to the depository is guarded by some dragon-like sentinels. They're meant to cook any thieves to be well done.
通往儲藏庫的路由幾尊像龍的哨衛守著。它們的用途就是把小偷烤到全熟。
There's a bit of a workaround though, if you kill the living sentinel, they'll deactivate and you can go through.
不過有個小辦法: 你只要殺掉那個活的哨衛，它們就會停下來，你就過得去了。
Make sure you don't get scorched either, the statues take a few seconds before they breath their flames. Good luck and godspeed!
也要小心別被燒到，那些雕像會隔幾秒才吐火。祝你好運，一路順風！
You'll be going directly in to the chamber. Once you see she's asleep, you book it to the egg!
你會直接進到那間廳室。一看到她睡著了，就立刻衝去拿蛋！
I understand if you're worried, but right now I can't think of anything else we can do...
你擔心我可以理解，但目前我想不出我們還能做什麼……
Don't wait any longer, {u}! Place the egg and we can finally lure that wretched dragon out!
別再等了，{u}！把蛋放下去，我們終於可以把那條可惡的龍引出來了！
These must be the Wood Sprites Dodegar was talking about...
這些一定就是 Dodegar 說的木之精靈了……
Dodegar carefully grabs the piece of wood and begins carving.
Dodegar 小心翼翼地拿起那塊木頭，開始雕刻。
到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Dodegar Bandysnoot 交談。
I'm glad you came along, I could do with a little help if you're not too busy.
你來得正好，如果你不太忙的話，我這裡需要點幫忙。
I'm Dodegar Bandysnoot, the world famous Hobbit swordsmith! Perhaps you've heard of me?
我是 Dodegar Bandysnoot，舉世聞名的哈比鑄劍師！也許你聽過我？
No? Oh... Well, I've had an idea about how I could make the best weapon that the world has ever seen!
沒有？喔……好吧，總之我想到了一個點子，可以打造出世上前所未見的最強武器！
But, I need some help getting the special resources to make it.
不過我需要有人幫我弄到製作它的特殊材料。
You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
你願意幫忙？！太好了！我們要蒐集到足夠的材料，一人做一把！
So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
首先，我需要一些活木來做握柄，[{~} Enchanted Stick] 應該就夠了。
The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
河對岸往西，那棵大樹幹裡住著木精靈，他們身上帶有魔力！這樣握柄就能貼合使用者的手形！要弄到一根應該不難！
I hope you are prepared, this will be your best quest yet!
希望你準備好了，這會是你至今最棒的一趟任務！

Sigh... she mentioned it to you too, didn't she? That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
唉……她也跟你提過吧？那場籠罩我們世界、由超乎我們之上的力量在打的無止盡戰爭？
I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did, too- and more. Once you know what to look for, it's everywhere. Light and Dark... and the War they leave in their wake.
我在 Gavel 瞥見過一些……我相信你看到的比我更多。一旦知道該看什麼，它就無所不在——光與暗，以及它們身後留下的那場「戰爭」。
The list goes on with various... odd statistics.
清單上接著列出各式各樣……古怪的數據。
It's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse. They're beyond our means to stop, so... the best we can do is keep them at balance.
正因為雙方僵持不下，事情才沒有更糟。它們不是我們有能力阻止的，所以……我們能做的，頂多是讓它們維持平衡。
She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
她說正因為雙方僵持不下，事情才沒有更糟，而……我相信。
...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
……然後就是那個選擇。加入她，幫忙確保那場戰爭裡沒有任何一方取得太大的優勢……或者……不加入。
To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and- and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that- that he's-
把它丟給別人去管，忘掉它、過我自己的日子，而我怎麼可能做得到，我明明知道他已經——
At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
至少在這裡……我做得到一些改變。在那場戰爭裡，也在 Fruma 裡。
If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
反正我都已經在這個位置上了……至少我能推動一些改變。
Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
倒不是說待在 Fruma 因此就變得比較好受了，哈。這裡的每一樣東西都在提醒我……嗯。你懂的。
...I am. I'm not sure how to feel about it still, honestly.
……我是。老實說，我到現在還是不知道該怎麼看待它。
There's... two parts to it. Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
這件事有……兩個部分。握有權限、指揮士兵，感覺很……奇怪。我不知道自己會不會習慣。
I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
我從來沒有過那種權力。可以叫別人做事，然後……他們就真的去做。
I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
我有了一個真的能推動改變、能讓事情變好的聲音，而……那感覺有點不勞而獲。
I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
我還是跟以前一樣的我！可是現在，有了這個被給予的頭銜，人們突然就願意聽我說話了。
... I don't like that that's all it took.
……我不喜歡「原來只需要這樣」這件事。
It's a strange feeling. Not... unpleasant, exactly, but not comfortable, either. A constant weight on my shoulder, reminding me of what I've signed up for.
那是一種很奇怪的感覺。不算……不舒服，但也稱不上自在。像肩上一份持續的重量，提醒我自己簽下了什麼。
It's always there, a... a small push to react to things I haven't noticed yet, that I wouldn't notice without it.
它一直都在，像……像一股小小的推力，讓我去反應那些我還沒察覺、若沒有它就不會察覺的事。
And the more focus I put on it, the stronger it gets. More overwhelming to keep track of, but... stronger.
而我愈是把注意力放在它上面，它就愈強。愈難掌握，但……也愈強。
...I try not to use it unless I have to.
She mentioned it to you too, didn't she?
That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
那場籠罩我們世界、由超乎我們之上的力量在打的無止盡戰爭？
I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did too- and more.
我在 Gavel 瞥見過一些……我相信你看到的比我更多。
…sigh. I thought… I thought I had it all figured out, but you being here is making things harder than I’d like.
……唉。我以為……我以為我都想通了，可是你出現在這裡，讓事情比我想要的更難。
Ha. Well… sort of, but not really. You’ve learned what it really means by now, then? Horrible, uncontrollable power… so they say.
哈。這個嘛……算是，但也不完全是。那你現在該明白它真正的意思了吧？可怕、無法控制的力量……他們是這麼說的。
It's all paper-thin, in the end. It's just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored.
說到底，那一切都薄得像張紙。它不過是控制人民的手段，好把所有魔法都關起來、盯著看。
...and knowing that it was all manufactured, that there was never anything actually... wrong...
……而知道那全是編造出來的，知道根本從來就沒有什麼……不對勁的地方……
To some extent, it's a relief - but more than that it makes me angry. This was weighing on me for so long, and for it to mean... nothing, in the end?
某種程度上那是種解脫，但比起解脫，它更讓我生氣。這件事壓了我這麼久，到頭來卻……什麼都不是？
...just another thing I want to change in Fruma. If I get the chance, that is.
……又是一件我想在 Fruma 改變的事。前提是我有機會。
...you being here is only making it harder for me to do anything about it of course.
……而你出現在這裡，當然只會讓我更難為此做點什麼。
They didn’t want us here. We were… disposable soldiers, just a resource to keep Wynn standing.
他們並不想要我們在這裡。我們是……可拋棄的士兵，只是讓 Wynn 撐下去的一項資源。
But now, all of a sudden… Now, they’ve changed their mind.
可是現在，突然之間……現在，他們改變主意了。
But I can’t just… forget. I had my memories discarded, and was shipped off to Wynn, for something beyond my control.
可是我沒辦法就這樣……忘掉。我的記憶被丟棄，我被送去 Wynn，為了一件我無法控制的事。
For something I’ve learned to appreciate over time. For something that was never really a curse!!
為了一件我後來慢慢學會珍惜的事。為了一件從來就不是詛咒的事！！
I did some digging when I got here, you know? I went looking for anyone I might have known here, before……
我到了這裡之後查過，你知道吧？我去找過任何我以前可能認識的人……
No one. Not a single person who knew me. Not a single person left to miss me, or even notice my absence!
一個也沒有。沒有一個人認識我。沒有一個人會想念我，甚至不會有人注意到我不在了！
I had my self stripped away from me, and it doesn’t even matter! Because there was nothing here for me anyway!!
我的自我被剝奪了，而那甚至根本不重要！因為這裡本來就沒有任何屬於我的東西！！
I can’t imagine the same for Aledar. He must have had… someone.
Aledar 就不可能是這樣了。他一定有……有某個人。
I guess it doesn’t matter. He’s gone anyway, isn’t he?
我想那也無所謂了。反正他已經不在了，不是嗎？
Why? Because you've been causing the crown problems ever since you broke in.
為什麼？因為自從你闖進來之後，你就一直在給王室製造麻煩。
Nobody will listen to anything not related to you... and for good reason! You massacred a fort of soldiers, you've killed Sovereign Zhiraok twice now...
只要跟你無關的事，沒有人肯聽……而且理由充分！你屠了一整座堡壘的士兵，你到現在已經殺了 Zhiraok 統領兩次……
Fine. You've killed Sovereign Zhiraok once, and... helped a second time...?
好吧。你殺了 Zhiraok 統領一次，然後……第二次是幫忙……？
...okay. And that isn't to mention the plot to kill the Queen.
……好。而那還沒算上刺殺女王的那樁計畫。
I...ugh. I wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
我……唉。我真希望事情沒有走到那一步。
I know. I know. I tried to warn you, to get you to call it off, but...sigh. It doesn't matter now. It's already done.
我知道。我知道。我試過警告你、想讓你收手，可是……唉。現在講也沒用了。已經發生了。
...I'm sorry about the rest of your friends. The Leaves in the Wind. They... they seem like nice people.
……你其他的朋友，我很遺憾。風中之葉。他們……他們看起來是好人。
I've gotten off track. I had something I needed to tell you.
我扯遠了。我有件事必須告訴你。
The crown has soldiers out looking for you. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to...explain things.
王室派了士兵在找你。女王陛下想跟你談談，想……把事情解釋清楚。
I… I guess so. I guess you’ve finally made an impression on her.
我……我想是吧。我想你總算讓她留下印象了。
I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was… but that doesn’t mean I have to like it.
我現在明白那場錦標賽為什麼要那樣辦了……但那不代表我就得喜歡它。
…I think you should hear her out, but that’s your choice to make. I just thought you should know.
……我認為你應該聽她說完，不過那是你自己的選擇。我只是覺得你該知道。
…okay. I can do that. Who first?
...me? I... I guess I'm one now, too. I'm still not sure how to feel about it, honestly. There's... two parts to it.
……我？我……我想我現在也算是其中之一了。老實說我到現在還是不知道該怎麼看待它。這件事有……兩個部分。
Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
握有權限、指揮士兵，感覺很……奇怪。我不知道自己會不會習慣。
He’s… probably the best of them all. He does genuinely care about his district’s well-being - I’ve seen the stuff he’s done over {~} years.
他……大概是他們之中最好的一個。他是真心在乎自己轄區的福祉——這 {~} 年來他做過的事我都看在眼裡。
When I was ascending… he was the only one who bothered telling me what to expect ahead of time.
我在飛升的時候……只有他願意事先告訴我會遇到什麼。
…he’s not perfect. Nobody in these positions of power is. But he’s the best Fruma has to offer.
……他並不完美。坐在那些位置上的人沒有一個是完美的。但他已經是 Fruma 拿得出來最好的了。
I still feel like I don’t entirely understand… I don’t know. Whatever it was she was working on - which you stole, by the way - it was important.
我還是覺得自己沒有完全搞懂……我不知道。總之她在做的那個、被你偷走的東西，那很重要。
…Zhiraok says she neglected her district, and left it on him to pick up the slack. Was that because of the project, or… did she just not care?
……Zhiraok 說她疏於管理自己的轄區，把爛攤子丟給他收。那是因為那個計畫，還是……她根本就不在乎？
I don’t know. And, now… she’s gone, either way.
我不知道。而且，現在……不管怎樣，她都不在了。
Eugh. He’s... frustrating. I mean we both saw him during that tournament, right? He really thinks he’s better than everyone else around him.
呃。他……很讓人火大。你想想，那場錦標賽上我們都看到他了吧？他是真心覺得自己高人一等。
What’s annoying is that he actually has the skill to back those claims up! There’s a reason he leads the military, after all. Apparently, he even taught himself magic!
討厭的是他確實有本事撐起那些大話！他能領軍不是沒有原因的。而且據說他的魔法還是自學的！
…truth be told, I’m not unfamiliar with dealing with this kind of person. You’ve seen Kymer. I just… wish it didn’t get to me as much as it does.
……老實說，應付這種人我並不陌生。你也見過 Kymer。我只是……希望它不要這麼容易影響到我。
I don’t know much about them. I’ve only met them a few times, but they’re… off-putting. I get the sense this is all just a game for them.
我對他們所知不多。我只見過他們幾次，但他們……讓人很不舒服。我感覺這一切對他們來說都只是一場遊戲。
…to tell you the truth… they scare me. I don’t think there’s a boundary they’re unwilling to cross, in order to achieve results.
……老實說……他們讓我害怕。我不覺得有什麼界線是他們為了結果不肯跨過去的。
You might end up running into them while you’re here. If you do… be careful, alright?
你在這裡搞不好會撞見他們。真的撞見的話……小心點，好嗎？
He’s… dangerous. I’ve only met him once, when I was ascending, but once was enough.
他……很危險。我只在飛升的時候見過他一次，但一次就夠了。
In terms of sheer brute power, he has the most of any of the Sovereigns. You can feel it radiating off of him. He could crush you with barely a second thought, if he wanted.
純以蠻力而言，他在所有統領裡是最強的。你感覺得到那股力量從他身上散出來。他只要願意，幾乎不必多想就能把你捏碎。
…luckily he stays at Gravity’s Monolith for the most part. He won’t be a problem if you just… stay away.
……所幸他大部分時間都待在重力方尖碑。只要你……離遠一點，他就不會是問題。
I would recommend you stay away. Take it as a warning from a friend.
我會建議你離遠一點。就當是一個朋友的警告。
There’s… nothing much to say. Not because I don’t want to, but because I just don’t know that much about her.
沒……沒什麼好說的。不是因為我不想說，而是因為我對她真的所知不多。
She keeps her secrets to herself. I’ve only even spoken to her a few times, and all of it was about…
她把自己的祕密守得很緊。我甚至只跟她講過幾次話，而且全都是關於……
It’s what I received the blessing for.
那就是我領受祝福的原因。
I… don’t want to talk about it, right now. It won’t matter until all of this resolves, either way.
我……現在不想談那個。反正在這一切了結之前，它都還不重要。
She’s done awful, horrible things. All of Fruma’s problems trace themselves back to her, in some way.
她做過可怕的、恐怖的事。Fruma 所有的問題，追根究柢都能追到她身上。
But… there’s more to her than that.
She’s like us, you know? She was… forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn’t escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
她跟我們很像，你知道吧？她也曾……被逼進一個自己痛恨的角色，被困在逃不掉的地方。她被塑造成某種完全不由她掌控的東西。
And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom…
而最後，她……她找到了出路。或者該說，她自己闢出了一條路。又抓又推又打，只為了任何一絲自由的可能……
…it’s rare to find someone who understands, you know? Of course, I’ve had you, and… and Aledar, but it’s isolating. Even others from Fruma, they just… don’t get it.
……能遇到一個懂的人實在太難得了，你懂吧？當然，我有你，還有……還有 Aledar，可是那還是很孤獨。就連其他從 Fruma 來的人，也……就是不懂。
So to have found someone who knows what it’s like, who managed to forge her own path forward… that connection feels worth holding onto.
所以能找到一個知道那是什麼滋味、又設法為自己開出路來的人……那份連結感覺值得抓住。
I should be going. And… you should get back to your friends.
我該走了。而……你也該回去找你的朋友了。
Before I do… I have a warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p}- Gikyo… they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They’re preparing an attack of some kind.
在那之前……我也有一個警告要給你。{p} 的統領 Gikyo……他們知道樹冠藏在哪裡。他們正在準備某種攻擊。
…you should be able to warn everybody in time this time around. Make sure nobody gets captured. If they do… it- it won’t be pretty.
……這一次你應該來得及警告所有人。務必別讓任何人被抓走。要是被抓……下場會很慘。
Now… go. Save the friends you still have left with you.
現在……去吧。去救你身邊還救得到的朋友。
{u}, you're... you're back. Does... does that mean you...?
{u}，你……你回來了。這……這是不是代表你……？
You're... you're alone. Where, um... where are they?
你……你是一個人。那，嗯……他們呢？
I didn't make it that far.
How do you know? H-how is it compromised?
你怎麼知道的？位、位置怎麼會曝光？
That... did he really do the same thing twice?! Ugh, why is he even helping us?
那……他真的做了同樣的事兩次？！唉，他到底為什麼要幫我們？
Hey hey, Sui and Yusanu! The creature has begun to speak! Isn't it a miracle?
嘿嘿，Sui、Yusanu！那生物開口說話了！這不是奇蹟嗎？
Oh, you return! That was... a rather quick excursion. Well, how was it then? Simple in-and-out break-in?
噢，你回來了！這趟……出門還真是快。那麼，如何？一進一出的簡單闖入？
Though I hadn't spotted any new arrivals, so... perhaps not.
不過我沒看到有新面孔到來，所以……大概不是吧。
I see, I see. Ran into too many guards, I suppose? It may be for the best, in any case - we've ourselves a talking changeling!
我懂了，我懂了。守衛太多，我猜？無論如何，這或許是好事——我們手上可有一隻會說話的換形者！
Now, as I was saying - you all should come and take a listen, it really is very-
那麼，就像我剛才說的——你們都該過來聽聽，那真的非常——
Oh dear! Why didn't you lead with that?! Goodness, that's a problem and a half... I'll have to inform Fuhue.
噢天哪！你怎麼不早說？！我的老天，這可是個大麻煩……我得去通知 Fuhue。
She just so happens to be questioning the prisoner as we speak, in fact! The little lizard has happened to spill some... rather interesting secrets.
說巧不巧，她此刻正好在審問那名俘虜！那隻小蜥蜴剛好吐出了一些……相當有意思的祕密。
Come along, kiddos! Let's give it a look, shall we?
跟上啊，孩子們！我們去看一眼，好嗎？
很好。你們來得正是時候。
It's shut up now, but it was speaking just a moment ago. Don't worry, I'll be able to get it talking again.
他現在閉嘴了，但剛剛還在說話。別擔心，我有辦法讓他再開口。
You'll want to hear what it says. It's relevant to your current concerns.
你們會想聽聽他說什麼的。那跟你們眼下關心的事有關。
Well alright, Fuhue, take it away!
Hm! Seems to have done the trick.
What? Magic? I don't know what that word means.
什麼？魔法？我不懂那個詞是什麼意思。
They refer to curses or blessings, captain.
隊長，他們指的是詛咒或祝福。
Oh! No, no, certainly not. It's a simple talisman. They're a traditional art, passed down to us through generations of the Canopy.
噢！不，不，當然不是。那只是一枚單純的護符。那是傳統技藝，在樹冠一代一代傳下來的。
I believe Master Azael explained it to Yusanu the other day? By inscribing specific glyphs in certain patterns, they can be ignited for varying powerful effects.
我記得 Azael 大師前幾天跟 Yusanu 解釋過？只要把特定的符文刻成特定的圖樣，就能點燃它們，產生各種強大的效果。
Through experimentation, we've determined which glyphs yield which results, though there's more we still don't know! As a matter of fact-
透過反覆實驗，我們判斷出哪些符文會產生哪些結果，不過還有更多是我們不知道的！事實上——
Fuhue, I appreciate the enthusiasm, I do, but shouldn't we return to the matter at hand?
Fuhue，我很欣賞你的熱情，真的，可是我們是不是該回到正題？
Yes. Of course. That's enough on talismans for now. Everyone, hurry up and take a look.
是的。當然。護符的事就到這裡。所有人，趕快過來看。
I am an ordinary citizen! This is a crime!
我是個普通市民！這是犯罪！
Ah, I see now. This one hadn't made it very far in its training. That would explain why it was so easy to capture.
啊，我明白了。這一隻的訓練還沒進行到很深的階段。難怪這麼容易就被抓到。
It- it knows! It knows their names, so- so does it know where-
他——他知道！他知道他們的名字，那——那他是不是知道他們在哪——
No mention of my brothers... or anyone else from the Steel Feather...
沒有提到我的兄弟……也沒提到鋼羽的任何人……
Oh... I- I didn't even... realize. I didn't even think... I- I'm sorry.
噢……我——我甚至沒有……想到。我根本沒有想到……我、我很抱歉。
It's... fine. I just... wish I could know for sure they're still alive out there.
沒……沒關係。我只是……希望能確定他們還活著。
Hey, little man, lighten up! The way I see it, it's incredibly likely they've split the two groups.
嘿，小夥子，振作點！依我看，他們把兩群人分開的可能性非常高。
Yes. It's a very common psychological torture technique! Splitting up groups of people does a number on one's-
沒錯。那是很常見的心理折磨手法！把一群人拆散，對一個人的——
Fuhue, really, do you think this is the time? Given our audience?
Fuhue，拜託，你覺得現在是時候嗎？考慮到我們的聽眾？
唉。沒有人欣賞我的洞見。
Now, importantly, all changelings receive training here in the {p}! The crown has a special fort up on the eastern mountainside for it.
重點來了，所有換形者都是在 {p} 這裡受訓的！王室在東邊山坡上有一座專門的堡壘。
Oh! Oh, we can organize a raid on the fort, gather information and find-
噢！噢，我們可以組織一次對那座堡壘的突襲，蒐集情報然後找到——
News? What news? I haven't heard anything from the owls yet this morning, and...
消息？什麼消息？我今天早上還沒收到梟們的任何回報，而且……
Did I forget? Forget what? Goodness, what am I missing...
我忘了？忘了什麼？天哪，我漏掉什麼了……
Oh! Oh, dear, right! Right right right! I remember now!
噢！噢，天啊，對了！對對對！我想起來了！
The crown knows our location, huh?
王室知道我們的位置了，是吧？
Again?! Gah!!! Barely get a month's rest before we have to move again...
又來？！啊啊啊！！！才休息不到一個月又要搬……
Ugh! I guess I'll go gather all our paperwork and emergency rations...
唉！那我去把我們所有的文書和緊急口糧收一收……
I'll summon the owls and deploy them to begin evacuations. I'll have to track down Cileon as well...
我去召集梟群，派他們開始疏散。我還得去把 Cileon 找出來……
You know they're just going to stay behind to take out as many soldiers as possible, right?
你知道他們只會留下來，能拖多少士兵就拖多少，對吧？
Cocky bastard... of course they will.
那個自大的傢伙……他們當然會。
Anyway! Kiddos, I'll meet you up at the top of this tree! That's where the Owls' headquarters are!
總之！孩子們，我們在這棵樹的頂端會合！梟群的總部就在那裡！
Rurie, I can't deal with all this paperwork on my own! Hand me two of your workers.
Rurie，這些文書我一個人處理不完！撥兩個你的人給我。
把 Sui 和 Yusanu 帶走！
Ah! Of course. That'll do. Well, chop chop outsiders. Pack up here!
啊！當然。這樣就行。好啦，快快快，外來者。這裡收一收！
Head to the meet up place at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
These talismans... the colors, pink green blue white gold... the shapes... there's something. There's something.
這些護符……那些顏色，粉紅、綠、藍、白、金……那些形狀……有什麼。一定有什麼。
I'm getting close, I can feel it. I just need... a little more time.
我快想到了，我感覺得到。我只需要……再一點時間。
They keep talking like we aren't here...
他們講話都當我們不在……
It's... it's okay. I know they're alive. There's hope! There's hope, there's hope, there's hope.
沒……沒關係。我知道他們還活著。還有希望！還有希望，還有希望，還有希望。
任務回報、庫存、位置計畫……
Ugh! I need to get to my lists. I can't think straight!
唉！我得回去看我的清單。我沒辦法好好思考！
Well, it's a good thing we have the emergency shelter! A shame it's in a cave. Sigh...
還好我們有緊急避難所！可惜它在一個洞穴裡。唉……
Well well well well! And there they all are!
Greetings are in order to the little doves! Ready to get moving then?
該向小鴿子們問好了！準備好出發了嗎？
Owls? Why, yes, of course - but you, dear friends, are doves. The small and defenseless, in dire need of aid...
梟？當然是啊——但你們，親愛的朋友們，是鴿子。弱小、沒有防備，急需援手……
Captain, if we're all in order, shouldn't we get moving? We're to lead them to the next hideout.
隊長，如果大家都到齊了，我們是不是該出發了？我們得帶他們去下一個藏身處。
Right you are! Right you are, indeed. Then to the north we shall fly, little doves and silent owls!
說得對！說得非常對。那就往北飛吧，小鴿子們，還有沉默的梟們！
Meet up with Sui, Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Sui、Yusanu 和 Rurie 隊長會合。
And so we fly forth, birds of the flock! Onwards we go!
於是我們振翅前行，同群之鳥！前進吧！
Oof! My goodness, they don't make these things quite like they used to! Since when have the ziplines been so... exhilerating?
哎唷！我的天，這種東西做得真是一代不如一代！這些滑索什麼時候變得這麼……刺激了？
Not the most graceful landing, captain.
Oh, what do you know?! Why don't you try to land gracefully in a- in- in a-... see how you do!!
噢，你懂什麼？！不然你來試試看，在——在——在一個……看你怎麼落得優雅！！
Ahem. Shall we get moving then? Over the hills and down the road, to the meet up spot we go!
咳。那我們出發吧？翻過山丘、沿著大路，往會合點去囉！
...{u}, Yusanu. When we get to safety, we... we should talk about what to do next.
……{u}、Yusanu。等我們安全了，我們……我們該談談接下來怎麼做。
Rex, Zeph... Mora... if- if they're here, then... then...
Rex、Zeph……Mora……如果、如果他們在這裡，那……那……
Don't worry, Sui, I... I get it. We'll do whatever we can to get your brother out of there. Promise.
別擔心，Sui，我……我懂。我們會盡一切努力把你哥哥救出來。我保證。
Speaking of the prodigal son and his companions, are we! My my, what a tragic tale... but perhaps I have an inkling of their present whereabouts.
說到那位浪子和他的同伴們！唉呀呀，多麼悲慘的故事……不過關於他們現在的下落，我或許略知一二。
You- you do? Why... why didn't you tell us sooner?!
你——你知道？那……那你為什麼不早點告訴我們？！
Ah ah! Sensitive information is for sensitive ears alone. I believed it best to wait for better circumstances... too many unknown faces back at the Canopy.
啊啊！敏感的情報只給敏感的耳朵。我認為最好等到情況更合適的時候……樹冠那邊有太多陌生面孔了。
Well, silent owls? Fly forth, update the others at the hideout on our whereabouts! I'll keep an eye on our little doves as we discuss matters further.
那麼，沉默的梟們？飛吧，去把我們的行蹤更新給藏身處的其他人！我會看著我們的小鴿子，我們繼續談。
...you're the boss, Captain. If you say so.
And I do say so! Well, chop chop, get it moving, wouldn't you?
我當然說了算！好啦，快快快，動起來，好嗎？
Ah... authority is its own sort of treat, isn't it?
啊……權威本身也是一種享受，不是嗎？
Rurie, you said you had a lead. What is it?
So impatient! So so impatient. Yes, fine, there is a military outpost just to the east, a flap of the wings as the bird flies! I will take you there.
真沒耐心！真是沒有耐心。好吧，東邊就有一座軍事哨站，鳥飛過去不過振幾下翅膀的距離！我帶你們去。
Uh... isn't that dangerous? You said that's where all the ch-
呃……那樣不危險嗎？你說過那裡就是所有換——
Yes well not everything can be so easy, can it?! Be brave! Take risks! Et cetera, et cetera.
是啊，可惜不是每件事都能那麼容易，對吧？！勇敢一點！冒點險！等等等等。
And with all the guards and soldiers and riffraff mobilized to the Canopy, it certainly will be simpler to sneak in! You do want to save your brother do you not?
而且所有守衛、士兵和雜魚都被調去樹冠了，潛進去肯定簡單得多！你們不是想救你哥哥嗎？
...still. We- we aren't much of fighters! If... if we get caught...
……可是。我——我們不太會打架！要、要是被抓到……
I- we can't, keep putting all the work on {u}'s shoulders. We need a better plan!
我——我們不能一直把事情都壓在 {u} 一個人肩上。我們需要更好的計畫！
Alas, it is now or it is never. Tick tock tick tock, time's running out, little doves! Onwards we shall fly, to save friend and family alike!
唉，機不可失，時不再來。滴答滴答滴答，時間不多了，小鴿子們！我們就飛吧，去救朋友，也救家人！
A problem? No... no, no no, there is no problem here! All is just as it should be.
問題？沒有……沒有，沒有沒有，這裡沒有任何問題！一切都正如它該有的樣子。
Are... are you- are you sure? You're... you're starting to scare me, Rurie.
你……你確、確定嗎？你……你開始讓我害怕了，Rurie。
H- huh?! Wh- what's going on?!
Th- thank you, Sui, that... I don't... you- you're really, uh, getting the hang of that ice stuff, aren't you?
謝、謝謝你，Sui，那……我不……你——你那個冰的東西真的愈來愈上手了嘛？
I... I didn't even... do that intentionally. It was... reflexive...
我……我根本不是……故意的。那是……反射動作……
B-but, more... more importantly- what happened? Where's- where's Rurie?
但、但更重要的是——發生什麼事了？Rurie——Rurie 呢？
Those... those must have been changelings!
那些……那些一定是換形者！
Oho! Impressive stuff. Simple pieces of paper in appearance... but they pack a punch. Rather useful!
哦豁！了不起。外表看起來只是幾張紙……威力卻不小。相當好用！
Easier than expected. Should use more- eugh, no no no, don't like this one at all.
比預期的容易。應該多用一點——呃，不不不，這一副我一點都不喜歡。
Ah, much improved! Now this - what an enjoyable form it has been, yes yes yes! The drama, the intrigue! Perhaps it would do to use it more, hm hm hm!
啊，好多了！這副——這副形體用起來多愉快啊，是是是！那份戲劇性，那份懸疑！或許該多用用它，嗯嗯嗯！
Who am I? Why, I am Captain Rurie, leader of the owls! Master of the mists, eyes and ears of the trees - runaway FOOL from higher lands!!!!
我是誰？哎呀，我是 Rurie 隊長，梟群的首領！霧的主人，樹林的耳目——從高地逃出來的蠢貨！！！！
Oh but no no no, I should think you have it figured out by now! Is it not obvious?
噢不不不，我想你現在該已經猜到了吧！這還不明顯嗎？
What a delight! This before you is the form of the Ranger {p}, Sovereign to these secretive little ants! The name it was given is Gikyo.
多麼令人愉快！你眼前這副是 {p} 巡林官的形體，這群鬼鬼祟祟的小螞蟻的統領！它被賜予的名字是 Gikyo。
To think there has been a struggle to take you in so far yet the task proved simple and easy! How delightful! The Sovereign Forest will be furious!
想想看，先前費了那麼大勁都抓不到你，這回卻簡單又輕鬆！多麼愉快！森林那位統領會氣壞的！
But that is enough talk and secrets spilling. It is time, crown's wanted! Time for you to go...
不過話與祕密都說夠了。時候到了，王室的通緝犯！該是你上路的時候了……
Talk to Sui and Yusanu. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
與 Sui 和 Yusanu 談話。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
Is this really it, then? Ordeal after ordeal and this is where it leads?
所以真的就是這樣了嗎？一關又一關，最後就是走到這裡？
Will it ever end? What's the point? The crown's after us now, and- and they're not going to stop!! Why- why even try?!
這會有結束的一天嗎？意義在哪裡？王室現在盯上我們了，而——而他們不會停手的！！為——為什麼還要試？！
Yusanu! Y-you need to... to get yourself together! Please, d-don't lose your head now... n-not here, of all places.
Yusanu！你——你得振作起來！拜託，現在別亂了陣腳……偏偏是在這種地方，不行。
I... ha, I- I know it feels hard. Im-impossible, even! A-and maybe I'm, I'm just putting on a brave face... I- I want to lie down and j-just wait for the, the inevitable, as much as you do!!
我……哈，我——我知道這感覺很難。甚至根本不可能！而、而或許我只是，只是在強裝鎮定……我也跟你一樣想躺下來，就、就這樣等著那不可避免的一刻！！
But... b-but not now. We're- we're here, a-and they're so close. Mora, Rex, Zeph... we- we have some hope! S-so... don't give up. Not now!
但是……但現在不行。我們——我們就在這裡，而、而他們就在附近。Mora、Rex、Zeph……我們——我們還有一點希望！所、所以……別放棄。現在不行！
...okay. Then... where do we start? They... they took all of our belongings... and you can't cast spells without your weapon, can you?
……好。那……我們從哪裡開始？他們……他們把我們的東西全拿走了……而你沒有武器就不能施法，對吧？
I... I still have my magic. I can... I can try.
我……我還有我的魔法。我可以……我可以試試看。
N-not... that. I... ugh, why is this so hard all of a sudden...?
不、不是那個。我……唉，為什麼這突然變得這麼難……？
Oh, sh- shut up! I- I'm trying, okay!
噢，閉、閉嘴啦！我——我在努力了，好嗎！
...oh. Oh, oh- I think I know a way out!
……噢。噢，噢——我想我知道怎麼出去了！
Look, this- this appears to be tempered glass!
你看，這——這看起來是強化玻璃！
Um... I... I have no idea what that means.
嗯……我……我完全不知道那是什麼意思。
No, look- it's one of the inventions I assisted Soosu with. I didn't know what its purpose was at the time, but... I guess this fits.
不，你看——這是我協助 Soosu 做的發明之一。我當時不知道它的用途，不過……我想這就對上了。
Tempered glass is incredibly strong and durable. It resists most attempts to break it, except - except for striking the edge of the glass with a sharp object.
強化玻璃極為堅固耐用。它能抵擋大多數想打破它的嘗試，除了——除了用尖銳的東西敲擊玻璃的邊緣。
And, Sui! If you could make an icicle with your magic... and strike the edge...
然後，Sui！如果你能用你的魔法做出一根冰錐……再敲擊邊緣……
...then we could get out? I... m-maybe. But, y-you just saw me- um, nearly flood our cell with... sewage...
……那我們就能出去了？我……也、也許吧。可是，你剛剛才看到我——嗯，差點讓我們的牢房淹滿……污水……
Sui. You were the one just giving me a pep talk. Come on, you can do it!
Sui。剛剛替我打氣的人是你。來吧，你辦得到！
...okay. Okay, you- you're right! I can... I can do this. I can.
……好。好，你——你說得對！我可以……我做得到。我可以。
I- ha, I, I did it!!
That's the first step! We've got the sharp object, now... aim for the corner!
那是第一步！尖銳的東西有了，現在……瞄準角落！
It- it worked! Ha... hahaha... oh, it worked...
成——成功了！哈……哈哈哈……噢，成功了……
Find Captain Rurie. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
找到 Rurie 隊長。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
L-let's go, then! Let's find the others, and- and get out of here!
我、我們走吧！去找其他人，然後——然後離開這裡！
Well! Hoo hoo, my little friends!
哎呀！呼呼，我的小朋友們！
Uh... duh? That devilish snake got the drop on me when I went up to the owls' nest! Those changelings certainly do not play fair, let me tell you...
呃……不然呢？我上梟巢的時候被那條該死的蛇偷襲了！那些換形者可真是一點都不講規矩，我跟你們說……
How... how can we know for sure it's, um, really him?
我們……我們怎麼能確定，嗯，那真的是他？
What?! Is it not obvious that I am who I say I- oh, whatever, something something it's protocol. Fine.
什麼？！我說我是誰還不夠明顯嗎——噢，隨便啦，什麼什麼是規定。好吧。
Hm... I don't think changelings have access to memories, do they? Rurie, where did we first meet?
唔……我想換形者拿不到記憶吧？Rurie，我們第一次見面是在哪裡？
Yes, finally, some sense! It was in that cave! My owls and I captured you as leverage, and if I do recall correctly, you nearly cried like a little baby! Ah, memories...
太好了，終於有人講點道理！是在那個洞穴裡！我和我的梟群把你們當人質抓了起來，而如果我沒記錯，你差點哭得像個小嬰兒！啊，回憶啊……
Finally! Now then, time for us to get moving!
THEY LEFT YOUR KNIVES ON YOU?!
他們把你的刀子留在你身上？！
Oh, no, no no no. They certainly did take them, alright! Seems they missed a few in my boots, though! Lucky me!
噢，不不不不。他們確實把刀拿走了！不過看來他們漏了我靴子裡的幾把！我真幸運！
Now, I simply couldn't help but overhear you little loudmouths, so I came up with a plan while you were debating whether I was real or not!
現在，我實在忍不住聽見了你們這幾個大嗓門的對話，所以在你們爭論我是不是真人的時候，我已經想好一個計畫了！
Yusanu. That device of yours is quite important, isn't it? I'll help you fetch it - hopefully add a few more to my kill list along the way, eh?
Yusanu。你那個裝置很重要吧？我幫你去拿——順便希望能在路上替我的擊殺名單再添幾筆，嗯？
And Sui... go find your family. Important to hold onto those you love, isn't it? You and {u} can handle this, I'm sure, but... be careful.
至於 Sui……去找你的家人。抓緊你所愛的人是很重要的，不是嗎？你和 {u} 應付得來，我相信，不過……小心點。
Well then! Let's skedaddle, kiddos! Good luck out there!
那麼！我們開溜吧，孩子們！外頭小心！
Let's... try and find our stuff. We, ha, can't really handle a whole fort of changelings without your weapon, can we?
我們……試著把我們的東西找回來吧。我們，哈，沒有你的武器實在應付不了一整座堡壘的換形者，對吧？
Find your weapon before you proceed further. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
繼續前進之前先找到你的武器。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
Hey! We can't leave without our belongings.
喂！我們不能丟下自己的東西就走。
那……那我們可以繼續了嗎？
Are you prepared for a fight
I... I hope so, but... I'm not sure. The ocean still feels... off. Like, like a step to the left.
我……我希望如此，可是……我不確定。那片海洋感覺還是……不太對。像是，像是往左偏了一步。
I... don't really, I don't have anything worth grabbing, here...
我……其實沒有，我這裡沒有什麼值得拿的東西……
Uh, I found this map... come here.
呃，我找到這張地圖……過來。
"{p}, Changeling Facility." So... this whole place is, um, probably crawling with them.
「{p}，換形者設施」。所以……這整個地方，嗯，大概到處都是他們。
This... this m-might be, um, harder than I thought it might be. B-but! I can't give up. They're so close... where are they...?
這……這可能比我原本想的還要，嗯，更難。可、可是！我不能放棄。他們就在附近……他們到底在哪裡……？
And the Sovereign's office looks like it's at the very back of the building...
而統領的辦公室看起來在整棟建築的最裡面……
There's a, another block of cells right outside. If we're careful enough... maybe we can avoid a confrontation with the Sovereign.
外面還有另一區牢房。只要我們夠小心……或許可以避開跟統領正面衝突。
...th-thanks for being here, {u}. I... I would've given up a long time ago if you weren't.
……謝、謝謝你在這裡，{u}。我……要不是有你，我早就放棄了。
Continue exploring the Changeling Camp and look for your friends. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
繼續探索換形者營地，尋找你的朋友。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
Continue to the Officer's Quarters in the southern wing. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往南翼的軍官宿舍。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
Here for a duel?! I love duels?! I love fighting?! I love life?!
來決鬥的嗎？！我愛決鬥？！我愛打架？！我愛人生？！
C-careful! That's... Sovereign Gikyo's office up ahead. Let's, um, try and avoid them.
小、小心！前面就是……Gikyo 統領的辦公室。我們，嗯，盡量避開他們。
No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
It's... it's a ticket. From the... Steel Feather... the ones... Quill gave us...
那是……那是一張票。鋼羽的……Quill 給我們的那些……
There- ha, there, th-there's no way s-some-someone could, ha, survive... this...
哈，這——這，這樣根本，哈，不可能有人活得下來……
How... h-how dare they... how DARE they?! Th-they have to pay for this, {u}, they- they have to!!
他們……他們怎麼敢……他們怎麼敢？！他、他們必須為此付出代價，{u}，他、他們必須！！
Come on... come on, come on, we- we need to confront Gikyo, we- come on!!
走吧……走吧，走吧，我、我們得去找 Gikyo 對質，我們——走吧！！
Head to Sovereign Gikyo's office to confront them. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
前往 Gikyo 統領的辦公室與他們對質。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
Well well, look who has stumbled on in! If it is not the crown's number one wanted and the silly weak sister! Were you not locked up?
哎呀哎呀，看看是誰晃進來了！這不是王室的頭號通緝犯，還有那個又傻又弱的妹妹嗎！你們不是被關起來了嗎？
No... you... wh- what did you... what did you DO?!
不……你……你、你做了什麼……你做了什麼？！
Hehehehahaha! Oh, this? Why it's the prodigal son of course! Go on, say hello to your little sister, big brother!!
嘿嘿嘿哈哈哈！噢，這個嗎？這可是那位浪子啊！來吧，跟你的小妹妹打聲招呼，哥哥！！
You should know I did offer the opportunity to speak, yes yes indeed! If only he would have spat up all those deep deep secrets on your group... could his pain have been avoided?
你該知道我確實給過他開口的機會，是的是的沒錯！只要他把你們那群人那些深深深藏的祕密全吐出來……他的痛苦是不是就能免了呢？
But but but but but sad as it is, he refused to say a word! What a shame indeed, indeed. A long deep dark painful agonizing death it was!
可是可是可是可是可是，遺憾的是，他一個字都不肯說！真是可惜啊，可惜。那是一場漫長、深沉、黑暗、痛苦、煎熬的死亡！
Well since you are here and the rest are taken it would seem it was for naught! I have every little dove just where I want them, yes yes I do.
既然你也來了，其他人也都被抓了，看來那一切都是白費！每一隻小鴿子都在我要的位置上，是的是的沒錯。
Yes! Shooty girl and wind boy! Rex and Zeph I believe it was?
沒錯！射箭的女孩和風之男孩！我記得是叫 Rex 和 Zeph？
Wind boy was always crying and screaming... how pathetic. But shooty girl... yes shooty girl was a delight.
風之男孩老是又哭又叫……真沒出息。但射箭的女孩……是的，射箭的女孩可有意思了。
Never let out a word no matter the pain! The ones like her are always the most most most fun to crack, yes they are.
無論多痛都一個字不吐！像她那樣的人，撬開來總是最最最有趣的，沒錯。
Alas... all good things must come to an end it would seem! The killjoy Sovereign {p}, swooping in and ruining ALL my fun...
唉……看來好事總會有結束的一天！那個掃興的 {p} 統領，衝進來毀了我所有的樂趣……
Noooo Gikyo you cannot keep your prisoners no matter how much you wish, no no no, the people {p} demand their girl returned and well who am I to stand against them?
不行喔 Gikyo，你不能想留犯人就留犯人，不行不行不行，{p} 的人民要求把他們的女孩還回去，而我又有什麼資格跟他們作對呢？
And so ended the fun that was being had! But I had the last laugh, ehehehaha. The Athassa girl could take one and not both of the companions! A choice? A choice!
於是那場正在進行的樂趣就此告終！但笑到最後的是我，欸嘿嘿哈哈。那個 Athassa 的女人只能帶走兩個同伴中的一個！一個選擇？一個選擇！
Oh the noble hero that he was, he chose to stay! What a bore. But what a joy! What a joy joy joy joy joy!
噢，多麼高尚的英雄啊，他選擇留下！真無聊。但又多麼令人愉快！多麼愉快愉快愉快愉快！
And now where is he? Bleeding out, dying, fading, vanishing with each and every passing moment! And it would seem perhaps he is the lucky one!
而現在他在哪裡呢？流著血、垂死、消退、隨著每一刻流逝而一點一點消失！這麼看來，他或許還是幸運的那一個呢！
Well then! Would you care to join him in this dance? To the end of days - yours end HERE and NOW!
那麼！你要不要也加入他這支舞？跳到世界末日——而你的末日就在此時此地！
Defeat Sovereign Gikyo. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
擊敗 Gikyo 統領。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
Check up on Sui. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
去看看 Sui 的狀況。若需要回營地，前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。
He's... he's my brother... give... give him... back...
他是……他是我哥哥……把……把他……還來……
He's dead. He's... dead he's dead he's dead, but so is that BASTARD!!!
他死了。他……死了他死了他死了，可是那個混蛋也死了！！！
And it... it... it doesn't even matter. I killed them, and... and... and what now? M- Mora, he's- he's still...
而這……這……這根本一點意義都沒有。我殺了他們，然後……然後呢？M——Mora，他——他還是……
No?? Then what do you CALL this?! Rex and Zeph are gone and Mora is- h-he's... he... he's...
沒有？？那你說這叫什麼？！Rex 和 Zeph 不見了，Mora——他——他……他……
We... we weren't fast enough... we took too long to get here, a-and now... and now...
我們……我們不夠快……我們花太久才到這裡，而、而現在……現在……
I already GOT revenge, {u}!! I didn't... I didn't know I... it- it happened so fast, and... and... I killed them. I got revenge and... and I still feel hollow.
我已經「復仇」了，{u}！！我不……我不知道我……事情發生得太快，然後……然後……我殺了他們。我報了仇，然後……然後我心裡還是空的。
He's... gone. He's gone, and- a-and I can't... I can't get him back...
他……不在了。他不在了，而、而我沒辦法……我沒辦法把他找回來……
We- we need to g-get out of here, I- I- I can't... I can't be here. I can't... I c-can't look at him.
我、我們得離、離開這裡，我——我——我沒辦法……我沒辦法待在這裡。我沒辦法……我沒辦法看著他。
...this is all my fault, isn't it?
I- I- all I've been DOING this whole time has been crying, worrying, and- and- and being USELESS!
我——我——我從頭到尾做的事就只有哭、擔心，還有——還有——一點用都沒有！
I was so afraid of my cur-... why, why, WHY can't I break that habit?! Magic. Magic magic magic magic MAGIC!!
我那麼害怕我的詛——為什麼，為什麼，我為什麼就是改不掉這個習慣？！魔法。魔法魔法魔法魔法魔法！！
I was so afraid that I never even tried!! If I had, if I- I- if I'd have learned more, been stronger...
我害怕到根本連試都沒試過！！要是我試了，要是我——我——要是我多學一點、變得更強……
I... I could have... I could have saved him. I could have protected him, I could have healed him, I could have-
我……我本來可以……我本來可以救他的。我本來可以保護他，我本來可以治好他，我本來可以——
But no, of COURSE NOT!! Because I'm worthless and useless and can't help ANYONE!!
但是沒有，「當然沒有」！！因為我一無是處、毫無用處，誰都幫不了！！
Rex and Zeph are- they're still out there. {u}, {u}, we can still save them. We- we know where they are!!
Rex 和 Zeph——他們還在外面。{u}，{u}，我們還救得了他們。我們——我們知道他們在哪裡！！
We just... we just need to find the {p} Sovereign. He has them, he- he has to. He... he has to.
我們只要……我們只要找到 {p} 的統領。他手上有他們，他——他一定有。他……他一定有。
...let's go. We can't- we can't let this happen again.
……我們走。我們不能——我們不能再讓這種事發生一次。
Meet up with Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Yusanu 和 Rurie 隊長會合。
Hello, dear friends! I see you have returned to us safe and sound!
你們好啊，親愛的朋友們！看來你們平安無事地回來了！
We found everything we were looking for, and- and more!! Plans, Sui, plans!! Of Deraj prison!!
我們找到了所有要找的東西，還——還不只！！計畫，Sui，計畫！！Deraj 監獄的！！
It would seem our dear Changeling Sovereign worked closely with the prison's warden... for what purpose remains unclear, though I imagine something changeling-adjacent?
看來我們那位親愛的換形者統領跟監獄的典獄長合作得相當密切……為了什麼目的還不清楚，不過我想大概跟換形者脫不了關係吧？
Sui, with- with these plans, we could... we could stand a chance of breaking everyone out! We could- we could get them all back!
Sui，有——有了這些計畫，我們……我們就有機會把所有人救出來！我們可以——我們可以把他們全都帶回來！
They're gone, Yusanu! Mora's- Mora's dead.
The Sovereign, they... they killed him.
那個統領，他們……他們把他殺了。
Just... gone. Taken to the {p}. But, Mora is- he's-
就……不見了。被帶去 {p} 了。可是，Mora 他——他——
So. So, I- I'm glad you have hope! For... for getting your people back! Good for you!!
所以。所以，我——我很高興你還有希望！為了……為了把你的人救回來！恭喜你啊！！
Emotions are... certainly running high right now, aren't they! Why don't we, ah, regroup with the rest of the Canopy, and... take some time?
情緒……現在確實都很激動，是吧！我們何不，呃，先跟樹冠其他人會合，然後……給彼此一點時間？
Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
一點。時間？不。不，我不要再等了。我受夠了哭，我受夠了擔心！我好……好……憤怒！對王室，對我自己，對——對 Mora！！！！
At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
對你們所有人，因為你們都把我當成什麼事都做不了的人！！！
S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
你明白？！你真的明白嗎？！因為聽起來你好像一切都好得很！你的兄弟都還活著！你甚至還有把他們救回來的計畫！！
Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
Rex 和 Zeph，他們……他們需要我。需要我們！而……而我不會再讓任何人受傷，或、或、或死掉，只要我阻止得了！！
The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
王室……那些統領……那個女王……他們會付出代價。他們會為對我、還有我——我的……我的家人做過的一切付出代價……
