非常抱歉，Zhight 大交易所目前正在整修！你還不能進去！
Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here, it has a red and white sail. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
也許你能幫我這個忙。船應該還卡在正北方，掛著紅白相間的帆。我很想再踏上甲板。
歡迎你，旅人，來到我們的小島。
Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you all the way up here?
喔？嗯，你好。你怎麼大老遠跑到這上面來了？

嘿嘿，歡迎光臨 Gawrick 瘋狂傳送，{~} 分鐘內送達，否則披薩免費！有什麼能為你效勞的？
Well, you remember how I teleported you to the Airbase? I figure doing that myself is easier than makin' scrolls.
這個嘛，你還記得我把你傳送到飛船基地那次吧？我想說，與其做卷軸，不如我自己動手傳比較省事。
Plus, I can charge for bags of peanuts too! Win-win!
而且，我還可以賣袋裝花生另外收錢！雙贏！
Then that'll be [{~} Emerald Blocks], my good fellow!
那就收你 [{~} 綠寶石磚]，我的好朋友！
Alright, here we go- Remember, hands and feet INSIDE the dimensional bridge at all times!
好，出發囉——記住，手腳隨時都要收在次元橋「裡面」！
Happy travels! Try not to get lost between dimensions on your way to- wherever you end up!
旅途愉快！在前往——呃，不管你最後到了哪裡——的路上，盡量別在次元之間迷路！
Why am I bouncing on this bed you ask? Heck if I know!
你問我為什麼在這張床上跳來跳去？鬼才知道！
Ever since the general's gone mad, he's asked me to 'test the bounciness of these beds.'
自從將軍發瘋之後，他就叫我「測試這些床的彈性」。
I've been doing it long enough that I consider myself quite the expert, now.
我做得夠久了，現在我自認是這方面的專家了。
Quite the exquisite bed, isn't it? Just the right bounce...
這張床相當精緻，對吧？彈性恰到好處……
Why is it in my administrator's? Person has work to do! Advise enclosed instruction book for tips.
為什麼它在我的行政官的裡面？人有工作要做！建議隨附的指示書來拿提示。
I don't blame you for being reluctant, human. But if you really want to trust that crazed General, go on in.
你會猶豫，我不怪你，人類。不過你要是真的想相信那個瘋癲的將軍，就進去吧。
Back up there, human. I'm no engineer but the way this thing is ticking can't be any good.
退後一點，人類。我不是工程師，但這東西滴答響成這樣，絕對不是什麼好事。
The door won't budge without a key.
沒有鑰匙，這扇門紋風不動。
Convenient! Person is not stupid! Smile!
Well I'm glad this is all over, but I see no harm in keeping the Springy-
這一切總算結束了，我很高興，不過我看留著那些彈彈也沒什麼壞——
I loved my job so much I managed to convince Lecade to become a fulltime bed-bouncer!
我太愛這份工作了，還成功說服 Lecade 讓我當全職的床鋪彈跳員！
One day I'll be the top of my craft in the world!
總有一天，我會成為這一行的世界第一！
...y-you. Whatever you do. Do NOT g-go in there. I'm begging you.
……你、你。不管你打算做什麼。千萬別進、進去那裡。我求你了。
It felt easy. Until...until... That cyclops... Th-that... It...
本來感覺很輕鬆。直到……直到……那個獨眼巨人……那、那個……他……
Everywhere I walked became painful. There were...so many... I-I couldn't tell what was real.
我走到哪裡，哪裡就痛。有……好多好多……我、我分不出什麼才是真的。
If I even looked at the illusions- I can still hear it laughing... M-Mocking me...
我只要看那些幻象一眼——我到現在還聽得見他在笑……在、在嘲笑我……
Save your sanity. Run. It's...it's not worth it, it's not worth it, it's not worth it, it's not it's not it's not...
保住你的理智。快逃。那……那不值得，不值得，不值得，不值不值不值……
Pulling her punches, pulling her punches- PAH! What about that was restrained at all?!
手下留情、手下留情——呸！那到底哪裡算是留手了？！
I feel like a pincushion, and my ears are still ringing!! That insufferable little...
我覺得自己像個針插，耳朵到現在還在嗡嗡叫！！那個讓人受不了的小……
How did those sonicbooms hit me after they had already gone by?! Just because the trails were still in the air... That's- That's CHEATING!!
那些音爆明明都飛過去了，怎麼還打得到我？！就因為軌跡還留在空中……那——那是作弊！！
Gaaah, and so condescending when I lost! Oh yeah, I'm suuuure I did such a good job!!
嘎啊啊，而且我輸了她還那麼高高在上！是啦是啦，我表現得可真——好啊！！
No, this place doesn't deserve to test my talents, not with that attitude!! Goodbye Hive, see you never!
不，這地方不配考驗我的才華，憑那種態度就不配！！再見了蜂巢，永遠不見！
Looks like this is the token collector. If you've gotten the catalysts, put them in and move on.
看來這就是代幣收集器。拿到催化劑的話，把它們放進去就能繼續前進。
Alriiiight, now you're feelin' it, right? All warmed up? Good! Try and keep up now!
好——的，現在有感覺了吧？熱身夠了嗎？很好！接下來可要跟上喔！
Whoa, you're really keeping up! Maybe it's time for me to cut loose a little bit!
哇，你真的跟得上耶！也許我該稍微放開來打了！
Let's get WILD with it now!!
Welcome, traveller, to The {p}. I am a humble servant of Mistress Qira. My job is to inform challengers of the Hive challenge of how your prizes work.
旅人，歡迎來到 {p}。我是 Qira 大人卑微的僕人。我的職責是向蜂巢試煉的挑戰者說明獎品的運作方式。
If you should prove yourself strong enough to fight through a division of Mistress' Hive, you will receive a voucher, which you may redeem here for a single prize.
你若能證明自己夠強，打通大人蜂巢的一支部隊，就會獲得一張兌換券，可以在這裡兌換一件獎品。
Depending on the division you have cleared, you may redeem your voucher for different prizes, and you may exchange a prize and Catalysts for another voucher within this Hive Exchange.
依你通過的部隊不同，兌換券能換的獎品也不同；你還可以在這個蜂巢兌換處，用一件獎品加上催化劑換取另一張兌換券。
However, of note about the prizes. Their elemental energies are strong enough that you cannot use more than one of the same division's prizes at once.
不過，關於獎品有一點要注意。它們的元素能量太強，同一支部隊的獎品，你一次只能使用一件。
Using two of the same elemented prize has a strange magical backlash... Your abilities will be completely nullified and you will be rendered helpless.
同時使用兩件同屬性的獎品，會引發奇特的魔法反噬……你的能力會被完全抵銷，變得毫無還手之力。
For instance, you could not wear two Thunder Division prizes at once, however you could wear a Thunder Division and Air Division prize together safely.
舉例來說，你不能同時穿戴兩件雷之部隊的獎品，但可以放心地同時穿戴雷之部隊與風之部隊的獎品各一件。
Additionally, should you somehow misplace your voucher, you may earn it back with a great number of Catalysts...
另外，萬一你不慎弄丟了兌換券，可以用大量的催化劑把它換回來……
...But the Mistress is displeased with this method. It is likely to change in the future.
……但大人對這個辦法並不滿意。日後很可能會更改。
I will be here if you should ever need this explanation again. I wish you luck, should you choose to challenge her glorious Hive.
你若需要再聽一次說明，我都會在這裡。倘若你決定挑戰她榮耀的蜂巢，祝你好運。
What, you think just cause I'm not one of you Corkians I can't deal in machines- Oh. You...uh. You aren't Corkian, are ya?
怎樣，你以為我不是你們 Corkian，就不能做機器買賣——喔。你……呃。你不是 Corkian 吧？
Sorry 'bout that. See, a few months ago there was this big party of Corkus idjits that came round, and they had the audacity to insult our forges!
抱歉啦。是這樣的，幾個月前有一大票 Corkus 來的白痴跑來這裡，居然有臉嫌棄我們的熔爐！
'specially that bald headed, square-faced, gray-haired, legendary SPITSTAIN! Oh, I couldn't STAND that guy. So I started dealing in machines, and it's going pretty well, I'd say!
尤其是那個禿頭、方臉、灰頭髮的傳奇級「口水漬」！噢，我真是「受不了」那傢伙。所以我就開始做機器買賣，我敢說做得還挺不錯的！
...oh, right. Gotta try and pawn some 'a this stuff. I got some rarities in my stock, but mostly I'm lookin' to get some machinery. If ya find any, I'll see what I can offer ya, aight?
……喔，對。得想辦法把這些東西脫手。我的存貨裡有幾樣稀有貨，不過我主要是想收些機械。你要是找到了，我再看看能拿什麼跟你換，行吧？
'Ello there me 'ol chum! See this beast 'ere? Ain't an easy catch. 'Colossus' Spawn' is what we call 'im.
哈囉啊，我的老夥計！看到這頭野獸沒？可不好抓。我們都叫他「巨像子嗣」。
Quite the mystery, they are. For a while no one knew where they were comin' from, 'til a couple of our lads saw somethin' at the Colossus' Statue.
他們可真是個謎。有好一陣子沒人知道他們是打哪來的，直到我們幾個小夥子在巨像雕像那邊看到了些東西。
Y'see, the statue is all crumblin', and one o' the shards that fell down just turned into a big ol' golem like this one.
你瞧，那座雕像一直在崩落，掉下來的其中一塊碎片就這麼變成了一隻大魔像，跟這隻一樣。
The lads panicked and attacked it. All of them made it out safe, but I think it's safe t'say that we've now got a bad reputation in their eyes.
那幾個小夥子嚇壞了，就對他動了手。他們全都平安脫身，不過我想可以說，我們現在在他們眼裡的名聲算是壞透了。
Specifically, {~} Liquid Emeralds! I'll be here all day and all night, selling Ardent Magma Crystals for a mere {~} Liquid Emeralds each!
具體來說，是 {~} 液態綠寶石！我會從早到晚都在這裡，每顆 Ardent Magma Crystal 只賣區區 {~} 液態綠寶石！
Hot work! Sweaty work! Taxing work for only the MIGHTIEST of souls! Truly a BRAVE endeavour! A man's challenge! Ardent Magma Crystals! Only {~} Liquid Emeralds!
火熱的工作！揮汗的工作！只有「最強大」的靈魂才扛得起的苦工！真正「勇敢」的事業！男子漢的挑戰！Ardent Magma Crystal！只要 {~} 液態綠寶石！
...Won't take emeralds for things like these. Sorry.
Hail, human of Wynn! How are you liking the grand Dwarven citadel? I bet you're curious about the doorway behind me, eh?
你好啊，Wynn 的人類！這座宏偉的矮人堡壘你還喜歡嗎？我猜你對我身後那道門很好奇吧？
Well, this leads to our sister city in the {p}, {p}! I'd recommend you take it...
嗯，它通往我們在 {p} 的姊妹城市 {p}！我很推薦你走一趟……
...but it's under construction right now, and I think they're busy preparing for a festival out there, so it may be awhile before you can use this.
……不過它現在還在施工，而且我想那邊正忙著準備慶典，所以你可能要再等一陣子才能用。
Between you and me, that was the first and only trade I've managed down here this trip.
偷偷跟你說，那是我這趟下來談成的第一筆、也是唯一一筆交易。
All the historical artifacts are being traded for things I can't even begin to afford!
那些歷史遺物要換的，全是我根本負擔不起的東西！
Still, can't give up hope yet. 's gotta be something I can get my hands on here! I've never walked away empty handed before!
不過，現在還不能放棄希望。這裡一定有我弄得到手的東西！我可從來沒有空手而回過！
I can feel it in my bones- there's eon's-lost history waiting here for me!
我打從骨子裡感覺得到——這裡有失落萬古的歷史在等著我！
Anyone interested in Hive trophies? I've accumulated quite the collection from those battles! Horns, scales, bone, catalysts...
有人對蜂巢的戰利品有興趣嗎？我從那些戰鬥裡累積了不少收藏！角、鱗片、骨頭、催化劑……
In exchange for these trophies, I seek the finest metals! Darksteel and Gollier Iron! Jaspilite and Voidstone! If it's high-quality, I can find a trophy of equivalent value!
我想用這些戰利品換最頂級的金屬！暗鋼和 Gollier 鐵！Jaspilite 和虛空石！只要品質夠好，我就找得出等值的戰利品！
Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals here!
礦石出售！礦石出售！稀有金屬這裡買！
Accepting bottlecaps from all types of events! Festivals, crownings, royal weddings, ravine-jumping contests! No substitutes!
各種活動的瓶蓋我都收！節慶、加冕典禮、王室婚禮、跳峽谷大賽！不接受替代品！
Ehm. 'Scuse me, Human? You're in the way of my barking. Don't mean to be rude, but could you move? Unless you've got a trade offer?
呃。不好意思，人類？你擋到我叫賣了。我不是想失禮，但你可以讓一讓嗎？除非你有東西要跟我換？
Ugh! NO SALES! None! Not now! Stupid Dohstaj!
唉！不賣！通通不賣！現在不賣！笨蛋 Dohstaj！
Quit fawning over Mastro already! I've got an artifact for you! But you just! Won't! Take it!
別再對著 Mastro 發花痴了！我有件遺物要給你！可你就是！不肯！收！
I SAID no sales! Get out of here!
Bet you've never seen a bazaar this size before, human! This is the biggest Dwarven market in the province!
我敢說你從沒見過這麼大的市集吧，人類！這可是全行省最大的矮人市場！
We do accept emeralds here for the most part, but some of the merchants you'd be interested in like to take platinum, too.
我們這裡大多是收綠寶石的，不過有些你會感興趣的商人也愛收白金。
And then there's the barterers. Who knows what in blazes those nutcases want to trade! I'd steer clear of them if I were you.
再來就是那些以物易物的。天曉得那群瘋子到底想換什麼！我要是你，就離他們遠一點。
I've done all that I can do now. If I went in with you, I'd only be a detriment. Good luck.
我能做的都做了。要是跟你一起進去，我只會拖累你。祝你好運。
Would you like to skip to the next room?
Oh, you really are interested in hearing about those bottlecaps, huh? Well! Sit down there, fella! These have a STORY behind 'em.
喔，你是真的想聽那些瓶蓋的事啊？好！坐下吧，老兄！這些東西背後可是有「故事」的。
See, almost all our drinks come in bottles. Bottles are just too useful, compared to cups or mugs. Good for improvised weapons, and so reusable!
跟你說，我們的飲料幾乎都是瓶裝的。跟杯子、馬克杯比起來，瓶子實在太好用了。能臨時拿來當武器，又能一用再用！
These bottlecaps were the first specialty ones made in Dwarven history! Someone got the idea, since the Dogun festival was a big event, to make decorative bottlecaps.
這些瓶蓋是矮人史上第一批特製瓶蓋！當時有人想到，既然 Dogun 慶典是件大事，那就來做裝飾瓶蓋吧。
Each one tells some of the story of the Dogun war on it, or some war trivia! See, this one tells you Delinaed the Wise's favorite book.
每一個上面都講了一段 Dogun 戰爭的故事，或是一些戰爭小知識！你看，這個寫的是智者 Delinaed 最愛的書。
It became a fad, then a tradition- practically every big Dwarven event has specialty bottlecaps made to commemorate it now. Collectors like me have our work cut out for us!
後來這成了風潮，再變成傳統——現在幾乎每一場矮人的大活動，都會做特製瓶蓋來紀念。我們這種收藏家可有得忙了！
So hey, if you ever go to a big Dwarven event, buy some drinks! Save up those caps- they're worth a hundred times their weight in emeralds, in terms of historical value!
所以啊，你要是哪天去參加矮人的大活動，記得買幾瓶飲料！把瓶蓋存起來——論歷史價值，它們抵得上自身重量一百倍的綠寶石！
Oh, I see that look in your eyes. That curiosity. You want me to unravel a mystery for you! Well, I can tell you this much...
喔，我看到你那眼神了。那股好奇。你想要我替你解開一個謎！好吧，我能告訴你的就這麼多……
If I'm being honest, Jaspilite isn't much good for weaponry. It's more of a good-luck charm than anything- I plan to stud a blade with this instead of using it for the base.
老實說，Jaspilite 拿來做武器並不怎麼樣。它更像是幸運符——我打算把它鑲在刀身上，而不是拿它當底材。
That just makes Ockar's success in the chaos of wartime with his Jaspilite blade even more astounding. That's why it's so valuable.
這就讓 Ockar 在戰時的混亂中，憑著他那把 Jaspilite 刀刃取得的戰果更加驚人。它之所以這麼值錢，原因就在這裡。
It's almost like if that hero you have...what was his name, John? Bob? Joe? I can't quite recall, the name, but it's something like that...
這差不多就像你們那位英雄……他叫什麼來著，John？Bob？Joe？名字我想不太起來，反正差不多是那樣……
It's like if he carved a good-quality training blade out of some vaguely rare, but otherwise mundane wood and used it to defend the citadels for decades.
就像他拿某種稍微稀有、但除此之外平凡無奇的木頭，削了一把品質不錯的練習用劍，然後靠它守了那些堡壘幾十年。
The wood itself is just wood...but it was used by a hero, so it must be special, yes? So Jaspilite is well sought-after. I once again thank you for liberating it from that stubborn bottlecap man.
木頭本身就只是木頭……但它是英雄用過的，所以一定很特別，對吧？所以 Jaspilite 才這麼搶手。我要再次感謝你，把它從那個頑固的瓶蓋男手上解救出來。
This core machine's gonna be a better challenge to figure out than ANY of that smarmy idiot's "legendary mechs," hah!
要搞懂這台核心機器，可比那個油嘴滑舌的白痴的任何一台「傳奇機甲」都更有挑戰性，哈！
...hm? Oh, 's you again! Suppose ya heard me and my little grudge, huh? Yeah. I forget if I told ya this or not, but a few months ago there was a group from Corkus here.
……嗯？喔，又是你啊！我猜你聽到我那點小恩怨了吧？是啊。我忘了有沒有跟你講過，幾個月前有一群 Corkus 來的人到過這裡。
Hoity-toity lot, they were. Got me into machinery though, even if it was just outta spite. Might not've heard about many Dwarven mages, but they exist!
那群人啊，一個個眼睛長在頭頂上。不過倒是讓我迷上了機械，就算純粹是出於賭氣。你可能沒聽過幾個矮人法師，但確實有！
Electromagic comes nice an' natural to me, so I've started riggin' up these machines. It's kinda funny you brought me somethin' from that Hive, too.
電魔法我學起來又順又自然，所以我就開始拼裝這些機器了。說來也有點好笑，你居然還帶了那座蜂巢的東西來給我。
They stopped by here on their way to the Hive, those Corkus idjits. Somethin' about a sponsorship to go see Qira of all people!
那群 Corkus 白痴是在去蜂巢的路上順道來這裡的。說是拿到什麼贊助，要去見的偏偏還是 Qira！
Heheheh, he got what was comin' to 'im! Serves 'em all right for bein' so high-and-mighty when they ain't even provincially recognized!
嘿嘿嘿，他那是自作自受！誰叫他們連行省的承認都沒有，還那麼趾高氣昂，全都活該！
MY EYES STING FROM THE HEAT OF YOUR DETERMINATION! Yes! Such passion flowing from you, now that you've experienced a treasure of EQUAL HEAT!
你決心的熱度刺得我雙眼發痛！沒錯！在你體驗過一件「同樣火熱」的寶物之後，你身上湧出了這般熱情！
It's only right you learn more! My PRIDE! My SWEAT! My MUSCLED MIGHT! My WAY OF LIFE- Ardent Magma Crystals!
你理應知道得更多！我的「驕傲」！我的「汗水」！我的「肌肉之力」！我的「生存之道」——Ardent Magma Crystal！
Gold makes the world turn! But nearly every piece of gold you see- is impure! There are imperfections in it, no matter how brilliant the luster!
黃金讓世界轉動！但你看到的黃金，幾乎每一塊——都不純！不管光澤多耀眼，裡面都有瑕疵！
But through HARD WORK! EXTREME HEAT! RIGHTEOUS SMITHING SKILL! It can be purified to shine like it was ALWAYS meant to! Shine like your SOUL!
但是靠著「苦幹」！「極致高溫」！「正氣凜然的鍛造技藝」！它就能被提純，綻放它「本來」就該有的光芒！像你的「靈魂」一樣閃耀！
The process is only for the STRONG! It takes months upon months of work- single mistakes can destroy the gold! But nothing worth doing in life is easy!
這道工序只屬於「強者」！要花上一個月又一個月的工夫——一個失誤就能毀掉黃金！但人生中值得做的事，沒有一件是容易的！
TRUE MEN will not give up! To be a man requires nothing of the body- it only requires a BLAZING SPIRIT! A weak body can be HONED! An impure metal can be PURIFIED!
真正的男子漢絕不放棄！當個男子漢與肉體無關——只需要一股「熊熊燃燒的氣魄」！軟弱的身體可以「鍛鍊」！不純的金屬可以「提純」！
Ardent Magma Crystals are the PUREST of gold! I have perfected my craft- each one takes a season's worth of time, but such patience only practices my own PASSION!
Ardent Magma Crystal 是「最純」的黃金！我的技藝已臻完美——每一顆都要花上一整季的時間，但這樣的耐心只會磨練我自己的「熱情」！
And with my gift to you, we are truly BOUND by our spirits, however fleetingly! Carry yourself with grace, friend- and with POWER! HEAT! SWEAT! AND TEARS OF FLAME!!!
而有了我送你的這份禮物，我們的氣魄就真正「相繫」了，哪怕只是短短一瞬！朋友，願你舉止優雅——並且帶著「力量」！「熱度」！「汗水」！還有「烈焰之淚」！！！
...you know...I feel...passionate. Let me talk for a bit.
……你知道嗎……我覺得……充滿熱情。讓我說一下話。
Flameshooters... Dogun weapons. Real common to find. But they're just hilts with buttons on them.
Flameshooter……Dogun 的武器。很常見。但它們只是裝了按鈕的握柄。
They shoot out flames like a blade... It's been millenia since they were made.
它們會噴出像刀刃一樣的火焰……從造出來到現在已經幾千年了。
...almost impossible to repair, too. You'd need Dogun magic. And Doguns are gone, mostly.
……而且幾乎不可能修好。得用 Dogun 的魔法。而 Dogun 大多都不在了。
...but almost impossible means it can be done. I found it broken, and fixed it myself.
……但幾乎不可能，就表示辦得到。我找到它的時候是壞的，是我自己修好的。
...oh, Mastro... He's my inspiration. Spends his life making those crystals... Does the impossible on a regular basis.
……噢，Mastro……他是我的靈感來源。一輩子都在做那些水晶……把不可能的事當成家常便飯。
...I've done it once. Just can't compete.
……我只做到過一次。根本比不上。
...least I've got a little bit of him now.
……至少我現在擁有他的一小部分了。
Finally, I can pack my things up and leave! I just need to endure this macho insanity til then... Thank you, human, for freeing me from this hell!
終於，我可以收拾東西走人了！在那之前只要再忍一下這股男子漢瘋病就好……謝謝你，人類，把我從這個地獄解救出來！
Though...suppose you wouldn't know the history behind that staff, would you...I can pack and talk at the same time, why not.
不過……你大概不知道那把法杖背後的歷史吧……我可以一邊收拾一邊講，有何不可。
That staff belonged to the Dwarven king, Draani Thunderwill I. He started the colonization efforts in the {p}, you see.
那把法杖屬於矮人國王 Draani Thunderwill 一世。你知道嗎，在 {p} 的殖民行動就是他發起的。
He led the war efforts against the demons that crawled from the stone- the ones that used the very same weapon that you so graciously provided me, as a matter of fact!
他領導了對抗那些從岩石裡爬出來的惡魔的戰事——說起來，那些惡魔用的，正是你大方交給我的這種武器！
That staff was presumed lost in the great battle against the demon god, Garaheth...but I found it! It was snapped into something like ten pieces...
大家都以為那把法杖在對抗惡魔之神 Garaheth 的大戰中遺失了……但我找到了！它當時斷成了差不多十截……
That thing took me four years to repair. It's good as new now- it can even channel lightning just like the legends. An effort well worth the trouble!
那東西花了我四年才修好。現在跟新的一樣——甚至能像傳說裡那樣引導閃電。這番工夫花得非常值得！
But the Dogun magic fascinates me- I've got to figure out how those Flameshooters work! I'll bet I can reverse-engineer them, I just need a working model...and now I have it!
但 Dogun 的魔法讓我著迷——我一定要搞懂那些 Flameshooter 是怎麼運作的！我敢說我能用逆向工程把它破解出來，只差一把還能用的樣品……而現在我有了！
Oh, what I want to do with the scepter?
喔，你問我要拿那把權杖做什麼？
Gotta keep some secrets, right? Keep people guessing.
總得留點祕密，對吧？讓人猜不透。
No fun otherwise. Now get out. I've got some people to call up.
不然就沒意思了。好了，出去吧。我還有幾個人要聯絡。
YES! HISTORY! I CAN FEEL THE EONS!
沒錯！歷史！我感覺得到萬古的歲月！
I'M GONNA FLY, PAPA! FLY ON THE WINGS OF TIME!
我要飛了，爸爸！乘著時間的翅膀飛翔！
矮人的歷史將被徹底改寫！
I see that reckless look, worm. You will be no different from the other soldiers who thought they had a chance.
我看到你那魯莽的眼神了，蟲子。你跟其他那些自以為有機會的士兵不會有任何不同。
Please, human... If I were to lose my grandson, I- I don't know what I would do!
拜託你，人類……要是我失去了孫子，我——我不知道該怎麼辦才好！
The southwest mountains have a shortcut past the bandits, I know this much...please, stop that fiend!
西南邊的山裡有條捷徑可以繞過那些盜匪，我只知道這麼多……拜託，阻止那個惡徒！
Do you want a hint or do you want to see the rules again?
你要提示，還是要再看一次規則？
Which core do you want a hint about?
你想要哪一個核心的提示？

The Gray Core loses a lot of Explosive Power for every core it's touching, except Rainbow. This means the best place for it is in in a corner, where it's touching only {~} cores, and one of those should be the Rainbow Core, to minimize Explosive Power lost.
灰色核心每碰到一個核心，就會損失大量爆炸威力，彩虹核心除外。所以它最適合放在角落，只碰到 {~} 個核心，而且其中一個應該是彩虹核心，這樣損失的爆炸威力最少。
The Rainbow Core gets big bonuses from touching other colored cores, so its best place would be in the middle, where it touches {~} different cores.
彩虹核心碰到其他有顏色的核心會得到大量加成，所以它最適合放在正中間，可以碰到 {~} 個不同的核心。
The Blue Core is pretty safe, as it doesn't lose a lot of power from touching any specific core. Rain bow also gets a ton of points from it, so ideally you want it on the right, and touching Rainbow.
藍色核心相當安全，因為它碰到任何特定的核心都不會損失太多威力。彩虹核心還能從它身上得到大量點數，所以最理想的是把它放在右邊，並且碰到彩虹核心。

The Orange Core doesn't have a lot of power on its own. However, Rainbow gets a big bonus when touching it, and Green loses a lot when touching it. So you'll want it on the left, and touching Rainbow, but not Green.
橘色核心本身威力不高。不過彩虹核心碰到它會得到大量加成，綠色核心碰到它則會損失很多。所以要把它放在左邊，碰到彩虹核心，但不要碰到綠色核心。
The Purple Core is pretty safe, as it doesn't lose a lot of power from touching any specific core. Both Blue and Orange gain bonus when touching it, so you'll wan't it touching one or both of those.
紫色核心相當安全，因為它碰到任何特定的核心都不會損失太多威力。藍色與橘色核心碰到它都會得到加成，所以要讓它碰到其中一個，或兩個都碰到。
Ho, adventurer! Have you found the missing members of my crew? If they're not by their red flag, they can't have gotten too far from it!
嗬，冒險者！你找到我走失的隊員了嗎？他們要是不在自己的紅旗旁邊，也不可能離得太遠！
You shouldn't go disturbing the bird's nest and chicks...
你不該去打擾那個鳥巢和雛鳥……
The canary is full, and ready to sing! You fed it a well balanced meal.
金絲雀吃飽了，準備好要唱歌了！你餵了他營養均衡的一餐。
You already have this item in your inventory.
你的背包裡已經有這件物品了。
I thought I was dead. Once I heard that an earthquake was happening, the whole building fell on top of me.
我以為我死了。才剛聽到有人說地震了，整棟房子就垮下來壓在我身上。
And then everything went black. That was the last thing I remembered when I woke up today. When I opened my eyes, I did not feel like I was there.
接著眼前一片漆黑。我今天醒來時，記得的最後一件事就是這個。睜開眼的時候，我不覺得自己在那裡。
It felt like I was in a state of limbo, unable to feel anything. But as soon as I moved my body, I felt immense pain everywhere.
我像是懸在生死之間，什麼都感覺不到。可是身體一動，全身上下就痛得不得了。
There was a large gash on my right thigh, probably cut open by some debris. I managed to find a piece of clothing nearby so I could at least stop some of the bleeding.
我的右大腿上有一道很深的口子，大概是被瓦礫割開的。我在附近找到一件衣物，至少能把血止住一些。
After some time, I got up and saw the most wretched thing I could ever imagine.
過了一陣子，我爬起來，看見了我所能想像最悲慘的景象。
My mother, pierced by a long piece of wood. Called her name. Nothing. Checked her pulse. Nothing. She was dead. First my brother.
我母親，被一根長長的木頭刺穿。喊她的名字。沒有回應。摸她的脈搏。什麼都沒有。她死了。先是我的兄弟。
Then my father. And now... I couldn't save her. I couldn't save anyone. Why? Why me? Why am I even here anymore? Who decided that I should live?
然後是我父親。而現在……我救不了她。我誰都救不了。為什麼？為什麼是我？我為什麼還在這裡？是誰決定我該活下來的？
The bond my mother and I shared... It was something special. She was the only friend I ever had.
我和母親之間的那份牽絆……是很特別的。她是我這輩子唯一的朋友。
She would always surprise me by taking me on spontaneous adventures. She'd do anything to make me happy, even if she herself was having a bad day.
她總是會突然帶我來一場說走就走的冒險，給我驚喜。為了讓我開心，她什麼都肯做，就算她自己那天過得很糟。
I would do the same for her, as much as I possibly could. Just to see the smile on her face. Happy is the man who can sleep, in the comfort of the smile he sees in the face of death.
我也會盡我所能為她做同樣的事。只為了看見她臉上的笑容。能在死亡面前看見那個笑容、在它的撫慰中入睡的人，是幸福的。
And yet... What is the man to do who has not been afforded that chance...?
然而……沒能得到那個機會的人，又該怎麼辦……？
The rain was crashing down on my bare skin, cold as could ever be. Not even a roof over my head. No food, no drink.
雨重重打在我裸露的皮膚上，冷得不能再冷。頭上連片屋頂都沒有。沒有吃的，沒有喝的。
I had nothing. All I had were the very clothes on my back, and even those were limited. Barely being able to walk, I searched for the nearest settlement.
我一無所有。我有的只剩身上這幾件衣服，而且連這些也沒幾件。我幾乎走不動，卻還是去找最近的聚落。
I searched for an answer. A way out. A way that people can live in peace again. I can only hope that I find it alive.
我尋找一個答案。一條出路。一個能讓人們重新安穩過日子的辦法。我只能盼望自己能活著找到它。
I have escaped society, the heart of suffering. Solved the puzzle. Reached enlightenment.
我逃離了社會，逃離了苦難的核心。解開了謎題。得到了開悟。
Yes, but let's do it slowly.
Thanks again for helping us out. Your efforts may have been futile, but at least we know how strong this gas is.
再次謝謝你幫我們。你的努力也許白費了，但至少我們知道這股氣體有多強了。
We just gotta be thankful that no one died. Forget about the coal, this is what matters most. If only...
沒有人死，我們就該謝天謝地了。別管煤了，這才是最要緊的。要是當初……
...Never mind. Once the elevator is repaired, you will be able to access the mine.
……算了。等電梯修好，你就能進礦坑了。
Have you looked into exploring the tomb at all? Please be careful where you step, I'm sure there are priceless artifacts inside!
你有沒有考慮去那座陵墓裡探一探？落腳的時候請務必小心，裡面一定有無價的遺物！
Have yer gone to check out the big laboratory to the North yet? I need my cows back!
北邊那間大實驗室你去瞧過了沒？我要我的牛回來！
If you want to escape, you'll have to push and pull the haybale around so that you can climb over the fences.
想逃出去的話，你得把那捆乾草推來拉去，好讓自己翻過柵欄。
You need to speak to the boss, he's in his office at the end of the facility.
你得去找老大談談，他在這座設施盡頭的辦公室裡。
So you're telling me we've got to move this thing all the way to the factory?
所以你是說，我們得把這玩意兒一路搬到工廠去？
With our bare hands? Couldn't even give us a wagon?
徒手搬？連台推車都不給我們？
Hey, it's for the cause. Remember what you're working towards.
欸，這都是為了大業。別忘了你是在為什麼打拚。
I'm here for a crate of this wheat stuff. How has the recent batch turned out?
我來拿一箱這種叫小麥的東西。最近這一批種得怎麼樣？
Same as usual. Growing this stuff underground isn't easy. You can grab a crate on the far left side.
老樣子。這東西在地底下可不好種。最左邊那裡可以拿一箱。
Right, thank you! Y'know, they say this stuff back home is a lot high quality than the stuff the farmers fed us.
好，謝啦！你知道嗎，聽說老家那邊的這種東西，品質比那些農夫餵我們的好多了。
Well it won't be too long until we find out.
嗯，再過不久我們就知道了。
Looking for the boss, huh? Well, he's just up ahead in his office, behind the big door. Pretty hard to miss.
要找老大啊？他就在前面的辦公室裡，那扇大門後面。很難錯過。
Hey, hope you don't mind me asking, but, uh... Why are you still walking around looking like that?
欸，希望你不介意我問一下，不過，呃……你怎麼還頂著那副模樣到處走？
Eh, I don't judge. You go right ahead, I've got some work to attend to.
唉，我不評論。你儘管去吧，我還有事要忙。
Moo moo Moooo. (I am a human
哞哞哞——。(我是被變成牛的人類。)
It's not even meant to turn humans into cows! I just made it to turn the exiles back into Wocs! So how does a human become a cow...?
它根本不是用來把人類變成牛的！我做它只是為了把流亡者變回 Woc！那人類是怎麼變成牛的……？
What're you waiting for? Get on through that pipe and talk to Drale!
你還在等什麼？快鑽進那根管子去找 Drale 談談！
Uh... It'll work. I'm sure it will work. It's always- always worked in the past! Heh...
呃……會成的。我確定會成的。以前一直——一直都成的！嘿……
Anyway, uh... Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and it'll take us back to the laboratory.
總之，呃……電梯在這裡！走進去就好，它會帶我們回實驗室。
Come on, get in the elevator!
Come on! Just... pop yourself back in the machine!
來吧！只要……再鑽回機器裡就行了！
Oh, hello! You must be the one cow from earlier, right?
噢，你好！你一定就是剛才那頭牛，對吧？
Well, Drale says you're welcome to visit whenever you'd like, so... Welcome!
嗯，Drale 說隨時歡迎你來，所以……歡迎！
We have many amenities available in this facility, so feel free to make yourself comfortable!
這座設施裡有很多便利設備可以使用，所以請自便，別客氣！
So. We still haven't moved this thing at all, huh?
所以。這玩意兒我們還是一點都沒搬動，是吧？
Guess that makes sense. Everyone's been busy talking about... you know.
想想也合理。大家都忙著在聊……你知道的。
Oh, hey, there they are! Hey, you! You're the one that helped Drale free a bunch of our friends from the ranch, right?
噢，欸，人來了！欸，你！你就是幫 Drale 從牧場救出我們一堆朋友的那位，對吧？
Hey, we never got to thank you for what you did! A lot of us wouldn't be here today if you hadn't. Kyle here definitely wouldn't, heh.
欸，你做的那些事，我們一直沒機會跟你道謝！要不是你，我們很多人今天都不會在這裡。這位 Kyle 肯定不會在，嘿。
Well, I hope we get to see you around some more! We've got to get back to... uh, moving this thing. But, hey, maybe after we can hang out?
嗯，希望以後還能常看到你！我們得回去……呃，搬這玩意兒了。不過，欸，說不定忙完之後可以一起混一下？
Hey... Don't, uh, tell anyone I asked... But you wouldn't happen to- happen to have some... barley?
欸……別，呃，別跟任何人說我問過……不過你該不會——該不會剛好有一點……大麥吧？
Woah, there. Calm yourself, friend. You know the rules about that kind of stuff.
喔，慢著。冷靜點，朋友。那種東西的規矩你是知道的。
Yeah, okay, here. Here's a package of... stuff. Don't tell anyone you got it from me.
好啦，行，拿去。這是一包……東西。別跟任何人說是從我這裡拿的。
Y-yep, of course! Thank you kindly. I'll make sure... nobody kn-
是、是，當然！太感謝了。我保證……不會有人知——
Oh no. H-hello there, Drale's friend! It's- good to. See you! You didn't happen to, uh-
噢不。你、你好啊，Drale 的朋友！很——高興。見到你！你該不會剛好，呃——
Best get moving quick before the word spreads, friend.
趁風聲還沒傳開，你最好快走，朋友。
Looking for the boss again, huh? Well, just as always, he's up ahead in his office. Hard to miss, as usual.
又要找老大啊？跟平常一樣，他就在前面的辦公室裡。照舊，很難錯過。
...So the cow thing wasn't your choice, huh? Could've fooled me. Almost did, really.
……所以變成牛不是你自願的啊？我還真看不出來。老實說，差點就信了。
...Well, this is awkward. Uh. You don't need to talk to me, y'know. Just go on ahead.
……嗯，這有點尷尬。呃。你不用跟我講話的，你知道吧。儘管往前走就好。
Hm... Oh, hi! Welcome back to my office!
嗯……噢，嗨！歡迎回到我的辦公室！
L.H. can continue to produce effectively.
L.H. 得以繼續有效生產。
Mechs in Corkus are still a very controversial subject. Many still want them, but after the factory falling.. It's just too dangerous.
機兵在 Corkus 仍然是個很有爭議的話題。很多人還是想要它們，可是自從工廠倒了之後……實在太危險了。
Before it all burns, get to the top in there and return to me afterwards...
趁還沒全燒光，快進去爬到最上面，之後再回來找我……
Are you deaf as well? Get those crates and put them on the boats, don't go above the limit of {~} though!
你連耳朵也聾了嗎？把那些木箱搬去放到船上，不過別超過 {~} 箱的上限！

During the night I saw something moving across the cliffs.. Looked like a personal balloon. It wouldn't have been out of the ordinary except there are occasional blood trails coming from the balloon...
晚上的時候，我看到有東西沿著崖壁移動……看起來像是單人熱氣球。這本來也沒什麼稀奇的，但那顆氣球下面偶爾會拖出一道血跡……
We're throwing you a feast at the luxurious Five Gears Diner!
我們要在豪華的 Five Gears Diner 為你辦一場盛宴！
Just head through the western gate and follow the signs to get there.
從西門出去，跟著路標走就到了。
You're talkin' to the right guy! Which beacon do you wanna hear about?
你找對人了！你想聽哪個信標的事？
Completing a challenge with a Yellow Beacon will cause one Flying Chest to appear next to the Challenge Reward chest.
選黃色信標完成挑戰後，挑戰獎勵寶箱旁邊會出現一個飛行寶箱。
These flying chests act as extra Challenge Reward chests, and the amount that spawn can be amplified by other conditions, such as Vibrancy or Aqua Beacons
這些飛行寶箱等於是額外的挑戰獎勵寶箱，而且出現的數量還能靠其他條件增加，像是璀璨效果或水藍信標。
A Blue Beacon will offer you a Boon after you complete its challenge.
完成藍色信標的挑戰後，它會讓你選一項加持。
Boons are super helpful, especially as enemies get stronger the later into a run you are.
加持超有用，尤其這趟掠奪長征跑得越後面，敵人就越強。
If you're struggling, I highly recommend grabbing a Blue Beacon to even the odds!
要是打得很吃力，我強烈建議拿個藍色信標來扳回一點劣勢！
A Purple Beacon will give you an extra item in your End Reward Chest, at the cost of a Curse!
紫色信標會讓你的結算獎勵寶箱多一件物品，代價是一層怪物強化！
These beacons are pretty risky, since Curses can massively impact how dangerous enemies are for the rest of your lootrun.
這種信標風險不小，因為怪物強化會大幅影響這趟掠奪長征接下來敵人的危險程度。
However... More loot! Who can say no to that?
不過……更多戰利品耶！誰拒絕得了？
Completing a challenge with a Grey Beacon active will allow you to choose one of three Missions.
在灰色信標生效時完成挑戰，就能從三項使命中選一項。
Completing a Mission will grant you a powerful perk for the rest of your Lootrun, hopefully making it much easier!
完成使命會給你一項強力的加成，持續到這趟掠奪長征結束，希望能讓你輕鬆不少！
Grey Beacons will become rarer over time, especially so if you skip them when they're offered, so grab 'em when you see 'em!
灰色信標會隨著時間越來越少見，出現了卻跳過的話更是如此，所以看到就拿！
What are the Missions and perks, you may ask? Well, it's a surprise! Be sure to take a Grey beacon when you see one, and see what happens!
你可能會問，使命和加成到底是什麼？這個嘛，那是驚喜！看到灰色信標記得拿一個，看看會發生什麼事！
An Orange Beacon will grant you an extra Beacon choice for the next five challenges.
橘色信標會讓你在接下來五場挑戰中多一個信標選項。
These ones are real handy, since the more options you have, the better chance you can get a good one!
這種真的很好用，因為選項越多，碰上好信標的機會就越大！
And if six challenges aren't enough for you, you can increase their duration with Aqua Beacons or Vibrancy!
要是六場挑戰你還嫌不夠，可以靠水藍信標或璀璨效果延長它持續的場數！
An Aqua Beacon will double the effects of your next beacon!
水藍信標會讓你下一個信標的效果加倍！
These ones can be game changers, since you can benefit even more from a good next beacon! However, if you die before your next challenge, you'll lose the Aqua effect!
這種有機會扭轉整個局面，因為下一個信標要是夠好，你能賺到的就更多！不過，要是你在下一場挑戰之前死了，水藍效果就沒了！
That being said, they also double the negatives from your next beacon, like Curses! Choose wisely!
話雖如此，它也會讓下一個信標的負面效果加倍，像是怪物強化！慎選啊！
Oh boy, Dark Grey Beacons are a real nightmare. Think of them like Purple Beacons, but more extreme.
哎呀，深灰信標真的是惡夢。把它想成紫色信標，只是更極端。
They give you {~} bonus items in your End Reward Chest, but also {~} Curses!
它會讓你的結算獎勵寶箱多 {~} 件物品，但同時也給你 {~} 層怪物強化！
If you're up for a real challenge, there's much more loot for you! Personally, I think I'll pass on these...
你要是想來點真正的挑戰，就有多得多的戰利品等著你！我個人嘛，這種我還是跳過好了……
A Green Beacon will give you extra time to complete your lootrun!
綠色信標會給你額外的時間來完成掠奪長征！
Green Beacons will also not buff enemies after their challenge, unlike every other beacon!
而且綠色信標的挑戰結束後不會強化敵人，跟其他信標都不一樣！
I must admit, I lose track of time while fighting sometimes, these are a real lifesaver!
我得承認，我有時候打著打著就忘了時間，這種信標真的是救星！
A Red Beacon will add three more challenges to your run, however, your next three challenges will not extend your time left after completion.
紅色信標會讓這趟掠奪長征多三場挑戰，不過，接下來三場挑戰完成後不會延長你的剩餘時間。
If you're speeding through and don't need the extra time, these can be real great! More challenges means more loot, after all!
你要是一路衝得很快、用不到多的時間，這種就很棒！畢竟挑戰越多，戰利品就越多嘛！
Hoho! A Crimson Beacon is a nasty one, not for the meek, I'll say!
呵呵！緋紅信標可不好惹，我說啊，膽小的別碰！
A Crimson Beacon will enter you into a Crimson Trial, where you'll be branded and put to the test.
緋紅信標會讓你進入緋紅試煉，你會在那裡被打上烙印、接受考驗。
Crimson Beacons will become rarer over time, especially so if you see one but don't take it. So take that into consideration when one shows up.
緋紅信標會隨著時間越來越少見，看到了卻不拿的話更是如此。所以它出現的時候，記得把這點考慮進去。
These trials can get real gruesome, especially late into your run. Though if you can complete one, they offer rewards like no other!
這些試煉有時候真的很殘酷，尤其是跑到後段的時候。不過你要是撐得過一場，它給的獎勵可是別處沒得比的！
A White Beacon isn't a very common sight. They add {~} extra Challenges to your lootrun!
白色信標不太常見。它會讓你的掠奪長征多 {~} 場挑戰！
Only {~} White Beacon can appear per lootrun, so if you've got the time, you should almost always get this one!
每趟掠奪長征只會出現 {~} 個白色信標，所以只要時間夠，幾乎都該拿！
Ooh, this one is special. A Rainbow Beacon will cause every beacon after it to be Vibrant!
喔，這個很特別。彩虹信標會讓它之後的每一個信標都變成璀璨！
A must-get, obviously. Though you won't have the chance very often! I've never even seen one myself!
當然是必拿。只是你不會常有這種機會！我自己連一次都沒見過！
If it weren't for our Lootrun Chief, I wouldn't even know they exist!
要不是我們的掠奪長征主管，我根本不知道有這種東西！
If a Beacon is Vibrant, that means it will double its regular effects.
信標是璀璨的，就表示它原本的效果會加倍。
Getting Vibrant Beacons isn't very common, so keep an eye out and get them when you can!
璀璨信標不太常碰到，所以多留意，能拿就拿！
No worries! Just let me know if you wanna learn more about Beacons.
沒關係！想多了解信標的話再跟我說。
No worries! Just let me know if you wanna learn more about Lootrunning!
沒關係！想多了解掠奪長征的話再跟我說！
Hi there, just reading up on the rulebook for those lootruns!
嗨，我正在研讀那些掠奪長征的規則手冊！
Y'know I've heard so much about people changing their lives after joining the company.
你知道嗎，我聽過好多人加入公司之後人生就不一樣了。
As soon as I got the opportunity there was no way I could pass it up!
所以機會一來，我說什麼都不可能放過！
Well, hello! Hard at work, I trust?
哎呀，你好！想必正在努力工作吧？
...Although, if you wish to know more, you should speak to the Guide. They'll have the information you seek.
……不過，如果你想知道得更詳細，就該去找嚮導談談。你要的資訊，對方都有。
What are you meant to be doing? Well, banishing spirits, of course!
你該做什麼？這個嘛，當然是驅逐惡靈啊！
So, why are you both doing t
所以，你們兩位為什麼要做這件事？
我還是搞不懂。我該做什麼？
...The connection has been established. My part in this is finished.
……連結已經建立。我在這件事裡的職責到此為止。
Good, good. Then all that's left to do is to wait for- ah, there you are!
很好，很好。那接下來就只剩等——啊，你來了！
What do you mean, "what"? Did I not make myself perfectly clear?
你說「什麼」是什麼意思？我講得還不夠清楚嗎？
Hmph. Everyone's a critic. Well, fine then, I can go into more detail, if you so insist!
哼。人人都愛挑毛病。好吧，既然你這麼堅持，我就說得詳細一點！
The Spirit Tide has come upon us once again, and with it, the veil between life and death has thinned. And with that, there are always complications.
靈潮又一次降臨了，生與死之間的帷幕也隨之變薄。而每逢這種時候，總免不了出些亂子。
Stragglers who cannot find their way Beyond. Escapees who take advantage of the occasion to return to your world - some have succeeded already, while others...
有找不到路前往彼界的迷途者，也有趁這個機會逃回你們世界的逃亡者——有些已經得逞了，至於其他的……
Others have not yet broken through. But we cannot allow them to.
其他的還沒有突破過來。但我們不能讓它們得逞。
Exactly! I'm sure you know the rest by now. The Guide here can point you towards the stragglers and escapees, if you speak to them.
正是如此！剩下的你應該都知道了。跟這位嚮導談談，就能得知迷途者與逃亡者的所在。
As for the others... We've spoken to the Event Airship Captain. He'll bring you there directly.
至於其他的……我們已經跟活動飛艇的船長談過了。他會直接把你送過去。
We'll speak there. See you soon!
我們到那邊再談。待會見！
...And he's gone. You heard what he said. Speak to me for the Guiding, and take the airship for the Banishment.
……他走了。他說的你都聽到了。要引渡就來找我，要驅逐就去搭飛艇。
...You return. I take it you are willing to take up the task of the Guiding?
……你回來了。看來你願意接下引渡的任務了？
Good. Let us begin. We will commune with those Beyond, to discern the location of those escaped.
很好。我們開始吧。我們要與彼界的亡魂溝通，找出逃脫者的下落。
...So you are not prepared. Return when you are willing to take up this task.
……看來你還沒準備好。等你願意接下這項任務時再回來。
Remember! Whether a parting last forever or merely a short time... That is up to you.
記住！離別是永遠，還是只有短短一陣子……全看你自己。
Ah, welcome back. How can I help you?
啊，歡迎回來。有什麼我能效勞的嗎？
I can't believe you helped this guy. He was obviously lying.
真不敢相信你居然幫了這傢伙。他明擺著在說謊。
For the last time, you're not getting my Moonsalts! Begone with you!
我最後說一次，我的 Moonsalts 不會給你！快給我走！
...Again, you return. And yet, the spirit remains. Do you require guidance? Or, perhaps, something else?
……你又回來了。可是亡魂還留在原地。你需要指引嗎？還是說，有別的事？
You should go see Omango back near the crashed ship!
你該回去墜毀的船那邊找 Omango！
Oh, hello {u}. Are you here for training as well? I've been honing my skills against these dummies... so that I'll be ready next time I need to fight.
喔，你好，{u}。你也是來訓練的嗎？我一直拿這些假人磨練身手……這樣下次需要戰鬥的時候，我才不會手忙腳亂。
That was good fighting out there, {u}! I'm going to head back to {p} for now, see if there's anything else I can do around there.
剛才打得漂亮，{u}！我先回 {p} 一趟，看看那邊還有什麼我幫得上忙的。
The apparition of Asher is frozen in time, unable to speak or move.
Asher 的幻影凍結在時間裡，無法說話也無法動彈。
I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him. Leave me now, I need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
我想你的朋友就在塔外面。你或許該去看看他。現在讓我一個人靜一靜，我得繼續我的研究。還有更多東西等著我去弄明白，我很確定……
... You return. And, so it seems, the spirits have been guided home. Well done. Come talk to me for your reward.
……你回來了。看來亡魂都已經被引渡回家。做得好。來找我領你的獎勵吧。
...You have done well. But that is only one of many lost souls. We have much work ahead of us.
……你做得很好。但那只是眾多失落之魂中的一個。我們還有很多事要做。
...But first, there is something I must tell you. The Seer... said you should be rewarded for your work.
……不過在那之前，有件事我得告訴你。先知……說你的付出應該得到回報。
So. As a start... take this.
所以。先從這個開始……拿去吧。
This is a ticket used for the Drawing of the Spirits, which the Seer is holding in the northwest corner of this city.
這是靈魂抽獎用的票券，先知正在這座城市的西北角舉辦抽獎。
For each Lost Soul you guide, I will grant you one ticket. Each Bounty Spirit will earn you two.
你每引渡一個失落之魂，我就給你一張票券。每個懸賞亡魂則是兩張。
...Or so the Seer told me to say.
Beyond that, however, I also have many artifacts I can offer you. Once you guide enough spirits, I can grant these to you.
不過除此之外，我手上還有許多聖物可以給你。只要你引渡的亡魂夠多，我就能把它們交給你。
To solidify this agreement... You may have the first. Simply click the reward's button to claim it.
為了讓這份約定算數……第一件就先給你。點一下獎勵的按鈕就能領取。
...Then it is agreed. You will help us guide these wayward spirits home. Speak to me when you would like to continue.
……那就這麼說定了。你會幫我們把這些迷途的亡魂引渡回家。想繼續的時候再來找我。
Very well. Let us commune with those Beyond once more.
很好。讓我們再一次與彼界的亡魂溝通。
You return. More spirits have been guided where they belong.
你回來了。又有更多亡魂被引渡到他們該去的地方。
...You are owed {~} Spectral Tickets. They are yours.
……我還欠你 {~} 張幽魂票券。拿去吧。
...Is there anything you need of me?
...Of course. I will show you what you may gain through the Guiding.
……當然。我讓你看看引渡能換到些什麼。
And so the hero arrives! And just in the nick of time, I should add.
英雄駕到！而且容我補一句，來得正是時候。
Well, if you're here, you must be in search of the Drawing, yes?
嗯，既然你來了，想必是來找抽獎的，對吧？
Indeed, indeed... The spirits have many riches they would share, for the right price.
沒錯，沒錯……亡魂們有不少財寶願意分享，只要價碼合適。
What price? It's rather simple. Aid my two companions, and you shall receive the tickets you seek.
什麼價碼？很簡單。幫我那兩位同伴的忙，你就能拿到你要的票券。
One Spectral Ticket for one draw. Seems fair, does it not?
一張幽魂票券抽一次。很公道，不是嗎？
...Oh, I nearly forgot to mention! Return here when the time is right, and the spirits may reward you greatly.
……喔，差點忘了說！時機對的時候回到這裡，亡魂說不定會重重賞你。
You may spend your tickets as you wish, but don't forget to do so before we depart!
票券要怎麼用隨你高興，但別忘了在我們離開之前用掉！
If you have any tickets you'd like to spend, speak to me once more.
要是你有票券想用，就再來找我一次。
Welcome back, hero. Have you come for the Drawing?
歡迎回來，英雄。你是來抽獎的嗎？
You have tickets, then! Let's see, how many do you have here...
看來你有票券！我看看，你這裡有幾張……
That's {~} new tickets, for a total of {~}. When you'd like to draw your rewards, speak to me again!
新增 {~} 張票券，總共 {~} 張。想抽獎的時候，再來找我！
You have a total of {~} draws ready. Would you like to spend them all?
你總共可以抽 {~} 次。要一次全部用掉嗎？
You have options! If you aid the Guide with their Guiding, you may be rewarded.
你有幾條路可以選！要是你幫嚮導進行引渡，說不定會有獎賞。
Additionally, the Envoy requires assistance with banishing some of the more threatening spirits. It could be worth your while!
另外，使者需要人手幫忙驅逐一些比較危險的亡魂。說不定值得你跑一趟！
And, of course... if you visit here at certain times, the spirits will reward you greatly.
還有，當然……如果你在特定的時間來這裡，亡魂會重重賞你。

Isn't that the human who won the scavenger hunt?
那不是贏了尋寶大賽的那個人類嗎？
Hey there friend! Looking teh barter fer some weapons or trinkets?
嘿，朋友！想來換點武器或小玩意兒不？
Scum! That guy jus' stole a necklace! Catch 'im and jus' take this as payment!!
混帳！那傢伙剛偷了一條項鍊！去把他抓住，這個就當作報酬拿去！！
You read an entry in the worn journal...
你讀了這本破舊日記裡的一則記事……
A stranger came into town today all the way from {p}. {p} of all places! What do the folk there want with us in this small town?
今天鎮上來了個陌生人，大老遠從 {p} 來的。偏偏是 {p}！那裡的人找我們這種小鎮要做什麼？
It's nothing but farmland for as far as the eye can see around here. I want some excitement! I want to go to {p} and see the castle there!
這一帶放眼望去全是農田。我想要一點刺激！我想去 {p} 看看那裡的城堡！
Who knows, maybe this'll all blow over soon...
誰知道呢，說不定這一切很快就會過去……
Sir Theorick, if you, um...if you have a moment? Your tribute is here...
Theorick 大人，請問您，呃……您方便一下嗎？您的貢品到了……
...good. Thank you. Good to see some who honestly respect what I'm trying to do for all of you. Was there anyone else?
……很好。謝謝。看到還有人真心敬重我為你們所做的事，我很欣慰。還有其他人嗎？
Ah...no. There...there wasn't. Not this time. They feel like you're taking too much from them, which I don't agree with, but-
啊……沒有。這次……這次沒有了。他們覺得您跟他們拿得太多了，我並不認同這種說法，可是——
...ask them, if they would prefer their money, or their lives. Am I not protecting them? Is it really so much to ask that I get something in return?
……去問問他們，是要錢，還是要命。難道我沒在保護他們嗎？我要求一點回報，真的過分到這種地步嗎？
We...we know. We told them that, too...we're sorry.
我們……我們知道。這些話我們也跟他們說過了……很抱歉。
You aren't the ones who need to apologize! I'm aware it's a voluntary contribution, but do they have any idea how difficult it is to cast magic like this regularly?!
該道歉的不是你們！我知道那是自願捐獻，但他們有沒有概念，要定期施展這種魔法有多困難？！
Howdy feller! This here is my cactus stand.
你好啊，老兄！這就是我的仙人掌攤。
I travel all across the desert, cutting down cactus for the juice!
我跑遍整片沙漠，砍仙人掌來榨汁！
Only the sharpest blades'll cut these cactus though. My collection's out back. You can look, but don't touch!
不過只有最利的刀砍得動這些仙人掌。我的收藏放在後面。可以看，但不准碰！
The telescope is pointed towards {p}... Wait. You spot something glimmering in the tree trunk.
望遠鏡對著 {p}……等等。你看到樹幹裡有東西在閃。
I regret to inform you that the girl has indeed perished, despite our best efforts.
我遺憾地通知您，儘管我們竭盡全力，那個女孩確實已經去世了。
We have tried all the emergency plans, but none have worked so far.
我們所有的緊急方案都試過了，但到目前為止全都沒用。
Not even the potion that Lanis suggested did anything... We are truly lost.
連 Lanis 建議的那帖藥水也毫無作用……我們真的走投無路了。
The Talor folk have been spotted patrolling the entire forest. There are no other possible explanations!
有人看到 Talor 家的人在整座森林裡巡邏。不可能有別的解釋！
We must come up with a new plan, or else--
我們必須想出新的計畫，否則——
The rest of the letter has been ripped off.
信的其餘部分被撕掉了。
No matter, it can be sorted ou-
I only serve customers with something to show me.
我只招待拿得出東西給我看的客人。
There's an inscription, but it's written in a language you can't understand.
上面有一段銘文，但寫的是你看不懂的語言。
"They have taken the forest. The last barrier between them and {p} is us."
「他們拿下了森林。擋在他們和 {p} 之間的最後一道屏障就是我們。」
"We must fortify. Put those fires out!"
「我們必須加強防禦。把那些火撲滅！」
"If we lose tree cover, we lose the war."
「失去樹林的掩護，我們就輸掉這場戰爭了。」
May the woman who died here in tonight's raid rest in peace. Though we did not know her name, her memory will live on through her son.
願今夜這場突襲中死在這裡的女子安息。雖然我們不知道她的名字，但她會透過她的兒子被記住。
Aha! So you can crack my defenses...then let me see what you are made of up close, Wynn warrior.
啊哈！原來你攻得破我的防禦……那就讓我近距離瞧瞧你有幾兩重吧，Wynn 的戰士。
There have been scarce few to push me to this point... I will not stop, however. You have not won yet, Wynn warrior!
能把我逼到這一步的人寥寥無幾……但我不會就此罷手。你還沒贏呢，Wynn 的戰士！
My pulse... Your brilliance is blinding- Your power so much more than I expected.
我的脈搏……你的光芒如此耀眼——你的力量遠超我的預期。
Maybe we haven't! But that's quite alright. The Seer was very specific with his instructions, as always.
也許沒見過吧！不過那完全沒關係。先知的指示一如往常地非常具體。
In any case, you asked who we are? We're... shall we say, a group of individuals interested in the continued wellbeing of this realm!
總之，你問我們是誰？我們是……這麼說吧，一群關心這個世界能否長治久安的人！
Exactly! And, so, we need your help. The Guide here can point you towards the stragglers and escapees, if you speak to them.
正是如此！所以，我們需要你的幫忙。跟這位嚮導談談，就能得知迷途者與逃亡者的所在。
...You return. Again. Are you prepared for the task of the Guiding this time?
……你又回來了。這次你準備好接下引渡的任務了嗎？
You have heard from those Beyond. Let their words guide you.
你已經聽過彼界的聲音了。讓他們的話語指引你吧。
Find the lost soul, and guide it here. I will return it to its proper place.
找到那個失落之魂，把他引渡到這裡來。我會把他送回他該去的地方。
...No matter. The reward is yours, when you would wish it. You will help us guide these wayward spirits home. Speak to me when you would like to continue.
……無妨。獎勵隨時都是你的。你會幫我們把這些迷途的亡魂引渡回家。想繼續的時候再來找我。
...I was in their position, once. I do not wish for a repeat of what happens if they are not returned.
……我也曾經跟他們處境相同。我不希望他們回不去時會發生的事再次重演。
Hm... I see. Disappointing, but you know where to come when you're ready, don't you?
嗯……我懂了。有點失望，不過等你準備好了，你知道該來哪裡找我，對吧？
Ah, alright then. Sorry, you reminded me of someone who helped me one time.
啊，這樣啊。抱歉，你讓我想起以前幫過我的某個人。
Who did you mistake me for?
Oh, just a human who came to my aid when I was down near {p} a while back.
喔，只是前陣子我在 {p} 附近落難時，出手幫了我的一個人類。
You see, that pumpkin mask in the case there is haunted, and I was transporting it, and it escaped!
是這樣的，那邊箱子裡的南瓜面具在鬧鬼，我在運送它的時候，它居然逃走了！
Fled into some old corrupted mine. Bet it thought it could escape me there.
它逃進了一座腐敗的舊礦坑。我猜它以為躲在那裡就能甩掉我。
Anyway, some human came along. A {p} soldier like yourself, actually. They retrieved the mask from the cave for me.
總之，後來有個人類路過。其實就是跟你一樣的 {p} 士兵。那個人替我把面具從洞窟裡拿了回來。
This macabre old mask did a great job at masquerading as a regular old antique, but now I know its secrets. Unfortunately it's still extremely burdensome to take care of...
這個陰森的老面具把自己偽裝成普通古董，裝得可真像，但現在我已經知道它的秘密了。可惜照顧它還是非常累人……
I really hope I can find someone here who can take it off my hands...
真希望能在這裡找到人把它接手過去……
Ah, you mean that strange fellow on the tree stump over there, right?
啊，你是說那邊樹樁上那個怪傢伙，對吧？
He's quite an ominous guy, but I don't mind him.
他是個挺不祥的傢伙，不過我不介意。
In fact, his two friends also seem like nice folk. They were very happy to let me set up shop here.
其實他那兩個朋友看起來也都是好人。他們很樂意讓我在這裡擺攤。
Can't say I completely understand what they're doing, but I'm not complaining about this perfect sales opportunity!
我不敢說完全懂他們在做什麼，但這麼好的賺錢機會，我可沒什麼好抱怨的！
However, I've also decided to throw in this Haunted Mask. You wouldn't know about it, so all you need to know is that it's very hostile and likes to escape.
不過，我也決定把這個鬧鬼面具一起拿出來。你不會知道它的來歷，所以你只需要知道，它非常兇，而且很愛逃跑。
Oh- hello! Sorry, was just... lost in thought.
喔——你好！抱歉，我剛剛只是……想事情想得出神了。
I'm thinking through a problem, right now... Do you mind coming back later?
我現在正在想一個問題……你介意晚點再來嗎？
You will need to enter the mine and get the cobblestone to fix Kroac's house...
你得進入礦坑拿些圓石，才能修好 Kroac 的房子……
I have written the coordinates of the cave Krolton hides in, in your content book.
我已經把 Krolton 藏身的洞穴座標寫進你的綜合手冊了。
Urrugh... My legs... they feel like they've been stretched... Am I taller?
呃啊……我的腿……感覺像被拉長了……我是不是變高了？
Then let us commune with those Beyond, once more.
那麼，讓我們再一次與彼界的亡魂溝通吧。
Well, I went safely back to my homeland, and continued selling masks there.
這個嘛，我平安回到了故鄉，在那裡繼續賣面具。
Not much to say besides that, except the fact that taking care of this Haunted Mask became tiresome.
除此之外也沒什麼好說的，只是照顧這個鬧鬼面具實在讓人累壞了。
I came back to Wynn to acquire some more antique masks from my associate, and, to my surprise, a spooky festival was on!
我回到 Wynn 向合夥人收購更多古董面具，沒想到竟然碰上一場陰森的慶典！
Perfect chance for me to sell some masks, and get rid of this Haunted Mask, so I stopped by!
正是賣面具、順便擺脫這個鬧鬼面具的大好機會，所以我就過來了！
So, how have your travels been? You look like you've traveled the whole world. I can feel your power even from here!
那麼，你的旅途如何？你看起來像是走遍了整個世界。我在這裡都能感覺到你的力量！
Well, suit yourself. I think I'll have one, myself.
好吧，隨你。我想我自己來一杯。
We can't leave each other behind. {u}, keep moving!
我們不能丟下彼此。{u}，繼續走！
You need to go through void holes to see if you can get across these spikes.
你得穿過虛空洞，看看能不能越過這些尖刺。
Eugh. Weren't you listening before? I have no time for these games- oh, no matter, I don't care which is which.
呃。你剛才沒在聽嗎？我沒空陪你玩這些把戲——喔，算了，哪個是哪個我才不在乎。
Scaling the dam would be too risky...
Oi! There's no way you're getting through without a passport!
喂！沒有通行證你休想通過！
It happened again. The challenger was crushed.
又發生了。挑戰者被壓扁了。
And what is different about it this time that is so important? There are many hopefuls who are defeated, are there not?
這次又有什麼不同，值得這麼大驚小怪？被打敗的挑戰者多得是，不是嗎？
I mean crushed. Literally. It shook the room apart, and the challenger died from falling rubble.
我是說壓扁。字面上的意思。整個房間被震垮，挑戰者被掉下來的碎石砸死了。
...surely you jest. Is the Hive not reinforced to resist the powers of its creatures?
……你一定是在開玩笑。蜂巢不是有加固過，能承受裡頭那些生物的力量嗎？
This one's different. It's so violent that it's caused its own room to cave in more than once.
這隻不一樣。他兇暴到不只一次把自己的房間弄塌。
And it survives still? ...Somehow or another, that is impressive. But we must go in?
而他居然還活著？……不管怎麼說，這倒是挺了不起的。不過我們非得進去不可？
And clear out the rubble. The morphs have already repaired the walls, we just have to clear the space.
還要清掉碎石。變形體已經把牆修好了，我們只要把空間清出來就行。
I should hope the beast is restrained, then, else we too will be bloody smears.
那我可希望那頭野獸被拴住了，不然我們也會變成兩灘血跡。
I almost had it, I almost had it!! Ugh, I never want to see a drop of water again!!
我差一點就成功了，差一點就成功了！！呃，我這輩子再也不想看到一滴水了！！
I withstood the whirlpools it trapped me in... I dealt with the walls of water...
我撐過了他把我困住的漩渦……也應付了那些水牆……
Was it really just distracted the whole time, or was I being toyed with?
他真的從頭到尾都在分心，還是我一直被耍著玩？
That deluge at the end... How is anyone supposed to withstand that?
最後那場洪水……到底要怎麼樣才撐得過去？
Back to {p} with me. Maybe the sun will dry out my clothes after a month or two.
我要回 {p} 了。說不定曬個一兩個月的太陽，衣服就會乾了。
These distractions belie my true power. Behold, and kneel before the law of the Hive!
這些小把戲不過是掩飾我真正的力量。看好了，跪拜在蜂巢的法則之前吧！
You have decent skill, I will admit. But the seas will claim all!
我承認你的身手還不錯。但大海終將吞沒一切！
The ocean winds shall claim you in this bout.
這一回合，海風將會吞沒你。
...it counterattacks. I didn't think it would counterattack.
……他會反擊。我沒想到他會反擊。
It really was just the worst matchup. I couldn't exactly direct my totem to NOT hit it!
這組對手真的是最糟的組合。我又不能叫我的圖騰「不要」打到他！
The faster you damage it the more it attacks. You are about to try too, yes?
你傷他傷得越快，他攻擊得就越猛。你也要去試試，是吧？
Still. I must nearly have defeated it. That Oceanic Judge seemed to have more endurance than it.
不過，我一定差一點就打倒他了。那個大洋審判者的耐力似乎比他還強。
Strange, but I suppose the division leader here simply focuses more on offense than defense.
真奇怪，不過我想這裡的部隊首領只是比起防守更專注於進攻吧。
Now, ehm... I must try and find some soothing balms for my skin...
好了，呃……我得去找些能舒緩皮膚的藥膏了……
Now, you will burn away before me.
現在，你將在我面前燃燒殆盡。
Hm. It seems I will need to pick up the pace.
嗯。看來我得加快步調了。
You fight well. We shall see if you can adapt to this.
你打得不錯。就讓我們看看你能不能適應這個。
Many have made it this far. None have succeeded- not against me.
走到這一步的人很多。卻沒有一個成功——至少對上我沒有。
I must admit my pleasure seeing you last this long- It is a refreshing change of pace.
我必須承認，看你撐了這麼久，我很高興——這倒是個令人耳目一新的轉變。
Do not presume I am limited to merely one trick. My knowledge surpasses the barriers of reality itself.
別以為我只有一招。我的知識超越了現實本身的界限。
Oh? You look surprised! Is it a wonder that the creator may be able to use powers of those she has created?
噢？你看起來很驚訝！創造者能夠使用她所創造之物的力量，有什麼好奇怪的？
But all things can be improved. Everything can be iterated upon and made stronger... And that includes you.
但萬物皆可改進。一切都能反覆打磨、變得更強……這也包括你。
Practice, rigorous training, magical equipment... And have you not gained all of these from my glorious Hive?
練習、嚴格的訓練、魔法裝備……這些你不都是從我榮耀的蜂巢裡得到的嗎？
The guards here are only trained in combat, not in solving mysteries. That's why the mayor called you!
這裡的守衛只受過戰鬥訓練，可不會解謎。所以鎮長才會找你來！
If you have any questions, go to the waiting room and wait for your turn, not run into my office willy-nilly! You'd have to be level {~} for that luxury.
有問題的話就去候客室等著輪到你，別隨隨便便闖進我的辦公室！想享受這種待遇，你得先到 {~} 級才行。
Check the Eastern Exit! I'm pretty sure that's where the hooded person keeps returning to.
去查查東側出口！我很確定那個戴兜帽的人一直往那裡跑。
Let's keep what happened here a secret, okay?
這裡發生的事，我們就當作祕密吧，好嗎？
{p} and its citizens are thankful for your service. The line between Human and Villager remains firmly in place... For the most part.
{p} 和全體市民都感謝你的協助。人類與村民之間的界線依然穩固……大致上是如此。
Whatever this thing is, it's broken. Probably best to leave it be for now.
不管這是什麼東西，它壞了。現在最好先別管它。
They appear to be asleep... Might be worth checking back later. Perhaps you could explore the path further...
他們似乎在睡覺……晚點再回來看看或許值得。也許你可以再往那條路深入探索……
又見面了。改變主意了嗎？
Welcome back. What do you need?
Anything else you would like to know?
You'll need to fix the broken transporter yourself. Maybe you can make something in the workshop?
你得自己修好那台壞掉的傳送裝置。也許可以在工作坊裡做點什麼？
This looks like it'd break if you punched it hard enough.
看起來只要揍得夠用力，這東西就會壞掉。
>Bring the keys to where madman dwells.
Welcome to my wonderful wooden home!
歡迎來到我美妙的木頭小屋！
You are welcome here as long as you don't have any mushrooms or chickens.
只要你身上沒有蘑菇或雞，這裡就歡迎你。
I hate those things. Just my home and me.
我討厭那些東西。只要我的家和我就好。
Hey there! What's this, you ask? Only the latest in a long line of ingenious Dwarven developments, now available to the public!
嘿，你好！你問這是什麼？這可是一長串天才矮人發明中的最新傑作，現在開放給大眾使用了！

With this right here machine, you can refine the Smouldering Chunks you get from the trees around the {p} into several ingredients. Unfortunately, the Refinery Merchant still has exclusive rights to those odd metal lumps...
有了這台機器，你就能把從 {p} 一帶樹上取得的 Smouldering Chunks 精煉成好幾種素材。可惜那些奇怪的金屬塊，精煉商人還握有獨家權利……
Ah, anyways! For the low price of [{~} Emerald Blocks], you'll be able to use the refinery any time you want! Whaddaya say?
啊，總之！只要區區 [{~} 塊綠寶石磚] 的低價，你就能隨時使用這座精煉廠！你怎麼說？
Ah well, that's okay. Feel free to come back any time though. The offer still stands.
啊，好吧，沒關係。不過隨時歡迎你回來。這個提議一直有效。
I saw some {p} soldiers come by earlier.
我稍早看到一些 {p} 的士兵經過。
I hope there's not another conflict on the horizon...
希望不會又要起什麼衝突……
She tugged you right back in with sheer force.
她用蠻力一把將你拽了回來。
This is filled with water. There're no clothes inside though.
這裡面裝滿了水。不過裡面沒有衣服。
It has random clothes, but no real outfit.
裡面有些零散的衣服，但沒有一整套像樣的服裝。
It's empty. You already found this chest.
裡面是空的。你已經找過這個箱子了。
You should show your newfound letter to Ava!
你該把剛拿到的信拿給 Ava 看！
迷你任務開始: 獵殺骷髏
Thankful human try help, but how even get into fort? Serepe should stopped...
感謝人類想幫忙，可是怎麼進要塞？Serepe 應該阻止……
...hmh. Onluk take inside. Makes sense now. She like Onluk. Like Onluk MUCH.
……嗯。Onluk 帶進去。現在懂了。她喜歡 Onluk。很喜歡 Onluk。
Like look at Onluk, like talk Onluk, never hit Onluk...
像是看 Onluk、跟 Onluk 說話、從不打 Onluk……
...wonder if villager know about death machine. Not machine that make death, machine that run on death.
……不知道村民知不知道死亡機器。不是製造死亡的機器，是靠死亡運轉的機器。
Bury parts for them. Not right to use tainted metal for things.
替他們把零件埋了。用被污染的金屬做東西，不對。
Tough human, to survive four-way attack. Or maybe just tough armour. Gaudy, bulky armour...
人類真耐打，四面圍攻都活下來。也可能只是護甲耐打。俗氣、笨重的護甲……
For tough human, will tell something that villager and human not know.
因為人類耐打，告訴你一件村民和人類都不知道的事。
All skulls on pikes outside, at other camp, not villager skull. Not human skull. Orc skull.
外面插在長矛上的頭骨，另一個營地那些，不是村民頭骨。不是人類頭骨。是獸人頭骨。
Show people who attack the cost of it. Show those who were killed as reminder. Not escape consequences.
讓攻擊的人看到代價。讓被殺的人當作警告。逃不掉後果。
...human trying now, but Ismikku see many things. Know human contributed many skulls to pikes. We watching you.
……人類現在有在努力，可是 Ismikku 看過很多事。知道人類讓很多頭骨插上長矛。我們在看著你。
Bah... Kreimu worry too much. Will be fine now.
哼……Kreimu 擔心太多。現在沒事了。
...did not expect see good human in lifetime.
……沒想過這輩子會看到好人類。
Armour still look gaudy though. Should wear orc leathers if want match style.
不過護甲還是很俗氣。想配得上風格，應該穿獸人皮甲。
What's a man gotta do to get some sleep around here?! I take a doze in this secluded corner, and I wake up to this racket!? Quiet down!
在這裡想好好睡個覺到底要怎樣啊？！我在這個偏僻角落打個盹，醒來就聽到這陣吵鬧！？安靜點！
AHHHH!! OH! I'M FREE!!! I think those slimes have some sort of numbing agent in them, I can finally feel again! And I've got a migraine!
啊啊啊啊！！喔！我自由了！！！那些史萊姆身上好像有某種麻醉的東西，我終於又有感覺了！然後我偏頭痛發作了！
Hey, get away from that! What are you even doing down here?!
嘿，離那東西遠一點！你跑到這底下來到底想幹嘛？！
Oh-ho! And look who we 'ave 'ere. A lone soldier steppin' on our turf.
喔呵！瞧瞧這是誰啊。一個單槍匹馬的小兵，竟敢踩上咱們的地盤。
Why don'tcha come closer and let me get a good look at'cha, huh!?
幹嘛不靠過來一點，讓我好好瞧瞧你啊，嗯！？
Gentle winds seem to congeal here. With a little help they might become useful.
輕柔的風似乎在這裡凝聚。稍加協助，或許就能派上用場。
You can come back at any time.
To enter the enclosure, you must complete The Canyon Guides
要進入圍場，你必須完成「峽谷嚮導」
If it weren't for the dying part, getting dissolved in these guys isn't so bad. It's like a massage, my back feels good as new!
要不是會死掉，被這些傢伙溶解其實還不賴。就像在按摩一樣，我的背舒服得跟新的一樣！

{u}, wait! Let's hear from Ope before we go into that cave.
{u}，等等！進那個洞穴之前，我們先聽聽 Ope 怎麼說。
Please save my son! Bring me proof of the dead witch too.
請救救我的兒子！也把那個女巫已死的證據帶來給我。
I'll go on ahead to the barracks, you should come as soon as you can.
我先去兵營，你盡快過來。
There's more spiders here than I expected... Nothing we can't handle, of course, but- still.
這裡的蜘蛛比我想的還多……當然沒有我們應付不了的，不過——還是。
I have a task for you, but you are...perhaps a bit ill-equipped? Come back when you are level {~}.
我有個任務要給你，不過你……似乎還有點準備不足？等你到 {~} 級再來吧。
這是一株長相古怪的海中植物。
It's a... pumpkin? How did this get here?
這是一顆……南瓜？它怎麼會在這裡？
I hope you find some food, Nick probably knows where to ask next.
希望你能找到一些食物，Nick 大概知道接下來該去問誰。
這顆水晶看起來很重要..
Me back ain' gunna hold up carryin' all that gold. Bring me my [{~} Gold Chunks] from the tunnel, and then I'll give ye yer information.
俺的背扛不了那麼多金子。去隧道裡把俺的 [{~} 塊金塊] 拿來，然後俺就把消息告訴你。
I wonder if me and my wife should've come here. I thought this secluded little hamlet would be peaceful, but the pigmen have been getting quite rowdy lately!
我在想，我跟我老婆是不是不該搬來這裡。我還以為這個偏僻的小村子會很平靜，可是最近那些豬人越來越鬧了！
I keep seeing the guards out by the gate fighting the blasted hamhocks. If we could just figure out where they're all coming from, we could put an end to it...
我老是看到守衛在大門外跟那些該死的豬蹄膀打架。要是我們能弄清楚牠們都是從哪裡冒出來的，就能做個了斷……
But their brutish stature belies a vicious cunning! None of us can find where the raiders are all coming from, they must be hiding their base astoundingly!
可是牠們粗野的外表底下藏著兇狠的狡詐！我們沒人找得到那些劫掠者是從哪裡來的，牠們把基地藏得好得驚人！
Thank you so much for bringing peace between our nations!
非常感謝你為我們兩國帶來和平！
has someone entered the sanctum? i did not think the bindings would allow entry to anyone from the outside. reveal yourself intruder!
有人進入聖殿了嗎？我以為那些束縛不會讓任何外人進來。現身吧，入侵者！
do not wander further intruder. i will deal with you shortly! this must take priority.
別再往裡面走了，入侵者。我很快就會來收拾你！這件事必須優先處理。
oh for heavens sake- You haven't understood a word I've said, have you? What an unrefined way of speech. Now, if you have intruded here, surely you must know who you are angering.
噢，我的老天——你一個字都沒聽懂，對吧？多麼粗俗的說話方式。好了，既然你闖了進來，想必你一定知道自己激怒的是誰。
Come to think of it, was that Poxper using... No, he couldn't have been casting magic, he had to have just been using the Axe's runewords...
這麼說來，那個 Poxper 用的是……不，他不可能在施法，他一定只是用了那把斧頭的符文咒語……
Are you another one of them "Ragny" soldiers they're sending over to deal with the Orcs? Welcome to Gavel, I 'spose.
你也是他們派來對付獸人的那些「Ragny」士兵之一嗎？那，歡迎來到 Gavel 吧，我想。
What do ya think of {p}? Ain't it pretty? It's where some of the richest people in the province live. Trade magnates and that.
你覺得 {p} 怎麼樣？很漂亮吧？這個行省裡一些最有錢的人就住在這裡。貿易大亨之類的。
Me? Though I'm lucky enough to live on the outskirts, I'm just a stablehand. I'm tryin' out somethin' new though in the hope it'll be my big break, a Time Trial.
我嗎？雖然我很幸運能住在城郊，但我只是個馬夫。不過我正在嘗試一些新東西，希望能讓我一舉成名，那就是計時賽。
I'm thinkin' the rich folks nearby might be entertained by it. Say, I have a route planned out for it, d'ya wanna give it a try?
我在想附近那些有錢人可能會覺得很有趣。對了，我已經規劃好一條路線，你要不要試試看？
There'll be stuff in it for ya if ya do. If you're in, talk to me again.
你要是來的話，會有好處給你的。要參加的話，再來找我說話。
N-no! NO! NO, NO! You idiot, you blundering HUMAN! A hundred lives lost in vain to your destructiveness!!
不、不！不！不、不！你這白痴，你這笨手笨腳的「人類」！一百條性命都因為你的破壞白白犧牲了！！
Why did they ever open the doors?! You all deserve to burn apart! You've ruined everything!!
他們到底為什麼要打開那些門？！你們全都該被燒個粉碎！你們把一切都毀了！！
The Quartron's energy spike is overloading the lab's quartz! This entire room is going to explode and kill everyone in it! ARE YOU PROUD?!
Quartron 的能量暴衝讓實驗室的石英超載了！整個房間都會爆炸，把裡面的人全部炸死！你很得意嗎？！
You can't enter this passage! You are way too weak to be a member of this town. Come back when you will be level {~}.
你不能進這條通道！你太弱了，不配當這個鎮的一員。等你到 {~} 級再來吧。
*cough* come speak with me... *cough* We don't have much time... *cough*
*咳* 過來跟我說話……*咳* 我們沒多少時間了……*咳*
Hi! I'm glad to be able to speak to someone.
嗨！真高興能跟人說說話。
Look around and gather some oats for me, will you...
四處看看，幫我收集一些燕麥好嗎……
Perhaps you could help when you are level {~}, but right now, my problem is far too dangerous for you to help.
等你到 {~} 級也許就能幫上忙，但現在，我的問題對你來說實在太危險了。
The element of freedom and high spirits. Now, choose a Practical Magic lesson.
自由與高昂意氣的元素。接下來，選一堂實用魔法課。
You need to make an herbal balm to try and heal the orc with.
你得做一份草藥膏，試著拿去治療那個獸人。
What, human get confused and give stalks to Kreimu instead?
什麼，人類搞混了，把莖拿給 Kreimu 了？
Bring me, Creinu- not Kreimu- [{~} Leafy Stalks].
拿來給我，Creinu——不是 Kreimu——[{~} 葉狀莖]。

The source of the Decay
tearing apart Gavel lies
within the great Nexus at the
heart of the Realm of Light.
The Light itself is fading.
Its embodiment is suffering.
Save Him.
撕裂 Gavel 的黯蝕，其源頭就在光之領域中心的那座大樞紐裡。光本身正在消逝，它的化身正在受苦。救救祂。

Homes ravaged by Decay, the
subterranean Grootslangs
search frantically for a
better habitat. Though they
harbor no ill intent, they
pose a significant risk for
the people of {p}, and
perhaps for all of Gavel.
家園被黯蝕摧毀之後，地底的 Grootslang 拚命尋找更好的棲地。他們並無惡意，卻對 {p} 的居民構成重大威脅——或許對整個 Gavel 都是。

Void Holes are strange... Are
they natural? Or are they
artificial? What makes them?
What happens to the matter
which they replace? A
particularly large Void Hole
rests within the centre of
the Silent Expanse, perhaps
it holds the answer to these
questions...
虛空洞十分詭異……它們是自然形成的嗎？還是人為的？是什麼造出了它們？被它們取代的物質又去了哪裡？The Silent Expanse 的正中央有一個特別巨大的虛空洞，或許答案就在那裡……

On the brink of war, Fruma
faces devastation from within
the palace walls. Its source
must be stopped, at all costs.
戰爭一觸即發，而 Fruma 的浩劫來自王宮高牆之內。無論付出什麼代價，都必須阻止它的源頭。

In its effort to protect
Gavel, the Canyon Colossus
instead only endangers the
province. With nobody to
maintain it for centuries, it
is on the verge of tearing
the land asunder. It must be
calmed, as soon as possible.
峽谷巨像為了守護 Gavel，反而讓整個行省陷入險境。數百年來無人維護，它隨時可能把大地撕裂。必須盡快讓它平息下來。

The Realm of Influence is named aptly- abominably powerful forces selfishly lay claim to it, and with their command change that realm in their image.
影響領域這個名字取得貼切——強大得令人憎惡的力量自私地將它據為己有，再憑自己的號令，把那個界域改造成自己的模樣。
The dark eroded at what it wished to claim, voraciously consuming the crumbling pieces. The holes left behind, devoid of physicality and presence, twist upon themselves.
黑暗侵蝕著它想佔有的一切，貪婪地吞下那些崩落的碎片。留下的空洞既無形體也無存在，只是不斷向內扭曲。
These gaps grow, inexorably, and encroach upon one another. What is overlapped returns to a world unseen and alien- Less than what used to be taken, but taken all the same.
這些缺口不可阻擋地擴大，彼此侵犯。重疊之處回到看不見、也不屬於此地的世界——被奪走的比從前少了，但終究還是被奪走了。
And what is responsible? What remains here should not- trapped far from whence it came.
而這是誰造成的？留在這裡的，本不該留下——它被困在遠離來處的地方。
What feeds the paradox's growth spares no thought- commanding its force as we would breathe.
餵養這場悖論的東西不假思索——它驅使那股力量，就像我們呼吸一樣自然。
The valley is nearly consumed. Then, the wastes are to be consumed. The obelisk, consumed after. On and on.
谷地就快被吞噬殆盡。接著輪到荒原，再來是方尖碑。一個接著一個，沒有盡頭。
Doomed to mutation, desolation, darkness, and despair...from that which bears no name.
注定走向異變、荒蕪、黑暗與絕望……全都來自那無以名之者。

The hell are you? Some random traveler?
你是哪根蔥啊？路過的旅人？
Well... My job is to shoo folks like you... But I don' get to talk to people often. So let's talk.
嗯……我的工作是把你這種人趕走……不過我很少有機會跟人說話。所以咱們聊聊吧。
Practically everyone 'ere knows me... Some've even seen me... I'm locally feared...
這一帶幾乎人人都知道我……有些人甚至見過我……我在這兒可是人人聞風喪膽的……
But... It's a livin'! I'm doin' what I'm supposed to, and it's the only purpose I've ever known. Besides alcohol, 'course.
不過……這是混口飯吃嘛！我做我該做的事，這也是我這輩子唯一的使命。喔，當然，除了喝酒以外。
Well... Yeah. It's jus' - Eugh. Dey haven't CRRRROAK IN' paid me my fair share in ages!
嗯……是啦。就是——呃。他們已經他呱～～的好幾百年沒付我該拿的那份了！
Usually when someone comes to da door, it's DEM. But not today. Not for da past month.
平常有人來敲門，都是他們。可今天不是。整整一個月都不是。
Say. Maybe YOU could 'elp. Dey pay me with bottles o' delicious green liquid. Forget da name. I bet you can get it elsewhere, though.
欸。說不定你能幫上忙。他們都用一瓶瓶好喝的綠色液體付我。名字我忘了。不過我打賭你在別的地方也弄得到。
Dey tend to come from the east side a' the Bog. I think. Maybe if ya looked there, ya'd find the stuff I want.
他們通常是從沼澤東邊來的。我想啦。你去那邊找找，說不定就能找到我要的東西。
In exchange? Err... Tell ya what. I'll let'cha into my place. And we can have a nice conversation about... Er... Whatever you want, I guess.

第二朵花開在社群之樹裡面，這棵樹就長在{c2}我們四周{/}！
